༄/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i glu/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa hā dza gī ti/ bod skad du/ lhan cig skyes pa'i glu/ bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong pa'i nags las me tog rab rgyas pa/ /me tog gcig la kha dog sna tshogs te/ /dpe med me tog skyes na phyogs las rgyal/ /rin thang rnged pa'i me tog longs shig 2dang / /de la rtsa ba rnged byung yal 'dab med/ /grogs dag ser kha bzang po'i phyogs rgyal ltos / /dpe med me tog skyes na phyogs las rgyal/ /rin thang med pa'i me tog longs shig 1dang / /ge sar blangs pas sgyu 'phrul mkhan po yin/ /rdo rje dbang phyug chos kyi dbyings la mchod/ /dpe med rnge tog skyes na phyogs las rgyal/ /rin thang med pa'i rnge tog longs shig 4dang / /mchog dang dga' bral rnam par brtags te zung / /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas mchod / /dpe med me tog skyes na phyogs las rgyal/ /rin thang med pa'i me 27—3

༄/ /rang bzhin gyi do ha mjod kyi glu'i lta ba jes bya ba/tsho ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ taṭ+wā ṭ+wāṃswa bhā ba dṛṣ+ṭi gī ti ka do ha nā ma/bod skad du/ rang bzhin gyi do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med bdud rtsi kun 'dus grub thob kyi/ /dri med dgongs pa lta spyod la sogs ni/ /nyams len thabs de kun la phan pa'i phyir / /bde gshegs rnams la phyag 'tshal bshad par bya/ /dngos po yang ni ma yin zhing / /dngos med la ni ma skyes pa'i/ /'di lta bu yi rang bzhin ni//su zhig gis ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /lū yi pa ni smra bar byed/ /'di lta bu ni ngo mtshar che/ /khams gsum gnas su longs spyod kyang / /de nyid gnas ni rtogs pa med/ /de yi kha dog rigs dang ni/ /dbyibs kyang bdag gis rtogs pa me+ed/ /de lta bu yi rang bzhin ni/ /dngos por ma grub ji ltar bstan—/ /lū yi pa ni smra bar byed/ /'di lta bu ni ngo mtshar che/ /khams 27—5

gsum gnas su longs spyod kyang / /de nyid gnas ni rtogs pa med/ /bdag gis gzhan la ji ltar dri/ /chu gting zla ba'i shegazugs brnyan ni/ /don dam sgyu mar rtogs pa med/ /lū yi pa ni smra bar byed/ /'di lta bu ni ngo mtshar che/ /khams gsum gnas su longs spyod kyang / /de nyid gnas ni rtogs pa med/ /lū yi pa ni smra bar byed/ /bdag gis gzhan la ji ltar dri/ /de yi rang bzhin rtogs pa med/ /rang bzhin gyi do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon lū yi pas mdzad pa rdzogs soXge // //bsdur mchan/5 41mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta//6 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 2〈〈snar 〉snosto/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1171)27—6

༄/ /rnam rtog spang ba'i glu zhes bya ba/sne༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi kalpa pa ri ha rasnyi ka nā ma/ bod skad du/rnam rtog spang ba'i glu zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bo 2la gsang ba'i rdo rje la/ /'dus pa sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /thig le gsang ba'i rtsa la byeng / /kak+ko la yi kha spyor la/ /kye ho re ni 'bar bar byed/ /kṛ pi ta yi sgra sgrogs pas/ /rtsa drug 'khor lo hūṃ gis bcing / /sku gsum dhū tīr bdag med rtogs / /rang byung me tog ldan pa yi/ /ga pur bo la bsres byas nas/ /ka ru ka'i bdud rtsi 'thung bar gyis/ /ka li dze ra skal bar ldan/ /rnal 'byor tshogs su bsre bar bya/ /'du 4dhur skal bar mi ldan te/ /spongs shig rnal 'byor dam tshig go/ /bzhi mnyam gla rtsi lus byugs nas/ /rtog pa rnams ni spang bar bya/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs dag tu/ /te ru ka yi nga rgyal ldan/ /sha wa 5zhing chen khur byas nas/ /ma la rigs skyes bram ze la/ /kun du phrad pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /27—7

༄/ /las kyi gtum mo'i do ha mdzod kyi glu jes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ karma tsaṇ+ḍa lbo 2ka do ha gī ti nā ma/ bod skad du / las kyi gtum mo'i do ha mdzod kyi glu zhes bya ba/ don thams cad grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nang nas gtum mo'i me sbar bas/ /dbus nas bdud rtsi 'bab par byed/ /rang byung 4sdong bu skyes pa yis5 ste mo'i ri la phyin te gnas/ /mgon po'i bdud rtsi 'bab par byed/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yun ring bcom/ /gshin rjer 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa spangs/ /sangs rgyas yon tan phreng ba 'byung / /bde ba chen po rgyas pa yis/ /thams cad kyis ni khyab par 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i snyug bsngal yun ring bcom/ /gshin rjer 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa spangs/ /rdo rjes brkos 6shing bgos pa la/ /nyi zla gnyis ni bsres byas nas/ /nam mkha'i dbyengs su thim par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po'i grong du phyin/ /kun dbus sangs rgyas yon tan gyis/ /rin chen 27—9

༄ / /lta sgom spyod pa 'azas bu'i do ha'i glu jes bya ba/rka༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ba 2na dṛṣ+ṭi tsār+ya pha la do ha gī ti ka nā ma/bod skad du/ lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu'i do ha'i 4glu zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po sna tshogs rang gi sems nyid yin//'khor 'das thams cad rnal 'byor dbyer med pa/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med pa ste/ /dper na chu dang de yi rlabs bzhin no/ /dngos dang dngos min spangs pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor skad cig gcig la ni/ /sgron me chung ngu zhig gis mun pa ltar/ /'khor ba'i dug lnga rang bzhin rab rib sel/ /zung 'jug phyag rgya 5blo 'das chen po ni/ /bde gsal mi rtog nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /khyab cing rgya chen snying rje chen po'i ngo / /snang yang rang bzhin med pa chu zla bzhin/ /gsal yang tha snyad mtha' dbus kun dang bral/ /gang gis ma gos dri med re dogs bral/ /lkugs pa'i rmi 27—/ 1

lam bzhin du smra mi shes/ /tshad med bde chen rang bzhin ye shes ni/ /nyi zla'i 'od bzhin phyogs dang bral ba rnged/ /kye ho rnal 'byor rang 'byung ngo mtshar che/ /gnyug ma ma bcos sems ni chos sgu ste/ /bcos pa'i sems kyis rnal 'byor thob mi 'gyur/ /de phyir bde ba'i phyogs su yan par mthong / /rang bzhin grub pa'i lam thob rnal 'byor bde/ /rnam rtog bral bas zhe 'dod 'byung mi srid/ /rta mgrin grub thob bdag nyid sar has smras/ /kye ho rnal 'byor lta ba'i nyams len gyis/ /de yi rang bzhin gang zhig sgom 'dod na/ /rang lus ri bo 'di ni gnas kyi mchog /sems nyid dus kyi rnal 'byor sgrub pa po / /dbang po rnams babyungs mtshams bcad bde bar 'gyur/ /g.yeng ba rnams kyang ched du spang mi bya/ /tug phrad sems su shes na yi dam lha/ /shes pa ma bkug rtog pa rim gyis spangs/ /sems la rnam rtog byung na rnal 'byor pas / /ras bal 'dab ma bzhin du glod la zhog /bya ba spongs la rang sems rang gis ltos/ /zhe 'dod byung na bdud du shes par gyis/ /rnam rtog rnams kyi rtsa ba sems yin te/ /de med phyir na rnam rtog yod min no/ /dran pa dran med bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor te/ /sems 'di rtag par ma grub rang la thim / /bsgom 'dod med pas sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob/ /rnal 'byor bu chung lta bur rtog pa med/ /ldum ra'i bung bas 1me tog ro myang ltar/ /nags nas nags su 'khyam pa seng ge bzhin/ /kun du rgyu ba sna tshogs rlung ltar ni/ /sems nyid bag dang ldan pa spyod pa'i mchog /rang bzhin mi dgag sbyon pa lta bur spyod2/ /rgyab tu mi chags mdun du zhen pa med/ /mdor na lta sgom spyod pa nyams len la/ /ji ltar phan pa'i spyod pas rnal 'byor spyod/ /sna tshogs 27—12

snang ba sems kyi ngo bo 'di/ /tug 1phrad tsam gyis ma grub phyag rgya che/ /snang la mi snang 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'byung / /de la sems na dngos grub dam pa yin/ /phyi nang thams cad lhan cig skyes pa 'di/ /rnam rtog chu bo'i rgyun gye rnal 'byor 'dra / /de yang sems las gzhan na btsal du med/ /yid la mi gzhag 2 phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /'bras bu ma re rtogs na phyag rgya che/ /ma rtogs rtog pa nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ /rtogs na de nyid rang bzhin stong pa yin/ /lta spyod 'bras bu dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ /rang bzhin dbyer med rtogs 4na 'bras bu'i mchog /lta sgom spyod 5pa 'bras bu do ha'i glu zhes bya ba slob dpon sa ra ha pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

༄/ /do ha mdzod kyi de nyid kyi riglu zhas bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ taṭ+wāṃ —do ha gī ti ka nā ma/ bod skad du/do ha mdzod kyi de nyid kyi glu zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtags na bdag gzhan dngos po med/ /byis pa lkugs pa'i rmi lam 'dra/ /de nyid rtogs pa shin tu dka'/ /byis pa rgyan po rtse ba 'dra/ /tha ka na ni smra bar byed/ /de nyid tshig gis brjod pa dka'/ /snang stong rtog pa ma sel bar /thar pa thob par ga la 'gyur/ /lus ngag yid gsum dbyings su ni/ /de nyid mnyam par ma shes na/ /de nyid rtogs par shin tu dka'/ /byes pa rgyan po rtse ba 'dra/ /dngos po tshig gis brjod pa dka'/ /chos rnams tshig tu smra ba yang / /tshig tsam gyis ni 'grub bam ci/ /sems kyi de nyid ma rtogs par / /thams cad gcig par rtogs pa med/ /don dam rtogs pa shin tu dka' / /byes pa rgyan po rtse ba 'dra/ /tha ka na ni smra bar byed/ /do ha 27—15

༄/ /spyod pa'i do ha mjod kyi glu jes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsār+ya do ha gī ti ka nā ma/ bod skad du/spyod pa'i do ha mdzod kyi glu zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ldong ros kyis ni thig le byas/ /ka tsa ri ni bstan par bya/ /kye ma rtse 2mos bdud bzhi bcom/ /gzi brjid ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /smra bar byed pa'i khyab 'jug gam/ /drag po tshangs pa bsrung mi nus/ /kye ma gal te smra ba na/ /'chi bdag gis ni za bar 'gyur/ /ma rungs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bsrungs//kye ma rmongs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /glags tshol bsam pas ci zhig bya/ /kye ho byol song mkha' 'gro ma/ /glags tshol bsam pas ci zhig bya/ /kye ho 'bar ba'i mer ma dug /gzi brjid ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /smra bar byed pa khyab 'jug gam/ /drag po tshangs pa bsrung mi nus/ /ji ltar sru gri ral gri'i so/ /de bzhin la ba pa yi zhabs/ /dam tshig spyod pa ngo mtshar che/ /gzi brjid 27—17

ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /smra bar byed pa khyab 'jug gam/ /drag po tshangs pa bsrung mi nus/ /spyod pa'i do ha mdzod kyi glu zhes bya ba slob dpon kai ka 33ba la nas brgyud pa slob dpon kaṅka 2nas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/17 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsed/18 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wam 〈〈〈pe 〉〉kam 1 〈〈snar 〉〉rka kabasdur 'bras re'u mig rgyud/ (1176)27—18

༄/ /lhan cig byes dga'i do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ha dzā ā rtenan+da gī ti ka dṛṣ+ṭi nā ma/ bod skad du/ lhan cig skyes dga'i do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis sbyor dug po brang la bstabs/ /bha dhe pa ni gnyid du log /ji ltar kun la mkhas pa yis/ /dug po de ni ji ltar khyer/ /tshem bu thob par gyur pa na/ /chags sdang gti mug gnas su dag /tshem bu 'di la dbye ba'am/ /rin kyi grangs kyis chod pa med/ /da ni bdag gi tshem bu 'di/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam par 'gyur/ /tshem bu thob par 'gyur ba na—/ /chags sdang gti mug gnas su dag /bha dhe tshem bu tshol du phyin/ /thams cad du ni btsal bas na/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dmigs med 'gyur/ /tshem bu thob par 'gyur ba na/ /chags sdang gti mug gnas su dag /lhan cig skyes dga'i do ha mdzod kyi glu'i lta ba zhes pa slob dpon bha dhes mdzad pa 27—19

༄7/ /bde gshegs kyi lta ba'i glu jes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ su ga ta dṛṣ+ṭa gī ti ka nā ma/ bod skad du/bde gshegs kyi lta ba'i glu zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /thams cad du ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /skye 'gag snyug bsngal sgrol phyir mdzad/ /dha ma pa ni smra bar byed/ /bde gshegs spyi bor bkur ba yis/ /bdag nyid don dam de nyid rtogs/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi 2lha khang du/ /'di ru bdag ni rab tu 'byung / /chos rnams thams cad khong du chud/ /dha ma pa ni smra bar byed/ /bde gshegs spyi bor bkur ba 4yis/ /bdag gis don dam de nyid rtogs/ / ri rab dang ni rtswa yi tshogs/ /ji ltar srang la gzhal lam ci/ /de bzhin phyi rol thams cad kyis/ /lta ba 'di dang mnyam mam ci/ /dha ma pa ni smra bar byed/ /bde gshegs spyi bor bkur ba yis/ /bdag gis don dam de nyid rtogs/ /527—21

༄/ /rlung gi de nyid kyi do ha'i glu zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā yu ta two do ha gī ti ka nā ma/ bod skad du/rlung gi de nyid kyi do ha'i glu zhes bya ba/ gnyis med bde chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtan g.yo rlung gi gzhal yas khang / /sems kyi rdo rje gdan du bzhugs/ /stong pa nyid ni zab mo la/ /kye ho lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /dga' mo bdag gi dpang du gsol/ /srid pa 'di ni rab g.yos na/ /slar yang ji ltar phrad par 'gyur/ /skye bo lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /mdzes ma bdag gi dpang du gsol//khyed ni bzhugs na bdag gis ni/ /ji ltar bdag gis gzhan la btsal/ /gru ni 'byeng bar 'gyur ba la/ /yongs su drang bar 'dod pa la/ /kye ho lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /dga' mo bdag gi dpang du gsol/ /srid pa 'di ni rab g.yos na/ /be+er yang ji ltar phrad par 'gyur/ /khyed kyi slad du bdag gis ni//rigs lnga'i grong ni bsang byas kyang / /khyod kyi zhal ni bdag gis ni/ /skad 27—23

cig gcig kyang ma mthong ngo / /kye ho lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /dga' mo bdag gi dpang du gsol/ /srid pa 'di ni rab g.yos na/ /slar yang ji ltar phrad par 'gyur/ /kye ho lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /mdzes ma bdag gi dpang du gsol//khyed kyi be+ed du bdag gis ni/ /phyag rgya dgos te cung tsam yang / /rigs ngan 1bram ze'i bsam pa med/ /kye ho lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /dga' mo bdag gi dpang du gsol/ /srid pa 'di ni rab g.yos na/ /slar yang ji ltar phrad par 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho'i nang du gzings 2bcas pa/ /thod pa can na kaṇ+ḍi las / /ma his gdams ngag thob par 'gyur/ /srid pa'i bcing ba 4yongs su bcad/ /kye ho lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /mdzes ma bdag gi dpang du gsol/ /rlung gi de nyid kyi do ha'i glu zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po nas brgyud pa slob dpon ma hi pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

༄/ /dpyid kyi thig le do ha mjod kyi glu zhes bya ba/ri1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ba sarnyi nati la ka do ha gri ti ka nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpyid kyi thig le do ha mdzod kyi glu zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /se bhu sgu gsum la sogs kyi/ /sos ka'i me tog mthong ba yi/ /gzhon nu bdag ni myos par 'gyur/ /te ru ka la chags pa yis/ /sos ka'i dang po dang po 'dir/ /khyod kyis bdag ni bsrung —bar mdzod/ /gdung bas 'gum par ma mdzad cig /me tog saṃ bha ka ru ṇa/ /dri bsung ldan pas dgyes par 'gyur/ /sha ris pas 4ni brdungs pas brdungs/ /me mar khur nas tsaṇ+ḍa līde/ /ri 6mo bdag la 'bab bo zhes/ /ka na pa ni gshegs par re//so ga'i )dang po dpyid dus la/ /khyod kyis bdag ni bsrung bar mdzod/ /gdung bas 'gum par ma mdzad cig /phyogs bcur bltas na bdag gis ni/ /khyod las gzhan ni mthong ba med/ /gdung ba'i mo 8 yis bdag gis ni/ /27—26

༄/ /rdo rje bzhi'i glu zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra tsa tur gī ti ka nā ma/ bod skad du/rdo rje bzhi'i glu zhes bya ba/ dpal sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi mthun sems ni khyod ma bsgom/ /de nyid de bzhin nyid ma 'dzin/ /'bras bu re ba sgom 2ma byed/ /mi dmigs phyag rgya chen po bsgom / /gal te mnol la gnas med na/ /de ni dpal gyi theg chen min/ /'bras bu re ba sgom 4ma byed/ /mi dmigs phyag rgya chen po bsgom5/ /phung po khams te phyag rgya che/ /dam tshig 'khor lo de rang bzhin/ /'bras bu re ba sgom 6ma byed/ /mi dmigs phyag rgya chen po bsgom7/ /gnyis med yon tan rgyal 'di yin/ /gnyis med yon tan rnal 'byor gsung / /'bras bu re ba sgom ma byed/ /mi dmigs phyag rgya chen po bsgom / /shā 9ri'i yul du sku 'khrungs pa/ /a ba dhū tī gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa a ma ra sing gi glu rdzogs so// //27—28

sto /bla ma mai tri'i glu/nyu ༄go/ /gang yang mi skye mi 'gag dngos po bcing ba named/ /khams gsum grol med 'khrul pa rnams la snang / /rtsa ba sems nyid sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /thog med 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin gzhigs na rnyed mi 'gyur/ /dngos rnams gdod nas skye med mthong ba gang zhig yin/ /su zhig skye bar 'gyur dang 'gag dang bcing ba sems/ /rtsa ba sems nyid sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /thog rnged 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin gzhigs na rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems ni nam mkha' dri med dang 'dra slob dpon gsung / /srid pa gsum po de 'dra'i rang bzhin yin/ /rtsa ba sems nyid sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin ni//thog med 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin gzhigs na rnyed mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin mi rtog rang rig nyams su myong bas 'grub/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal 'khrul pas ci phyir rmongs par 'gyur/ /rtsa ba sems nyid sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin 27—30

༄7/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab mo zab mo 'jig rten kun smra yang / /ma skyes pa la dga' ba 2'ga' zhig 'dug /kye sems kyi zab mo shes par dka' bas na/ /lhan cig skyes pa gzhigs na rnged pa yin/ /mi gnas sems ni mi dmigs pa la bzhag /rnal 'byor me yis dngos po thams cad bsreg /kye sems kyi zab mo shes par dka' bas na/ /lhan cig skyes pa gzhigs na med pa yin/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa bla mas bstan du med/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs gong na med pa len/ /kye sems kyi zab mo shes par dka' bas na / /lhan cig skyes pa gzhigs na med pa yin/ /dpal gyi bde ba chen po tshol 'dod na / /dbus ma tshol 'dod mig med khron par ltung / /kye sems kyi zab mo rtogs par dka' bas na/ /lhan cig skyes pa gzhigs na med pa yin//sa ra ha pa'i —glu rdzogs so// //27—32

1257༄༅/ /sa ra ha'i glu/ 1 ༄7/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong pa dang ni snying rje'i rang bzhin 'dres/ /stong nyid dbyer med rgyun mi 'chad par yod/ /bdag gis stong pa'i rnal 'byor ma de mthong / /nam mkha' bzhos shing bzhos shing 'thung zhing 'dug /nam mkha' nam mkhar sbyor ba de ma mthong / /'khor bas bcings pa'i sa la de mi gnas/ /bdag gis stong pa'i rnal 'byor ma de mthong //nam mkha' bzhos shing bzhos shing 'thung zhing 'dug /de 'dra'i rnal 'byor rtsa ba'i khyim las g.yo/ /snying rje'i ro chen dri ma med pa yin/ /bdag gis stong pa'i rnal 'byor ma de mthong / /nam mkha' bzhos shing bzhos shing 'thung zhing 'dug /sa ra has brjod gang gzhan ci phyir byed/ /nyin dang mtshan du nam mkha' 'jo 2phyir 'gro/ /bdag gis stong pa'i rnal 'byor ma de mthong / /nam mkha' bzhos shing bzhos shing 'thung zhing 'dug /sa ra 27—34
ha'i glu rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/34 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabyo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1184)27—35

༄/ /bo rū byed pa'i rdo rje'i glu/ 1༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mda' 'dzin te//chos rnams mtshon par rab shes nas/ /nga yis lhan skyes mda' 'phangs rgyab/ /'be+en med gcig kyang phog pa med/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gtam gson cig /thams cad dngos por sbyor ba'i mda'/ /nga yis lhan skyes mda' 'phangs rgyab //'ben rnged gcig nakyang phog pa med/ /de rnams nas ni tshor ba med/ /de yi 'di yin gnyis sked song / /nga yis lhan skyes mda' 'phangs rgyab/ /'be+en med gcig 4kyang phog pa med/ /gla ster 'gron bu nyi shu rnged/ /de 'dra'i khol po bi rū 5byed/ /nga yis lhan skyes mda' 'phangs rgyab/ /'be+en med gcig 6kyang phog pa med/ /bi dru 7byed pa'i rdo rje'i glu rdzogs so// //27—36

bsdur mchan/36 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brgyab/ rduge〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1185)

༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bum pa rdo rje sogs/ /grol bar mi lta phung po 'grangs pa'i thabs/ /ka na pas brjod de 'dra su zhig byed/ /thams cad brdzun pas slu ba yin par 'dod/ /ka na pa'i glu rdzogs so// //27—38
bsdur mchan/38 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1186)27wa 39

1260༄/ /bla ma rje btsun byeṣ+ṭi dzñā na'i zhal snga nas rdo rje'i glu zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye bram ze ral can skyes bu sang gha ba/ /sangs rgyas ye shes dag la mos par gyis/ /de 'dra'i skyes bu'i sems ni dga' ba yin/ /brtan g.yo thams cad dri med rin po che/ /mi gnas rang bzhin bung ba khyod ni bsgom2/ /yang dag bla ma'i man ngag nan tan gyis/ /de 'dra'i skyes bu'i sems ni dga' ba yin/ /brtan g.yo thams cad dri med rin po che/ /mi gnas rang bzhin bung ba ma skyes pa/ /rmi lam bud med de bzhin med pa ste/ /de 'dra'i skyes bu'i sems ni dga' ba yin/ /brtan g.yo thams cad dri med rin po che/ /mi gnas rang bzhin bung ba de shes na / /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas dngos grub 'grub/ /de 'dra'i skyes bu'i sems ni dga' ba yin/ /brtan g.yo thams cad dri med rin po che/ /mi gnas pa'i don thugs su chud pa bla ma rje btsun byeṣ+ṭi dzñā na'i zhal snga nas rdo rje'i 27—40
glu zhes dra/ ba jordogs so// //bsdur mchan/4༷ 91 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1187) 27go41

༄/ /bla ma byespyo jo na'i zhal snga nas kyi glu/1 ༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar bltas pa de ltar mthong ba med/ /brdzun pa med pa'i slu ba 'ba' zhig ste/ /bsam mi khyab cing grub smra he ru pa/ /skyob pa'i sems kyis rang bzhin gzugs mi shes/ /ji ltar de ltar glo bur gang la bzhag /'dod pa'i mdung gis rang la ci ste 2/zug /bsam mi khyab cing grub smra he ru pa/ /skyob pa'i sems kyis rang bzhin gzugs mi shes/ /lhan cig sems te mkha' lus bde snying lus/ /gnyis med gnyis yin stong dang snying rje'i sems/ /bsam gyis mi khyab grub smra he ru pa/ /skyob pa'i sems kyis rang bzhin gzugs mi shes/ /de ni mi skye mi 'gag rkyen rnged de//rang bzhin rtogs na rtsa ba'i sems shes yin/ /bsam kyis mi khyab grub smra te ru pa / /skyob pa'i sems kyis rang bzhin gzugs mi shes/ /bla ma byeṣ+ṭi dzñā na'i zhal snga nas kyi glu rdzogs so// //27—42

1262༄ga /glu/hwasna/༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ma khams gsum sems can rnams / /rnam rtog sgrog gis dam bcings te/ /'khor ba'i mya ngan 'dam 2bu ru/ /phyogs bcu kun du rnam par 'khyam / /e ma 4khams gsum bde bar gshegs/ /gdod ma nyid nas grol ba che/ /rnam dag zhing ni bde ba can//sangs rgyas rol mo rab tu ston/ /kye ma rnam rtog 3sdug bsngal lam/ /phyin pa'i dus med smon pa bzhin/ /bde bral 'dod pa snyug bsngal nyid/ /mnyam nyid don la rab tu gol/ /e ma'o lam med lam gyi mchog /lhun rdzogs nam mkha'i bya bzhin du/ /re dogs med la phyag rgya che/ /skyon yon dbang gis bslad du med/ /kye ma'o bskal pa grangs med gsum/ /de nyid btsal bas mi rnyed de/ /rmongs pa nam mkha'i mtha' tshol bzhin/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya rnyed mi srid/ /e ma'o skad cig gcig nyid la/ /ma bral 'bras 27—44

1263༄ / /gaṇ+ḍa ri'i glu/༄1 ༄7/ /mkha' la ba 'jo 'jo byed bla ma ste/ /'thung ba'i be+e'u ni rang gi sems nyid yin/ /mkha' la rgyun mi 'chad 'jo ka na pa/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /ba 'jo snod gsol ga re mā ma shī/ /ba 'jo sgod ni dri rnged lhan cig skyes/ /mkha' la rgyun mi 'chad 'jo ka na pa/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /mkha' la bzhos shing bzhos shing snod bkang bzhag /bzung bar mi nus 'di ltar glang po lnga/ /mkha' la rgyun mi 'chad 'jo ka na pa/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ /mkha' la ba 'jo 'jo byed 'dir ma mthong / /ji ltar nang du chus gang ka li pa//mkha' la rgyun mi 'chad 'jo ka na pa/ /rnal 'byor sdom pa'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul / /gaṇ+ḍa 2ri'i glu rdzogs so// //27—46

1264༄/ /ma ti byu be+e'i glu/1༄7/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog gcig rgyas kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /stong pa'i ljon shing dag las shin tu rgyas/ /btsan po dpe med rnge tog rab rgyas pa/ /rin thang med pa'i me tog 'di snoms shig /de shing rtsa ba yal ga lo ma med/ /ltos dang zla nyal 'gro ni bzang po'i dus/ /btsan po dpe rnged me tog rab rgyas pa/ /rin thang med pa'i me tog 'di snoms shig /ge sar gcod mkhas sgyu ma'i mkhan po yin/ /chos dbyings rdo rje dbang phyug mchod pa 'bul/ /btsan po dpe med me tog rab rgyas pa/ /rin thang med pa'i me tog 'di snoms shig /mchog dga' dang ni dga' bral gzhig nas longs / /yang dag bla ma'i zhabs btud nan tan gyis/ /btsan po dpe med me tog rab rgyas pa/ /rin thang med pa'i me tog 'di snoms shig /ma ti tsi tri'i glu rdzogs so// //27—48

༄7/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi//dge dang mi dge'i las rnams la/ /dga' dang mi dga' khyod ma byed/ /rang dga' ye shes seng ge bzhin/ /chos nyid zab mo rnal 'byor yul/ /sgom dang mi sgom byang chub sems/ /ldan dang mi ldan khyod ma byed/ /rang dga' ye shes seng ge bzhin/ /sangs rgyas dang ni sems can gyi/ /spyod pa'i lam ni 'di yin zhes/ /mthun dang mi mthun khrod ma byed/ /rang dga' ye shes seng ge bzhin / /bde dang sdug bsngal 'bras bu'i chos/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la/ /re dang dogs pa khyod ma byed/ /rang dga' ye shes seng ge bzhin/ /2rdzogs so// //27—50

༄go/ /bdag ni 'dug ste shi dang ma shi med/ /bdag gi yid la don gcig 'jug pa med/ /ka na'i 2ral gris zhags pa rab bcad pas/ /da lta re ba med de ba da smra/ /gru gnyis sna la rkang pa rab bzhag nas/ /lus 'gyal gyur te sems la sdug bsngal skye/ /ka na'i ral gris zhags pa rab bcad pas/ /da lta re ba med de ba da smra/ /mi gang rtsa ba khron pas bskor gyur kyang / /shing gcig la ni 'bras bu gnyis mi 'byung / /ka na'i ral gris zhags pa rab bcad pas/ /da 4lta re ba med de ba da smra/ /mig sman ri lu 5bcud len rkang dngos grub/ /de rnams la ni bdag ci 6le lor gyur / /ka na'i ral gris zhags pa rab bcad pas/ /da 7lta re ba med de ba da smra/ /rdzogs so// //27—52

bsdur mchan/52 7mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde bstan dkar chag 〉〉ltar bkod/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyel/〈〈co 〉toragyil/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ 31〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ril bu/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉de/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1193) 27wa 53

༄/ /ā tsār+ya dpa' bo rnam par snang mdzad kyi glu/sna ༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye yul rnams thams cad lta 'dod na/ /ri bo chen po'i kha nas ltos/ /chos rnams thams cad skye 'gag rnged2 / /rang sems rig na ra rab rtse/ /chu rnams thams cad 'thung 'dod na/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu la 'thung / /skye med byang chub sems kyi chu/ /mtha' dbus sked pa'i rgya mtsho che/ /brtan g.yo thams cad bsreg 'dod na/ /'jig pa'i dus kyi me chen spor4/ /rnam rtog brtan g.yo thams cad de/ /lhun grub ye shes sems kyi me/ /'jigs med bde ba'i gnas 'dod na/ /dgon pa chen po'i gnas su 'dug /'khor ba rnam dag bde ba'i gnas/ /byang chub sems ni dgon pa che/ /ā tsār+ya 5dpa' bo rnam par snang mdzad kyi glu rdzogs so// //27—54

bsdur mchan/54 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ tsho(〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa'i yul/ zhu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉re/ ④〈〈pe 〉yar/ ri'u 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsar+ya/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1194)27—55

༄/ /ṅgā ro paṇ+ḍi ta'i glu/ hūṃ༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin bdag med ma de ni/ /bdag gi go rims 37byed pa yin/ /chags pa med pa de yis ni/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed pa yin/ /skye dang 'chi ba srid pa yin/ /'khrul pa rnams ni spong ba yin/ /bde ba chen po ster byed pa'i/ /len gyi 'khrul pa ma yin no/ /des na kha dog dbyibs med de/ /tshad kyang yod pa ma mthong ngo / /'dod pa med pa de yis ni/ /nga rgyal skye ba mi 'dod do/ /gang tshe bdag med ma de ni/ /bdag gi snying la zhugs pa na/ /bdag dang gzhan rnams ma lus pa'i/ /dbye ba yod par ma mthong ngo / /'gro ba rnged cing 'ong ba med/ /gar yang gnas pa ma yin te/ /nam mkha' yi ni ngo bo ltar/ /yongs su gsal bar snang ba yin / /thub pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /ma lus pa dang ral pa ni/ /de ni me li bdag med mar/ /de ltar bdag med /smra ba yin/ /nā ro paṇ+ḍi ta'i 27—56
(1 :rdob/ba/ skras// //bsdur mchan/56 〉mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ tshon 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab rir du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)da/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1195)

༄4/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can nyon mongs gdung bas sa stengs 27bskor ba'i lha/ /de lta na yang bde chen chung ma'i lus mi 'dor/ /kye kye dpe med chung ma la ni rab tu chags/ /bskal pa dpag med mi 'bral gtso bo'i 'jig rten lha/ /shin tu ngo mtshar bdud kyi chung ma de mi len/ /gzhan las khyad 'phags gzugs mchog mnga' ba'i lha/ /kye kye dpe med chung ma la ni rab tu chags/ /bskal pa dpag med mi 'bral gtso bo 'jig rten lha/ /'gro ba brgya phrag mang po nad kyis thebs la bskor/ /de dag bde ster lha ni khams gsum me long yin/ /kye kye dpe med chung ma la ni rab tu chags/ /bskal pa dpag med mi 'bral gtso bo'i 'jig rten lha/ /mnyam med mnyam pa'i bde gsol ma ti do 1ha na/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan mang ldan kār+ṣa pa ṇa'i lha/ /kye kye dpe med chung ma la ni rab tu chags/ /bskal pa dpag med mi 'bral 27—58

gtso bo'i gyo)'jig rten lha/ /༷/ yi pa'i glu rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/58 ①mtshand byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steng / 1〈〈pe 〉〉59 ༷// ༷༵/'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1196)—— —27wa 59

༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu ma'i nags tshal mang po de dang der/ /ri dwags gsad phyir blon po ḍom+bi 2'go/ /log 'go ri dwags gar 'gro nga yis mthong / /ḍom+bi mda' rnon bkang nas nang du zhugs/ /mda' lnga yod de lnga ka shar kyis bton/ /ḍom+bi gzhu bkang gzung — nas rnam par 'dug /log lta'i ri dwags gar 4'gro nga yis mthong / /ḍom+bi mda' rnon bkang nas nang du zhugs/ /gzhu med rgyud med smyug med mde'u med/ /ḍom+bi the tshom med de nges par bsad/ /log lta'i ri dwags gar 'gro nga yis mthong / /ḍom+bi mda' rnon bkang nas nang du zhugs/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga dbu rgyan byas nas su/ /ri dwags bsad 5pa slar la sos 6par bya/ /log lta'i ri dwags gar 'gro nga yis mthong / /ḍom+bi mda' rnon )bkang nas nang du zhugs / /ḍom+bi'i glu rdzogs so// //27—60

༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan pa ngan pa 'jig rten kun smra yang / /gces pa'i yon tan dri med zab mo yod/ /ut+pal chu nang btus na chus mi reg /de 'dra'i mang po'i sgyu mkhan bi rū pa/ /tshong dus rke dang ni grong dang chu 'gram ni/ /gang du phyin nas lus 'gyel de mi shes/ /ut+pal chu nang btus na 4chus mi reg /de 'dra'i mang po'i sgyu mkhan bi byu pa/ /'jig rten ngan par smra ba de brdzun yin/ /khros pas 5gaṅgā bab pa rgyun las bzlog /ut+pal chu nang btus na 6chus mi reg /de 'dra'i mang po'i sgyu mkhan bi rū pa/ /nyi ma gta' 7mar bcug nas chang ni 'thungs/ /an+da 'jigs byas bhe me'i sa ra bshig /ut+pal chu nang btus na 8chus mi reg /de 'dra'i mang po'i sgyu mkhan bi rū pa/ /bi rū pa'i glu rdzogs so// //27—62

bsdur mchan/62 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 945〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradus/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nas/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ri(〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tonas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagate/ 'u〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1198)27wa 63

1272༄ / /lwa ba pa'i glu/bye༄go/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ltos ༷ dang skye ba gnas pa med pa na/ /de tshe lhan cig skyes dang khyad par sked/ / 1de nyid mi mthun pa de rnam 4par smros/ /'di ltar khams gsum bde bar gshegs pa lnga/ /de yi tshe na gang gis bcings par sems/ /de nyid rang bzhin shin tu go gyur nas/ /ji ltar mi mthun pa de rnam par sgos/ /'di kun rtsa ba'i rang bzhin ma rnyed stor/ /de'i tshe nam mkha'i rang bzhin mi 'chi 'am/ /de nyid rang bzhin shin tu go gyur nas / /de nyid mi mthun pa de rnam par smros/ /rmongs par ma byed gnyis med mdud pa yis/ /cis te stong pa'i khu tshur brdzun gyis bcings/ /de nyid rang bzhin shin tu go gyur nas/ /ji ltar mi mthun pa de rnam par smros/ /lwa 5ba pa'i glu rdzogs so// //27—64

1273༄༅/ /ma hā su kha ta'i glu/7 ༄7/ /ji ltar til la til mar khyab pa bzhin/ /de bzhin khams gsum 'jam dpal sku yis gang / /de shes lhan grub rnal 'byor bsgom pa yis//bde chen dam pa chos kyi glu 'di long / /bde gshegs kun gyi btsun mo ming med ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can snying rje can de dang / /lhan cig 'grogs na sbug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bde chen dam pa chos kyi glu 'di long / /nam mkha' nam mkha'i mtshan nyid ci 'dra bar/ /sems kyi chos nyid de 'dra bla ma gsung / /bla med don de mi shes bsgom mi nus/ /bde ba chen po chos kyi glu 'di long / /nyi ma me shel ras bal 'dus ji bzhin/ /lung dang man ngag de bzhin bsten 2pa las/ /rang rig ye shes me ni 'bar bar 'gyur/ /bde chen dam pa chos kyi glu 'di long / /glegs bam chos dang gzhan lag gnas pa'i nor/ /chos nor min te dgos pa'i dus na med/ /'phags pa'i nor 27—66

chen rang gi sems la chongs/ /bde chen dam pa chos kyi glu 'di long / /bde dang sdug bsngal gnas skabs thams cad du/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i de nyid byang chub sems/ /'jam dpal kun 'dul nyin mtshan nan tan byos/ /bde chen dam pa chos kyi glu 'di long / /ma hā su kha ta'i glu rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/66 41mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 〈〈〈pe 〉༄rten/ 〈〈snar 〉thartan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (/2༷༷)27—67

1274༄༅/ /rnal 'byer pra sa ra'i glu/ 1༄7/ /dpal sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu ngo mtshar bdag gis gtam/ /glang chen btsongs nas gnyid log ltar/ /gang zhig nor yod rngel tshe byed/ /kun khyab dpa' bo pra sa ra/ /chos dang chos min gtam mi 'dri / /rang byung rang bzhin g.yo ba med/ /glang chen btsongs nas gnyid log ltar/ /gang zhig nor yod mel tshe byed/ /kun khyab dpa' bo pra sa ra/ /rnal 'byor mai tri'i dbye shes pas/ /thog med dus bsags skyon kun bral/ /gang zhig nor yod mel tshe byed/ /kun khyab dpa' bo pra sa ra/ /rnal 'byor pra sa ra'i glu rdzogs so// //27—68

༄ṣ+ṭha/ /stong pa la gnas snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /zhing na bzhugs pa'i thabs dang shes rab tshogs/ /gzugs brnyan lta bur shes par bya/ /snying rje'i ro yis tha dad rtsod pa spangs/ /der ni kun rdzob yul gyi sha rnams bza' / /shin tu rnam dag stong pa'i chang ni btung / /skye 'gro skal ldan rnams la don 'di bstan/ /skal med rnams la shin tu gsang bar bya/ /rnam thar byug pas phyi nang brlan byas la/ /yul gyi longs spyod la ni ci bder spyad/ /phan tshun 'gro dang 'ong ba'i chos rnams la/ /dag dang ma dag yid la mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems kyi phreng bas rnam brgyan la/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nang du 'jug bya ste/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i g.yung mo mi spang ngo / /klu sgrub kyi glu rdzogs so// //27—70
bsdur mchan/7༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〉na/ ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (12༷2)

༄/ /dī paṃ ka ra s+thā dzñā na'-i chos kyi glu/1༄7/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog 'jig pa'i chom rkun 'jigs shes na/ /tshul khrims nor chen bsrung phyir mel tshe gyis/ /kye snyom las ma byed sems kyi rngel tshe gyis/ /gti mug gnyid kyis 'khor ba'i mtshan mo ring / /kye snyom 4las ma byed sems kyi mel tshe gyis/ /gnyid log na ni khyem nang 5chom rkun 'gro/ /khyod kyi tshul khrims nor chen 'phrog par 'gyur/ /tshul khrims nor de med na ting 'dzin med/ /de med na ni nyi ma 'char ba med/ /de nyid nyi ma bsgom pas mel tshe gyes/ /skad cig gcig kyang nor chung gzhan ma byed / /de yi dus na de nyid nyi ma 'char/ /'di ltar de tshe 'khor ba'i nam langs 'gyur/ /kye snyom 6las ma byed sems kyi mel tshe gyis/ /dī paṃ kā 7ra shrī dzñā na'i chos kyi glu rdzogs so// //

1277༄7/ /thig le babyu drug gi nyams len zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣe ḍa sha bin+d+ra bhā ba 2na nā ma/ bod skad du/thig le bcu drug gi nyams len zhes bya ba/ yum bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo//rang lus khong stong bsam byas nas/ /mtshan med a ba dhū tī la/ /'khor lo bzhi ni bsam par bya/ /yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhi ni/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs/ /bde gshegs lnga dang lha mo rnams/ /'dab brgyad pad+mar 4dgod par bya/ /khams dang phung po dag pa'i phyir/ /dbyangs can bcu drug longs spyod bsgom/ /de rnams nyis 'gyur spyi bo ru/ /bdag nyid bsrung ba'i man ngag go/ /bcu drug thig le rab tu 'bar/ /rtsa brgyad thig le rgyu ba yin/ /bzhi po zhu ste rol pa gnyis/ /gnyis kyi phyed ni bdag med ma/ /bcu drug phyed phyed grangs yin no/ /ka nas brtsams nas ma yi bar/ /reg byed nyi shu rtsa lnga yin/ /ya nas brtsams nas ha yi bar/ /mi reg 5ming can 27—74

brgyad yin no/ /basbus pa ā phreng kā phreng gnyis/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor bsam par bya/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis dros tsam na/ /khams gsum sreg cing zhu bar bsam/ /chos kyi rim pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /ri bong can gyis rgyas par 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro longs spyod bdag thim nas/ /dga' ba'i bdag nyid skad cig la/ /dpa' rgyal snying rje chen po skye/ /yang dag zung 'jug grub pa yis/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag par 'gyur/ /skye 'gag med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /kai ka li bdag grub pa thob/ /kye ho ma yengs rnal 'byor pa/ /rang gi sems la nyams len gyis/ /slob dpon kai ka li pas mdzad pa 'khor lo bzhi'i nyams len gyi 2zhal gdams rdzogs so// //27—75

1278༄/ /phyi nang byang chub sems bcing ba'i man ngag ces bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā hra an+tar bo bye tsit+ta brnya nā ma/ bod skad du / phyi nang byang chub sems bcing ba'i man ngag ces bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /lhan cig skyes te mun pas bsgribs/ /kun du skye ba'i nyams len ni/ /bdag gis 'di ru bshad par bya/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas bo la'i bar/ /sna tshogs rtsa ni bsgom par bya/ /de nas bde chen 'khor lo ru/ /sgo nga'i khog pa lta bu yi/ /byang chub sems la sems gtad nas/ /bo la'i rtse la rgyal lo tsam/ /gsal la sran rdog tsam du bsgom/ /bde chen sgo nga'i rtsa la ni/ /byang chub sems ni 'dzag par bya/ /lte ba'i bar du rnal 'byor kye/ /gnyis rnged bdud rtsis bkang byas nas/ /shes pa bde ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /sgom pa'i spyod yul phar mi spro/ /sems ni tshur la bkug mi bya/ /dper na sbrul gyi mdud pa 27—77

༄/ /rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ /༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā yu taṭ+wāṃ bhā ba 2no pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gho ra kha ni ba lang bsrung / /ba rdzi ba lang 'tsho bar byed/ /'tsho bar byed cing gnyis med 'gyur/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba gnyis/ /ro gcig par ni 'dres par 'gyur/ /sgo ra kha ni sgra gcan gyis/ /nyi ma zos pa ngo mtshar che/ /gal te rgyab kyi sgal tshigs su/ /drag tu bcings pas rnal 'byor pas / /skad cig tsam gyis khams su grub/ / gzhom du rnged cing kun nas dngas—/ /stong nyid dngos po rnam par gsal/ / nyi ma dang ni zla ba gnyis/ /ro gcig par ni 'dres par 'gyur/ /sgo ra kha ni sgra gcan gyis/ /nyi ma zos pa ngo mtshar che/ /shing bu gting du nub pa dang / /pha wang gyen du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dga' bas bdag ni bsgrubs 5so zhes/ /gho ra kha ni smra bar 27—79

1280༄/ /rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā yu taṭ+wāṃ bhā ba na 2nā ma/ bod skad du/rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod ma ni lhan skyes rtogs snyepa med/ /phra zhing mi dmigs rang bzhin yid 'ong ba/ /pad+ma'i dbus 'gyur sna tshogs rol mdzad de/ /dus kyi stobs kyis 4dpa' bo gnyis med pa/ /nam mkhar khyab cing thim par dmigs pa rnged/ /mnyam pa'i bde rtogs skad cig gcig la ni/ /khams gsum g.yo zhing bde lta rtogs pa ste/ /bla ma'i bka' yis gang yang lhan skyes so/ /bla mas ma rtogs lhan skyes gzhan du min/ /yon tan rnams la nga rgyal ma byed kye/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gnyid log myos 'gyur ba/ /dam tshig glang chen lta bur spyod/ /dbang po sgo dgu'i sngags kyis lam bkag pas/ /brtan pa'i bum pas de ni mya ngan 'das/ /pad+ma'i ge sar rlung gi 'byung 'jug 'di/ /brtan par 27—81

bcings na mgon po 'chags par 'gyur/ /rlung nyid thim pas mi 'gyur kha dog med/ /'byel med dran sems nyid ni stong pa la/ / bsgoms dang bsgom rgyu sgom byed 1de la med/ /g.yo ba'i sems nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis ni/ /sems kyi rgyal po brtan med mkha' la lding / /mnyam par non cig lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bya/ /sems nyid bde chen bkram pas mya ngan 'das/ /gti mug zhags pas bcings shing 2gzhan dag spongs/ /skad cig gcig la 'khor ba'i chags pa bral/ /de nyid bcings pas bya ba bral 'gyur ba/ /'gro ba drug tu yang dag bye mi len/ /gang zhig rtsa sgor ma yengs gnas pa des/ /drag po'i rkun mas de la 'jigs pa med/ /gang zhig brdzun rku brdzun mi mya ngan rnged/ /sngags nyid rang gi lus la gnas pa ste/ /bde ba thams cad rnal 'byor dran par gyis/ /bde ba rtogs pas rnal 'byor skyes 'gyur ba/ /khyim gyi bdag mo rang lus rang bzhin tshim gnas la/ /rlung gi sems nyid pad+ma'i chu dang 'drazhe//'byung ba rnams ni de yis myong 'gyur bas/ /de phyir g.yo ba'i sems la rnal 'byor pa'i/ /sgo dgu bkag nas nan tan gyis/ /rnal 'byor gyis 6ni gti mug bcad byas la/ /gnas kyi yon tan rtogs pas 7chags med 'gyur/ /sprin ltar cho 8'phrul rang bzhin kun brtags kyi/ /gti mug gnas kyi gti mug bsregs byas nas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas la rnal 'byor thim/ /thams cad nub pas steng 'og lam 'gags pas/ /gnas kyi nyams kyis 'khor ba mya ngan 'das/ /de ni rnal 'byor bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs/ /nyin mtshan bla ma spyi bor bsgom byas nas/ /lhan cig skyes pa nyid du gnas 'gyur ba/ /yang nas yang du nam mkha'i bdud rtsi rngub/ /rjes 'brang bkur ste dri med sku 27—82

thob pas/ /ka ba gcig la gzhal yas sgo dgu ste/ /lam gyi sgyu lus bdag gis gcig tu rtogs/ /de yis bdud bzhi bar gcod sel bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dge sbyin khrims sogs dgos mi 'gyur/ /dge sbyong chos smras lha nyid bsgom pa ste3/ /chos kyi ro ni sus kyang rtogs pa med/ /sgu gsum brtan par 'dod na rnal 'byor kye/ /phyi nang byang chub sems kyi rlung nyid bsgom2 / /dug lnga'i yan lag bcad pas myur du ni/ /byang chub sems kyi lam la legs par 'jug /rnal 'byor brtan pa thob ste skye mi 'gyur/ /rlung gi de nyid bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon tso ra ghis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

༄/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzags pa'i rim pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni nibe+en na 2kra ma/ bod skad du/rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gzhu ru thogs/ /dngos po thams cad 'ben du btsugs/ /gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyab/ /bsgom dang sgom rgyu dmigs pa med/ /bsgrun pas skye ba dmigs mi 'gyur4/ /bdag gzhan gnyis kyi mtha' yang bcad//gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyab/ /bsgom 5dang sgom rgyu gnyis ka med/ /stong pa'i gzhu ni bkang byas nas/ /shor med mda' ni rdeg par byed/ /bsad dang gsad 6bya gnyis ka med/ /gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyab/ /bsgom 3dang sgom rgyu gnyis ka med/ /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul chen po yis/ /chos nyid thams cad bsdus byas nas/ /gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyab/ /bsgom 8dang sgom rgyu gnyis ka med/ /bi rūs 'di ltar 'khor byas nas/ /27—85

gcig nas nyi shu'i bar du ni/ /dngos po cir yang zhugs pa med/ /yi ge stong pa gsos su byin/ /gnyis su med pa'i mda' yis brgyab/ /bsgom hu dang sgom rgyu gnyis po/ med/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon bi tho/ pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon bhi na pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/85 kyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rag rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉debya:/ ri /sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skosgom/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa gyur/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgrosgom/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsad/ she cinye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skosgom/86 skre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (12༷8)27wa 86

1282༄ga /rnal 'byer bzhi'i nyams len gyi thabs zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tur yo ga bhā ba 'en nā ma/ bod skad du/rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams len gyi thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems dang sems nyid rgyu med de/ /bsgrub bya sgrub byed thig le'i ngo / /'bras bu ma grub mya ngan 'das/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo yi ge gred / /lte bar gsang ba'i ge sar la/ /ā li kā li la brten nas/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi nyams len bshad/ /lte ba ye shes 'khor lo ru/ /rtsa ni brgyad kyi thig btab nas/ /ā phreng kā phreng mnyam bsams nas/ /mkha' 'gro brgyad kyi rnge lce sbar/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'od las ni/ /gnyis med zung 'jug 'dzag byas pas/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi lam nas rgyu/ /de 'gag rnal 'byor mtshan ma med/ /brtan pa'i rnal 'byor grub 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sa lam thob/ /ā li kā li'i rnal 'byor ro/ /27—87

a ho bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dngos dang dngos med bral 'gyur bas/ /phyi nang dug gi rnam pa sel/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni brtan grub na/ /zla ba drug nas 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam mo/ /de ni rig pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /sems nyid gnas su pad+ma ni/ /mnyam pa nyid ni dmar por bsam / /pad 'dab bzhi la thig le ni/ /dbus su rgyu med thig le yin/ /de dag rnams kyi kha dog ni/ /shar du dmar dang byang du ser/ /nub tu dkar dang lho ru gnag /sna tshogs 'od gsal dbus su 'phro1/ /sngar bshad sngags dang bcas pa ni/ /sgom 2na rnal 'byor dbang phyug de/ /skad cig gcig la rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ni mnyam nyid rnal 'byor ro/ /mi bskyod chu dang rnam snang dang / /phyi nang bdud rtsi lnga yis 4ni/ /sngags pa'i thabs kyi 5rnal 'byor kyi6/ /tan ti bdag gis grub pa thob/ /rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams len ces bya ba slob dpon tan ti pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—88

༄7/ /thabs dang shes rab gtan la phab pa'i bsdus pa zhes bya ba/shā༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ prazlo pā ya bi nibya ya sa mud yo nā ma/ bod skad du/ thabs dang shes rab gtan la phab pa'i bsdus pa zhes bya ba/dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sprin ltar rtog pa sel cing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /nang pa rnams kyi mnyam 2dang mi mnyam gnyis med chos sgu de / /gzugs ldan sna tshogs longs sgu'i rang bzhin rnams kyi rgyur gyur pa/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sprul sku de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /lham mkhan rig 'dzin bdag gzhan don du rnam par basbu byas nas/ /ma rtogs sems can rnams la phan phyir ma lus de nyid ni/ /bdag gis bshad bya blo ldan rnams kyis gus pas mnyan par gyis/ /dngos po'i rtog pa la brten nas/ /dngos med bdag med yang dag 'byung / /gnyi ga rtog pa 4mnyam mod kyi/ /byis pa rnams la drang phyir gsungs/ /de la nyon mongs thams cad de/ /skye 27—90

'jig sdug bsngal de las 'byung / /bdag gzhan gnyis kyi 'dzin pa yis/ /thar pa thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /de phyir dngos po spang bya zhing / /dngos med la yang brten mi bya/ /rnal 'byor dngos po la brten na/ /'khor ba nyid las gzhan du min/ /phan tshun 'byel phyir de dag min/ /de min bdag gzhan grub pa med/ /dper na nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /de phyir dngos dang dngos med ni/ /brdzun pa'i cho 'phrul spang bar bya/ /rang bzhin ma grub dri ma med/ /de phyir pha rol phyin mar grags/ /khyab byed snying rje dbyer med de / /rnal 'byor pa yi thabs yin no/ /chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis rnged pa/ /'dzin bya 'dzin byed thog mtha' med/ /dri med dngos po'i mtshan ma bral/ /gnyis dang gnyis min zhi ba'i bdag /de rnams la gnas bde ba'i mchog /rang rig ye shes chos kyi dbyengs/ /zhi dul pha rol phyin ma yin/ /theg pa gsum dang sgu gsum ldan/ /sngags ni 'bum sde grangs las 'das/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog phyag rgya dang / /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten rnams/ /lha dang lha min brgya byin dang / /mi dang yi dwags dud 'gro sogs/ /dper na chu yi rlabs 1bzhin te/ /de las byung zhing thim par 'gyur/ /de phyir thabs dang shes rab kyis/ /gnyis med don ni bsgom par bya/ /mi mnyam pa yi sngags nyid kyis/ /stong nyid bsgom par mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dngos po bsgom mi bya/ /de dag gnyis kyi 'dzin pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das kyang 'khor ba yin/ /de ni mi rtag spang byas pas/ /dmigs med stong nyid 'grub 'gyur ro/ /brjod bral nam mkha'i snying rje ste/ /de nyid yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'gro ba'i don 27—91

ni byams pa yin/ /nam mkha' kun la khyab pa bzhin/ /gnyis med sems ni dga' ba yin/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis dag la/ /bsgom pa'i btang snyoms de nyid ni/ /dngos med don dam bsgom par bya/ /bya ba dang ni byed pa po/ /bsgom dang sgom 1rgyu gnyis ka med/ /sbyin dang sbyin bya gnyis ma grub/ /'dzin bya dang ni 'dzin pa po/ /brtags pas nyon mongs dngos po med/ /de nyid ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /byang chub sems ni grub 'gyur ro/ /chags pas bsgribs pas 'khor ba yin/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bu ni/ /rtog pa dang bral mya ngan 'das/ /de phyir sems ni brtan byas nas/ /blo dang ldan pas bsgom par bya/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi pad+ma las thob gdams ngag bris/ /bdag nyid grub pa gang zhig dge ba'i 'bras bu des/ /'gro drug nyon mongs 'dam las rgal zhing 2dri med pa/ /byang chub sems la gnas shing grub pa thob par shog /thabs dang shes rab gtan la phab pa'i dngos grub bsdus pa zhes bya ba slob dpon tsa ma ris gsungs pa rdzogs so// //

bsdur mchan/9༷ ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 29〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhan/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sku/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ther/91 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/92 9①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brgal phyir/ dzokye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉warab/bsta/ 'ardokā ༵༷ )migal27wa 93

༄/ /rang bajin grub pa med pa'i gaji'i man ngag ces bya ba/ rte༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ swa bhā ba a sidhi nā ma u pa de sha /bod skad du/rang bzhin grub pa med pa'i gzhi'i man ngag ces bya ba/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ji ltar mkhas pa yisa'e/ /lha khang 'di ni bzhengs par bya / /ka ba gcig la sgo dgu pa'i/ /shing mkhan gang gis khang par byas/ /ji ltar nam zhig lha khang der/ /'jig par 'gyur ba mi shes na/ /lha khang nang nas phug ron ni/ /gnas ni gang du tshol bar byed/ /ji ltar nam zhig lha khang der/ /'jig par 'gyur ba mi shes na/ /gang gis g.yogs shing zhal zhal byas/ /sgo rab bsdams pa de ltar na/ /ka ba srin gyis zos pa na/ /ji ltar nam zhig lha khang der/ /'jig par 'gyur ba mi 4shes so/ /gang gis g.yogs shing zhal zhal byas/ /lha khang nang nas phug ron ni/ /gnas ni gang du tshol bar byed/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi'i zas byen yang / /rigs ngan gye 27—94

ni spyod pa 'dra/ /de bzhin rdo rje 'gro bar byed/ /ji ltar nam zhig lha khang der / /'jig par 'gyur ba ma shes so/ /lha khang nang de'i phug ron ni/ /gnas ni gang du tshol bar byed/ /sna tshogs mdog can phug ron ni/ /lha khang bum pa spangs nas ni/ /dpa' bo'i sgo nas smra bar byed/ /ji ltar nam zhig lha khang der/ /'jig par 'gyur ba ma shes so/ /lha khang nang nas phug ron ni/ /gnas ni gang du tshol bar byed/ /lha khang bum pa spangs nas ni/ /dpa' bo'i sgo nas smra bar byed/ /sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin no zhes/ /'phags pa klu sgrub smra bar byed/ /rang bzhin grub pa rnged pa'i gzhi'i 1man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—95

༄/ /rje btsun yi ge brgya pa'i sems dpa' gsum gyi bsgom pa'i thabs 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha ta ak+ṣa ra bhaṭ+wā nar ka l+ya sa two tre ya bhā nab na / bod skad du/ rje btsun yi ge brgya pa'i sems dpa' gsum gyi bsgom pa'i thabs/ bla ma rje btsun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi lam/ /dge ba gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /sgu gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal te/ /blo dman dang ldan sgrub brtson zhing / /bla ma'i gdams ngag dang bral la/ /phan phyir sgrub thabs gsum bsres brtsam4/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa maya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka two no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ 5rnyo me bha ba/ su tostso me bha ba / a nu rasto me bha ba/ su postso me bha ba/ sarba sirnyidz+re pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsiṭ+wāṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/te ru ka bad+dhi bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ6hūṃ phaṭa/ de la bsgom pa'i man ngag ni/ /rang snying dbus gur phra ba yi/ /hūṃ gi dkyil du mje bo tshad/ /ṭi yig dkar 27—97

'od lta bu ni/ /de yi spyi bor gnas par bsam/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i 'od zer ni / /ting 'dzin sems dpa'i snying ga yi/ /kha spyor nam mkha'i dbus su ni//'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /oṃ dang hūṃ gi sbyor ba las/ /pad+ma rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /oṃ ni du ba'i mdog lta bu/ /dam tshig sems dpa' shes par bya/ /de gnyis nye bar spyor ba las/ /a ni ye shes sems dpa' bsgom/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal stong pa nyid/ /thig le'i ngo bo yi ge med/ /gnyis dang gnyis min zhi ba nyid/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /'di lta bu ni mgrin par bsgom/ /gnyis kyang 'od zer gcig la spro/ /du ba rnge khyer mar ske'i nang / /mkha' snang dang ni smig rgyu'o/ /kha dog lnga pa'i 'od zer ni/ /dbang po'i gzhu 'dra'i ngo bo nyid/ /rnam snang rdo rje nyi ma dang / /pad+ma gar dbang rdo rje rgyal/ /rdor sems drug pa he ru ka /mgrin par basbus te rnam par gnas/ /de ltar bla med rgyud rnams la/ /bsnyen pa'i sems dpa' gsum gyis ni/ /sgrub 1pa'i gdams ngag zhal kyi lung / /rim pa ji bzhin bshad byas nas/ /da ni rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin du/ /sgrub 2pa'i zhal gdams bshad par bya//rnal 'byor rgyud du dbang thob pa'i/ /shes rab ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bde bar stan la 'dug byas la/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gi 7sems dpa' ni/ /gsum kyi don la 'di ltar brtsam/ /thog mar rdo rje skyil krung bcas/ /ting 'dzin rgyal bcas sna rtser lta/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ ni brjod byas pas/ /gnas gsum du ni rnam par bsam/ /de nas so so'i kha dog gi/ /'od zer lcags kyu lta bu ni/ /spros pas sangs rgyas sras bcas rnams/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drang zhing / /27—98

de la lnga'am bdun pas mchod/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro la sogs bya/ /de nas sprin bral nam mkha' la/ /gnas pa'i skar ma lta bu ni/ /yig brgya'i 4sngags ni 'di yin te/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra la sogs pa/ /de nas 'di lta'i sngags brjod bya//oṃ dang swa bhā ba shudheḥ/ /sarba dharmā swa bhā ba/ /shurnyolha2snahaṃ zhes brjod byas pas//skar ma ltar gsal dag par bsam/ /oṃ dang tsit+ta pra ti be+e/ /bye dang ka ro mi brjod pas/ /de la nam mkhar hūṃ las ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma bsam par bya/ /de nas yi ge oṃ gyis ni/ /nam mkhar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /de yi steng du ā brjod pas/ /rang nyid skar ma ltar gsal ba/ /zla ba'i steng du rnam par bsam/ /der bye rjes oṃ dang bo bye tsita/ /ta dang ut+yā da yā mi/ /brjod de rang nyid yi ge ā/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ /de yi rang bzhin gsal ba yi/ /byang chub kyi ni sems yin pas/ /'gro ba rnams la khyab byed cing / /gsal bar byed pa'i bdag nyid bsam/ /de rjes gsum pa yi ge ni/ /haṃ zhes brjod pas spyi bo yi/ /tshangs pa'i bu gar hūṃ bsams la/ /de las byung ba'i rdo rje ni/ /rtse lnga pa ni rnam bsams te/ /brtan byed sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /oṃ dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/ /de zhu ba las rdo rje sems/ /bdag nyid 'di yi rigs can ni/ /yin par yang ni rab bsams te/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /de la shrī ni dpal kyi don/ /de ni rdo rje sems dpar brjod/ /de ltar oṃ gyi yi ge yis—/ /dam tshig sems dpar gernam par bstan/ /yang na 'di ltar shes par bya/ /oṃ ni zla ba 4de steng du/ /hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /de yi dbus kyi rtse mo la/ /dbyangs yig dang po las byung ba'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sku 27—99

mdog dkar/ /zhal phyag la sogs snga ma bzhin/ /de ni oṃ ste dam tshig sems//thog mar dge ba bkra shis pa'o/ /da ni ting 'dzin sems dpa' ni/ /bsgom pa rnam par brtsam par bya/ /oṃ dang ya ta te ta thā/ /ga ta ta thā haṃ zhes pa/ /brjod pas mdun du hūṃ sngon bsam/ /de byung 'khor lo bcu drug rtsibs/ /de yi dbus byung 3rdo rje ni/ /rgya gram de dbus paṃ las kyang / /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /de yi ge sar steng du ni/ /hūṃ byung 37rdo rje sems dpar bsam / /de nas shar gye 'dab ma la/ /tshangs yig dang po bris pa yi/ /mā me muñtsa'i sngags brjod pas/ /rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /mi bskyod na mgon po bsam par bya/ /rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /rin chen 'byung ldan g.yas 'dab la/ /oṃ dang badz+ra satwa two/ /no pa tiṣ+ṭha brjod pas so/ /oṃ dang dṛ rnyo me bha ba/ /brjod pas rgyab dkyil pad 'dab la/ /sa bon las byung 'od dpag med/ /g.yon gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /oṃ dang su tostso me bha ba / /brjod pas don grub sa bon las/ /me yi phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/ /rnam snang yi ge dang bcas pa'i/ /a nu rasto me bha ba/ /brjod pas rang gi sa bon las/ /rdo rje sems ma sgu mdog dkar/ /zhal gcig spyan gnyis g.yon du gzigs/ /phyag gnyis dkur brten gtso dang mtshungs/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje 'bar/ /bden bral oṃ dang su postso/ /me bha ba brjod rigs can ma/ /sa bon las byung sku mdog ser/ /phyag g.yon sngar bzhin g.yas pa yis/ /rin chen 'dzin cing g.yon du gzigs/ /rlung oṃ sarba sid+dhid+me / /pra yats+tsha brjod chos ma dmar/ /g.yas pad g.yon pa snga ma bzhin/ /g.yon du gzigs te dbang ldan du/ /rig byed tshig gi dang po dang / /sarba 27—/00

karma su tsa me/ /tsiṭ+wāṃ she yaḥku ru brjod/ /sa bon las byung las ma ni/ /ljang ser sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas/ /phyag g.yon mthun la g.yon du gzigs/ /yum bzhi'i dbu rgyan rigs kyi bdag /de rjes 'khor lo'i rtsibs la ni/ /dbang ldan las brtsams g.yon skor du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa/ /sems dpa' bcu drug rim bzhin bskyed/ /hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga bān badz+ra satwa ni/ kun la khyab par byed pa'i tshig /ma ni 'dren pa'i don yin te/ /me ni bdag tu rnam par bshad/ /muñtsa 'dzin par brjod cig pa'o/ /de phyir bdag ni gzung la drangs1/ /khyad par byung ba rdo rje sems/ /sku mdog ljang gu g.yon du gzigs/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /g.yon pa dril bu dkur brten te/ /pad+ma'i gdan la brten pa'o/ /dzā las rdo rje rgyal po ser /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon lcags kyu/ /kha cig g.yas pa be+egs kyu ste/ /phyag g.yon dkur ni brten pa 'chad/ /sa byung chags pa sku mdog dmar/ /g.yas mda' g.yon ni gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /ste las legs pa ma rgad mdog /skyabs sbyin g.yas la g.yon dkur brten/ /bha 'byung rdo rje rin chen ser/ /dbang bskur phreng ba gnyis kyis 'dzin/ /ga las rdo rje nyi ma dmar/ /snying gar phyag gnyis nyi ma 5'dzin/ /bān las rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i mdog /yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan ni/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni 'dzin pa'o/ /ma byung bzhad pa sun+dha ri/ /mdog can rgyal mtshan so yi 4ni/ /phreng bas mtshan pa 'dzin pa'o/ /hā las chos ni dkar dmar mdog /g.yon gyi pad sdong g.yas kyis 'byed/ /sa byung 5rnon po gur gum mdog /phyag g.yon po ti g.yas ral gri/ /ma las byung ba'i rdo rje rgyu/ /sku mdog ser la chos 'chad rgya//27—101

sems dpa' la/ /de yang gnyis med don du bshad/ /de rjes yi ge hūṃ gyur pas—/ /rdo rje lce ni rdo rje yisakye/ /'od der rnguspro bar rnam bsam bya /de yis phyi nang dag byas nas/ /bdag nyid la ni dbang bskur te/ /de rjes bzlas pa ci nus bya/ /bzlas pa'i rig pa 'di lta ste/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa two no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ rnyo me bha ba/ su tostso me bha ba/a nu rasto me bha ba/ su postso me bha ba/ sarba sedhisme pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me—/ tsiṭ+wāṃ gre ya1ཿku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān/ badz+ra satwa mā me muñtsa/badzā bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ/④ des ni dam tshig bsrung bar gsungs/ /yi ge brgya pa btus pa yi/ /sgo nas sems dpa' gsum gyi don/ /sgrub thabs dge ba gsum ldan pa/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun par bstan/ /da ni bya ba'i rgyud gsungs pa'i/ /sems dpa' gsum gyi sbyor ba brtsam/ /thog mar rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /phung po lnga yi nga rgyal bya/ /de rjes sngags ni 'di ltar brjod/ /oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badzī ṇi/ ma hā pra ti sa re/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/cho lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom byas la/ /de rjes byams sogs dran byas nas/ /mdun du lam skyes gru bzhi ste/ /de dbus sna tshogs pad+ma bsam/ /de steng oṃ las byung ba yi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsam/ /ut+pal phyag rgyas bkug pa yi/ /ut+pal rigs brgya bsam par bya / /phyag rgya de ni dam tshig gi/ /sems dpar yang ni rnam par bshad/ /de rjes ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /sngags 'di yis ni dgug par bya/ /oṃ e bye hi bha ga ba ti/ pra sā dha na tsa dha yi ku ru a/ pū snedze+e kṛṇ+ḍi/ a tra sam+bi 3hi to bha ba/ 'di brjod ad+ku'i phyag rgya yis/ /ye shes sems dpa' /5sbyan 27—103

drang bya/ /da ni ting 'dzin sems dpa' yi/ /spyor ba 'di ltar shes par bya/ /oṃ bha ga ba ti sa ma ye shwa ri sarba budhe ma te/ tā 3re a dhiṣ+ṭha nāñtsa rnge ku ru swā hā/tsā yig hūṃ gis brgyan pa las/ /byung ba'i sgrol ma ljang gu ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug spyan gsum ste/ /mi bskyod pa yi dbu rgyan can/ /rgyan rnams kyis ni legs par spras/ /g.yas zhal dkar la g.yon zhal gnag /g.yas gsum phyag mtshan rim par ni/ /mi 'jig sbyin dang mda' dang ni/ /rdo rje rtse lnga rnam par 'dzin/ /g.yon gsum rim bzhin sdigs mdzub dang / /gzhu dang ut+pal shes par bya/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du ni/ /pad+ma'i stegs byergya'i bzhugs stabs kyis/ /mkha' lding lnga la brten pa'o/ /dbus kyi mkha' lding dkar po ste/ /lag pa gnyis kyis bum pa 'dzin/ /g.yas su nag dang ser po ste/ /g.yon pa ljang dang dmar po yang / /rim pa bzhin du shes par bya/ /de ni ting 'dzin sems dpar bshad/ /rang lus la ni rnam dag don/ /yi ge gsum gyi 5byin gyis brlabs/ /oṃ dkar spyi bo'i gtsug tu ste/ /mgrin par āḥyig dmar po bsam/ /hūṃ nag snying ga'i pad+ma ru/ /de ltar rang lus rnam bsam bya/ /sa bon rnams la legs bskor ba'i/ /yi ge brgya pa bzlas par bya/ /oṃ bha ga wa ti tā re/ sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ tā ra ka two no pa tiṣ+ṭha / dṛ sto me bha ba/ su tostso me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su posgo rnge bha ba/ sarba sernyidz+re khupra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsiṭ+wāṃ gre ya7ཿku ru hūṃ/ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga ba tī badz+ra tā re mā me muñtsa tā ra/ bha ga wa ti ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ/ 'di ltar mi skyo'i bar du bzlas9/ /sgon lam rgya chen btab byas la / /oṃ gats+tsha ste pa budhe bi ṣa yo pu na ra ga ma na yats+tsha/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya 27—104

ba'i don ni/ oṃ khyed ni sangs rgyas gnas su gshegs/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'o/ /hūṃ gis dgug cing dzaḥyis gshegs/ /baṃ gyis bcings shing hoḥs dgyes pa'o/ /de ltar bya ba'i rgyud la ni/ /brten pa'i sems dpa' gsum don bshad/ /da ni rgyu yi theg pa las/ /grags pa'i sems dpa'i don bshad bya / / 1 yang na gcig kyang ldan pas kyang / /'jig rten chos la blo ldog ste/ /rnam par dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /bde bar stan la 'dug nas su/ /'di ltar bsgrub pa'i spyor ba brtsam3/ /dang po 1maṇ+ḍal la sogs bsham/ /sems babyed sngon du song ba yis/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /skyabs kyi dam pa bla med pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes brjod lus yid spyor ldan bya/ /des ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dge bsnyen du ni ming ③'gyur te/ /de rjes byang chub sems bskyed de/ /bdag dang tha mi dad pa yi/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms kyang ni bsgom par bya/ /de yi rjes la bla ma la/ / dang ba 5bskyed de dad pa bsgom/ /de ltar byas pas 'bras bu ni/ /'khor ba las ni grol 'gyur te/ /bar chad rnams kyang mi 'byung ngo / /gdams ngag don ni rnam pa gnyis/ /bsgom dang de bzhin bzlas pa'o / /6sgom don dang po mal nas langs byas te/ /de rjes dkon mchog gsum ni rjes dran bya/ /de nas bdag nyid thog mar khrus byas te/ /rang gi lag mthil g.yon par o las ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de yi steng du dhīḥ/ /de las byung ba 'o ma'i mdog can gyi/ /bdud rtsi'i chu bsam oṃ s+thāḥswā hā yi/ /byin gyis brlab bya chu dang rang nyid la/ /dbang bskur 27—105

tshul du sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rnyi ṣe ka ta snes ma ya shri ṭu /ye hūṃ/ zhes bya'i ①sngags brjod ④spyi bor gtor/ /sgrub pa'i gnas la sogs la gtor bar bya/ /de rjes yig gsum gnas ni gsum du dgod/ /spyi bor tshangs pa'i yi ge dkar po ste/ /mgrin par ye shes yi ge ldidamar bsam /khro yig sngon po snying ga'i dbus su dgod/ /de ni sems dpa' rnam pa gsum du bshadarka/ /de yi man ngag khro yig pad+ma ste/ /a ni zla ba rig byed dang po'i tshig /bcom ldan shākya thub pa yin zhes bsam/ /de ni gnas gsum bsrung zhing dag pa'o/ /de rjes shar gyi phyogs su kha bltas la/ /gser sogs snod du chu ni gtsang ma bltamagye/ /shar gyi phyogs su nam mkhar hūṃ yig bsam/ /de gyur las byung pad+ma'i ge sar la/ /a las zla ba de yi rigs skyes mtshon/ /de steng rnam snang yig gyur nyid dkyil 'khor/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor lta bur rnam par bsam/ /zla dbus bcom ldan shāka thub chos 'chad rgya/ /nyi 'od thub dang gnyis su med par bsam/ /de yi rjes la gsang sngags 'di brjod de/ /oṃ na mo ta thā ga ta su phaṭa phaṭa/ mṛṣ+ṭi aṇ+ḍa pa rgo/ pra yats+tsha me swā hā/ me tog re blangs sngags re brjod byas pas/ /sngar bshams chu la nyi shu rtsa gcig dor / /yang na rig pa de nyid brjod byas la/ /snga ma'i me tog re re blangs nas kyang / /maṇ+ḍal la sogs sa phyogs 'ugatsang mar ni/ /bcom ldan shākya thub la dbul bar bya/ /de rjes dpal ldan yi ge brgya pa ni/ /mi skyo'i yid kyis ci nus bzlas par bya/ /oṃ bha ga ba te mu ne+e rkyeye sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/shākya mu ne+e two no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ rnyo me bha ba/ su tostso me bha ba/ a nu ralto me bha ba/ su postso me bha ba/3 sarba sid+dhim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsitrī 27—106

gre ya༄(ཿku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ga bān shākya mu de mā me muñtsa/ budhe bha ga bān/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ/2 de ni thog mar gti mug yi ge la/ /bar du sgra can — —tha mar dbyangs yig las/ /yi ge a ste sems dpa' gsum du grags / /de rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo byas te/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /rig gnas lnga la mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang / /dpyad 4par rtogs dka' rdo rje 'chang gi dngos/ /rtsa ba'i grub chen lū yi nas brgyud pa/ /gdams pa phyi nang gsang ba'i sems dpa' gsum/ /sgrub thabs slob ma mchog gis thugasol btab ngor/ /bla ma'i gdams pa bum rgyun 'thungs lags 6pa/ /brtson shugs 'bar ba'i snying rjes sna drangs te/ /nyam chung gzung 7phyir rin chen phreng bar bsdebs/ /ji srid thub pa'i bstan pa gnas bar du/ /mtha' 'khob phyogs su dar zhing trergyas gyur cig /rje btsun gyi yi ge brgya pa'i sems dpa' gsum gyi bsgom (pa'i thabs slob dpon nā ro pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

༄/ /rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/7༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ rat+na mā la nā ma/ bod skad du/ rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po kun gyi bdag nyid ni/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin ma grub pa'i/ /bla ma rje la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rin chen phreng ba bshad par bya/ /bsgom khyedang sgom rgyu rna'/ 'byor gyi/ /rtog pa de ni bden pa min/ /bden gnyis grub pa med pa'i phyir//sgom la brten par mi bya'o/ /chos kyi dbyings dang de bzhin nyid/ /gang yang rang bzhin rtogs pa de/ /zhi ba rang rig gnyis su med/ /bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i shes rab ni/ /phyag rgya bla ma'i gdams ngag bcas/ /phra zhing rang rgyud ye shes kyi/ /ma rdzogs pa yi skad cig la/ /yang dag grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /bla ma gnyis pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /rnam par stog pa bden pa min/ /rtog med rjes su 'brel pa yi/ /rim gyis rnam rtos 27—110

rnams dang bral/ /dper na tha gu shesbrul 'dzin te/ /rnal 'byor rtog med bde ba che/ /bla ma gsum pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /ma rig pa yi snang ba 'di/ /rang rig ye shes rtogs gyur byen/ /rmi lam nyin mo'i snang ba rnams/ /mnyam pa nyid du don rtogs pas/ /tshor ba tshor byed gnyis su med/ /gnyis dang gnyis min spangs pa yi/ /gang la mi gnas rnal 'byor de/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma yin/ /bla ma bzhi pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /bdag nyid sha khyala'i dgongs pa ni/ /dmigs med snying rje'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnyis 'dzin gnyis med don rtogs can/ /zab mo'i chos nyid la gnas pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob 'gyur/ /rtog pa dang bral dri ma sked/ /rnal 'byor rol pa'i lta spyod ni/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rtogs gyur 4na/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gnyis med rtogs/ /de ltar rtogs pas rang grol 'gyur/ /rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba slob dpon si la a lis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā 2ru ṇa a byebye na bhā ba na nā ma/ bod skad du/ snying rje bsgom — pa'i byen rlabs 4zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs 5thob gyur pas/ /skad cig gcig la mnyam par rtogs/ /rgyud sde rnams la mi gsal bas/ /snying rje bsgom 6pa'i nyams len bshad/ /rnal 'byor de nyid dran byas nas/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rang bzhin gyis7/ /snying ga'i dbus su thig le ni/ /mun pa'i rab rib bsal gyur pa/ /zla rtse'i steng du bsam par bya/ /rang bzhin bdag po rol mdzad pa/ /drag po'i gzi brjid phreng bas brgyan/ /he ru ka dpal mgon po che/ /bdud bzhi las ni rnam par rgyal/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dur khrod gnas/ /bde ba chen po dga' ba'i mchog /ro myang 9longs sgu byang sems ldan/ /yi ge rgyu med yang dag gsungs/ /lha sgom phreng sngags mtshams 27—/ /3

gcod dang / /sbyin sreg tshoklog sogs dgos pa med/ /rtog pa rnams ni spangs 2byas nas/ /'jigs med snying rje bskyed byas la/ /slob ma dang ni bdag nyid kyi/ /snying gar bsgoms pas ye shes ni/ /thams cad mkhyen dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de nyid rtogs pas yang dag phrad/ /rdzu 'phrul bzhi dang sa bcu thob/ /nam mkhar spyod de mi snang 'grub/ /skye ba dran zhing rang sems rtogs/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar ni/ /rang rig gzhan rig thams cad skye / /mgal me'i 'khor lo bskor ba ltar/ /sna tshogs sems kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /nyams skyes rnal 'byor grub pa thob/ /snying rje bsgom ④pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon te lo pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

1288༄7/ /rjag pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa zhes bya ba/2༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yā na a pa tā ra 2nā ma/ bod skad du/ theg pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la 'be+ebs pa zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /jeg pa chen po'i bdag nyid ni/ /bde chen rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi ni / /mtha' dbus mnyam pa'i tshad nad sel/ /dga' ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg pa rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /shes dang shes bya'i ye shes ni/ /gzhan la phan phyir rang la min4/ /bdag gis gtan la dbab par bya/ /'dzin dang 'dzin bya'i rig pa ni/ /so so'i las dang rnam par ldan/ /dngos po gzugs can 'ching ba'i rgyu / /phyi dang nang gi gzugs med pas/ /de nyid ma grub gnyis med do/ /gang zhig 'dzin pa gzugs yin te/ /'dzin pa med pas de nyid do/ /de ni dam pa'i ye shes te/ /ldun grub kha dog dbyibs dang bral/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rang rig rtogs / /gang zhig rig pa stong pa de/ /stong pa min la rig pa min/ /'di dag 27dod/ /6

thams cad rang 'gag go/ /bden gnyis bral ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /stong nyid rig pa'i lta ba 'di/ /snying rje chen po'i shes rab bo/ /rdzogs pa'i rim dang lha sgrub sogs/ /rgyud rnams kun las gsungs pas kyang / /de nyid don dam ye shes min / /don dam ye shes stobs kyis ni/ /rdzogs pa'i lha ni grub par 'gyur/ /de phyir bdag ni rdo mkhan dhisatsho/ /blo dman rnams kyi yul min pa/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis med bshad/ /theg pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po rdo mkhan dhis samadzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/116 17mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta ri/ da〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stonas/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rna/117 9〉 sa7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabarnyis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1215)27——117

1289༄༅/ /sems la kros 'debs pa jes bya ba/tsho ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta gya saṃ 2pra dhā ya byu baṣ+ṭa rgo nā ma/ bod skad du / sems la gros 'debs pa 4zhes bya ba/ yum rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo//dpa' bo dpa' mo 'byung po rnams kyis bskor byas pa'i/ /dpal chen he ru ka yi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /khams gsum sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /bdag gzhan rnams kyi don du sems la phan pa'i gros 'debs bya/ /'dod pa pad+ma'i chu ltar rig nas sems nyid kyi5/ /bla rnged lta sgom 6'bras bu khyod kyis dran par gyis/ /de yis dpal ldan zhal mthong gnyis med don rtogs te / /de phyir nyams len brtson pas phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs gzugs sgra sogs la ma chags ma zhen na/ /'khor bar mi gnas rgyu med mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /pad+ma bzhin mdzes mngon sum mig gi dbang po dang / /sgra brnyan rna ba nyams shing sems nyid rmongs 'gyur bas/ /kye ma zhe sdang phrag dog 27—118

dug ni ci phyir 'dzin/ /skra dkar gnyer ma la sogs khyod kyis mthong gyur kyang / /yongs su tshol /—ba'i zhen pas nyes pa skyon gyis bcings/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i spyod lam 'dod chags zhe sdang gis/ /mkhas btsun mngon pa'i nga rgyal 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyam/ /yi dwags lha min dud 'gro la sogs sdug bsngal mang / /de phyir phrag dog spangs la rang nyid dmigs par gyis/ /lha dang klu dang mi rnams bde bar grangs mang thob gyur kyang / /sems kyi rgyal po 'dod pas mi ngoms ngo mtshar che/ /gnyen bral sbug bsngal mchi ma rgya mtsho bas kyang lhag /dur khrod gnas kyi keng rus bsags pa ri dang mnyam/ /'dod pa'i rma phyung 'khrugs pa'i khrag ni mtsho dang 'dra/ /kye ma sems kyi rgyal bo'i rnal 'byor ci phyir srid mi spong / /mi lus 'dod bya khom ldan yang dag thob byas nas/ /dngos po rnams ni chu bur lta bur brtags byas la/ /khyod kyis bdag gzhan rnams la ji srid phan par gyis/ /'khor ba'i 'dam la bying 'gyur thar pa shi na tu dka'/ /dmyal ba'i snyug bsngal ngu 'bod tsha grang sreg cing btsir/ /sred pas phrag dog yi dwags bkres skom skye 'gyur la/ /snying rje'i gnas thob dud 'gro phan tshun zhe sdang che / /lha yang gnas nas ltung 2'gyur mi rnams sdug bsngal mang / /de ltar 'a1 ba'i sdug bsngal khyod kyis dran byos la/ /don dam kun rdzob tha snyad sna tshogs spang bar kyis/ /longs spyod sprin phung glog ltar rnam par g.yo bar 'gyur/ /tshe 'di 1rlung gis bskyod pa'i pad+ma'i chu ltar 'jig /lang tsho rnams ni mi rtag de ltar bltas byas nas/ /mkhas pa rnams ni myur du nags su 'gro bar gyis/ /'khor ba'i 'dod pa'i gnyen bshes chags pas phrag dog skye/ /mthar yang gshin rje'i gnas 'gro rgyal ba thob mi 'gyur/ /khyod kyis de ltar shes na thar pa'i lam thob bo /27—119

mi lus dam pa yang dang yang du thob pa dpo/'a/ /dper na rgya mcho1re chu rlabs rlabs gnye/snang zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang / /rmi lam mig 'phrul 'khrul snang sna tshogs sgom dro1byed na/ /'khor ba'i zhags pas bcings grol rgya la bya bzhin no/ /de phyir sems nyid ma chags ma zhen nyams len gyis/ /'khrul zad gang zhig rnal 'byor bde ba thob pa des/ /sems gsal yal ga brgya yis sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob / /sems kyi gros 'debs zhes bya ba slob dpon a dzo kis mdzad pa rdzogs cas—/ / //bsdur mchan/118 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dha/4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wapa/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsho)/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/119 te 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toratshol/ 〈〈〈pe 〉lhun/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〉nga / (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/120 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phosangs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1216)27wa 120

༄ga /gzhi lam 'bras bu bsgom pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ s+thā na mārga 2pha la ma hā mu dra bhā ba na nā ma/bod skad du/ gzhi lam 'bras bu bsgom 4pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi ni / /rtsa gsum brgyud 5pa'i bla ma dang / /yig 'bru gsum gyi nyams len ni / /nyam chung nyon cig bshad par bya/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo nas/ /sna bug gnyis dang tshangs pa'i bar/ /rtsa gsum la ni sems gtad bya/ /g.yon gyi dkar dang g.yas rtsa dmar/ /dbus kyi mi bskyod mthing ga la/ /g.yas par hūṃ dang g.yon par oṃ/ /tshangs pa'i 6bu gar a yig bsam/ /'od gsal mthing ga dkar dang dmar/ /khams gsum sprul pa'i 'od kyis khyab//gdul bya btul nas slar yang thim/ /yi ge gsum gyi zla tshes la/ /stong pa'i thig le steng du ni/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma 'od gsal ni/ /de steng 'di ltar 27—121

bsgom par bya/ /g.yon gyi sna bug yi ge la/ /yid ches nyams myong bla ma ni/ /skar ma lta bu'i 'od gsal bsgom/ /'bras bu mngon sum bla ma ste/ /hūṃ yig zla tshes steng du ste/ /brtan par bsam gtan bsgom par bya/ /rlung gsum 'gags te 1gdon gsum sel/ /dug gsum rnam rtog bral 'gyur ba/ /rgyu 'bras chos kyi rtog pa spangs/ /lus kyi dgon pa brtan 'gyur bas/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med don rtogs te/ /dur khrod kyi ni 'jigs pa spangs/ /ha ri tsan+d+ra nam mkha'i dbyings/ /dri za'i grong khyer longs spyod byed/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu bla ma bsgom pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon paṃ ka las mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—122

༄ga /rtsa rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā da bin+d+ra dā re yo gi ni tsar+ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ rtsa rlung gi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa zhes bya ba/ yum bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag ni mdog sdug 'phyon ma min/ /dbyebs legs 'phyon ma'ang ma yin te/ /dgyes rdor spyod pa'i dge sbyang gis/ /de ni bdag gi bdag por 'gyur/ /bdag ni mtshams su phung 4bar 'gyur/ /bhan+dha pa yis mtshams su bcom/ /de ni bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /phyogs bzhir bltas na thar pa med/ /thams cad bltas pas nam mkha'i dbyings/ /bdag ni mtshams su phung bar 'gyur/ /bhan+dha pa yis mtshams su bcom/ /da ni stong pa'i de nyid rtogs/ /sgras dang sems khyod ci rtogs na/ /de ngor gzhan cig 'gro bar byed/ /bdag ni mtshams su phung bar 'gyur/ /bhan+dha pa yis mtshams su bcom/ /da ni dur khrod dgon pa ru/ /de ru bdag ni 27—/24

༄ / /yi ge gastis pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/༄kyi༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ak+ṣa ra dī pa u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bla ma rje btsun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig byad 2 dang ni gtun shing yin/ /dzā dang mu sal gtun brdung 4yin/ /sa ma bhe dang gtun 5 du byas/ /a thar shim 6mas phyag brdar 7byas/ /kye ho —bdag gis gtun 'di ni/ /bla ma dam pa'i bka' dang brdung 9—/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag dang / /drangs shing rkang pas rdeg par byed/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin spyod pa na/ /lta ba drug ni sangs rgyas pa'i/ /lam 'di bdag gis dang du blangs/ /kye ma rtse gcig sems kyis brdung / /'di ltar 'bras na 1nag po las/ /bsod nams brdeg pa gnyis ka yisalo/ /bsnun pas snyigs ma zad 'gyur te/ /rang sems stong pa nyid du lus/ /kye ho bdag gi gtun brdung 1 yin/ /nyi zla gnyis ni 'gram shing byas/ /rkang pa'i gtun 427—126

nang bdag gi nyutshoganas/ /'di ni lkugs ༷༷pa'i rmi lam 'dra/ /ji ltar gang la smra bar byed/ /kye ho bdag gi gtun snyeshing ni/ /nam mkha'i he dang ༷ni sgra sgrogs / /srid pa'i nges pa gnyis spangs te/ /nyin mtshan skad cig re re la//gtun chodang mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /yi ge gnyis pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ḍo bis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/126 nyamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉byed/kwa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtun/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtun brdungs/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabartun/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shil / pe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rdar/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ge brtun/ 9 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brdungs/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu/ te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gnyi ka yi/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtun brdungs/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉jun/127 9)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ tshos〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉skug 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtun/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1219)27wa 127

༄/ /de nyid bde ba bsgom pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ a nu yo ga ta twa bhā ba no pa de sha 2nā ma/bod skad du/ de nyid bde ba bsgom pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom 4pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig snying gar kha spyor pad+ma'i dbus su ni/ /sems nyid phra zhing rab gsal khyab la 5nyams dang ldan/ /khams gsum thams cad nye bar gnyis med thob 'gyur ba/ /mnyam zhing gnyis med chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yo 'gyur dbang po'i rta rgod nang du thim pa de/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi ye shes yang dag snod du ni/ /mkhas pas gnyis med thob 'gyur myur ma'i don rtogs pas/ /dpal ldan dri med nam mkha' ltar ni lta ba grub/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran rnal 'byor chos kyi dbyings la ni/ /chos dang chos nyid bsgoms pas chos sku'i rang bzhin thob/ /de nyid dran tshor rig pa med 'gyur ye shes mthong / /shin tu 27—/28

bsgoms pa'i dgos pa 'od gsal yid gnyis med/ /yi ge rnged pa'i thig le snying gar gnas pa ni/ /sgom par byed pa'i rnal 'byor ye shes rab tu skye/ /de las rdo rje mkha' 'gro snying rjer ldan pa thams cad gnas/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' khams su bcas/ /de nyid rang bzhin mchod pas mchod 'os rnams las mchod pa thob/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor sgom byed sangs rgyas rnams kyis mchod/ /mchod sgom byed pa de ni 'bras bu sangs rgyas gsung 1/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor nang gi bdag nyid gnyis spyor bas/ /de phyir rdo rje'i mchod pas mkhas pa rnams kyis mchod/ /ye shes lnga 'phros sangs rgyas 'grub 'gyur je tshom med/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la/ /ban+d+ra ka yi 'bras ltar pad drug ge sar dbus/ /a ṇi su tri pre du ka rigs drug 'gag phyir bsgom/ /dbus su khong stong yig 'bru drug po rim gyis ni/ /ka la thim pas sems nyid 'gags te 2skye ba med/ /bsgrib bya sgrib byed rang sems dri med dmigs pa med/ /rgyud rnams 'dul phyir gsungs te rnal 'byor don dam min/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub 'gyur rang bzhin mchod pa che/ /gnas chen nyi shu rang gnas sa lam rim pa thob/ /de phyir de nyid gzhan du mi tshol rang la gnas/ /rnal 'byor de nyid ma rtogs 'khyams na ci zhig bya/ /gal te de nyid rtogs na gzhan du ci zhig bya/ /skal bzang bdag nyid rang la grub cing de nyid thob/ /gang zhig gang gi 4spyor bas brtul zhugs can gyis ni//gnyis med bsam gtan la ni smyon pa bzhin du spyod/ /nam mkha'i gos can yang na rnal 'byor de min pa/ /lus la yi dam lha gnas rang bzhin de nyid bsgom5 / /zla ba drug tu ngag bsdams mkha' 'gro rnams dang phrad/ /ye shes 27—129

༄ga /'dzag pa gcod pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ 1sna༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sra ba pa rits+tsha dan nā ma/ bod skad du/'dzag pa gcod pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ yum don grub ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkyen dang rgya mtsho rgyas pa dang / /grang ba spyod lam nyes pa ste/ /kha zas byin rlabs dam tshig gis/ /grang ba 'dzag pa chu rgyun bzlog /rdo rje'i rked par dar dkar bsgril/ /dar gye skud pas dam par bcings/ /g.yas g.yon ra ba drag 2tu sprugs/ /bsam gtan lte bar gtad par gyis/ /rnam snang sgo ru sku yig bsgom / /rgyun gcod sngags ni zhal nas longs/ /zla ba rgyas na rgya mtsho lud/ /kha brag brgyad la chu rgyun 'dzag /gaṅgā'i rgyun bzlog rnal 'byor kye/ /mi ltung tshe ring bde ba thob/ /rdo rje'i spyi bor drag ser bsgom/ /trī ṭī hūṃ gi 4thig le 'dra/ /steng rlung bcings nas zhags pa ltar/ /g.yas skor g.yon skor rtsa la gram/ /rgya mtsho grang ba me yis bsro/ /bcud len sman 27—131

kyi spyor ba bya1/ /a ru gser mdog 'o mar bskol/ /tsha ba gsum dang cang zhi bsre/ /bcud can zas dang sbyar la bza'/ /na ba'i sa ru mu sdug dang / /be+em rtol brgya dang rtsa brgyad brgyab/ /mar bskol 2ras bal me btsa' gdab//grang 'don pags pa rked la dkri/ /lha srung log na gdon gyi 4rkyen/ /rgya mtsho ma thub 'dzag pa la/ /rang byung me+e tog gu gul nag /yungs kar thal ba me klad bsre/ /ha bu'i sngags bzlas rdo rjer byug /dog pa nag pos bcing bar bya / /drag po'i spyod lam bzlas byas nas/ /bum 5pa'i rlung bcing hūṃ phaṭa 'dren / /rnal 'byor kha zas nyams na ni/ /se'u'i shun lpags 6'o mar bskol7 / /kha ra btab 'thungs 'gag par 'gyur/ /dam tshig nyams nas rgyu ba la/ /mchod dang gtor ma byin rlabs zhu/ /gzhan du thams cad rnal 'byor la/ /yod pa dag ni ma yin no/ /'dzag pa gcod pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ku dzi 8pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

bsdur mchan/131 tematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag rab/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ gi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ges/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag132 1〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgyas/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgol/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bub/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pags/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgol/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ku ri/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1221)
