1295༄7/ /mu stegs kyi gtum mo zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ti thi ka tsaṇ+ḍa lī 2 ka nā ma/ bod skad du/mu stegs kyi gtum mo zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thal sgud can la phyas 'tshal lo/ /bud med gnas ni dbu rgyan mā/ /rigs ni gtum mo'i rigs gyur pa/ /srid pa gsum yang sreg par byed/ /me lce 4nam mkhar khyab par byed / /a tsin 5dpal ni gar byed 'gyur/ /nam mkhar rnge'u 6chung sa la rnge'u 7chung brdung / /rdo rje me yis rgya mtsho skems/ /nyi zla gnyis kyang skyabs su gzhug /gar byed dpal gyi a tsin thod pa can/ /nam mkhar rnge'u chung sa la rnge'u chung brdung / /lha dang lha min mi rnams dang / /dbang phyug u ma la sogs pa/ /thams cad ye shes me yis bsregs/ /gar byed dpal gyi a dzin 1thod pa can/ /nam mkhar rnge'u chung sa la rnge'u chung brdung / /rnal 'byor ma ni khyed byas nas/ /mgon po'i gnas su 'jug par byed/ /27—/34

'di lta'i dkyil 'khor glu ru blangs/ /gar byed dpal ni a cin 1thod pa can//nam mkhar rnge'u srichung sa la rnge'u nachung brdung / /mu stegs kyi gtum mo zhes bya ba slob dpon a sdi(stos mabosad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/134 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉non mu stegs kyi gtum mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 47〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsaṇ+ḍa li/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉slo/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stes/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsan/ dzi ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhugs/ 9 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/ 17〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsen/ 1 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/135 )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsen/ ge ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/bsdur 'bras re'u mig——— rgyud/ (1222)27wa 135

1296༄7/ /gser 'gyur gyi rtsi zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ dhā tur pā da 2nā ma/ bod skad du/gser 'gyur gyi rtsi zhes bya ba/ yum rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyin pa'i pha rol rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi gdams pa ni/ /nyams su len pa'i gang zag la/ /tshogs ni bsag phyir bshad par bya/ /bal po se'u sman tsha dang / /sa 'u ra bsre ka si sa/ /chang skyur dang ni sbyar bar bya/ /zangs kyi snod du zhag gsum bzhag /de nas bdun gsum nyi shu gcig /zhal gyi gdams pa'i sman rtsi yis/ /srab mo'i lcags rnams zangs su 'gyur/ /dngul chu dang ni kham sa dang / /sen 4rtsi dang ni lci ba ni/ /lde gur byas nas de yi dbus/ /zangs dmar bzhag na dngul du 'gyur/ /rta rmig 5dang ni lug ru dang / /rus sbal shun lbags shi lar bcas/ /bzhus pa'i gser la dngul btab nas/ /de rnams bsdus pa'i cha brgyad kyis/ /bzhus pa'i zha nye btab 27—/36

byas nas/ /zla ba lngar —1—ni dngul 'gyur ro/ /dngul dang khar ba mnyam byas nas / /zha nye'i tshad du bsre bar bya/ /phyi lta'i snod kyi nang du ni/ /zhu bas thams cad dngul du 'gyur/ /sha chen srang ni brgyad dang ni/ /zha nye dkar po de dang mnyam/ /sa dz+re srang gnyis sman tsha dang / /dug srang 2gcig dang dngul chu mnyam/ /gangs can sman ni khu ba yis/ /snga ma'i sman rnams mnye bar bya/ /thams cad rwa dkar nang du bcug /yang na rdza sa'i snod du ni/ /kha sbyor byas nas bsreg par bya/ /sman thal bar du bzhag nas bton/ /dngul ni zla ltar grub par 'gyur/ /skyes pa tsam gyis she'u yi/ /bu ri sha na blang byas nas/ /nyi ma zhu nas btab par bya/ /de ni bzhi 'gyur phye yis ni/ /zha nye dkar po'i zhun mar la/ /btab nas chu skams dngul du 'gyur/ /sman tsha dang ni tsha la dang / /ya bak+ṣa ra sardzi ka /tsi 4dkar sman ni khu ba dang / /dug dang ha nu ma sha ti'i/ /chu ni ma he'i zho dang sbyar/ /zhag gsum zha nye'i nang du bzhag /du ba mi 'byung thabs kyis bsreg /dngul 'gyur phongs 5pa'i sdug bsngal sel/ /dngul 'gyur spyor ba bshad byas nas/ /gser 'gyur bdud rtsi bshad par bya/ /gangs can ri bo rnams la ni/ / ro dan ti 6zhes sman mchog grags/ /lo mas sa phyogs zil mi bral/ /gser gyi mdog can khu ba 'dzag /zha nye dkar po dngul chu ldan/ /thal spyor zhal gyi gdams pa yis/ /reg pas dngul zangs gser du 'gyur/ /dang po me yis dngul chu yi/ /mi 'chor ba yi sbyor ba bya/ /de nas sman kyi rtsi shes nas/ /rnal 'byor gser 'gyur 'grub 'gyur ro/ /mi dang lhan cig ma gnas na/ /gser 'gyur 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir kha spyor 'khor lo yis/ /ci 27—137

thabs zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta tsi ti la sha pa no pā yi/ bod skad du/sems dang sems nyid 'dul ba'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spu mdog sna tshogs ri dwags 2te/ /rkang pas rdeg cing phyogs bzhir 'gro/ /brdas nas nam mkhar bsad par byas/ /rang gi sha yis rang lus la/ /rnam pa kun du dgra ru song / /bhu su ku yi rngon pa yis/ /skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med/ /ri dwags mo ni pho la smra/ /nags su gnas na bde bar 'dug /de nas byung nas gsod par byed/ /rang gi sha yis rang lus la/ /rnam pa kun du dgra ru song / /bhu su ku yi rngon pa yis/ /skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med/ /pho ni mo la 'di skad smra/ /su la bdag gis gnod ma byas/ /ci yang bdag gis zos pa med/ /su la'ang gnod pa ma byas na/ /ci yi phyir na sod cig smra/ /rang gi sha yis rang lus la/ /rnam 27—/39

pa kun tu dgra ru song / /bhu su ku 1yi rngon pa yis/ /skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med/ /rtswa dang chu la mi gnod pa'i/ /gang du gnas kyang ltogs pa med/ /rtag tu btsal kyang 2ma rnyed pa'i/ /ri dwags pho mo 'di gnyis ni/ /bdag gis rnyed par ma gyur to/ /rang gi sha yis rang lus la/ /rnam pa kun du dgra ru song / /byu su ku yi rngon pa yis/ /skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba rnged / /rgyug cing 'gro ba'i ri dwags ni/ /de yi rjes ni rnyed pa med/ /brdas pas nam mkha'i dbyings su stor4/ /bhu su ku 5yi rngon pa yis/ /skad cig gcig kyang gtong ba med/ /sems dang sems nyid 'dul ba'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon shān+ta de ba nas brgyud pa slob dpon me ko las gsungs pa rdzogs so// //

1298༄༅/ /lha kun gyi sgogs pa'i lam zhes bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba de ba dha ni sa pan kra ma marga nā ma/bod skad du/ lha kun gyi rdzogs pa'i lam zhes bya ba/ mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi snyan sgra sogs spangs pa yi/ /dben zhing gtsang ba'i sa phyogs sam/ /yid dang mthun pa'i dgon pa ru/ /rim pa 'di bzhin bsgom par bya/ /shing gcig byang chub sems yin te/ /a ba dhū tī'i chu 'gram la/ /lte ba'i gtum mo dur khrod de/ /ri thod snying ga'i pad+ma la/ /dgon pa rnam snang gnas yin te/ /nags tshal pad+ma'i gsang ba ru/ /bhi ḍa dang ni rdo rje chu//byang chub sems dang bzhi mnyam dang / /rin chen 'byung ldan 'od dpag med/ /thig le'i gnas ni drug la bsgom/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sgrub sa bstan/ /de nas lus kyi maṇ+ḍal ni/ /rang bzhin dri ma med pa'i rtsa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /zlum po nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /mje bong tshad ni bde chen 27—1 2

la / /oṃ mam haṃ gnyis gang rung bsgom/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /maṇ+ḍal byin gyis brlabs byas nas/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni/ /rnal 'byor snying ga'i sgra gcan gyi/ /steng du hūṃ ni dud ka bsam/ /mi bskyod pa yi rgya mtsho la/ /oṃ ni skar ma lta bu ste/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lor bsam par bya/ /byang chub sems dang rak+ta dang / /mi bskyod chu yi thig le'o/ /de ltar byen brlabs rtsa bsgoms nas/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsag 1pa'i phyir/ /mtshan rnged rtsa dang 'khor lo bzhi/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi rgyas btab nas/ /thig le bzhi la nyams len bya/ /tshad med bzhi yi nyams skye'o/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi bsgoms nas/ /rdzogs pa'i hūṃ bsam bgegs skyod 2do/ /snying ga'i khong stong dbus su ni/ /paṃ las pad+ma ram̐ nyi ma/ /hūṃ las 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'phro/ /phyi dang nang bgegs mtshams bcad do/ /de nas rnal 'byor stong nyid ni/ /skyil krung bcas shing lus nyid bsrang / /mig gi dbang po sna rtser gtad/ /dngos po thams cad rjes dran nas/ /dri ma rnged pa'i nam mkha' la/ /skar ma lta bu'i sems nyid kyis/ /phra rab tsam gye bdag gzhan bsgom4/ /stong nyid lta ba bstan 5byas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i dbang gi rim pa bstan/ /rdo rje dril bu'i spyor ba yis/ / rkan gyi 6phyogs su 'gyur lha mo/ /bde ba chen po'i zla rgyun ni/ / 'bebs sam dbang bsgur lus tshim mo/ /de nas dpa' bo dpa' mo yis/ /gang yang dpal ldan 'dus pa'i sgu/ /dri med me long gzugs brnyan dang / /nam mkha'i skyes bu lta bu ni/ /rang bzhin kha dog dbyibs dang bral/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgom par bya/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i 27—/ 43

༄ / /nyi zla bcing ba'i thabs jes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ so ma srur+ya 4ban+dha no pā ya na ma/ bod skad du/nyi zla bcing ba'i thabs zhes bya ba/ yum don 4grub ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun rnams kyi 5yon tan brjod mi shes pa yi/ /gaṇ+ḍi'i 6sgra brdungs skyon smras phyi rol dag tu bskrad/ /chu yi steng gshegs me tog len cing chu yi gting mi 'bying //ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i bi rū pa zhes grags/ /tshong 'dus srang du 7'khyam zhing zas kyi lhag ma za/ /yud tsam khros pas gaṅgā'i chu rgyun gyen la bzlog /chu yi steng gshegs me tog len cing chu yi gting mi 'bying / /yon tan phul du byung ba'i be+e rū pa zhes grags/ /chang tshong dag la khro bar mi byed nyi ma ni/ /khyod kyi khang par gta' mar bzhag ces smras te 'dug /chu yi steng gshegs me tog len cing chuyi gting mi 'bying / /ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i birlu 7pa zhes grags/ /mu stegs rten la spyan zur gzigs pas liṅga gas11/ /de mthong khyab mjug 12lha yi 27—145

1300༄/ /sems nyid kyi thig le hūṃ nyid bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ hūṃ ka ra tsit+ta bin+d+ra bha ba na kra ma/ bod skad du/sems nyid rngukyi thig le hūṃ nyid bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje nyi zla'i steng du ni/ /de steng rin chen 'od byed pas/ /pad+ma'i kha ni dbye bar byed/ /mdzes ma lha mdzes btsun mo kye/ /pad+ma'i tshal snyeni btang ba yis/ /gzhan na yon tan ci zhig yod/ /sems kyi bung ba ge sar la/ /khu ba dag ni 'thung bar byed/ /gzugs ni skams nas 'phur te 'gro/ /mi rgod lnga dang me ④tshogs bzhi/ /de lnga mnan te thog tu gnas/ /dga' ba'i gzhu ni bkang byas nas/ /mda' ni bde ba chen por brgyab/ /sems kyi bung ba ge sar la/ /khu ba dag ni 'thung bar byed/ /gzugs skams gyur nas 'phur te 'gro/ /bung ba mo la 'di skad smra/ /smras kyang go bar mi byed dam/ /'di 'thungs rtag tu 'di ru gnas / /bde ba chen po'i khu ba 'di/ /'thungs 5zhing sgra skad sgogs bhepar byed/ /27—147

bde dang sdug bsngal grong khyer gnyis/ /mtshams na bdud rtsi'i rdzing bu gnas/ /de ru chu 'thung mi byed pa'i/ /yon tan med pa'i bung ba khyod/ /sems kyi bung ba ge sar ni/ /khu ba dag ni 'thung bar byed/ /gzugs skams gyur nas 'phur te 'gro / /stong nyid zhags pa chen po yis/ /sems kyi rgyal po bcing bar bya /bde gshegs lnga ni bsdam shetshobyas nas/ /gcig tu mgo la bkur byas te/ /bde bas gar ni byed par 'gyur/ /sems nyid kyi thig le'i hūṃ nyid bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon dzā lan+dha ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/147 lkumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/nyid/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab/ nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torathung / ni〈〈snar 〉〉sgrags/148 71〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ོma/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1227)27—148

༄7/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa jes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ a dzin bha ba ti pa ri bhā 2ba na nā ma/ bod skad du/ bsam gyis —mi khyab pa bsgom pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgongs pa mdor bsdus rnal 'byor gyi/ /tshad rnged bzhi yi nyams len ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bshad par bya/ /rgyu 'bras stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /dngos med gzugs dang gnyis med smra/ /dmigs med 'bras bu 'bad med 'gyur/ /dper na 'brug med char bzhin no/ /de phyir rang bzhin bdag med kyi/ /brtul zhugs skal ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /snang zhing srid pa sna tshogs 'di/ /dngos po stong pa bdag med de/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag /de lta bu yi snying rje la/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med/ /mi bsgom 5mi rtog rang bzhin gsal/ /mtha' dbus bral ba dbu 6ma'i don/ /de lta'i sems kyi 27—149

rang bzhin bsgom1/ /ma rtogs pa yi sems can la/ /nad 'don snying rje bsgom 3par bya/ /bdag gi mdun du gang zhig kyang / /mnyam par bzhag ste mnyam par bsgom / /de la rnam pa thams cad kyithu/ /gnyis med don ni 'grub 'gyur ro/ /dgon pa'i snyan rgyud 5gdams ngag ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /kun gyi sems nyid hūṃ yig dkar/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi snying gar bsgom/ /nyi ma'i gdan steng thig ler bsgom/ /de nyid kyi rgo 'phro 'du las7/ /nyon mongs thams cad sbyang bar bsam/ /de ni gnyis med don yin te/ /lha yi de nyid rang bzhin med/ /de ltar snying rje bsgom 8byas nas/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i bsam 9pa ni/ /phan phyir bde ltar bsam par bya/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid snying ga ru/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sran ma'i tshad / /de nas 'od gsal dkar dmar te/ /bar du me lha'i i yig ni/ /dngos po'i rnal 'byor gang yang med/ /de las ci yang bsam mi khyab/ /gang zhig sgom sde pa'i rnal 'byor de/ /gnyis med ye shes 'grub 'gyur ro/ /gsal rig med pa chos sku de / /de ltar phra ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mngon shes shar te gnyis rnged rtogs/ /dga' ba'i rang bzhin 'byung 'gyur la/ /btang snyoms 'bras bu thob pa'o/ /kha cig lha mo bzhi bsgoms nas/ /kha byug dag sagi don la brten/ /gnyis med bsgom 1 pa mi shes so/ /zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa yi/ /zhal gdams gzhan la phan phyir ni/ /rā hu las ni bshad par byas/ /tshad med bzhi bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom —pa zhes bya ba slob dpon rā hu las mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—/50

bsdur mchan/149 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉non bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// zhu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rte/ khu〈〈co 〉〉gyi/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanabus/15༷ ༄17 mizhu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ 4)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brgyud/ /nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/3〈〈pe 〉toradul ba'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉'du la/ sre4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesgom/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byams/ 6)〈〈co〉〉bsgom—/ tso〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi sku/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngag 1nye 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1228)27—151

༄/ /bye yig sems nyid thig le bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/4 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ hūṃ ka ra tsit+ta bin+d+ra bhā 3ba na kra —ma/ bod skad du/ hūṃ yig sems nyid thig le bsgom 4pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ yum rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus ma yi/ /gyen thur gnas pa'i rtsa drug la/ /de rnams la ni sman drug 'bab/ /dri dang zla ba sman gnyis ni/ /gyen thur gnyis kyi dbye ba yis/ /ra sa nā nas yang dag rgyu/ /chu dang nyi ma kun 'dar ma/ /gyen thur gnyis kyi dbye ba yis/ /snga ma bzhin du yang dag rgyu/ /dbus ma a ba dhū tī la/ /dbugs dang sgra gcan mi rgyu ba/ /me dang chu khams mgrin pa yi/ /dus gsum gnas pa'i phag mo mchod/ /nyi zla'i shu kra rak+ta yi/ /thig le 'dzin byed sgra gcan dang / /sems nyid thig le ji ltar dag /thig le de ni gang la gnas/ /'khor lo bzhi yi dbus su ni/ /kha sbyor pad+ma'i 'dab brgyad la/ /de 5dbus nyi zla kha sbyor la/ /nā da bin+d+ra 27—152

rnam par brgyan/ /gnas pa phra zhing yungs kar tshad/ /yi ge hūṃ nyid bsgom 1par bya/ /de las 'od 'phros thig le bzhi/ /pad 'dab bzhi la 'phro bar bsam / /shar gyi thig le mkha' 'gro ma/ /mi bskyod chu yi rang bzhin no/ /nub phyogs lā 2ma'i thig le ni/ /gsal ba'i dri ni rnam snang ngo / /khaṇ+ḍa ro ha byang phyogs te/ /byang chub sems kyi thig ler 'phro/ /lho'i phyogs su rū pi ni/ /thig le dmar po bsgom par bya/ /gnas bzhi'i 'khor lo dag pa yi/ /skye gnas bzhi ni dag par byas/ /de ltar 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro drug sems can dag par bsam/ /slar yang thig ler thim pa yis/ /sbyor ba 'di ltar shes par bya/ /thig le bzhi ni hūṃ thim pa'i/ /hūṃ ni zla tshes bsdu bar bya/ /zla tshes nam mkha'i thig ler 4bsnyu/ /nam mkha'i thig le khong stong la / /nyi zla'i kha sbyor thig le ni/ /gsal zhing kha dog dbyibs dang bral/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ /hūṃ yig sems nyid thig le bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po pa nas brgyud pa'i slob dpon dharma 5pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—153

bsdur mchan/152 nyamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rto/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nā/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ dhi〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉de'i/153 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ zhu④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spo/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1229)27wa 154

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra kṛ ti sidhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ rang bzhin grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdor bsdus pa yi rim pa ni / /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin te/ /lus la gnas pa'i khro ldan rnams/ /rjes su dran zhing nyams su blangs/ /yab yum spyor ba'i nga rgyal bya/ /gang zhig rgyud de'i rdzogs pa'i rim/ /de phyir bdag nyid yi dam gyi//nga rgyal dang ni bral mi bya/ /yum ni rigs kyi lha mo ste/ /dpal ldan yab ni dag pa'o/ /de dag gnyis kyi longs spyod ni/ /'od 'phags thim pa bde gshegs so/ /zhe sdang rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ /gti mug dra ba rnam snang po / /nga rgyal rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa'o/ /gzhan yang thabs dang shes rab kyi/ /lus la gnas pa 'di dag go/ /sa yi khams ni sangs rgyas spyan/ /chu khams mā ma tī zhes bya/ /gos dkar mo ni me khams 27—155

te / /sgrol ma rlung khams ngo bo nyid/ /nam mkha' rdo rje dbang phyug ma/ /sa yi snying po mig dag la/ /phyag na rdo rje rna ba la/ /sna la nam mkha'i snying po ste / /lce ni spyan ras gzigs dbang po/ /lus la sgrib pa rnam sel te/ /yid la kun du bzang po'o/ /byang chub sems las 'di rnams 'byung / /de phyir bdag ni chos dbyings so/ /sa dang me dang rlung khams sogs/ /brjod bya tsam du rnam par sprul/ /rang bzhin dri ma dag pa yi/ /de nas sngags gsum brjod byas nas/ /rang lus khong stong bsam byas nas/ /de dbus rgyu snalas gzhal yas khang / /sor bzhi tsam gyi 3rnam par bskyed/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ brjod yi dam lha/ /rnal 'byor dag gi sgo lnga nas/ /gzhal yas dbus su spyan drang bye bya//de nyid thig le zhu byas nas/ /lam du rgyu zhing chos 'byung dbus/ /zil ba lta bu'i thig le la/ /bde gshegs dgug gzhug gnyis med bsam/ /de nas byang chub sems nyid ni/ /pad+ma'i dbyibs ldan bsam byas nas/ /de la bdag nyid sems gtad do/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon rdo ka ris mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—156

bsdur mchan/155 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradi/du〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉jo /156 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 / du)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drangs/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1230)

༄/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ba/ lke༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa hā dza a nan+ta ā bā yo nanā ma/ bod skad du / lhan cig skyes pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying ga'i kha spyor dbus su ni/ /gnyis med thig le yungs kar tshad/ /de yang 'o ma'i rgya mtsho ltar/ /rim gyis rgyas pa bsam par bya/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi lus nyid ni/ /dri med bdud rtsis 4zho ltar gang / /rlung nad sel zhing 5sems nyid bcing / /me bye bdag ni smra bar byed/ /dngos por sems gtad 6dngos rnged rtogs/ /kye ho ma yengs rang sems zung )/ /rnal 'byor grub rtags dngos med pa/ /phan tshun gnyis kyi 'byel pa bcad8/ /dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin la/ /mtha' gnyis mi gnas lhan skyes grub/ /dngos po thams cad skye med de/ /bsgribs 9 pas bdag gis ma rtogs so/ /snang ba thams cad sems ngo bo/ /sems nyid ma grub sems nyid de/ /27—158

bdag nyid snying rje kun du khyab/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur ba med/ /gnyis la mi gnas sems nyid yin/ /me bye bdag ni smra bar byed/ /rang rig ma bcos bya ba thong / /'dzin med dran med sems nyid de/ /chad par mi 'gyur rang rig rtogs/ /rtag tshopar mi 'gyur sgo 'dogs bcad/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin rtag chad med/ /me bye bdag ni smra bar byed/ /lta ba bsgom 2med 'bras bu med/ /snang la rang bzhin dngos po med/ /rnam rtog sbrul gyi mdud pa ltar/ /rang grol zung 'jug tha snyad gred/ /de ltar bsgoms pas stong nyid rtogs/ /me dhi bdag ni smra bar byed/ /lhan skyes zung 'jug stong nyid de4/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis rtogs pa'o/ /lhan skyes zung 'jug gi gdams pa slob dpon me bye nis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—159

bsdur mchan/158 1snamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rag lhan cig skyes pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ba bzhu/gas so// sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gta dza an+ta yi/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉go/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsi'i / khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cing / ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabatad/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcad—/ 1 )〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgrib/159 ༷te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtag ci —rdzo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tog ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1231)27wa 160

1305༄/ /bla med spyor ba'i rim pa jes bya ba/1 sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ a nut+ta ra sarba shudhe kra oṃ 2nā ma/ bod skad du / bla med sbyor ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar pad+ma 'dam las skyes/ /de bzhin ma rig mun pa las/ /gnyis med rig pa skye 'gyur ba'i/ /rang rig de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bla med spyor ba'i rim pa yis/ /dri med dam chos bshad par bya/ /stong dang shin tu stong pa ste//stong pa chen po gsum pa yin/ /bzhi pa rgyu 'bras thams cad do/ /thabs shes yang dag sbyor ba yis/ /rdzogs rim rkyeyang dag nye bar 'gyur/ /rdzogs pa nye bar mthong ba yis/ /thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal yin/ /rang rig gsum gyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /rgyu gsum rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /stong nyid don ni rtogs pa yin/ /bla na med pa'i gnas thob 'gyur/ /'od gsal stong pa shes rab dang / /sems nyid gzhan gyi rjes su 'brang / /de la bdag gis 27—sde61

'di ltar ni/ /yang dag 'phros pas bshad par bya/ /rnam par chags shing shin tu chags/ /chags pa chen po de bzhin no/ /gti mug la sogs dug gsum gyis/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i sems nyid 'di/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gsum/ /zhi dang chags dang rtogs par ldan/ /phyi rol ji ltar nang na gnas/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar ba/ /'das pa'i 'das par bdag gnas so/ /sred pa che dang shin tu sred/ /bkres dang skom pa kun du ldan/ /tshor ba nyal ba'i tshor ba dang / /shin tu tshor ba'i skad cig gcig /so sor rtog dang snying rjer snaldan/ /ngo mtshar ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /nyams dang phrag dog rnam par bsags/ /de ltar sum cu rtsa gsum kyis/ /rang rig ye shes rnam par 'gribs/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 37nyams len la/ /nam mkha' bde chen pad+ma'i dbus/ /zla ba'i gdan la haṃ yig gnas/ /kun rdzob gsal zhing dri ma med/ /'byung 'jug rlung 'dzin ye shes yin/ /zla tshes dmar po shes rab ste/ /dbyangs yig dang po thig ler ldan/ /rlung ni 'dzin phyir bsgom par bya/ /de ni 'od gsal skar chen ltar/ /sems nyid stong pa'i thabs yin no/ /gzugs dang bral zhing kha dog med/ /zhi ba'i rnam pa zung 'jug bral/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i tha snyad med/ /de ltar bla ma'i rgyadrin gyis ni / /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta phyob/ /rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /ci yang mthong 'gyur je tshom med/ /ji ltar bud shing skam po la/ /me khyergyu gnas kyang 'bar ba med/ /de bzhin brda dang rtsol med la/ /byams sems gnas kyang grub pa med/ /de phyir nga rgyal la sogs spang / /brtson 'grus bskyed la bla ma bkur/ /dbang bskur thob nas nyams len gyis/ /rnal 27—162

'byor dang po'i spyor ba yis/ /sa ni brgyad po thob par 'gyur/ /'od gsal gsum ldan rdzogs pa yisakye/ /yongs su sgogs pa'i sa thob po/ /dbang bskur thob kyang skur pa 'debs pa dang / /brtson 'grus chung la log lta 'dzin pa dang / /bla ma'i skyon brjod yon tan brjod mi 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i lam ni de yis thob mi 'gyur/ /bkur snyi med cing de nyid thob tu re/ /tshig ni 'jam ste khro tshul bstan nas 'gro/ /mi tshogs mang po gnas pa'i sa ru ni/ /bla ma mthong yang phyag sogs mi byed de/ /snod dang mi ldan gdams ngag mi sbyin no / /yon tan bzang thob brtson 'grus ldan pa ni/ /bla ma 'khor sogs 2 bkur ste ldan pa la/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang mnyam pa'i dga' ba 'dzin/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos la sred pa che/ /rgyud rten rgyud mang 4rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam du 'gyur ba de/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba gang thob rgyur 'gyur ba/ /'gro ba drug la bsngo zhing bkra shis shog /bla med spyor ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon bāng ga dzas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—163

bsdur mchan/161 nyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rims/162 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rje/ ci3)〈〈pe 〉staspris/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / ④〈〈co 〉〉sped/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ltar/dzo'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi/163 ༷17〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la sogs pa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanaka' bar/ 9ge〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉mangs—/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyurngan/ (1232)27wa 164

༄ / /a phreng ka phreng gi sngags kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā li kā li man+t+ra dzñā na nā ma/ bod skad du/a phreng ka phreng gi sngags kyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo /dbyangs dang gsal byed bzhi bcu rtsa dgu yi/ /bdag gzhan sgra yi rig pa'i sgra don ni/ /ba rdzi la sogs grangs kyang de don rtogs pa rnged/ /de phyir gsal don bdag gis bshad par bya/ /sgra yi gnas ni brgyad yin te/ /rkan dang lce dang so rnams te/ /spyi bo mgrin pa mchu dang ni/ /khong 2pa sna la rnam par gnas / /de yi dang po a phreng ni/ /thun phyed bcu drug la sogs ldan/ /shes rab me long ye shes te/ /blo dang ldan pas shes par bya/ /de yi thog ma bcu bzhi pa/ /dbyangs can sgra gsal yi ge'o/ /de dag rnams kyi dang po ni/ /bcu ni mnyam pa'i ye shes so/ /skabs 'byung lnga ni thung ba ste/ /gzhan rnams ring bar shes par bya/ /dbyangs rnams kyi ni thog ma gnyis/ /spangs 27—165

te bcu bzhi'i ming can no/ /e e o au bzhi dag ni/ /don dam kun rdzob 'bral yig go/ /a 1ni stong pa'i thig le'o/ /zla ba nyi ma gtum mo'o/ /thig le gnyis ldan a yig ni/ /drag po'i sgra ni dbye bar byed/ /ṛ dzā t+pa shā 'byung ba bzhi/ /dbye bas sreg 2byed yi ge'o/ /thung ba'i mig 'dzums — skad cig gcig /mig 'dzums ④ring ba skad cig gnyis/ /skad cig gsum pa 'bod yig yin/ /skad cig phyed pa gsal byed de/ /rnal 'byor g.yon gyi phyogs su ni/ /dbyangs can bcu drug shes rab bo/ /de rnams sgra gnas 'di yin te/ /a ku ha yig thig le gnyis la lcung / /a ni khong gi yi ge'o/ /i tsu ya sha rkan la gnas/ /t+pa tu la sa so 'byung ngo / /ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bor grags/ /saṃ ni 'od gsal sna ldan te/ /lte bar gnas te gyen la rgyu/ /e i mgrin pa o au mchu/ /de yi thog mar chos dbyings so/ /de ltar a phreng bshad byas nas / /a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha ste/ /rtsa ba'i sgras ni de rnams so/ /ka las brtsams te ha yi mthar/ /g.yas phyogs gsal byed shes par bya/ /ka phreng lnga tshan lnga po ste/ /bzhi yi sgra yi reg 3pa'o/ /sha ṣa sa ha bcas pa ni/ /thog mar gnyis gnyis grangs min no/ /lhag ma gsum gsum sgra yin te/ /lnga tshan lnga ni sna las 'byung / /mtha' la gnas pa'i 'byung ba bzhi/ /rnal 'byor kun rdzob 'dod pas bcad/ /ma tshan lnga yi 6nam mkha' la/ /sha ṣa sa ha drod can gnas/ /k+ṣa ni kā li ma mo 'dus/ /de ni 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ro//bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dbye ba yis/ /rgyu yi yi ge bshad par bya/ /ka nas brtsams nas ha yi bar/ /ste ra ro yi gdan yin no/ /ya ra la ba ma yis brgyan / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bskyed thabs so/ /shaṃ ni thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /27—166

tsha ni keng rus gdugs yin te/ /nga tshan lnga ni nyi ma yin/ /sha ṣa dur khrod shes par bya/ /sa bon yi ge bshad byas nas/ /kā li rnal 'byor ngo sprod bstan / /ka tshan ya dang bcas pa ni/ /zla gam sngon po nang nub la/ /phu phu sa dang gzhan la chags/ /ji ltar ri mo bri dang mthong / /shar gyi yi ge rlung yin no/ /tsa tshan ra dang sha dang bcas/ /gru gsum dmar dang nyi ma phyed / /zhe sdang dus su sbrul yang bri/ /lho phyogs drag po'i gnas yin no/ /ṭa tshan bha dang bcas pa ni/ /zlum la dkar te snga dro'i dus/ /ka li dz+dza dang 'bug ka ni/ /gti mug bya yi ri mo can/ /nub kyi phyogs su mo gdon no/ /ta tshan k+ṣa dang ṇa bcas pa/ /gru bzhi ljang ser nam phyed ni/ /sa dang rlung gi khams yin no/ /phrag dog dmar po rgyas pa'i dus/ /rmi lam rta dang stag mthong ba/ /rgyal po sa bdag gdon gyi ngo / /byang gi phyogs su 'dzin par bya//ba tshan sngon po chu rlung 1ste/ /gru gsum zla gam dbyibs dang ldan/ /nang nub dus su khams lci ba/ /rig pas rnal 'byor brtag par bya/ /de bzhin 'byung chung nyi shu lnga'i/ /gdams pa zhal nas blang bar bya/ /dri med shes rab brgyan pa yi/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i spyor ba ni/ /tha snyad mun pa rab bsal ba'i / /de dag sems nyid stong pa bdag /tha snyad la bkod dge ba des/ /'gro drug sdug bsngal zad phyir bsngo/ /ā li kā li'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba slob dpon gadhes 2mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—167

sngag /ka phreng sgom pa'i lam jes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā li marga bhā 2ba na nā ma/ bod skad du/ka phreng sgom pa'i lam zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam kun rdzob rab gsal ba'i/ /a sogs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu yi/ /rang byung yi ge rnams kyi ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bsgom lam bshad/ /bdag gi gnas bzhi rtsa lnga dang / /sum mdo rlung lha 'khor lo nas/ /lte bar 'bar ba'i gtum mo la/ /snying ga sbar ba'i 'khor lo yin/ /steng du brtan pa'i 'khor lo gnas/ /spyi bor chu rlung ljang gu ste/ /de rnams la ni rim pa bzhin/ /ka phreng yi ge lnga la dgod/ /thog mar chags pa'i 'dab ma la/ /shar du shaṃ dang lho ru khaṃ/ /nub tu shaṃ ste byang du sgo/ /dbus kyi nam mkhar baṃ zhes brjod( / /rim bzhin sngo dang dmar dang dkar/ /ser dang sngo ba bsam par bya/ /chags pa skyes te chags pa na/ /chags pa'i nad rnams sel bar 27—169

byed / /shaṃ gi rlung ni me la phog /gtum mo 'od zer rjes dran nas/ /chu bskams 1sa brtol rlangs pa byung 2/ /de nas lte ba nas hig hūṃ bgrang / /bde chen ha la sems gtad nas/ /bdud rtsi rgyun ni 'bab par bsam /lte ba'i rdzing bu bkang byas nas/ /spyi bo'i tshangs 4bug sgra skad 'byung / /bde chen khang stong bsam byas nas/ /lte dbus khong stong sems gtad bya/ /rnal 'byor sdig pa dag par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dha ma dhu ma yis/ /de ltar sbyang ba'i 'pho ba smras/ /yul nas yul du 'pho byed na/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi 5mdun du ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi maṇ+ḍal bya/ /tsa na ka yi 'bras bu ste/ /thod pa nag por gzhag par bya/ /kun+da 6lta bu'i hūṃ nyid bri/ /de bzhin rang gi snying ga ru/ /zla tshes steng du hūṃ nyid bsgom/ /sems nyid rtogs nas rnal 'byor pas/ /thod pa'i dbus su sems gtad na/ /grub pa'i rtags 'byung rnal 'byor bde/ /sems la sems nyid thim par bya/ /de nas me khyer ro blangs 7la/ /de yi snying gar hūṃ bsam bya/ /ro langs grub rtags byung ba yis/ /rigs bzang gzhon nu'i ro la ni/ /kha spyor de nyid hūṃ nyid bsgom/ /rnal 'byor grong nas grong du 'pho/ /rnal 'byor btsan thabs 'pho ba la seng ge rnam rgyal me tog 'dzin/ /phyag rgya bcas la tshangs pa phye/ /sems nyid ri rab rtse mo'i steng / /pad 'dab brgyad pa'i ge sar la/ /hūṃ las sems nyid gtad par bya/ /dpal ldan nag po'i 'pho ba ni8/ /dha ma dhu ma bdag gis smras / /rnal 'byor gang zhig 'grub 'gyur na/ /nam mkhar thim 'gyur the tshom med/ /ka phreng bsgom pa'i lam zhes bya ba slob dpon dha ma dhu mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—170

༄/ /a phreng ka phreng bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byer chen po bsgom pa zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ salba ra tsakra 2ā li kā li ma hā yo ga bha ba na nā ma / bod skad du/ a phreng ka phreng bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor chen po bsgom pa zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i thog mtha'i tshad nad ni/ /bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid kyi/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i bdud rtsis sel/ /dga' chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan phag mo'i snying po yis/ /bde chen dkyil 'khor shin tu mdzes/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhis/ /sa mu dra yi lus nyid la/ /go cha drug gi rgyas btab la/ /yi ge bdun pa'i rna rgyan can/ /dpal ldan phreng ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /mgo phreng bzhi bcu rtsa dgus brgyan/ /glang po che yi g.yang gzhi ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'go 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rig pa ni/ /rnal 'byor rgya mtshos rked rgyan byas/ /thod phreng ye shes lnga yin te/ /bde gshegs lnga yis spyi bor 27—/72

—brgyan / /sā ga ra bdag gar byed do/ /tshangs spyod rtag tu bsrung byas nas//rnal 'byor chen po gnyis med bsam/ /rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags mchod bya/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor sā 1ga ra/ /dur 2khrod brgyad du gnas byed kyang / /'jigs pa rnams dang bral ba yin/ /de phyir rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams/ /bde mchog 'khor lor rtag tu mchod/ /kye ho rigs lnga'i spyod pa 'di/ /rnal 'byor pa yis tag ༄ tu rtogs/ /rtog pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'dod yon lnga ni spyod par gyis/ /rgyan drug gis ni brgyan pa'i sgu/ /seng ge bzhin du rtag tu spyod/ /a phreng ka phreng rnal 'byor che/ /mdun du bsam zhing gnyis med skye/ /rnal 'byor chen po bsre byas nas/ /bdag gi lte ba'i khung bu la/ /zla ba'i thig le rgyas par bsam/ /yang dag pa yi yi ge ni/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus bsams nas/ /dbang po zhi zhing gnyis rnged 'grub/ /bsam gtan bsam med 'grub rgyu rnged/ /bsam med bsams na grub pa thob/ /sā ga ra bdag smra bar byed/ /grub pa'i rtags ni glang chen thul/ /rnal 'byor chen po gnyis med do/ /a phreng ka phreng bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor chen po bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon sā ga ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

bsdur mchan/172 tu mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ran /a phreng ka phreng bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor chen po sgom pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tso/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsakre shwa ra/173 4) 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ (7〈〈snar 〉〉du/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tog 〈〈co 〉〉rtogabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1235)27ge174

༄/ /rlung gnas nad kyi brtag pa jes bya ba/ 1 ༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā yu s+thā 2na ro ga pa ri dzñā na nā ma/ bod skad du/ rlung gnas 4nad kyi brtag pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge dang mi dge'i chags pas 'khor ba'i gzhi/ /de dag chags bral rnal 'byor mya ngan 'das/ /me rlung chags pa'i gnas su gnas 'gyur ba/ /rlung gi chu gnas g.yo ba'i sems nyid dag /de yis rnam rtog gang yang rim gyis 'gags/ /dper na chu dang nam mkha'i skyes bu bzhin/ /me rlung nag pos snang ba 'ded gyur pas/ /dkar po'i shel ltar la sogs ye shes 'grub/ /dang po'i yan lag mgo ni gti mug gnas/ /sngar ltar bsgoms 5pas de nyid ye shes yin/ /dbang po lnga la nyi zla'i mig gnyis chags/ /lus kyi yan lag bhe 6ba'i ye shes ni/ /chags pa'i 'khor lor srog gi rtsa gnas so/ /de la zla grangs rtsa ni bcu gnyis la/ /lus kyi tshad ni 'dom gang gru bzhi yin/ /27—175

'dzam bu'i gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dag byung / /nyi zla'i sgo nas rlung ni yang dag 'byung / /lho byang gnyis dag nyi zla'i lam yin te/ /dbyar zla 'bring po byang gi bar du dgu/ /dgun zla 'bring po lho ru shes par bya/ /ston dpyid gnyis kyi 'bring po nyin mtshan mnyam / /1da ni rnal 'byor rlung gi grangs la ni//skad cig thang cig yud tsam gcig yin te/ /thun brgyad thun phyed sum brgya drug cu gzhag2 /lo gcig hūṃ nyid thig ler shes par bya/ /nyi zla gnyis kyi sgo nas rlung lnga ni/ /rang nas mi rgyu gzhan nas rgyu ba des/ /dpal ldan rnal 'byor rlung log na bar 'gyur/ /de la rlung gi ming dang gnas rnams ni/ /brtan g.yo bar gnas mkhris rgyas bde gshegs rlung / /rim par gti mug chu rlung mgo la rgyu/ /bad kan skye bas 4rnal 'byor lha gnas nyams/ /g.yo ba'i rlung ni gzhan gyi rtsa la rgyu/ /mdud par chags na drod nyams grang ba ste / /chu rlung bar na me rlung gnas pa de/ /rtsub pa'i rlung 'dzin ngal dub byas pa'i tshe/ /drag po'i zhe sdang mthar yang snying rlung ldang / /'dus pa'i gnas su dug gsum rlung 'dus pa/ /'dus pa'i nad kyis sems kyi dbang po 'khrul / /bde gshegs gnas su mi rgyu gzhan rgyu na/ /rnal 'byor las kyi nad du shes par gyis/ /sman dang sman pa rang 6lus gnas pa la/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi thig le las/ /sor ni bcu gnyis bcu gnyis steng du ni / /bzhi bzhi gnad 'dzin brgyad la sems gtad bya/ /bung ba'i rlung 'dzin 'khrul 'khor nad 'don bya/ /dbu 8mar ma chud rlung ni rtsa bzhi ru/ /bzung bas rnal 'byor mngon rtogs 'di ltar 'char/ /sa yi rlung gis lus lci sems mi gsal/ /mi rtag chu rgal zla ba mthong ba dang / /chu mig la sogs 27—/76

rtags ni sna tshogs 'byung / /rnal 'byor sha rgyas ldan pa shin tu dka'/ /thang la 'gro bar 'gyur na glo 1snying brdung / /rlung gi rlung ni zin pa'i mngon 2rtags ni/ /grang ba skye zhing lus khol thig le 'dzag /pho ba na zhing g.yang za yan lag 'khums/ /me rlung zin pa'i rtags ni mkhris pa rgyas/ /sems nyams drod skyes ro stod lci zhing na/ /rmi ltas mi mthong snang ba dmar po mthong / /'chi rlung g.yang za 'gro 'dod sems mi dga'/ /mi rtags 'phur dang khrung dang phrad mi thar/ /bde gshegs rlung 'dzin sems bde gnyis med gnas/ /bsus pa'i gegs sel rim bzhin 'di ltar bya/ /dmigs pas me sbar sa khams 4bsreg par bya/ /chu mig brgyad la rnal 'byor rlangs pa 'thul/ /chu brub 5sa sbyang rlung gi phyag dar bya/ /tho rangs mi bskyod grang nas btung bar bya/ /rlung la me bsgom hi rgyu mar 6chen dril/ /bem rtol brgyab pas ba spu'i bu ga phye7 / /'khor lo bsgom zhing grang ba sel bar byed/ /dbu 8mar ma chud chu rlung gzhan zhugs na/ /bad kan na bas bu ga gnyis dag byed/ /lus bca' chu 'brub rlangs pa 'thul bar bsam/ /rnge rlung gnyis kyis 'byung bar sems gtad do/ /mkhris 9pa ldang na gangs kyi chu 'brub bya/ /bdud rtsis lus gang gangs nas du ba 'thul/ /spyi bor bla ma'i bdud rtsi lus la byug /rlung gi rlung ni 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /byang chub sems kyi ting nge 'dzin la babe+eb / /gzhan yang nad rtags nad 'don zhal las shes/ /rlung gnas nad kyi brtag pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a dzo kis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—177

sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta ta two pa de shaṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/sems nyid kyi de nyid bcing ba zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal 'o/ / /de nyid kyis ni bcings pa la/ /de nyid kyis ni grol bar byed/ /bla ma'i bka' yis thams cad rtogs/ /g.yon nas 'gro ba'i ce 2spyang ni/ /de bzhin g.yas 'gro shes par bya/ /ko dha li ni smra bar byed/ /de tsam gyis ni bya ba grub/ /'khor bas nga ni de nyid tsam du rtogs/ /bshad dang dkyil 'khor ci zhig bya/ /gang gis bcings pa ma rtogs sam/ /g.yon nas 'gro ba'i ce / —spyang ni/ /de nyid khyogayas 'gro shes par byed/ /ko dha li ni smra bar byed—/ /de tsam gyis ni bya ba grub/ /rtsa ba babyur nas yal ga dag /btsal ba des ni ci zhig bya/ /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis/ /'jig rten gsum yang gsal bar byas/ /g.yon nas 'gro ba'i ce rngospyang yang / /de nyid 27—179

g.yas 'gro shes par byed/ /de tsam gyis ni bya ba grub/ /chos nyid ji ltarasne snang ba yang / /de yi rang bzhin rang la bzhag /g.yon nas 'gro ba'i ce spyang yang / /de nyid g.yas 'gro shes par byed/ /ko dha li ni smra bar byed/ /de tsam gyis ni bya ba grub/ /sems nyid kyi de nyid bcing ba zhes bya ba slob dpon ko dha lis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/179 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉mun /sems nyid de nyid bcing ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 2 nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganyis/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/180 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1237)27wa 180

༄ga /gtum mo'i thig le bkram pa jes bya ba/rte༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsaṇ+ḍa līka 2bin+d+ra pra spa ra khaṃ nā ma/ bod skad du / gtum mo'i thig le bkram pa zhes bya ba/ yum gtum mo la phyag 'tshal lo / /lus ni gru bzhi 'dom gang tshad/ /'khor lo bzhi ni rang bzhin gnas/ /rlung ni gnyis te 'khor lo drug /rlung gi de nyid yang dag ni/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i rtsol ba dgag /rlung gi de nyid bsgoms nas ni/ /me chu sa yi de nyid shes/ /rtsa gsum gru gsum rang bzhin te/ /phyi rol ma yin nang yin no/ /srog gi rtsa nas yab kyi ngos/ /sor bzhi gnas su de gnas de / /thig le dang ldan yi ge saṃ/ /lte 4ba ye shes 'khor lo yin/ /sprul pa'i gnas su bsgom bya ste/ /de steng sor ni bcu gnyis la/ /chos kyi rang bzhin brgyad du be+e / /rigs bzhi yum bzhi sa bon gyi/ /rlung dang me dang chu ru gnas/ /de steng longs spyod bcu drug ni/ /me long ye shes yi ge saṃ/ /gsal la shel 27—181

ltar bsgom par bya/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas su ni/ /a phreng gnyis ldan yi ge haṃ/ /de ltar shes pa'i lus gnas ni/ /bde ba chen po'i yul zhes bya/ /lte ba'i ram̐ yig yi rlung gis/ /ye shes me nyid 'bar bar 'gyur/ /g.yo ba'i ye shes rlung yin te/ /brten pa'i mtshan nyid ye shes me/ /saṃ bcas dbus su 'bar na ni/ /sdug bsngal dug lnga'i nad rnams dag /bdag nyid stong pa'i mnyam nyid lha/ /log min rgyu nas 'khrul 'khor bya/ /bde chen gnas nas chos dbyings 'bar/ /sems kyi bde ba cher skyes na/ /gzhu rgod 'then nas 'phen par 'gyur/ /thig le 'thor nas dgram 2par bya/ /sems nyid snying gar bstems nas bsgom/ /gtum mo thig le bkram pa zhes bya ba slob dpon lu tsi kis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—182

bsdur mchan/181 nyu3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ cis 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srem dzokye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sta/182 3ri 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉then/ byu (1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkram/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtse/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1238 )27wa 183

༄/ /lus kyi rtsa thig mnyam pa nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba/—1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sha dṛ ra ṇa ri ka bin du sā mā tā 2nā ma/ bod skad du/ lus kyi rtsa thig 4mnyam pa nyid kyi man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji srid rtsa ba sdong bu rnams/ /brkos pas de ni ma byas na/ /de srid phag rgod gsod pa yi/ /mda' pa de ni tsha de 5yin/ /gnad du bsnun nas phag rgod gsad/ /dze+eng bu skams par ma gyur pas/ /de gong du ni brlag par byas/ /dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi pa yis/ /gru bzhi pa yi rdzing bu la/ /nang du zhugs par / byas nas ni/ /zas ni don du gnyer bar byed/ /shin tu bkang bar byas nas ni/ /gnad du bsnun nas phag rgod bsad/ /rdzing bu skams par ma gyur par/ /de gong du ni brlag par byas/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhu ru byas / /rtsa gnyis de ni rgyud du sbrengs/ /bla ma'i man ngag mda' ru byas/ /shin tu bkang bar byas nas ni/ /gnad du bsnun pas 7phag rgod bsad/ /rdzing bu 27dod18 4

༄ga /'byung ba bzhi'i srid pa'i chags lugs zhes bya ba/lha༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tur budhe bha ba bh+ya ba sha shaṃ kra baṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'byung ba bzhi'i srid pa'i chags trelugs zhes bya ba/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri rab zur ni brgyad pa dang / /rol pa'i mtsho ni bdun pa dang / /tshangs pa brgya byin nyi ma dang / /zla ba dang ni lha chen dang //mthu chen 'di dag rtag min na/ /bdag gis ji ltar brtan pa thob/ /bdag ni brtag na ji ltar yin/ /bdag gi ma ni gang du song / /pha yang gang du song bar 'gyur/ /'di lta bu yi 'jig rten ni/ /bltas pas 'jig rten rmi lam 'dra/ /stobs ldan gyur na sus kyang bkur/ /stobs nyams gyur na smra mi byed / /de bas tshem bu'i gos kyon la/ /bsod snyoms kyis ni 'tsho ba stethu/ /yul dang grong khyer so ma ru/ /yang yang sprang ba mkhas pa yin/ /'di lta bu yi spyod pa yis/ /'jig rten kun la rgyal ba thob/ /skal ldan bdag lhani tsa ra 27—186

pa tri smra/ /'byung ba bzhi'i hūṃsrid pa'i chags gelugs zhes bya ba slob dpon tsa ra pa tris mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/186 tu)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ca/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtags/ /④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉de/ (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag181 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhi/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ca/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1240)

༄/ /rang rig ye shes kyi lta ba'i nyams len zhes bya ba/rte༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+ma pa ri dzñā na dṛṣ+ṭi u pa de sha nā ma/bod skad du/ rang rig ye shes kyi lta ba'i nyams len zhes bya ba/ yum bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang rig ye shes las yin na/ /byed pa po med las med do / /de dag med na bya ba rnged/ /gsum ni ji ltar gnyis med do/ /gal te phyi ni bden pa yin/ /tha snyad 'byel phyir nang du brjod/ /gal te kun rdzob rang rig yin / /rig pas rig pa rig pa med/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid rig na ni/ /'khor ba'i snyug bsngal 'joms par byed/ /tha snyad 'di yis dngos po rnams/ /rang bzhin ma grub dri ma med/ /dngos po rnams ni ma grub pas/ /gzhan dag bdag la grub rgyu med/ /de phyir bdag ni rten med pa/ /gal te sgra don rtogs bya yin/ /rang bzhin don la sgra don med/ /dngos po ma grub rnal 'byor pa / /nga bdag 'di ni thams cad 4bral/ /gnyis bral ma rig mun pa med/ /27—188

de med dri med ye shes medarin/ /'di ltar rnal 'byor rig pa yis/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba grol bar byed/ /gan rkyal nyal ba rnal 'byor skye2/ /lus kyi rnam gzhag dran par gyis/ /mig bgrad rnam par shes pa 'bul/ /nam mkha'i phyogs su bltas byas pas/ /mthong rgyu yid la 'dzin rgyu med/ /phyogs kyi rtog pa bral ba yin / /dbang po nub 'gyur gnyis med 'grub/ /rang rig ye shes kyi nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon tsam pa gas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/188 tu7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skog (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kazhan ma/189 9)〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉te/ 〈〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spres/bsdubyed 'a lta 2/sta mig—————— —27—189

༄/ /'jogs pa brgyad zongs par byed pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa bu ra mut+ta ka ra rtsa 4u pā ya nā ma/bod skad du/ 'jigs pa brgyad rmongs par byed pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbrul stag chom rkun mda' dang me yi 4ni/ /'jigs pas mi 'jigs klu sgrub gdams pa thob/ /skar mkhan bi kha na ni 'jigs med de/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor nyams kyi nus pa bri/ /sems nyid 'dul zhing bdud 'joms rnal 'byor la/ /las ni ma rtogs rkyen gyi bar chod 'byung / /de phyir dang po'i 5rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos/ /'jigs skyob dran zhing bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /spyor ba byas 6pa'i snying po la sogs bzla/ /oṃ ste a rjes la ni bzhi pas sbyar/ /ka phreng gnyis pa las byung 7gsum pa ste/ /a phreng gsum pa rnal 'byor 'byel par mdzod/ /baṃ gyis bcings te dha ni rjes su bri—/ / rkan gyi / dang po dbyangs can lnga pas bcings/ /la dang i 'byor sha 27—190

za'i skad yin no/ /dbyangs can bcu gsum yi ge tsa yig ni/ /'byel nas mthar yang 'byung chen gnyis pa bri/ /phyis 'byung seng ge'i nang du stag ltar spyod / /byā gh+ra'i sgra sgrogs stag gi 'jigs pa med/ /kan dhā bzla zhing mda' yi 'jigs pa bral/ /sab pa snal chen rnams kyi 1'jigs pa sel/ /mu haṃ kha bcings ban+dha swā hā bri / /2'gro ba'i don du rnal 'byor sems bskyed nas/ /bzlas bya nyon mongs bral zhing thar pa thob/ /a khu nag po'i khrag gis mig sman dang / /sor bzhi'i shing bu blangs nas rnam par 'phyang / /zla brgyad ro yi yan lag brgyad blangs nas/ /zla ba'i zhag la mchod dang gtor ma bya / zla zin dus su mi snang sgrub bzlas bya/ /tshe na'i spyor bas mgo ni mthong min no/ /mi mthong mi snang sbyor ba 'di yin no/ /oṃ ka li ka li ma hā ka li/ dze+e sa sho dha ni / sgo 4dzha ni/ sma sha 5na bha si ni dha byi dang / ma rma pa sh+yan+tu 6ma nu sha /a dang ha ha s+thā 7hūṃ swā hā mthar/ /brgyad dang bcu bzhi nag po'i tshes la ni/ /gos dmar gcer bu dur khrod mtshan mo ni/ /khye bzlas rak+ta'i gtor mas mi snang 'grub/ /da ni rnal 'byor yang snying spyor ba ni/ /snying po 'di lta ste gzhan yang zhal las blang / /oṃ ru dha ki rā ti/ ki ri ki ri/ mi ri mi ri/ru dh+ra a rnge le/ k+ṣu pa k+ṣu pa swā hā/8 'di ni brgyad brgya rnal 'byor bzlas byas nas/ /lam du 'gro ba'i dus su spyor ba bya/ /sbrul stag chom rkun mda' bcing bshad byas nas/ /sreg byed me yi nus pa'i rten 'byel bshad/ /chu sbal btang ba sbal tshil dzam —byer chu/ /zhib tu btags nas rkang pa lag pa bsku / /'di ltar snying po nye snying bshad byas nas/ /shar ba'i mar gyis gtor nas sreg 1 mi nus/ /sidhi nā gārdzu na pa dang ni/ /asni mo ha ra ti 27—/91

ra sgra dang / /de rjes te ta da ka ran te bri/ /ni pa ri bha na te me 1nus med/ /oṃ sernyi ni gārdzu na pa ste/ /pa yi ra gsum mthar sngags rdzogs par bzla/ /lan gsum gcod cing yungs kar mar khu gtor/ /be+egs bsregs me ru zhugs kyang sreg mi nus/ /nus pa mthar phyin sngags spyor gnyis pa ni/ /na mo la bhi shwa mi tra ya te/ /ju ta bha ha ha ste ste bha ya mi/ /tsi li swā hā med nus med par gyis/ /da 4ltar byang sems ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rim bzhin bsgrubs na 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /'jigs pa brgyad rmongs par byed pa'i thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon rnyi ṣa 5nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/19༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du khros pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga 'jigs pa brgyad rmongs par byed pa'i thabs jes bya ba bzhugs so/ / 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rte/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa shā// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yonas/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sko / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacas/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorabyung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stag 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnaman gyis/191 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉// // — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamad+ma/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byusto/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 // // 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra la/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngadzam/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sreg 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sernyi/ 1 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a ta/192 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasreg 〈〈pe 〉'a/ 〈〈snar 〉'a/ thu〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉lke/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba kha/27—192
193bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1242) 27—193

༄/ /phyi nang gi dug sel gyi rim pa zhes bya ba/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi ṣa an+ta ra bā khya ni thra ti ba 3bha na kra mo/bod skad du/ phyi nang gi dug sel gyi rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid dang mthun pa'i sgrub gnas su/ /phyi nang dug ni sel ba yi/ /gsang ba'i rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i thabs/ /ti lo bdag gis bshad par bya/ /rnal 'byor bskyed pa'i rim par ldan/ /ru tsog sbrul la sogs pa yi//dug chen 'joms pa'i oṃ āḥhūṃ/ /lan gsum brjod cing 'di ltar bsam/ /rtse sor 4bcu gnyis tshad du ni/ /spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga la/ /dbus su oṃ bsam bdud rtsi 'bab/ /spyor ba de yi rnal 'byor ni/ /skad cig gcig la mdangs ldan no/ /de ni phyi yi dug sel to / /5nang gi 'di ltar bsgom par bya / /rdo rje chen po'i snying ga'i dbus/ /sku mdog dkar po bsil ba'i 'od/ /tshes gnyis zla bar sprin chen po/ /bsgoms shing 'phros 'gyur rnam par bsdu/ /27—19 4

yang dang yang du bsam byas pas/ /nang gi nad med kun du bzang / /ri rgyal dang mnyam dug yod kyang / /skad cig gcig la sel zhing 'dren/ /skabs las byung ba'i dug sel ni/ /'dab brgyad pad+ma na sa ru/ /zla dkar gsal zhing dri ma med/ /ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi ni/ /a yig de dbus bsam par bya/ /dug lnga gag lhog rkyen gyi nad/ /spre'u khyem bya'i gzugs can rnams/ /de dag phyung zhing nam mkhar thim/ /bdag gi sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs khams dang / /gzugs med khams dang dngos med pas/ /de phyir rang bzhin nam mkha' ste/ /des ni stong pa rten sked pa/ /rnal 'byor mi rtog sems gtad do/ /phyi nang nad sel gyi gdams pa slob dpon ti lkulos mdzad pa sgogs so// //27—195

1317༄ / /g.yung drung 'khyil pa gsum gyi zhal gdams kyi nyams len zhes bya ba/tsho sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ nabye brta tra ya mu kha ā ga ma 3nā ma/ bod skad du/ g.yung drung 'khyil pa gsum gyi zhal gdams kyi nyams len zhes bya ba/yum rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i zhal gdams thob byas nas/ /g.yung drung gsum kyi gdams pa ni/ /stong nyid don ni rtogs pa'i phyir/ /shaṃ ka me kha la bshad bya/ /rang gi lus ni khong stong la/ /spyi bor brtsams nas lte ba'i bar/ /rtsa gsum ser dang dkar dmar ro/ /de rnams nang ni khong stong ste / /g.yas kyi rtsa la khab rtse tshad/ /rang bzhin bsal ba bsam par bya /g.yon par zla ba'i thig le ste/ /dbus kyi rtsa ni khong stong ngo / /de la sems gtad phyi nang stong / /shes pa rgod na g.yas g.yon gyi/ /thig le gnyis la sems gtad la/ /de nas dbu bcad dhū tī'i steng / /dhīḥlas g.yung drung 'khyil pa ni//me yi mdog can rnam bsam bya/ /g.yung drung 'khyel pa'i zur bzhi la/ /oṃ dang 27—197

āḥdang hūṃ dang phaṭa/ /g.yas phyogs ra sa'i steng du ni/ /a las zla ba'i g.yung drung 'khyel/ /byang chub sems kyi chu rlung bkag /g.yon pa la 1nā'i steng du ni//oṃ las g.yung drung 'khyil pa dmar/ /bsams pas me yi rlung 'gags so2 / /de nas rlung gi 'khor lo nas/ /rlung ni langs te mgrin par sleb/ /dbus su bde gshegs rlung rgyu bas/ /sor ni bcu gnyis rtsa 'thon nas/ /g.yas g.yon chu rlung me rlung ni/ /nyi zla'i rtsa nas 'byung byas nas/ /lha mo gnyis dag zhal du rngub//slar yang gnyis kyis phu byas pas/ /rtsa dag gnyis kyi 4rtsa bug brtol/ /rnam par rgyu ste g.yung drung 'phog /dbus kyi sems bskor byas nas su/ /gnyis ni g.yas skor g.yon skor ro/ /slar yang rlung gis dephu byas nas/ /g.yung drung gnyis la thim byas nas/ /dbus kyi 'khyil pa thim par bsam/ /ye shes me sbar rang lus ni/ /mgrin pa'i gnas nas rkang mthil bar/ /rim gyis zhu ste chos dbyings su / /mnyam nyid thig ler sems gtad do/ /brtags pas ma grub dngos med yin / /dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad bral/ /de ltar ma bsgoms ci byas kyang / /lhan skyes ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams/ /thig le de las blangs byas nas//bdag nyid dbu bcad yum du bskyed/ /de nas lte bar hri 6yig bsam/ /sum mdor shaṃrlung ldang gyen la rgyu/ /tri nyani thig le gsum du zhu/ /i ni rlung gi thig le ste/ /ha ste byang chub thig le'o/ /rak+ta'i thig le re yig ste/ /mdor na rim par sngo dkar dmar/ /ma shar rlung gis gyen la 'ded/ /dbu bcad rtsa sbubs rgyu na ni/ /steng du sor bzhi 'thon par bsam/ /g.yon pa g.yon skor g.yas pa g.yas/ /dbus kyi thig le 'bar zhing thim/ /lha mo gnyis kyis phus btab pas/ /g.yas g.yon thig le dbus la thim/ /de nyid mar la rngub byas 27—198

༄/ /lhan cig byes pa'i rang bzhin zhes bya ba/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ha dza a nan+ta swa bhā ba na nā ma/ bod skad du / lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin zhes bya ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo rna rgyan mgul rgyan gdu bu dang / /ska rags khyod la bzang zhing rab tu mdzes/ /bo la kak+ko la myos ngo mtshar che/ /skad cig gcig la he ru ka dpal dgyes/ /kye ho rtsa lag 'di la bdag yid dga'/ /lus ngag sems kyi ro ni gcig byas nas/ /nam mkhar bsdus nas rnal 'byor sbas par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma kye 'di la bdag yid dga'/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug he dang hūṃ sgra spro / /phyogs bcur chang gis myas pa yi / /kye ho dpal ldan rnal 'byor ma//kye ma dpa' bo rnal 'byor med/ /stong pa dang ni snying rje'i rang bzhin la/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis ka med/ / pra phab gzugs bzhin mkha' la 27—200

snod / / 3kye ho rnal 'byor ma dang yum lnga'i grong / /ā li dang ni kā li nyi ma rnams / /med pa rmongs pa rnams kyang gti mug che/ /ā li rnams dang kā li nyi zla dag /med la shes min phyugs 'dra the tshom med/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams sbyor ba yis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod pa ngo mtshar che/ /kye ho rtsa lag 'di la bdag yid dga'/ /lus ngag sems kyi ro ni gcig byas nas/ /nam mkha'i khams su bsdus nas sbas par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma kye 'di la bdag sems dga'/ /tshad med gnas bzhi'i dbus su ni/ /bdag gis spyir 2yang dngos po brjod du med/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbang phyug ngo mtshar che/ /ji ltar chu gting chu zla dang 'dres ltar/ /rnal 'byor ma kye 'di la bdag sems dga'/ /sha rlon dam tshig rdzas 'di ngo mtshar che /go ku la sogs dam tshig la chags pas/ /de yis bdag med ma ni gar mdzad do/ /kye ho bde gshegs rnam snang phyag rgya can/ /rnal 'byor ma kye 'di la bdag sems dga'/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin zhes bya ba slob dpon kadze+e ris mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—201

༄7/ /a ti rnal 'byer gyi sgom pa'i thabs jes bya ba/1༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ a 2ti yo ga bhā nab na nā ma/ bod skad du/a ti rnal 'byor gyi sgom pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod brgyad la 'jigs byed brgyad/ /dus mtha'i me 'bar khams gsum bsreg /tshangs pa'i sgo nas du ba 'thul/ /rgya mtsho bskams geshing pad+ma 'bar/ /rdo rje ze 'bru'i dbus su ni/ /nyi ma'i gdan steng gnas pa de/ /nam mkha'i 'od chen hūṃ nyid sgrogs/ /mdzes pa'i sems nyid rgyu ba yin/ /rus sbal 'then cing sgra skad 'byung / /ri bong can gyis mdud pa bkrol/ /nyams myong dpa' bo rang rig rgyal/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i 'jigs pa'i bdag /mgon po nyid ni bsam par gyis/ /de nyid snying rje'i dkyil 'khor 'phro/ /de nyid dur khrod me yin te/ /de nyid smra dang zla rgyun 'dzag /skye rga shi dang khams gsum gnas/ /rang nyid dran te de nyid mthong / /27—203

༄/ /byang chub sems kyi rlung rgyu ba'i gdams ngag bsgom pa zhes bya ba/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā yu bo bye tsit+ta sra ba na bha ba na u pā —yo nā ma/bod skad du/ byang chub sems kyi rlung rgyu ba'i gdams ngag bsgom pa zhes bya ba/dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang lus khong stong bsam byas nas/ /lte ba'i dkyil du rlung nyid ni/ /phra la sngo ba yungs kar tshad/ /rnal 'byor de la sems gtad bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sems nyid skye/ /de nyid khong stong nam mkha' ru/ /nam mkha'i sprin ltar thim par bsam/ /rnal 'byor pho rlung 'phrog tsam na/ /'di ltar me rlung bdud rtsi 'bab/ /sum mdo rgyab kyi sgal tshigs la/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po bsam/ /lte bar rnge dang snying gar chu/ /mgrin pa'i sa las rlangs pa thon/ /gnyis rnged dhū da tī rnge yis khengs/ /mi jemada' chu shing me tog las / /rgyas shing sems kyi bung ba ni/ /ge sar bdud rtsi 'jib par bsam /rlung gis me sbar chu khol bas/ /drod skyes nam mkha'i bdud rtsi 'bab/ /khong stong 27—205

༄/ /lta spyod skye med kyi bsgom pa jes bya ba/1༄yi/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsar+ya dṛdze+e a nuta pan+da twa ta bhā 2ba na nā ma/bod skad du/ lta spyod skye med kyi bsgom pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems nyid stong pa skye med yin/ /de nyid ma bcos chos nyid de/ /de yang dbyer med lta ba rtogs/ /sgom las ma 'das pa ni smra/ /zhen med rnal 'byor rang sar spyod/ /phyogs bcur re med 'bras bu yin/ /de la mi re chags pa spyad/ /rang bzhin nyams skyes ngo mtshar che/ /pa na ha ni smra bar byed / /gnyis med ye shes rtogs pa yin/ /bde chen bdud rtsi bdag gis 'thungs je / /kuñdza chona'i phreng bas mgul pa brgyan/ /lo ma'i sham thabs brtan par chings/ /myos pas nags kyi gseb tu 'khyam/ /bdag nyid pa na ha ngo mtshar mthong / /pu ri ma lar bdag po lnga/ /gcig dang mi 'byel ngo mtshar che/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas su ni/ /me tog ldum ra rgyas par byed/ /27—207

༄ / /tshe sgrub pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ba/ 1 ༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā 3yu pa ri rak+ṣa nā ma/ bod skad du/tshe sgrub zupa'i gdams ngag ces bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bcud len zhal gyi gdams pa yis/ /lus ngag rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /de med bsgrub thubya grub min pas/ /des na thams cad 'bad pa yis/ /don ni thams cad sgrub pa'i phyir/ /skabs 'byung tshe sgrub 5'di ru bshad/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi 'o ma mnyam/ /snum pa'i snod la sbyar byas nas/ /nas kyi sbang mar zhag gcig bzhag /de nas bton 6nas nye bar bza'/ /so dang sen mo zla drug gis/ /brjes 3'gyur lo ni stong thub ste/ /rtags ni mig no stobs ldan no/ /nye shing rtsa ba blang byas nas/ /grib skam zhib tu btags par bya/ /'o ma'am zho dang sbyar byas nas/ /zho ni langs nas 27—209

—sgog 1par bya/ /mar sar blangs nas tho rangs bza'/ /zhag ni bdun nas rtags 'byung ste/ /bdun gnyis gyur nas nyi 'od ldan/ /bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig nas/ /'bras bu nad sel lus yang ngo lo drug tu ni bza' btung gis/ /rnam rtog bral zhing tshe 'grub bo/ /tho ras mu zi srang phyed ni/ /yungs kar mar khus btul nas bza'/ /shu ba'i nad sel tshe 'grub 'gyur/ /sprin nag zho gnyis sbrul mig pa'i/ /khu bas mnyes nas gang bar bya/ /zhu rjes drug cu'i 'bras chan btang / /'o ma btung zhing tsha sngo spang / /lo gcig sbyor ba 'grub par 'gyur/ / byeng ga 4ra dza' phye la ni/ /mar dang sbrang gi rtsi sbyar nas/ /lto stong dag la bza' bar bya/ /sgyur rtsang bcud can kha zas btang / /zla ba drug tu zos gyur 5na/ /nad rnams sel cing nyis brgya thub/ /'bras bu gsum dang lcags phye dang / /de bzhin z-ing 6ga ra dza dang / /ru rta dang ni cha mnyam ste/ / byeng ga'i ⑩khu bas sde gur sbyar/ /grib skams phye ma bza' bar bya/ /reg pa dang ni sngo skyur spang / /lo gnyis kyis ni 'grub 'gyur ro / /lcags kyi lhang bzed mar gyis bkang / /lha shing rtsa ba'i shun lpags ni/ /zhib btags sbyar la lo gcig bzhag /gza' skar bzang po'i dus su bton/ /yi dam lha yi bsnyen trepa bskyal/ /ra yi 'o ma btung bar bya/ /zla ba gsum na gnyer ma dngas/ /zla ba drug nas rlung shugs ldan / /lo gcig spyor bas tshe 'grub bo/ /'bras bu gsum dang z-ing ga'i blophye/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar la bza'/ /sman nyid zhu ba'i dus su ni / /'o ma 'bras bskol bza' bar bya/ /mig rno nad med sum brgya 27—210

thub / /tho rangs a ru gnyis dag dang / /nyi ma phyed la ba ru ste/ /zhag dus sgyu ru bzhi dag za1/ /drug cu'i 'bras dang 'o ma yi/ /rnal 'byor kha zas ci nus btang / /skra dkar gnyer ma nad rnged pas/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug nad med ldan/ /bya khyung lta bur mig rno 'gyur/ /'bras bu gsum gyi lde gu ni/ /lcags kyi snod la bskus byas la/ /nyin mtshan gnyis ni khrus byas nas/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar la bza'/ /lo gcig spyor bas sum brgya thub/ /nad byang so dang sen mo brje/ /ko ki la lta bu'i skad ldan 'gyur/ /de phyir bdag nyid ko ki lar grags/ /tshe sgrub 5pa'i gdams ngag ces bya ba slob dpon ko ki las mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—211

bsdur mchan/2༷9 4)tshomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stam/ ri sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ ri'u7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ston/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rjes/ skre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉togams/21༷ nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dkrog 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torangs/ ci /sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gdamig ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'bring gha/'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toragyur/ nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabring / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torabring gha'i/ du 〈〈snar 〉〉bsnyan/klu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'bring gha'i/211 nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bza'/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1249)27wa 212

༄ / /dug sel bsgom pa'i rim pa jes bya ba/ 1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi ṣa ni baṇ+ḍaṃ bha ba na dze+e kra oṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ dug sel bsgom 3pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi dang nang gi dug bzhi'i rtsa ba ni/ /sems can rnams kyi srog gcod 'khyam 1pa'i rgyu/ /de rnams sel thabs zhal nas zhal brgyud pa/ /a ram̐ bdag gis sgom lugs bshad/ /thog mar nang gi dug sel bzhi rnams la/ /zhe sdang gnyen po bdag gzhan grub med la/ /chags pa'i gnyen po mi gtsang rang lus sman/ /nga rgyal gnyen po 'di dag mi rtag pa/ /phrag dog 'dus pa'i nad ni spang byas nas/ /gti mug gnyen po bla ma lha nyid dang / /rnal 'byor tshad med bzhi ni bsgom par bya/ /de yis bdag gzhan nad sel nad med 'grub/ /phyi ltar tshad med 'bras bu rang snying dbus/ /tha yig dkar po ba tshan lnga pas brgyan/ /ye shes bya khyung phyag rdor snying por ldan/ /27—213

bdud kyi gdan la haṃ sa'i bya khyung ste/ /hūṃ 'byung sna tshogs gser gyi gshog pa can / /dbu skra bcas pa'i khyung zhal dmar po ste/ /rwa gnyis nyi zla'i thig le dag gis brgyan/ /pus mo se ral brang dang lte ba dkar/ /'jigs byed klu rgyal rnams kyis brgyan pa bsgom/ /zhal nas haṃ sa'i bdud rtsi dkar ser 'dzag/ha phus zhal nas dug gi rlangs pa 'thul/ /de ltar bsgoms shing sngags kyi glu nyid blang / /oṃ a ra haṣ+ṭa 1gha 'i dza'/ gho sa'i phyag 2 ka ra'i/ dha su na sa'i / tu hi bye tu ka ba lo/ tig khu bye sa na'i/ bhi sa bhi ṇa khaṃ/ ne+e sa su ma sa ṇi/ a bha ru ha bhu ju / bhadhi bhu ye sa la ye/ bha bi se na/ ki byeta thi / e larlu bi 4la ḍa ṇa/ a tha ka'i/ tsan dhe tsan dha bhe sa ṇi/ u pa ri dha hi/ a tha ka'i ka ra/ hri rjo rjad+ma/ ts+tsha/ hri k+ṣiṃ yi/ a sa pa yi rde me/dze+e 7gha li/ bye saṃ kha mi/ dha 6/saṃ pi waṃ mi/ le ba rde/ ma jo khaṃ ka ro yi/j-i 7bhe khaṃ/ bhe se —ṇa ba bha'i/ ti rgo bhe la/ e a i/ hi hi/ ṛ ṛ /sid+dhā dze+e ga li/ ra ha ṛ sbyirak+ṣi dza yi 1 swa hā/ 5 dug gis zin pa 'am/ sbrul gyis rmugs pa la/ rna bar glu len chur 2bzlas byin pa yis/ /skad cig gcig la dug nad sel bar 'gyur/ /da ni bskyed rim rdzogs rim 'di ltar bsgom / /bde chen nam mkhar saṃ ste haṃ yig gis/ /zla ba'i thig le dkar la gangs ltar bsil/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas bdud rtsi'i 'od zer ni/ /dkar ser 'dzags te khong stong lus 'di mudag /rkang la zhugs pa'i phyi nang dug rnams ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pas sel 'gyur ze tshom med/ /zla tshes dkar po thig les brgyan pa ni/ /sems nyid bdud rtsi tshidabus su dkar dmar ltar/ /snying ga'i kha spyor pad dbus spyor byed na/ /de yis phyi nang 27—214

dug sel byang chub bsgrub1/ /phyi yi dug rnams sel ba'i sman spyor ni/ /mtshan mo'i sman ni srang gcig 'o mar bskol/ /dug zin 2rnams la btang bas dug 'dren no/ /mtshan mo ma dang sbrul mig thang bskol te/ /lo dug sbyar 4dug rnams ni sel 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'di 5ni ras la lan bdun bzlas/ /dug can nad pa de yis bkab byas nas/ /de nas chu yi snod la rkang lag bcug/sngags 'di bzlas shing brab cing gdab/ /oṃ na ma sha ba ra dze+e/ sha ba ri ku ma ra ka rgo/ khu khu ri/ sa ra sa ra/ pa tre pra bhi shudha6/ gha re swā hā/ de ltar bzlas shing byang chub sems bsgom mo/ /gdams ngag 'di bstan dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ /gang thob de yis 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa dag cing byang chub sems/ /dri med mkha' ltar phyag rgya chen po thob par shog /dug sel bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba slob dpon a rang gis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—215

༄/ /gnyis med kyi rtsa bsgom pa'i rim pa/3 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ a dwa ya ni ri ka bha ba na kra ma2/ bod skad du / gnyis med kyi rtsa bsgom pa'i rim pa/ gnyis med bde chen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi klong dkyil du/ /myos pas dbyings su rin chen stor/ /kye ma rigs nyams ngo mtshar che/ /mnyam nyid gnas su gnyis pred 'gyur/ /bdag gis de ni ma rtogs pas/ /ni la khan dhas mtshams su 'joms / /bdag gis de ni ma rtogs pas/ /dge spyong gis ni mtshams su 'joms / /gnyis med sems ni gnyis med 'gyur4/ /mkha' yi bdag nyid mgul nas mkhyud5/ /bdag gzhan brje 6ba'i khyad par byas/ /gnyen 'dun thams cad rlag par byas7/ /de 8ni bdag gis ma rtogs pas/ /ni la khan dhas mtshams su 'joms/ /de ni bdag gis ma rtogs pas/ /dge spyong gis ni mtshams su 'joms/ /gzhon nu lo ni bcu gnyis ma/ /ci yang 27—217

bdag gis rtogs pa med/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi byed gnas pas/ /'phyon ma dang ni 'dra bar byas/ /de ni bdag gis ma rtogs pas/ /ni la khan dhas mtshams su 'joms/ /dung dang gser dang dngul dag kyang / /gcig kyang bdag la dgos pa med/ /bdag nyid 'thad pa'i grogs dang 'grogs/ /he ru ka la 'khyud pa yis/ /bdag gi rgyal srid ngo mtshar che/ /nam mkha' deng rtser 1chags pa la/ /sus kyang ma mthong ngo mtshar che/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad dga' zhing 'khyud/ /he ru ka dang 'khyud nas gnas/ /gnyis med kyi rtsa bsgom pa zhes bya ba slob dpon nag po nas brgyud napa slob dpon ni la khan dhas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—218

༄/ /phra ba'i rnal 'byer zhes bya ba// ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sugh+ra yo ge nā ma/ bod skad du/ phra ba'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ dpal gshin rje'i 2gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyim du khyem bdag rnal 'byor pa/ /gsang 'khyud gnyis med bsgom par bya/ /'jigs pa can gye rnam rtog 'di/ /khyod kyis 'di kun sba bar gyis/ /tshad kyang gzung du med pa la/ /de yi rigs kyang rtogs pa med/ /sa mu dra yi dge spyong ni/ /sa gsum grags pas khyab par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid myos pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /dug lnga khrus shing dag par 'gyur/ /'jigs pa can gyi rnam rtog 'di/ /nang du mnan nas bsad par gyis/ /rigs kyi nga rgyal spang byas nas / /dge spyong bdag gis smras pa yin/ /dbang po sna tshogs mthong 'gyur kyang / /dus kyi pho nyas dran pa yis/ /ci phyir bdag nyid 'gro 'ong byed / /mtha' gnyis bral na don rnams grub/ /'jigs pa can gyi rnam rtog 27—220

'di / /sems 'di mnan nas spang bar gyis/ /rnal 'byor rnam rtog gcod pa yis/ /sa tshomu dra dag dngos med 'gyur/ /phra ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa yis / /bdag nyid gnyis med grub pa thob/ /phra ba'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len zhes bya ba slob dpon sa mu dras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/22༷ /rinyamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉smon phra ba'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/221 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rngos/bsdur 'bras re'u mig— rgyud/ (1252)27wa 221

༄/ /phyi nang bdud rtsi'i babyud len zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā khya an+tar a mṛ ta kalpa nā ma/ bod skad du/phyi nang bdud rtsi'i bcud len zhes bya ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /rgyun chad bdud rtsis gsang ba bcud len gyis/ /nyams len thabs dang de yi sman spyor dang / /nyams su blangs na tshe ring grub pa thob/ /de phyir bdag nyid bya ra'i nyams len bshad/ /rnal 'byor phyi yi nyams len byed na ni//bdud rtsi lnga yis rang lus dag par byas/ /rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa rnams/ /rang gi lus gnas nyams len shes pa med/ /mā ma shī yi rgyud btus nyams len bshad/ /rnam snang blangs la rdo rje'i chu yis dkrugs—/ /btsir nas snod kyi nang du thun phyed bzhag /byin brlab —mchod bya rlung med sa ru brdung / /rlung nad can la bu ram sbyar bar bya/ /bad kan can la tsha ba gsum dang sbyar/ /dri med rnam 27—222

snang btsir nas grib skam bya/ /zhib par btags nas mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar/ /mi bskyod pa yis sbrus nas bza' btung bya/ /sha dang 'o ma za zhing chang rnams spang / /rnam snang nyams len bdag nyid bh+ya ris smras/ /mi bskyod bskol 1 nas mar dang kha ra sbyar/ /grangs par byas nas rnal 'byor btung bar bya/ /chang dang bud med spangs na 2zla drug grub/ /mi bskyod bcud len bh+ya ris smra bar byed/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gan bye 4dngul chu dang / /ra yi 'o ma sbrang dang bhi ta ste/ /zhib par btags ltanas ka ra la sogs sbyar/ /mar khu bton nas rnal 'byor lus la byugs/ /sman rnams gtong dus khengs pa'i dus su gtong 4/ /gzhan dang mi 'dra bha ri stobs skyes 7so/ /dbyar zla gsum la don yod grub pa yi sna/ /a ru ra dang sman tsha sbyar la bza'/ /ston gsum ka ra a ru ra sbyar nas/ /rnal 'byor pa ni lto stong dag la bza'/ /dgun gsum 'bras bu gsum dang sbyar la bza'/ /dpyid gsum mar sbrang 'bras bu gsum sbyar bza'/ /don yod grub pa'i rnal 'byor bcud len pas/ /nad rnams sel zhing don rnams grub par byed/ /shing mngar sbrang mar 'od dpag sked pa 'bras bu gsum/ /cong 9zhi dang sbyar zos na nad rnams sel/ /cis kyang rnal 'byor bla ma'i zhal la stos/ /'od dpag med kyi bcud len bh+ya ris smras / /zla ba drug nas rnal 'byer ru rta bskol 1 la btang / /dkar gsum mngar gsum rten dbang chu bskol 1btang / /mdor na ci dgos kha zas rim gyes spang ka/ /brag la sbyar nas bh+ya ris brten par bya/ /kha zas rgyun chad bshad nas gsang ba bshad par bya/ /snying ga'i dbus nas yi dam lha nyid ni/ /rdo je phag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ldan/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung bdud rtsi 27—223

—bum pa 'dzin/ /ngag tu hūṃ brjod snying ga gyen la bzlog 1 /yum gyi 'od kyis dkar nag mtshams su bcad/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ brjod zhal nas bdud rtsi 'dzag2 /dkar nag bcad pa'i mtshams nas 'bab pa yin/ /rang lus khong stong 'o ltar gang bar bsam/ /de ni ting 'dzin sems dpa' bdag gis smras/ /mdun gyi mkha' la ye shes sems dpa' ste/ /yid kyis dran nas de yi 'od kyis ni / /rang gi smin mtshams yan chad thod pa bcad / /ye shes sems dpas oṃ āḥhūṃ brjod pas/ /thod pa'i bdud rtsi 'dzag ste 5rtsa sbubs zhugs/ /bum pa'i 'og tu re 'bar bdud rtsi blugs/ /de nas 'dres pas lus ni bdud rtsis gang / /gnyis med de yi stobs kyis chu ser sogs/ /gsang ba'i gnas nas mar la 'dzag 6par bsam/ /de nas mar shal yar 7la bdud rtsis rang lus gang / /slar yang rnal 'byor thod pa'i bcad 'phro las/ /bdud rtsi sor gcig lud nas gang bar bsam3/ /gal te rnal 'byor rlung khams skyes na ni//snying ga'i bum pa mar gyis gang bar bsam/ /mkhris pas skya rims tshad nad 'bab nad la/ /ga pur chu bzhin nang lus bsel bar bsam/ /rnal 'byor grang ba'i nad ni na gyur na/ /drod sman rnams kyi 1stobs ni bsgom par bya / /bsgoms kyang skyo na tri yig blo ldan bzla/ /bh+ya ri bdag gis gsang ba'i bcud len smras/ /brtan pa'i sems kyis rnal 'byor nyid kyis bsgrubs//nyams su myong ba'i yon tan nad rnams sel/ /zla drug shes rab blo 'phel rang bzhin skye/ /slob dpon bh+ya ris gsungs pa'i phyi nang gi bdud rtsi'i spyobacud len gyi gdams pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na pha las rang 'gyur du mdzad nas/ bshad rgyud kyi 27—224

༄/ /do ha spyod pa'i glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba/3 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsar+ya dṛṣ+ṭi do ha gī ti ka nā ma/ bod skad du/do ha spyod pa'i glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rma bya'i gdugs bsgreng dwa'adzin byed cing / /cha byad sna tshogs 'dzin byed pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa ni smyon pa 'dra/ /nga rgyal can la rgyal ba'i lam/ /med ces lū/ yi smra bar byed/ /lus kyi tshim bu bsrungs pas grub/ /dbang bsgur mang ngo/ blang bya ste/ /don med par ni slu bar byed/ /dbang bskur rtogs par ma gyur na/ /dus kyi dbang du 'gro ba yin/ /nga rgyal can la rgyal ba'i lam/ /med ces lū yi smra bar byed/ /lus kyi tshim 4bu bsrungs pas grub/ /gnyid dang chang dang rtsod pa dang / /sbyor bas rnal 'byor ji ltar grub/ /bzlog na srid pa'i zhags pas bcings/ /nga rgyal can la rgyal ba'i lam/ /med ces lū yi smra bar byed/ /lus kyi tshim 5bu bsrungs pas grub/ /tshang dus kham phor 27—226

gser skyogs ltar/ /gal te de ltar byas pa na/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad par 'gyur/ /nga rgyal can la rgyal ba'i lam/ /med ces ༷/ yi smra bar byed/ /lus kyi tshim (1bu bsrungs pas grub/ /do ha spyod pa'i glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon lū yi (37pa nas brgyud pa slob dpon ki ra pas mdzad nga/ rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/226 tu mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kho do ha spyod pa'i glu'i lta ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgreng / ma〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ ci snatshoge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/227 〉〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉zam/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staṇ+ḍi/bsdur 'bras re'u migawa rgyud/ (1254)27wa 227

༄/ /stong pa nyid kyi lta ba zhes bya ba/tso ༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ shu n+ya tā dṛṣ+ṭi nā ma/ bod skad du/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba zhes bya ba/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems kyi rtog rtse chos nyid ni/ /sa bon nam mkha'i dbyings su smos/ /bdag med gzhon nus mgul nas 'khyud/ /gnyid sad byed pa nyid du gnas/ /spongs shig dor shig bdag rmongs so/ /kye ho bcings pa ma lus pa/ /sha ba ri bde chen por rol/ /stong pa'i btsun mo 'khyud byas te/ /kye ho lus ngag sems smin te/ /thams cad dus su ཿbrtags pa yis/ /sha ba ri ni myos par 'gyur/ /dga' ba'i rnam pa thams cad du/ /sha ba ri ni gnyid log nas/ /gnyid ni nam mkha'i dbyings su log /kye ho bdag gi de nyid ni/ /sa bon nam mkhar mnyam par smos//'bras bu nam mkhar skar chen shar/ /spongs shig dor shig bdag rmongs so/ /srid pas bcings pa'i glang chen bsad/ /dbang po lnga yi gtor ma byas/ /27—228

༄khya/ /bde sdug gnyis bral gyi lta ba zhes bya ba/tsho ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ su kha duḥkha adh+ya pa rir+ya gha dṛṣ+ṭi nā ma/ bod skad du/ bde sdug gnyis bral gyi lta ba zhes bya ba/ yum shes rab kyi pha ro'/ tu phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgom las 'das pa sgrub rgyu med/ /mgon ngo/ rnams kyi bdag nyid can/ /grub thob rnams kyi bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal gnyis/ bral lta ba bshad/ /rang bzhin bsgom 3rgyu med pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor sgom las 'das pa yin/ /dngos dang dngos min gnyis dang bral/ /de phyir kun rdzob grub pa med/ /dngos po sgom med dngos med min/ /rang bzhin dbyer med rgyu las 'das/ /nam yang rang bzhin ye shes te/ /zung 'jug dga' ba gnyis su med/ /dran pa dang bral dran med de/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 'khrul nga/ yin / /shes rab thabs kyi zung 'jug la/ /rnal 'byor gzhan gyi dgongs pa ni/ /dang po thabs ni bsgom pa'i phyir/ /mi rtog shes rab skad cig la/ /27—230

ma grub thabs kyang grub mi 'gyur/ /mthong min de ni bsgom pa min/ /gang zhig thabs ni sgom byed na/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag ldan pa yis/ /yang dag phyag rgya thabs nyid kyis/ /phra zhing rang bzhin rab rgyu ba/ /ye shes kun gyi bdud rtsi 'bab/ /mtshon pa'i 'od gsal skad cig la/ /blo ldan brtan pa'i sems kyis bsgom/ /brtags pas ma grub rtog 1bral yin/ /dper na 'gron po yul 'gro bzhin/ /chos sku'i mtshan mar sems gtad pas/ /rim gyis sleb pas de nyid min/ /sngar bzhin mtshan ma med gyur pas2/ /rnam rtog dang bral bde chen 'grub/ /sna tshogs pa yi rig pa rnams/ /rang rig gzhan gyis rig mi 'gyur/ /de rtogs nyin mtshan bde chen mnyam/ /gnyis dang gnyis med spangs gyur pa'i/ /gang la mi gnas rnal 'byor de/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa rtogs/ /de rtogs bdag med lta ba yin/ /rnal 'byor bde sdug gnyis dang bral/ /gnyis bral rnal 'byor shārnyi 4pa/ /rtogs pas phyag rgya chen po thob/ /bde sdug gnyis bral gyi lta ba zhes bya ba slob dpon shābye 3nga/sa mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—231

bsdur mchan/230 tusnamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ran bde sdug gnyis bral gyi lta ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// khu/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/231 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur bas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉staspris/ du⑦〈〈pe 〉〉bām ti/〈〈snar 〉〉gli ti/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1256)27wa 232

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ a saṃ ban+dha dṛṣ+ṭi nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'byel rnged kyi lta ba zhes bya ba/ 'byel med rgyun chad ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig dang rten pa'i tha snyad la/ /re zhig rten 2na 'jig rgyu med/ /'jig dang rten gyis ci zhig bya/ /de phyir 'jig rten pa yis ni/ /rnam par gzhag pa yod min la/ /'jal byed tshad mar shes par bya/ /khyab bya dang ni khyab byed kyi/ /dbye ba'i dpe yi dbang du ni/ /nyi ma khyab bya zhes bya ste/ /'od zer khyab byar shes par bya/ /dper na 'o mar 'dres pa yi / /mar ni dang por yod min te/ /khyab bya khyab byed 'thad 4min la/ /de dag 'byel pa yod min no/ /me yi rgyu ni gang yin la/ /de la 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung / /me yi mtshan nyid sreg byed de/ /de nyid khyab byed ces bya ste/ /khyab byar du ba yin par mthong / /pha ni sangs rgyas khyab byed de/ /bu ni dam chos khyab byar gsungs/ /27—233

dper na bum pa'i me de ni/ /nang gsal phyi tshoni gsal mi byed/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas gsal byed me/ /chos ni ji ltar gsal bar byed/ /dang po chos min sangs rgyas min/ /skye min la ni ji ltar 'byel/ /rgyu rnams 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung / /gsungs pa rgyu med 'bras bu me3// /khyab bya khyab byed ji ltar sgrub / /g.yo dang mi g.yo rnams kyis ni/ /rten 'jig je'abyung ba rnams kyi ste/ /'byung bzhi mtha' dag rang mi sgrub/ /shing ni khyab bya yal ga dang / /rtsa ba khyab byar 3ji ltar yod/ /bdag dang bdag gis rtogs shepa yis / /ming dang ming can 'phros pas 'byung / /dang po ming can ming zhe na/ /de ltar gang zhig ldog pa ni/ /khyab bya de bzhin ldog pa'o/ /rten cing 'bre'/ pas 'byung ba ste/ /rten cing 'byel par 'gog 7par byed/ /gcig 8la yang dag 'byung ba ni/ /byis pa rnams kyis smra bzhin byed/ /khyab bya ldog na 'gal ba med/ /de ltar de ni 'jig rten kyi/ /'jal byed tshad mar shes par bya/ /ji ltar ri bong rwa co ni/ /brtags bzhin yod pa ma yin te/ /de bzhin du ni chos rnams la/ /gang zhig rtogs bzhin yod pa min/ /ba yi rwa — co ji ltar ni/ /shar dang nub ni de bzhin du/ /phrad par shes par mi 'gyur te—/ /dpe ni de bzhin lta drug pa/ /phyi nang mu stegs rtags can dang //nang pa sangs rgyas nyan thos dang / /a ti dang ni gcer bu dang / /grub mtha' khyab 'jug tshangs skud can/ /phyi nang gnyis ni sgrub min pa/ /rnams la 'byel pa yod min la/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa de yin te/ /de dang mi ldan gang zag ni/ /'jig rten 'das zhes mi bya'o/ /de yi dbang du byas nas ni/ /brtags pas khyab bya gang zag ni/ /bdag gzhan gang zag yod 27—234

dod —min no/ /bya ba mtho ris ngan song dang / /khyab bya sems nyid gnyis su mthong / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa bzhin/ /bdag gir 'dzin pas 'khor ba ste/ /de nyid bral zhing bde gshegs te/ /chags pa zhe sdang rmongs pa dang / /bral zhing rgyun chad mya ngan 'das/ /de ltar rtogs pas sangs rgyas te/ /gsungs pa de ni mi rigs so/ /'khor ba de ni mya ngan min/ /mya ngan 'das la mya ngan med/ /rig pa dang ni ma rig pa'o/ /gnas skabs rtogs pas ①bcing bar byed/ /mi rtog bkrel bar grugasungs pa ste/ /rtog pa rnams la khyad par med/ /yong 'gro dag ni byang chub la/ /nye ring tha snyad yod pa min/ /nyon mongs mun pa byang 'gyur la/ /mthong min de la yod min no/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni lung las gsungs/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i rgya mtsho ni/ /ji ltar yi dwags skams par mthong / /de bzhin ma rig myun pa yis/ /tshig pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas ni/ /yod pa min la mthong ba min / /rdzogs chen pa yi zulung las ni/ /chos nyid gzhi thu'am ma bcos pa/ /khyab byed de la 'byung ba yi/ /'gro drug khyab par zhegasungs pa'o/ /cung zad dge ba'i chos rnams la/ /sangs rgyas mi sgrub ci zhig byed/ /dper na dmus long skyes bu la/ /'bar ba'i rin chen lag mthil bzhag /mthong min de yis ci zhig bya/ /nang pa mu stegs dbang du ni/ /rang rig 'od gsal khyab byed de/ /rnam par rig pa khyab bya sems/ /dper na chu dang bsres pa yi/ /'o ma sgod ni gcig pa ste/ /ji ltar chu ni lus byas nas/ /ngang pas 'o ma 'thung bar byed/ /de bzhin nyon mongs 'dres pa ni/ /ye shes snod ni gcig pa ste/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor rig pa 'thung / /ma rig pa ni lus par byed/ /27—235

nang pa mu stegs rnams kyis ni/ /lta ba de ni gsungs pa'o/ /de la lan gyi dbang du ni/ /sangs rgyas lung las 'di ltar gsungs/ /byed po med la las kyang med/ /de dag med la khyab bya med/ /gsum med 'byel pa ji ltar sgrub —1//phyi ni bden pa gal te yod/ /nang ni bden par rang bzhin no/ /gang zhig rtogs snyepa phyi don la/ /de med gang zhig yod pa min/ /rang dang gzhan gyi rig pa min/ /de phyir khams gsum 'byel pa med/ /de phyir rig pa dngos po la/ /mtshan nyid yod pa ma yin no/ /dngos po rig min dngos min bzhin//skye min de ni bdag med pa/ /bdag med pa ni skye mi len/ /de ni kun rdzob mi rigs te/ /gal te rigs na don dam med/ /re zhig rgyu med skye ba med/ /'bras bu med la skye ba med/ /bdag la mi skye gzhan la min/ /gnyis la min phyir kun rdzob min/ /rang rig bde gsal khyab byed dang / /rnam rig tsam du khams gsum dang / /sems kyi 'dod pa khyab bya yi/ /dbang du bshad pa byas nas ni/ /nyan thos rnams kyi dbang du ni/ /kun gzhi ke — rnam shes khyab byed la/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / /rtog pa rnams ni khyab bya'o/ /dper na nam mkha' khyab byed ni / /nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang / /sprin dang glog dang chu sogs dang / /khyab bya mi 'gal deyon tan bcu/ /de ltar dpe rnams gnyis yin te/ /tha snyad 'jal byed tshad mar shes/ /de la don dam 'jal byed kyi/ /tshad ma'i dbang du byas nas ni/ /gong ma'i dpe don rnam gnyis ni/ /shaṃ pa la yi dgongs pa ni/ /phyi sgrub lus las gsungs pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas dang ni grub 6rnams kyis/ /nyams rang rig pa gsal bar gsungs/ /de las lung gi dbang du ni/ /chos kyi bdag ni yod min la/ /khams gsum 27—236
