1344༄ / /rdo rje mkha' 'a1 ma'i brda'i mgur zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra ḍā ki m+bi gī ti 27nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i brda'i mgur zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas rtogs pa'i lta ba'i brda bstan skyepa/ gser gyi ral gri til ngar ldan pa da phyung la/ /bung bas me tog rtsi bcud ma lus myang bar gyis/ /chu bran sna tshogs rgya mtshor gcig go lan tshul ro/ /me long bzhin ni byad yin gud du ma sems cig /chu yi zla ba 'di la byis pa ltad mo byed / /bu ram gzugs 'di tha dad snang yang mngar ba'i ro/ /nam mkha' gzugs su mthong ba'i byis pa snying re rje/ /ri bo rlung gis bskyod du med pa shin tu gces/ /ta la'i sdong po byegs na mgo rtsa gnyis ka skam/ /nam mkha'i kha dog rkyen kyis 'gyur ba ngo mtshar che/ /'dab chags mkha' la gnas kyang grib ma sa la rgyu/ /shel gye kong 6bu'i mar me 'di la dri ma med/ /rmi 27—318

lam sad pa'i skyes bu 'di ni blo sems bde/ /gzings la gnas pa'i bya rog gang bder 'gro bar gyis/ /khang stong nang gi khyi rkun 'di ni ltad mor che/ /shel la tshon gyis bsgus kyang gting nas 'gyur ba med/ /rang gis bsags pa'i 3gser la ka 'jis 3brdar mi dgos/ /ded dpon lam rgyus can dang 'grogs na nor bu lon/ /drang srong nags la chud pa 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /ku sha rlung gis bsgul 1ba'i rtsa ba a sgore 'khrul/ /gdeng rnged gyad kyi spyod pa byed pa snying re rje/ /sman dug 'dres pa 'di yi 5gnyis ka'i nus pa nyams/ /glang po'i gzugs brnyan 'di la khal gyi nus pa med/ /rin chen snod du bzhag nas 'tsho ba gong du slong / /nam mkha' gos su gyon nas 'byung ba gnas su thim / /khur bar chu blugs skyes bu de yis smra ma shes/ /rgyal po'i rjes gnang thob pas hūṃgashed ma la mi 'jigs/ /ral gri'i 'khor los mtshon cha gang yin gtub par byed/ /'dab ma gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems can mkha' la 'gro/ /a ma mthong ba'i byis pa gzhan gyis 'khrid du med/ /sa bon rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi nus pa mkha' la bskams3/ /nyi ma mkha' la shar ba'i rgyu skar zil gyis gnon//snying phyung de nas yan lag g.yob par ga la nus/ /mtho yor mi ru shes pas de tshe 'jigs dang bral/ /sbrul nag mtshon gyis zin na dug gi gnod pa bral/ /rtsi yi rgyal pos 'bru rnams bcud du sgyur bar byed/ /rgyal bu pha dgos bzang po 'di la rtsol ba med/ /dbul po rin chen gling du sna tshogs thabs kyis zhugs//'thor rlung chen pos stong gsum 'jig rten g.yeng bar byed/ /dus mtha'i me yis srid gsum sreg 8par je tshom med/ /bskal pa'i chu yis snod bcud ma lus gzhi nas 'khru / /zhes gsungs so 9// //27—319

lta 3ba'i brda rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i mgur/ bam po dang po/sangs rgyas mkha' 'gos ting 'dzin nyams kyi brda bstan pa/ drod gsher 3ldan pa de tshe sa bon gdab pa'i dus/ /sa bon skyed med btab —pas myu gu bskyed du sla/ /gyen thur lam la chu bo 'bab par 'gyur/ /nags tshal khrod du shing rta 'dren pa'i skyes bu blun/ /rin chen sna bdun ldan na 'khor los sgyur rgyal rgyu/ /so ma btang ba'i rdza ni chu la reg pas 'jig /seng ge'i 'o ma snod ngan nang du drugs 4mi bya/ /dbul po'i lus 'di dal bar mi bzhag cis kyang bkol3/ /sna tshogs rgyu las sgra snyan 'byung ba ngo mtshar che/ /zhun spyong lags 6pa'i rin chen 'di ni bkol dz+wan bde/ /so mtshams srung ba'i skyes bu 'di la dngul chu blud/ /nad kyis gdungs par gyur na thur ma gtad par bya/ /nor bu rin chen rgyal mtshan rtse la phyar nas kyang / /mchod pa byas na dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'a tsu/ma srin mos khyer ba 'di ni dran gyis la/ /skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas seng ge'i gsob gon nas/ /nyi zla'i steng du dpa' bo'i gdong la blta bar bya/ /rgyal po'i rkun mo gang yin de ni rtsad bcad nas/ /gyad kyi nor bu 'di ni thabs kyis btsal bar bya/ /glang chen smyon pa mi rtse yan du bcug pas srun 1/ /chu yi rnyog ma ma bsgul skyebazhag pas rim gyis dngas/ /bya ba zin pa'i skyes bu 'di ni blo sems bde/ /lan bo'i rdog po 'di la chu'i thigs pa gzan/ /chab rom nyi mas gdungs pa 'di ni chu ru 'gro/ /dug la sngags kyis btab pa 'di ni sman gyi mchog /lbu 6ba chu yin 'di la tha dad yod ma yin/ /sprin rnams gtor ba'i rlung po 'di la nan 27—320

tan bskyed/ /gsal bya gsal byed med pa'i sgron me bde ba che/ /chu bo cha sna dang rtag tu 'grogs pa shin tu gces/ /'gro ba bzang mo'i mya ngan 'di ni yid la zhog /nam mkha' yid can 'di ni shar gyi phyogs su 'gro // // zhes bsgom pa'i brda mkha' 'gro ma'i mgur/ bam po gnyis pa/1til kyi sgron rnge bum pa'i nang du sbar 4bar bya/ /tshes gcig zla ba 'di ni skyed du rim gyis 'phel/ /'gro ba bzang mo rang gi phru 5gu gso ba mkhas/ /'dab chags sgo nga'i ched du gab pa 'di la ltos/ /chu lud 'dzom pa'i 'bras bu myur du smin/ /'tsho byed mkhas pa sman gyi nus pa sna tshogs brten/ /nags kyi me la rkyen rnams sna tshogs grogs 7su 'ong / /gzhon nu ma yi bde ba khyod kyis smra nus sam/ /nam mkha'i ri mo 'di la gces par ma 'dzin cig /skyi 7ser 'di yis chu yi lbu 7ba dbyings su bdas/ /nam mkha'i sgron me dus rnams kun du sbar bar bya/ /dngul gyi me long 'di ni yengs pa med par phyi/ /ri rab mthon po'i rtse la byin pa 'di ci sems/ /bung rtsis myos pa 'di yis ci smras sbyon pa'i tshig /nad rnams 'byin pa'i sman mchog skran 9 du gyur pa yod/ /pad+ma'i rtsi bcud 'thungs pa'i bung ba phyir mi lta/ /shel gyi mchod rten ma mthong bar du lta ba gces/ /sgon me lag na thogs pa'i skyes bu snang lam bde/ /khong 1du seng ge'i snying gis rtag tu brgyal bar 'gyur/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yis dngos po bzang ngan med par 'joms/ /chu bo chen po zhon nas nam mkha'i bya lam snyag /chu bo'i rgyun chad de dus rang thag 'khor mi nus/ /'khor lo'i srub thag chad pa'i rdza mkhan blo sems bde/ /sprin gyis nam mkha'i 27—321

—dod— —————dod ————— ——ngang las byung zhing de ru dengs1/ /bltas kyi bltas kyi nam mkha' 'di ni mthong ba 'gags // //sprunyams kyi brda mkha' 'gro ma'i mgur/ bam po gsum pa/ skyes bu nad kyis zin pa'i blo sems dran gyis la/ /dur khrod wa mo 'di yi spyod 'gros blta bar bya/ /nags tshal khrod na ri dwags dman ma gnas pa ltos / /rgyal po'i btsun mo 'di ni su la'ang 'jigs pa med/ /rdo yi mi la 'gran par nus pa ngo mtshar che/ /nags na gnas pa'i spre'u 'di yi spyod pa 'am//yang na rgyal bu gzhon nu 'di la blta bar bya/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i bya bran 'di 'dra ci yi phyir/ /'bru yi mdzod du bkres pas nyen pa snying re rje/ /phye ma leb kyi spyod pa 'di 'dra su yis phod/ /dong gi btson 'di thar ram yid la bya bar rigs / /sdug bsngal rgyan du mthong ba'i glang po sgog la dga'/ /mtsho 4yi nang nas smig rgyu snyag pa'i ri dwags snying re rje/ /rin chen gling nas stong log byed pa'i ded dpon drun/ /nam mkha'i rlung dang 'grogs pa phyogs bzhir kun du rgyug /glang chen shugs kyis bag ma tshobs la khye sha zo/ /smyon pa'i rjes su 'brangs 6nas nam mkha' 7sman mchog ster/ /nags la gnas pa'i ri dwags 'di ni yan par bye8/ /'dab chags mkha' la rgyu ba 'di yi rkang rjes ltos / /ral gri lag na thogs pa'i mi de gang phrad gsod/ /gyad kyi spyod nga/ 'di la sems can phra mo skrag /khye phag gnyis kyis bram ze'i gsang tshig rlung 'a/ bskur / /mi mgo skam po la ni shing gi skyes bu dga'/ /gyi / ling sgrog dang bral na lakun du rgyug par rigs/ /kha ba'i nus pa mtsho la gnas par mi 'gyur 27— 322

ro / /shing lo rlung gis khyer ba 'di yi rtsad mi 1chod/ /nyi zla lta bur gyur na skar ma'i tshogs dang 'grogs/ /gru pa 'di yis skya ba 2nya ra bya bar rigs/ /dug 'di rma bya'i zas yin gzhan rnams phung bar byed/ /'dab gshog med par mkha' la 'gro ba dor bar bya // //—spyod pa'i brda mkha' 'gro ma'i mgur/ bam po bzhi pa/5shel sgong yongs su dag na 'od zer nang nas 'char/ /nam mkha'i gter la spyod pa'i skyes bu dbul dang bral/ /snying gi dbus su pad+ma'i ge sar smin par slakhu/ /drod tshad ldan pa'i 'o ma rtsol bas mar du 'gyur/ /stong pa'i sgod 'di nam chag tshe na nam mkha' 'dres/ /'ja' tshon dus kyi mkha' la yal ba rnyed mi 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'di 'dra ngo mtshar che/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal sna tshogs gnas nas bsdu ba mdzad/ /rgun 'brum 'bras bu bsgul bas mi smin bzhag na smin/ /nor bu yon tan sus byin 'di yi bsam pa ci/ /nyi zla mkha' la 'char ba 'di la rnam rtog med/ /stong pa'i cho 'phrul 'di yis lo tog 'bras bu smin/ /nam mkha'i dbyengs 'di sna tshogs ston pa gang gi rkyen/ /chu sgod du ma'i zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shes par kyis / / // 'bras bu'i brda mkha' 'gro ma'i mgur/ bam po lnga pa/8mkha' 'gro ma'i brda bam po lnga pa zhes bya ba gsang mdzod na shog dril du gnas pa las/ dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams kyis bka' bgros nas rje dam pa rgya gar la gnang / be+ed kyi / ding ri zla 7'khor du zha ma lo tsā bas bsgyur nas bla 27——323

ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la gtad / 'di khyad par gyi mgur snachen po brgyad las brda skor rnam pa bzhi rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/318 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rag mkha' 'gro ma'i brda'i mgur jes bya ba bzhugs so// 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra shī ta/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉girdo rje/ pa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sgrol ma/ phya〈〈pe 〉ra rda' brtan/ 〈〈snar 〉snga rda' bstan/ 5〈〈pe 〉sta nga / 〈〈snar 〉rnamang /319 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibasags pa'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉'jigs/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgul/ rnyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mome/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamams/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sres9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma sa gsung ngo /32༷ 3sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra lta/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sher/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga skyed med btag 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byeg 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 skol/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉legs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga skol/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung / she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mos/ ṅku 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsad/ skye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra srun/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rgul/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spu/321 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉che/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o// // 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sba/lha〈〈pe 〉〉tsag ce〈〈pe 〉〉ngagrogs/ che〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spu/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kran/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 lta/ 11〈〈co 〉skabang /322 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodangs/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 4〈〈snar 〉mthatsho zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ba/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'brengs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamakhas/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khye she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉donas/323 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yis rtsad ma/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kya ba'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoraphung / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉//5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// //9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga /324 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa yin no/ /khyad par gyi brgyud pa/27—324
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1271)27wa 325

༄ / /thugs kyi gsang ba glur blangs pa zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta gu khya do ha nā ma/ bod skad du/thugs kyi gsang ba glur blangs pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram ze chen po sa ra has thugs kyi rtogs pa mgur du bzhengs pa/ kye ho 'khor 'das kun gyi rtsa ba sems kyi rang bzhin te/ /rtogs na 2sgom du med kyi ma bcos lhag par zhog /rang la bzhag nas gzhan las 'tshol ba a re 'khrul/ /'di yin 'di min med do thams cad gnyug ma'i ngang / /zhes gsungs so/ /klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa/ rtogs na 4gang gis 'ching bar nus pa khyod kyis smros/ /'ching ba gang yin de ni ye nas grol ba nyid/ /gang la bcings dang 'ching bar bya ba ma grub na/ /nags la gnas pa'i glang po gang bder gyug tu chug /gsung ba// //6pradzñā pha las smras pa/ rtogs dang ma rtogs gnyis kyi bar na su 'dus 27—326

pa / /de ni nga yin gzhan du ci yang yod ma yin/ /de la gang mthong de ni bde chen rang byung ste/ /thams cad thams cad de nyid yin par shes par bya/ /gsung ngo // //—1zhi ba 'tshos gsungs pa/ mnyam nyid dbyings las mi g.yo cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston/ /chu bran sna tshogs rgya mtshor gcig go lan tshu'i ro/ /du ma ro gcig 'di la tha dad yod ma yin/ /thams cad thams cad gnyug ma'i ro yis khyab na bde / /gsung ngo // //3 blo gros brtan pas gsungs pa/ gza' rgyal mkha' la shar bas rgyu skar zil non ltar/ /gnyis med ye shes chen pos rtog tshogs nyams par byas /'dis ni 'khor ba'i sa bon ma lus bcom zin gyis/ /da ni mya ngan 'das pa gzhan du ma tshol cig /gsung ngo // // —ngag gi dbang phyug gis gsungs pa/ snang srid chos dbyings pho brang na/ /rig pa'i ye shes lham me ba/ /bde gsal stong pa'i gdan chol bzhugs/ /'dod yon sna tshogs mchod par zhe'abul/ /dgag sgrub med par rol du gsol / /gsung ngo // //khurdo rje dril bu pas gsungs pa/ sems kyi de nyid mthong 'dod cing / /bdag gzhan 'dod pa bsgrub 'dod pas/ /spyi bo'i nor bu mchod par bya/ /dngos grub thams cad de las 'byung / /gsung ngo // //dz+washang ka ras gsungs pa/ dri med shel sgong dag pa gcig /tshon gyi rkyen gyis sna tshogs 'char/ /bar snang khams su 'jog shes na/ /gtan gyi bde ba de las 'byung / /gsung ngo // //827—327

shān+ti pas gsungs pa/ gnas na zhog la 'gro na thong / /gnyer ka ma byed yan du chug /ched du gang 'dzin 'khrul pa yin/ /gzings la 'phur ba'i bya rog ltos/ /gsung ngo // //birlu pas gsungs pa/ gang gang mthong ba de de nyid/ /dran pa'i rtsi dang ma bral bar/ /ci rigs par ni nyams su long / /gser 'gyur rtsi yi mkhan po ltos/ /gsung ngo // //ye shes zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ snying phyung snaskyes bus yan lag g.yob par mi nus bzhin/ /sems nyid rtsa ba bral na rtog pas bcing du med/ /dug gi sngags can dug nyid sman du 'gyur ba bzhin/ /thabs dang ldan pas nyon mongs nyid ni byang chub rgyu/ /gsung ngo // //shān+ta de bas gsungs pa/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rtsa ba la byang sems rnam gnyis sdong po rgyas/ /'di phyi gnyis kyi me tog shar/ /bdag gzhan gnyis kyi 'bras bu smin/ /gsung ngo // //ye shes snying pos gsungs pa/ chu shing 2/snying po bral ba bzhin/ /sems kyi de nyid btsal gyi stor/ /sgyu mkhan ri mo ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs snang la ngos gzung ri med/ /gsung ngo // //ni ru pas gsungs pa/ mar me rang gsal gcig pur zhog /chu dang rlabs ni 4tha dad min/ /bya yi rjes la btsal mi dgos/ /gnyid sad skyes bu blo sems bde/ /gsung ngo // // tog tse 5pas gsungs pa/ gang la nges shes skyes pas rtsa ba zin/ /de bas ‘lhag pa'i ngo sprod gzhan yod min/ /snang dang srid pa'i chos rnams 27—328

thams cad la/ /bla mar ma gyur pa ni yod ma yin/ /gsung ngo // //nag po zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ rnge tog sna tshogs du ma'i ro/ /bung bas gcig tu sdud pa ltar/ /chos rnams sna tshogs du ma'i ro/ /rtogs dang ldan pas gcig tu bsdus/ /ro ni skye ba gred pa'i ro/ /myong ni ngos gzung med par myong / /gsung ngo // //nā ga bhu su kas gsungs pa/ myong ba med pa'i nyams myong la/ /blo dang bral bas nyams su blangs/ /rtogs su med par gtan la phab/ /thob tu sked par mngon du 'gyur/ /gsung ngo // //lū yi pas gsungs pa/ gnyug ma'i shes pa 'gyur med mngon du gyur nas kyang / /rtsol bas sangs rgyas logs su tshol ba ngal ba ste/ /glang po rnyed nas glang po'i rjes tshol ji bzhin no/ /nga ni sangs rgyas med par shes pas 'dod blo bral/ /gsung ngo // //kṛṣ+ṭa pas gsungs pa/ ngos gzung 1med par ngo sprad pas/ /stong nyid ngang du nyams su myong / /dran pa'i mel tshe srung mkhas pas/ /'khrul pa'i rkun mos glags ma rnyed/ /rgyun chad med par nyams blangs pas/ /'du 'bral med par mngon du gyur/ /gsung ngo // //in+d+ra bhu tis 2gsungs pa/ skyes bu gnyid log 'khrul pas non gyur kyang / /gnyid sad dus na 'khrul pa yul na sked/ /de bzhin ma rtogs 'khor bar sdug bsngal kyang / /rtogs dang ldan la 'khor ba'i yul na med/ /gsung ngo // //rat+na tīrtis gsungs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer kun nas rgyas pa'i dra ba can/ /27—329

mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad ngo mtshar che/ /rtogs ldan bla ma thugs rje'i 'od zer dra ba can/ /gdul bya'i blo yi mun sel 'di ni ngo mtshar snache /gsung ngo // //kau ka tas gsungs pa/ dbang bzhis smin pa'i bu la nyams kyi gdams pa yod/ /thos pas sgro 'dogs chod la tshig gi gdams pa yod/ /bla mas thugs la btags la gnad kyi gdams pa yod/ /'khrul pa gong du bshig la mtshang gi gdams pa yod/ /gsung ngo // //sa ha dzas gsungs pa/ bu nyon khyod kyis nam mkha'i dkyil du ltos/ /lho sprin mi gda' 'di ni nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin/ /'ja' tshon 'di la bden par ma 'dzin par/ /chu bo chen po'i rgyun la zhon la shar du rgyug /gsung ngo // //glang chen gos kyis gsungs pa/ rtsi yi rgyal pos 'bru rnams bcud du 'gyur ba bzhin/ /nyams myong rtsi yis snang srid bde ba chen por 'bar/ /gang gang mthong ba de de skye med spros dang bral/ /'di la ngos 'dzin med pas stong pa btsal mi dgos/ /gsung ngo // //bha su dha ris gsungs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad bde bar gshegs/ /snang ba thams cad chos kyi sku/ /'dod yon thams cad sems kyi rgyan/ /rtog tshogs thams cad ye shes che / /gsung ngo // //te ru ka pas gsungs pa/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /bla ma'i kha las gsal bar rtogs/ /gzhan gyis brjod min gnyug ma'i don/ /'di ni ma bcos rang byung ba'o/ /gsung ngo // //27—330

ka na ko tis gsungs pa/ srid pa'i me yis dngos po thams cad bsregs 7pa ltar/ /rtogs pa'i me yis bdag tu 'dzin pa bsregs nas kyang / /'khor ba'i bud shing ma lus gtan nas 'joms par byed/ /de nas 'gro ba'i don du ci bder gshegs pa yin/ /gsung ngo // //nyi ma'i rtsal gyis gsungs pa/ sna tshogs sems kyi cho 'phrul te/ /sems ni 'di zhes mtshon du med/ /de phyir 'khor 'das rtsa ba bral/ /de nyid chos skur shes par gyis/ /gsung ngo // //rin chen rdo rjes gsungs pa/ nges shes las ni don mthong 'gyur/ /mos gus las ni byin rlabs ༄ sna'abyung / /brtson 'grus kyis ni dgos pa grub / /gsung ngo // //tre'u tra pas gsungs pa/ rig pa khong nas ma sad na/ /'di zhes bstan pas rtogs mi 'gyur/ /mig nad can kyi snang ba bzhin/ /thog mar rang rgyud bsal tshobar bya/ /gsung ngo // //yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes gsungs pa/ mthong ba mngon du ma gyur na/ /mig gi dbang pos yul mthong bzhin/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ /goms par bya ba shin tu gces/ /gsung ngo // //dza ba ri pas gsungs pa/ sku gsum phyi rol yul na med/ /rig pa'i ye shes dngas pa las/ /gzugs brnyan tsam du nang nas 'char/ /rnam par rtog pas rnyog mi bya/ /gsung ngo // //gu dha ri pas gsungs pa/ snang srid ye grol chos kyi dbyings/ /phyag rgya chen po spang 5thob med/ /nam mkha'i bya yis gar ma phyin/ /byis pa'i rtsol ba 27—331

sha thang chadasna/ /gsung ngo // //lwa 2ba'i na bza' can gyis gsungs pa/ gang du'ang ma mthong long ba'i mig /ci yang mi sems gti mug dang / /gang du ma phyin 'phye bo'i 'gros / /ci yang ma thob dbul mo'i gter/ /gsung ngo // //ḍom+bi 4he ru kas gsungs pa/ srid zhi mnyam nyid spros bral la/ /rtsol sgrub byed pa sha thang chad/ /yul sems gnyis med zang thal la/ /tha dad 'dzin pa nyon re mongs/ /bdag gzhan gnyis med chos sku la/ /bzang ngan 'dzin pa snying re rje/ /gsung ngo // //nyi ma sbas pas gsungs pa/ yul la ltos thupas skye ba med/ /sems la ltos 6pas spros dang bral/ /gnyis med don 'di blo las 'das/ /ngas ni ci yang ma shes so/ /gsung ngo // //gu ṇa tis gsungs pa/ ma skyes mi g.yo nam mkha'i ngang / /gzugs brnyan sna tshogs cho 'phrul te/ /snyems med rig pa rang sar zhog /chos kyis bcings pa snying re rje/ /gsung ngo // //pad+ma'i rdo rjes gsungs pa/ bya ba thams cad yongs btang ste/ /sems kyi glang po rang sar zhog /gnyis med ye shes btsal du med/ /thams cad thams cad de de nyid/ /gsung ngo // //ti 7lo pas gsungs pa/ kun gzhi zang thal zhabs phyung la/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa dbyings su bsgyur8/ /yid kyi rnam shes stod la non/ /sgo lnga rang grol lhag par zhog /gsung ngo // //shes rab 'byung gnas kyis gsungs pa/ spros dang bral la rtog pas 27—332

'ching mi nus/ /sgyu mar mthong la yul gyis 'ching mi nus/ /zhe 'dod bral la spyod pas 'ching mi nus/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la 'khor bas 'ching mi nus/ /gsung ngo // //dzñā na shīs tso7gsungs pa/ rtsa ba bral ba'i sdong po 2bzhin/ /nga yi sems nyid nam mkhar stor/ /'khrul snang ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /nga ni nam mkha'i rnal 'byor yin/ /gsung ngo // //pa ra te tas gsungs pa/ kang ka mkha' la lding ba bzhin/ /'khor 'das ro mnyam dbyings su grol/ /re dang dogs pa kun bral te/ /bde ba chen po nam mkha'i ngang / /gsung ngo // //kā ma shrīs gsungs pa/ lus med lus kyi nang na gnas/ /rten med mkha' la bya bzhin rgyu/ /dmigs med smra bsam yul las 'das/ /'gyu snamred rang byung ye shes chashā/ /gsung ngo // //mi thub zla bas gsungs pa/ sgron me 5zla ba tshol ba bzhin/ /rtog pa de nyid mi rtog pa/ /nam mkhas nam mkha/ 'a tshol ba bzhin/ /mi rtog pa nyid blo las 'das/ /gsung ngo // //dzā lan+dha ras gsungs pa/ ye shes med na mthong ba che/ /rtog pa med na gsal ba che/ /zhen pa med na bde ba che/ /gang du'ang mi gnas gnas 9 pa che/ /gsung ngo // //me 7tri ka ma 8las gsungs pa/ sems nyid gzhi stong rtsa ba bral/ /las kyis 'ching bar mi nus te/ /dngos por zhen pas de ltar min/ /de ltar rtag tu rang sems ltos/ /gsung ngo // //27—333

pad+ma badz+ras gsungs pa/ nam mkha'i dbyengs kyi bha ga ru/ /rig pa'i rdo rje gsor nas kyang / /gnyis med ngang du sbyar byas nas/ /bde chen lhan cig skyes pa 'chang 1/ /gsung ngo // //klu'i byang chub kyis gsungs pa/ mkha' la rlung 'phyo srab kyis gzung 2/ /khang stong khye yis spyod pa ltos/ /nam mkha'i 'a thum sus mthong ba/ /bu ni pang du rgyug par nges/ /gsung ngo // //'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis gsungs pa/ rin chen gling du phyin na dbul dang bral/ /bla ma'i bka' drin thob na 'khrul pa zhig /sems kyi de nyid mthong na 'khor ba med/ /byang sems nang du 'byongs na 'gro don 'byung //gsung ngo // // rā dzā ha snyis gsungs pa/ rtogs nas 5gzhan don mi byed par༄ —/ /de ni sa yi gter srung 7bzhin/ /'di na tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /thugs rjes sems can mi 'dzin nam/ /gsung ngo // //bzang po dpal gyis gsungs pa/ bdag dang sems can dbyer med kyang / /'gro ba las kyis sdug bsngal bas/ /rgyun chad med pa'i thugs rje yis / /'gro ba'i don la rol du gsol/ /gsung ngo // //li la'i bzang pos gsungs pa/ rang la yod kyang ngo ma shes/ /dbul mo gter gyis bslus pa bzhin/ /de nyid ma mthong sems can la/ /thugs rjes sgron me gdeg tu gsol/ /gsung ngo // //rnal 'byor ma dru ti mas gsungs pa/ chab dang chab rom tha dad min/ /snang dang stong pa dbyer mi phyed/ /mkha' dang rlung la bye brag med/ /sems dang 27—334

sems byung de bzhin no/ /gsung ngo // //shing lo mas gsungs pa/ brag ca'i sgra 'di su yis smras/ /me long gzugs brnyan su yis bris/ /rmi lam ltad mo gang du gyes/ /gang na'ang med do sems kyi ngang / /gsung ngo // //dur khrod mas gsungs pa/ kun gzhi 1dag pa chos dbyengs yin/ /yin ngo shes pa ye shes yin/ /bdag 'dzin zhig na rtsa bral yin/ /sgo lnga rang gol lam khyer yin/ /gsung ngo // //gcer bu mas gsungs pa/ rang grol blo dang bral ba la/ /mi bcos sgo gsum lhag par zhog /mi zhen dgag bsgrub 2med par zhog /mi g.yo mnyam nyid chen por bzhag /gsung ngo // //ro langs mas gsungs pa/ ma yengs bsgom — du med pa la/ /nyams su len na mkhas pa yin/ /sna tshogs rjes med chen po ru/ /lam du 'khyer 4 na grol ba yin/ /gsung ngo // //ma hā sidhes zhegasungs pa/ ma bsgom ma bsgom blo ma bsgom/ /blo sgom rtog pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin/ /rtog pas 'khor bar 'ching ba ste/ /blo dang bral la sgom 6du med/ /gsung ngo // //dri med mas gsungs pa/ sems nyid ye stong ye bral la/ /skye med bsgom tsopas ci zhig bya/ /sems byung rang shar rang grol lo/ /rtog pa spangs pas ci zhig bya/ /gsung ngo // //blo gros dbyangs mas gsungs pa/ nam mkha'i ye shes kun la khyab/ /ye grol chen po mchog gis lasabhe/ / /mi g.yo mi 'gyur bsam las 'das/ /27—335

rtog med rang rig ye shes che/ /gsung ngo // //bdag med mas gsungs pa/ nam mkha' nam mkha' mnyam nyid che/ /nyi ma nyi ma ye gsal che/ /chu bo chu bo rgyun chad med/ /'ja' tshon rang grol bde ba che/ /gsung ngo // //gsal byed mas gsungs pa/ go ru med pa'i don rtogs na/ /brjod du med pa'i gleng gzhi 'byung / /bsam du med pa'i don bsgoms na/ /thob tu med pa'i 'bras bu 'byung / /gsung ngo // //bye ma lung pas gsungs pa/ gnyis med bde chen don gyi nyemachog /rang la yod pas gzhan du tshol/ /mi shes rtsol bas sgra phyir 'brang 2/ /'khrul pa'i sems can snying re rje/ /gsung ngo // //rdo rje gcig mas gsungs pa/ stong nyid nam mkha'i glegs bam la/ /rang rig ye shes yi ger bris/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi gdams pa bkod/ /rgyun chad med pa'i bstan pa sgrogs/ /gsung ngo // //sngo bsangs mas gsungs pa/ mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje la/ /g.yo 'gul 'byung ba'i cho 'phrul shar/ /sna tshogs skye 'gro'i bya ba byas/ /rang grol nam mkha'i dbyengs su yal/ /gsung ngo // //gri skor mas gsungs pa/ ming dang bral ba'i ming mang pos/ /der 'dzin zhig pa'i blo bral po/ /yongs su grol ba'i byar med po/ /ye yin chen por rtogs par gyis/ /gsung ngo // //lam skyes mas gsungs pa/ dmigs bya dmigs byed mtha' spangs te/ /ting 'dzin rten dang bral ba la/ /chu bo chen po'i rgyun bzhin du/ /ma yengs 27—336

nyams su blang bar bya/ /gsung ngo // //bshes gnyen mas gsungs pa/ nam mkha'i bya lam rjes med bzhin/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa rjes med yin/ /rang rgyud 'dzin pa med gyur 1na/ /mi dge bcus kyang 'ching mi nus/ /gsung ngo // //ro zan mas gsungs pa/ gser 'gyur rtsi dang phrad pa bzhin/ /snang srid bde stong ngor rteshar bas/ /dngos por 'dzin pa kun las grol/ /snang srid spros bral ye shes che/ /gsung ngo // //pad+mo shrīs gsungs pa/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa de/ /bsam sgom zlo yis ma bcos na/ /chos sku gzhan nas btsal mi dgos/ /rang chas yin no lhag par zhog /gsung ngo // //pad+ma'i rgyal mos gsungs pa/ rang rig ye shes 'di rnyed na/ /bskal pa'i mun pa sgron me bzhin/ /las kyi 'khrul pa gtan nas bcom/ /skyes bu gnyid sad ji bzhin no/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma dkar mos gsungs pa/ las zin skyes bu de ci sems/ /bram ze skud pa 'khal la lhos/ /nam mkha' gang gis za bar nus/ /khyod dang nga la tha dad med/ /gsung ngo // //lha sras dpal gzher gyis gsungs pa/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i shul yin te/ /gol sa med par gsungs pas na/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan par bya/ /gsung ngo // //rdo rje bde bas gsungs pa/ mi g.yo bsam gtan rgya chen po/ /g.yo 'gul sna tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo dbyer med pas/ /bsgom 27—337

dang mi bsgom 'di la med/ /gsung ngo // //ye shes zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ gang du chos rnams ma mthong ba/ /de yis chos kun mthong ba ste/ /mthong bya mthong byed kun las 'das/ /rang rig ye shes chen po yin/ /gsung ngo // //gha gha dpal gyis gsungs pa/ gang du mthong tshor myong ba kun/ /de de'i ngo bos stong shes na/ /'dod yon sems kyi rgyan yin te/ /'ching bar mi 'gyur grol bar 'gyur/ /gsung ngo // //las kyi 'byung gnas kyis gsungs pa/ sems kyi ye shes gang mthong ba/ /chos kyi de nyid rtogs 'gyur te/ /chos rtogs pas ni bde ba thob/ /gsung ngo // //rgyan gyi rgyal mos gsungs pa/ dbyibs dang bral ba'i mdog med po/ /ming dang bral ba'i don med po/ /sna tshogs rig pa'i bsam med po/ /spangs pa med pa'i thob med po/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma la ba can gyis gsungs pa/ dmigs rnged ye shes chen po ni1 / /tshig gis mtshon par mi nus te/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bstan 2—pa las//gzhan gyis rtogs pa ma yin no/ /gsung ngo // //thig le dag pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba grub thob pho mo brgyad cu'i rtogs pa brjod pa mkha' 'gro mas yi ger btab ste gsang mdzod na gnas pa las/dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams kyis bka' bgros nas rje dam pa rgya gar la gnang ba zha ma lo tsā bas legs par bsgyur ba'o// // 27—338

rdzogasasgo// //27dod339
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1272)27wa 340

༄khya/ /grub thob lnga bcu'i rtogs pa brjod pa thig le 'od kyi phreng ba jes bya ba/1༄7/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras mi yi seng ge yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gsang tshig brtol/ /grub thob nyams kyi rtogs pa rnams / /bka' rgya bgrol to gtad rgya byas/ /ār+ya de bas thugs kyi rtogs pa mgur du bzhengs pa/ kye ho phung po lha yi ngo bor gnas/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur rang la rdzogs/ /sgra stong brag ca lta bur rtogs/ /gsang ba'i dbang la ltos mi dgos/ /nyams myong bde chen khong nas sad/ /shes rab ye shes dbang dang ldan/ /chos rnams nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ /bzhi pa'i dbang gis don dang ldan/ /gsung ngo // //nā gārdzu nas gsungs pa/ kye ho rtsa ba bral ba'i sems nyid 'di/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /de las 'khor 'das sdong po gyes/ /bde sdug gnyis kyi lo 'dab rgyas/ /sna tshogs las kyi 'bras bu smin/ /gsung 27—341

ngo // //mar pas gsungs pa/ kye ho sna tshogs snang la ngos gzung 1med/ /'di zhes mtshon pa'i tshig dang bral/ /mi g.yo mi sems sems chen po/ /bla dgas tsam du brjod par zad/ /'di la don du gzung du med/ /gsung ngo // //rdo rje dril bu pas gsungs pa/ kye ho dbang ldan pad+ma'i dbus na bde ba'i ye shes gnas/ /thabs kyi spyor bas spros bral lhan cig skyes pa 'char/ /bde gshegs thugs kyi gdams pas nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam/ /'di ni gsang sngags thabs kyi gnad do ngo mtshar che/ /gsung ngo // //lū yi pas smras pa/ phung po'i dbus na gnyug ma'i ye shes me gcig po/ /srog dang rtsol bas bskyod na bde ba'i ye shes 'bar/ /bdag 'dzin sreg pa'i me ni rlung gis sbar bar bya/ /bde chen mchog ni nam mkha'i khams su mi shong ngo / /gsung ngo // //shān+ta de bas gsungs pa/ kye ho sems ni ye shes chen po ste/ /'di las gud na sangs rgyas med/ /sems kyi de nyid shes gyur na/ /'khor ba rang grol mya ngan 'das/ /gsung ngo // //dha sa pas gsungs pa/ kye ho 'gro ba sna tshogs las kyis bcings/ /las kyi de nyid shes gyur na/ /bcings pa med de grol ba med/ /sgyu mkhan ri mo ji bzhin no/ /gsung ngo // //g.yog po ljon pa can gyis gsungs pa/ kye ho he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i sku/ /rnal 'byor ma ni las kyi yum/ /sna tshogs snang ba mchog gi zhing / /'gro ba lha 27—312

dang lha mo ste/ /'di na 'khor ba'i ming yang rnged/ /gsung ngo // //a ba dhū tī pas gsungs pa/ gshis kyi stong nyid 'o ma'i mtsho/ /thabs kyi 37rol pa srub ma'i shing / /dad brtson she mas rtsol byas na2/ /sku gsum mar gyi gong bu 'dril —/ /gsung ngo // //dur khrod dbang phyug gis smras pa/ mthong du med do sems kyi don/ /bsam du med do gnyug ma'i ngang / /dgag sgrub med pa smyon pa'i lus/ /btsal du med pa gyad kyi nor/ /gsung ngo // //ye shes skyong gis smras pa/ kye ho snang stong dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ /rig stong dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ /gnyis med ye shes lhan cig skyes/ /rgyu 'bras dbyer med lhan cig skyes/ /'di la tha dad ngas ma mthong / /gsung ngo // //li la'i zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ sna tshogs snang ba rang gi sems/ /sems ni sems kyi rang bzhin bral/ /thig le chen po chos kyi sgu/ /'di las mi spro gzhi la bzhag /gsung ngo // //nyi ma sbas pas gsungs pa/ lus la ye shes chen por gnas/ /bde ba drod kyis sbar bar bya/ /las kyi rtsi bur sreg par byed/ /bla ma'i bka' las shes par bya/ /gsung ngo // //sa 'dzin zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ lus kyi 'khor lo bzhi 'khor bas/ /srid rtsa'i sdong bo gcod par byed/ /rtsa yi rgyal po spangs pa yis thar pa'i srog shing 'dzugs par byed/ /bde chen nam mkha'i ba bzhos pas/ /lhan cig skyes pa ston par byed/ /gsung ngo // //27—343

bi na sas smras pa/ nyi zla stod la mnan pa yis/ /las kyi phreng thag gcod par byed/ /spu gri klad la bskor ba yis/ /bya bran nam mkha'i dbyengs su sgod/ /bya ba zin pa'i skyes bu de/ /'a 1ma'i pang du rgyug par byed/ /gsung ngo // //phyogs kyi glang pos smras pa/ rig pa'i sgron me sbar ba yis/ /log rtog mun pa rab bsal te/ /gzhan gyi sde pa kun bcom nas/ /rang gi mtshan nyid mtshon 2du rnged/ /gsung ngo // //dpa' bo dril bu'i zhabs kyis smras pa/ dga' ba'i ye shes spar ba yis//gnyug ma'i lhan cig skyes pa rtogs/ /'khor 'das gnyis po gzhi las grol/ /gsang sngags thabs kyis khyad par 'phags/ /gsung ngo // //li la'i bzang pos smras pa/ lkugs pa'i kha dang rus sbal mig /gzhon nu ma yi bde ba 'am/ /khur bar chu blugs ji bzhin du/ /mtshon du 'dug par ngas ma mthong / /gsung ngo // //nā ga bo byes gsungs pa/ gnyis med spros bral nam mkha'i ngang / /ming med ye shes bde chen po/ /bsam med brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das/ /'gyur med chos sku ngo mtshar che/ /gsung ngo // //tog tse pas gsungs pa/ ltos shig nam mkha'i dkyil du ltos/ /ma mthong ba ni de mthong yin/ /sdod cig rgya mtsho'i gnying du sdod/ /mi g.yo ba ni dgongs pa yin/ /zung shig bar snang rlung po zung / /ngos gzung zimed na stong pa yin/ /gsung ngo // //nag po zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ lam gyi de nyid mthong goms na/ /27—344

'chi ba'i 'od gsal gdon mi za/ /las kyi 'phen pa nam mkhas 1 khyer/ /dus der chos nyid ma bu phrad/ /gsung ngo // //bhi na zhabs kyis smras pa/ snang stong thabs dang shes rab la/ /bla ma'i ngo sprod brda yis rol/ /rig pa'i ye shes khong nas sad/ /bde chen lhan cig skyes pa rtogs/ /gsung ngo // //pad+ma'i myu gus smras pa/ sna tshogs snang ba las kyi phyag rgya ste/ /der 'dzin stong pa chos kyi phyag rgya yin/ /gnyis sked ngang las mi 'da' dam tshig ste//der 'dzin blo dang bral na phyag rgya che/ /gsung ngo // //mtsho skyes rdo rjes smras pa/ lte ba mkha' dbyings gru gsum du/ /rig pa'i lha mo'i skur gsal te/ /'od zer spro bsnyus 'gro don byed/ /sku gsum gzhan nas btsal mi dgos/ /gsung ngo // //gu dha ri pas gsungs pa/ ye shes rdo rje 2nam mkha'i mdog /sna tshogs 'byung ba'i cho 'phrul ston/ /dmigs pa med par kun la khyab/ /'du 'bral med par rang la rdzogs/ /ma btsal lhan gyis grub pa'i don/ /gsung ngo // //ti 4lo pas gsungs pa/ kye ho ltos shig yul la ltos/ /snang ba sna tshogs rig pa'i rtsal/ /'dod yon sna tshogs sems kyi rgyan/ /bde sdug sna tshogs gnyug ma'i rtsal/ /gar yang ma phyin nam mkha'i bya/ /snang ba sna tshogs gzigs mor che/ /gsung ngo // //nā ro pas gsungs pa/ spyi gtsug pad+ma'i gdan stengs su/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i spyan snga ru/ /rtsa dar dkar gyi lam la 'gro shes na/ /27—345

mtshams med lnga po byed kyang grol/ /gsang sngags thabs kyi khyad par yin/ /gsung ngo // //kṛṣ+ṭa pas smras pa/ rtse gsum gsal ba'i me long la/ /sems kyi rgyal po lta 7shes na/ /'khrul pa'i yul gyis mi phrogs te/ /gnyug ma'i rdzong bhel nges par gnas/ /gsung ngo // //bha du las smras pa/ ka ra yul la bcings pa yis/ /rtog pa'i 'gyu ba gcod par byed/ /lta stangs snga phyi brjes pa yis/ /bying rgod thun skyon sel bar byed/ /gnyen po'i rtsol ba bshig pa yis/ /gnyug ma rang la 'khor bar byed / /gsung ngo // //ḍom+bi te ru kas smras pa/ las kyi phyag rgya las byung ba'i/ /dga' bzhi'i ye shes phyag rgya che/ /snang ba zag med spros dang bral/ /gnyug ma don gyi ye shes mthong / /gsung ngo // //ka na pas smras pa/ sems nyid spros dang bral ba nam mkha'i ngang / /rgya mtsho shel dang me tog bzhin/ /sang nge rje rine+e sa le ba/ /dran du mod sbung yengs 5su med/ /ci rigs tsam du goms par gyis9/ /gsung ngo // //ban+dha badz+ras smras pa/ gnyis med ye shes chen po 'di/ /bstan du yod de mtshon du med/ /goms su yod de bsgom du med/ /myong du yod de brjod du med/ /gsung ngo // //kalba las smras pa/ snang ba'i ngo bo stong pa'i ror/ /spor cig yul la yengs pa'i tshe/ /bde ba'i ngo bor 7gsal ba'i ror/ /spor cig sems la 27—346

bltas pa'i tshe/ /rtogs pa'i ngo bor nyams kyi ror/ /spor cig chags sdang skyes pa'i tshe/ /gsung ngo // //pradzñā pha las smras pa/ sna tshogs sna tshogs de de nyid/ /dgag pa med cing sgrub 1pa med/ /dran pa'i rtsi dang ma bral bar/ /spang blang med par rol du gsol/ /gsung ngo // //dpa' bo rdo rjes smras pa/ sems kyi thig le yi ge'i dbyibs/ /rlung gis bskyod de mkha' la 'phur/ /las kyi sgo bzhi 'gags nas kyang / /bde chen gnas su 'pho bar byed/ /gsung ngo // //shrī ba tas smras pa/ dug sbrul bsad la glang chen btsong 2/ /bya ni mkha' la spar bar bya/ /btsun mo lha sras yul phyung la/ /rgyal po bcom na nges par grol/ /gsung ngo // //gnyis med sbas pas smras pa/ yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /spyi bo'i bla ma legs mchod la / /'dod pa thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bya ba mang pos ci zhig bya/ /gsung ngo // //in+d+ra byu tis smras pa/ sna tshogs yul gyi snang ba 'di/ /rig pa ye shes rgyan yin pas/ /mi spang de bzhin nyid du rol/ /'ching bar mi 'gyur grol ba'i lam/ /gsung ngo // //ka pa tsa ris smras pa/ chu bo sbubs su chud pa bzhin/ /sna tshogs de bzhin nyid du 'dus/ /rgya mtsho lan tshul ro bzhin du/ /du ma ro gcig bde bar 'bar/ /nags kyi me la rlung bzhin du/ /rkyen ngan sna tshogs lam gyi gogs / /gsung ngo // //27—347

ku la ma ris smras pa/ gzhi ma bcos chos dbyings pho brang du/ /lam rig pa'i ye shes lham me ba/ /de bde gsal stong pa'i ngar gyis rdeg /don chos sgu gnyis med kyi ngang du grol/ /gsung ngo // //rat+na bo byes smras pa/ ma bcos rnal ma'i shes pa de/ /mi bsgom de bzhin nyid du bzhag /bcos pa thams cad blo yin te/ /blo las grol na thar pa'i lam/ /gsung ngo // //pad+ma badz+ras smras pa/ gang gis sems kyi don mthong na/ /rtsa ba bral ba'i sdong bu bzhin/ /sna tshogs snang bas 'ching mi nus/ /sems kyi de nyid yin phyir ro/ /gsung ngo // //ra ma pha las smras pa/ gang du rtogs pa blo yin la/ /gang du sgom 1pa rtog pa ste/ /gang du bcos 2kyang bcos ma nyid/ /ji ltar bsgrubs kyang 'dod pa'i lam/ /'di kun byis pa'i rtsed mo yin/ /mkhas pa rnams la ci yang med/ /gsung ngo // //klu'i byang chub kyis smras pa/ yi ge gsum kyi spyor ba yis/ /rlung gi de nyid shes gyur na/ /sems kyi de nyid rtogs par 'gyur/ /sems rtogs pas ni bde ba che/ /gsung ngo // //karma badz+ras smras pa/ 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba ma chod na/ /sems kyi 'khrul 'khor mi 'jig ste/ /bcos ma'i theg pa snying re rje/ /rtsa ba bral ba'i don mthong na/ /las kyi 'khrul 'khor gzhi la 'jig /gsung ngo // //zla ba grags pas smras pa/ yod dam med pa'i mtha' spangs te/ /dbus kyi don la mi gnas par/ /bsgom du med pa'i ngang la zhog /thob tu 27—348

med pa'i 'bras bu 'byung / /gsung ngo // //sa ra pas smras pa/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di/ /khyod kyis khros dang ji ltar yin/ /ma myong shes na myong ba'i mchog /mi btsal de bzhin nyid du bzhag /gsung ngo // //su ka ra sidhis smras pa/ gang la zhen pa'i blo de thong / /rtog pa gnyis rgo mtshungs par sgrib/ /rtog dang bral na sgom 1du med/ /bsam du med pa ji ltar dran/ /gsung ngo // //ye shes rdo rjes smras pa/ kun gzhi 2dag pa'i dbyings nas rig pa'i nyi ma shar/ /rgya mtsho nor bu'i gling nas yid bzhin nor bu lon/ /'gro ba'i ma rig ling tog shes rab thur mas phye/ /'khor ba'i chu bo bzhi las thabs ldan bla mas bsgral/ /gsung ngo // //mtsho skyes rdo rjes smras pa/ dpe yi ye shes mtshon du med/ /don gyi ye shes sgom du med/ /thabs kyi man ngag smra ru med/ /bla ma'i drin lan 'khor thabs sked/ /gsung ngo // //ra 4tri tas gsungs pa/ mtshon gyi 'khor los phyogs rnams kun gyi dngos po gcod/ /thos pa'i 'khor los log rtog blo yi spros pa gcod/ /nyams kyi 'khor los gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i snang ba gcod/ /rtogs pa'i 'khor los 'khor 'das gnyis kyi re dogs gcod/ /gsung ngo // //grub thob lnga bcu'i rtogs pa brjod pa thig le 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang mdzod nas phyung ste rje dam pa rgya gar rin po che la gnang ba zha ma lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o//5 //27—349

༄/ /phyag rgya chen po rin po che brda'i man ngag ces bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra 2rat+na bye gī ta u pa de sha nā ma/bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po rin po che brda'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /u rgyan ts+tshasdo ha'i gling du mkha' 'gro ma dpal gyi yon tan gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod par/ u dusmra 4ra'i ge sar chu 'dam las mi 'khrungs/ /skyug nad can de zas kyi zhen pa bral nas 'dug /gaṅgā las thar mi de sems ngal skam la 5so/ /bshes med dgras gtser ba de phyogs bzhir mgon skyabs tshol/ /sgu yi 6'bras bu 'di ni 'phel stobs rab tu che/ /gsung ngo // //shar phyogs bde ldan gyi phug par mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje nyi ma'i mig gis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ 'gro ba chu las 7gru dang gzings 8kyis sgrol/ /'khor los brgyan pa'i shing rta sa lam gcod/ /so btang bum pas chu nang skol 27—351

ma 'dzags/ /dang po'i skas gdang 1yang thog steng du bskyal/ /zhun mthar 2'byongs pa'i ngar gyis sha rus gcod / /gsung ngo // //klu sgrub 4spyod kyi phug 5par mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi bum pa 'dzin mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ nam mkha' dang ni stong gsum dbyer ma phyed/ /gshog gcig bya yis mkha' la 'phur ma nus/ /mgo dngaci sug pa 6lus po go gcig 'gyur/ /rdo yi gzugs 'dra'i 'khyag pa'i ngo bo chu/ /me long dang ni gzugs brnyan tha dad rnged/ /ces gsung ngo // //'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da 8ka gnas pa'i sar mkha' 'go ma kang ka khrag ldag mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ chang gis grod pa brtol 9bas sngar snang 'jig /'khor los sgyur rgyal bya ba gzhan mi byed/ /dbul mo gter ngo shes tshe sngar spyod 'chor/ /gling don grub pa'i ded dpon bde bar gnas/ /gsung ngo // //grong khyer chen po rdo 'jog tu mkha' 'gro ma shwa na glog gi zhags pa can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ sna tshogs phyag rgya thal mo rang yin mod/ /tshi lus rkang mar sha rus khrag la brtan1 / /nyi ma'i 'od kyis skar ma'i 'od zer bcom / /chu 'dzin nang du me shel nus pa brlag /gsung ngo // //dur khrod chen po u tsa la'i lhor mkha' 'gro ma sha za dung 'bud mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ sprin lding ba la gtan sa yod ma yin/ /mkha' la byung ba'i rlung ni ngo bos stong / /brag ca'i skad 'di gzhan gyi sgra la brten/ /smyon pa'i sems ni gza' gtad bral nas 4'dug /gsung ngo // //ri me ri 'bar ba'i khar mkha' 'gro ma glog gi ral pa can gyis rtogs pa'i 27—352

brda brjod pa/ rtog bral bu chung gser bor bong ba len/ /dus la bab pa'i myu gus sa sran 'bigs/ /tshon 1gyi dri ma chu yis dag tshe gsal/ /bsam pas 'grub pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i lus/ /gsung ngo // //rgyal po'i khab ser skya'i byang du mkha' 'gro ma ri'i 2rgya mtsho mdangs len mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ mchil lham gyis ni rkang pa'i mi mthun skyob/ /ri gzar rbab ni mi sdod drag tu 'phar/ /gaṅgā'i chu klung bar mtshams med par 'byel/ /ce 4spyang mig la mun pas sgrib mi nus/ /gsung ngo // //rdo rje gdan kyi byang chub chen po'i rtsar 5mkha' 'gro ma bde ldan mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ mgo gnyis spyi mas gcig gis 6dug zos 'chi/ /rma can gcig gis sbal pa'i tshang rnams 'drul/ /mig skyon ma byang zla ba gnyis su snang / /grib ma dgra ru mthong bas skyabs gnas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /gsung ngo // //mtsho kun+da thuli dung skyong gi gnas su mkha' 'gro ma rma bya'i gdong can kyis rtogs /—pa'i brda brjod pa/ skyar mo nya med bya gzhan gyis mi 'tshe /dug gi nus pa sngags kyis zin dus ltorashā / /rma bya sman bor 'jo 1sgeg rang la lta / /mgo bcad ta la'i shul der myu gu stong 1 / /gsung ngo // //byang chub shing gi rtsar mkha' 'gro ma dga' ldan gser gyi 'od can mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ til mar nang nas bton pa'i gso 2ras me yi rgyu/ /sgyu ma'i bu yis rgyal po'i gdung mi sobs/ /ri dwags lte ba'i dri ni rgyu nyid dri/ /mdza' bos bslus tshe grogs la yid ches stor/ /gsung ngo // //phyag rgya chen po brda'i man ngag las rgyan rnam par bkod pa'i dum bu 27—353

mkha' 'gro ma mdangs ldan gser gyi ral pa can gyis bsdus so/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin gyi ri bo la mkha' 'gro ma 'khor lo gdong gis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ drang srong gdan du ku sha bzang bas rtswa gzhan spang / /zhing pa sa bon nam zin dus su sems ngal so/ /rlung gis ma bskyod mar me rang khar gsal / /yid gcugs bu dang bral na gzhan mi dran/ /gsung ngo // //dpal ldan nor bu'i gling du mkha' 'gro ma nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ skye bo blo chung don de rang gi sa/ /dam du 1bcings pa'i khong 'khril grol na bde/ /dngul dkar me long 'phrul gyi gdan la 'phyi/ /'phang 2gi slob dpon gam nas rgyang du bsring / /gsung ngo // //lho phyogs a su ra'i phug par mkha' 'gro ma nor bu'i spyan ldan mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ khar gzhong nang gi rus sbal nyi ma'i 'od la dga'/ /gser las byas pa'i rgyan ni gser nyid yin/ /'ben la mda' brdeg dpag chen gzhan mi dran/ /bu ram gzugs rnams ro la tha mi dad/ /gsung ngo // //nags tshal dra ba can gyi mthongs su mkha' 'apo ma ba ti ro zan mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ chu shel zla ba yar ngo gcig 4la 'phel/ /mkha' la 'ja' yi kha dog ngo bos dben/ /gzhon nu'i bde ba sus kyang brjod ma shes/ /til mar gyis blud 5ral gris bcad tshad 'gyel/ / gsung ngo // // 6grong khyer ser skya'i ljongs su mkha' 'gro ma pur sna khyung gshog can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ khur bar chu blugs khong gi gtam rnams 'gags/ /27—354

sgyu ma'i ltad mo yang dag ma yin no/ /dbul mo gter dang phrad tshe sngar rtog bral/ /lan tshwa'i rdog po chu bo nyid la thim/ /gsung ngo // //dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du mkha' 'gro ma nyi ma'i phreng bas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ wa yi skad la seng ge dngang 1skrag skyes/ /btsun mo rin chen bran mo la mi 'jigs/ /dgra ru bu langs mdza' bo su la bya/ /lkugs 2ma'i rmi lam mkhar mi 'don par 'dug /gsung ngo // //lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la mkha' 'gro ma gtsug na mu tig 'chang gis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ bag ma dang ni smyon pa'i spyod pa 'dzol / /rgya mtsho'i chu la nya ni rang byan tshud/ /rgya skyegs ri la rnge shor rlung rnams grogs/ /chu rnams 'bab sa na ni ro gcig go/ /gsung ngo // //ma ga dh+wa rgyal po'i khab tu mkha' 'gro ma bdud rtsi bum 'dzin mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ /ce thuspyang ro la chags pa'i blo ni skye mi 'gyur/ /dgos pa'i dus las khra yi rtsal ni gzhan du min/ /wa yi 'gro 'dug dur khrod nang du gzhol ba yin/ /bu chung dang ni me long seng ge ltos/ /gsung ngo // //shar phyogs bi kra ma shrī 5la'i gtsug lag khang du mkha' 'gro ma tshe ldan rgyan mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ chu tshad dus su la ko rang 6sa zin/ /nyi ma'i snying po mun pas gos ma yin/ /lag pa chad pa'i bzo mkhan bya ba rdugasadz+wa/ /dkar nag yi ges mkha' la gos pa min/ /gsung ngo // //klu gtsug na rin chen gyi yul du mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa 8can mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ sgo nga mkha' la skyes pa'i tshang yang de nyid do/ /khu /rta'i sgum bu sa la nams kyang min/ /nam mkha'i kha dog ma 'gags rnam 27—355

par dag /na bun sa la langs nas mkha' la thim/ /gsung ngo // //shing 'dzam bu dṛ k+ṣa'i grib ma la mkha' 'gro ma 'byung gnas rin chen mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ chu bo sna tshogs rgya mtshor tha dad min/ /ma dros chu ni gting nas g.yo 'gul bral/ /chu dang zla ba'i rang bzhin so sor stong / /rlan dang rba rlabs rgya mtsho las ma 'das/ /gsung ngo // //phyag rgya rin po che brda'i man ngag las 'od zer dra ba'i tshosnamakha' 'gro ma dpal ldan dbang gi rgyal mos bsdus pa ste gnyis pa'o// //bde ldan rin chen gling du mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i 'od zer gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ dmu 3rgod dul ba'i spyod pa gzhan pas g.yung / /'bru yi chang rgod bram ze'i btung ba min/ /lcags kyus zin pa'i glang po rang dbang med / /g.ya' ma phyis pa'i me long zubazhin mi 'dod/ /rgyud med gzhu la su yis mda' sring nus/ /gsung ngo // //thang bzang gser gyi bya skyibs can du mkha' 'gro ma rgya mtsho mig gis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ chol zangs nang du sbrang rtsi'i g.yos mi bya/ /smin pa'i sa bon ser dang ldan la gdab/ /bud med bsnol ④'tshang khyo gye la smra mi phod / /rdzas ma tshogs pa'i srub mas me mi thon/ /til sbyangs ⑥zhabs med nang du til mi ldugs/ /gsung ngo // //nub phyogs blak+ṣa'i tshal du mkha' 'gro ma bi za gzugs 'phrog mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ dug sbrul mar la blo ldan skye bo 'dzur/ /rin chen gling 'dod ded dpon gzhan gyis min/ /dman tshupa la bsnyen tsand pa rang bzo 27—356

spang / /lo stong mun pa sgron me gzhon nus sel/ /mkhas pa'i rus sbal tsher ma'i khrod rnams spong / /gsung ngo // //grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas su mkha' 'gro ma shīrti thog mtha' can gyes rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ stobs ldan gyad spyod 'phye bos byar mi rung / /chu bran rnams ni rgya mtsho'i nang du 'bab/ /rngon pa gling bu ri dwags ngos der 'bud / /me shel 'od ni ras kyi bal la che/ /zangs kyi mdog ni gser 'gyur rtsi yis 'gyur/ /gsung ngo // //dur khrod so sa'i gling du mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i 'od can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ ldum ra'i ri1me tog ljon shing grib las skyes/ /khab len rdo yis lcags rnams dbang du sdud/ /tshong pa rang gi rigs la 'jug par 'gyur/ /spre'u'i rten ni 'bras bu can gyi nags/ /gru btsas len pa rgya mtsho sgrol la brtson//gsung ngo // //shing tsi tra ba la'i grib ma la mkha' 'gro ma blo gros gser gyi gdu bu can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ chu mthong rus sbal skam la bsdad 2mi rigs/ /dug mda'i rma la le lo byas pas phung / /phag gis gtsang btsog 4/med par kha ru bcug /dur khrod nang du ce spyang ro la brel/ /ri yi sul la seng ge 'jigs pa med/ /gsung ngo // // rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du mkha' 'gro ma bde ba bzang mos rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ bung ba rtsi 'jib ut+pal mdog mi nyams/ /char ni rdo sol me yi grogs yin no/ /mun pa'i smag sarum nyi zla'i 'od kyis sel/ /'bru rnams skye ba tsha sgo med pa'i zhing / /'khor lo med pa'i shing rtas 'gro ma shes/ /27—357

gsung ngo // //phyag rgya chen po brda'i man ngag las ye shes rnam par gzigs pa'i dum bu mkha' 'gro ma su kha pha las bsdus pa ste gsum pa'o// //ri bo bya rkang gi steng du mkha' 'gro ma bum pa'i lto can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ rigs ngan bu mo rgyal po'i khab tu min/ /sbrang ma ga pur 'a/ 'byol ngan skyugs dri la 'du/ /bram ze gso sbyong dus su bya gzhan dor/ /sgeg mo rgyan gyis spras tshe rab tu dga'/ /tsan+dan dri la ltos 1'gro mchog tu gdung / /gsung ngo // //rgyal po'i khab yangs pa can du mkha' 'gro ma gtsug na nor bus rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ mi gtsang lud 'di 'bras kyi zhing la phan/ /nad gzir skyes bu g.yo med sman pa bsten/ /rigs ldan ded dpon 'khor la bu bzhin rtse //chu bran gling la nor bu yod ma yin/ /sbrang ma rtsi yi nus pa grogs kyis 'gyur/ /gsung ngo 4// //dharma gha na rā 5dza chos kyi mdzod du mkha' 'gro ma 'bar ma dpal gyi phreng mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ 'dzam bu'i gser la mgar 9bas 'dod dgu bsgyur / /phye leb nya dang bung ba lcags kyus phung / /gso bya'i dus der nad pas le lo spang / /ma yis bu la brtse ba'i sems mi gtong / /rin chen gling du khrid pa'i ded dpon mnyes par bya/ /gsung ngo // //klu'i rgyal po e na ya'i gnas su mkha' 'gro ma khyung gi gdong pa can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ dug sbrul mche ba gdags pa'i rgyan ma/ yin/ /27—358

—bde dang bral ba btson rar chud pa'i mi/ /ha la'i me tog mtshar 1ba'i ngor ma thu3 / /bang mdzod rku ba'i mi de bag yod ldan/ /btung bas gdungs pa'i mi de smig rgyu snyag /gsung ngo ༄ // //phyag rgya chen po brda'i man ngag las sems rnam par dag pa'i dum bu mkha' 'gro ma khyung gdong mas bsdus pa ste bzhi pa'o// //bya rgod phung po'i ri la mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi rgyal mos rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ 'dam gyi skyon gyis pad+ma la mi gos/ /gshog ru rgyas tshe byi'u sgophrug tshang nas 'phur/ /tsan+dan mthong ba'i sbrul gyis le lo bor/ /'dod pa'i gnas der zo chun 6chu rgyun bsring / /mchil pas zin pa'i 7nya yi bde ba stor / /gsung ngo ri/— // //'byung po'i grong khyer bi ma la kar mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje 'dam skyes mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ zhing la chu lud rim gyes bsten/ /pha lam gyis ni mi phigs med/ /'byar la ma reg ut+pal 'dab/ /rgya mtsho'i chu la rig byed rnged / /mun pas ma zin nyi ma'i 'od/ /gsung ngo 9// //shar phyogs zangs kyi dung rgad kyi nang du mkha' 'gro ma dpal ldan 'jigs sked mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ nags la brten bca' drang srong rgyab tu shing lo gon/ /gangs la gnas pa'i seng ge ya nga bral nas 'dug /khyung phrug gshog ru rgyas tshe rten med mkha' la lding / /sa 'dzin myu gus 'bras bu rang chas 'grub/ /gdol pa'i bu de 'phyor yang rang mthong zhig /gsung ngo 11// //27—359

shar phyogs kā ༄17ma byu 5ru 'phags pa rang byung 5gi rtsar mkha' 'gro ma 'khor lo shugs 'chang mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ bram ze'i skud pa thog mar bsgrims nas glod/ /gso ras mkhan mos zla ba gcig 3nas glod/ /zhun la bab pa'i gser mgar yangs dang bral/ /gdan gyi steng du rgyal pos bag gzhi phab/ /dmus long mig phye snang ba gzigs mor che /gsung ngo // //mchod rten dpal dbyangs kyi rtsar mkha' 'go ma gtum mo gser mig mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ bram ze'i rig byed gsang tshig bu la ston/ /5rmi lam sdug bsngal sad pa'i dus der dag /mang po'i khrod der mi ngo shes pa nyung / /rgyu yis ma skyes nam mkha' gdod nas dag /til mar ngar btags ngar kyang 6snum gyis 'phyi/ /mda' ru ltor zos sa gzhi gser ༄ 7du mthong / /gsung ngo // //byang phyogs 'dam bu'i khrod du bde ldan 'od kyi gnas su mkha' 'gro ma nyi ma'i gshog pa can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ bram ze'i rig byed gsang tshig bu la ston/ /rgyal po'i pho brang rigs ngan gyis ma mthong / /srang ka'i 8kham phor bya ba zin nas 'dug /dug gsum dag na dmus long bris mkhan med / /nor bu'i brtag pa blun pos shes pa min/ /gsung ngo // //rjing bu pad+ma'i mdangs can gyi 'gram du mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bsnyems rngo/mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ rwa med gser la rtog pas gzon 11mi nus/ /rin chen gling na gram gseg gyo dum med/ /dus kyi rkyen kyis pad+ma rgyas par 'gyur / /tshangs pa'i lus ni ma bkrus dri ma dag /gsung ngo // //27—360

— dha na tshiko sha'i gling du mkha' 'gro ma rin chen thod 'dzin mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ dgra med mi la bsu bskyal kye bya mi dgos/ /ka la piṅka'i gshog ru sgo ngar rgyas/ /pad+ma'i kha ni nyi ma'i zer gyis 'byed/ /chu dang rlan ni gnyis su mi snang ngo / /gsung ngo // //sing ga ①la'i tshal du mkha' 'gro ma nyi ma'i zhags pa can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ rmi lam ltad mo su yis byas pa yin/ /brang chab med pa'i bu mo brjed ngas che/ /bskyed bsrung ④la brtson 'bras bu mi len blun/ /nam mkha'i chu ni smin pa'i rgun 'brum 'bar/ /gsung ngo ge // //dur khrod chen po sgra sgrogs su mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje dung can mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ lha khang nang du dmyus long ltad mo nub/ /ji srid shing yod bar du de srid me/ /sos ka'i chab rom gzhi la stong shemi srid/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan po 'khrul hūṃl rtog pa bral/ /nor bu'i yon tan sus kyang byin pa med/ /bskal pa ma zhig nyi zla'i 'od mi 'gag /khong sran ma byang gyad la sgyu rtsal med/ /rgya mtshor bor ba'i chu thigs skam mi 'gyur/ /gsung ngo bye// //dpal shrī na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang du mkha' 'gro ma rin chen 'od gsal mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ sbyon pa'i mig gis nya dang stong mi mthong /rlan med spyin la 'byar ba'i nus pa med/ /skyes bu med pa'i lcags kyus glang mi zin—/ /thod le kor gyis nam mkha' mtshon mi nus/ /gsung ngo // //phyag rgya chen po brda'i man ngag las dpal gyi thugs rnam par bkod pa'i dum bu mkha' 'gro ma rin chen gcig mas bsdus pa ste lnga pa'o// //27—361

rgya mtsho gser gyi gling du mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bu gcig mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ shing rta dang ni 'khor lo 'bral mi bya/ /dug sbrul dgra ru sgo nga ldang bar 'gyur/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ni dngul gyis ldang / /glang po dul tshe snying la yi ge 'jug /gsung ngo // //nub phyogs bi ra'i tshal du mkha' 'gro ma sha za dpal 'dzin mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ ge sar steng du 'dab ma gdan du gding / /thar pa 'dod pas khyab 'jug mig la blta/ /stobs dang ldan pas gser 'gyur rtsi mchog ni/ /de 1ring ban+da'i drin las rab tu rnyed/ /gsung ngo // //dur khrod rab dga'i nang du mkha' 'gro ma nor bu'i 'od can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ grang ba'i nad la ga bur bsten mi bya/ /tshangs pa'i yi ge smra ru ma btub po/ /gi wang thuzad pa'i glang po sgrog las thar/ /dngul chu'i nus pa lha dbang mig la phan/ /gsung ngo /// //shar phyogs khar sa pā 4ṇi'i gtsug lag khang du mkha' 'gro ma bu ta ro zan mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ sbrul sngags shes pa'i nad la dug mi tshugs/ /'chi ba'i dus der rgyal srid ci zhig bya/ /sna khrid med pa'i long ba gang du 'gro/ /phag gis glang po mtshon te ma mtshon no/ /gsung ngo // //dur khrod ma hā kā la'i dbus su mkha' 'gro ma dpal gyi phreng ba can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ rmi lam ltad mo rang gi sems la byas/ /me ni spra ba dag la rab tu 'bar/ /yi ge gcig gis rig byed kun la 'jug /rig byed kun gyis yi ge gcig ma shes/ /gsung ngo // //bā rā ṇa sīr 5mkha' 'gro ma dpal ldan dung 'bud mas rtogs pa'i brda 27—362

brjod pa/ sngo gzhan dang ni gser 'gyur rtsi mi 'dra/ /nya rgyas zla bas shel la chu rgyun 'dzag /sbu ba'i chu rgyun rgya mtsho rang la thim/ /mkhas pa ba lang skyong ba drag shul 'dor/ /gsung ngo // //chu mig mda' chu khron pa skyes pa'i rtsar mkha' 'gro ma 'bar ma gser dril can gyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ ri brags zubs mtha' dbe+en pa'i gnas ma yin / /rgyal po'i pho brang tshong 'dus rab tu 'gol/ /byad ni me long rgyab tu blta mi bya/ /snag tsha byi ba'i yi ge snying gis klag /gsung ngo // //glang po ljongs kyi grong khyer du mkha' 'gro ma khrag sna rgyal mos rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ nam mkha'i yid can mkha' las 'phags ma nus/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan thar pa'i lam ma yin/ /dkyil 'khor gyis kyang mya ngan las mi 'da'/ /'bras bu mchog ni smyon pa'i sems las btsal /gsung ngo // //byang phyogs sman kyi nags su mkha' 'gro ma gtsug na rgyan dz+ral mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ phag rgod mgo bo rdog pas mnan pa'i mi/ /skyes bu de yis gdams ngag thams cad bstan/ /ded dpon bu yis nam mkha'i yi ge klag2 /grogs dag 'di yi zhabs la 'dud par rigs/ /gsung ngo // //dpal 'bras phung du 4mkha' 'gro ma dpal ldan gru 'dzin mas rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ rdza yi 'khor lo srub thag ma then par/ /nor bu rin chen 'di la mchod par bya/ /glang po smyon pa 'tshong ba'i mi de mkhas/ /gter mthong nas ni 'byol bar mi bya'o/ /gsung ngo 5// //mchod rten rnam dag gi rtsar dpal rang byung gi rgyal mos rtogs pa'i brda 27—363

brjod pa/ kye ho bu rnams seng ge'i 'o ma 'thung / /phan pa'i sman mar phyi ru ma skyug cig /snying gi dbus su nyi ma shar nas su/ /mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab tu 'joms par 'gyur/ /gsung ngo // //phyag rgya chen po brda'i man ngag las las rnam par grol ba'i dum bu mkha' 'gro ma dpal ldan pad+ma'i spyan gyis bsdus pa ste dum bu drug pa'o// //le phran lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa ①phyag rgya rin po che brda'i man ngag rje dam pa la mkha' 'gro mas gtad de zha ma lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o//① //bsdur mchan/351 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gag/ /phyag rgya chen po rin chen brda'i man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / rngo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉/ (/pe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshan do'i—/ she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉l+lī ba/ gye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉las/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadangs/352 sne 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdang / sti〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thar/ blu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ricad/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrubs/she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lbār/ 〈〈co 〉lbāb/ 'u〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉shed/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉skadag thu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉dha/(〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉drod par rtol/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdo/ 114〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharten/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzag khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ginas/253 k+ṇi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zotshon/ ldu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzab/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ā+o/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtser/ khu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉cig gis/ 〈〈co 〉sngagacig gi/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thun dha/8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamadongs/ ḍa〈〈snar 〉〉stogs/ ṅku〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉stor/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngajo' /tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thalta/ skra〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉/stongs/ 8〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉shes/354 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngaphong / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadad/ dzi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rigasung ngo // //355 lta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadang / 2bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skug sha bye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skorajol/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nywa/27—364
