—(1 shanab drabye 0ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ḍā ki ni badz+ra gu hra gī ti nā ma/ bod skad du/mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gsang ba'i glu zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal lha mo bdag sped ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /u dus+thā 2ra'i ut+pal rgyun du 'khrungs pa dkon / /g.yul ngo mi ldog /gyad kyi dgos pa stor/ /nor bu'i gling nas stong 'dab byed nus sam/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs la zhon pa'i skyes bu brel/ /chu bo chen po'i rgyun 'di bcad mi nus/ /lcags kyi pha wang gyen la 'dril bar dka' / /nyi zla'i 'khor lo rlung gis bzlog mi nus/ /mig ser nad kyis btab na dung yang ser/ /byang blta'i phug par nyi zla'i 'od mi 'char/ /skyes bu rang srog dor ba'i dpa' bo blun/ /dug ni 5srog gi bdud yin mngar yang dor / /rba la 'byol ba'i mnyan pa bya btang bskyed/ /nad la phan pa'i sman ni kha yang bza'/ /puṇ+ḍa rī 6ka'i sa bon ma mthong ngam/ /lha sras bzod pa 27—367

che na kun gyis 'khur/ /tshong dus 'gron po 'brel med tshogs kyi 'gyes/ /sbrang ma rtsi bcud mang bas sdug bsngal skyed1/ /ngal sar mkhar len 5byed pa'i skyes bu drun/ /sgyu ma'i yul la mkhan po chags mi skye/ /brag ca'i sgra 'di stod smad smra mi byed/ /rmi lam bde sbug 'di ni sad pas stong / /phyag rgya chen po brda'i mgur las brul tsho dang po'o// //a ma mthong ba'i bu chung gzhan la yid mi 'chor/ /skyes bu skam 4gyis gdungs pa kha zas gzhan mi 'dod/ /mkha' la 'brug sgra bsgrags pas dus kyi yid ches byas/ /khyem bdag khe mthong las la ngal ba med/ /nad kyis nyen pa'i mi ni dpyad la dga'/ /ded dpon nor bu 'dod phyir rtsol ba byed/ /nye zho med pa'i tshang tshol khu 5rta sgrim/ /drang srong rigs ldan ya nga'i kha zas spong / /dor sdebs mthun pa'i glang po rol du bde/ /dge slong gzhon nu'i bsam pa dran gyis la/ /til ngar ldan pa'i gri thogs kun du rgyug /mar me'i 'od la btsal thabs legs su gyis/ /gdan sar bton pa'i rgyal bu 'di la ltos / /bung bas rtsi bcud ma lus ro gcig sdud6/ /gyad ni dpung bzhir bcas te dgra dpung 'joms/ /rgol ba 7mi ldog stobs ldan ci yi phyir/ /gsang tshig mi sgrub blon po gros mi dbang / /bka' bzhin mi bsgrub rgyal po'i 8gshed mas dz+waspong / /srog rgol khodagra la bzod par mi rung bsre/ /rig byed mkhan po'i rgyud ni shi yang slob/ /khrims la gnas pa'i rgyal po sems rgya bskyed//phyag rgya chen po brda'i mgur las brul tsho gnyis pa'o// //27—368

yid bzhin nor bu khur du khur nas kyang / /stobs dang ldan pa'i glang po zhon byas te/ /bdud rtsi gangs kyi zhun ma btung bar bya/ /chu bo sgrol ba'i gru la zag lhan gdab/ /sgo lnga mdangs dang ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan ltos/ /srog dang bral ba'i skyes bu de ci sems/ /mkhan bzos ma byas bse ru'i gzugs la lta/1/ /btso sreg 3/ma byas sa bon myu gu'i rgyu/ /bram ze skud pa 'khal ba'i drung du sdod/ /na bun thibs po bye'adi ni rlung gis gtor/ /glang chen smyon pa 'di ni lcags su gzhug /bung bas me tog rtsi thob phyir mi blta/ /mkha' la 'ja' tshon skyon bral rang sar yal/ /'grul pos chu sgrol gru yi gces 'dzin zhig /mthong byed mig dang bral bas yul rnams 'gags/ /rgyal po'i bka' la brnyas na chad pa'i gnas/ /mthon po'i rtse ni lhung ba'i gnas yin gzabs④ / /'dab gshog ya 'gal gyis ni 'phur mi nus/ /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul skye 'gro'i dpal du shar/ /mkha' la snyechar rgyun bab pas rtsi thog 'khrungs//ded dpon rgan po'i gling don gzhan gyi cheda'u/ /phyag rgya chen po brda'i mgur las brul tsho gsum pa'o// //dig mas tshig tu smras pa med/ /chu shal )zla ba su yis byas/ /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs ngo mtshar che/ /nam mkha'i dbyings zudang kha dog su yis mthong / /bar snang dngas pa'i nus pa gang gi mthu/ /na bun 'di la ngos gzung she'adug gam ci/ /rna dbang sgra la zin pa'i ri dwags blun/ /dbang po yul gyis non pa'i ri dwags ltos/ /gnyen po 'phrig dang ldan pas spyosha ba ltos/ /chu yi zla ba ma bsgul bzhag skyen drungs/ /til gyi mar me gsal 27—369

dngas 1ngar dang ldan/ /rmi lam bde ba'i nyams ni sad pas stong / /rgyal pos sa srung ral gris rgol ba 'joms/ /khro bo'i gzugs brnyan 'di yis byis pa sdigs4 / /gnam lcags thog gi shugs la sra snyi med/ /chu yi zla ba 'di la yid mi gtad/ /'ja' tshon ngo bos stong pas spang blang med/ /na bun mkha' la yal ba'i byung sa ltos/ /dngos med mun pas khyab pa'i nam mkha' las/ /sna tshogs mdangs dang ldan pa'i lho sprin 'thibs/ /char rgyun du mas 'gro ba'i lo tog rgyas//phyag rgya chen po brda'i mgur las brul tsho bzhi pa'o// //myu gu mgo rtsa gnyis su gyes kyang gcig gi stobs/ /chu nang zla ba cha med nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin/ /ga bur nus pa 'di yi 3sman dug byas pa med/ /chab rom snang yang chu las gud na grub pa med/ /na bun 'di yi rang bzhin cha med gzung bas stong / /me long nang du gzugs med rkyen shar snang ba tsam/ /mo gsham bu yi pha ma khyod kyis mthong ngam ci/ /skad cig 'di la dus gsum khong nas dag pa yin/ / lits+tsha bī 6yis smras pa khyod kyis ji ltar go/ /a lu ngo shes byis pa de dus brid du rnged/ /'a tsi ba la'i mtshang rtogs nas ni 'jigs mi dgos/ /nor bu lag tu lon pa'i ded dpon dbul dang bral/ /shel gyi rang bzhin mi 'gyur tshon gyis bcos su med/ /nam mkha' ma grub phyir na sprin gyis gang la sgrib/ /gser la gzugs brnyan du ma byas kyang gser nyid yin / /grib ma gzugs las byung bar shes pas spang blang med/ /drang srong rnams kyi rig pas sman dug dbyer ma phyed/ /dbul mo gter dang phrad tshe bcol ba'i las mi byed/ /nam mkhas 7nam mkha' bsten 8pas nam mkha' phyi 27—370

nang 'dres/ /spang blang med pa'i nam mkha' la ni 'byung bzhi shar/ /'byung bzhi'i rtsal du 'gro ba gso bskyed byas/ /phyag rgya chen po brda'i mgur las la bzla ba'i brul tsho ste lnga pa'o// //zhing pa brtson 'grus ldan pa la/ /lus ngag las la dub pa med/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'khor los sgyur/ /gdan sar gdon pa'i bya ba gces/ /lha yi bu mo yid 'ong ma/ /sgyu ma tsam du brtse bar bya/ /mdung ste lnga la ngar blud de/ /nam mkha'i 'o ma dbug par bya/ /jem skas gdang bu bzhi la dbab//gzhon dus byis pa zas kyis bkol1/ /gangs kyi thigs pa mi dbo bar/ /dpyang thag 'dren pa'i thag pa bzung / /rlung gis mkha' la sbar nas kyang //chu bran yur ba gzud par bya/ /chab rom smin pa rdo yi mi/ /skye dang 'chi bas slu chomi shes/ /des ni mchog gi nor bu'i gter/ /rma bya'i zas ni btsan dug nyid/ /me yis tshig la me nyid sman/ /'dod can rnams kyi don du ni/ /thabs kyi khyad par gzhan las 'phags/ /phyag rgya chen po brda'i mgur las rtsa ba'i de nyid bstan pa ste brul tsho drug pa'o// //rnam par shes pa nam mkha'i gzugs/ /srid dang zhi ba'i byed pa'o/ /m+bid pas gzugs su bzung bas 'ching / /zhi bas der 'dzin spros dang bral/ /srid pas dbus su bcug pa yis/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'dzin par byed/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi sogs kyis6/ /lus rnams kun la khyab par gnas/ /'byung dang 'jug dang gnas dang gsum/ /yi ge gsum gyi spyor ba yis /27—371

dgu brgya bcu gcig grangs them na1/ /rtog pa rlung gis za bar byed/ /mi rtog lnga po shar ba yis/ /las kyi rmang rdo lnga po bcom/ /'od gsal ba yi don mthong nas/ /bar do'i gong khyer 'joms par byed/ /phyag rgya chen po brda'i mgur las rlung gi de nyid bshad pa ste brul tsho bdun pa'o// //phyag rgya chen po brda'i man ngag 2snamakha' 'gro ma rdo rje gsang ba'i mgur brul tsho bdun du bstan pa'o// //mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang mdzod na gnas pa las dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams kyi bka' bgros nas/ ka ma la shī la la gtad/ zha ma lo tsā ba ston pa seng ge rgyal pos bsgyur ba'o//4 //bldur mchan/367 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga ma/kha' 'gro ma rdo rje gsang ba'i glu 'es bya ba bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dusbra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdogs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kudi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/268 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskyed/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ca'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkem/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skathug 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasdud/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ya/sa// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesal/369 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra lta/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sreg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngarathibs so/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sazobs 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skalas/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyed/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shel/ 〈〈co 〉〉the ra 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanabyibs/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rizung / —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/ 1 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgul gshanag37༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skomadangs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamanyams/ 〈〈snar 〉〉srungs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra dzisas /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉ra tsa byi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉thamakha'/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastan/27—372

༄ / /jon pa ba chen pos ka ma la shī la la gnad kyi gdams pa bstan pa/—1༄go/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gros nabyin brlabs rtogs pa'i brda/ /til ni sgron me — gsal bar byed/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i sman bzhin du/ /rma bya'i zas ni gzhan gyis min/ /tsan+dan ri dwags lte ba'i dri/ /chu yi rlabs ni rgya mtsho nyid/ /gsal ba'i rang bzhin ras dkar 'dra/ /ri bo bskyod par mi nus pas/ /gangs ri chu las gzhan med de/ /dri dang sgog skya tha dad min/ /nyi zla'i yon tan gsal ba yin/ /bya yi rjes ni tshol mi byed/ /nam mkha' rtog ge'i spyod yul min/ /maṇ+ḍal phyogs cha rab tu snyoms/ /ro langs bya sar dkon de bzhin/ /dpe med ngo mtshar nor bu shel/ /zhes rngon pa ba 4chen po sa ra has ka ma la shī la la lta ba'i brda bstan pa'o // // 5dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gros byin brlabs bsgom pa'i 27—374

brda—/ /tshang tshing nags kyi dur khrod du/ /bdag med ma dang phrad byas la/ / nyi ma shar ba'i tsho) bsam pa yis/ /las zin pa yi skyes bu bzhin/ /spyi bo'i nor bu mchod nas kyang / /khang pa stong pa'i khye bzhin du/ /sman pa'i don stor nam mkhar khyer/ /chu bo chen po'i rgyun 'bab bzhin/ /drang srong ku sha'i steng du bzhag/mar me rlung dang bral ba bzhin/ /dngul dkar me long phyi bar bya/ /yid 'ong bral ba'i ma bzhin du/ /rus sbal 'khar gzhong nyi ma la/ /rtsal ldan 'phong slob brtson pa ste/ /mda' mkhan yid ni gcig tu gtod/ /gdams pa'i gtsor ni nges par grol/ /gser las byas pa'i rgyan bzhin du/ /bu ram ro la myang bar bya/ /zhes rngon pa ba 2 chen pos ka ma la shī la la bsgom pa'i brda bstan pa'o // //༄ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gros 4byen brlabs spyod pa'i brda—/ /bag ma'am sbyon pa'i tshul bzung ste/ /glang po btsongs la phag rgod bsad/ /nya ni rgya mtshor yangs pa che/ /nags rnams me yis rab tu sregalha /res 'ga' mgyogs pa'i rta la zhon/ /gri gug rnon po'i mtshon gyis ni/ /ce 5spyang dur khrod rnam par rol/ /spyan gzigs zas la rtag tu spyad/ /khra yi rtsal ni nges par drag /wa ni dur khrod rnam par rol/ /chang 'thungs pa yis yul mthong 'dra/ /me tog sgyu ma bung ba ste/ /bu chung seng ge me long 'dra/ /stag ni 'jigs pa med par— rgyu/ /sgron se rtag tu thogs byas te/ /glang po zhon la kun du rgyug /zhes rngon pa ba 7 chen pos ka ma la shī la la spyod pa'i brda bstan pa'o // // dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gros 9byen brlabs 'bras 27—375

bu'i brda/ /ge sar pad+mo'i dkyil nas 'khrungs/ /shel gyi 'od zer nang nas shar / /rma bya'i ri mo su yis bris/ /'ja' tshon nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin/ /rtog med re ba nor bu bskang / /'dab gshog med par 'phur mi nus/ /gtsub 1stan me ni rtsol bas 'byin/ /shing ni rang gis rang la bsreg /gser gyi kha dog mtshur nyagyis 'don/ /dgra med mi ni zon dang bral/ /gnyid sad skyes bu de ci sems/ /byis pa a lus 'brid pa ltos/ /nam mkha' nam mkha' nam mkha'i ngang / /chu bran rgya mtsho'i dbyings su 'dres/ /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul ngo mtshar che/ /chu zla du ma yod ma yin/ /zhes rngon pa bas ka ma la shī la la 5'bras bu'i brda bstan pa'o // // 4dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gros byen brlabs lam gyi brda / /sdom ni tshad las mi 'da' bar/ /ri bong 'di yi spyod 'gros ltos/ /khra yi rtsa la yangs pa med/ /rtag tu 'khor lo'i rtse la zhon/ /rdza mkhan bu la yangs pa med/ /ral gri til ngar ldan pa gces/ /me la rlung gis bskyod pa yis / /tshang tshing nags kyi dur khrod bsreg /bram ze skud pa 'khal la ltos/ /bya ba zin pa'i skyes bu mchog /snying chung 5de ni mi ro yin/ /mar rnge rlung gis ma bskyod par/ /'khor lo'i srub thag gcad 6par bya/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /lho sprin rlung gis brda bar bya/ /'ja' tshon 'di yis byis pa bslus/ /so mtshams mkhar gyi bdag po ltos/ /rin chen gter gyi me+el tshe gyis/ /nam mkhas nam mkha' grol bar nges/ /zhes rngon pa ba chen pos ka ma la shī la la 8lam gyi brda bstan pa'o // //tsu27—376

dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gros byin brlabs nyams kyi brda / /dkar po'i zla ba rim pa ste/ /'ja' tshon nam mkha' nyid la mdzes/ /gzhon nus smras pa ci ste go/ /chus bkang nas ni smrar mi btub/ /khug rna dang ba'i rnam pa bzhin/ /dbul mo gter ldan ngo mtshar che/ /lan tshwa chu bo nyid la thim / /bya ni mkha' las 'da' mi nus/ /dgras bslus gnyen la'ang yid ma 1gtod / /ral gri ngar ldan ngo mtshar che/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo 'jigs mi byed / /wa yis seng ge skrag pa min/ /bya ni mkha' la rtsol sgrub 2med/ /mkha' dang cho 'phrul tha dad min/ /nam mkha' gang gis za bar nus/ /chu ni ma rnyog bzhag na dngas/ /'di nyid yin dang ma yin zhes/ /sus byas su yis go ba su/ /zhes rngon pa ba chen pos ka ma la shī la la 4nyams kyi brda bstan pa'o// //dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gros byin brlabs gnad kyi brda / /seng ge glang chen phag rgod bsad/ /rtsa ba bral ba'i sdong po bzhin/ /nags kyi ri dwags gal la tshud/ /gzings kyi bya rog gar bder thong 5/ /dngas ma'i chur ni gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /mkha' la tshon gyis bskur 6mi nus/ /ri bo rlung gis bsgul ba min/ /rgya mtsho chen po gting mi g.yo/ /snying chung 7de ni skal bar ldan/ /seng ge'i gsob la byis pa 'jigs/ /bung ba'i spyod pa yid kyis ltos//bu shi'i mya ngan sems la zhog /sgon me lag tu thogs pa'i mi/ /kun gyi sna la 'gro bar gyis/ /de nas nam mkha'i phyi nang 'dre/ /zhes gsungs te/ rngon pa ba chen pos ka ma la shī la la 8gnad kyi gdams pa bstan pa'o // //27—377

༄ga /sems kyi gsang ba zab don brda'i glur blangs pa zhes bya ba/zi1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta gu hra garje rārba gī ti zunā ma/ bod skad du/ sems kyi gsang ba zab don brda'i glur blangs pa zhes bya ba/ sha ba ri dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ho chu dang 'o ma so sor nam mkha'i mthongs su bsres pa rtog med ngang pa'i mchu des bsdus nas song / /'dab chags 'ug pa'i mig gis sna tshogs mun pa'i khrod na snang ba so sor mthong ba phyi rol min/ /'dab chags de tsos nyi ma'i 'od la rtsi shing nags khrod mthong la dga' zhing rtse la lhag par chags/ /rma bya dug gi lo ma zos pas spu sdug lhag par mdzes pa'i kha dog mdongs ni su yis bris/ /sgeg mo bzhin /gyi dri ma dag pa'i gdong 4can me long blta la rab tu brtson pa shes par gyis/ /srin po'i gling las thar pa'i ded dpon dri za'i grong mthong de la gnas bcas don chen 'grub pa mtshar/ /drang srong chu yi zla ba blta zhing nyi zla'i phreng ba bgreng 5la 27—379

brtsen 1pa gtsang sbra lhag par che/ /rgyal pos dgra thabs kyis ni bkug ste bcings nas bsad pas srid dang bcas pa thob ste g.yon can min/ /ging pa srog gcod mkhas pa nyin bzhin srog gcod de la sdig pas mi gos gshin rje gshed / /rdzi bo thabs mkhas lcags kyus stobs ldan glang po'i kha lo ji ltar 'dod bzhin bsgyur 2ba phyi rol min/ /mig 'phrul mkhan pos nyi zla brkus te mun khung nang du sbas pas gza' skar thams cad dbang du 'dus/ /tshangs pa'i ril ba chus bkang mi 'dzag dag byed rgyud du 'chang ba shes na rten 'brel che ba yin/ /dpyid dus me tog mgul chad lhang ba shing thog ro ldan 'gyur bar re ba'i mi de 'ja' tri yin/ /rdza so ma btang snod der chu blugs mi 'dzag min pas me nang bcug la ti tsha mkhas par bya/ /khu rta skom yang sa nang 'bab pa'i chu ni mi 'thung nam mkha'i char rgyun 'dzed par shes par bya/ /lkugs par sdod pa'i mi des khab len rdo yis lcags phye bsdus pas rgya mtshor zla ba gza' yis bzung / /dus mtha'i mdung rtser 'bab pa'i tshangs pa'i dngul chu de la gzugs mdzes brtan 5pa'i rgyal po lhag par dga'/ /zo chun 'khor los khron pa'i chu rnams gyen du drangs pas mchog gi lo tog smin pa e ma ho9/ /zab mo brda'i glu gsang ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba sdogs so// //sha ba ri dbang phyug gis dam pa la gsungs/ dam pa'i zhal snga nas zha ma lo tsā bas gtan la phab ste dpal ding ri mkhan pa'i khrod du bsgyur ba'o// //27—380

bsdur mchan/379 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sems kyi gsang ba zab don brda'i glur blangs pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (4)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasnyirā tha gī ta/ 6)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhan / ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉padong / sa 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragreng /38༷ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtson/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/ /kye〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉skathug ④〈〈snar 〉sngagazung /⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brten/ 'u〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'o/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1277)27wa 381

༄/ /dpal u rgyan du tshogs 'gor byas pa'i dus su rnal 'byer pa grub pa thob pa bzhi bcus rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa nyams kyi man ngag thig le gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/5rte ༄go/ /2bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal nas / gang gis ma rtogs pa yis rtogs pa'i spyod pa mi bya ste/ /byas na rgyal po'i khrims la dmangs kyi rdoganod pa byas pa bzhin/ /rtogs pa rnams kyis ma rtogs pa yi spyod pa mi bya ste/ /byas na glang chen dag ni 'dam du byeng ba 'dra / /gsung ngo // //slob dpon sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ kye ho grogs dag lhan cig skyes pa ste/ /gzhan nas rnyed min zhal la dris/ /don dam gzhan gyi ngo bo de rtogs na/ /yid ni gar 'ching rlung yang chad pa med/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon tog tse pa'i zhal nas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad//tshogs drug dag na bde chen rgyun mi 'chad/ /brtags pa thams cad don med g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ /sgom du med pas gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /gsung ngo // //27—382

slob dpon sa man+ta badz+ra'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po rang la lhan gyis grub pa ste/ /mi bsam mi rig 'bad pa med par ngang gis zhog /chad pa med de sngon du nyams myong rang gis rig /rtag par mi 'gyur mngon zhen med par zung du 'jug /gsung ngo // //slob dpon ka na pa'i zhal nas/ shing rta'i 'khor lo gcig dang mi ldan 'gro bar mi nus bzhin/ /sbyin sogs 'bad pa byas kyang bla ma'i man ngag med na dngos grub dam pa med/ /bya rgod rtsal rdzogs 'dab mar bcas pa dag no mkha' la spyod cing rgyug /skal bzang rnal 'byor dam pa rnams ni dbang dang byen brlabs dam pa'i 'og tu chud cing bde/ /gsung ngo // //kadza la'i zhal nas/ zab cing rgya che rgya mtsho nor bus gang ba la/ /klu yi rgyal po rnams kyis ①mnga' mdzod ngo mtshar che/ /snang grags thams cad ye nas chos sku yin pa la/ /rtogs dang nyams myong 2ldan pas mnga' mdzod ngo mtshar che/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon lū yi rngo pa'i zhal nas/ khyi rgod rab tu mi srun sna la sbrang rtsi byugs na phyogs rnams kun tu za bar byed/ /blo dman skal ba dam —pa'i gang zag rnams la dbang dang gdams ngag byin pas rang rgyud bsreg /glang chen dpa' la brtan pa'i sna la ral snyegri bskur bas dgra dpung 'joms/ /skal bzang blo ldan skye med rtogs pa rnams kyis thugs 6phrad dag gi rnam rtog 'joms//gsung ngo // //slob dpon ti (7 lo pa'i zhal nas/ ri rab gser gyi ngos la bya gnas pa / /bya yi rang bzhin bor nas gser du snang / /mkhas pa gang 27—383

gis skye ba drad rtogs na/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin bor nas bde ba che/ /gsung ngo // //ti 1lo pa'i zhal nas/ bdag nyid gdod ma nyid nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /ma rtogs dbang gis sangs rgyas nyid du ma mthong ngo / /gnyis med gang gis rtogs pa de ni phyag rgya che/ /rtogs pa'i yul na mthong ba med byung rtogs pa med/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon shes rab bzang po'i zhal nas/ byis pa chung ngu gsos nas gyad kyi stobs dang ldan pa bzhin/ /blo chung rnams kyang bla ma'i gdams ngag dag gis brid pas jeg pa che/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad rnams sman gyis sel ba ltar/ /nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nad rnams bla ma'i gdams ngag dag gis skad cig nyid la bsreg /gsung ngo // //slob dpon nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal dpung gi tshogs rnams kyis/ /gling rnams kun la dbang bsgyur bzhin/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ro rnyed pas/ /'khor ba dag la dbang bsgyur ngo mtshar che/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon ḍom+bi pa chung ba'i zhal nas/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi nus pa yis//lcags rnams gser du 'gyur ba bzhin/ /rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis/ /nyon mongs ye shes gnyis med 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo // //slob dpon dza ba ri pa'i zhal nas/ skye med rtogs kyang nyams myong bral//de yang srin mo'i lag tu bu khyer 'dra/ /nyams su myong yang gnas lugs ma rtogs na / /de yang glang chen lcags kyus phrogs pa 'dra/ /zhes gsung ngo // //27—384

slob dpon ba su dha ra'i zhal nas/ gang gis ma rtogs bar du ro 'di 'bras chan dag dang khyad par che/ /de bzhin ma rtogs bar du sangs rgyas sems can khyad par brtagasatsho/ /rtogs pa'i dus na 'khor ba dag kyang sangs rgyas che/ /de phyir rtogs dang ma rtogs dag kyang dbye bar dka' bas khyad par sked / /thugasung ngo // //slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal nas/ bya ba gtong ba man ngag yin/ /zhe 'dod med na rtogs pa yin/ /bsgrub bya med na spyod pa yin/ /smra brjod med na nyams myong yin/ /blang dor med na 'bras bu yin/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon ḍom+bi he ru ka'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu la/ /nyams su myong bas mdog phyung la/ /spyod pa'i nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung / /ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon a ba dhū tī'i zhal nas/ thabs dang shes rab an dza la/ /bla ma'i chu bo'i rgyun gyis rab tu rgyal / /lhan cig skyes pa'i dpag bsam shing dag la/ /'bras bu lhan grub rang la rdzogs par 'byung / /gsung ngo // //slob dpon dā ri ka pa'i zhal nas/ /rang la bde chen yod kyang ma rtogs 'khrul pas bsgribs/ /bde chen gsal bar 'dod na tshogs gnyis bsag 4par bya/ /tshogs gnyis ma bsags bskal pa brgya ru 'bad byas kyang / /don mred don dang mi ldan bde chen rtogs mi 'gyur/ /5gsung ngo // //slob dpon nag po zhabs kyi zhal nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo gcig /de yi rang bzhin byang chub sems/ /rtogs par 'dod na ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na mngon du 'gyur/ /6gsung ngo // // 37—385

slob dpon gcer bu lcung bzed kyi zhal nas/ bla ma dag las dang po 1rang gi sems rtogs bya/ /de nas chos rnams kun dang tha dad med byas la/ /gnyis med goms phyir dur khrod gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag nas sbyon pa'i brtul zhugs dag gis spyad/ /3gsung ngo // //slob dpon ro langs bde ba'i zhal nas/ rta dang glang po rgya mtsho 'dra na rab tu bde/ /spre'u chu yi ri mo 'dra na spro bar 'gyur/ /chu bo nyi ma sman dang 'dra na dbyer mi phyed/ /gtsug phud mig dang 'khor lo lta bur 'bras bu thob / /gsung ngo // //slob dpon rā ma pha la'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kun kyi sdom pa'i mchog/rang gi rtogs par gnas pas na/ /gnyug ma'i sems kyis rtogs pa gang / /sangs rgyas thams cad des mthong yin/ /༄gsung ngo // //slob dpon ku ku ri pa'i zhal nas/ dbyer med sa la gnas na kun kyang skal ba 9bzang / /rgya mtsho'i gting du phyin na dbul dang bral/ /ral gri lag na 4thogs na longs spyod che/ /phyogs med sa la phyin na gnyen dang phrad/ /snyegasung ngo // //slob dpon spyod pa mthu stobs can gyi zhal nas/ rnal 'byor rnams la gang snang thams cad gdams pa ste/ /mthong bas de yi skye med rtogs pas slob dpon mchog /byas pa kun gyi skye med rtogs phyir thabs yin te/ /dga' dang mi dga' bral na skyes bu de la gnyis med 'byung / /zhes gsung ngo // //slob dpon ku mā ra tri ta'i zhal nas/ gang gis bla ma'i gdams pa la/ /dbang blangs lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /ro yis kun la khyab byas te/ /skye med 27—386

rgyas 'debs rdo rje 'dzin/ /byin brlabs shar bas dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas—/ /lku gsung ngo // //slob dpon bha ti ba'i zhal nas/ chos rnams kun kyang rang gi sems dang gnyis med sbyor/ /rtogs pa'i nyams myong nges don gdams pa'i don bral na / /nor bu mching bu dag la bde chen min/ /chos de rnams dang ldan na re dogs med par rang sar zhog /gsung ngo // //slob dpon lus med rdo rje'i zhal nas/ sems ma gdungs na bde ba che/ /zhe 'dod med na ro snyoms yin/ /'bad dang bral na bsgom 27pa'i mchog /gnyis snang bral na rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /nagasung ngo // //rgyal po in+d+ra bo bye'i zhal nas/ dus kyi sna rtse bdag byin brlab 4dang ma ldan na/ /phyi dang nang du spyod pa byas kyang sangs mi rgya/ /bde ba rang chas snang ba dag dang khyad par med/ /zhen pa btang bas nyams su myong ba mchog thob 'gyur/ /h+yegasung ngo // //slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra'i zhal nas/ gar yang ma bltas dbus su ltos/ /mchog dang bral na dga' ba che/ /sngags rig gsang ba ltos spyod na/ /rnal 'byor rtags kyis bsgyur bar bya/ /9gsung ngo // //lha lcam lal+lī shaṃka ra'i zhal nas/ dang po blo ldan rtogs pa bskyed/ /gnyis pa nags su sna rtse bsgom/ /nyams su myong ba skyes pa na/ /spyod pa'i khyad par rtogs par bya/ /8gsung ngo // //slob dpon pad+mo zhabs kyi zhal nas/ gang gang lhan cig skyes pa de/ /glang po che yi mig bzhin du/ /gze reg 9skyes na zug rngur 'gyur/ /glod na 27—387

zhan med bsam gtan mchog /gsung ngo // //slob dpon snying po zhabs kyi zhal nas/ chu rgyun gnas pa'i nyams bstan nas / /spyod pa'i gnas kyis 'gro bar bya/ /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis / /chags sdang rtog pa zhi bar bya/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon rdo rje zhabs kyi zhal nas/ bde'o bde'o gnas med bde/ /'dod pa rnged pa'i rang bzhin bde/ /brtags pa thams cad der shes bde/ /bsgrubs pa med pa'i sangs rgyas bde/ /1gsung ngo // //slob dpon dril bu zhabs kyi zhal nas/ la rīl ra sa dhū tī gsum/ /bdag byin brlab phyir bcing bar bya/ /bla ma sems dang snang ba gsum/ /rtog 4pa bskyed phyir mkhas pas bstenalta/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon mdung can lkugs —pa'i zhal nas/ dgag bsgrub bral ba'i sku bzhi dbyer mi phyed/ /gza' gtad med pa'i chos rnams rtsa ba gabyug /ma yengs pa yi sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /phyogs cha med na rnal 'byor kun gyi mchog / gsung ngo // //slob dpon ku ti bhi ra pa'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas mchod sogs rnams la don mi 'byung / /'dod dang rtsol ba yod na sangs mi rgya/ /byin rlabs 8bla ma'i ngag gis nyams myong 'phel/ /bla ma'i man ngag cha las gzhan kyis min//9 gsung ngo // //slob dpon mi pham ral pa can kyi zhal nas/ rje btsun dam pa bsten na de nyid 'thob/ /nags tshal mthongs su bsgoms na dben pa thob9 chos rnams sems su rtogs na mi mthun med/ /nam mkha'i 'o ma 'thungs na tshim 27—388

par 'gyur/ /shegasung ngo // //slob dpon zhi ba'i dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ bde ba stong pa mtha' dang bral rtogs na/ /dpag bsam shing la brten pas nyes bral te/ /mtsho las skyes bu 2rkyal bas 'gro shes na/ /bram ze pha dang ma la bu skye 'gyur/ /chogasung ngo // //rnal 'byor ma dharma'i zhal nas/ go cha chen po gon nas kyang / /nor bu lta bu'i snying stobs kyis/ /rang gi sems la chu btang ste/ /mi ro'i khog par nges zhugs nas/ /skye ba bdun pa'i sha zos na/ /nam mkha' la ni bya bzhin no/ /gsung ngo // //slob dpon mo tri pa'i zhal nas/ bde dang stong pa dbyer med snying ga pad+ma dag la rdzogs/ /skye med yid la byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab bde ba chen po'i sems/ /snang grags thams cad ro mnyam gsum du rnal 'byor pa yis spyad/ /rjes su bdag gis byin brlabs shar bas dbyer med sgogs sangs rgyas/ /gsung ngo // //rnal 'byor ma gha gha'i zhal nas/ yul la ma lta 5sems la'ang ma lta 6zhig/zhe 'dod ma byed bya ba ma byed cig /dogs pa ma 'cha' nyams pa ma byed par/ /gnyug ma'i shes pa gang dga' nyid du thong / /7gsung ngo // //byu su ku'i zhal nas/ bya ba 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyid du zad/ /bya ba btang ba'i rnal 'byor sems rtogs byed/ /gang du'ang mi gnas rtag chad mtha' las 'das/ /bsgom du med pas bsam gyis mi khyab nyid/ /2 gsung ngo // //27—389

rnal 'byor ma kang ka ra'i zhal nas/ gnyis med shes pa chu la chu bzhag 'dra / /rang bzhin ma bslad 7glang po lta bur zhog /nyams myong spre'u gang ltar byung yang rung / /rtogs pa'i nam mkha' ji ltar khyab par bya/ /zhes gsung ngo // //dpal u rgyan du 2tshogs 'khor byas pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa grub pa thob pa bzhi bcus rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa nyams kyi man ngag thig le gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/382 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi༄༄ pa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/383 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+ku/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyong / 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ zi〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉raman/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sharas/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thug 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tai/384 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tai/385 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra tags/ 〈〈pe 〉〉mod do/ /zhes/ 〈〈snar 〉rabad do zhes/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rgyal/4〈〈pe 〉ra sags/ 5 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhes/386 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yar/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ces/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thade'i/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhes/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskal pa/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tu/ 2sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ces/387 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhes/ 2〈〈pe 〉snga sgoms/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhes/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs—/ 5 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'es/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lasmi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 jes/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'am/388 sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7zhes/ 2bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shar/ ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkegs/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharten/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skug 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ces/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'es/ rka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngathob/27—390

༄khya/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa lnga'i rtogs pa brjod pa/1༄4/ /na mo rat+na gu ru/ dur khrod chen po 2bsil ba'i tshal du mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i ro zan mas dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ rjes la rgun chang phra men kyi snod bkang ba drangs te/ rtogs pa brjod pa'i mgur re zhus pas/ dang po la mkha' 'gro ma nyi zla gser gyi thor cog can gyis rtogs pa brjod de mgur bzhengs pa/ kye ho ma bcos rnal ma'i shes pa la/ /nges shes skyes na sangs rgyas yin/ /dkar dmar yul gyi snang ba 'di/ /brda ru go na bla ma yin/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma ral pa'i thor cog can gyis rtogs pa 4brjod pa/ kye ho gnyis su med na 'ching grol rnged/ /ngos gzung med na sgrib pa med/ /rang bzhin med na chags sdang med/ /dran du med na yengs su med/ /gsung ngo // //rdzo7—392

mkha' 'gro ma rlung gi gshog pa can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho chos rnams gzhi med rmi lam 'dra/ /snang bar rkyen skyes gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /rang byung rang zhi lbu 2ba 'dra/ /rtsa bral chen po nam mkha' 'dra/ /3gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma nyi zla'i thod phreng can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho de nyid nyams su myong ba'i skyes bu gang / /bde chen nam mkha'i khams su mi shong ngo / /'di la mtshon du 'dug gam khyod kyis smros/ /nga yis ci yang mthong ba med par mthong / /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma lwa 1ba'i gos can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho pad+ma'i ge sar snying gi dbus su sad/ /gsal ba'i me tog 'dam gyi dri ma bral/ /dri dang kha dog ldan pa gang gis rkyen/ /'di la dgag dang bsgrub 4pa yod dam ci//gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma me kha las rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho nam mkha' las byung cho 'phrul ni/ /nam mkha' nyid kyis 5byas pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i ngang du rang byung ste/ /'di la skyon du ma 'dzin cig /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma ro langs bde mas rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho bla ma'i drin gyes bde chen mchog rnyed nas/ /thabs gzhan brtan 6pa rmongs pa shes par bya//'di las gud du gyur pa'i bde lam zhig /gzhan nas rnyed pa sus kyang nus pa med/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma ye shes rdo rjes rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho sna tshogs snang ba'i cho 'phrul 'di/ /dran pa'i gzugs brnyan yin shes shing / /dran pa rang ngos stong shes na/ /dbyings kyi bde ba btsal mi dgos/ /mkha' 'gro ma srid 27—393

pa'i rgyal mos rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho rang rig rgyal po 'di mthong na/ /thams cad thams cad thar pa'i lam/ /rang rig nyid ni ma rtogs na/ /grol ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma pad+ma zhabs kyis rtogs pa'i brda brjod pa/ kye ho yod med tha dad 1bral ba la/ /gang gis brtag 3dpyad bya bar nus/ /dran med blo dang bral ba la/ /gang gis bsam zhing bsgom par nus/ / gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma rgyal ba'i blo gros kyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho stong nyid rig pa'i rtsal dang ldan/ /skye med skye ba'i cho 'phrul ston/ /dgag sgrub med de rang sar grol/ /'di la bya rgyu ngas ma rnyed/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho yod do byas na ngos gzung 4med/ /med do byas na sna tshogs 'char/ /yod med mkha' las 'das pa la5/ /'di zhes nga yis mtshon mi nus/ /gsung ngo ༄ —/// //mkha' 'gro ma gzi brjid kyi rgyal mos rtogs pa brjod pa/ dran du med na ma yengs shig /yengs pas 'khor ba rmi lam 'dra/ /rtogs na 4 skyes bu gnyid sad 'dra/ /ngas ni 'khor ba ma mthong ngo / / gsung ngo // //8mkha' 'gro ma dpal gyi bzang mos rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho snang srid 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /'dod yon 'di ni dngas pa yisaṣe/ /gnyug ma'i don la 'du 'bral med/ /bde chen thang la rgyug tu gsol/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'go ma dpal gyi 'od zer gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho gnyug ma don gyi 7gter mdzod na/ /dgos 'dod sems nyid nor bu yod/ /sde mig bla ma dam pas 11'dzin/ /rjes su 'jug pa spro lags sam/ /gsung ngo // //27—39 4

mkha' 'gro ma bzang mos rtogs pa brjod pa/ ltos shig rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas pas ma rnyed rtsa ba stor/ /yal ga ji ltar dgyes tsodagyes mdzod / /nga ni rtog 5pa rang grol yin/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bde mas rtogs pa brjod pa/ 'gro rnams las kyis 'khrul gyur kyang / /bde ba rang las gzhan med de/ /bskyar de rang gi don de ltos/ /yid ni las las thar bar 'gyur/ //gsung ngo // //bdag nyid chen po nyi ma'i dbang phyug gis rtogs pa brjod pa/ nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid kyis/ /snang srid gsal zhing bsregs 4pa ltar/ /gnyis gred ye shes chen po yis/ /chos rnams gsal zhing 'joms par byed/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma lha dpal gyi ye shes kyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho nga ni mi skye mi 'jig ste/ /'gyur med ye shes rdo rje yin/ /nga las byung ba'i chos rnams kun/ /nga yi ngo bor mnyam du grol/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma stag gi gdong pa can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho mi skye mi 'gag bsam las 'das/ /'di zhes mtshon pa'i tshig dang bral/ /ye grol chen po mchog gi lam/ /bsam du med do rang sar zhog /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma zhi ba bzang mos rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho sems kyi de nyid smra ru med/ /gshis kyi de nyid bsam du med/ /chos kyi de nyid ngos gzung med/ /lam gyi de nyid bsgom du med/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma gha gha dpal gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho bu khyod ci sems de la ltos/ /spros dang bral ba mthong du med/ /bsam du med pa su 27—395

zhig bsgom/ /'di la ma rtsol /tshogazhi la zhog /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma ye shes dbang phyug gis rtogs pa brjod pa/ gang gis de nyid ma mthong na/ /lus ngag dge ba'i las spyad kyang / /bde chen mchog dang mi phrad de/ /gnas skabs tsam kyis bde bar zad/ / dugasung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i rdo rjes rtogs pa ③brjod pa/ kye ho gang gis mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang tshor ba'i bye brag kun/ /yid kyi ye shes dngas pa la/ /gzugs brnyan tsam du shar ba las/ /gzhi la ma grub ngo bos stong / /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma lha nyi ma'i rta can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ gang gis ma mthong de mthong na/ /yid ni rang grol chos kyi sku/ /rlung gi rta pho shul du lus/ /sems kyi mi pho mkha' la 'go/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma pad+ma'i myu gus rtogs pa brjod pa/ 'gro ba yid kyi phreng bas babyungs/ /yid bsad phreng thag bcad pa yis/ /dug sbrul mtshon gyis gtses pa bzhin/ /'di yis phan gnod byas pa med/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma dbyengs kyi rgyal mos rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho nam mkha' yongs su dngas na tshon gyis bsgyur du med/ /rtogs dang ldan pa'i 4skyes bu las kyis bcing du med/ /gdengs 5med gyad kyi ༄5spyod pa byed pa 'di/ /seng ge'i pags 7pa wa yis gon pa 'dra/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma zla ba'i gdong can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho ye shes chen po mchog gi lam/ /ma bgrod de bzhin nyid kyi sa/ /ma bsgrubs lhan kyis grub pa'i don/ /e ma rnal 'byor skal bar bzang / /gsung ngo // //27—396

mkha' 'gro ma 'bar ma glog gi phreng ba can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/bltas rikyekyis ma mthong nga yi mig /bsam gyis ma dran nga yi sems/ /smras kyis ma brjod nga yi lce/ /bgrod kyang ma phyin nga yi lam/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma shel gyi thor tshugs can gyis rtogs pa brjod pa/thu/ mi bsgom rdurnal ma'i shes pa la/ /dran pas bzung dang ma bzung med/ /mi spyod sgo gsum lhag pa la/ /ched du dgag dang sgrub pa med/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma nyi ma'i rgyal mos rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho rang byung bde chen ye shes 'di/ /ma rtogs smra bar mi nus te/ /rtogs nas brjod du ga la yod—/ /myong ba smra phyemed lkugs pa'i kha/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i mdangs can kyis rtogs pa brjod pa/ kho la ma lta 6nga la ltos/ /nga ni ye shes chen po yin/ /kho ni nga yi sprul pa yin/ /gnyis med ye shes blo las 'das/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma khrag gi gdong pa can gyis rtogs pa — brjod pa/ kye ho dran dang ma dran so mtshams su/ /yid kyi shes pa bsam las 'das/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par gyis/ /gzhan gyis rtogs par 'gyur ma yin/ /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma dpal gyi sgron mes rtogs pa brjod pa/ kye ho gang phyir yid kyi ye shes 'di8/ /khyod kyis bltas pas ji ltar mthong / /brtags pas rtogs par mi 'gyur te/ /mi btsal 9de bzhin nyid du bzhag /gsung ngo // //mkha' 'gro ma snang gsal gyi rgyal mos rtogs pa brjod pa/ 'gro ba las kyi 'jur bus bcings/ /bram ze skud pa 'khal ba bzhin/ /yid kyis 'jur bu 27—397

glod par bya/ /las las shāgrol na 'ching ba med/ /gsung ngo // //ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa lnga'i rtogs pa byebarjod pa mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang mdzod na gnas pa las/ dbyings kyi gtso mo rnams ༄ —kyis bka' bgros nas rje dam pa rgya gar la gnang ba 7zha ma lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o//thu //bsdur mchan/392 shāmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ra /mkha' 'gro ma'i 'byam glu ring mo zhes bya ba gnyis bzhugs so/ / 'u)〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉she 'i/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉skorabyor/ ④tsho〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jung /393 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbu/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 thes/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ rge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagags dang sgrubs—/ 5/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dkyi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masan/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/394 —1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7tha' dang / 2〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thartags/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhes/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / 5〈〈snar 〉phros/ ce〈〈snar 〉ringo / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ༄8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rigasung ngo // //she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamanyug ma don gyis/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/395 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodagye/ 5〈〈snar 〉mtshags/ ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhes/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasregat+ta96 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtsol/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gizad// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par 4〈〈pe 〉snga 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadeng / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉srasags/397 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltas/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi mngon par rtogs pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smrar/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thalta/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bar 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dis/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsal/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ 1ce/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/398 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gikyi gtso mo rnams/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉〉snang ba'o// sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rdzogs sto//27—398

1353༄7/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i 'byam glu zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ḍā ki be+e 3 ta la gī ti nā ma/ bod skad du/mkha' 'gro ma'i 'byam glu zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /u rgyan gyi gnas mkha' 'gro ma'i gling dur khrod chen po rgyu skar dpal gyi rol par mkha' 'gro ma su kha 4ma hā sernyis tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i dus su/ rnal 'byor pa ka ma la shī las 5rang gi de kho na nyid kyi ye shes gnyug ma'i don de rtogs shing khong du chud pa la gdeng 6thob cing / nyams kyi rtsal phyogs med du shar ba'i stobs kyis gnyis med kyi ye shes chen po de mtshon pa tshig gi rta la bskyon te tshogs kyi gral du mgur bzhengs pa las/ ye shes dang las 8las grub pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dgyes te mdun gyi nam mkha' la sprin gyi phung po bzhin du 9 gtibs nas/ rnal 'byor pa la snying gtam gsang tshig tu sbran te mgur bzhengs pa/ kye ho stobs ldan rigs kyi bu/ /yang dag don 27dod400

grub rdo rje'i rtsal/ /sbyangs pa'i las sad skal ba can/ /yon tan dbang phyug gter gyi bdag /dngos grub gnyis kyis brgyan pa'i lus/ /mi yi khyu mchog tshogs kyi rje/ /khyod rgyu yi chos nyid rkyen gyis gsos1/ /sbyangs pa'i las 'phro dum bur 'thung / /yon tan yid bzhin nor bu brnyes/ /'od gsal chen po'i mdangs la gnas/ /sgyu ma tsam du 'gro don mdzad/ /dpe med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /khyod la bskul ba mi 'tshal gyis/ /'on kyang nged kyi glu la nyon/ /spyir skye 'gro byesems can las kyis 'khrul/ /sdug bsngal gyi gnas na longs spyod byed/ /'di ma bzod brtse bas sha la bab/ /da khyod kyi thugs rjes mi dgongs na/ /'gro drug gi pha ma ji ltar byed/ /khyed phan sems skyed byecig rnal 'byor pa/ /lar rig pa'i khye'u 4chung yengs la dga'/ /'khrul pa'i snang ba ltad mo che/ /gzung 'dzin rkun ma 5mgo lo rgod/ /yid gnyis kyi shes pa tsam tsom hūṃmang / /gnyen po'i rngel tshe snying rus chung / /shes bzhin gyi dran pa sgo cha lhod/ /sems nyid kyi nor bu 'chor nyen yod/ /khyod yul la ma yengs rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhi 'gyur med nam mkha'i btsun mo la//nyon mongs dug lnga'i khong sran zhugs/ /gzung 'dzin gyi 'gong po srun dgu gnod—/ /bzang ngan rkyen rtog gi 'khrul phyir 'brang lte/ /chags sdang gi spyod lam ma legs pas/ /gzung 'dzin gyi nad ro gting nas bslang bye/ /rang lus kyi bde ba stor nas 'dug /'khrul pa'i sems can snying re rje/ /khyod 'gro don gyis shig rnal 'byor pa/ /lar yid kyi ye shes co lu chung / /sgo lnga'i brdzun ༄9la nyan nyan nas/ /rigs drug g.yang la bsgyur spunyen gda'/ /khyod gnyis 'dzin shig cig rnal 'byor pa/ /'gyu byed kyi dran rtog 1blo rgod po/ /27—401

kun gzhi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ /ma bcos car nyal mi byed par/ /'dod yon sgyu ma'i slu brid la/ /dug lnga'i grogs dang 'grogs nas rtse/ /yul chags sdang gnyis la yengs pa yis/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang du lhung hūṃnyen yod/ /dbang po sgo lnga'i sgo sdoms la/ /yid kyi khye'u )chung btson du zung / /bde gsal stong pa'i mal du snyol / /khyed yengs su 'gro'o rnal 'byor pa/ /skye rga na 'chi'i thuchu bo la/ /rkyal med kyi blun po rtse la dga'/ /dal 'byor kyi gru bo yod bzhin du/ /rje bla ma'i gnyen snyepa mi bsten par/ /las mi dge'i rba la gtam col 6byed/ /sdug bsngal gyi rba la gnyen pos byol/ /zhen chags kyi 'dam la ma lus par/ /thar pa'i skam sar ci stogs gyis/ /khyod zhe 'dod thang cig rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod pa dug gi sdong po la/ /spang blang gnyis kyi yal ga gyes/ /zhen pa'i lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas/ /rtsol sgrub kyi me tog mkha' la 'phur/ /sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu thur la brul/ /snying med kyi spre'u bsgugs hūṃkyi za/ /'khor ba'i nags su 'chi nyen yod/ /sna tshogs zhen rnged kyi skyes bu yis/ /gdeng 'gyur ba med pa'i mtshon thogs te/ /'dod pa'i sdong po rming nas bsgyel/ /dug lnga'i 'bras bu sngo skams 9 khyer/ /dug 'chi byed kyi nus pa zad par gyis/ /khyod zhe 'dod spongs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /ri dwags sgra rkayis phung ba de/ /snyan grags ched du bsgrubs pas lan/ /bstod smad brag ca lta bu la/ /phyogs 'dzin ma byed rnal 'byor pa/ /glang chen be+egs kyus rkizin pa de/ /rgun chang ro la chags pas len /1/ /'dod yon lan bo'i chu rgod la/ /zhen pa ma che rnal 'byor pa/ /rma bya gud nas shi ba de/ /sru thog rgyan du mthong bas lan/ /'byung bzhi mi gtsang phung po la/ /27—402

rang mthong ma che rnal 'byor pa/ /sbrang ma 'dam du chud pa de/ /bsung can dri la chags pas lan/ /nye du gnas skabs 'byel pa la 1/ /brtse gdung ma byed rnal 'byor pa/ /phye leb me yis tshig pa de/ /zhun mar mdangs la chags pas lan/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i yul snang la/ /der 'dzin ma byed rnal 'byor pa/ /'dab chags snyi rngu la zin pa de/ /'dod yon zas phyir 'brangs pas lan/ /zhen pa be+egs kyu'i kha zas la/ /ltogs 'dod ma byed rnal 'byor pa/ /kun gzhi dag pa'i me long la/ /tshogs drug rig pa'i phyi bdar byas/ /yul drug gsal ba'i gzugs brnyan shar/ /ma rtogs byis pas dngos por gzung / /chags sdang gnyis kyi bde sdug myong / /kun gzhi ma bcos chos kyi dbyings/ /tshogs drug ma 'gags der 'dzin med/ /yul drug gsal la ngo bos stong / /dngos 'dzin byis pa ga chad ngu / /mkhas pa rang snang der 'dzin bral/ /khyod der 'dzin shig cig rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhi ngos gzung rnged pa'i nam mkha' la/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i lho sprin 'thibs/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'brug sgra bsgrags/ /sna tshogs las kyi char rgyun phab/ /zhen chags 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab g.yos/ /'gro drug srug bsngal gyi rtsi thog rgyas/ /lhag mthong rig pa'i nyi ma yis/ /dbyings kyi nyi ma gsal btab ste/ /mnyam rjes dran pa'i skyi 5ser gyis/ /dran rtog gi lho sprin dbyengs su bdas/ /bdag 'dzin kyi 'brug sgra rang sar yal/ /las kyi char rgyun rtsa ba bral/ /zhen 'dzin gyi 'dam rdzab nyi mas bskams/ /rigs drug gi 6sa bon skam la yar/ /snyug bsngal gyi lo tog sngo bskams khyer/ /khyod 7the tshom ma byed rnal 'byor pa/ /mtshan ldan gyi rgyal bu blon pos brkus / /bshes med kyi yul du sprang drir 27—403

'khyams / /lhad dang hral hrul 1 gyi 'tsho ba bsten2/ /rang gzhan gnyis kas ngo ma shes/ /mtshan mkhan gyi bram zes rigs brgyud rtogs/ /blo gos blun po'i bu la dris/ /gnas lugs rig pa'i rje la gtad/ /tshogs gnyis dag pa'i khrus nas bton/ /gdams pa yid bzhin nor bus brgyan/ /rtogs pa rin chen gyi khri la bzhag /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi rgyal sa bzung / /khyod bla ma bsten 4cig rnal 'byor pa/ /rten med yid kyi ri dwags de/ /las dbang bar do'i thang la 'khyams/ /zhen chags smig rgyu'i chu la gdungs/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i mtha' la shi/ /ri lung 5sha khrag rjes kyis bkang / /da rten sked kyi rig pa mkha' la chings/ /tshogs drug gi rkyen kha ma 'grim 9par/ /'od gsal chen po'i thang la rgyug /'dod yon smig rgyu'i chu bo la/ /der 'dzin gyi zhen pa ma byed par/ /zhen 'dod kyi gdung ba nang du chod/ /rigs drug gi rkyen kha ma 'grim par/ /mnyam nyid 7chen po'i dbyings su nyol/ /yid bsam du med pa'i gnyug ma la/ /dran pa g.yeng 8med kyi mda' mkhan gyis / /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bor bsrang / /re dogs gnyis kyi mgo rtsa bregs / /dga' bzhi'i bcas su dril nas kyang / /lhan cig skyes pa'i mde'u bcug /thabs shes rab gnyis kyi ltong btong nge / /skad cig bzhi yi sgro bskyon nas/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i phyogs su 'phangs/ /gti mug phag rgod snying la gzer/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi srog rtsa bcad/ /'khor ba'i gnas su da mi rgyu/ /khyod btsan sa zung shig rnal 'byor pa/ /yul rang snang zhen med du shar ba'i tshe/ /'dod yon lam gyi grogs su 'gro/ /pad+ma'i kha dog 'dam na gsal/ /nyams rkagang dgar skyongs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /27—7/01

chos bden med khong du chud pa'i tshe/ /srog rtsol zung 'jug chen po 1yin/ /glang po'i gser sgrog glod na bde/ /'bad rtsol zhog cig rnal 'byor pa/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i rta pho de/ /gzung 'dzin gyi sgrog tu ma chud par/ /bdag gzhan du 'dzin pa'i srab kha glod/ /phyogs rnged kyi thang la gar bder rgyug2 /nyams shugs byung du rdol ba'i smyon pa de/ /gnyen pos lcags su ma gzhug par/ /tshul 'chos kyi khyim nas sgor phyung la/ /gar bde'i gnas su yan du chug /rtog pa nam mkha'i khyung chen de/ /grub mtha'i gzan la ma chags shing / /'khrul pa'i g.yang la ma byed par/ /phyogs med kyi mkha' 4la lding du chug /'bras bu yid bzhin gyi 5nor bu de/ /re dogs kyi dri ma ma chags shing / /yid smon gyi gling la ma lus par/ /dgos 'dod kyi gsol ba rem la thob/ /'gyur med kyi btsan sa zin nas kyang / /thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs med kyi/ /'gro drug gi pha ma byed pa ru/ /sngon dam bcas go cha gon pa de/ /da dus la bab po sa ma yā/ /zhes gsungs te skul ba chen po'i sgra 7bskal pa'i 'brug bzhin du bsgrags te nam gyi mtha' dang mnyam du mi snang bar dengs so/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i 'byam glu ring mo zhes bya ba sgogs so// //27—405

1354༄ / /phyag rgya chen po rin po che dbang gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra 2rat+na gī ta tsakra nā ma/ bod skad du / phyag rgya chen po rin po che dbang gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser la ra med ka 'ji'i rdo la rtogs par 'gyur/ /'dra man rnams ni tshong 'dus dag tu rgyug par 'gyur/ /gser zol skor zhing 'khor nas gnas po'i lag tu 'bab 4pa yin/ /phra 5men ma ni ma bsten 'gyur te rten 'byel thams cad su yis bsgrigs/ /ded dpon mkhas pa grong dang gling phran tshong spangs rin chen gling nas 9nor bu len/ /phyi bdar byas tshe rgyal mtshan rtse la mchod pas dgos 'dod 'byung / /rin chen gsum ngo shes pa'i ded dpon 'dzam bu'i gling na dkon/ /srang la zhal lce bcol bas che chung rnged par gcod de rtsod 8dang bral/ /'gron po lam zhugs bar gyi grong dang grong khyer ri 9sul bgrod nas don 'grub pa/ /gi ling rta po 27—108

mgyogs kyang lcag gis brabs na de bas mgyogs par 'gyur/ /ltas ngan chen po byed pa'i mi de su yi rigs rgyud 1yin/ /dmigs med tshogs sog 2byed pa rgya mtsho chen po mkhas/ /bya yi tshogs la mda' 'phangs gang la phog pa de dag 'gum / /ri mtsho tsan+dan gsum gyis bya glang sbrul gsum skyabs 'og bcug pa shes lags sam/ /ras yug dkar po tshur nas bton nas tshos ma'i lag tu btang bas gang 'dod 'byung / /mdzub bsgreng srin mjeb nang du mdzub 4mo bcug cing mkha' la bsgreng ba'i don ldan brdar shes bar chad med/ /bung ba khri snyan phyi ba gsum gyis shes rab gsum gyi spyor ba ngo mtshar che/ /'du ba gso byed sman pa'i rgyal po mnyes pa yis/ /rin chen bdun spyor spyi bo gtsug bshal 5btang nas ni/ /sha rus khrag sogs smin cing lus kyi 'byung ba rtas par byed/ /tshangs pa chen po'i gsung dbyangs khyod kyis mnyan 6par gyis/ /seng ge'i 'o ma btsun mos bzhos pa'i bcud mchog ngo mtshar can/ /'di ni gang gis 'thungs dang lce la reg pa tsam gyis ni/ /rtsa grol 7rlung zin thig le dros pa'i nus mthu 'byung / /u ma de ba len pa'i glu de mchog tu snyan pa yin pas gson / /snang ba thob nas dbe+en pa'i sa phyogs der ni rang gi gnas btsal la//rgyan gyis spras shing mdzes ldan bdag med yum gyi zhabs la 'dud/ /gtan gyi bde ba blangs pa nam mkha' rdo rje grong du gzhug /srid pa'i rgyal mo len pa'i glu la yid gtad bya bar rigs/ /rang byung 1 shel gyi mchod rten skyon bral ye nas dag pa la/ /snang srid gsal byed 'phrul gyi me long phyis te blta bar bya/ /mo gsham bu yis bden pa mthong ba'i don de gang yin khyod kyis smros/ /khyab 'jug chen po rang gis blangs pa'i glu la yid brtan byed/ /khrus khang dag na dri 27—409

mas dri ma ma lus dag par byed/ /med bzhin snang ba mkha' la bris pa'i 'ja' ltar gzugs sku rnam gnyis gang zhig yin/ /sbrang rgod zos pa'i rtsa la byen rlabs 1rgyas par byed/ /skyug nad can dang rma dkris gnyis la chags pa'i zhen pa cang gda' 'am/ /dri dang sgog pa g.yer lcem phyed par snang ba gzugs brnyan 'di 'dra rtogs lags sam/ /chu zla bzhin du snang la rang bzhin med pa mig gi rnam shes nyams su myong bas gzigs/ /'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad la sman pa rnams kyis drod tshad 'dzin/ /bshal rjes mi srung rtag tu bsrung ba ma lags sam/ /gnam lcags sa la bab ④na gang la babs pa'i yul de 'jig par byed/ /mkha' la 'brug gi sgra bsgrags dbyar dgun shan 'dang de yis phyed par 'gyur/ /sprul pa'i dge slong mkhas pa 'gro 'chag nyal du ston kyang skyo dub med/ /gser gyi ri la brten pa'i bya yang de yi mdog tu 'gyur/ /snang yang de bzhin spyod pa'i sgyu ma mkhan dang rtag tu 'grogs/ /zhing pa'i lo tog rten 'byel rab tu 'dzom pas 'bras bu ston rnams sdud/ /mchod sdong nyi zla nor bus rtog pa med bzhin 'gro ba'i don la brtson/ /so btang bum par chu bskyed mi 'chag snod kyi bya ba byed/ /ka la piṅka'i sgra bzhin tshangs pa'i gsung gis bag chags sgrib pa 'dag /rlung gi rta del dran pa'i srab kyis mkha' la btags la dbu ma'i 6khyem du gzhug /lo zla 'das pa'i ma bu phrad bzhin nges pa'i shes pa skye/ /nya dang chu las 'byung ba gos su gyon ḍa7pas zhen pa cang gda' 'am/ /me long shel bzhin khong ras gsal stong byas pa med pa lta ba mchog /dngas ma'i chu la bzhin kyi dkyil 'khor gsal dngas phyed par snang / /'gon po lam zhugs nye ring med par phyin nas 'dod pa'i mi dang phrad/ /rgyal 27—410

po'i khrims la 'bangs kyis dam tshig gces ༄1par bsrungs pa legs/ /rma bya'i zas su btsan dug zos pas stobs su 'gyur ba ngo mtshar che/ /rin chen gser de sa la gnas kyang 'od zer mkha' la 'char/ /bag ma bung ba seng ge smyon pa bzhi po spyod pa 'dzol/ /rlung dang yi ge rnam shes gsum po 'grogs la tshangs pa'i mthong lam snyogs/ /sa 'gus mchod sdong btsugs pa'i sa der klu yi 'jigs pa mi bdog go/ /rin po che la rtog pa med kyang gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod 'byung / /mkha' la sprin tshogs 'dus nas char gyis 'gro don mdzad / /rgyal bu rgyal sar bzhag nas 'bangs rnams kun gyis 'khur kyebar byed / /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba'i mun pa'i tshogs la bsdad dbang med mod kying / /nyi zla ngos gzung phyechu bo gyen la zlog pa grangs pas gangs dkar rtse nas zhu ba ngo mtshar che/ /ma ga dha ru rdo rje'i gdan du bsdad pa'i rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku de su yin lo/ /drang srong rnams ni kham gyi zas la ma brten bsam gtan thun gyis 'tsho—/ /rdo rje gdan la dbang po bstan pas nam mkha'i bsgrub bya med par rtogs—/ /myong zhing smra ma nus pa'i bcu drug lon pa'i bde ba su la bslangs/ /mkha' la shar ba'i rgyu skar rnams kyis nam zla dus bzhi'i drod tshad 'dzin/ /bzhin gyi dri ma sel ba'i me long 'di la sgeg mos gces par 'dzin/ /rgyal po'i khang bzangs snedag na btsun mo 'dod yon rtag tu spyod kyang de la zhen pa rnged/ /gang gis 'joms par mi nus pha lam rdzas kyi rdo rje yin/ /drang srong rnams kyis tshe yi rig 'dzin grub pa gang gi stobs las byung / / btsog pa'i chol zangs khya snying po bor nas rin chen snod mdzes tshol ba thabs la mkhas/ /rdo yi skyes bu srin mo'i gling la nyam nga med de gang gi 8 rtog /nam mkha'i mdzod la longs 27—411

spyod nus na dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bral/ /dmyal ba la sogs rigs drug dag la bde gshegs sku gdung 'brul/ /dug la sngags kyis thebs pas 'du ba'i nad rnams thams cad 'joms/ /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba skar ma la sogs snang gzhan zil gyis mnan pas nam mkha'i dkyil ltar mthong / /ka ra ṇa bcings chu yi 'gro 'ong chad nas gzhon nu me long blta zhing nam mkha'i dkyil na 'dug /rab rib mig ser sol ba dung la ser por mthong ba'i 'khrul pa dus der zhig /gshed mas khrid pa'i mi de thar nas dpa' mdzangs de yi lag tu cang 'gro 'am/ /nam mkha' dag pa'i 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa'i gzugs su bris pa gang na med/ /nam zhig mu ge'i dus su bu sha zos kyang de la chags pa cang skye 'am/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten ri1pas yin min rten 'byel thams cad rtogs/ /rdo yi mi la sdom pa dam tshig phog kyang bsrung dang nyams pa'i rig byed med/ /rtog bral ro de gang la mi 'jigs nus mthu su yis byen pa yin/ /dngas pa'i mkha' la gza' dang rgyu skar 'byung ba —shes pa'i drang srong mkhas pa yin / /ri dwags drang srong lta bu gcig pur 'dug pa'i mi des bden pa myur du thob/ /'byung ba gyes pas dngul chu mkha' la 'phur bar gang nas 'ongs/ /rnyog ma'i dri ma can gyi chu la nor bu bcug pa'i stobs kyis dngas par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs be+ems po ltar snang sman dang sman chu stegs dang zam 4pa de mchod kyis / /rtog gred 'byung bas 'gro drug 'dod pa dus su skong 5ba ngo mtshar che/ /rin chen gling du phyin nas sa rdo btsal med ci snyed thams cad rin po che/ /mkha' la sprin gyis 'khrigs na nyi ma'i 'od zer snang ba min/ /gang rdugs dzilam de bsal na chu de 'dod pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /kha brag lam na 'dug pa'i 27— /2

mi de grogs kyi rkyen gyis gar 'go'i cha yang med/ /nor bu rin chen len pa'i tshong pa bsgugs la de dang sbrag /rdo yi mi la rmi lam ci zhig dris kyang lan de 'ong nges med/ /na tsha sdug bsngal che dus rtsa ba de rang yin te thabs gzhan med/ /snang ba'i gzugs rnams sdigs su byung yang de nyid snying rje'i yul te logs na med / /gshog gnyis rgyas pa'i rtsal des nam mkha' gar byas rkyen gnyis dbang du bsdus/ /gangs dkar rtse la nyam nga med pa'i seng ge rtsal gsum sdogs / /sgo gnyis khyem spangs bsam gtan thun gyi zas bsten 1nam mkha' mdzod du byas/ /lce dang mtheb mo gnyis ka brag la seng ge bu dang sbrag /nam zhig 'brug la zhon nas 'jig rten gsal bar byed/ /lan tshu' rgya mtshor chu rnams ro gcig tha dad med/ /rgya mtsho dngas pa'i nang na gza' skar gzugs brnyan snang ba su yis bzhag /byang lta'i phug pas nyi ma ma mthong gang gis len/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu'i nus pa su la blangs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mchog gi brgyud pa las byung ba zab mo'i don to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma'i brda rin po che dbang gi 'khor lo gsal ba zhes bya ba dur khrod rgyu skar dpal gyi rol par gsungs pa rdzogs so // //2 dbang gtso bor bstan pa'o// //27—413

bsdur mchan/4༷8 nye—mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyag rgya chen po rin po che dbang gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba dur khrod rgyu skar dpal gyi rol pas bstan pa bzhugs so// ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dru/ kyetsho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dka'/ ④)〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skorababs/ khyebhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoraphra ༄ 7〈〈co 〉〉na / 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉che/ de 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsod/ ༄rterngo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi/4༷ 9 ( 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brgyud/ — ge〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉sogs/ /rngo/— 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoratheb mdzub 'theb/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradzub/ 5 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bshad/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉snyan/ rdo 7〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉gral/ blu〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉〉gros—/ —9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉panyan/ te 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'byung /41 ༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ phya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbyer/ rdosnesna 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung / ④ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉babs—/ byu3/〈〈snar 〉〉te/ 6༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbul mo'i/ ⑫sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesan/411 1 〈〈snar 〉〉ces/ kye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ska ra/ ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadad/ gye 〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ ༄snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / chokye‘〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazang / dze+e 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsog pa'i chos zang bye)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi/412 ༄rte‘〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharten/ ri bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byeng / 〈〈snar 〉7pa'i/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zab/de 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bskong / she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadugs/41 3 ri1 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉za brten/ ༷ da 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉//27—4 1 4

༄/ /rnal 'byer pa thams cad gyi de kho na nyid snang ba jes bya ba grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i mgur/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga larba tarwa 5u mu tri ā lo ka nā ma bi ka la badz+ra gī ta/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid snang ba zhes bya ba grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i mgur/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu sems can la 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i lam tshogs gnyis las phyir gyur pa med la/ bsod nams tshogs kyi mthar thug ni chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /de bskor ba'i gnas ni skye bos bgrod pa dka' ba'i sa phyogs / 'byung po ro langs rgyu ba'i srang / 'jig rten kyi mi ma yin rgyu ba'i sa / mthong ba tsam gyis bdud ba spu ldang zhing srin po skyi g.ya' ba las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas/ dur khrod chen po brgyad du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams dang / chos nyid skye ba med pa la blo 'byangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams rab tu tshogs nas/ rang rang gi rgyud la don dam pa'i bden 27—4/6

pa 'jug pa'i yul nges pa'i shes pa gang la skyes pa dang / gnyug ma don gyi lhan cig skyes pa rang la gnas pa'i ye shes ngo gang la sprad pa dang / rtog 1pa gang gi sgo nas shar ba de tshogs kyi mchod pa byin gyis rlob pa la nyams myong gi mgur bzhengs ṭ+wāpa/ gnas de dang de na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma su kha ta skal ba 4bzang mo la sogs pa rnams kyis mi bsnyel ba'i gzungs kyis phyi rabs kyi don du yi ge rigs 5su dkar shog la btab pa 'di rnams so/ /dka' thub mthar phyin pa lū yi 6pa'i zhal snga nas/ tshe 'di'i che thabs 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /bya ba ma mang thar lam 'gag /'dod pa'i blo bral bya ba'i yul / /sa phyogs de na byang chub nye/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bde ba'i mdangs ldan ma shrī su kha'i zhal snga nas/ 'jig rten bya ba bdud kyi yul/ /tshe 'di'i blo log 'phags pa'i lam/ /'dod pa'i dug sbrul gtses 7pa yis/ /rjes ni snyug bsngal nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /nor bu gling pa la li ta badz+ra'i zhal snga nas/ ting 'dzin shes rab dri ma sel / /rang rig ye shes 'od gsal sku/ /bde ba thob byed dbang gi lam/ /mngon du gyur tshe rtog pa grol/ /zhes gsung ngo / /'dod chags lam du slong ba mo tsan+d+ra bi ma la'i zhal snga nas/ shes rab rno ngar ting 'dzin gyis/ /ma mthong 'khor ba'i sgog mi chod/ /rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis/ /zag pa bde chen nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /nus pa'i mthar thug bīr+ya 9pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'dam bral pad+ma skam pa bzhin / /dug lnga med na ye shes 'gag /'dod yon lam khyer sa lam 'dums / /spangs nas grol 'dod dman pa'i lam/ /zhes gsung ngo / /27—417

zang zing gi sbyin bdag mo ru ru su ka'i zhal snga nas/ drang srong shes rab mig can gyis/ /nad gzhi lus kyi zungs su bsgyur/ /de bzhin thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /dug lngas ye shes skyed 1par byed/ /ces gsung ngo / /'gro ba'i mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ rmi lam rang bzhin med pa bzhin / /chos rnams rang gi ngo bos stong / /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /don la grub pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsung ngo / /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thugs su chud pa'i dzñā na dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ ngo bos stong pa snang ba'i mtshang / /gang la rang bzhin med pa yi/ /brjod du med pa'i bdag nyid do2/ /zung 'jug ma mthong grol mi nus/ /zhes gsung ngo / /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas/ snga nas ma dran rdo rje'i gdan / /smra bar ma nus yid 'pham sa/ /'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa'i bdag /gnyis snang grol ba phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /rdo rje bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ma a nu ki ra'i zhal snga nas/ dngas ma snang stong rkyen dang bral/ /tshogs drug yul du ma bcad pa'i/ /'gro 'ong med pa gnyug ma'i ngang / /dran brjed mtshams su sems ngal sos/ /zhes gsung ngo / /ri khrod dbang phyug sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas/ 'khrul pa rkyen snang glo bur ba//dus gsum skye 'jig gis stong pa/ /gzhi la ma grub ngo mtshar yul/ /de mthong ba ni grol ba'i yul/ /zhes gsung ngo / /skyabs kyi sbyin bdag mo su ka bha'u'i zhal snga nas/ dran rig rnam par rtog pa ni/ /ma rig pa yi stobs las 'byung / /sna tshogs med shar ngo bos stong / /rtsa bral nam mkha'i rjes thob can/ /zhes gsung ngo / / 27—118

mi las 'das pa ār+ya de ba'i zhal snga nas/ 'od gsal gdod nas dag pa'i ngang / /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /rang gnas rtsa ba 'dus ma byas / /spros bral 'di ni gzigs mor che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor ma bha su ri ka'i zhal snga nas/ kun la khyab pa 'od gsal dang / /'gro 'ong med pa'i bdag nyid can/ /spros bral dus rnams thams cad pa/ /chos sku 'gro ba mi 'dor ro/ /zhes gsung ngo / /smra ba'i seng ge ka la a le ba'i zhal snga nas/ grub mtha'i lta ba ming du brjod / /ming rnams rnam par rtog pa ste/ /de nyid stong pa chos kyi sku/ /ming las grol ba phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ma ka ri dha ri ma'i zhal snga nas/ bde gshegs btsun mo ming med ma/ /nam mkha'i 'o ma rab 'thungs nas/ /smra bsam blo yi yul las 'das/ /gnyis snang za zhing nam mkha' 'jo/ /de mthong bas ni grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /blo gros mi bzad pa shān+ta 1de ba'i zhal snga nas/ tshe 'di'i blo log thar pa'i lam/ /snang phyir ma 'brang 5'khrul pa grol/ /dus gsum chig chog gnad kyi mtshang / /dri med rang snang phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /chos kyi sbyin bdag mo a nu tā ra'i /7zhal snga nas/ go cha 'jig rten pa yi sgog /ma grol 'phags lam zin mi 'gyur/ /de srid bde ba dang mi 'phrad/ /rang snang dag tshe zhing khams 'char/ /zhes gsung ngo / /brtul zhugs mthar ziphyin ḍom+bi pa'i zhal snga nas/ dmigs pas ched du ma bzung 5ba'i/ /shes pa yul las ma 'phros pa/ /bde gsal mi rtog dri ma 27—419

med / /dngas ma yid 'bral phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /'dod pa la blo log pa rnal 'byor ma dzñā na bi ma la'i zhal snga nas/ sgom blo'i 'dun pa dri ma ste/ /rig pa so la bzhag pa yi/ /ma byas shes pa skyon las grol/ /'dzin rtog dmigs pa'i steng du ni/ /spros bral 'char bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung ngo / /shes rab spyan ldan ka ma la'i zhal snga nas/ dngos don rang rig ye shes kyi / /lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams myong ni/ /tshig gi spyod yul ma yin te/ /brda yis mtshon pa seng ge'i gsung dzo/ / zhes gsung ngo / //kye bdag rnged kyi sgra sgrogs ma pad+ma dha nu'i zhal snga nas/ gnyug ma ngo bo nyid kyi gshis/ /blo yi yul na gnas pa min/ /mtshon du yod la ngos gzung bral/ /yang dag bla ma'i brda las rig /ces gsung ngo / /'khrul pa'i sgrog grol ba sgyi na pa'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar chu zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /snang ba'i rang mtshang ngo bos stong / /dngos por 'dzin pa 'khrul pa ste/ /der 'dzin grel bas phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /sdom pa'i tshul khrims can me kha la'i zhal snga nas/ ji ltar dri za'i grong khyer bzhin/ /chos rnams rang bzhin brtags ri na dben/ /bden zad brdzun zad yi ge zad/ /tshig gi lam chad blo las 'das/ /zhes gsung ngo / /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor go rak+ṣa'i zhal snga nas/ rtog 57pa yid bzhin nor bu la / /goms 'dris phyi 5bdar byas pa yis/ /brtan pa thob pa mdog phyin te/ /de tshe dgos 'dod mngon 7du 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /'khor ba'i yid phyung ba mo ku ma la srur+ya'i kyezhal snga nas/ rang snang sprin 27—420

rum ma dngas na/ /dpal gyi be+e'u'i 'od mi gsal/ /rnam rtog rgyang du ma bsrings na/ /ye shes nye ru mi 'dod do/ / zhes gsung ngo / /1rlung la dbang phyug pa tso bo ri ka'i zhal snga nas/ zung 'jug gnas pa'i yi ge ni/ /'gros kyi rnam shes yi ge sel/ /nyams myong gsal bas bdag 'dzin zhig /'di yis nyams kyi 'phen len 'jig /ces gsung ngo / /dpal mi'i seng ge'i spyod pa can u mu ka ri'i zhal snga nas/ bde chen chos dang sprul pa yi/ /'khor lo gsum gyi lte ba la/ /gnas pa'i yi ge bde gshegs kyi/ /ma lus kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /zhes gsung ngo / /brda la rang ngo mthong ba na du ba'i zhal snga nas/ snying gi dbus su ngo sprad pa'ibye / /bla mas bstan pa mchog gi don/ /lhun grub rang ngo shes pa ni/ /gnad de nges pa'i shes pas mthong / /zhes gsung ngo / /dge ba'i chos sdud tshul khrims can bha tsa la'i zhal snga nas/ bzhi rdzogs rang byung thuye shes su/ /tshos ma'i rkyen la rag mi las/ /rang rig 'od gsal dngos po'i gshis/ /rten 'byel gang gi thabs kyis rig /ces gsung ngo / /lung rigs gter gyi dbang phyug ti pa'i zhal snga nas/ bla ma'i gsung gis sdongs pa bsal4/ /de mthong ming gi sde snod la/ /bltas tshe gdams par ma gyur pa'i/ /yi ge gcig kyang bor du med/ /ces gsung ngo / /gsal ba'i mdangs ldan ma karma li ka'i zhal snga nas/ nam mkha' dbyings kyi glegs bam la/ /dkar dmar sna tshogs yi ge rnams/ /rnam rtog 'khrul pa bloyi chos/ /don la glegs bam yi ges stong / /zhes gsung ngo / /bde ba lam khyer thabs la byed pa darnyi pa'i zhal snga nas/ nang gros phyi yi 27—421

rkyen zhu bas/ /rtsol ba ma byas ngang gis su/ /khams 'dus rang la gnas pa yis / /ye shes shar bas las las grol/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bde ba lam du slong ba na ka ra'i zhal snga nas/ rmi lam dbang gis sgo nga ru / /grol lam bskyed rdzogs 'dab gshog rgyas/ /mos gus dad pas sbubs phye bas/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i rgya las gol/ /zhes gsung ngo / /rtog 1pa byin rlabs snyelas shar ba tsa ra'i zhal snga nas/ mchog gi nor bu rin po che/ /snying la bcangs pa'i brtse gdungs gis/ /dpal gyi gter mdzod yongs su 'gengs/ /grogs dag nor bu'i gces 'dzin gyis/ /zhes gsung ngo / /sems can gyi don byed tshul can bhi ka la'i zhal snga nas/ ded dpon med par rgya mtsho yi/ /mchog gi gling don mi 'grub bzhin/ /yon tan du mas rab brgyan kyang / /bla ma med par srid mthar min/ /zhes gsung ngo / /rtog pa shing bzo la shar ba kha ga pa'i zhal snga nas/ dngos rnams sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ /bden med ltos dang 'khrul pa 'jig /'khor ba'i mtshang mthong rang bzhin med/ /spang bya ma rnyed gnyen po stor/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes khong du chud pa mordzu nu ta ri'i zhal snga nas/'khor ba ma grub gzhi yis stong / /myang 'das ma grub blo yis stong / /sa lam ma grub bden pas stong / /'bras bu ma grub yul gyis stong / /zhes gsung ngo / /re dogs kyi dri ma dang bral ba ka na pa'i zhal snga nas/ gzhi med rtsa ba bral ba yis/ /chos rnams gdod 1nas stong pa las/ /'khor ba gang yin myang 'das ci/ /'bras bu ma mthong nyams len grol/ /zhes gsung ngo / /27—122

sems la dmigs pa'i rnal 'byor ma ga da ra'i 3zhal snga nas/ ji ltar chu shing sdong po la/ /nam zhig snying po yod gyur tshe/ /de yi dus su gsal ba las / /'bras bu gzhan du mthong ba min/ /zhes gsung ngo / /ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa ka na ra'i zhal snga nas/ phyi rol lha —yi byin rlabs thu/min/ /nang du rig pa dngas las 'byung / /'dzin pa chad pas nyams myong 'bar/ /rig pa dngas pa'i stobs las ni/ /sgyu rtsal sna tshogs 'char bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa badz+ra sid+dhi'i zhal snga nas/man shel ma dag phyi rol rkyen/ /mi 'jug g.ya' dag ngos der ni/ /sna tshogs dar gyi kha dog len/ /sems pa'i las kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsung ngo / /de kho na nyid snang ba rdo rje'i mgur las ma rig pa sgo nga'i sbubs rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //yi ge lam du 'khyer ba ta ka na'i zhal snga nas/ mtha' bzhi las ni grol ba yi/ /sangs rgyas skye 'gag dri ma bral/ /rnam par rtog med bde gsal dang / /gnyis snang bral ba phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /rtog pa rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma hu lu ka'i zhal snga nas/ gang gis ma bcos ma bslad pa/ /dbyer med dbyengs su gcig pa yi/ /chos kyi jesku yis kun la khyab/ /rnam rtog gis bcings mngon mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bden pa gzigs pa ti zhelo pa'i zhal snga nas/ dran rtog tha mal shes pa ni / /'ching ba mtha' dag nyon mongs 'gyur/ /dran rig ldang rlung bde ba 27—423

bcad / /de tshe shes pa yul mi gso/ /zhes gsung ngo / /chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor pa ma ti la'i zhal snga nas/ lha yi lus kyis tha mal gyi/ /rtog pa yang ni bden par byed/ /rlung gi ngag la bde ba yis/ /yid kyi tha mal shes pa spong / /zhes gsung ngo / /bla ma'i byen rlabs ༄1zhugs pa nā ro pa'i zhal snga nas/ dpal ldan yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /'di med par ni rnyed mi 'gyur/ /mos gus med par byen brlabs la/ /'jug pa'i yul med smin mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /gnod pa byed pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa dang ldan pa karma ka ri'i zhal snga nas/ rang gi don du chos kyi sku/ /gzhan gyi don du gzugs sku gnyis/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten ༄ las byung / /'di med mchog gi dngos grub stor/ /zhes gsung ngo / /nus pa la thugs rjes brgyan pa sa li ༄ pa'i zhal snga nas/ byams pa snying rje byang chub sems/ /'di med byang chub mchog gi lam/ /nam du yang ni phrad mi 'gyur/ /grogs dag gces pa dor mi bya/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bde ba'i gos kyis dros pa ta ra a ling gi zhal snga nas/ phan bde'i sa bon bskrun pa'i gzhi/ /byams pa'i sa gzhi 4snying rje'i chu/ /bdas pa'i ser la byang sems kyi/ /myu gu skye 'gyur gzhan du min/ /zhes gsung ngo / /spros bral sgra 'gros la shar ba tsa ta la'i zhal snga nas/ rno la ngar chags drag po'i mig /gsal dngas phyar bas bying rmugs sel/ /rtog pa chod rjes chos nyid kyis/ /rang ngo rjes kyi shes pa zin/ /zhes gsung ngo / /tshe 'di'i so tshis zhig pa a nu se 5ra'i zhal snga nas/ res gsor rje 6ba 27—(/24

dum bu'i 'grosathu / /lta stangs 'jog 'dor rnam gnyis kyis/ /brjes 2pas nang phrad ngos gzung /༄/bral/ /des ni gnyug ma'i rang ngo mthong / /zhes gsung ngo / /dpa' gdeng lam du khyer ba bhi ta'i zhal snga nas/ lhan cig skyes pa seng ge'i gsang / /smra bsam blo yi yul ma yin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag 'od gsal ngang / /rang rig spros bral phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /zab mo'i chos la bzod pa ru pa ti'i chozhal snga nas/ gnyug ma rang la gnas pa yi/ /ye shes khu ba 'thungs pa'i ros/ /myos pa gyad kyi spyod lam 'dzin / /gdeng ldan 'khor ba'i g.ya' dang bral/ /zhes gsung ngo / /mi'i khyu mchog ta khon ti pa'i zhal snga nas/ sna tshogs rkyen las shar ba yi//snang ba'i chos rnams stong pa las/ /ma 'das rang gi ngo bos dbe+en/ /gnyis med de ni phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsung ngo / /gtsang sme rkyedor ba phag gi spyod pa can bi ga ma'i zhal snga nas/ dngos po sna tshogs sems nyid de / /snang ba las ni gzhan 'gyur ba'i/ /phyi rol don ni yod ma yin/ /chu bo'i mthong snang de yis shes/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bdag nyid chen po a lu ki'i zhal snga nas/ gdol pa'i lag na mtshon thogs bzhin/ / tsan ta )li yi rtog pa 'joms/ /bde gsal pheng gis gzung 8ba yis/ /dri med dngas ma sems la 'phel/ /zhes gsung ngo / /pheng gi sgra sgrog sa ma bhi tu ra'i zhal snga nas/ bung ba'i sgra skad pheng gi dbyangs / /dpal gyi be+e'u'i nang na sgrogs/ /'di yis gzung 9'dzin rtog pa 'joms / /sems pa'i 'od zer yid pham byed/ /ces gsung ngo / /27—425

lta stangs lam du khyer ba la bya de ba'i zhal snga nas/ srid gsum mi g.yo ye shes kyi/ /skye ba'i zhing ni bcing ba'i gdan 1// /phra rags gcod pa ka ra ṇa ⑤/ /dpal gyi rdo rje'i mig las 'khrungs/ /zhes gsung ngo / / go cha'i /④brtson 'grus can su ka ma la'i zhal snga nas/ g.yas su mnyam par bzhag nas ni/ /de yi thugs rjes g.yon du gzung thu / /mdun du rnam par lta ba ni/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /zhes gsung ngo / /mi rtog pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa rat+na a ling gi zhal snga nas/ thabs kyis ma chun shes rab kyis/ /lam mi 'dod de shes rab kyis/ /ma zin thabs kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis 'dzom mkha' lding gshog pa 'dra/ /zhes gsung ngo / /sbyangs pa'i las can ka dha pa'i zhal snga nas/ thabs kyi gzhu la shes rab mda' / /ma bral dad pas bskul ba yi/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags pas/ /dam pa gnyis ni thob par byed/ /ces gsung ngo / /'gyu ba stod ༅la gnon pa ka ma la'i zhal snga nas/ rig pa sor bzhag rgyal sa bye'adzin/ /dar med rlung gis 'phro shergod 'dul/ /shes pa gzengs smad rma bya'i mig /don gyi gnad rig der 'dzin pas/ /dam pa gnyis ni thob par byed/ /ces gsung ngo / /nga rgyal lam du slong ba mo ku ma si ta mo'i zhal snga nas/ mdun du zug pas rtsa ba zin/ /drug pa'i lta stangs rkyen mi g.yo/ /mthong mthong rma byas gzhan snang 'gags/ /shes pa chig tshugs mi rtog lam/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bsod nams kyi tshogs lam du khyer ba'i ḍā ki sa la'i zhal snga nas/ rdul med zhabs la bsnyen bkur ba'i/ /rnam par smin pa skar mda' bzhin/ /ma rig 27—426

mun sel sprin bral lam/ /der ni dpal gyi be'u mthong / /zhes gsung ngo / /sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa bha ri dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ mchog gi nor bu rin po che/ /yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /'khor ba'i rgyun chags rab bcom nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par byed/ /ces gsung ngo / /'khrul pa rkyen thog tu grol ba bha do de ba'i zhal snga nas/ rtog pa thugs ①phrad yul mi dmigs/ /shes pa so mas 'khrul 2pa sel/ /rig pa yul rjes mi 'brang ba'i/ /chig chod ye shes skye ba'i rten/ /zhes gsung ngo / /me long lta bu'i ye shes khong du chud pa mo so ri saṃ gha pa'i zhal snga nas/dran snang chig chod so ma'i rtsal/ /'khrul pa'i snang ba thugs pephrad sel/ /dmigs med rten bral 'dzin pa'i rten/ /rig pa sor bzhag rgyal sa ༄'dzin/ /zhes gsung ngo / /'dod pa'i blo log tan+ta pa'i zhal snga nas/ sgrub sgopa 'dod blo mi zhugs pa'i / /dmigs med 'khor gsum dag pa'i lam/ /'bras bu re ltos bdud kyi yul/ /mchog don spu ris med pas 'grub/ /ces gsung ngo / /sgyu lus kyi rnal 'byor ma kun+dha li'i zhal snga nas/ 'khrul 'khor las dang shing gi mi/ /bya ba rnams la tsu'adod pa med/ /de bzhin 'dod pa'i blo bral ba/ /'dzin sked skyes pa 'phags pa'i lam/ /zhes gsung ngo / /nam mkha' lam du 'khyer 3ba ku ku ri pa'i zhal snga nas/ nam mkha'i bdud rtsi byung ba yis/ /grub mtha'i 'dod pa ji snyed tshim/ /ma bcos rnal ma'i steng du ni/ /rig pa mdung tshugs 'dzin rtog grol/ /zhes gsung ngo / /yongs su mthar phyin pa'i brtson 'grus can badz+ra bi ma la'i zhal snga nas/27—427

shes pa tha mal yul mi dmigs/ /gnyug ma'i ngo bo 'dzin rtog med/ /zhen med rang grol ngo bo gshis/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gzigs mo sa/ /zhes gsung ngo / /rnal 'byor pa su ka dha nu'i zhal snga nas/ 'gon bu'i spyan gyis dri med 'dzin / /snang ba gcud ༄1la bor ba yis/ /rang nyid nyams myong 'gyur med gsal / /ngo bo mthong tshe rang snang gol/ /zhes gsung ngo / /'od gsal rang ngo phrad pa dharma bha dra'i zhal snga nas/ sems nyid 'od gsal dngos po'i don/ /rang bzhin ngo bos sangs rgyas rgyu/ /dmigs med gdod nas dag pa yi/ /ye shes de mthong ma rig sel/ /zhes gsung ngo / /du ma ro gcig gi rnal 'byor pa bha ta li'i zhal snga nas/ ngo bo spros bral dri ma med/ /'gro ba kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /shel gong 3'dam gyis gos pa bzhin/ /glo bur 'khrul pa'i rtog pas 'gribs/ /zhes gsung ngo / /mnyam gzhag dngas pa ma ti pa'i zhal snga nas/ snying gi dbus su dran pa'i gling / /pha wang mig gis rab tu 'dzin/ /yul snang mi dmigs phra rags 'gags / /ma bcos rang lugs spros bral lam/ /zhes gsung ngo / /yon tan mngon par grub pa'i bsam gtan dang ldan pa ma a re ta la'i zhal snga nas/ ka ra ṇa 4bcings lcags sgrog gis/ /srid pa gsum po g.yo mi 'gyur / /rgyal po btson du bzung thub yis/ /'bangs rnams 'phra bar mi nus so/ /zhes gsung ngo / /yul snang sgyu mar ngos zin pa a bhi ta'i zhal snga nas/ rus sbal mig gis rnam rtog bcad/ /de dus chos rnams nam mkha'i ngang / /rjes thob yul snang rang bzhin med/ /bden med mthong bas 'khrul pa grol/ /zhes gsung ngo / /27—128

ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho ba'i rnal 'byor ma tsaṇ+ḍa 1bi ma la'i zhal snga nas/gyen gyi lta stangs tshangs pa'i gsang / /dbang po rang snang phyag rgya che/ /chos nyid ngo bo thabs kyis zin/ /spros bral 'char ba yi ge'i gnad/ /ces gsung ngo / /gzhan don la bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba sa ha la'i zhal snga nas/ pha dang ma ru ma gyur pa'i/ /srid pa gsum na sems can med/ /bde med 'khor bar gnas pa la/ /snying rje mi skye thrun pa yin/ /zhes gsung ngo / /bsgrub pa lhur 'dzin mo ru ru su ka'i zhal snga nas/ spros bral 'char ba gsang 2gi gnad/ /'phags lam gzhung ni byang chub sems/ /gzhan don lhur blangs rang don rdzogs/ /'di la dngos grub nye bar gnas/ /zhes gsung ngo / /rtsa rlung las su rung ba ni la pa'i zhal snga nas/ dran rtog 'od gsal la bcings pas/ /rang rig ye shes lnga yi mdangs/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' yi//snang ba rgyu lam 'bras bu'i rtags/ /zhes gsung ngo / /mi g.yo ba'i bsam gtan dzñā na dha ra'i zhal snga nas/ dngas ma'i 'od zer du bar snang / /smig rgyu ltar snang bde ba'i 'od/ /gsal ba srin bu me khyer 'ong / /mi rtog 'od zer mkha' ltar snang / /zhes gsung ngo / /de kho na nyid rab tu snang ba rdo rje'i mgur las gser gyi nyi ma rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag in+d+ra byu ti'i zhal snga nas/ 'dod chags kyis ni bde ba 'dzin/ /zhe sdang gis ni gsal ba spor/ /gti mug 27—129

gis ni mi rtog 'bebs/ /nga rgyal phrag dog yon tan rgyu/ /zhes gsung ngo / /lha'i rgyal po de ba ra mi'i zhal snga nas/ grong khyer rnams kyi mi gtsang lud/ /zhing la 'bru rnams skyed tshosnapar byed/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor rgyud la ni/ /nyon mongs kyis ni ye shes 'phel/ /snang ba rang grol de ltos dang / /zhes gsung ngo / /gsang spyod mthar phyin me go ba'i zhal snga nas/ mchog gi dngos grub sbas pa'i lam/ /ma gsangs tsobagegs chen skye bar 'gyur/ /gang 'dir mngon sum med pa'i gzugs/ /rtogs pa gong du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /nyin mtshan med pa ce spyang gi spyod pa can a nu shrī'i zhal snga nas/ lha yi thig le ma bstan par/ /phyag rgya'i 'od zer phyir mi spro/ /rigs ngan gdol pa'i spyod lam gyis / /bdud rtsi 'thungs na bcud du 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /na ba la rtog pa shar ba ko ta ri tog tse pa'i zhal snga nas/ rtog pa spang bar mi bya'o/ /mi mthun lam du bslang ba 4yis/ /'gal ba'i rkyen rnams grogs su 'char/ /thabs 'dis gnyen po'i bya ba stor/ /zhes gsung ngo / /e waṃ gi glu len pa de ba su kha'i phyazhal snga nas/ ji ltar nags la mched pa'i me/ /rlung gis rab tu spor ba ltar/ /brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /de tshe rkyen ngan grogs su 'gyur/ /zhes gsung ngo / /sems can don byed kyi bsam gtan dang ldan pa dha ra ni'i zhal snga nas/yid kyi yul du gyur pa yi/ /blo snang ri mo subs pa'i rjes/ /dran pas ma gos spu ris bral/ /dngas ma'i ye shes 'char ba'i sa/ /zhes gsung ngo / /dus skad cig mas 'das par 9rtogs pa shar ba dzā 7lan+dha ra'i zhal snga nas/mi rtog spros bral 'dus ma byas/ /rang bzhin med pas skye 'gag bral/ /27—430

gnyis snang grol ba'i de nyid ni/ /gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang / /zhes gsung ngo / /dga' ba'i mdangs ldan ma bi ka su ra'i kyizhal snga nas/ ma bcos shes rab 'byung ba'i sa/ /gnyis snang rkyen dang bral ba'i dbus/ /mtshan ma rang sar grol ba de/ /dran brjed mtshams su ma bu phrad/ /ces gsung ngo ༄ / /bya ba'i rnal 'byor pa rā hu la'i zhal snga nas/ dngos rnams sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te/ /phug khrus tshe 'di'i mngon zhen 4bzlog /bden 'dzin grol ba 'khrul lam chad/ /des ni ye shes 'bar bar byed/ /ces gsung ngo / /phrag phyadog lam du slong ba mo dza ki ri'i zhal snga nas/ ngal ba don med tshe 'di'i ched/ /rtsol sgrub tshi chad sdug bsngal rgyu/ /don dam spyod lam ma spangs pa'i/ /'khrul pa bzlog 6par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung ngo / /'ching ba las grol ba dharma 7pa'i zhal snga nas/ chos rnams ngo bo gzhi rtsa bral / /gnyug ma rang ngo rtog pa yis/ /'dam gyis ma gos dngas pa'i ngang /gnas lugs snang stong rkyen dang bral/ /ces gsung ngo / /thos pa shes rab can dzo ki a ling gi zhal snga nas/ sna tshogs rang bzhin med pa'i gshis/ /der ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum mnyam/ /snang ba med pa'i chos nyid ni/ /de ni snang ba rang gis bstan/ /zhes gsung ngo / /thugs rje'i rgyan dang ldan pa gser gling pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster ba yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra byang chub sems/ /sangs rgyas ma bcos lhun grub sku/ /'gro ba kun la rang bzhin gnas/ /zhes gsung ngo / /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes khong du chud pa pad+ma bi ma la'i zhal snga nas/27—431
