1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs kyi brgyud/ 〈〈pe 〉〉re'i/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ra'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesad/27— 4 8 /

༄༅/ /phyag rgya chen po gser phreng jes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra ka na ka mā le nā ma/ bod skad du/phyag rgya chen po gser phreng zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyon shing me tog 'dab rgyas 'bras bu mngar mang zhing / /chos ldan rgyal pos stong gsum zhi 7dul rgyan gyis mdzes/ /nam mkha' nyi zla'i gar dang rgyu skar gar dang bcas/ /klu rgyal spyi bo nor bu rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /mdzes ldan yid 'phrog skyes bu mu tig phra yis spras/ /mtshan ldan sangs rgyas lha mi 'khor gyi tshogs na gsal/ /nor bu rin chen yon tan mang ldan yang / /ded dpon dang bral rgya mtshor bgrod mi nus/ /thos mang sde snod yon tan kun ldan pas1/ /byin rlabs dang bral skye rnged don mi rtogs/ /dbyar gyi dus na sngo rnams skye 'gyur kyang / /zhing la ma btab lo tog 'byung min ltar/ /'go drug sems can sangs rgyas rang bzhin yang / /ma bsgoms rnam grol ye 27—483

shes don mi mthong / /mig yor the tshom lam gyi 'drul chad de/ /'dod pa'i yul du phyin par 'gyur min ltar/ /yid ches ma gyur the tshom blo can gyis/ /bde chen byang chub go 'phang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /bsgom dang mi bsgom rtog pa blo yi yul / /bsgom min snyam bral yengs su med pa'i sa/ /yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /kye ho bya bral skye med blo las 'das/ /gsal stong 'od rig chos nyid ye shes sgon/ /bde stong zag med bde chen rgyal po la/ /snang stong rtog med chos nyid spyan pa yis/ /e ma ngo mtshar chos nyid bden pa mthong / /sgyu ma 'od gsal chos skur 1'od drang zhing / /sgyu lus 'od gsal chos sku'i snang ba zung 2/ /gnyis med lhan skyes chos nyid mjal phrad kyis/ /kye ma bla ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas / / nā ga sa ra tsar ya 4pa/ /sa wa sa ra ka ma ya//shārnyi bhu su bi rū zhepa/ /sde 6ki u na mi na pa/ /pu be+e tsa tra bha tra pa/ /ār+ya me ka ka ru pa/ /ra bi di to kon+ta nili/ /bha ga bi ra ni lo pa'i/ /kabe+e ko ki a na ha3/ /tsan+dha kyesarba ko ha li/ /bha de ka na kam+bha li/ /ḍom+bi ⑫te ru dā ri ka/kṛṣ+ṭa nā ga pra bhā ka /ku ku tsa nu ghaspyo 1rtapa// //gang gis ma lte/rtogs rtogs 1ne+epa'i spyod pa mi bya ste/ /byas na rgyal po'i khrims la dmangs kyis gnod pa bzhin/ /rtogs pa rnams kyis ma rtogs spyod pa mi bya ste/ /byas na glang chen brtan pa 'dam du tshud pa bzhin/ /kye ho grogs dag lhan cig skyes pa de/ /gzhan nas mi rnyed bla ma'i zhal la dris/ /don dam zhal gyi ngo bo de rtogs na/ /yid ni 'chi med rlung yang chad pa med/ /chos nyid 'od gsal bde chen gyi/ /zag med mya ngan 'das kyi sku/ /gang gis ma rtogs rtogs med lam/ /bstan par mi nus snying po'i mchog /27—7 84

—bdag lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thar lam srog gcod phyi nang gi/ /rdul sped rdul tshon la sogs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'bad rtsol ci yang rnged/ /bde stong gnyis med nyams myong bla ma yi/ /byen rlabs sgron ma chos nyid rang byung la/ /ma rtogs mi rtogs bsgom du med pa la/ /'di dang 'di zhes smrar sked lkugs par spyod/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gar yang ni/ /mi 'go skye med gnyug ma'i lam/ /chos nyid byang chub chos sgu yi/ /nyi ma ma rig mun dang bral / /rus sbal lta bur 'khor ba yi/ /skyon gyis ma gos gdod nas dag /sgon ma mun bral bla ma yi/ /drin gyis ye shes nyi ma 'deshe/ /ma blta bltas pas mthong ba med/ /ma rtogs grertog dpyod yul min gyis/ /ma sems bsam du ci yang med/ /ma re re dogs yul las 'das/ /bltas pas mthong ba'i yul mi phyin/ /bsgom pa bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /chos nyid don mthong ci yang ni//mi sems ngos gzung med par grol/ /bya ba btang ba'i skyes bu la/ /bya bral byar sked gzung ④'dzin med/ /re dogs dang bral nyams len la/ /mi rtog bsgom du ci yang med/ /e ma ngo mtshar chos nyid bden pa mthong e ma byen rlabs zhenyams myong sgron ma 'bar/ /e ma bla ma'i dad gus yengs pa med//e ma 'bras bu rang gsal byin rlabs 6gsal/ /rang rig gdod ma ma skyes pa//stong pa ma bcos lhan gyis grub/ /sems nyid rang rig rang gsal gyi/ /nor bu gsal dngas go ma 7'gags/ /bsgom dang mi bsgom rtog bcas kyis/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rnyed mi 'gyur/ /bsgom med yengs su med pa la/ /ma bcos yengs med lhug pa nyid/ /rang rig lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /chos nyid bde chen smrar med la/ /bdag gzhan bde sdug blo las 'das/ /chos nyid 27—485

bden mthong chos sku'i klong / /rang rig rang gis rtogs pa la/ /chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin/ /sangs rgyas sems can 'khor 'das dag /spang blang tha dad ci yang med/ /dug gsum rang grol chos kyi sgron ma yi/ /rtsa rlung bde stong gnyis med la/ /tha mal rnam rtog dngos por 'dzin pa yi/ /chags sdang mdud pa rang sar gzung 1'dzin grol/ /ye shes lus can chos nyid gsal dngas la/ /mtha' bral brten med dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul 'khrul gzhi 'khrul pa yi/ /rtsa ba skye med bya bral ngang du chad//'ja' tshon lta bu sgyu ma'i sgu/ /dam tshig phyag rgya zhen med kyi/ /dbang po rang snang thugs phrad kyis/ /chos nyid bden pa mthong ba yin/ /zag med bde chen chos nyid nyi ma yi/ /las kyi phyag rgya chos nyid ye shes sgron/ /skye med byang chub kun rtog bral ba yi/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bde chen klong du sad/ /bdag lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos kyis ni/ /phyag rgya rtsa rlung byang chub sems/ /gnyug ma dmigs su ci yang med/ /sems nyid bde stong chos nyid kyi/ /don rtogs phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /dmigs bya dmigs byed dmigs med la/ /ci yang bsam du med pa nyid/ /bdag med seng ge'i sgra sgrogs kyis/ /stong nyid ting 'dzin sgron ma yis/ /bde sbug rtag chad la sogs kyi/ /sgrib pa ma lus sel bar byed/ /dge dang mi dge'i las rnams ni/ /'dzin med gnyug ma'i ngang du yal/ /chos nyid bde ba chen po'i sku/ /rang rig gnyis med ngang du 'phrod/ /pi wang sgra bzhin dam tshig gi//sgron ma bral na bde med phyir/ /dam tshig nyi ma ye shes kyi/ /nyi ma chos nyid nyi ma mthong / /dbang bzhi bgod pas lam bzhi mthong / /sku bzhi phyag rgya 27—7/86

bzhi ru grol/ /thabs ldan zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku/ /bdag lus rgyal ba'i ngang du rdzogs/ /bag chags ye shes rang grol la/ /rtag chad spang blang sgro skur ci yang med/ /gdod nas dag pa chos nyid gnyug ma la/ /sgrib byed byeng rgod re dogs ci yang med/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rang rig 'od gsal la/ /dran pas gzung dang gzung ༄1'dzin ci yang med/ /nyon mongs rang dngas rnam rtog chos sgu la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas btsal du ci yang med/ /gser 'gyur rtsi ltar khams gsum nyid/ /bde chen chos nyid rol gang pa/ /don dam 'khor ba kun sgob dag /mtha' bral chos nyid dbu ma'i lam/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang rtog pa yi/ / rme sha gzung 2'dzin 'khor ba'i chos/ /'khrul pas bde chen mthong ba med/ /ma mthong rnal 'byor de mi rnyed/ /tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad/ /tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /brtags pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu/ /bsgom du med pas gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /phyag rgya chen po rang la lhun gyis grub pa ste/ /mi bsam mi rig 'bad pa sked pa'i ngang la zhog /chad pa med de sngon du nyams myong rang gis myong / /rtag par mi 'gyur mngon zhen med pa zung du 'jug /shing rta'i 'khor lo gnyis dang mi ldan gar yang 'gro bar mi nus ltar/ /sbyin sogs 'bad pa byas kyang bla ma mi ldan dngos grub dam pa min/ /bya rgod rtsal rdzogs 'dab mar bcas pa dag gis nam mkha' gcod cing rgyu/ /skal bzang rnams ni dbang dang byen rlabs 4gdams pa khong du chud 5pas bde/ /rgya mtsho zab cing rgya che dag gi nang na nor bus gang ba la/ /klu yi rgyal po rnams kyis mnga' mdzad gang yin de ni ngo mtshar che/ /snang grag thams cad ye nas chos sku 'gyur med 27—487

yin pa la/ /rtogs dang nyams myong ldan pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis longs spyod ngo mtshar che/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi nus pa yis/ /lcags rnams gser du bsgyur ba ltar/ /rin chen dbang gi nus pa yis/ /nyon mongs ye shes gnyis med bsgyur/ /rtog 7pa yid bzhin nor bu la/ /nyams su myong ba'i mdog phyung bas/ /spyod pa'i nus pas dgos 'dod 'byung / /ro snyoms ldan pa rnams kyis 'grub/ /rang la bde chen yod kyang ma rtogs 'khrul pas bsgribs/ /de bsal 'dod pas bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags 2bya/ /tshogs gnyis ma bsags bskal pa brgya ru 'bad byas kyang / /bla ma mi ldan bde ba chen po rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo gcig /de yi rang bzhin rang gi d+ngha sems/ /rtogs par 'dod na ji bzhin zhog /goms par byas na mngon sum 'gyur/ /bla ma dag las dang por thurang gi sems rtogs bya/ /de nas chos rnams kun dang tha dad med byas la/ /gnyis med rtogs shing dur khrod gnas su 'dug nas ni/ /nyams rtogs smyon pa'i brtul zhugs ngang gis spyad / /rta dang glang po rgya mtsho 'dra na mnyam nyid bde/ /spre'u'i ltachu yi ri mo bris pa 'dra na spros par 'gyur/ /chu bo nyi ma sman dang 'dra na dbyer mi phyed//gtsug phud dmigs dang 'khor los sgyur rgyal lta bu 'thob/ /sa la gnas pa kun kyang skal ba bzang / /rgya mtsho'i gting du phyin na dbul dang bral/ /ral gri lag na thogs na longs spyod che/ /phyogs med sa la phyin na gnyen dang phrad / /sems ma gdungs na lta ba che/ /zhen pa med na ro stoms yin/ /'bad pa bral na bsgom pa'i mchog /gnyis snang bral na rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /la la ra sa dhū tī gsum/ /rang byin zlob cing bcing bar bya/ /bla ma 27—7/88

sems dang snang ba gsum/ /rtogs pa bskyed phyir bsten par bya/ /phyag rgya chen po gser phreng las tshogs 'khor dang po byin rlabs shugs 'byung 1gi le'u ste dang po'o// // lā yi dzā lan birlu 5pa/ /ka ma in+d+ra kha ra bha/ /be+e — —ku na tha gho ra kha/ /to ka bhe ṇi bi na si/ /ghu na an dzo kan tha ri/ /dha bu ta pa bo te le/ /o tra sa ka ni tra 4yi/ /kaska sa na ga na si/ /tsa ba su ku si ya li/ /su ta dharmā saku ru na/ /rā 3/hu ku su ku ma dri/ /la kha dha kha pa ra pu/ /sgo ka thube+e ḍa ṇi ra pa / /tsa ma dha kha snying po pa// //khyi rgod mi srun sna la sbrang rtsi bskus na phyogs rnams kun du za bar byed/ /blo dman skal ba med pa'i gang zag dag la gdams pa byin na rang rgyud sreg /glang chen brtan la dpa' ba'i sna la ral gri bskur dz+wan dgra dpung thams cad 'joms / /skal bzang blo ldan skye med rtogs pa'i snang ba thugs / phrad dag gis rnam rtog 'joms/ /skye med rtogs kyang nyams su myong bral na/ /de yang srin po'i lag na bu khyer 'dra/ /nyams su myong yang gnas lugs ma rtogs na/ /glang chen sna la lcags kyu rgyab —pa 'dra/ /sangs rgyas mchod sogs rnams la don mi 'byung / /'dod dang rtsol ba yod na sangs mi rgyate / /byin rlabs 7bla ma'i ngang gis nyams myong 'phel/ /blo yi cha la yin gyi 1 don ma yin/ /gang yang ma lta dbus su ltos/ /mchog dang dga' bral bde ba che/ /sngags rigs gsang ba ston spyod nas/ /rnal 'byor rtags kyis bsgyur bar bya/ /dus kyi sna rtse bdag byin brlab saldan na/ /phyi dang nang gi spyod pa dag gis sangs mi rgya/ /27—489

bde ba rab rgyas snang ba dag dang khyad med na/ /zhen pa btang bas nyams myong mchog thob 'gyur/ /rje btsun dam pa brten /kyin de nyid mthong / /nags tshal mthongs su bsgoms na dben pa 'thob/ /chos rnams sems su rtogs na mi mthun med/ /nam mkha'i 'o ma 'thungs na tshim par 'gyur/ /bde dang stong pa mtha' bral nyid rtogs na/ /dpag bsam shing rten pa yis mnyan byas te/ /mtsho la ༄ skyes bu rgyal bas 'go shes na/ /bram ze pa dang ma las bu skye 'gyur/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /gzung —'dzin chags sdang rang sar chad/ /rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhen med kyis/ /nyams myong gsal snang go ma 'gags/ /gsal lo gsal lo bde chen gyi/ /bla ma byang chub lam mkhan gsal / /gnyis med chos nyid gsal dngas kyi/ /nyams myong gnyug ma'i ngang du gsal/ /bde'o bla ma bde chen bde/ /bde bar mi 'dzin cir yang mi rtog bde/ /gzung 5'dzin rang grol 'dzin pa rang dngas bde/ /bya bral skyes bu byar med blo 'das bde/ /stong ngo stong ngo tha mal lus/ /sgyu lus zhen med dbyengs su stong / /zung 'jug skye med ngang du stong / /rang rig lhan skyes sku ru stong / /rig go rig go rang gi sems/ /cir yang mi 'dzin rtog med rig /gar yang mi dpyod 6smra med rig /rtog dpyod 7/yul las 'das par rig /mi rtog rtog med rtog dpyod 8yul las 'das/ /mi sems bsam med bsam du ci yang med/ /rten dang rten 9med 'go 'ong gnas dang bral/ /'khor 'das bde sdug bde chen klong du sad/ /ma bcos yengs med rang bzhin lhug pa la/ /sems byung rgyun chad 'od gsal 'gro 'ong bral/ /snang ba smrar med slob dbon yang su med/ /chos nyid rang gsal rig pa chos skur 27—490

—'phrod / /sems nyid ma mthong ci yang med/ /da lta bltar med bstan du med / /ma yengs yengs rnged yengs su med/ /bsgom med bsgom du med pa yin / /bral lo bral lo 'khor 'das bral/ /bde chen chos nyid klong du bral//rig pa smrar med ngang du grol/ /bsgom pa zhen med dbyings su bral/ /bya ba byar med skam sar gnas/ /e ma chos nyid chos nyid mthong / /kye ma sangs rgyas kye sangs rgyas/ /kye ho byang chub go 'phang thob e ma ngo mtshar 'chi rgyu med / /snang srid mi bden gdod nas brdzun/ /dgra zun ye med 1'khrul snang yin/ /byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal dang / /chags sdang bral na sangs rgyas yin/ /byas pa thams cad don med snyug bsngal rgyu/ /byar sked bde'o rnal 'byor rtsol med bde/ /ci la bsams kyang dgos 'dod mi 'byung bas/ /bsam du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang la bde/ /sems nyid bde chen thig le'i sku/ /bde stong dbyer sked sems kyi rgyun/ /nam mkha' lta bur brjod med kyis/ /chos nyid bltar med bstan du med/ /e ma ngo mtshar bla ma'i sku/ /stong nyid spros bral rtog med dang / /snang stong dbyer med stong pa'i dbyings/ /chos sku skye med rgyun du ldan/ /snang sems sangs rgyas sems can dag /nyi ma dang ni 'od bzhin du/ /spang thob las grol zhe 'dod med/ /gang la med pa de sangs rgyas/ /shes bya snang la rang bzhin bral/ /shes pa gsal la rtog med de/ /sems nyid bde chen zag med la/ /yengs med bsgom du ci yang med/ /sems nyid bla ma sangs rgyas sku/ /snang sems 'dus byas dge ba'i gzhi/ /chos sku ngan song ting 'dzin lam/ /nga rgyal gnyis sked byang sems ldan/ /chos nyid ma bcos 'khor ba yi/ /thog mtha' re dogs 27—491

snyam 1dang bral/ /bsgom bya sgom byed blang dor spangs/ /'bras bu rang gsal rang gi mchog /rang rig lhan cig skyes kyi sku/ /ngo bo rig pa rang gsal gyi/ /'gro drug sangs rgyas snying po la/ /dam tshig rtog med rgyan dang ldan / /snang sems chos nyid chos kyi ni/ /sku can mnyam bral rtog med kyi/ /dag pa'i sgyu lus byang chub lam/ /zung 'jug skye med bde 'gro'i rgyan/ /snang sems rang rig bde chen spros dang bral/ /sgyu ma rtsa rlung rlung sems brjod du med / /rmi lam 'od gsal bde chen zung 'jug la/ /sku bzhi 2ye shes gsal snang go ma 'gags/ /bltar med blta ru med pa yi/ /rang sems rnam dag bla mar snang / /snang ba stong pa bde chen sku/ /bde stong dbyer med byin rlabs rgyan/ /sems nyid bltar 4med blo 'das kyi/ /rtsa ni gsal stong mkha' 'gro'i gsang / /snang ba stong nyid bde chen sku/ /snang stong dbyer med mkha' 'gro'i rgyan/ /bya bral rtog 5med rlung sems kyi/ /snang ba stong pa spros dang bral/ /stong nyid bde chen brjod du med/ /bde stong mtha' bral rlung gi rgyan / /rang sems bde chen byang chub sems/ /zag med bde chen chos kyi sku / /snang ba 'od gsal stong pa'i klong / /bde stong ye shes byang chub rgyan/ /k+ṣiṃng ba rmi lam bden pas stong / /gzung 'dzin chags sdang 'khrul snang yul/ / brtags pas 6chu shing snying po med/ /zhen med gang snang lam gyi rgyan/ /gang nas ma 'ongs gar yang ni/ /mi 'gro mi rtog sems nyid la/ /bltar med bstan du med pa yi/ /chos nyid ngo bo mthong gi rgyan/ /'khor ba sbug bsngal bde med kyang / /bla ma'i byen rlabs 7ngo sprod lam/ /bying rgod bsgom pa nyams kyi dgra/ /rang rig 'od gsal mthong gi rgyan/ /nyams myong bya bral 27—(/92

khro 'das kyi/ /bsgom pa dmigs brtags bzung 'dzin bral/ /cir yang rtog med lhun grub la/ /re dogs dgag sgrub 1rang grol rgyan/ /ye shes lus can stong pa nyid/ /snying rje rgyan ldan byang chub 2lam/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med phyir/ /bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i sku/ /bde'o shugs 'byung zhen med kyi/ /blo 'das nyams myong gnyug ma'i lam5—/ /bsgom med yengs su med pa yi/ /chos nyid ye shes rgyan ldan bde/ /gang yang mi rtog cir mi sems—/ /cir yang mi 'dzin rtog dpyod bral/ /byar med rig pa dang gsal ba/ /bcas bcos mi bya rang grol rgyan/ /bde'o ci bder rtog med nyams / /stong ngo chos 5nyid blo 'das dang / /spyod do ro snyoms shugs 'byung 4/lam/ /grol lo re dogs rang grol rgyan/ /cir yang med do snang srid yul / /gar yang stong ngo ngos 'dzin sems/ /rtog dpyod med do 'khor 'das lam/ /mi bsgom mi dpyad gnyug ma'i rgyan/ /chu rgyun gnas pa'i nyams bstan na/ /spyod pa bags kyis 'gro bar bya/ /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis/ /chags sdang rtog pa zhi bar byed/ /phyag rgya chen po gser phreng las tshogs 'khor gnyis pa sgom dz+wadon nyams kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// // ti lo nā ཿro bha su tra/ /gos can dhū tī ra ma ya/ /spyod pa ra tri dze+e tri pa / /sgo ta legs sbyin pad+mo (zhabs/ /badz+ra dharma dzo ki ni/ /kaṇ+ḍi r+ṣame kha ma hā la/ /ri /1ri rang ga ⑫ka so ri/ /'bar ba tsin+dha bi rū pa/ /dzñā na badz+ra ske dha pa/ /ḍo bi bha ta ri bo pa/ /ka ma kri ta pradzñā ru/ /badz+ra ka na na ma se/ /ho ra si ti ka ra na/ /bhū ṇati ta ma ta bra saman// //27—493

ri rab gser gyi ngos la bya gnas pa/ /bya yi rang bzhin bor nas gser du snang / /mkhas pa dag gis skye ba med rtogs na/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin bor nas bde ba che/ /bdag nyid gdod ma nyid nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /rnam rtog dbang gis sangs rgyas nyid ni ngas ma mthong / /rtogs pa'i dus na mthong ba med de thos pa med/ /gnyis med gang gis rtogs pa de ni phyag rgya che/ /byis pa chung ngu ma yis gsos pas stobs dang ldan pa bzhin/ /blo chung dag kyang bla ma'i gdams par rim gyis theg pa che/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad kun sman gyi nus pas sel ba ltar/ /nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nad rab thams cad bla ma'i gdams pas bsreg1 /long ba'i tshogs kun mig ldan gyis / /skyes bus 'khrid par byed pa ltar/ /ye shes lam ston —bla ma yi/ /spyan pas byang chub 'khrid par byed/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal dpung gi tshogs/ /gling rnams kun la dbang byed bzhin/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ro rnyed nas/ /'khor ba dbang sgyur bde ba che/ /rigs ldan rigs mchog rigs kyi dbang / /bla ma mkha' 'go chos nyid grogs/ /lta spyod bsgom don lhan cig skyes/ /dpe don ye shes bden pa mthong / /las can rnal 'byor dbang gi lam/ /sku gsum chos nyid 'od gsal rnge4/ /sems nyid gsal dngas sgyu ma'i sku/ /rnal grol phyag rgya zung du 'jug /'gro drug skyes pa sdom gsum rgyan/ /lta bsgom 5spyod pa zhen med skas/ /rang lus bde chen ngo bor rig /dgag sgrub spang blang nyams dang bral/ /re dogs rang gsal bla ma'i drin/ /bdag ma rtogs pa'i gong nas 'bras chan dag dang ro 'di khyad par che/ /rtogs nas mngar ba'i 'bras chan dag dang 6rul ba'i ro 'di khyad par med/ /de bzhin 27—/91

ma rtogs dus na 'khor ba dag dang sangs rgyas tha dad brtags/ /rtogs pa'i dus na 'khor ba dag ni ye nas sangs rgyas chen po'i sku/ /bya ba btang na man ngag yin/ /zhe 'dod med na rtogs pa yin/ /bde ba dngos med bsgom pa yin/ /bsgrub bya med na spyod pa yin/ /thabs dang shes rab a dzan lta/ /bla ma chu yi rgyun gyis rab tu khyab/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dpag bsam shing dag la/ /'bras bu khrun grub dang la rab tu rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa'i mchog /rang yid rtogs 1la mi gnas pas/ /gnyug ma'i sems kyis gang rtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad des mthong yin/ /rnal 'byor pa yis gang thos thams cad dam pa ste/ /mthong ba de yis skye med rtogs phyir slob dpon mchog /byas pa kun gyis gnyis med gsal phyir thabs yin te/ /dge sdig 'bras bu skyes bu de la gnyis mi 'gyur/ /gang las bla ma dam pa las/ /dbang las lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /ro yis kun la khyab pa ste/ /skye 2med rgyas thebs rdo rje 'dzin / /bde dang stong pa dbyer med snying ga pad+ma dag la rdzogs/ /skye med yid la byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab bde chen sems/ /snang grag thams cad ro snyoms rnam gsum rnal 'byor rnams kyis spyod/ /rje btsun dag gi byin rlabs 5shar bas dbyer med sgogs sangs rgyas/ /chos rnams kun dang rang gi sems rnams du mar spyod/ /rtogs pa thams cad nyams myong gdams pa don bral na/ /nor bu mching 6bu dag la rang bzhin du bde na/ /chos rnams de dang ldan na re dogs med pas rang bde zhig /dang po blo ldan rtogs pa skyed7//gnyis pa nags su sna rtse bsgom8/ /nyams su myong ba skyes pa na/ /spyod pas khyad par 'gro bar bya/ /gang gang lhan cig skyes pa de/ /glang po che yi mig 27— /9pya

bzhin du/ /gzer re bskyed nas zug rngu 'byung / /glod na zhen med bsam gtan mchog /bde'o bde'o gnas med bde/ /'dod pa med pa'i rang bzhin bde/ /brtags pa thams cad der shes bde/ /bsgrub pa med pa'i sangs rgyas bde/ /go cha chen po bgos nas kyang / /nor bu lta bu'i snying stobs kyis/ /rang gi sems la grub gtad na/ /mi ro'i khog par bde chen zhugs / /gang gis gang du gang las ni1/ /rtog cing dpyod pa'i blo las ni/ /dngos 'dzin gdon gyi 2dbang song phyir/ /cir yang mi 'dzin blo gros mchog /snang ba chos nyid nyi ma la/ /gzung 'dzin khri mon smag tu tshud/ /sems nyid rang gsal chos sku nyid/ /ma rig mun pa'i dra bas gtumasagi/ /gnyis med bde chen bla ma'i drin/ /shugs 'byung 5zhen bral nyams kyi klong / /rang grol rang bzhin spyod pa'i 'gros/ /re dogs las grol chos kyi sku/ /skye med kun rtog 6spangs pa yis/ /byang chub lam chen rtog dang bral/ /mi rtog 'dzin med blo las 'das/ /gang du btsal yang rtog rnged ngang / /rang bzhin dri med thabs dang shes rab kyisadz+wa/ /rang bzhin sems gang las ni sangs rgyas kyi//yon tan rin chen rin thang med kyi mdzod/ /dam chos nyi ma bla ma'i drin gyis ltos8— / /'khrul bcas bden las 'das pa yi/ /nyon mongs 'ching ba gcod mdzad kyi/ /chos nyid bden pa mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /bshes gnyen skye sked 'od gsal mthong / /shes rab mig bral dngos po yi/ /gdon 'joms bdag gzhan bde chen sku/ /cir yang rtog med bya bral gyi/ /nyams myong ye shes sgron ma gsal/ /gang gis dngos dang dngos med du/ /'dzin te mar me lta bu ru/ /blo yi yul min spang dka'i 9 phyir/ /blo 'das bcas bcos rgya 27— 96

mdud shig /thabs bral shes rab sgron ma nyid/ /nam mkha'i me tog shes rab lam/ /ri bong rwa ltar don med kyi/ /spang bya mthar 'dzin blo dang bral/ /gang gis gnyis med don rtogs na/ /chos nyid ma mthong chos sku yi/ /chos nyid nyi ma yengs su med/ /de nyid phyag rgya chen po yin/ /shes dang shes bya las grol gyi/ /'khor 'das stong nyid 'od gsal ba/ /bltar med bstan du sked pa yi/ /blo 'das shes rab sgon ma nyid/ /snying rje rgyun ldan gru gzings kyis1 / /'gro rnams 'khor ba bzod med kyi/ /snyug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po las / /ma lus sgrol mdzad thabs kyi skas/ /snang sems gnyis med thabs dang ni/ /shes rab dbyer med byang chub lam/ /chu dang 'o ma lta bu ru/ /ro mnyam nyams myong dbyer mi phyed/ /yod med gzung 2'dzin mtshan nyid dang / /mtshon bya rang bzhin dri med kyi/ /gnyis rnged ye shes chos nyid sgron/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun kyi gsang / /'gro rnams bde sdug skyon yon gzhi/ /nam mkha' la ni sprin bzhin du/ /ma lus sems can thams cad la/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur gnas/ /dgag sgrub re dogs las grol gyi/ /nyams spyong bltar med bstan du sked/ /yang dag don gyi de nyid la/ /yang dag don mthong rnam par grol/ /ris drug sdug bsngal sems kyis 8ni/ /snang ba nyams myong bde chen la/ /snang ba mthun snang med pa ru/ /bla ma'i drin mthong rnal 'byor grol/ /don chen nyi ma byang chub kyi/ /chos nyid ye shes spya na pa yi/ /nyams myong sgron la thams cad kyi/ /bde chen smrar med don mthong bde/ /kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad kyi/ /bla ma'i drin thob zhen rnged nyams/ /gang gis bya ra mi byed par/ /gnas pas 'khor bar bde mi 27— 97

rnyed / /sgra don 'brel med thos nas ni/ /shes rab yul las 'das pa'i phyir / /bla ma'i drin gyis sems dang ni/ /nor bu rin chen yon tan ldan/ /dad gus yengs med dam tshig gi/ /sgron ma bdag lus rgyal ba'i mdzod/ /bde chen yon tan 'byung gi gnas/ /bltar med don mthong ngo mtshar che /gang nas ma 'ongs 1gar yang ni/ /'gro 'ong las grol gnyug ma yi/ / nyams myong smrar gred yengs su med/ /bsgom pa 'bral med blo las 'das/ /chos nyid 'od gsal dag pa'i sems/ /byang chub gsal snang chos kyi dbyings/ /bde chen ye shes sku can gyi/ /sems kyi nor bu dri med rnyed/ /ma bltas —bde chen mthong du med/ /ma rtogs nyams myong blo las 'das/ /ma sems rtog pa chos nyid klong / /cir yang bya bral yengs su med/ /di ring mchog la gnas pa'i nyams myong rin po che/ /brtags pa ma yengs 5gnyug ma yengs su rnged pa'i ngang / /yengs med gzugs kyi 6bdag 'dzin dngos po 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /gnas lugs dge sdig spang blang ci yang bsam du med/ /dmigs rnged yid la mi byed dran pa yi/ /kun rtog 7'ching ba gcod mdzad ye shes sgron/ /rgyu ba chos nyid chos sgu'i klong 8 du chad/ /ma bsgoms dmus long mthong ba'i yul min phyir/ /bsgom pa bdud rtsi'i ro tshor bla ma'i drin/ /byin rlabs 9brgyud pa bla ma'i nyams myong la/ /bde ba'i ro tshor ngos gzung 11ci yang med/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /rtog med rtog dpyod yul las 'das / /bsgom dang bsgom pa cir yang med/ /mi 'dzin 'dzin rtog 'khrul pa spangs/ /chos kyi spyan can chos kyi ni/ /sku can chos kyi sgron ma yin ki / /tshogs gnyis chos kyi rnga bo che/ /byang chub lam chen chos kyi dung / /bdag 27— /98

mred 'od gsal sgra sgrogs dus/ /nor bu rin chen 'dod 'jo'i ba 'chi pred bdud rtsi bcud kyis 1len/ /ljon shing me tog 'bras ldan kyis2/ /rgya mtsho ri rab bum pa bzang / /nam mkha' nyi zla glu gar rtsen/ /mngon sum dang ni rjes dpag gis/ /brtags pa don shes don mthong gi/ /yid ches nges dang bcas pa yis4/ /sngar 'dris ma bu dam tshig mjal/ /chos dang chos min mnyam nyid las/ /tha dad 'gro rnams brdzun blo yis/ /thar pa'i srog gcod tshe 'di yi/ /rnam rtog thar med chu srin kha/ /snying rje dang ni stong pa nyid/ /ya bral tha dad don mi mthong / /stong dang snying rje dbyer 5med lam/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhen pa'i blo can rtog pa yis6/ /yul gye rgya mdud su mi 'dod/ /'dod yon lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /bde ba'i ros gang skye med lam/ /rang bzhin dge ba'i sems nyid 'di7/ /gnyug ma'i bde chen mngon sum gyi/ /lhan skyes ro tshor brjod med na/ /rtags kyis de nyid don mi rnyed/ /bde chen 'khor 'das rtog pa yi/ /blo can rmongs rnams 'ching ba'i phyir/ /gang dang gang du bltas gyur kyang / /de nyid blo yi yul las 'das/ /rang rig bde chen mtshon du med pa'i lam/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i yid can gnyug ma'i ro/ /bla ma'i drin rtogs skye med bsgom pa yi/ /nyams las don mthong skye med ngo mtshar che/ /'gro rnams 'ching byed las la ni//rnam grol don shes rang rig gi/ /sems rtogs mya ngan 'das kyi mchog /de nyid spros pa'i yul dang bral/ /sems nyid nor bu rin chen mdzod/ /'khor 'das srid zhi mya ngan 'das/ /dge sdig sa bon bag chags rtsa/ /thar lam byang chub rnyed kyi sku/ /rang sems chos nyid nam mkha' yi/ /grong du grol na 27—499

'gro rnams kun/ /rnam dag ye shes nyi ma ste/ /rnam grol byang chub gzhan 'ga' 1med/ /'gro rnams bde chen ros gang yang / /thabs bral de nyid don mi mthong / /thabs ldan bya bral skyes bu la/ /'chi med 'gro 'ong yul las 'das / /gang gang 'dzin de dngos po yi/ /gdon gyi dbang gyur rmongs rnams la/ /'ching las thar lam med pa'i phyir/ /thar pa'i lam ston 'dzin med ltos/ /rlung gi rta zhon rtog bcas yid kyi bu/ /gzung 2'dzin sbrang ma 'dod yon rjes su snyeg /gang snyegs bde med 'khor ba'i 'khrul bcad de/ /ye shes byang chub rtsa rlung chos nyid zung / /gang gang rig 'dzin rtog pa yi/ /dbang song 'dod yon ltad mo nyid/ /bdag gzhan ltos med mthong ba las/ /rang rgyud ma 4mthong 'dod mi tshim/ /dngos med dngos dang bral ba yi/ /chos rnams dngos dang dngos min phyir/ /gang dang gang du 'dzin de nyid/ /blo yi yul yin 'dzin rtog phyir/ /stong dang stong nyid 'bras bu rung / /dngos por 'dzin pa'i gdon 5chen kyis/ /gzhan dbang bran ltar ma bkol na/ /gang la gnas pa de mi mthong / /mos pa'i blo ldan gus pa'i blo gros mchog /las kyi mtshams sbyar 6bag chags rtsa ba can/ /yid kyi lus can chos nyid don mthong gi/ /gzhan don nor bu dpag bsam shing ltar mthong / /ting 'dzin byeng rgod las grol rtog pa yi/ /rlung gis mi bskyod rtog med chos kyi ni/ /skra can bla ma chos nyid chos sku yi/ /ri bo nyi ma ma rig mun bral mdzod/ /'akro la brtse ba'i blo can thugs rje yis7/ /rgya mtsho mi g.yo dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag thugs kyi dkor mdzod nas/ /ye shes sgron ma byang chub lam mkhan mdzod/ /me tog 'bras ldan 'gyur med dpag bsam shing / /27—500

'chi med bdud rtsi'i ros gang ku sa 1li/ /bdag med bde chen khros bral rtsed mo yi / /'gyur med don ston dngos po'i gdon 'joms mdzod/ /skye med 'od gsal stong nyid 'od 'phro yi/ /nor bu rin chen yon tan kun ldan gyi 2/ /dpal ldan dpal gyi 'byung gnas ā tsar+ya / /gnyis med spros bral stong nyid sgra sgogs mdzod/ /bde chen bde ba'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kun gyi 4gsang //mi 'jigs seng ge 'jigs bral ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ / bung ba 5me tog bcud ldan sbrang rtsi len bzhin du/ /rang bzhin rtog med blo 'das sgron ma'i don ston mdzod / /bsod nams mchog gis brgyan pa yi/ /nam mkha'i yon tan mi zad gter/ /sangs rgyas ye shes dharmā 9bzhi/ / dhā tu 7byang chub chos thob mdzod / /skye med blo ldan nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /chos rnams stong nyid 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /mtha' bral bdag med spros bral chos sgu yi/ /tshogs ldan nyi mas ye shes don rtogs shog /rang bzhin lhan skyes 'gro rnams lhan cig skyes kyi sku/ /chos rnams rnam dag mya ngan 'das kyi dbyengs/ /rnam rtog dang bral tshogs gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas spyan/ /tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag po chos nyid don mthong shog /sangs rgyas kun sdom bcom ldan mkha' 'gro ma yi sdom/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas bde chen nyi ma bde ba kun gyi dpal/ /bla ma'i gsang mdzod gdams ngag snying po don gyi gsang ldan mdzod/ /bde chen bdag med bde ba 8chen po'i tshogs dang ldan gyur cig /sred dang zhi ba rnam dag ni/ /ro mnyam dkyil 'khor ldan gyi gtso/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshogs kyi mchog /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dpal ldan shog /gnyis med 'dzin dang bral ba yi/ /chos rnams dngos sped stong pa nyid/ /chos nyid 'od gsal 27—501

tshogs kyi ni/ /'khor lo byang chub don mthong shog /bsgom bya sgom byed dmigs pa yi/ /kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad kyi/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshogs kyi ni/ /byams mgon rgyun dang ldan par shog /zhi ba'i blo gros bdag med mya ngan 'das kyi dbyings/ /ji srid bde chen byang chub mchog gi sems/ /snying rje'i rgyun ldan gsang sngags snying po'i 1don gyi bcud/ /sgyu ma byang chub lam can 2sangs rgyas byang chub 'od/ /dngos dang dngos med brtan g.yo gnyis dang gnyis 'dzin gyi/ /lam stor khyab bdag bcom ldan mi yi seng ge ni//sangs rgyas grong khyer tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i grong mchog tu/ /byang chub sgron ma ye shes sgron ma'i 'od ldan zhing / /sems can rnam dag gdod nas sangs rgyas rang bzhin yang / /ris drug rmongs rnams ma rig mun pa'i sprin tshogs kyis/ /yang dag lam bral bde gshegs nyi ma nub rnams la/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo ye shes 'od 'bar me bo che/ /chos rnams rang bzhin spros bral mya ngan las 'das pa'i / /chos nyid bde chen byang chub lam gyi rtsa ba can/ /gnyis med 'od gsal ma nyams zag med myang 'das kyi/ /bde spyod 'akro mgon thugs kyis 'dzin par shog /ma rig mun bsal 4ye shes nyi ma'i byang chub 'od/ /dpal ldan chos kyi byang chub chos kyi sgon ma yi/ /ye shes byang chub bshes gnyen āt+ma ta kṛ 5ni/ /chos kyi blo gros chos nyid gzungs kyis 'dzin par shog /dge ba'i blo can yon tan kun gyi gnyen gcig po/ /thugs rje'i rtsa brtan mi yi seng ge byams pa yi/ /ljon shing bshes gnyen nor bu rin po che/ /mi zad gter chen grib la skyong bar shog /dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum na yon tan kun gyi gtso/ /mi mchog rgyal po lha dang lha min kun gyi ni/ /gtsug gi 27—502

nor bu yon tan kun ldan dam pa'i rje/ /zhing skyes nor bu rin chen rgyan dang ldan par shog /rnam rtog las grol bcom ldan lhan grub chos kyi ni/ /sman pa nyon mongs zug rngu 'byin mdzad 'gro ba yi/ /mgon gyur rje btsun las can las las grub pa yi/ /las kyi nyon mongs zug rngu mi zad dbyung du gsol/ /bde gshegs nyi ma chos nyid chos kyi spyan can gyi1/ /zla ba'i 'od zer dri med shel gong dngas gsal gyi/ /bla ma'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'chi rnged sgron ma yis/ /sngags skyes 'khor ba'i dri ma ma lus dag par mdzod/ /dpal khyod thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus sel mdzad sgron ma'i pha/ /dpal ldan dri med thabs dang shes rab bdag gzhan phan pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rgyud ldan bla ma mtshungs sked dpa' bo yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /srid mtsho las sgrol 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun gcod dpa' chen rol mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba'i tshogs kyi mchod pa chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i bu/ /tshogs rje tshogs kyi mchod pa srid mtsho ma lus skems byed bu/ /bde gshegs mchod pa dpag bsam shing chen yon tan kun gyi rgyan lta bu/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig sangs rgyas skye med tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bu/ /ma ma ma gcig bcom ldan yum gyur tshogs kyi 'khor lo bde chen ma/ /gnyis med byang chub lam mkhan tshogs 'khor bdag sked chos kyi spyan can ma/ /gang zhig gang gi drin gyis bdag blo'i pad+mo kha 'byed nyi ma'i 'od/ /mthong thos dran gyi sgon ma ma rig mun sel ye shes byang chub sgron/ /rnam 'byor nyams myong mkhas pa rtogs tshad spel 2legs mu tig rin chen phreng / /'gro drug nor bu rin chen yon tan med kyi dus/ /bde gshegs chos kyi spyan mnga' sangs rgyas sras po yon tan rin chen gdung rgyud ldan/ /27—503

yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po byang chub lam gyi 1bag chags rtsa ba 'chang /chos nyid chos kyi don ldan chos mchog lam chen yid 'ong gser gyi phreng bar ldan//gnyis med ye shes las byung khyab bdag 'gro mgon nor bu rin chen chos kyi mdzod / /don yod lugs gzigs sde snod rnam grol don mthong rnam dag thugs de'i dgongs pa nyid/ /gang gis —drin gyis ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam ltar bde chen don mthong zhing / /je tshom blo bral yid ches sgon ma byang chub gsal dngas dri rnged rtog dang bral/ /gnyug ma'i nyams myong zhen med chos nyid 'od gsal nyi mas ma rig mun pa sangs/ /'dir phrad smon lam mtshams 4spyor bag chags las 5kyi rtsa ba can/ /bsam pa'i sdong po rnam mdzes sgrub 6pa'i me tog 'bras ldan gyi/ /byang chub ljon shing las 'bras yid ches bsil grib la/ /sngar 'dris mi dang phrad bzhin smon lam ma bu cis mi mjal7 / /phyag rgya chen po gser gyi phreng ba 8las tshogs 'khor gsum pa gnyis med yid ches rang gsal gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i glu rin po che gser gyi phreng ba 9zhes bya ba grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang paṇ+ḍi ta mang pos gsungs pa rnams rje btsun mnga' bdag mai tri pas gzhung gcig tu bsdebs pa'i gdams pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o / / //27—50/

༄/ /shes rab kyi phrin yig ces bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā le kha nā ma/ bod skad du/ shes rab kyi phrin yirngu/ ces bya ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang lha mo sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo de nyid gsum gyi rin chen rnam par dag gyur pa/ /gsang las shin tu gsang gyur mkha' dang mtshungs par snang / /lha mo kun 'gro bde ba mchog gi sa gzhir gyur//shes rab don dam gyur pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang grub don thob pa'i rgyur gyur byung / /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang po ltar snang ba / /de yi 2shin tu gsang ba'i phrin yig mnyan 'os pa/ /de nyid don gyi go 'phang bshad byar spring bar bya/ /de nas sgrub po la phan phyir/ /shes rab phrin yig pad rdo rjes/ /gsang las shin tu gsang gyur pa/ /de kho na nyid rab gsal bya/ /swa 4ste dag pa kun grol ba/ /nam mkha' lta bur skye ba med/ /27—508

rang rig tsam gyi 37shes bya dang / /mchog tu dga' ba byed pa mo/ /mtshan ma med cing snang ba med/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /chos dbyengs rang bzhin zhes bya ba/ /mchog tu dri ma med pa'i gnas/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /bdag med dri ma med pa'i gzhi/ /rdo rje gsum byung dri ma med/ /'dod pa'i don gyi gnas gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /lha yi dpag bsam shing lta bu/ /mchod pa mchog gi gnas gyur pa/ /de na gnas pa'i lha mo des/ /shes rab lha mo bla na med/ /rdor gsum mi phyed spyor ba yis/ /de kho na nyid pad+mar ldan/ /nang gi gnas kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /mchog tu dga' ba byed pa 2la/ /dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin gyis/ /'bad de yang dag mkhyen par gsol/ /rba rlabs med cing snang ba med/ /rang gi lus la gnas gyur kyang / /'bar ba chen mo de srid kyi/ /dus gsum bdag gis ma shes so/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can ma/ /rang bzhin med pas mdzes pa ste/ /skye ba med pas kun rtogs pas/ /thams cad du ni khyab byed ma / /'dod pa yon tan bzang sngar ldan/ /lus dang lus la kun du gnas//dmyal ba la sogs thams cad la/ /gsang ba'i spyod pas rol pa ste/ /mdog dang yan lag rnam par spangs/ /gsang las shin tu gsang gyur 'di/ /dpal ldan bde chen zhal snga yi/ /bka' drin gyis ni bdag gis rtogs/ /dri ma mred byung khyab pa mo/ /rang rig mtshan nyid gabyug pu ste/ /skye ba med la rtogs bya'i phyir/ /ji bzhin du ni rnam par gnas/ /dngos dang dngos med mchog 'dzin pa/ /zad par bya phyir ji bzhin gnas/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i 27—509

bka' drin gyis/ /dge ma ji tshobazhin shes nas ni/ /yang dag gus dang bcas pa yis/ /nus pa ji bzhin bsgom 3pa'ang byas/ /de ltar na yang da bar du/ /gcig tu mi 'gro ci yi phyir/ /yang na bdag la skal med dam/ /ji ste bdag gi sems rgyud la/ /yang dag pa yi spyor ba yis/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin mi gnas sam/ /rang gi rang bzhin gyis dag pa/ /mngon par byang chub byed pa mo/ /phung lnga rdo rje gsum sogs la/ /ji bzhin yang dag gnas pa ni༄ / /slob dpon dpal ldan zhal snga nas/ /snying rjer zhugs pa'i thugs kyis ni/ /'bad de de bzhin rtogs bya'i phyir/ /yang dag ji bzhin bdag la gsungs/ /dpal ldan bde chen mgon po yis/ /khyod kyis 4dngos la bdag blo bskyed/ /bka' lung stsal cing gnas pas na/ /de la 'dir ni the tshom med/ /de nyid gsal bar shes nas su/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsgom byas kyang / /gang phyir bden par gsal ba ru/ /mi snang bas te stong ngam ci/ /yid bzhin nor bu mkha' mtshungs pas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs so lo/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i tshig de dag /bden pa dang ni mi bden yin/ /mkha' mtshungs gang yin bden pa ste/ /gang zhig shes nas bsgom gyur kyang / /gang dngos gsal bar mi ston pas/ /yid bzhin nor mtshungs brdzun pa yin/ /bdag gis khyod ni don dam gyis/ /kun du 'char bar shes pa ste/ /de ltar na yang mi dmigs pas/ /sgyu ma tshogs kyi 3gzugs 'dzin yin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis don dam du/ /nges par skyon dang yon tan dag /grogs 'dus pa las ji bzhin 'gyur/ /gsungs pa'i ngag de bden pa ste/ /shes rab bden par smra ba khyod/ /gang gis rtogs pa'i rang 27—510

bzhin yang / /bdag med bzhi yang 'dus pa yis/ /de dang mtshungs par de gnas so/ /bzang mo dri ma med 'bar ma/ /'on kyang gang gis bdag shes nas / /yun ring dus su rnam dpyad kyang / /ma dmigs pa de gang du yib/ /mchog tu dga' bar byed pa'i gzugs/ /mngon par byang chub byed pa'o/ /ye shes sgron ma'i snang ba ni/ /phyogs bcur gsal bar bteg nas su/ /dri dang phreng sogs na bza' dang / /bza' bca' ston mo de bzhin gzhan/ /gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rgyun mi 'chad par rtag tu ni/ /bdag gi shes rab bsten gyur kyang / /skad cig kyang ni 'gyur ba med/ /mngon rtogs dri sked 'jug pa'o/ /de bzhin nyid shes dag pa yi1/ /khyod kyi dam tshig spyod pas 2ni/ /byang chub lam ni ston pa po/ /rgyud las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin—/ /rgyun du bar chad med par ni/ /'dod yon lnga po bsten pa yis/ /bdag gi byis pa nas bzung ste/ /shin tu bdag nyid rig pa yis/ /bsten pa dang ni —bsgoms gyur pas/ /dge ba yi ni sa gzhi khyod/ /bdag la ci phyir yid mi rton/ /sems gnyis ldan pa'i bud med la/ /su zhig la ni rton byed ces / /yang dag mgon pos gsungs pa gang / /de ni bden par nye bar gnas / /sgyu ma dag ni thams cad la4/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /rnam pa du mas phan btags pas/ /gang gis rnam kun bsten byas shing / /khams gsum ma lus par bltas kyang / /mi snang gcig pu ga 5na gnas/ /khyod kyis gnad ni dran med par/ /byis pa gang gis khyod bsgoms na/ /de rnams don med phung khu'agyur zhing / /byang chub rgyur khyod gnas pa min/ /gnad ni legs par shes ldan pa/ /gang gis khyod ni bsgoms gyur na/ /byang 27—51 1

chub snying po'i bar du yang / /de rnams sangs rgyas bya phyir gnas/ /bzang mo khyod dngos shes gyur nas/ /gang gis ma bsgoms de la yang / /grogs mos lag pa bsdams te song / /rigs ngan dang ni mtho 1ba'ang rung / /gnad shes nas 2ni mdzar gyur nas/ /bzang mo nang du'ang snang byed cing / /lan 'ga' 'ang mdza' ba'i ngo med cing / /ma rabs rnams kyi rang bzhin kau//mtshang brtol na ni nges pa ru/ /skye bo de yi gdong gi ni/ /pad+ma lta zhing dbang du 'gyur/ /cho 4'brang can gyi skye bo yang / /'jug pa lam ni 'di nyid de/ /tshig tsam chad pa byas na yang / /'chi ba na yang 'gyur ba med/ /gnyi ga dag pa'i rigs las byung / /cho 5'brang can du skyes pa yin/ /bya ba dang ni bya min dang / /snod dang snod min 'dir khyad med/ /khyed la bdag gis rnam kun du/ /mchod byas lan 'ga'ang mi lta bas/ /shes rab khyod kyi rigs spyod yul / /da ltar bdag gis khong du chud/ /bud med rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /shin tu 'phyar la g.yo ba yin/ /mchu rkan la sogs skam pa ste/ /mtshang 'dru mang pos ci zhig bya/ /khyod ni nyin dang mtshan dag dang / /skad cig gcig kyang ma yengs 6par/ /sgom na skad cig nyid kyis ni/ /bla na med pa'i gnas thob byed/ /gang gis nye bar bsgoms pa yis/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang rgyu yin pa'i / /khyod kyi spyod pa 'di lta bu/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin sngar ma shes/ /mang po smra ba ci zhig dgos/ /yid brtan rung ba 'ga' yang med/ /'akyod dang gnyid dang rmugs pa yis/ /rmongs pas khyod ni mi shes na/ /khyod kyi rang gi rang bzhin gang / /gsal ba ru ni de smros shig /rdor gsum sa bon las byung bas/ /gsum gyis bskyed par the tshom med/ /'dod chags zhe sdang 27—5 12

sogs dri mas/ /sems can thams cad rmongs pas na/ /bye ba du ma'i nang nas kyang / /gang gis khyod shes su yang med/ /mang du smra ba byu zhig dgos/ /smad 'tshong g.yon can gyis bskor bzhin/ /don dam du ni grub med pas/ /sgyu ma mchog gi gzugs 'dzin ma/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med par/ /rmongs pa 1 khyod ni ma shes te/ /bza' dang btung sogs chags pa yis/ /srid pa'i btson rar lhung bar 'gyur/ /de la shin tu chags pa yis/ /'byor ster khyod ni brjed par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya'i chags la 'jug pa yis/ /rgyal 'gyur rdo rje can mchog ma/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin las/ /bzang mo khyod kyi rang bzhin nizhe/ /ji ltar yang dag gnas pa bzhin/ /thams cad bdag gis shes par 'gyur/ /khyod kyi rang bzhin ma lus pa/ /thams cad bdag gis shes pas na/ /rmi lam na yang slu mi nus/ /de bas bdag la blo gtod cig /khyod kyi lam ni gcig pu nyid/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin sbyangs te/ /gang bzhugs sangs rgyas nyid phrad /—par/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis yang dag bstan/ /zab mo de yang bdag gis ni/ /ji srid sbyang ba ma byas pa/ /de srid khyod kyi lus reg las/ /byung ba'i bde ba rnyed ma yin/ /gti mug 'obs kyis 'khrigs pa dang / /zhe sdang gis 4ni sdong dum ldang / /'dod chags tsher ma nyam nga bas/ /byang chub lam ni bgrod par dka'/ /phung po'i shing ni thog mtha' med/ /'dod yon yal ga gyen 'grengs pas/ /nam mkha'i mthong 5ni g.yogs pas na/ /lam de dam por bkag ste gnas/ /phung po nyon mongs de bzhin du/ /'chi bdag lha bdud chom po pa/ /sdang ba mang pos bskor nas su//rnam rtog chen po las byung ba'i/ /srid pa'i rtswa 6dang lcug ma dang / /rdo rgyal 27—du 13

la sogs ldan pa'i nags/ /shin tu rgya chen rgal tshodaka' bar/ /phung po'i shir 2rta brten nas su/ /gti mug 'obs ni rgal dkar gnas/ /kun rtog rtswa dang ldum sogs pa'i/ /skyibs su 'bad de yib par byed/ /lha bdud la sogs chom po pa/ /de lta bu yi phyogs na gnas/ /yang dag lam zhugs 'gon po dag /sems kyi nor bu 'phrog pa yis/ /rab tu sdang bas 'joms par byed/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mdzod po che/ /yon tan nor gyis yongs bkang ba/ /byang chub lam la gnas pa yi/ /mel tshe pa yis de mthong nas/ /ye shes rdo rje sta re ni/ /so ni rnon por bdar ba yis/ /byang chub kyi ni lam 'gog pa'i/ /phung po shing ni kun bcad nas/ /cho ga bzhin du gtubs nas su / /yid kyi shing de las byung ba'i/ /nyon mongs ldum dum tsher mar bcas//bdag med me la bsreg par bya/ /nga rgyal rdo yi tshogs de ni/ /shes rab rdo rjes phye mar bya/ /gti mug 'obs ni 'khrigs pa dag /byang sems rgyun mi 'chad pas dag4 /yang dag lam zhugs 'gron po la/ /'tshe byed 'dul bar dka' ba yi/ /'chi bdag bdud sogs chom po pa/ /bcom pas de dang des 'bros 'gyur/ /byang chub lam ni yangs pa na/ /byang chub 'gegs bya'i phyir gnas pa/ /phyogs bcur gnas pa'i sdang ba rnams/ /thabs kyi lus ni dri med pas/ /shes rab ral gri rnon po yis/ /'bad pas de dag bcom nas su//lam bzang de ru zhugs nas ni/ /thams cad der ni ci dgar 'go/ /byang chub lam ni sbyangs pa yis/ /kun du shin tu dri med pas/ /rmad byung bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /grogs mo khyod ni sbyangs pas na/ /rang bzhin dri med dag cing zhi/ /rang rig bdag med mnyam pa nyid/ /'dod pa'i 27—514

don gyi 'bras ster ba/ /go 'phang bla med thob par 'gyur/ /khyod kyi rang bzhin ro myang 1na/ /'di ni 'di 'dra zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang brjod mi nus/ /rang rig skye ba med pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /dbang po las 'das gang yin 'thob/ /mchog tu dga' ba las byung dag /shin tu rnyed dka' go 'phang ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bla na med / /mya ngan 'das gnas zhes bya ba/ /mngon par byang chub byed pa'o/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsgom pa yi/ /chos gcig gis ni thob par 'gyur/ /shin tu gus pas bsgom pa las/ /gzhan du de ni thob pa min/ /de ni rang bzhin dag pa ste/ /dus kun du ni 'dus ma byas / /rtag dang chad pa rnam par spangs/ /thabs dang shes rab dri ma sked / /skye ba med par rtogs pa yis/ /sems can kun la yang dag gnas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsam mi khyab/ /bla na med par der shes bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas de ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob byed pa'o/ /de ltar sems dang sems byung gi/ /don kyi rang bzhin rtogs nas ni/ /rdo rje dri mred gsum spyor ba/ /ji ste shes nas rnam bsgoms na/ /ye shes rdo rje rab spyor gyis/ /des ni grogs mo 'grub par 'gyur/ /dngos dang dngos med las 'das pas/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa ste/ /dri rnged zhi ba thabs bcas par/ /brten par bya zhes 'dren pas brjod/ /thabs dang bral na khyod kyi min/ /thabs kyang khyod dang bral na min/ /de gnyis phan tshun bral ba yis/ /'grub pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /thabs dang yang dag ldan pa ru/ /mdza' mo khyod ni ji bzhin 'gyur/ /bdag gis 2kun du shes zin na/ /de 27dod515

las gzhan pa ci smrar yod/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin ni/ /bdag gi byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sangs rgyas nyid du brtan bgyid na/ /de bas bdag la drin gyis g.yogs/ /dpal ldan bde chen zhal snga nas/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas nyid bya'i rgyu/ /thabs dang yang dag ldan pa yi/ /blo gros chen mo khyod la ni/ /pad+ma rdo rje 1nges par ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis zhes ji skad du/ / spring ba de bzhin grogs mo mchog /thabs dang bcas par bya dgos par/ /dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje can/ /de skad phrin brdzongs bye de bzhin du/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyu nyid du/ /khyod kyis de ltar myur du gyis/ /bdag la ji bzhin gsal po ru/ /phrin las skad cig myur du bskuraje/ /khyod kyis spangs pa'am brjed ngas pa/ /bdag gis tshe 'dir gnas mi byalha/ /byeng dang rgod pa spangs nas su/ /dus kun nyin dang mtshan du ni/ /rgyun du bar chad med pa ru/ /skad cig skad cig khyod dran pas/ /dngos grub don kun bdag la sbyin6/ /gal te de ltar ma gyur na/ /de tshe bdag ni sma phab pas/ /ji ltar byed pa ltos shig dang / /ji bzhin rgyud kyi de nyid kyi/ /theg 7pa yis ni bcings nas su/ /yang dag pa yi khyem du ni/ /dge mas kun nas bcug nas ni/ /ske ba med par rtogs pa yi/ /sems dang sems byung rang bzhin gyis / /'bad de srung ba byas nas su/ /de nyid sangs rgyas sa mchog tu/ /thabs kyi lcags sgrog gis bcings te/ /ye shes rdo rje'i gzer btab la/ /bdag med rdzong du bzhag nas ni/ /de nas bdag gis bsgrub par bya/ /de ltar khyod la spring bya ba/ /ji ltar gyur pa bdag gis springs/ /'jom dang ngo dga' spangs nas su/ /bzang mo la ni kun bzlas kyis/ /gal te byams par 27—pya16

mi byed na/ /de tshe ci zhig smra ru yod/ /'on te min na than 'di dag /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i snying la zhog /khyod kyi lam dang sbyang ba yi/ /bye brag dag kyang ngas shes la/ /rigs dang gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang / /bdag gis khyod kyi kun 'byung dang / /don dam gnas kyang shes pas na/ /de bas bdag la blo gtod cig /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyes/ /thabs kyi mchog dang bcas pa ru/ /shes bya thag pa rab sra bas/ /de dang de ru rgyug byed pa/ /bdag gis bzung ste bcings zin pas/ /da ni 'bros sa ga la yod/ /de bas lha mo bdag dga' bas/ /dbang gyur dam tshig la mnos la/ /dpal ldan bde chen zhal snga'i bka'/ /yon tan rgya mtshos bskyang bar gyis/ /khyod kyi rang bzhin gzung 1med cing / /rmad byung ji bzhin rig nas ni/ /dpal ldan bde chen spyod pa ni/ /bka' yis de bzhin 'jug par bya/ /rdo rje gsang ba'i tshig ldan pa/ /shes rab phrin yig mnyam med pa/ /dpal ldan bde chen zhal snga yi/ /bka' drin gyis ni bdag gis byas/ /shes rab ri bo srub shing gis/ /shes bya'i 'o mtsho bsrubs las byung / /ye shes bdud rtsi rang byung ba/ /mngon sum sangs rgyas byed pa po/ /shes rab phrin yig la 'bad de/ /skyes bu gang gis de rig nas/ /'bad de rnam par bsgoms pas na / /de ni rdo rje 'dzin dngos 'gyur/ /shes rab kyi phrin yig slob dpon chen po pad+ma rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shān+ta bha dra dang / bod kyi zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lha 2 btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te 4gtan la phab pa'o// //27—517

༄ / /rnal 'byor pa'i rtog pa'i gegs sel ba zhes bya ba/ spyo ༄go/ /rnal 'byor pa'i rtog pa'i gegs 2 sel ba zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma rnams dang / dpal rdo rje sems dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ci phyir zhe na gang gis gang la gang ltar bsgom/ /rtags dang yon tan bar chad gegs skyon bsal / /de dag shes na 4goms pas byang chub 'thob/ /ma thos mi shes mi grub 5yang na 'gyangs/ /dang po ci phyir bsgom pa gzung rtse'adzin gnyis/ /ma spangs ji bzhin ma bsgoms rnal 'byor pas/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bshags sbyin pa mang byas kyang / /bsod nams 'phel yang ye shes rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /gnyis pa gang gis rnal 'byor dang 7ldan pa/ /thos mang brtson zhing dam tshig sdom gnas shing / /mchod dang sbyin mos byang chub sems ldan pa/ /de ni theg chen gsang ba'i snod yin bsgom8/ /gsum pa gang la zhe na rang gi sems/ /ji bzhin ma bcos ye nas rnam dag cing / /spros bral yod med rtag chad mtha' spangs pa/ /de la 27—520

g.yeng ba rnged par rtag tu gnas/ /bzhi pa gang ltar bsgom 1pa bsgom bya dang / /bsgom 2pa gnyis med rang gi ngo bo la/ /ci yang med la cir yang snang gsal bar//byeng rmugs spros pa'i rtog pa med par bsgom/ /lnga pa de rtags rnal 'byor brtson ldan la/ /dang po gnyid dang 'dod sred chung bar 'gyur/ /de nas rim kyis rmi lam 'dod la sogs/ /rtog pa ji bzhin cho 'phrul gzugs kyang ston/ /drug pa de yi yon tan bsam brjod pa/ /mngon sum tshe ring nad rnams gso ba dang / /bgegs sel la sogs yon tan mang po 'byung / /de bzhin rim gyis byang chub lam la 'jug /bdun pa bar chad bgegs ni rnal 'byor pa/ /gnas spang zuganas 'tshol gzhan du 'gro 'dod na/ /gnod sbyin gzhan dang gzhan du 'gro 'dod de/ /rnal 'byor sems la zhugs nas gnas gzhan 'phen/ /gal te rnal 'byor bsgom zhing gnas bzung bas/ /smra bcad bar skabs nang du gzhan 'jug dang / /phyir byung khengs grags 'dod brkam 4zas nor tshol/ /yi dwags 'dod sred can gdon de sems zhugs/ /gal te rnal 'byor sems 'khrugs 'thab 'dod cing / /'khor la gshe dang gzhan la spyo byed na/ /'byung po'i bdag po ya ba sho na pa/ /sgrub pa de yi snying la zhugs pa yin/ /gal te rnal 'byor 'phres shing nyal la dga'/ /zas skom sred cing bzlas la mi brtson na/ /lto 'phye nyal brtson snyom 5byed ces bya ba/ /rnal 'byor sems la zhugs nas gnas par byed/ /gal te rnal 'byor rang gi longs spyod rkyen/ /yo byad srung zhing so 'dzugs srung ma bsko༄6 //gsog phyir 'dod tshol gzhan du gtong 'dod na/ /gnod spyin nor bsrung 7zhes bya sems la zhugs/ /gal te rnal 'byor pha ma srun tshogs la/ /chags nas smon lam rim gros 8srung byed na/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bag chags ma byang bas/ /nyon 27—521

mongs ma spangs byang chub ring bar 'gyur/ /gal te rnal 'byor gza' skar 'jug phod dang / /dus dang lo zla bzang ngan rtsi byed na/ /dbyer med mnyam pa nyid dang 'gal bas na/ /byang chub thob par rab tu dka' bar 'gyur/ /gal te rnal 'byor thos mang rtogs che zhing / /bsgom brtson bsnyems pas bdag bstod gzhan smod na/ /nyon mongs ma spangs nga rgyal 'phel 'gyur bas/ /phyir yang lhang zhing byang chub ring bar 'gyur/ /gal te rnal 'byor bdag la gzhan dag gis / /sngon dang da ltar ma 'ongs gnod byed ces/ /zhe sdang skyes nas rig sngags gsod gtong na/ /zhe sdang dbang gis byang chub ring bar 'gyur/ /gal te bdag la gzhan gyi ju1mchod bkur zhing / /bsngags pa mang brjod bstod la sems dga' na/ /'gro la phyogs char gyur te chags sems kyis/ /byang chub lam la 'dis kyang ring bar 'gyur/ /gal te rnal 'byor 'khor mang 'du long dag /rgyal po lta bur mang por brten na ni/ /khengs 2grags yin pas bsgom pa g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ /byang chub lam las shin tu ring bar 'gyur/ /brgyad pa skyon bsal thabs ni rnal 'byor pa/ /sems la bar chad mtshan ma de byung na/ /'di ltar bsams nas mtshan rtog bsal 4bar bya/ /chos su ci snang sems las gzhan med cing / /sems kyi rang bzhin chos nyid ngo bo la/ /bzang ngan spong len 'dod sred byams sdang sogs/ /rtog dang rtog pa'i dbang gis bgegs byung na/ /sems la bltas na gang yang mi snang bas/ /snang sked sems rtog mtshan ma ga la yod / /bdag rtog mtshan mar sems la bzung nyes pas/ /rtog pa thams cad spangs shing rtog med gnas/ /rtog pa med pa la yang gnas pa med/ /de ltar ring du gnas na rtog bgegs ni/ /myur bar zhig nas ji bzhin bsgom pa la5/ /27—522

༄ / /dug lnga sbas pa'i lam mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba/rte༄go/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byis pa'i rjes su byes pa 'breng / /byis pas byes pa 'jig 'gyur bas/ /'dir byis pa grol bar bya ba'i phyir/ zhes pa 'chad par bsams so/ /byis 'ching lam du dkyer ba bshad/ /de la 'dul ba don yod par grub pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ gang gis 2rmongs pa 'ching 'gyur zhing / /ngu 'bod mthar ni nges 'gyur ba/ /de nyid kyis ni grol 'gyur zhing / /shes rab stobs kyis bde ba thob/ /ces gsungs pa'i don mkhas pas mngon du bsten par bya ste/ gang de la mchog tu bsdam par bya ba yin pas thog mar rgyud brtag par bya'o/ /de la cha mnyam pa ni 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa yun ring por skye bar mi 'gyur yang dngos po des de la 'dod chags la sogs pa mi 'byung ba ma yin no/ /nyon mongs pa chung ba ni 'dod chags la sogs 27—524

pa'i dngos po chen po dang / mang po dang / lhag pa dang phrad cing mngon du gyur pa la ni nyon mongs pa bul bar skye la/ 'bring dang chung ngu la ni shin tu cha phra ba'o/ /gang zag 'dod chags spyad pa ni chags pa'i dngos po chung ngu dang /ngan pa la yang chags pa chen por 'gyur na/ de las bzlog 1pa la lta ci smos te yun ring du chags pa'o/ /dbang po mnyen pa dang / de bzhin du 'jam pa dang / mi brlang 3ba dang / lus ngag gis gzhan la tho 'tshams 3pa ma yin pa dang / dbral bar dka' ba dang / dman pa la mos pa dang / spro ring ba dang / de la 'du ba dang / yid mi bde ba mang ba dang / kun dga' ba mang ba dang / khro gnyer med pa dang / mdog gsal ba dang /'dzum pa sngon du gtong ba dang / sha rtsi dmar zhing 'gro ba mgyogs pa dang /'khun bur smra zhing mi brtan pa'i bsam pa sna tshogs su rgergyu ba'o/ /zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni sha rtsi nag cing stobs che ba/ drang por 'gro zhing brlang por smra ba/ thams cad mnar sems dang ldan pa/ zhe sdang ba'i dngos po chung ngu la khong khro bas chokun nas dkris pa stug po dang / mang po skyed par byed na 'bring dang chen po la lta smos ci dgos te yun ring du gnas par byed do/ /dbang po mi mnyen 6mi 'jam gzhan la tho 'tshams)/ dbral bar sla/ yid 'byung ba sla/ mu cor smra/ spyi brtol che/ mi mos pa mang / las kyi mtha' dam brtan/ brtul zhugs dam brtan/ yid mi bde ba mang / 'khrug pa mang / bzlog dka'/ gnod bzhin du gnas/ khro gnyer dang ldan/bzhin 8gyi mdog mi gsal ba'o/ /gti mug dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni rmongs par 'gyur ba'i dngos po chung ngu la yang gti mug gis kun nas dkris pa stug po 27—525

dang / mang po skyed par byed na gzhan lta ci smos te yun ring du gnas par byed do/ /dbang po bul ba dang / blun pa dang / zhan pa dang / lus kyi las kyi mtha' lhod pa dang / ngag gi las kyi mtha' lhod pa dang / nyes par sems pa 1dang / nyes par smra/ nyes par byas pa'i las byed/ le lo che/sgrub mi phod/ smra ba zhan/ yid mi 'jug /brjed pas shes bzhin du mi spyod / log par 'dzin/ dbral bar dka'/ yid 'byung bar dka'/dman pa la mos/ glen dig lkugs/ lag pas brda byed/ legs par gsungs pa dang / nyes par bshad pa'i chos rnams kyi ༄2/don kun shes par mi nus / rkyen gyis phrogs/ gzhan gyi dring la 'jog /sha mdog nges pa med/dal bar rgyu'o4// /gang zag nga rgyal dang ldan pa ni/ khengs par gyur pa'i dngos po chung ngu la yang nga rgyal gyi rgyu kun nas dkris pa stug po dang / mang po skye bar byed na 'bring dang chen po la lta ci smos te yun ring du gnas par byed do//dbang po rgod pa dang / dbang po 'dam bu ltar mtho/ khengs lus cher brgyan pa la sbyor ba'i rjes su brtson/ btsan ngag tu smra zhing mi 'dud/ pha ma nye du bla ma lta bu dag la dus gsum du rkyen du 'bab pa'i mchod pa mi byed/lus mi 'dud/ gsong por smra ba dang / phyag 'tshal mngon du ldang thal mo sbyar zhing 'dud par byed pa'i ngang tshul can ma yin pa dang / bdag nyid kun tu 'dzin/ bdag bstod gzhan la smod/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste 3'dod/grags pa 'dod/ tham thom gyi snod gyur/ dbral cing yid 'byung ba 6dka'/rgya chen po la mi mos/ snying rje chung / bdag dang / sems can dang /srog dang gso ba dang gang zag tu lta ba shas che/ khro gtum che/ 'khrug pa 27—pya26

dang ldan pa yin te/ de lta bu dang mthun pa ni nga rgyal gyi rtags so/ /phrag dog dang ldan pa'i gang zag ni sha mdog sngo nag pa/ 'dus pa'i yul med par rgyu ba/ gzhan la gnod par smra zhing / nges pa med pa'i bsam pa sna tshogs rgyu ba'o zhes gsungs pa 'di dag nges par slob dpon gyis brtags la gdams 1 par bya'o/ de yang gsungs pa/ bsregs 3bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /yongs su brtags te nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yis gus phyir min/ /zhes gsungs pas yongs su sgrol ba la bsam gyis sdemi khyab par 'dod pa dang /rgyu ma dag pa la bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dod pa dang / phyogs tsam la bsam kyis mi khyab par 'dod pa dang / rab tu thal ba bsam gyis mi khyab par 'dod pa ste/ 'di dag ni rmongs pa rnams kyi dan 5rtags yin te/ mkhas pas kun du spang bar 3bya ba yin no/ /blang bar bya ba ni mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ de yang gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bzod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / thabs bsam kyis mi khyab pa dang / gnyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /bye 'pho ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang drug go/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni bla ma'i gdams pa'o/ /bzod pa bsam gyis mi 8khyab pa ni dug lnga sbas pa'i lam du 'khyer 9snaba'o/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa kha cig kyang dug lngar 'dus mod tsokyi dgongs pa can yin no/ /dug lnga lam du ji ltar 'khyer na/gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ /de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dod chags kyi stong nyid ji lta ba bzhin du zhe sdang la sogs pa'o—/ /de la phyi nang gi gzugs /1la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba gcig la chags 27—527

pa skyes pa de yang kha dog la sogs par ma grub pas na brtag pa'i mtha' bsal ba'o / /rlung rjes su dpag pa las shes pa de bzhin du shes rig ma 'gags pa'i sgo nas chad pa ma yin no/ /de gnyis kyi bar de gnyis ka'i bdag nyid can gyi dngos po yang yod pa ma yin te/ de bas na bzhi pa ni rjes thob kyi shes pas dpag par bya ba'i de nyid dus su spros pa ci yang yod pa ma yin no/ /de la 'dod chags ma spangs rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhe sdang la sogs pa la smras te/de ni phan tshun spangs te 'gal ba ma yin no/ /chos kyi dbyings rtogs pas ma lus pa'i yul dug med par byas so zhes gsungs so/ /sngar smos pa ltar stong pa nyid ni kun du sbyar bar byas 1la/ dug lnga'i btsal thabs ni zhe sdang btsal ba bzhin du kun du blta bar bya'o/ /de la nang par ldang ba'i dus su de —ring ni bdag gi zhe sdang gi dngos po bdag gis skyes pa'am/ phas rgol ba'am/gzhan dag phan tshun 'thab pa'am/ zhe sdang skyes pa gang yang rung ste/ de dag mchog gi dngos grub thob 4par byed pa'i yan lag yin pas zhe sdang ci byung tshor bar shog shig 5par smon lam btab la/ nam tshor ba'i dus su zhe sdang de nyid bsam gyes mi khyab par bya'o/ /gal te de'i nyin par zhe sdang ma byung na sngar bdag nyid zhe sdang skyes pa'am/ phan tshun sdang ba dang / gzhan gyi phan tshun zhe sdang skyes pa la dran pa bskyed la de nyid rang bzhin med par bya'o/ /de ltar nang gcig bzhin du smon lam btab la bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas zhe sdang gi dug gis mi tshugs 6par bya'o/ /zhe sdang skyes so cog lam du shes tsam na/dug gzhan la yang de bzhin du shes par bya ste/ zhe sdang yid kyi gang zag gis zhe sdang yi dam du byas pas de las su rung ba dang / 'dod chags la sogs 27—528

pa la sla bar 'ong ba de bzhin du gang gi zhad 1che ba de thog mar yi dam du bya'o/ /de nas gzhan la sbyar ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /cha mnyam pa dang / nyon mongs pa chung bas kyang thog mar gang yang rung ba cig yi dam byas la/ de las su rung ba dang rim gyis 2spo bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ las dang po'i gang zag gis — gcig la mchog tu ma gdams 4na dug lnga mang du 'byung bas yid gtod snying mi 'dod de/ gzhug lhod pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni sngon du bstan par mi bya ste/ nam sgom pa'i dus su gzod gang la de gdams pa zhes sngon du bstan pa'i don de ni de nyid yi dam du gdams pa'o/ /dug lnga'i lta'ajigs pa btul 9nas mi 'jigs pa la zhugs 7pa 'di ni mchog tu gsang ba'o/ /sgod shin tu bzang ba la gdams par bya'i/ snod ngan tshig tsam la brten nas bag med du spyod pa la ni ma yin no/ /thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ /gtor ma dang ni bzlas pa dang / /dkyil 'khor me dang chu yi las/ /phyag rgya gdugs sogs mchod pa dang / /phyag dang bskor ba bya ba dang / /lugs ma'am bris pa la sogs dang / /gsung rab bri sogs rtsom pa dang / /thams cad dus su rnal 'byor pas/ /thams cad rang bzhin rtog 8med bya/ /gnyid ni bag med mi log ste/ /ji ltar pad+ma kha zum pa/ /grib mas non pas zum pa ste/ /grib sel stobs kyis rgyas pa ltar/ /gsal ba'ang sa nas ma rig pa/ /sa mthug pegyur pa'i stobs kyis te/ /dbugs dag ske long dkyil 'dus ltar/ /rim gyis bsdus te ma rig pa/ /shes rab kyis ni sbyang byas nas//gcig shos la ni nges 'dus pa/ /ma goms pa las yid mi 'byung / /goms pas yid gnyis med pa ni/ /rab tu 'bad pa'i sems goms yin/ /gsang 27—529

ba 'dus pa las/ 'pho ba'i dus su bsam mi khyab/ /las kyi shugs kyis 'pho ba dang / /rnal 'byor lceb pa'i man ngag go/ /bsgom bya smig rgyu la sogs la//mthong 'og de nyid gnas pa dang / /rang bzhin gyis grub rdo rje'i lus/ /bdun gyi 'pho ba spangs nas su/ /srid mi 'jug ste mtha' gnyis spang / /spyor sems sngon du btang ba yis/ /mthong nas ldang 'gyur mi 'jug byed/ /'da' bar mi 'gyur mchog grub pa'o/ /rkang pa dang ni kha dang lte/ /snying ga spyi gtsug mig rnams te/ /rlung ni gang nas 'pho 'gyur ba/ /rim pa bzhin du skye zhing 'thob/ /dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang / /mi dang lha dang ye shes so/ /de nas sgo gzhan dgag byas la/ /mig nas rlung ni phul bar bya/ /bla ma'i 1zhal la gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin lceb pa'ang zhal la gnas/ /rnal 'byor mi shes gang zag gis/ /mi dang lha yi skye ba ru/ /blang ba'i sems ni rtse gcig bya/ /rdo rje mkha' 'go'i nang nas kyang / /'chi ka'i sems ni gtso yin pas/ /gang ltar bsams pa de ltar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na sdig pa can yang de ltar 'gyur ram zhe na mi 'gyur te/ sdig che las kyis 2bskal nas ni/ /man ngag 'dod na mi phrad de/ /gal te phrad na 4glad gzer dang / /sbyo 'bog sogs pas mi dran no/ /'o na tshogs bsags pa la 'da' ka'i sems med kyang bde 'gro ru skyo'o 5zhe na/ tshogs du ma bsags kyang 'chi kar sems ngan skyes na rgyal po ma skyes dgra lta bu'o/ /de bas na 'da' ka ma'i bsam kyis 6mi khyab pa la shin tu 'bad par bya'o/ /'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni sku dang 7ye shes te/ gser ni mi gtsang nang du bcug gyur kyang / /'bar ba'i rang bzhin nam yang mi spong 8ltar/ /nges pa gang 27—pya 30

zhig 'jig rten chos spyod 1kyang / /bsam pa'i rang bzhin nam yang de mi spong / /zhes gsungs pas gzugs skus 'go ba'i don byed pa na yang 'jig rten gyi bya ba ngan pa dang bral ba'o/ /de ltar rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad du gnyis su rnged pa kho na yin zhing / dug lnga shin tu btsal bar bya ba yin kyang thog ma med pa'i dus nas phyin ci log la goms pa'i dbang gis shes rab dang bral nas log pa'i shes rab rgyu bas dben pa ru gnas te/ mi rtog pa'i nus pa rnyed nas tshogs kyi gseb tu phyin kyang zhe sdang la sogs gang byung yang dran pa dang mi 'bral zhing gzhan gyi dbang du mi 'gro na dus la bab pa'o/ /yang na kun du rgyu nyid bya ste/gnas gcig tu yun ring du gnas par mi bya ste/ mi dang khye 'dra bas khye yang rang gi gnas ni stobs che la/ yul gzhan du dul bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mi yang rang gi gnas na nyon mongs pa dul bar dka' ste/ yul gzhan du nyon mongs pa thul bar be+e bas kun du rgyu'i tshul la gnas par bya'o/ /gang zhig bdag gis byas bsod kyis/ /kun kyang 'tshe ba med par shog /gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du grub par shog /dug lnga sbas pa'i lam mchog tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba slob dpon 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

bsdur mchan/524 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsdams—/525 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dzag 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7nga / bye 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉d+kutshal/ gye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉risu/5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 6 〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganyen/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoratsham/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhin/526 rte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gnapa'/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gzhan gyis phrogs/ dzu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu ba'o/ 5 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 ste/ khu/〈〈co 〉〉 ra/527 hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉snga dmas/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉steg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodangos/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ 57〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rangan/ 〈〈co 〉shesan/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagangs par/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giganyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 8 〈〈snar 〉rnam/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khyer/ te〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉mos/ ⑪〈〈co 〉〉thugs/528 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbya/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉gi/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngathob 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi mi tshug 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stand/529 tsho 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masang / zhe sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ ( — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gi/ lgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadis/ sgo)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngas/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rtul 3〈〈pe 〉〉(〈snar 〉mthug nya〈〈co 〉〉rtogs/ 97〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'thug53༷ rte 〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ ṭa〈〈co 〉dkyi/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyang / ba/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skye bo—/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sams kyis/ shaṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 nga / bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈/531 1 〈〈snar 〉〉pad/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga seb/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/27—532

1360༄ / /rnal 'byer gyi mtshan nyid bden pa/tsho rak+ṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ yo ga lak+ṣa ṇa sa t+ya/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu dus kun 2sangs rgyas dang / /chos dang dge 'dun tshogs bcas la//thal sbyar gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i man ngag nirdo/ /rin chen sna tshogs tshogs pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams sgrol ba'i phyir/ /mdor basbus 4nas ni bshad par bya/ /nam gyi cha smad gnyid las sad/ /bdag ma gtogs pa'i sems can la/ /thog ma nyid du snying rje bsgom5/ /de nas bdag nyid la bltas 6nas/ /ding gi nyin zhag 'di la ni/ /slong ba'i sems can dag la ni/ /ji srid 'ongs kyang ser sna yi/ /dri mas mi gos nyid du bya/ /gal te babe+eb pa las 'gal ba'i/ /yid la rgyu ba phra mo yang / /bsam pa nyid du mi bya na/ /ngag dang lus kyi smos ci dgos/ /bdag ladi 27—534

ring khro ba dang / /brdeg pa la sogs 'byung bar shog /des kyang 'khrug par mi bya yi/ /le lo byung na shes bzhin gyis/ /mgo la me 'bar 1bzhin du dor/ /bdag gis 27'gro 'am nyal 'dug rung / /spyod lam ji ltar gnas 'dug kyang //yid ni lha yi nga rgyal dang / /skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar/ /rang nyid yin par rtag tu bsam/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /shes dang shes bya bdag gis ni/ /di ring nyid nas bdag gis brtag /bstod dang smad pa grags ma grags/ /gzhan dag ji ltar zer yang ni/ /de nyid brag ca lta bu dang / /'on pa lta bu bdag gis bya/ /chags pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg /'dod yon lnga la gang du yang / /rnam shes 'phro ba'i yul byung yang / /ngag tu ma thon bar du bzlog /gzugs su snang rnams sku nyid yin/ /sgra rnams gsung du bdag nyid brtag /sems can byang chub rgyu yin phyir/ /de yi shes pa ye shes yin/ /sems can ji ltar mthong gyur kyang / /de dag nyid la blo phyag bya/ /'di dag nyid la brten nas bdag /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub pas na/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa yin/ /mang po tshogs par gyur pa na//ro dang dur khrod 'du shes bskyed4/ /grong du 'jug par byed pa na/ /btson ra khri mon 'du shes bskyed/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'gro ba na/ /ngan 'gro nad dang 'ching ba dang / /g.yang 3sa chen po'i 'du shes bskyed6/ /gal te bud sked tshogs mthong na/ /mi gtsang rdzas ni sum cu dang / /'khor ba'i lam 'dren yin par bsam/ /nye du pha ma bu tsha rnams/ /de la chags spangs btang stoms bsam7/ /dgra rnams mthong na 'di dag gis8/ /bzod sdogs byang chub yin par bsam/ /bdag gi longs spyod rdzas la yang /27—535

'dir ni rtsod 1pa'i rgyu dang ni/ /phyi mar ngan 'gror 'khrid par bsam /bdag la bstod pa brjod na yang / /'di ni nga rgyal 'phel byed pas/ /ngan 'gror 'khrid 2par byed pa yin/ /gal te smod pa byung na yang / /'di la bzod bsgom byang chub kyang / /mtshan ma rdzogs par rab tu bsam/ /gnas la zhen pa byung gyur na/ /rmi lam grong khyer ji bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rab tu bsgom4/ /bdag gis deng gi nyin zhig ge7la/ /ngag las bzlas brjod kha ton bya/ /klag sogs bslab las mi 'gal bar/ /de 5/ ring bdag gis smra bar bya/ /lus kyi g.yo ba thams cad kyang / /mchod dang bskor 7ba la sogs pa/ /ngal so don yod nyid du bya/ /rnam rtog phya7gnyen por ma bsdams 9na/ /tshig tu brjod pas ci zhig 'grub/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /gnyen po'i dpung tshogs bskyed nas ni/ /nyon mongs rnams ni dpyis phyin bya/ /bza' btung zhim po za ba'i tshe/ /ro la zhen pa spang bya zhing / /mi gtsang rgyu las byung ba dang / /tha mar mi gtsang 'gyur bar bsam / /reg bya 'jam po tshor ba'i tshe/ /reg bya ji bzhin yin par bsam//'dir mang smos pa ci zhig dgos/ /gang du nyon mongs 'phel ba yi/ /khyem pa 'ang rab tu byung yang rung / /de dag rab tu spang bya zhing / /nyon mongs rnam par mi 'phel ba'i/ /sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gang yang rung / /de dag bsten —pa mig ltar bya/ /bdag ni de 1ring nas brtsams te/ /byang chub snying po mchis bar du/ /rtag tu rab tu byung ba dang / /tshangs par spyod pa nyid du bya/ /nyin mtshan dus las ma yol bar/ /thun mtshams gsum du bsgom par bya/ /srog dang rtsol ba bkag pa dang / /rlung med pa yi mar me 27—536

ltar / /rtag tu spros bral bsgom par bya/ /de nas ldang tshe nga rgyal gyis/ /mtshan dang dpe byad skur ldan pa'i/ /lha yi nga rgyal brtan por bsam/ /mtshan mo'i thun la bab pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs ji ltar gzims pa ltar/ /'jig rten rtog 1spangs bdag nyid nyal/ /mdor na chos rnams thams cad kun / /rmi lam lta bur brtag par bya/ /rnal 'byor sgom 2rnams gtsor bya yis —/ /lus ngag dge ba gtsor 4mi bya/ /chos spyod rnam bcu la sogs la//nyon mongs pas ni ma yengs par/ /bsgrims nas bdag gis 'bad pas bsgrub//rtag tu 'chi bsam ma chags blos5/ /dngos po ci la'ang ma chags par/ /spyod lam ji ltar gnas kyang bsgom/ /bsod nams sems can kun la bsngo/ /byang chub bzang po bdag gis ni/ /rnal 'byor sgom 6pa brtsams pa yis /dge ba zla zer dri med des/ /bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog /rnal 'byor gyi 8mtshan nyid bden pa mkhas pa chen po dpal byang chub bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—537

bsdur mchan/534 tumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉dag rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid bden pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gyi/ rngo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdus/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ 13)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stas/ 3)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po'i/535 41〈〈pe 〉〉 ba/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gi/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bur/ ge〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉skyed/ skye/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayangs/ sgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉srasam/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/536 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsod/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skasad/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thang / /④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgom/gnye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gos nyin zhag 57〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉de/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgor/ du 〈〈pe 〉〉rtogs/9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdums/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brten/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/537 51〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ci ma〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bya'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btsor/〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉slos/ phyo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ citsu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ glu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyes/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1287)27wa 538

༄ / /shes rab brtsam pa dus kyi gtam zhes bya ba/ri1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradzñā tar+sha gasgo shi pā ri ka thā nā ma/ bod skad du/ shes rab brtsam pa dus kyi 2gtam zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen 'khor lo zag med spros pa rgyas pa'i sgu dang chos/ /tshogs pa'i zhing dang dngos grub rtsa ba rnams la phyag 'tshal te//gal te brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa'i dus min gyi/ /yin pa'i rtags dang ldan dus rtag — tu bzod med brtsam4/ /slob dpon slob ma tshol ba dang / /rin chen rnyed par bsgrub 5pa dang / /slob ma don drin slar 'don 6dang / /dbang bsgur 3 sked par slar 'dod dang / /re ba'i gos kyis 'gro ba dang / /lci ba'i zas kyis 'tsho ba dang / /mi phyed rnyed sogs rtsod pa dang / /drag pos gzhan zil gnon 'dod dang / /sku gzugs rtsod 8pas 'jig pa dang / /mig can 'gran zlas sgod / gyur dang / /dge slong gnas la rtsod pa dang / /grub mtha' skur pas sun 27—539

'byin dang / /'gro rnams spyod pa lta ba dang / /mkha' 'gro 'bras bur 'pho ba dang / /rin chen grags pa 'das pa dang / /mi rnams g.yo sgyus 'tsho ba dang / /shing rnams g.yab mos g.yab 1pa dang / /ri rnams cho nges 'debs pa dang / /chu rnams me yi 'od 'byin dang / /skal ba can la zhegrags min brjod/ /rtsod rtags nyi shu rdzogs pa yis/ /bram ze mo yi mar me 'dra/ /kye lha dang drang srong 'tsho ba'i dus 'das bsam/ /snying rjes dman pa rjes 'dzin zla 'byung dus/ /skyabs su 'gro ba dam pa'i rten 'brel na/ /'chi ba'i dus tshe sdug bsngal sogs 'byung 'gyur/ /kye skye ba bzang thob skyes 1ngan bud med kyis/ /lus dang ngag yid sdom pa mchog gsum la/ /brtse ldan dmigs med 'byel pa mi gnas pa//dam par 'gyur tshul bral na nges par 'ching / /kye dngos grub nye bar rnyed par 4ma btsal na/ /rang gi bde chen 'bad pas rtogs mi 'gyur/ /'od gsal ma brnyes nyon mongs lam mi 'gyur/ /ngag dang mi ldan chos nyid rgyas gdab bral/ /bden pa bral bas nges 'byin rnyed mi 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs brtan 5te ma byas gsal mi rnyed/ /sems kyi mel tshe bral bas mchog thob min/ /dbang po ma yengs skye ba rnal 'byor rnams/ /'dod pas ma g.yeng bya ba la mi 'jug /man ngag 'gro la ma g.yeng gnyid ma ldog /dam pa'i brgyud pa ma bskam 'bras ma bcad/ /kye7 / kye ma rtag tu phyi nang mnyam par blta/ /dus ni yun thun 8'di la ma rdzogs na/ /dus 'gyur ba yis 9 dus rab rnyed mi 'gyur/ /de bas brtson 'grus dus la bab kyis byos/ /rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas bram ze ste/ /'dod la rab chags bha bye ti/ /ngoms med nyams bral bha lo sha /da ni dus 'das nyi ma 'dra//bdag gis gdams pa 'di bris pas/ /rim gyis lam la rtsol 'gyur shog /27—540

༄/ /ting nge 'dze+en tshogs kyi le'u/tsho༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa mā bye sam+bha ra pa ri brta/ bod skad du/ting nge 'dzin 2tshogs kyi le'u/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po'i snying rje'i stobs las byung / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems brtan bya/ /srid pa'i longs spyod bde ma chags/ /yongs su 'dzin pa rgyab kyis phyogs/ /dad sogs nor ni phun sum tshogs/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dang mnyam gus/ /des bstan dam tshig spyod pa ni/ /yongs su bskyang la rab tu brtson/ /bum pa gsang ba'i dbang bsgur 5ba/ /bla ma'i drin gyis yongs su thob/ /lus ngag sems ni rnam dag pa'i/ /sgrub 9pa po de dngos grub snod/ /ting 'dzin yan lag las byung ba'i/ /tshogs ni yongs su rdzogs pa las/ /myur du dngos grub thob 'gyur ba/ /de ltar gsang sngags tshul gnas yin/ /ting 'dzin yan lag nyams gyur cing / /de yi mi mthun phyogs gnas na/ /byeb 27—542

bye ba stong gis kyang / /ting 'dzin rab tu grub mi 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin ni rab grub phyir/ /gsang sngags spyod gnas rnal 'byor pas/ /de las gzhan pa'i sems spangs te/ /g.yeng 1med brtson pas 'bad par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag dang / /mi mthun phyogs gang nges bya'i phyir/ /ting 'dzin yan lag mi mthun phyogs/ /de ni mdor bsdus nas bshad bya/ /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang / /longs spyod rnams la stos med nyid/ /bzod ldan dam bca' brtan pa dang / /skye bo 'du 'dzi rnam par spang / /lus dang ngag yid las rnams la/ /shes bzhin dang ni ldan pa dang / /sangs rgyas skur 'dogs dran pa yi/ /lus kyi rjes dran yang dag ldan/ /dus gang du ni bya ba yi / /rjes dran de la brtan pa dang / /sgrib pa lnga ni spang ba dang / /zas kyi tshod rig spyod lam ran/ /'jig rten chos ni thams cad la/ /rtag tu sems ni btang stoms dang / /yo byad bsnyungs 'di yan lag ste/ /go bzlog pa ni mi mthun phyogs/ /ting 4'dzin tshogs kyi 5le'u bkod pa'i bsod nams des/ /'akro bas ting 'dzin rdo rje lta bu thob par shog /ting nge 'dzin gye tshogs kyi le'u slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong shākya blo gros kyis bsgyur byung zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //27—57 3

༄khya/ /'jog rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo ka a ti ta sap+ta ka bi byeḥ2/ bod skad du/'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag gnas phyag byed phyag rnams ni/ /gang tshe tha dad mi dmigs pa/ /de 'dir sngags pa'i phyag yin te/ /rdo rje'i phyag ces brjod pa yin/ /mchod gnas mchog 4byed mchod pa rnams/ /gang tshe sna tshogs mi dmigs pa/ /de tshe mchod pa chen po ste/ /rdo rje'i 5mchod pa zhes brjod do/ /bshags bya 'chag 6byed bshags pa rnams/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor pas ma mthong //rang bzhin dag par yang dag mthong / /de 'dir bshags pa'i mchog yin no/ /jes yi rang bya thams cad dang / /bdag dang rjes su yi rang ba/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mnyam par mthong / /rjes su yi rang dam pa yin/ /sgyu mas 27—545

sprul pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /sgyu mas sprul pa'i lus can phyir/ /brag ca lta bu'i chos rnams ni/ /bstan par yang dag skul 'debs pa/ /sprul pa dag dang mtshungs par ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas skul byed cing / /rdo rje rnal 'byor mnyam par mthong / /sgul 1bar byed pa'i mchog tu 'dod/ /mya ngan 'das/ bzhed sangs rgyas rnams/ /'khor bar sprul pa bzhin du ni/ /sems can sprul pa'i don gyi phyir/ /bzhugs par gsol 'debs de nyid rig pa /'jig rten 'das pa nyid kyi phyir/ /de 'dir gsol 'debs mchog tu 'dod/ /dmigs pa can du 'jug pa nyid/ /thams cad 'jig rten pa nyid yin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rmi 'dra la/ /de nyid rig pas rmi 'drar rig /rmi 'dra'i srid par gnas pa yin/ /sems can rnams la phan btags pas/ /chos/ dbyengs bzhin du dpag med par/ /dge ba thams cad yongs bsngo 4na/ /de 'dir bsngo ba dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags5/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis dpal bsam yas lcun gyis grub pa'i gtsus lag khang chen por mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—546

༄/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ su ga ta shā sa na rat+na bha 2hi da dra nā ma/ /bod skad du/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse ldan rtogs bcas lung gis 4 phyug /smra mkhas skyo ba med yid thul/ /sbyangs sdom dbang po rab zhi ba'i/ /bla ma la btud de bstan bshad/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i da' ba sprin 'dra las 'bras jes 'brel sbug bsngal can/ /gnas la rab dad 'asngo la brtse dang chos rab rnam 'byed brtson 'grus dang / /gus pas mchog gsol cho ga bzang ldan mnyam par 'jog brtson legs bsngor bcas/ /bsam bya bsgrub bya rnal 'byor mchog spyod srid zhi'i rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru/ /rus sba'/ gyis ni gnya' shing dang / /yungs 'bru khab kyi bu gar dang / /rtsig ngos lani sran 'bras ltar/ /dal ba shin tu rnyed dkar 7gsungs/ /gang phyir las 27—5/8
