—sde ————dodacan kun gyi las/ /rgyun ltar thur du lhang phyir dang / /der yang mi dge 'phel phyir dang / /min yang legs spyad 1bya dka'i phyir/ /rten 'di thob dka' de bzhin du/ /ji tsam rnyed dka' de tsam gyis/ /snying po med pa'i lus 'di las/ /snying po dam pa btsal bar bya/ /de phyir bdag la legs 'dod pas/ /skyes bu'i don bsgrub bya ba'i phyir/ /rgya mtshor byeng bas rnyed pa yi / /gru bo lta bur lus 'di spyad/ /srog 'di 'dus byas yin phyir dang / /chi/ sdod 2 phyir dang rkyen mang phyir/ /de bzhin snying po med pa'i phyir/ /'chi bdag gis bdag myur za nges/ /lus dang longs spyod sbug pa yi/ /mdza' rnams rjes 'brang mi 'gyur zhing / /mgon med gadrug pu gyi nar ni/ /'jig bhen pha rol 'dong bar byed/ /re zhig tshe rabs 'ga' lta zhig /nyon mongs mi 'gyur gdeng thob pa'am / /bdag la yang ye 4mi snang na/ /ci phyir bdag yid bde bar 'dug /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'di'i dgos pa khyad bsad byung / /mgo la me shor bsgrims 5pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa sla da ma'i don bsgrub bya/ /mthong dang ma mthong myong ba yi/ /rnam smin rgyu rnga/thun dbang gi las/ /mngar skyur kha la rang rgyu bzhin/ /slu drad las 'bras 'brel par 'dod/ /mkha' ltar 'gag med sems nyid la/ /sna tshogs bag chags sprin tshogs 'khyegs/ /smin gyur 6char gyi rgyun 'bab pas/ /rjes myong lo tog smin par byed/ /chos kun rten cing 'brel 'byung zhing / /rten med deyirten yin te/ /brten pa'i rgyu 'bras gshis yin phyir/ /dkar gnag las 'bras 'byel pa nyid/ /slu med so sor nges phyir dang / /chung las che nyid 'byung phyir dang / /sngon byung da dung myong 'gyur phyir/ /blo ldan blang 27—bye /9

dor 'bad par rigs/ /de ltar las de dang de yi/ /'bras bu sdug bsnga'/ bsam yas kyis/ /skye dgu kun du gdung ba yang / /rnge lce yi 1ni so ma'/ bzhin / /de ni 'du byed 'gyur ba dang / /sdug bsngal gyi yang sdug bsnga' sogs / /skye rga na dang rgud dang 'chi/ /phrad bral bsrung dka' tshol 'a/ sogs / /ji ltar bkra shis rna nag dang / /dri mi zhim dang mi gtsang bzhin/ /sdug bsngal nye bar len pa la/ /lhan skyes rtag tu 'byel pa yin/ /rmongs/ rnams sdug bsngal gyis skrag bzhin/ /de yi rgyu la dga' mgur spyod/ /mi gang nad la dug bzhin du/ /shes pas gnyis spong de mkhas pa/ /bskal mang rnyed dka'i dal ba legs rnyed brag rum u dus+thā 2ra bzhin/ /gang thob sros 'di'ang rtag tu mi rung ri gzar khrod kyi klung rgyun 'dra/ /lus can rnams kyi dkar nag las kyang sa bon dang ni lo tog mtshungs/ /'di dag tu ni snyus bsngal gdung ba'ang me 'obs 'bar ba'i spe lce bzhin/ /zhes bya ba ni bsam/ par bya ba'i gnas bzhi'i chos mdor basbu ba'o// //skyabs gsum thar pa las 'bras la/ /rab dang mngon 'dod yid ches/ dang / /rnyog med yid gzhungs rnam par nges/ /gus spyor je tshom med par rgyu//yon tan shes pa nyid dang de/ /cig shos skyon mthong yid 'byung bcas/ /rtags myong khong du chud gyur la/ / brten nas dang ba 4thob par 'gyur/ /bya ba kun sngon 'gro phyir dang / /byed pa yi ni rgyu nyid phyir/ /sa bon tshis las myu gu bzhin/ /chos kun spro ba med la min/ /'di na gang la rab dang yod / /de yis dngos gang bsgrub dka' ba/ /de yang gzhan gyis bya sla bas///27—byebye0

rab tu sla bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems can chos dang chos nyid la/ /brtse rtogs mtshan ma med snying rje/ /mi bzod mngon du byed rtog med/ /don shes dri ma zad spyor rgyu/ /gnyen tshogs sdug bsngal mthong dran dang / /gang zag chos bdag med nyid dang / /rigs lung man ngag gis phye bas/ /mthong phyir gzhan zhugs brtse ba skye/ /sku gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /rin chen sems kyi rgyu phyir dang / /ji ltar khab la khab len bzhin/ /'gro ba sdud par byed phyir te/ /de bzhin de yi khyad par gyis/ /rgyal sras mdzad pa khyad par phyir / /sman shing ljon pa lta bu yi/ /phun tshogs snying rje bskyed par byos/ /sgyu mas sprul pa'i grong khyer du/ /skyes bu de dag dga' dang gdung / /yul dus rnam kun shin tu ba/ /snang mtshungs don ma grub rtogs shes/ /ma 'gags mu mthar thug min dang / /skye ba med las skye phyir ni/ /snang 'gyur sang skyes skye med dang / /rten 'byel rtsa ba zad phyir stong / /de la gang snang la/ sogs phyir/ /'khor ba'o de nyid de tshe der/ /dpyad na ma/kha' ltar dben ji/ na / /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das par brjod/ /de ni mi rtogs rtogs dka' zhing / /rtogs na nges par grol 'gyur phyir/ /rab zab zab cing ngo rnga/tshar phyir/ /mkhas pas 'dzin pa rnam par gzhig /'bras bu bzang rnams mthong nyid dang / /'grub pa 'bad pa la rag phyir/ /rgyun 'brel bom/sa pas don thob shes/ /bsam brtson phyir mi ldog brtson 'grus/ /sa'-in skyon 'di yi yon tan rig /gnyid sogs stom bral zhum med dang / /thabs sbyangs snying brtan rtul 4phod dpa'/ /skal ldan spro ba rnam par 'phel/ /rlung rtsed rnam g.yo mi 'byung bzhin/ /brtson bral legs spyad ga la yod/ /spro rdzo7—bye5/

ldan skad cig nyid la yang / /ri rab thal bar brlag sems bskyed/ /kye ma/ ho gzhan du yid brtan med/ /nying mtshams tshe na long med de/ /gson tshe 'ang bsel khang mar me bzhin/ /ci phyir bdag blo ngal bar gnas/ /bdag nyid pad+mo dmar gsal rab dga' dri sked dad pa'i nyi zer 'bar bas rnam phye ba/ /mtha' yas 'gro la brtse ba'i chab brlan rjes chags ut+pal mig gi rdzi rab dkrugs nas ni/ /sna tshogs snang sems shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rten cing 'byel 'byung rang bzhin stong pa nyid rig dang / /srid pa'i dgra tshogs skyon mang gis skrag phang du sbrul 'ong brtson pa bzhin du brtson par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni bsgrub par bya ba'i gnas bzhi'i chos mdor bsdu ba'o / /—1srid zhi'i skyon yon dran byas nas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub phyir//yid bzhin nor la byi dor bzhin/ /de nas dngos grub mchog gsol bya/ /sang phyir bskal pa brgya phrag tu/ /'bad kyang phyogs tsam mi rnyed pa/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la thob bya'i phyir/ /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor cho ga yis/ /ji bzhin mngon du byas nas su/ /re ba nyid dang gdung ba dang / /gus pas rten gnyis gsol ba gdab/ /gang tshe lhar bcas bla ma yi/ /byin rlabs 2snying la gang babs pa/ /de tshe shel ltar dang ba yi/ /sems thob spro bas non par 'gyur/ /rnam dag gsum gyis bsgyur byas nas/ /'od gsal gyis ni dri med bya/ /zung du 'jug pas ye shes te/ /dbang bsgyur 3spyor bas phrin las bsgrub/ /lha dang sngags dang ting 'dzin nyid/ /snang grag —dran pa nyid med nyid/ /sna tshogs bral ba kun snang zhing / /gang 27——5bye2

snang gzhan gyi dbang can no/ /'di dag lus ngag yid rim bzhin/ /dri ma 'khru bar byed phyir dang / /mchog byed ro gcig byed pa'i phyir/ /don sgrub 1byed phyir rnam par gzhag2 /bdag nyid rtogs par byed phyir dang / /rtogs pas grol phyir grol ba nyid/ /gzhan don rnam par 'phrul pa'i phyir/ /lam 'di jeg gzhan las khyad 'phags/ /rnal 'byor chen po rang gi sems/ /dri pred rab dang sim byed phyir/ /mkha' dang zla 'od bden mthong zhing / /mi rtog 'od gsal bde chen brjod/ /sgyu ma nyid dang de snang dang / /de dag ji bzhin chos rnams kun/ /sems yin de nyid 'od gsal phyir/ /blo mchog rnam par mi rtog go/ /rang bzhin kun du ma 'gags shing / /rnam pa sna tshogs rang snang ba/ /kun khyab rnyog pa rnged mtshan nyid/ /skal bzang 'od gsal ting 'dzin bshad/ /mchog mthong phyir dang rdul med phyir / /dngos bral dngos la mngon chub phyir/ /chags bral zag pa med rab zhi/ /sim gyur bde ba chen por 'dod/ /de ltar 'di skyes dge ba yang / /mtshan ma me+ed cing 4rgya che nyid/ /stong nyid snying rjer bcas sems kyis/ /mchog spyod sgu gnyis legs bsngo bya/ /rmi lam yul gyi 'du byed bzhin/ /gang phyir gang du gang gis gang / /ji ltar bsgrub pa mi dmigs phyir/ /dge ba mtshan ma med par gsungs/ /dmigs med dmigs par rab gsal ba/ /ngo bo ngo bo rnged jes 'brel/ /rnam lnga yan lag snang ba'i gzhi/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi tshogs rab yin/ /gang zhig chog 5shes gang zag shes/ /shes rab thabs bcas chags bral chags/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das bsngo ba/ /bdag nyid chen po'i ngo mtshar rmad/ /gang snying cod pan chu skyes dmar rgyas lha mchog gis mtshan 27—5/ pya 3

rdzogs sangs stong ldan mgon pos brgyan/ /phyi nang gsang bdag dri med ye shes lhan cig skyes rol 'od kyi spyor bas rnam par rtsen1/ /sprin bral mkha' dang zla rgyas zer ltar dag cing rab gsal bde chen yid rab sim pa dang / /gang skyes dge tshogs rin chen mda' de'ang brtse ba'i gzhus bskyong 'gro la yonganu/ 'phen de dpa' bo/ /zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor du bya ba'i gnas bzhi'i chos mdor basbu ba'o// //srid mtshor 2rab gnas nyon mongs chu srin kha gdengs gnas/ /sbug bsngal rlabs 4'khrug gting mtha' med mngon 'jigs pa dang / /zhi ba mching bu'i mtsho chen dkar 'khyel gnyis ka las/ /sgrol byed bstan pa rin chen gru mchog bzang 'di yin/ /legs sbyar bdag blo rab dang dga' ba dang / /snying brtses yid gzhungs 'bad byas dge ba 'dis/ /'gro rnams sngon gyi rgyal bas ma bsgral ba/ /de dag legs sgrol ded dpon mchog bdag gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gru bo zhes bya ba grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a dzi ta mi tra gup+tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //6

bsdur mchan/548 namatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bhi/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtog gi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉des/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wabasgru ba bya/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po ra/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thus/549 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyang / 3〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stagadod/ tsho ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'ang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yong yi/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrim/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/550 41〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yis/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum wa/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganag 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rten nas dad pa/551 41〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ — ci〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stoms/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtul/552 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ska/ // 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grags/553 41〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyed/zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chos/554 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsen/ tshoge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mtsho/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadangs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toraching / sgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 paṇ+ḍi ta dza ga ta mi a nan+ta dang bud+dha shrī dzñā na dang lo tsā ba byams pa dpal gyis bsna/ra ba'o// //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1291)27wa 555

༄/ /dpal 'ching ba rnam grol gyi bstan bcos/ ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bad+dhā bi muk+ta shān+t+ra/ bod skad du/dpal 'ching ba rnam grol gyi bstan bcos/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig ma rtogs rtogs dka' 2rtogs na de nyid dus/ /'ching ba mi bzad shin tu grol dka' grol 'gyur ba/ /bdas dang gzhan don phun tshogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam/ /ngo mtshar de ni 'asngo ba bsgral phyir bdag gis bshad/ /gyad kyi nor bu la sogs bzhin/ /snying ngo/ de ni gzhan min gnas/ /gang phyir thams cad rang gis rang 'ching dang gol 4bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /'di na 'ching ba gang yang med/ /'ching ba gang yin de grol ba'o/ /de ni stong dang rten 'brel 'jug /de phyir phongs/ pas mi rtogs so/ /dman dang log pa'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /zin gyur bsod nams brtson 'grus zhen/ /sbyangs stobs blo gros chung ba yi/ /byebo 27—byebye6

——rnams kyis rtogs dka'o/ /rtogs ldan snying brtse man ngag mkhas/ /bshes gnyen dam pa btsal bar bya/ /de ni srog 1lus longs spyod sogs/ /rnam kun dri med gus pas bsten/ /ji srid bdag sems brtan gyur pa/ /de srid lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /de yi rjes su bstan pa ni/ /rten 'byel stong nyid bdud rtsi'i chu/ /skom pas gdungs la chu bsil bzhin/ /dga' mgu mi zad 2dang bas btung / /lam gzhan phun tshogs nges 'byung min/ /de shes thabs dang shes rab yin/ /de ni chos sgo kun gyi sgo/ /rtogs dka' rtogs byed dam pa'i lam/ /ji ltar rten 'byel tsam nyid phyir/ /de ni ji ltar stong ma yin/ /gang phyir stong pa nyid yin na/ /de ni mkha' ltar 'gag rnged phyir/ /ci phyir rten cing 'byel mi 'byung / /de phyir de gnyis gnyis ma yin/ /de la rten 'byel ji lta bu/ /de yi stong nyid gang zhe na/ /nyon cig 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos/ /dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab gsal ba/ /sna tshogs bde dang sdug bsngal sogs/ /'di dag rang 'byung rgyu med min/ /rgyu gzhan ma yin ma nges min / /mngar skyur kha la rang rgyu yin/ /sems nyid rten cing 'brel par 'byung / /ji ltar mkha' la sprin bzhin no/ /kye ma srid pa'i nags tshal du/ /sdug bsngal lo 'bras cher lhags shing / /nyes par spyad pa'i yal ga can/ /'dzin pa'i me tog rab gsal ba'o/ /de rgyu chags sdang tshul min sdong / /bdag tu lta ba'i rtsa brtan te/ /mi shes bag chags bcas drod gsher/ /sa chen 'byung ba las bskyed pa'o/ /mkha' la snod kyi 'jig rten ltar/ /e ma'o rten sked rten gyur pa/ /rten 'brel brtan pa rnams kyi mchog /re zhig rten ni ma grub na/ /brten pa ji ltar rnam gzhag rung / /bdag med de lta bden 27—557

min na/ /des bskyed chags sogs las rnams sogs/ /gang du ji ltar nges par bya/ /de ma grub na sdug bsngal gang / /de myong nyid kyang su zhig brjod/ /ji ltar sdong po'i rtsa phyung na/ /bcad pa'i bya ba grub pa ltar/ /gzhir gyur bdag rtogs rnam 1bzlog pas/ /mkhas pa de bzhin srid pa gzhig2 /bsregs bcad bdar bas gser sogs bzhin/ /'di ltar bdag dang gzhan pa zhes/ /bya ba ji ltar rten dang gnas/ /ngo bo mtshan nyid brtag par byos/ /de la lus ngag rlung dang yid/ /phyi nang bar sogs 'di dag ni/ /nam yang rten byed gnas gyur pa/ /sus kyang nges par mi nus so/ /gang phyir bdag de snang rung na/ /dmigs gyur dmigs pa med pa'i phyir/ /mi snang sems dang sems min smos/ /sems ni rang bzhin stong bdag nyid/ /sems min mi rtag rten 'byel bdag /rnam par dpyad na spros med do/ /rtag la bya ba 'gal ba'i phyir/ /gang na ci 'dra bdag bstan byos/ /mdor na 'dir mang smra mi bya/ /bdag de rang gi sgo gsum las/ /gzhan na 'dir sgod ci zhig byas/ /mtshon gyi rma ltar nyes pa yang / /byis pa rnams kyi rang rtags 4dang / /log sred skye bo'i rtsod 5par zad/ /gzhan min de dag rnam dpyad na/ /ji ltar gang zhig bdag tu 'gyur/ /de min de rten de gnas gang / /gang yang 'di dag de rten dang / /de gnas phyogs kyang rnam dpyad kyi6 / /tshul 'dis bdag dngos bdag mtshan nyid/ /sgyu ltar legs grub bstan pa yin/ /ltos shig tshul 'di chu shing 'dra/ /ngag ni brag ca mkha' 'dra yid / /rdul tsam dmigs pa yod min na/ /'di la ji ltar bdag tu brtag /phyi ni phyi rol nang yang gzhan/ /des na bar yang de dag 7min/ /gang yang rdzo7—558

de ni dkar sogs min1/ /ring dang thung dang sgom dang phra/ /mthug 2dang srab ces bya la sogs/ /mtshan nyid nges par nus ma yin/ /ci ste shing la 'khril shing bzhin/ /de ni kun gzhi'am bag chags la/ /brten te mi mngon gnas she na/ /snang dang mi snang rnam dpyad dang / /de nyid sems dang sems min zhes/ /sngar bzhin brtag pa mtshungs par 'gyur/ /'on te sems ni gang yin pa/ /de nyid bdag ces bya zhe na/ /sems ni dmigs gred 'od gsal phyir/ /da ni bdag de bdag med 'gyur/ /e ma'o shin tu rtogs dka'i gnas/ /e ma'o e ma shin tu rmad/ /e ma'o mkhas pas shes par rung / /e ma'o shes bral shes pa'i dbyings/ /de ltar 'gro ba 'di na bdag /med kyang nga dang nga yi zhes/ /gzung dang 'dzin pas brlabs pa yi /skye bo smyos pa 'di dag ci/ /'on kyang 'jig rten log pas mig /bsgribs nas gzung 4dang 'dzin pa ni/ /ji ltar snang ba ji bzhin bzhag /snang la snang ltar rab chags srid/ /snyug bsngal 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyu/ /bdag cag de las 'da' min nam/ /gal te bdag nyid ma grub kyang / /de 'dzin nyid du bden zhe na/ /'di nyid e ma'o 'gro kun gyi/ /log par 'ching ba mi bzad pas/ /mgo la me shor bsgrims 5pa bzhin/ /rings par myur du ldog par bya/ /grogs dag 'di ltar mngon sum du/ /yang dag rig 6pa'i mig nyid kyis/ /bdag de ma grub des na 'dir/ /gzhan zhes bya ba'ang yod min na / /yu bu thams cad nga snyam dang / /nga'o snyam 7dang gzhan snyam dang / /gzhan gyi 'o zhes log rtog pa/ /'di dag ji ltar gang du dogs/ /dper na rmi lam bu shi ba/ /bu nyid med na de shi yang / /bden par yod pa ma yin pa//27—pya pya9

de bzhin yu bu'i 'dzin pa yang / /e ma'o shin tu ngo mtshar gnas/ /gang zhig gcig nyid rtogs pa yis/ /thams cad rnam par grol 'gyur ba/ /'di la the tshom su zhig skrag /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /phung po khams dang skye mched sogs / /jeg gsum jeg gsum nges 'byung lam/ /ma lus bdag min bdag gis min/ /bdag rnged stong pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /med phyir med la med nyid du/ /tshul bzhin nges par byas pa la/ /kye ma khyod la skyon ci yod/ /gang gang bdag dang bdag gi zhes/ /'dzin pa'i 'ching ba thams cad kyang / /phyi min nang min bar yang min/ /de bzhin lus ngag yod ma yin/ /de dag las min der gnas min / /de bzhin chags dang sdang sogs kyi/ /ma lus yid la byed pa yang / /dpyad na re zhig gang la gang / /gang du gang gis chags pa dang / /sdang bar 'gyur ba'ang ga la yod/ /gzugs sdug sgra snyan dri zhim dang / /ro mngar reg 'jam yid bde'i rkyen/ /'di dag gang gis de shes la/ /ci zhig phan btags /'byel pa yod/ /de shes pas kyang de dag la/ /chags dang rab tu chags 'gyur gang / /de ni phyi nang bar dag dang / /lus sogs dngos po gang zhig yin/ /de min de la 2de brten dang / /skyes dang gnas dang 'gag 'gyur ba/ /sgyu ma yi ni rta glang ltar/ /don du grub pa yod ma yin/ /gang gis bdag la brnyas sogs dang / /smad sogs brdeg sogs byas pa'i rgyu/ /sdang dang rab sdang sems 'byung ba / /'di yang sngar bzhin bdag sems dang / /gang yang pha rol de yi sems/ /mkha' 'dra mtshan ma med pa yin/ /de bzhin gzhan de'i ngag nyid dang / /lus ni dri sgra shing lta bu/ /yin na sgyu mas sgyu ma yi/ /rgyal ltar des 'dir bdag gnod gang / /bdag gi'ang de bzhin ngag dang lus/ /de ltar lus can thams cad 27—560

—kyi'ang / /mtshungs phyir 'di dag skye ba dang / /gnas dang 'gag 'gyur mi dmigs so/ /gang phyir phan tshun 'brel med phyir/ /dpyad na thams cad spros med phyir/ /yul dus rnam kun dri gred phyir/ /mkha' la 'phur ba'i bya rjes bzhin/ /de ltar stong pa'i spyod yul 'dir/ /rmi lam sgra dang 'ja' bzhin du / /gang la gang zhig ji ltar chags/ /de bzhin sdang ba'ang gang du dogs/ /pha dang ma dang chung ma bu/ /gnyen dang bshes pa de bzhin dgra / /sgyu ma ji bzhin nge bzhin pas/ /'dzin pa thams cad gzhig par bya/ /de nyid kyis na chags so/gas kyis/ /las byed de yang ji lta bu/ /yang yang shes rab brtan po yis/ /ma/khas pas sngar bzhin brtag par byos/ /de phyir bde dang sdug bsngal yang / /ngems pos rnam par myong min la/ /rig la dngos po yod min te/ /thog med dus nas log 4sbyangs pa/ /'khrul pas 'dzin pa nyi 5tshe ba/ /de yang dngos po me+ed pa nyid/ /de ltar rnged la rnged nyid du/ /blo bzang rnams kyis goms byas na/ /spyos 6pas gnyen la dgra bzhin du/ /mi bzad 'ching bas bcings pa de/ /sbrul mdud rang gis 'grol 7ba bzhin/ /nges par rnam par grol bar 'gyur/ /rnam grol rnam grol las byung ba'i/ /'bras bu lhan gyis 8grub pa gang / /don gnyis phun tshogs ngo mtshar ba/ /de ni bum pa bzang po bzhin / / dpal 'ching ba rnam grol gyi bstan bcos rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po grub pa brnyes pa'i dpal be+eska laṅkas mdzad pa sgogs so// //rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tā nan+da'i zhal snga nas/kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bud+dhā shrī bha dras gtan la phab nas bod kyi lo chung gnubs tshul khrims shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //

༄khya/ /lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag ces bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi shud+dhā dar+sha na tsar+ya u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmi lam lta bur phyi rol min/ /sgyu ma lta bur bden don med/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid bral/ /chos kun rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /'gro 'ong gnas med byang chub sems/ /rgya chen sems can don la mkhas/ /tshogs gnyis dbyer med lam gyi mchog /stong nyid snying rje'i snyi/nga po bsgom2/ /lta spyod rnam dag gi man ngag ces bya ba kha che'i rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal chos kyi shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis khro phu bzang lung du bsgyur ba'o// //27—563

bsdur mchan/563 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rin lta spyod rnam das si man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so// sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rje/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1293)27wa 564

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta rat+na bai sho dha māṃ mārga lo/ bod skad du/sems rin po che sbyang ba'i lam 'bras/ rje btsun mi pham mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor myur du 'jig /las dang de 'bras sbug bsngal yin/ /de spong shes rab snying rje bsgom/ /skyes gsum lam gyes don gsum thob / /dam pa gsum gyis bsod nams bsags/ /rgya chen thabs kyis yang dag spel/ /shes rab zab mos rnam dag bya/ /zung 'jug bsngo bas rgyas gdab po/ /kha che'i rigs las bal yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal lnga rig pa'i mchog bud+dhā 4shrī dzñā na'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa sems rin po chesbyang ba'i lam 'bras zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bal yul yam 'gal gyi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //27—565

1368༄7/ /'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ban+dha bi musto pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ho gang gis 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam/ /'di na 'ching ba gang yang rnged/ /'ching ba gang yin des grol ba'o/ /'dod chags bde ba chen por dag /zhe sdang 'od gsal me lce 'bar/ /gti mug rnam par mi rtog nyid/ /dug gsum sgu gsum lhan gyis grub/ /'ching ba rnam grol gyi man ngag ces bya ba/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+da'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa sdogs so// //rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug de nyid kyi spyan sngar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyes bal yul gu lang gser khang du bsgyur ba'o// //27—567
bsdur mchan/567 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tog 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snam/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1295)

sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ sid+dhā 2 sad+mārga nirna lo ta / bod skad du/grub pa dam pa'i lam nges pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khad+ma pā 4ṇi 'jig rten dpal/ /thugs rje chen po ston nga/'i mthus/ /gdul dka'i rang sems gdul ba la/ /snying po bla med rnam sasum thob/ /kye ma ho 'dzam gling skye bo nyon/ /'gro ba'i bshes gnyen 'di skad smra/ /gang zhig 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam//rdu ga bsngal rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che/ /de yi ngo bo lam dang thabs/ /bshes gnyen kun dga'i gdams pa yin/ /e ma'o/ /milus rin chen rnyed par dka'/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor sprin ltar g.yo/ /'khor ba thams cad sbug bsngal te/ /rang sems mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /rgya mtshor bying bas rnyed pa'i gru/ /chu rgyun drag po'i dba' dang ni/ /dug can 27——569

sbrul gyi tshang bzhin dang / /ston gyi nam mkha'i gung bzhin no/ /longs spyod ci 'dra khyim gyi sbra1/ /bshes pa ci 'dra tshong khang mi/ /rang lus ci 'dra sbru'/ gyi lpags/ /tshe srog ci 'dra ri gzar chu/ /kye ma ho mi rtag srin po yi/ /khar chud ma gyur de srid bar/ /grogs dag srid pa ru bzlog la/ /sgrim par gyis shig bzhin bzang dag /sgyu ma'i grong khyer yangs pa na/ /rmi lam skyes bu longs spyod pa/ /sems nyid rten 2cing 'byel par 'byung / /snang sems nge ltar shes par bya/ /ltos shig lus ni chu shing 'dra/ /ngag ni brag ca mkha' 'dra yid/ /rdul tsam dmigs pa yod min na/ /bu dag gang la su zhig 'ching / /yu bu thams cad nga snyam dang / /nga'o snyam dang gzhan snyam dang / /gzhan gyi 'o zhes log rtog pa/ /'di dag ji ltar gang du dogs/ /ji ltar dri/ lam bu shi ba/ /bu nyid med na de shi yang / /bden par yod pa ma yin pa/ /de bzhin yu bu'i 'dzin pa yang / /chos kun rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir/ /zas gos nor dang grogs bshes dgra/ /sna tshogs snang ba 'di dag kun/ /sgyu ma yi ni rta glang bzhin/ /gang shar sor bzhag dran pa yin/ /dran pa rang grol bral ba ste/ /bral ba ro mnyam lcun gyis grub/ /snying po'i gseb 4lam rnam nga/ gsum / /spra5//‘ //

༄/ /rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems mdud pa 'grol ba'i man ngag1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ swa tsit+ta 2yo gi gran+d+ra ka to pa de sha /bod skad du/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems mdud pa 'gol ba'i man ngag /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /'khor dang 'das pa'i byed rgyu can/ /gzhan min rang gi snying dbus gnas/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par 'gyur/ /kye ho bzhin bzang nga la nyon/ /gang gis 'ching bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /de nyid grol bar byed pa'i lam/ /'di na 'ching ba gang yang med/ /rmi lam grong khyer yangs pa na/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu longs spyod pa/ /longs spyod dus na longs spyod med/ /snang sems de ltar shes par bya/ /sna tshogs snang ba rang gi sems/ /de ni sprul pa'i tshogs 'dus bzhin/ /rang sems dbang po'i gzhu 'dra ba/ /gnyug ma 'od gsal lcun gyis 4grub/ /gang shar thams cad 27—572

de yin te/ /de ni gang du'ang ma shar ba'o/ /de phyir gang skyes de ma skyes/ /ma skyes pa nyid skye ba'i tshul/ /me long gzugs dang pi wang sgra/ /dge slong sprul nga/ rdzu 'phrul bzhin/ /yod dang med dang skye 'gag dang / /'gro 'ong mtshan nyid rtogs par gyis/ /sgyu ma yi ni rta glang ltar/ /snang ba rten cing 'byel nga/ra 'byung / /de nyid ston gyi mkha' bzhin du/ /'od gsal chos gsum sbyar bar bya/ /e ma'o rnal 'byor rgyal po che/ /e ma'o ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /e ma'o ma spangs lcun gyis grub/ /e ma'o e ma'o bde ba che/ /ma rtogs 1'go la rang dbang du/ /snying rje chen po'i dbang gis na sa/ /dmigs gred rnam kun yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /bsod nams ye shes phun tshogs 'gyur/ /rang gi sems kyi mdud pa 'grol ba'i gdams pa rdzogs so// //bla ma mi tra ā nan+da zhes bya ba sbas pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid bod yul kha ba can gyi mthil bkra shis kyi tshong 'dus 4chen po 'gur mo rin po che'i gling du byon nga/'i tshe mdo sngags kyi bdag po chen po/ rgya/ 'bre/ lam/ lo/ dro/sashen drug gis zhus pa'i don du gsungs pa/ phyag rgya chen bo chig chod kyi do ha sanubs lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o// //

༄khya/ /dpal rnal 'byor bdun gyi lam —rnam par ngas pa 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī sap+ta yo ga mārga bi nibya ya/ bod skad du/dpal rnal 'byor bdun gyi lam rnam par nges pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi zhal gyi bka' drin gyis/ /gdul dka'i rang sems 'dul ba la/ /snying ngo/'i man ngag rnam bdun thob/ /kye ho bzhin 2bzang nga la nyon/ /thog med 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'dir/ /khyed cig gang gis 'khor gyur pa/ /e ma ho 4de nyid de yi rgyu/ /gdod nas rnam grol rang gi sems/ /gang phyir thams cad rang gi ngang / /'ching dang grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /'di na 'ching ba gang yang med/ /'ching ba gang yin de grol ba'o/ /grol ba'i lam ni mkhas par rig /kye kye e ma ho e ma ho5/ sbug bsngal rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru//rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /'di yi ngo bo byang chub sems/ /de yi ngo bo 27——mi 7pya

stong pa nyid/ /de dbyer med pa can yin no/ /'grub pa tshad med rnams kyi bdag /bsgul ba bsgyur ba spro ba dang / /dran dang bral ba lcun gyis grub/ /gnyug ma 'od gsal byang chub sems/ /mi rtag sbug bsngal bdag med kyi/ /srid la chags med bskul bar bya/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam dag gis/ /snang sems ye shes bsgyur bar bya/ /rten 'byel stong nyid snying rje yis/ /'khor 'das 'gro ba'i don rab spro/ /gang shar sor bzhag dran pa yin/ /dran nga/ rang grol bral ba ste/ /bral ba ro mnyam lhan gyis grub/ /gang shar ngo bo ma bcos pa/ /gnyug ma'i de nyid yul dbang gis/ /sna tshogs 'gyu ba stong pa ni/ /sems nyid zab mo'i 'od gsal yin/ /'od gsal gang yin bye yi ro/ /brtse chen rab 'byams byang chub sems/ /de yi 'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal/ /bla ma'i mthu yis/ 'dzam gling gi/ /mig byin grogs po'i ming can la/ /ngal so'i man ngag rnam pa bdun/ /dpal rnal 'byor rnam pa bdun gye lam rnam par nges pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+da'i 1 thugs kyi 'khor lo dam pa bkra shis kyi tshong 'dus 2chen po dpal 'gur rdomo rin po che'i gling du dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rgya/ 'bre/ lam/ lo/ dro/ gshen drub gi don du mdzad pa'i bstan bcos de kho na nyid rnal du mtshon pa'i man ngag jordogs so// //427—576

bsdur mchan/575 41 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉khon dpal rnal 'byor bdun gyi lam rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka'in/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cagazi 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ma'o/ ci'i〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o e ma'o/576 ) 〈〈pe 〉snas nan+da'i/ 〈〈snar 〉srasanarnya'i/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dus/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pagur/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉mi tra dzo kyis mdzad pa de nyid dang khro phu ba yis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur 'bras re'u mig rgyud/ (1298 )

༄/ /ting nge 'dze+en gyi dbang bad+kur ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa mā dhi a bhe ṣe ka /bod skad du/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba/ dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dpal ldan bdud bzhi'i dgra bcom byang chub mchog dbang nyid brnyes nas/ /thugs rjes mi bsnyel lus can gzhan yang zhi ba bla med lam bzang du/ /smin mdzad dbang stsol sa gsum bdag po spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud de/ /skal ldan ting 'dzin ye shes sems spyod rnam dag dbang bsgur cho ga bshad / /2yid 'ong gnas su bde ba yi/ /rkyen tshogs dam tshig kun ldan pas/ /snying rje chen po mdun bzhag la/ /gus pas sngon du gsol ba gdab/ /'dom gang srid 'phags nam mkhar ni/ /thub pa chen po 'khor los sgyur/ /bde chen yum dang lhan cig skyes/ /dang/sa med sras bcas bsgom par bya/ /sna tshogs dngos kun mchod pa'i sprin/ /27—578

kun du bzang spyod ji bzhin du/ /mchod byas sdig pa bsal nas su/ /rnam dag dbang bsgur de rjes nod/ /lha dang bdag gnas rnam gsum du/ /rdo rje 'bru gsum mngon bsams la/ /dad dang thugs rje dam tshig gis/ /kha dog rim gsum 'od zer phyung 1/ /sgu mchog snying po oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dang / /gsung rgyun dri med āḥlas de bzhin dmar po'i 2'od/ /rnam dag thugs bdag hūṃ las rnam 'phros rab sngo zer / /bdag lus ngag yid gnas gsum la reg dri gsum sel/ /de rjes bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngo/ /dag byed rnam gsum man ngag bzhin/ /de 'og ye shes rnam gsum byug /mthar ni gnyis med zhi ba'o/ /shin tu gsang ba bde ba che/ /thig le gsum rgyun spyor ba ni/ /de rjes blo gros chen pos bsgom/ /dbang bskur nas ni gshegs par rol /nying nge 'dzin kyi 4dbang bskur rdzogs so// //5gnubs lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o// //27—579

1373ra༅/ /pha rol dbang du bya ba/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ pa 2ra wa sha mā na/ bod skad du/ pha rol dbang du bya ba/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /k+shin tu snying rjes non pa'i yid/ /lus can mya ngan 'das pa la/ /bsam pa thag pas mgron gnyer ba/ /de yis pha rol basbu ba bshad/ /nam langs nu/na pas slebs pa dang / /gnyid ca du nye dang sad pa'i dus/ /dga' dang sadung ba skyes 5pa nas/ /de yi cho ga spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag gi lus sang lha yin te/ /ngag ni yi ge bzhi nyid do/ /rnam par rtog dang mi rtog sems / /snying rje che dang stong pa nyid/ /mig gnyis nyi zla 'bar ba dang / /lce steng ā kā'i phreng bas brgyan/ /lte ba me thab 'khyel pa'i dbus/ /dpal lda/na 'dod pa'i lha mo yi/ /mi gang dbang du bya ba de'i/ /smin phrag snying dang bye ba'i dbus/ /dga' dang dad dang gdung ba nyid/ /thig le pad+mo a yig 827—58/

—gzugs / /byams pa yi ge a yi rgyun/ /bdag gi sprul pa las skyes reg /rab tu mi bzod snying rje can/ /dga' ba'i blta bas rnam par bzhu/ /btang snyoms tshad med blo gros che/ /yi ge lnga brjod pad+mo 'byed/ /oṃ āḥ tri dza hūṃ /'bum phrag lnga rab ma yengs dang / /lhag bsam bar chad spangs bsnyen bsgrub/ /bde gshegs ring bsrel sku khrus sogs/ /brtse ldan rnams kyis sngags chur bcas / /rnge tog dmar pos gdong bkrus la/ /lce dkyil sbrang rtsi ldan sngags brjod/ /oṃ āḥdhī lo ka nā tha 4ma hā kā 5ru ṇi ka ho sa ma haṃ/ che ge mo'i tsit+ta ma hā sā dha 6tsa la tsa la pra tsa la pra tsa la dzaḥdzaḥ7/ blo gros bzang ngo/ snying rjes myos gyur pa/ /skye bo 'di dag thabs gang phrin las kyis/ /bde bar rung na bdag cir gyur sla'o zhes/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu yid byed mi 'bra'/ na / /rnal 'byor rgyal po brtag 8pa 'dis/ /zhag gsum drug gam dgu nyid na / /lcags kyus gzhus 9pa'i yal ga ltar/ /gdon mi za bar de dbang 'gyur / /pha rol dbang du bya ba gnubs lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'o// // 27—582

1374༄/ /rin po che 'khor lo'i dbang gi man ngag gi rim pa/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ rat+na tsakra a bhe ṣe ka u pa de sha kra ma/ bod skad du/ rin po che 'khor lo'i dbang gi man ngag gi rim pa/ dpal kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bde chen po/ /dkyil 'khor sgyu ma la gnas shing / /dang bo gnyis gsum bzhi pa yi/ /man ngag rdzogs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mthong ba'i chos la sa rab non/ /dbang dang man ngag 'brel bcas pa'i/ /rgyud rnams kun la rab 'jug pa/ /in+d+ra bhū ti bdag gis bshad/ /thabs dang shes rab la sogs rgyud/ /phyi nang sbas/ dang mthar thug pa'i/ /dbang gi rim pa ngo bo ru/ /rdo rje bdag pos yang dag bshad/ /de bas rgyud kun dbang yin pas/ /man ngag can gyis shes par bya/ /rgyud kyi tshig la rab goms shing / /smra ba'i tshig la ma rmongs kyang / /dbang dang man ngag ma thob pa/ /de dag ngal ba don med yin/ /dbang 27—584

dang man ngag 'dod pa yis/ /rang srog lus dang rdzas rnams kyis/ /bla ma slob dpon mnyes byas la/ /thabs la mkhas pas 'dod pa blang / /man ngag thob pa'i skyes bus kyang / /srog lus gtang bar phangs pa ltar/ /man ngag dam pa de bas phangs/ /de bas btsal thabs mkhas par bya/ /bla ma'i drin lan mi shes shing / /man ngag phyal bar spel ba dang / /thos nas mi mos mi sgom 1na/ /mthong ba'i chos la dmyal tshogs 'tshed/ /bla ma'i drin lan mi brjed cing / /man ngag btsal ba'i thabs mkhas pa/ /mos shing bsam gtan mchog gzhol ba/ /rgyal sras kun gyi nang na mchog /dbang bsgur rim pa yang dag pa'i/ /gnas dang dus dang slob dpon dang / /slob ma dang ni gleng gzhi da nga / /dkyil 'khor dag dang der 'jug rim/ /dbang bsnyur rim dang rnam grangs dang / /bskur ba'i gnas dang thabs dag dang / /sgrib byang tshad dang sa non dang / /de 'byel man ngag rim pa dang / /rtags dag dang ni brda dag dang / /rdzas dag dang yang dgos pa'i don/ /nus pa'i tshad dang 'bras bu ste/ /rnam pa nyi shus mngon par brjod/ /de dag kun gyi mtshan nyid dang / /bum pa'i dbang dang gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang / /de ltar de bzhin yang bzhis bshad/ /rgyud rnams kun kyi tshig don rnams/ /ma lus 'dir ni 'dus pa yin/ /dang por bum dbang gleng gzhi nas/ /yang dag brtsams te bdag gis bshad/ /kye ho shākya seng ge la/ /bltams 2tshe klu rgyal dga' sogs pas/ /bum pa'i chu yis khrus byas dang / /mngon par rdzogs par byang chub tshe/ /sa yi lha mos bum pa yang / /bkra shis brjod nas phyag tu phul/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal rgyud 'byung 27—585

ba / /spyi bor dbang bskur gleng gzhi yin/ /gnas ni ri sogs yul khams dang / /sgrub khang gnas dang maṇ+ḍal sa/ /bkra shis yid dga' rjes mthun par / /so so'i 3rgyud las gsungs pa yin/ /dus ni bla mas gnang ba yin/ /slob ma dad pa yod pa dang / /dam chos 'byung dang sgrub pa dang / /dgos nga/ phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /rnam pa bzhir ni brjod pa yin/ /slob dpon yon tan kun ldan zhing / /dbang dang dam tshig ldan pa dang / /rkyen thub sa bon gzi brjid che/ /snying rjer ldan zhing slob la brtson/ /rigs can kun kyis bkur ba'i sa/ /dbang mchog bsgur bar gsungs pa yin/ /slob ma dad par ldan pa dang / /slob dang sgrub la dga' ba dang / /rtsa ba'i sngags zlos byed pa dang / /sngags rgyud dag la dga' sems dang / /gzhan yang tshe phyi don 'don dang / /gzhan yang glegs bam mchod rten sogs/ /zhal sros rig pa spyi 2dang ni/ /gzhan yang tshe 'phos ched du ste/ /rnam pa 'di dag rgyal bas gsungs/ /de re la yang gleng gzhi dag /rgyud rnams kun las rgyas par bstan/ /dkyil 'khor slob ma rab 'bring tha / /ting 'dzin me tog rdul tshon rim/ /gzhan yang lugs 'bur bzo bris dang / /glegs bam mchod rten bla ma sogs/ /de kun spyan sngar bum dbang ni/ /bskur du rung bar bde gshegs gsungs/ /de dag so so'i cho ga'i rim/ /so so'i rgyud las gsal bar bya/ /rdul tshon la sogs byed pa'i tshe/ /sa ni dag par bya ba dang / /bgegs bsal geb dang gzung ba dang / /bum pa'i sta gon bya ba dang / /lha dang slob ma yo byad rnams/ /ji ltar sta gon bya ba dang / /sngon du bsnyen 5pa'i rim pa dang / /thig gdab pa yi cho ga dang / /tshon rtsi dag ni dgyeb 27—586

dang / /rgyan rnams bkod de mchod pa dang / /ye shes dbab dang mchod sogs dang / /ji ltar grags pa'i cho gas bya/ /gang zag dang pos rang gis byi / /gnyis pa gsum pas phab ste bri/ /bzhi pas yid kyis 1bya ba yin/ /lugs ma la sogs de bzhin no/ /yang na slob ma'i sgod dang sbyar/ /yang na mos pa'i dbang du gsungs/ /der 'jug pa yi rim pa ni/ /ku sha so shing skud pa dang / /dag pa'i chus reg gtsang byas pa'i/ /thun mong sdom gnas sems bskyed pa/ /sgor bkug me tog sbyin bya zhing / /gdong g.yogs gsol btab spro bskyed de/ /kun byed chu yis gsal dag bya/ /snying la rdo rjer der gzhan bsgom/ /yol ba'i —nang du drangs nas su/ /bskor ba phyag 'tshal gsol ba gdab/ /mna' yi dam tshig cho ga sbyin/ /thun mong bsrung ba'i dam tshig dbog /phyi yi dbab pa'i dam tshig gis/ /phyi rol rdo rje 'dzin pa dbab/ /phyi yi me tog phreng dor ro/ /phyi yi rang gi lha yang sbyin/ /lhang ba'i mtshan ma shes bya bsgom/ /sha mig dag 'gyur snga ltas su/ /ci mthong bri ba'i cho ga bya/ /de nas sha yi mig phye ste/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor bstan par bya/ /de kun rgyud nas rgyas par gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i 'og tu ni/ /dbang gi maṇ+ḍal gnas su bzhag /mgo la me tog phreng btags pa/ /lha'i dbang ste dang por bshad/ /chu dang dbu rgyan rdo rje dang / /dril bu ming dang rnam pa lnga/ /slob ma rig pa'i dbang zhes bya/ /de nas seng ge'i khri steng du/ /rig byed slob dpon dbang sbyar bya/ /gong ma brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje dril bu brtul zhugs gnyis/ /phyag rgya dam tshig gsum pa yin/ /dbugs dbyung ba dang lung bstan pa/ /phyir mi ldog sogs rim pa yin/ /de kun 27—587

bum pa'i dbang yin te/ /der yang bum khrus byed phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dbang gi rnam grangs ni/ /so so'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs te/ /ji skad gsungs pa de shes bya/ /bum pa'i dbang la rnam gsum ste/ /phyi dang nang dang sbas pa'o—/ /spyi 1la thun mong khyad par te/ /thun mong phyi pa'i rgyud dang mtshungs/ /de mtshungs bum pa'i bcud nang du/ /mi 'chi bcu phyed dag dang ni/ /btung ba snum pos gang byas pa/ /khyad par bum pa zhes gsungs so/ /nang gi slob dpon bla ma'i sku/ /bum pa'i nang nas 'bab pa'i chus/ /slob ma'i spyir blugs sems skul 2byed/ /sbas pa'i bum pa bde chen gnas/ /stong phrag bdun cu'i rtsa lam nas/ /thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la/ /lha yi chu yis khrus byas pa/ /sbas pa'i thabs kyis bum pa'o/ /phyag rgya ma yi bum pa nas / /sems kyi chu dang mtshal chen sems/ /thabs kyi gsang ba'i nor bu la / /dag pa'i chu yis khrus byed pa/ /sbas pa'i shes rab bum par bshad/ /de nas bum pa'i dbang la yang / /dbang rnam bzhir ni nges gsungs te/ /bu ma pa'i bum pa thun mong ste/ /gsang dbang khyad par bum pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes sbas pa gnyis/ /de ltar rnam gsum bum pa yang / /yod med mtha' las yang dag grol/ /bum pa'i dbang ni bzhi pa yin/ /de'i gnas spyi bor bum brtan bya/ /phyi yi spyi bor chu yi 4khrus/ /nang gi spyi bor tshangs pa'i sgor/ /sems 'be+ebs sbas pa sems phyir 'bebs/ /dbang bskur ba yi thabs mchogo ni / /slob mas bsgoms nas bzed pa'i tshul/ /mnyes pa'i bla mas spyin par mtshungs/ /bsam mthun bde thabs dam pa'o/ /phyi nang sbas pa'i bum pa yis/ /srog gcod rku dang log par g.yem/ /lus kyi 5nyes gsumabyang 27—588

—bas na/ /lus kyi dri ma dag par bshad/ /nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib//sa bcu dag gis byang bar gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor mthong bas tshogs kyi lam/ /phreng bas mos spyod spyor lam dag /chu dang dbu rgyan sa dang po/ /mthong lam rnam par dag par gsungs/ /rdo rje dril dang bdag po yis/ /sa gnyis pa nas brgyad pa'i bar/ /sgom lam rnam par dag par bshad/ /brtan par byed pas 'bras bu lam/ /sa bcu dag par rgyal bas gsungs/ /de ltar dbang thob slob ma la/ /bla mas man ngag drin sbyin bya/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba la sogs pa'i/ /slob dpon spyi yi las dag dang / /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i man ngag dang / /zhi sogs bya ba'i las dag dang / /thun mong sgrub sogs ma/na ngag sbyin/ /thun mong bum sogs phyi rgyud sbyin/ /khyad par nang gi de bzhin no/ /nang gi bum pa'i dbang rdzogs na/ /bden pa gnyis kyi man ngag bstan / /sbas pa'i bum pa'i dbang thob nas/ /sbas pa'i kun rdzob spyod gsum bstan/ /mdor na ji bzhin sgra dang ni/ /dgongs ma yin dang bkre don dang / /tshig gi don dang yan lag don/ /tshogs la bshad rim gnas par bshad/ /dngos grub myur ba'i rtags dang ni/ /so shing dor dang rmi lam dang / /ci mthong dri dang me tog dor/ /dbab pa dag las shes par bya/ /phyi yi sbas pa'i ngag brda dang / /lnga bsdus phyag rgya de la bstan/ /'dri bas dge slong gsang phyir bstan/ /dbang rdzas dag gi khyad par ni/ /mgo la 'dogs pa'i me tog phreng / /spyi bor dag pa'i chu yin no/ /de yang bum pa'i bye brag las/ /rin chen dang ni thod sogs phreng / /mgo la bcing ba'i 1dburgyan yin/ /dpral bar rigs dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /rtags kyi rdo rje de 27—589

sbyin bya/ /dril bu kha yi thad kar sbyin/ /ming la dbang rdzas dag pa'i mtshan/ /dam tshig rdor dril lag tu sbyin/ /gsor gsil sgra dang bcas pa'o/ /phyag rgya'i bdag po'i phyag rgyar bsgom/ /dbugs dbyung ba dang yon tan brjod/ /lung bstan pa la chos gos dbyibs/ /phyir mi ldog la de nyid bstan/ /gzhan yang zhar la 'ongs pa'i rdzas/ /cod lku pan me long sasnadung dang ni/ /gser byas thur ma la sogs pa'i/ /so so'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs te/ /ji ltar 'byung ba de bzhin bya/ /de las gzhan pa'i thun mong dang / /rin chen bdun dang nye ba'i bdun/ /bkra shis brgyad dang nyer brgyad sogs/ /bya ba'i rgyud dang gnyis ka dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang bstan pa/ /rnal 'byor bla ma'i gnas skabs su/ /rdzogs par yod ces rgyal bas gsungs/ /dbang bskur bla ma'i dgongs pa yang / /spyi dang khyad par shes bya ste/ /mkha' dang mnyam/ pa'i ye shes las/ /snying rje slob ma la bskyed de/ /bu yi 'du shes nyer bzhag /nas / /byams sems dga' sems btang snyoms sems/ /rtse gcig ci 4yi dgongs rgyud yin/ /khyad par so so'i dgongs pa ste/ /me tog lha dang bcas/ pa de/ /slob ma de la thim par bsam/ /rgyud rnams so so'i rjes mthun pa'i/ /lha dang lha mo ji lta bas/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bsgur ba/ /chu yi dgongs pa'o ye shes lnga'i/ /rtags su sku lnga rdzogs byed pa/ /dbu rgyan hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed/ /de 'og rgyud lnga sbyang ltabya ste/ /ye shes lngar grub rdo rje'o/ /shes rab dbyangs kyis ngag sgrib sbyangs/ /dril bu'o ming gi bdag po yi/ /dngos grub rjes su 'dzin par bshad/ /yang na/ phreng ba'i yi 6dam rgyal ba'i dbang / /chu khams mi bskyod dzarnam par dag /dbu rgyan rin chen mnyam 27—590

nyid de/ /rdo rje kun rtog 'od dpag med/ /dril bu bya grub 1gdon mi za/ /ming ni chos dbyings snang mdzad sku/ /rdo rje brtul zhugs sems dag byed/ /dril bu ngag ni rnam dag ste/ /phyag rgya dam tshig lus dag pa'o/ /yang na/rdo rje thabs kyi ngo bo ste/ /dril bu de bzhin shes rab sbyangs/ /gnyis med phyag rgya dam tshig 'dod/ /gzengs bstod pas ni lung bstan no/ /ji skad bsgo ba bka' yin no/ /yon tan brjod pas dbugs phyung bas/ /de kho na nyid kyis phyir mi ldog /gzhan yang rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs 2te/ /ji lta'i dgongs rgyud de dang des/ /slob ma rnams ni yongs smin bya/ /nus pa'i tshad ni rnam pa lnga/ /dri ma 'khrud dang sgrib byang dang / /las byed pa dang 'bras bu la / /mngon du phyogs dang bdud bzhi ni/ /'joms pa'i nus pas brjod pa ste/ /phreng bas ma dag dri ma dang / /mos pa'i spyod pas sgrib pa 'khru/ /'dod lha mnyes pa'i las yin te/ /'bras bu mthong ba'i lam la phyogs/ /yi dam dngos grub nye ba yin/ /gzung 'dzin phung po'i sngubadud rnams bcom/ /chu dang dbu rgyan kyi nus pas 5/ /'khor 'das dri ma rnam gnyis 'khru/ /sa ni dang po'i sgrib pa dag /las ni rdo rje rin chen gyis/ /rigs kyi nga rgyal byed nga/ yin/ /'bras bu bsgom lam phyogs pa dang / /rdo rje dang ni rin chen kyi/ /thun mong dngos grub 'grub pa yin/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud rnams bcom/ /rdo rje dril bu bdag po yis/ /g.yeng ba lnga yi dri ma 'khru/ /sa gnyis pa nas brgyad pa yi/ /bar gyi sgrib pa sbyangs pa yin/ /pad+ma las dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /rigs kyi nga rgyal las byed yin/ /'bras bu mthar phyin la phyogs shing / /gsum po'i thun 6mong grub pa yin/ /'chi bdag bdud bcom tshe la dbang / /27—591

—brtan byed dbang gi rim pa yis/ /g.yeng ba phra mo'i dri ma 'khru/ /sa bcu'i sgrib pa dag par byed/ /las ni brten 1par byed pa ste/ /brtul zhugs kyis ni me tog brtan/ /chu dang dbu rgyan 2dam tshig gis/ /bum pa brtan par bka' stsal gyi/ /rdo rje dril bu lung bstan gyis/ /dbugs phyung bas ni bdag po'o / /yang na kun gyis thams cad do/ /sangs rgyas sa la mngon phyogs/ dang / /dngos grub brtan byed 'bras bu'o/ /lha yi bdud gcod bum pa yin/ /'bras bu bzhi ni me tog la'o/ /rgyu mthun chu dang dbu rgyan gyis/ /rdo rje dri'/ bu rnam smin yin/ /skyes bu byed pa ming gis te/ /brtan pa dri med 'bras bu ste / /yang na 'bras bzhi bstan zhes 4pa'o/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i yon tan ni/ /bsam yas ji snyed bstan pa kun/ /dbang gi 'bras rab yin par gsungs / /'bras bu yod dang rgyu 'byung ste/ /dbang thob rgyu ni yon yin te//ji ltar rgyud lus 5gsungs pa yin/ /las kyi dang por dbang bya ba/ /dang po'i dbang du gsungs pa yin/ /gnyis pa gsang ba bshad bya ste/ /kye ho ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'khor rnams bsnyu ba rnam ‘mdzad nas/ /yum gyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gsang ba byang chub sems rab bskur/ /de ltar dpal 'dus la sogs pa'i/ /rgyud rgyal kun la grags pa rnams/ /gleng gzhi zhes su rnam par bshad/ /gnas ni bud med dkyil yin te/ /lhan cig skyes dang zhing skyes dang / /sngags skyes pa zhes grags pa la/ /sme sha can dang mthu chen dang / /gar mkhan btso blag 7mkhan la sogs/ /so so'i rgyud la grags pa yi/ /jiltar rigs kyi rjes mthun pa'i/ /shes rgyud sbyangs shing yon tan ldan/ /byin gyis 27—592

brlabs pa'i gnas bya ste/ /sangs rgyas gtso bo'i yum du gzung 1/ /bum pa'i dbang rnams rdzogs pa dang / /rak+ta 'bab pa'i dus dang ni/ /bla ma yum gyi 2gnang ba ni/ /gnyis pa'i dus su rnam par brtag /slob dpon rnam pa gsum du shes/ /dang po thabs mchog yab kyis te/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i gzungs ma la'o/ /gsum pa gnyis su gred pas bya'o/ /slob ma bum dbang rdzogs pa dang / /snying po bzlas pas byed pa dang / /brtul zhugs dam tshig 'dod pas bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa dang / /dkyil 'khor bha gar bstan pa'o/ /de yang lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /lha yi mtshan nyid shes bya ste/ /lus ni 'dom gang gru bzhi pa'o/ /yang na gru bzhi 'byung ba bzhi/ /steng 'og g.yas g.yon sgo bzhi'o/ /tshon sna kha dog sna lnga'o/ /yang na bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga/ /rtsa ni thig gi rang bzhin te/ /ka ba brgyad ni rkang brgyad do/ /yan lag rta babs mtshan nyid de/ /so sen ba sru twa ra brgyad / /snying ni dbus kyi lte ba ste/ /rgyud gang dang ni rjes mthun sbyar/ /lha yi phung po lnga gco 4bo/ /'byung ba lha mor shes par bya/ /khams dang skye mched mang po kun/ /sems dpa' sems mar rab tu grags/ /bud med dkyil 'khor du gsungs te/ /bha ga gzhal yas brtsegs par bstan/ /de la gzung 5ba'i cho ga dang / /sbyang dang brtag 6dang byin brlab ke dang / /rgyan dang ldan zhing bdug 8pas bdug /phyi nang khrus byas lha rnams dbab/ /tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod byas la/ /lha ru nye bar brtag par bya/ /de la changayang drang bar bya'o/ /de la 'jug pa'i rim pa yang / /bum pa'i bya ba yang bya ste/ /yol bas bar du bcad nas ni/ /gsol gdab de yi ngo yang 27—593

dgab / /me tog byin te drangs nas su/ /dkyil 'khor bskor nas phyag gsum btsal/ /nang gi dam tshig brtul zhugs sbyin/ /de bzhin dbab pa yang byas nas/ /me tog dor te mthong ba dri/ /lha dang chos kyi tshig phye ste/1 / /lus kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bstan/ /legs par mthong ba'i 'og tu ni/ /mdun na gnas pa de nyid la/ /gsang ba'i dbang gis sbyor byas te/ /dam tshig 'khor lo drug rim gyis/ /khu ba phyung ste dbang bskur bya/ /dkar dmar spel ba phreng ba'i dbang / /shu kra zhes te chu yi dbang / /tshangs sgor mi bskyod dbu rgyan dbang / /lce la 2rdo rje de rdo rje/ /rdor bum hūṃ sgra dril bu'i dbang / /a ho su kha ming gi dbang / /dam tshig lces len brtul zhugs dbang / /blta bar mi bya lung bstan dbang / /longs spyod rtsar sbyar phyir mi ldog /bde bas bde thabs dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /'di kun gsang bar bstan pas na/ /gsang ba'i dbang zhes bstan pa yin/ /gsang ba la yang gsum du ste/ /phyi dang nang dang sbas pa'o/ /ga bur tsan+dan bcu phyed bcas/ /sbom po dang ni dbang mo'i rtses/ /slob ma'i kha ru dbab pa giphyi'o/ /slob ma'i dus nyid mnan byas te/ /kha yi thad kar gnyis sbyar nas/ /ra ka 5a ta ra 'bab pa/ /be'u 'drar rdo rje bzhib 5pa'i thabs/ /bung 'drar pad+ma lces len pa/ /shes rab nang gi gsang ba'i dbang / /slob ma rang gi lte ba can/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'dus pas gsungs/ /rdul dang mun pa snying stobs te/ /'og sgo'i kha ru rab 'bab pa/ /sbas pa'i gsang ba'i dbang du gsungs/ /gsang ba'i dbang la yang bzhi ste/ /rdo rje dang ni pad+ma nas/ /dri med chu 'bab bum pa'i dbang / /yang na gong gi rim de nyid/ /zla ba nyi ma lce la reg /de ni gsang ba gnyis 27—594

pa ste/ /bde chen lam sbyangs gsum pa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa / /ye shes chen po bzhi pa'o/ /de nas ngag gi lam yin te/ /lce yi pad+ma zhes bya ba/ /phyi dang nang dang sbas pa'i lce'o/ /phyi yi pad+ma ngag gi lam/ /nang du tsit+tar der shes bya/ /sbas pa lte ba'i pad+ma la'o/ /thabs ni gtso gzungs slob mar bcas/ /lus ngag sems la dri med cing / /de ni mi phyed mthun pa yin/ /ngag gi sgrib pa des byang nas/ /ngag ni shin tu sbyangs pa ste//sangs rgyas sa ni dang po non/ /de yi man ngag gsang ba'o/ /dgongs pa'i don dang nges don dang / /ji bzhin med dang sbas pa yi/ /don rnams nges par bstan par bya/ /slong ma bkri ba'i don bstan bya/ /de ni ma hā yo 1ga yin/ /thabs dang shes rab rtags su sbyar/ /nang gi sbas pa'i ngag brda dang / /spyor ba yi ni brda rnams dang / /rim gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda skad bstan/ /sbom pos khro mo mnan pa ni/ /lag brda 'dri na shes par bya/ /rdzas ni zla ba nyi ma dang / /bcu phyed rdzas kyi rnam pa yis/ /longs spyod bya yi dor mi bya'o/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /gtso gzungs 2zhal du thim pa las/ /skuyi dbus su thim pa dang / /bde ba'i 'bru tshogs gsal ba'i rgyun/ /rdo rje'i lam nas pad+mor 'khyil/ /shu kra rak+ta 'dres pa ni/ /yab yum pa yi 4ngang du gsal/ /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag ltar/ /thim pas sems gyur dgongs pa'i don/ /nus pa'i tshad kyang de bzhin du/ /ji snyed ngag gi dri ma 'khru/ /bubye'i sar sgrib shin tu dag /shes rab thabs kyi nga rgyal byed/ /chos kun ro gcig shes par nus/ /sangs rgyas sa ni mngon du thob/ /thabs kyi phyag rgyas phung po 'joms/ /nyon mongs shes rab ma yin te/ /'chi bdag gnyis su 27—pya 95

med pa yis/ /sems 'phros pas ni lha yi bdud/ /'joms pa gsang ba'i nus pa'i tshad/ /thabs ni skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras/ /shes rab dri med 'bras bur bshad/ /rgyu mthun khu ba'i ngo bo yin/ /lces len rnam par smin par gsungs / /yab yum mnyes par mchod bya ba/ /dbang thob pa yi rgyu yin no//de nas gsum pa bshad bya ste/ /kye ho dpal ldan 'dus sogs las/ /sngags/ kyi spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sngags dang dus dang rgyal ba las/ /bslang ste sbas pa'i don bstan pa/ /de lta bu yi gleng gzhi'o/ /lus kyi ngo bo dgon pa la1/ /byang chub sems kyi gnas bcas pa / /bde ba'i stan yang gnas su bshad/ /dus ni dbang gnyis sgogs pa dang / /bla mas gnang dang rig mar ldan/ /de yi slob dpon phyi dang nang / /phyi yi bla ma'o nang rig ma/ /slob ma dbang gnyis rdzogs pa dang / /sbas pa'i don la yid 2mos dang / /nye ba'i snying po zlos pas bya'o/ /gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa la/ /glegs bam la sogs bya ba min/ /tshe 'phos pa yang de bzhin min/ /sems kyi dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor mchog /de la bzung bar gnang ba yin/ /rig ma bzung dang sta gon dang / /sbyang dang sems babyed byin rlabs dang / /dbang bsgur bla mas bya ba yin/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis bcu drug dang / /nyi shu nyi shu lnga lon pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bu mo dang / /sring mo grogs mo ma yin te/ /de sems sbyang ba mchog yin no/ /yang na lha yis lung bstan pa'i/ /zhing skyes ma ni rung ba yin/ /sngags skyes bzlas dang bsgom 4ldan pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ma ni so so med/ /dkyil 'khor lhar bcas sngon dang 'dra/ /sbas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi po la/ /rtsa yi 'dab ma gnas 27—596

nas su/ /pad+ma'i sna 1'dra'i yi ge rnams/ /rgyud las gsungs pa brtag par bya / /g.yas dang g.yon dang dbu ma yi/ /rtsa gsum mtshan nyid shes bya ste/ /dkyil 'khor spyor ba mchog yin no/ /me tog bkram pa'i maṇ+ḍal du/ /ga bur la sogs dris byugs te/ /chos gos rgyan chas ldan par bya/ /de la tshogs kyi ston mo dbul/ /chang yang drang ba byas nas ni/ /rang yang mos pa'i lha ru bsgom / /'khor lo bzhi yang de dang 'dra/ /rdo rje pad+mo rnam gnyis kyang / /rgyud las 'byung rteb ji bzhin du/ /bla mas byen rlabs natshul bzhin bya/ /'jug pa'i tshul ni dben pa ru/ /yol bas bar du bcad nas ni/ /'jug par gsol ba gdab par bya/ /ngo yang bkab nas drang bar 4bya/ /brtul zhugs sdom pa sbyin pa dang / /ye shes dbab pa de byas te/ /bud rnged rnams n-i kun la yang / /rab tu dga' ba'i sems bskyed de/ /bskor ba lan gsum byas nas ni/ /yid kyis 5me tog gtor nas kyang / /mos pas phyag kyang btsal bar bya/ /shes rab spyan dang sangs rgyas spyan/ /phye ste mtshan dang dpe byad ni/ /mar me'i 'od la bstan par bya/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang por bstan/ /de nas sems kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'khor lo rnam bzhi legs nga/ra bstan/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i 'og tu ni/ /dbang gi rim pa brtsam par bya/ /chags pa'i glu dang dga' ba'i gar/ /rol pa'i brda rnams mtshon nga/ra bya/ /chags pa'i mtshan nyid phreng ba'i dbang / /chu 'byung mtshan khrus chu yi dbang / /bhag 6tsum skra gzung dbu rgyan dbang / /pad+mar rdor bcug rdo je'i dbang / /de gnyis bskyod pa dril bu'i dbang / /dam tshig ha skad ming gi dbang / /de dag brtan pa sar 'byung ba/ /bltas pas dga' ba rdo rje yi//27—597

brtul zhugs dbang du de brjod do/ /bgad 1pa dril bu'i brtul zhugs so/ /'khyud pa dam tshig phyag rgya yin/ /kha phrad pa ni dbugs phyung ba/ /ku tsa mnye ba lung bstan yin/ /pad+mar tsum byas phyir mi ldog /de yang gsum pa 'a/ yang gsum/ /phyi dang nang dang sbas pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes dbang zhes bya/ /rig ma gtad pa'i rim pa ni/ /phyi rol shes rab ye shes yin/ /shes rab 'a/ brten bde ba yi/ /ye shes skye phyir de skad do/ /shes rab rang sems ye shes/ las / /bde ba 'gog pa bde chen po 'am/ /shes rab 'khor lo'i rtsa lam du/ /bde ba'i ye shes 'bab pas na/ /bde ba myong ba nang gi bshad/ /dmigs su med pa'i shes rab las/ /skad cig ye shes byung nas ni/ /sems dang lus kyi bde thob pa/ /sbas pa shes rab ye shes so/ /'di la yang ni dbang bzhi tshang / /lta 4sbyin brda phrad la sogs pa/ /bum pa'i dbang du 'dod pa yin / /pad dang rdo rje phrad sogs pa/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i dbang yin no//zhu ste bde ba babs pa ni/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa yi/ /dga' byed bde byed bzhi par 'dod/ /de ni gsum pa'i rnam grangs yin/ /bskur ba'i gnas ni snying la ste/ /sems kyis len par byed pas so/ /bud med sgyu ma la brten te/ /bde de dang po sems kyis myong / /de 'og lus kyis myong ba yin//skal ba med pa'i sems can la/ /rtsa 'gog pas na cha shas myong / /de mtshon bde ba rnyed pa dang / /thun dang zhag dang lo yi bar/ /ji srid bskal pa'i bar du ni/ /sangs rgyas bde chen thob par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs yon tan bsam 6yas thob/ /thabs kyi dam pa mchog yin no/ /sems kyi sgrib pa kun byang ste/ /thams cad kun mkhyen ye shes ldan/ /sangs rgyas sa gnyis 27—598

non pa ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa zhes zer/ /de dang 'byel pa'i man ngag ni//sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /sems kyi rig pas brtan gyur na/ /gzung 73'dzin gnyis kyi lam 'gog pas/ /las kyi mdud pa grol bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ /bsod nams rlung las baspyod pa 2na/ /ye shes chen po 'bar byas te/ /bde chen gnas nas zhu nas su/ /'khor lo bzhi la 'bab pa na/ /dga' ba rnam bzhi rim par bskyed/ /til gyi 'bru bzhin bdes gang ba/ /bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya/ /de yis las kun byed pa ni/ /rtsa ba lnga dang yan lag lnga'i/ /rlung bcu'i rtsol bas byed pa yin/ /de lta'i tshul du bstan pa ni/ /steng gi sgo la brten pa yi/ /man ngag rim pa de la brtenage/ /yang na de la brten pa ni/ /dang por rlung gi de nyid babe+eb/ /de nas rlung dang 'dres pa yi/ /sngags kyi de nyid babe+eb par bya/ /rlung dang sngags ni rab sbyor bas/ /dbugs kyi 'byung 'jug mtshan nyid can/ /rdo je'i bzlas pa bslab par bya/ /de yi sems kyi 5dmigs pa dang / /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas6/ /'od gsal ba yi gnas thob nas/ /gnyis med ye shes thob 'gyur ba'i/ /steng gi man ngag bslab par bya/ /'og gi sgo la brten pa ni/ /rdo rje pad+mar spyor ba las/ /bskyod pa'i rlung gis drod bsgul bas / /sra ma ka ni bde bskyod de/ /shu kra su kha'i 8rang bzhin can/ /'khor lo bzhi la brgyud nas kyang / /bde bskyod gnas su sbrul 'khyud de/ /gsang ba'i pad+mor ma sbos 9par/ /til 'bru lta bur gang ba ni/ /bde ba ji srid bskal pa'i bar/ /rab tu dga' ba'i bde bas myong / /ye shes chen pos gnas pa'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad dang / /mtshan mar 27—599

btags pa thams cad kun/ /bde chen nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /bde chen nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis ma brnyes so/ /rang sems las su rung ba'i rtags/ /phyi yi yul la snang ba ni/ /dang por smig rgyu lta bu dang / /gnyis pa du ba lta bu dang / /gsum pa glog gi rnam pa dang / /bzhi pa mar me lta bu dang / /lnga pa nam mkha' 'dra ba'o/ /rlung dang rtsa dang 'khor lo dang / /skad cig dga' bzhi'i rnam pa kun/ /ngag brda ji ltar grags pas brjod/ /sgom po khro bo —1mnyam sbyar ba/ /dbang gsum thob pa'i lag brda yin/ /gsum pa yi ni rdzas dag ni/ /rang dang rig tu bcas pa yi/ /dri chen chu dang rak+ta dang / /ga bur baṃ sa'i shel sogs rdzas/ /'jigs pa med par bza' bar bya/ /bud med rnams ni spyad par bya/ /de yi gzugs lta sgra ni mnyan/ /dri dag kyang ni mnam 2par bya/ /gsang ba'i pad+mar tsudza bya//glang po'i lag pas g.yon pa blang / /dung gi phur pas gdab pa dang / /'da' 'da' ya bcu gzung 4bar bya/ /mdor na rig la snang ba'i rdzas/ /de kun dgongs pa bstan pa yang / /sprul pa chos dang longs spyod dang / /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo bzhi/ /mgrin dang gsang ba'i 'khor lo gnyis/ /sbas pa yin te rnam pa drug /lte ba snying ga rkan dang ni/ /spyi bo dag la rim pa ste/ /sbas pa mgrin pa gsang bar gnas/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi brgyad dang ni/ /bcu drug sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /rtsa yi grangs te 'dab ma yin/ /ka nas brtsams nas sa yi bar/ /g.yas dang g.yon du mnyam sbyar ba/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi sprul pa'o / /ka sogs dang po chos sku brgyad/ /longs spyod ā 5snali bcu drug yin/ /bde chen ā 6li mnyam sbyar gnyis/ /a dang hūṃ dang oṃ dang haṃ/ /sprul chos 27—600

longs spyod bde chen dbus/ /'khor lo chags pa dmar po ste/ /yig 'bru dkar po sems rang bzhin/ /sprul dang longs spyod shes rab la/ /chos dang bde chen thabs su bshad/ /kā li thabs la ā li ni/ /shes rab de phyir 'khor lo bzhi/ /shes rab thabs kyi spyor ba dang / /thabs la thabs kyi spyor ba dang / /shes rab shes rab sbyor ba dang / /thabs la shes rab spyor ba ste/ /rnam pa bzhi ni gsungs pa yin/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /sbas pa'i 'khor lo rnam pa gnyis/ /mgrin 'og dkyil 'khor lha grangs bzhin/ / tsi ta ༄1ti la ka de bzhin/ /pad+ma drug la de ltar gnas/ /lha re'i byang chub sems su bshad/ /gsang ba bde skyong sbubs su ni/ /sangs rgyas rin chen gab tse 2la/ /dbus su mi shigs yi ge ha/ /re'u mig lnga bcu'i yi ge ni/ /kā li rnams la ā lis bskor/ /'byung bzhi'i yi ge grwa na gnas/ /bde bskyed pa yi yi ger bshad/ /rlung dkyil gzhu 'dra gsang bar gnas/ /de steng me ni gru gsum pa/ /rlung gis me bskyed lte dbus langs/ /sprul pa'i yi ke bsregs nas su/ /chos kyi yi ge yang bsregs nas/ /longs spyod lan gsum bskor byas te/ /gling bu smin phrag g.yas phyung nas/ /bde chen 'khor lor phyin nas bzhu/ /bdud rtsi 'grogs te 4sngar lam du/ /longs spyod chos dang sprul pa yi/ /'og rnams la brten 5yig rnams gsos/ /spu yi nyag ma khri yicha/ /lte ba'i dbus nas 'gro dang 'ong / /mgrin pa'i 'khor lor song nas su/ /lha rnams kyi ni 6sems bzhus 7nas/ /bde skyong gnas su phyin pa dang / /ā li kā li la thim ste/ /kā li 'byung ba'i yi ge la/ /'byung ba lha la thimapa dang / /ma spros bar du bde chen sku/ /pad+mar spros nas longs spyod sgu//27—601

phyogs bcur spros pas sprul sku yin/ /slar 'dus chos kyi sku ru gsal/ /de ni gsum pa'i dgongs pa'i don/ /nus pa'i tshad kyang de bzhin te/ /des ni sems kyi dri ma 'khru/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag /phyag rgya bsten pa'i las dang ni/ /bde bskyed thob par nus pa yin/ /'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin nga/ ste—/ /rang gi rig pas rig pa 'dzin/ /bde chen nyon mongs bdud bcom/ ste / /longs spyod gnas su phung po'i bdud/ /dharma tsakrar lha bdud bcom/ /sprul par 'chi bdag bdud bcom ste/ /dga' bzhis bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms—/ /dam tshig 'khor lor phung po 'joms/ /pad+mar rdor bcug nyon mongs 'joms/ /rdo rje pad bskyod lha bdud 'joms/ /bde ba 'be+ebs pas 2'chi bdag 'joms/ /bde chen rnam smin 'bras bu ste/ /longs spyod rgyu mthun 'bras bur bshad/ /dri med 'bras bu chos su ste/ /skyes bu byed pa sprul pa'o/ /yang sprul rgyu mthun 'bras bu ste/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam par smin//longs spyod skyes bu byed pa yin/ /bde chen 'khor lo dri med pa'o/ /yang /dam tshig 'khor lo rgyu mthun pa/ /rdo rje pad spyor skyes bu byed/ /bde ba babs pas rnam smin yin/ /chags dang bral ba dri ma med/ /'bras bu rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs/ /bla ma rig ma mnyes ma ni/ /de ni dbang thob rgyur bshad do/ /yang / 'bras bu dga' ba bzhi skyed byed/ /lha spyin brda phrad bum pa'i dbang / /de yi 'bras bu dga' ba skyed/ /bhag tsum skra bzung 4dbu rgyan dbang / /de yi 'bras bu dga' ba 5skyed/ /pad+mar rdor bcugardo rje'i dbang / /de yi 'bras bu mchog dga' skyed6/ /rdo rje pad bskyod dril bu'i dbang / /de 'bras lhan cig dga' ba skyed/ /dam tshig ha skad mingagi 27—602

dbang / /bde ba chen po skyed par byed/ /ngo bo 'bras bu dbyer med do/ /shes rab la ni brten nas su/ /gnyis med ye shes bskyed pas na/ /shes rab ye shes dbang zhes grags/ /rim pa tha ma bshad bya ste/ /kye ho dpal ldan 'dus sogs par/ /'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /gsang ba'i yi ge mthong ba yisna/ /skal ba bdag gcig med ces dus/ /ston pas yi ge rnam dag ces/ /yi ge las dbe+en mtshan nyid gsungs/ /bzhi pa'i gleng gzhir 2snashes par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs la gnas/ /chos kun sems la gnas byas te/ /sems ni ye nas rnam par dag /de phyir chos kun rnam par dag /de ni gnas kyi bla mar gsungs—/ /dus gsum gcig ste khyad med cing / /gang du dus gsum dbyer med pa/ /de ni blang dor med pa'i dus/ /mchog ni bla mar de rab ge gsungs / /slob dpon ma mthong sems nyid mthong / /rang sems bla mar snang ba'i phyir/ /kun gyi slob dpon skal ba bzang / /gnyis med slob dpon dam pa'o/ /'gro kun dbyings las skyes pas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i spun yin te/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yul slob pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dam par bshad//sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med par thugs chud pa/ /gnyis su mred pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ /'di yi gzhung thos mig phye ba/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba don rtogs yin/ /rtogs nas goms byed 'jug pa ste/ /mngon du gyur pa dngos grub yin/ /gnyis sked ye shes dbang 'gyur bas/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba la/ /ji ltar 'dod par dbang bsgyur 5bas/ /rig pa rang dbang mchog tu bshad/ /'di 27—603

dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /bsgyur ba'i dbang la thogs pa med/ /ji snyed theg pa rab 'byam 1gyis/ /dbang bskur rnam grangs ji snyed kun/ /gsang ba'i dbang du gsungs pa ste/ /yang dag pa yi grangs las 'das/ /mnyam pa ye shes chen po nyid/ /gcig dang du ma las grol phyir/ /gnas dang gnas min dmigs dbye med/ /sgo gsum dbye ba rdul 3tsam med/ /gnyis med ye shes chen po las/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mi 'gog phyir/ /thabs dang thabs byung thabs bsam yas/ /thabs kyi nang na mchog tu gsungs/ /rang rig ye shes rgyal ba nyid/ /khams gsum 'khor ba nyid yin phyir/ /'di la sgrib dang mi sgrib ces/ /mnyam pa'i rgyal pos yongs ma gsungs/ /sgrib nga/ nyid ni byang chub la/ /'khor ba nyid ni mya ngan 'das/ /dbye ba med pa'i sa mchog gis/ /sa yi khyad par zil gyis gnon/ /thams cad sa nyid ye shes dang / /brjod pa'i tha snyad yul las 'das/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal zhing / /rdzogs pa chen po'i mthar thug pa/ /man ngag kun gyi mchog gi mchog/de sgrub 4thabs su gsungs par zad/ /dper na glang po rnyed gyur na/ /glang po'i rjes ni mi btsal ltar/ /rang rig ye shes mngon sum na/ /mtshan ma'i rtags ni 'khrul pa'i gzhi/ /yang dag don ni brda las 'das/ /mtshon par bya ba'i yul min yang / /mdzub mos zla ba bstan pa ltar/ /brda yi sgo nas 'jug pa yin/ /snang dang srid pa ji snyed pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rjas yin pas / /lhag par spang ba 5blang dang bral/ /ye shes rjes kun las grol bshad/ /rang gi don la mngon sum nazhwa/ /rang rig kho na tsam du zad/ /rang rigade yang 'di snyam zhes/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad rnams dang bral/ /'di ni dgongs 27—604

—pa'i mchog tu gsungs/ /rig pa rang dbang gyur pa ni/ /srid pa gsum na 1 'gran zla med/ /'og ma rnams kyi gnyen por che/ /nus pa mang po'i bye brag lda na / /rgyu dang 'bras bu dbyer med pas/ /rgyu 'bras tha snyad yongs kyis bral / /rgyu yi nang na'ang mchog yin te/ /'bras bu'i nang na'ang bde mchog go/ /dbang gsum bye brag las grol phyir/ /bzhi pa'i dbang zhes grags pa ste/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kyi gsang / /thams cad mkhyen par 'dir brjod do/ /'on kyang kun mkhyen ma thob par/ /de nyid nye bar yang mi 'gyur/ /'on kyang 'di yi dbye ba yis/ /de nyid thob bya'i gnas su 'gyur//de las 2rim pa mchog yin pas/ /sgrub po rnams kyis nan tan bya'o/ /slo/ba dpon rnams ni ma mnyes shing / /dbang rnams rim gyis ma bgrod par/ /sngags spyod sgrub pa rtsom byed na/ /de 'bras med cing ngan song ltung / /dbang rnams bgrod pa 4ma byas par/ /thugs thub ra chod sems kyis ni/ /gang dag man ngag rim bstan na/ /phung 5byed gnyis ka dmyal bar ltung / /de no sngags kyi dam tshig ces/ /smra byed lce la zhing rmo zhing / /mnar med gnas su nye bar 'khor/ /dbang ma bgrod pa'i gang zag dag /gal te 'dri bas dge slong yang / /gtam gyi rigs tsam yang mi brjod/ /de brjod nyes pa'ang brjod mi lang / /rim pa rdzogs shing snod can la/ /'dri shing 6gleng slong byed pa na/ /de la de don ma bstan na/ /de yang nyes pa'i gnas su 'gyur / /gang zhig dbang gi rim pa ni/ /bla ma gzhan las rdzogs blangs la/ /man ngag gi ni rim pa ni/ /bla ma gzhan las blang du rung / /dbang dang man ngag ma bgrod par/ /glegs bam la brten shes rab kyis/ /gang zhig man 27—60pya

ngag rim rnyed na/ /de ni sngon sbyangs 'phro can no/ /des kyang bla ma dag pa la/ /dbang gi rim pa bgrod par gces/ /rnam smin shes rab sbyangs pa'i mthus/ / lung ngag rtogs hūṃpa sbyangs pa dang / /rin chen 'khor lo'i man ngag 'di/ /dbang ma bgrod la bstan gyur na/ /bdag kyang phung la gzhan yang brlag /de bas gzhan du bstan mi bya/ /bdag gis brtsams pa'i man ngag 'di/ /rim pa tshul bzhin bris pa yis/ /'gro kun gsang sngags snod ldan te/ /tshe 'di nyid la byang chub shog /rin chen 'khor lo'i dbang gi man ngag gi rim nga/ slob dpon in+d+ra byu 3ti'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/584 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga rin po che 'bor lo'i dbang gi man ngag gi rim pa 'es bya ba dbang po'i blo'am 'byung po'i dbang pos mdzad pa bzhugs so/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sngag rin po che bzhugs/ 'e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bhu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/585 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sgom/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ltam/586 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spros rigs pa ci/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamatha' 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈smir༄)〈〈co 〉sngagasal/ 5〈〈snar 〉ra snyan/587 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra stan/588 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phyi/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga skul/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yis 5〈〈co〉sum̐s 589 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacings pa'i/59༷ 1〈〈pe 〉thacod/ 〈〈snar 〉sngagacod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 nga / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabazhags/ 4〈〈nge rīrī〈〈snar 〉〉bye/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra nga / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yid/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyod/591 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorabyengs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉thazung / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra〉rtswanu 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamathun/27—606
