2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltas/37——680

༄ga /rdo rje shāg pa rtsa ba'i rtsang ba bsdus pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na mū la pasti saṃ gra ha/ bod skad du/rdo rje jeg pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba bsdus pa/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar rab btud de/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni/ /rgyud las gsungs pa bshad par bya/ /gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs/ /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par gsungs/ /khros pas rdo rje spun gyi ni/ /nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /sems can rnams la byams pa spong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems / /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba 27—682

sgogs 1pa bdun pa yin/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /smod par byed pa brgyad pa yin/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba dgu pa yin/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa/ /byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod / /chad sogs ma yin chos rnams la/ /brtags pa las ni bcu gcig pa/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa yi/ /sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa/ /dam tshig ji bzhin rnyed pa dag /mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /'di dag rnam par spangs pa yi/ /sngags pas dngos grub nye bar 'thob /gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pas bdud kyis gzung 2'gyur te//de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'go/ /de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni/ /rang gi 'khrul pa shes byas la/ /ci 'byor pa yis bla ma la/ /thub pa'i spyan sngar mchod byas nas/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa dag /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /sngags pas 'bad de blang bar bya/ /rdo rje jeg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bsdus pa slob dpon chen po rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //27—683

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ khyu la pasti/ bod skad du/ lhang ba sbom po/thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sems dang bla ma yi / /zhabs kyi pad+mar rab btud de/ /rnal 'byor sdom par gang gsungs pa'i/ /ltung ba sbom po bshad par bya/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig rig ma ni/ /dam tshig med nga/'ang stobs kyis spyod/ /de la 'phya bar byed pa yang / /de yi lhang ba dang por gsungs/ /rgyud las ma gsungs rim nyid kyis/ /gang zhig bdud rtsi bsten pa yang / /de la ngan 'gror ltung ba yi/ /lhang ba gnyis par 'gyur ba yin / /rmongs pa gang zhig tshogs 'khor lo/ /rtsod par sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ /dam tshig la ni bzhad gad byed/ /de la gsum par 'gyur ba yin / /gsang ba'i chos ni gang gsungs pa/ /blo ngan gsang bar mi byed na/ /rmongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa de la/ /sgom po'i ltung ba bzhi par 'gyur/ /dad 27—685

ldan chos la 'dri ba na/ /chos nyid gzhan du ston pa ni/ /de la sbom por bshad pa yi/ /ltung ba lnga par rgyal bas gsungs/ /nyan thos jeg pa can dag dang / /zhag bdun du ni lhan cig gnas/ /sgom por grags pa de la ni//drug par 1rab tu 'gyur ba yin/ /yang dag de nyid mi shes par2/ /gang zhig de nyid nga rgyal byed/ /rmongs pa'i sems ldan de la ni/ /sbom po zhes bya bdun pa yin/ /gang zhig snod min sems can la/ /phyi yi 4chos mos de la yang / /gsang ba'i chos ni yang dag ston/ /de la sbom po brgyad par 'gyur / /blo ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /'di dag spang bar bya ba ste//gal te byung na cho ga bzhin/ /bshags na dmyal bar mi 'gro'o/ /thabs ni 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /bsnyen par bshags par 5mi byed na/ /bla mas slob min de bzhin du/ /rdo rje'i spun gyi tshogs kyis kyang / /ltung ba bsdus pa byas/ pa las/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /'go kun ltung bas mi gos shing / /dam tshig snod du 'gyur bar shog /ltung ba sgom po 6bsdus pa slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—686

༄go/ /rgyud gzhan las gsungs pa'i ltung ba'i mtshan nyid gzhan bshad pa yang brjod par bya ste/ rang lha blang dor ltung ba mig /de nyid dus 'das ri bong can/ /lha gzhan dga' ba yon tan no/ /rig byed dngos la zhen nga/ yin / /ma rdzogs rdzogs byed mda' yin no/ /'jig rten chos phyir dbang po'o / /khyad du gsod pa yang ni ri/ /gong med tshul ston bkra shis so/ /phrin las ma rdzogs gza' zhes grags/ /don med gnas pa phyogs yin no/ /brtse ba gtong ba drag po ste/ /dman pa'i spyod pa nyi ma'o/ /zang zing rtog pa yan lag go/ /yongs su mi 'dzin sa zhes grags/ /rang spyod 'dor ba tshes zhes grags/ /lcung ba bco lnga pa rdzogs so// //27—688

༄7/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa nyer bstan 2cig shos min/ /snod dang ldan pa rnam par brtag /'dod phyir gzhan la gnod pa spong / /dkon mchog la sogs nor la min/ /gzhan don skad cig yal mi dor/ /byang chub min par dge mi 'jug /rnam shes 'pho ba'i de nyid mkhas / /gzhan du yan lag nyes pa'o/ /yan lag gi nyes pa bdun pa rdzogs so// //27—690

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na khyu la pasti / bod skad du/ rdo rje jeg pa'i sbom po'i ltung ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+ma la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal te/ /sbom po'i ltung ba rnam pa brgyad/ /rgyud du gsungs pa zi bar bya/ /shes rab stobs kyis len pa dang / /de yi bdud rtsi stobs kyis len/ /snod min la ni mi gsang dang / /tshogs kyi nang du rtsod pa dang / /dad ldan la gzhan chos ston dang / /nyan thos nang du zhag bdun gnas/ /brdzun gyis rnal 'byor nga rgyal byed/ /dad pa rnged la chos ston pa/ /'di rnams sbom po'i ltung ba brgyad//rtsa lhang sbom po'i rim pa dag /cho ga yis ni shes bya zhing / /nyams par gyur na bshags par bya/ /rdo rje jeg pa'i sgom po'i ltung ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—692

༄/ /rdo rje rjag pa'i rtsa ba'i snung ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//nye༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na mū la pa ti/ bod skad du/ rdo rje jeg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo//kun nas dang bas bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma la btud de/ /rtsa ba'i lhang ba bcu bzhi ni/ /rgyud las gsungs pa bshad par bya/ /gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs gsungs/ /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /rdo rje spun la khros pas ni//nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /sems can rnams la byams pa sgong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bar gsungs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smodapa drug pa yin/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrog pa bdun pa 27—694

yin / /phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /de la smod byed brgyad pa yin/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba dgu pa yin/ /gdugs 1la brtag tu byams ldan par/ /byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la/ /der rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa yi/ /sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa/ /dam tshig las ni ji bzhin rnyed/ /mi brten pa de bcu gsum pa/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud rnged la / /smod 2par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /sngags pas 'di dag spangs na ni/ /dngos grub nges par 'thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pas bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur/ /de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni/ /bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bla ma la/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod par bya/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni/ /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /sngags pas 'bad de bzung bar bya/ /rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba rdzogs so// //27—695

༄7/ /yan lag dam tshig ces bya ba/ /dam tshig dang ni mi ldan pa'i/ /rig ma bsten par dga' ba dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod 2pa dang / /gsang ba'i chos ni ston pa dang / /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /dam chos gzhan du ston pa dang / /nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun gnas pa dang / /sbyor ba nges par ma byas par/ /skal min gsang ba sto/na pa dang / /gang zhig phyag rgya mi mkhas la/ /lus kyi phyag rgya ston pa dang / /bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / /sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa la/ /dgos pa med par 'da' ba ni/ /kha na ma tho bcas 'gyur te/ /sngags pa de yi dam tshig zad/ /zad pas 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /bdud dang sdug bsngal mang du 'phel/ /nyin dang mtshan mo 'a/na gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni bzla bar bya/ /yan lag gi dam tshig ces bya 27—697

༄ga /rdo rje rjag pa'i rtsang ba'i snye ma zhes bya ba/tsho ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na pasto mañdza ri nā ma/ bod skad du/rdo rje theg pa'i ltung ba'i snye ma zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sdom pa 'dzin pa la ltung ba'i sde tshan rnam pa gnyis te/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bshad pa dang / spom po'i ltung ba bshad pa'o/ /de la bla ma la ma gus pa dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' las 'das pa dang / zhe sdang gis rdo rje spun la skyon 'bru ba dang / byams pa gtong ba dang / byang chub kyi sems gtong ba dang / jeg pa gsum la smod pa dang / yongs su ma smin pa la gsang ba sgogs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid phung po lnga la smod pa dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rnam par dag pa la the tshom za ba dang / gdug pa la byams pa dang ldan pa dang / thog ma dang / tha ma dang / dbus kyi chos thams cad 27—699

—stong pa la thog ma dang tha ma dang dbus su rtog pa dang / dad ldan gyi sems sun 'byin pa dang / ji ltar rnyed pa'i dam tshig mi bsten pa dang / bud med la smod pa ste rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi'o/ /de la stobs kyis rnal 'byor ma len pa dang stobs kyis de'i byang chub kyi sems len pa dang / gsang ba mi sgod 1pa dang / dam tshig la rtsod ༄pa dang / dad pa dang ldan pa la phyin ci log gi chos ston pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dang lhan cig zhag bdun du gnas pa dang / rnal 'byor mi shes par rnal 'byor par mngon pa'i nga rgyal byed pa dang / mi dad pa la chos ston pa ste sgom po'i ltung ba brgyad do/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bslab pa la gnas pas/ rnam pa thams cad du yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /rdo rje theg pa'i ltung ba'i snye/ ma zhes bya ba mkhas pa chen po a sgyu ka ra gup+tas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /ma ga dhā'i mkhas pa chen po de nyid dang / mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa sangs rgyas grags pas nā len+d+rar bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //

༄/ /rdo rje rjag pa'i rtsa ba'i rtsang ba bcu bzhi pa'i 'grel pa/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na mū la patrī bṛtrī/ bod skad du / rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi pa'i 'grel pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos kyi lus ngag gtso bor gyur pa'i spang bya bdun gyi mtshan nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje gtso bor gyur pa'i spang bya bcu'i mtshan nyid dang / gsang sngags rnal 'byor chen po'i thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa gtso bor gyur pa'i spang bya bcu bzhi'i mtshan nyid de/ de la gnyis ni gzhung gzhan rnams las gsal bas 'dir ma bshad do/ /gsang sngags rnal 'byor chen po'i rnam par thar pa la ltos 2te bstan pa la/ spyir thob par bya ba dang / mngon par rtogs pa'ibye brag dang / bsrung ba'i tshul lo/ /de la gnyis ni rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud dag las gsal bas 'dir logs shig tu ma brjod do/ /27—702

—bsrung ba'i tshul la gnyis te/ dam tshig dang / sdom pa'o/ /de nyid ni dam bca' ba'i yul dang / spong ba'i bye brag gis te/ 'di skad du/ sdom pa sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /e waṃ la ni rab tu bzhugs/ /rgyu yis yul las mi 'da' bas/ /dam tshig zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bas na dbang bzhi'i bye brag gis dam tshig kyang bzhi ste/ sgra ji bzhin pa dang /sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa dang / dgongs pa can dang / mthar thug pa'i bye brag gis so/ /de dag kyang mdor bsnyu na/ rigs kyi dam tshig dang / rtsa ba dang / nyes pa sgom po'o/ /rigs kyi la gnyis te/ spyi dang / khyad par ro/ /rtsa ba la gsum ste/ dbang gsum gyi dbye bas so/ /sbom po la gsum ste/ lus la sogs pa'i bye brag gis so/ /de la sdom pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa'i sdom pa gsum la gnas na sangs rgyas nyid dam rdo rje 'chang chen po 'thob po zhes 'byung la/ de yang rdo rje rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs nas ji skad du/ byang chub sems 'dzin gyur nas ni/ /lha gzhan la ni mi mos pas / /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang / /de la gzhol zhing 'bab pa yis / /gsod dang rku shedang 'khrig pa dang / /brdzun dang chang ni rnam par spang / /khyim pa'i tshul du gnas pas kyang / /rig sngags rgyal po rtag tu bsgrub/ /gal te der ni rab byung na/ /sdom pa gsum la gnas par 'gyur//so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin rang gi sdom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas de'i don la 'jug par bya ste/ 'dir de dag dang mi 'gal ba ni yeshes kyi bye brag gis te/ rang bzhin pa'i chos bzhi mi spyad cing bcas pa la de bzhin nyid kyi bdag nyid can gyis shes pas spyod cing don chen po yod pa'i 27—703

phyir dang / shin tu spros pa med pa'i spyod pa la ni dngos po la 'gal ba mred pas nyes byas la sogs par mi gzhag go/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i dam tshig bstan nga/ la spyir btang ba ni gang la gnod pa dang / gang gis 3bar du gcod pa dang /gang dri ma can du byas pa ste dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum dang / dngos grub gnyis dang / rang gi rgyud dang go rims 2 bzhin no/ /de la dngos gzhi ni/gnyi ga'i bar du gcod cing ngan song gsum du ltung bar byed do/ /'dra bas ni gnyi ga'i bar du gcod cing ngan song gsum du lhang yang sdug bsngal drag po 'a/ sogs pa ma yin pa dang / 'bring gis ni gnyis ka'i 4bar du gcod kyang ngan song du ltung ba'i rgyu ste 5khyad par du mi byed pa dang / chung ngus ni 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kyi bar du gcod do/ /yang spyir 'gro ba ni nyon mongs pa drug dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang 'byel pa'o/ /yang gnyis te/ lhan cig skyes pa dang / kun du brtags pa'o/ /yang bdun te/ spyor ba dang /dngos gzhi 7dang / nyes byas dang / nyes pa med pa dang / phyogs dang mthun pa dang / bslab par bya ba dang / dri ma las ldang ba'o/ /ldang ba la bdun te/ dbang dang / tshogs dang / bsnyen sgrub —dang / tshogs pa'i mthu dang / bzlas pa dang / sems sun 'byin pa dang / tha mal pa la bshags pa'o/ /da ni gzhung la 'jug par bya ste/ slob dpon la ni brnyas pa dang / /zhes smos pa la gang las dbang bsgur mchog thob pa med pa dang / slob dpon gyis de nyid bstan pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang 27 —70/

'brel pa'i sems dang / lus ngag yid kyis 1sbyor ba byas pa dang / go ba'am khyad par can gyis nyon mongs pa bskyed 2pa dang / rang bzhin du gnas pa dang / dbang dang ldan pa dang / rmi lam yin pa dang / yan lag brgyad kyi /ni dngos gzhi 4yin la/ spyor ba ni ji srid ma rdzogs pa de srid do / /gzhan ma tshang ba la yan lag gtso bo yod pa ni nyes pa chen po'o/ /'bring dang chung ngu yod pa la ni nyes pa 'bring dang chung ngu'o/ /gsum po lta bu'i gnas skabs su ni nyes pa med do/ /gnyis dang shan 'dra ba ni phyogs dang mthun pa'o/ /slob dpon thams cad la rdo rje sems dpar blta'o zhes pa ni babe+eb par bya'o5/ /rtsa ba ni dbang gis ldang ngo / /tshogs dang bsnyen sgrub 6ma gtogs pa bzhis ni 'dra ba las ldang ngo / /gong ma gnyis kyis ni 'bring las ldang ngo / /tha ma gnyis kyis ni chung ngu las ldang ngo / /de bzhin du sazhan rnams la yang ci rigs par shes par bya'o/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa dang / /zhes smos pa las/ 'dir ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang rdo rje 'chang gi bka' thams cad kyang gdul bya'i ched du yin la/ de yang 'gro ba'i don du ste/ de bas na gang zag bdag grol 1 ba'i dbang du byas pas thams cad kyang der 'dus so/ /rdo rje'achang gi bka' yang bzhi ste/ las kyi bye brag thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dang / bsrung bar bya ba dang / sgrub 8pa'i thabs dang /'bras bu'o/ /de las 'das pa ni gnyis te/ log par spyod pa dang / log par ston pa'o/ /de dag kyang dgag sgrub kyi bye brag gis rnam pa bzhi'o/ /de 27—70 3

la yan lag ni thun mong ba gsum dang / nyon mongs pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / yul khyad par can dang / der 'du shes pa dang / log par spyod pa'i sbyor ba byas pa dang / nges pa bskyed 3pa ste brgyad kyis dngos gzhi'o2 / /ston pa'i phyogs la tha ma'i don go bar gyur pa gzhug go/ /ldang ba ni tshogs pa'i mthu man chad bzhis dngos gzhi las ldang ngo / /shes rab gsum dang / nyon mongs pa'i sems dang / yul de gong ma lta bu 4yin pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang / spyor ba byas pa dang / go ba'am nyon mongs pa khyad par can bskyed pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa ste dgus dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /de ni tshogs kyi 'khor los ldang ngo / /gzhan ni snga ma bzhin no/ /chom rkun 5gyi gnas kyi grogs stobs can lta bur rdo rje spun kun la blta'o 6zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /byams pa chen po sgong ba dang / /zhes pa la sems can shin tu sdug bsnga'/ dang ldan pa la btang snyoms dang ldan pa dang der 'du shes pa dang / bgrod du rung ba na yod par mthong ba'am thos pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i sems dang /thun mong ba cha gsum dang / bdag la mthu yod pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa dang / bde ba'i spyor ba 'dor ba ste bcus dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /tshogs pa'i mthu man chad bzhis de las ldang ngo / /sems can 8thams cad la pha ma la sogs pa dang / bdag nyid kyi bar du 'du shes babyed par bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /27—706

byang chub sems ni 'dor ba dang / /zhes pa ni dngos por 'dzin pa dang zhen pa ste/ spong ba'i gdams ngag mi tshol ba dang / gnyen po mi bsten pa dang /yang dang yang du 'dor ba dang / de'i dbang gis 1nyes pa la spyor ba'o/ /yan lag gi grangs ni snga ma bzhin no/ /bde ba'i sbyor ba 'dor 2ba zhes pa ni sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i sbyor ba 'dor ba zhes gzhag go/ /ldang ba ni snga ma bzhin no//ma rgal ba bsgral bar bya'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /lha yi bdag nyid phung po smod/ /ces pa ni/ lhar mi sgom pa dang /'bral bar 'dod pa dang / de las gzhan du bsgom pa'o/ /yan lag ni thun mong ba bzhi dang / yul de dang de lta bu yin pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang /gong ma gsum gang yang rung ba ste bdun gyi 4dngos gzhi'o/ /ldang ba ni bsnyen sgrub 5kyis so/ /lus la mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs pa bsam par bya'o zhes bya ba ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /jeg pa gsum la smod pa dang / /zhes bya ba ni bya ba 6dang gnyi ga dang /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / gsang ba'i theg pa gsum po rnal 'byor ma dang thabs dang zung du 'jug pa'o/ /smod pa ni gzhung bzhin ma smos pa'o/ /thun mong ba 7bzhi dang / yul khyad par can dang / der 'du shes pa dang / mi mthun pa'i spyor ba byas pa dang / yang dag pa'i spyor ba log pa ste brgyad kyis dngos gzhi'o/ /tshogs pa'i mthu man chad bzhis ldang ngo / /med na mi 'byung 8 27—707

ba'i lam gsum du shes par bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o1/ /yang dag chos la yid gnyis za/ /zhes pa la srung ḍa2ba dang / sgrub nga/ dang / thob pa don dam pa'i rang bzhin la yid gnyis za ba ste thun mong ba bzhi dang / don dam pa dag pa dang 'byel pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang /med dam snyam pa'i blo gnyis dang / 'di la ma dad pa dang btang snyoms su dor ba ste dgus dngos gzhi'o/ /ldang ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /chos thams cad 'a tshul gcig kho nas shes par bya'o zhes bya ba ni babe+eb 4par bya ba'o/ /chos la gnyis su 'byed pa zhes bya ba 5ni chos rnal 'byor chen po la sogs/ pa'i grub pa'i mtha' las grags pa'i bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i cha shin tu phra ba phyi rol pa'i grub pa'i mthar 'chad cing 'dzin pa'am/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub pa'i mtha' la bzang ngan 'byed pa'am ston pa ste thun mong ba bzhi dang / yul khyad par can dang / der 'du shes pa dang / mi mthun pa'i spyor ba byas pa dang /gzhan gyis go ba dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa ste dgus dngos gzhir 'gyur ro//tshogs pa'i mthu man chad bzhis ldang ngo / /lam la bye brag med par bslab par bya zhing bden par smra bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni bslab par 6bya ba'o/ /gdug la byams dang chags bral dang / /zhes pa la/ 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig par byed pa dang / sun 'byin pa ste/ stobs dang ldan pas 7bcom pa'o/ /de dag chos dang zang zing gi 'byel pa dang bral bar 27—708

bya ba ste/ de las gzhan du byed pa ni nyes pa'o/ /thun mong ba bzhi dang / yul khyad par can dang de ltar 'du shes pa dang / spyor ba byas pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa dang / gzhan gyis go ba ste dgus dngos gzhi'o/ /ldang ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed pa/ /'bad pas gsad 1par bya ba yin no zhes bslab par bya ba'o/ /chags bral ba ni snying rje dang bral ba'o/ /skal min gsang ba ston pa dang / /zhes 'byung ba la thun mong ba bzhi dang / rung bar ma byas pa'i yul dang / der 'du shes pa dang / ngag gi spyor ba byas pa dang / dbang dang 'byel zhing zab pa dang / rgya che ba 4 brjod pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa dang / go ba ste bcus dngos gzhi'o/ /ldang ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /'di na gsang ba'i sgod dkon par blta'o zhes pa ṭi bslab par bya ba'o/ /dad ldan sems ni sun 'byin dang / /zhes 'byung ba la thun mong ba bzhi dang / yul rung bar gyur pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang / dgongs pa mayin pa dang / ngag gi spyor ba byas pa dang / go ba ste dgus dngos gzhi'o//ldang ba ni snga ma bzhin no/ /chos kyi spyin pas sems can thams cad tshim par bya'o zhes bya ba ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /dam tshig las ni ji bzhin rnyed mi bsten/ /zhes bya ba ni thun mong ba 27—709

bzhi dang / rdzas khyad par can dang / der 'du shes pa dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dus dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa dang / gzhan gyis go ba ste dgus dngos gzhi'onyu/ /ldang ba ni tshogs kyi 'khor los so/ /spyod pa thams cad dang mthun par bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /shes rab rang bzhin can smod pa/ /zhes bya ba ni dam tshig dus su rung ba gzungs su byas pa'am yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /sgod pa ni skyon brjod pa'o / /thun mong ba thubazhi dang / yul khyad par can dang / der 'du shes pa dang / spyor ba byas pa dang / gang yang rung bas go bar byas pa dang / dgongs pa ma gru/yin pa ste dgus dngos gzhi'o/ /ldang ba ni bsnyen sgrub la sogs pas so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par ④dmigs par bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /gyede dag kyang bsdu na gsum du 'du ste/ byang chub sems 'dor bde gshegs bka' 'das dang / /byams spong theg gsum smod dang chos yid gnyis//thugs kyi'o/ /slob dpon brnyas dang lha nyid phung po smod/ /dam tshig mi bsten 5shes rab smod pa rnams/ /sku'i 'o/ /mi bsngags brjod dang dad ldan sems sun 'byin/ /gdug la chags bral chos gnyis gsang ba ston/ /gsung gi'o/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i dngos gzhi'i yan lag ma tshang ba las sbom po la sogs 27—710

pa gsum gyi bye brag gis rnam pa du mar 'gyur ba bstan pa las/ 'dir de dang mi 'dra ba'i nyes pa sbom por bstan par bya ste/ dam tshig dang ni mi ldan pa'i/ /rig ma bsten par dga' ba dang / /zhes 'byung ba la thun mong ba bzhi dang /yul dam tshig med pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang / sbyor ba byas pa dang /nyams su myong ba ste brgyad kyis dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /ldang ba ni bsnyen sgrub man chad kyis so/ /ma'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod 7pa dang / /zhes pa ni thun mong ba bzhi dang /bla ma'am rdo rje spun gyi tshogs pa dang / bsgrub 3pa'am/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor kyi nang du zhugs pa'i dus dang / der 'du shes pa dang / ngag —gi spyor ba byas pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa ste bcus dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /ldang ba ni tshogs kyis so/ /bag yod par bya zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /dam chos gzhan du ston pa dang / /zhes bya ba la thun mong ba bzhi dang / sems can snod du gyur pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang gzhan ston pa'i ngag gis sbyor ba byas pa dang / go ba dang /dgongs pa ma yin pa ste dgus dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /ldang ba ni bzlas pa la sogs pas so/ /bden par smra bar bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun gnas pa dang / /27—711

zhes pa la 'dir skur pa 'debs pa dang / mi mos pa yin par gzung ngo / /zhag bdun nam drug tu 'gro na bar du gnas shing rang gi spyad pa mi byed pa na lung dang yul chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de las 'das pa ni dus kyi sgrub par tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /kha cig ni yon tan bdun dang ldan pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor can zhag gcig kyang gnas par mi bya'o zhes 'chad do/ /de yang 'di lta/ ste / dkyil 'khor tshogs dang sbyin sreg 3snadang / /mchod dang gtor ma go rims 2dang / /de nyid dang ni bdun du bstan/ /zhes 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'o/ /'dir yang thun mong ba bzhi dang / yul khyad par can dang /der 'du shes pa dang / zhag bdun 'das pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin nga/ ste / brgyad kyis dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /ldang ba ni tshogs kyi 'khor los/ so / /gcig pur gnas par bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /spyor ba nges par ma byas pa'i/ /skal min gsang ba sgrogs 5pa dang / /zhes pa ni dam tshig thob kyang phun sum tshogs pa ma yin pa dang / de dang mi ldan pa la bya'o/ /thun mong ba bzhi dang / yul khyad par can dang / der 'du shes pa dang / dbang dang 'byel pa'i gsang ba dang / ngag gi spyor ba byas pa dang / go ba dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa ste bcus 'gyur ro/ /ldang ba ni bzlas pa la sogs pas so/ /brgyad brtag 6par bya'o zhes pa ni babe+eb 7par bya ba'o/ /gang zhig phyag rgya mi mkhas pas/ /lus kyi phyag rgya ston pa dang / /zhes 27—7/2

——pa la thun mong ba bzhi dang / yul khyad par can dang / der 'du shes pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa dang mthong ba ste brgyad kyis 1dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /ldang ba ni bsnyen 2sgrub kyis so/ /shin tu sba bar bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / /zhes pa la thun mong ba bzhi dang / dag par ma byas pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa dang / spyor ba dang zhugs pa ste dgus dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /ldang ba ni bsnyen sgrub kyis so/ /mtshan ma thob nas 'jug par bya'o zhes pa ni bslab par bya ba'o/ /sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa las/ /dgos pa rnged par 'da' ba dang / /jes pa la thun mong ba bzhi dang / ltung ba'i yul yin pa dang / der 'du shes pa dang / dgongs pa ma yin pa dang / spyor ba dang / de dag las 'das pa ste dgus dngos gzhir 'gyur ro/ /ldang ba ni bzlas pa la sogs pas so / /sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya'o / //bla ma lnga bcu pa'i nyes pa ni ci rigs par bcu bzhi pa'i nang du 'dus par rig par bya'o / /4slob dpon chen po dpal lak+ṣa m+bi ka ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi pa'i 'grel pa rdzogs so// //

—bsdur mchan/7༷2 shematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉gi rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i tring ba bcu bzhi pa'i 'grel pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ④〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉 ltos/7༷3 77〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gin/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibadag nyid/7༷4 gyo/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 23〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rem/ kye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra zhi/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉skanyi ba'i/3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ phyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da pa/ 3〈〈snar 〉thazhi/ kro〈〈pe 〉skod ra 〉thasgrub/7༷5 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ bya〈〈snar 〉ra zhi/ gye〈〈snar 〉khya ba'o—/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sgrub/ /3〈〈pe 〉〉'grol/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgrub/7 6 lha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉ra zhi'o/ rjo〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉shegar/ ④〈〈co 〉lbār/khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga na/ ⑥ 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉skada'o/ spyo〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉staXngs pa sge〈〈pe 〉〉gican/7༷7 hu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesar/ 〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ñdzu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gib/ spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gini bya ba/ klu)〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gib/ ske〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅka'abyung /7༷8 ①〈〈be+e 〉snga〈snar 〉rabya'o/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srung / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bangs pa/ ④〈〈pe〉skopo ra 〉l+lab/rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7bya'o zhes bya ba ni babe+eb par/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha dang / bcos/7༷9 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasad/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7no/ 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7pa ni/ ④〈〈co 〉thar/71༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhi'o/ pya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅mongs pa bu〈〈pe 〉〉gim/ ④〈〈co〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈be+e 〉tha'o// // ( 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7 sten/711 ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabartsod/ ṭ+wāṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ bye ༄〈〈pe 〉sngagang /712 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasreg du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rem/ spyo〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉mizlas/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈'dir 〉tha'ir/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrog ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtags/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamab/713 te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganyen/ da ④〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉sha/ // me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gisnga/27dod714
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1315)

༄/ /rdo rje shāg pa'i rtsa ba'i yung ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ rta༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na mū 2la padhi ṭī kā / bod skad du/rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sku gsum sprul/ /sku rnams/ 'dul ba'i rgyal po dang / /'phags dang zab pa'i don ston dang / /rna brgyud thob pa'i slob dpon ni/ /bcu gnyis tshogs la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen lta bu'i rgyud chen las/ /gzhi mo lta bur bzhag nas ni/ /rgyud rnams kun las btus nas kyang / /sgrub 4pa'i don du bshad par bya/ /de la/ dam tshig nyams dang ma nyams dang / /bskang ba'i cho ga gsum du bstan/ /rdo rje slob dpon dam tshig ni/ /nyams pa'i rab 'bring gsum dang dgu/ /ngan sems bcas nas slob dpon la/ /tshig rtsub mtshon phyung rgyab 5nas ni/ /yun ring mthol bshags mi byed pa/ /nyams pa che ste 'bring 27—716

bi ni/ /mtshon phyung la sogs brgyab nas su/ /cung zhig mthol bshags mi byed pa/ /'bring yin tha ma nyams pa ni/ /ngan sems sgo nas bshags nas su//mthol bshags mi byed zla ba'i bar/ /tha ma yin te gsum ka la/ /sems dang dngos dang sogs pa la/ /bzlog nas ches cher 'khrul pa dang / /go ma/nyam pa ni mtsho skyes gsungs1/ /yang na dgu yi rab kyi rab/ /bsam pa brong rdzogs slob dpon bkrongs / /lo ru bshags pa mi byed pa/ /'bring ni sgong bzhin rdzogs nas su/ /lo phyed bshags pa mi byed pa/ /tha ma zla bar mi bshags pa'o/ /slob dpon ma bkrongs gsum pa rdzogs/ /lo ru mi bshags 'bring gi rab/ /'bring gi lo phyed tha ma ni/ /zla ba gcig go 4tha ma'i bar /gnyis po rdzogs nas lo dus su/ /'bring ni lo phyed du ni bstan/ /tha ma zla ba 5sacig gnas pa'o/ /slob dpon gnyis su bstan pa la/ /rdo rje slob dang slob dpon tsam/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin brlabs 6pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon de la ni/ /thams cad brtsi bar bya ba yin/ /bstan bcos slob dpon dgu yi ni/ /tha ma tsam mam yang na ni/ /yan lag mgo mnyam tsam du dpyad/ /rdo rje slob dpon gsum du ste/ /rtsa ba dang ni yan lag gnyis/ /dgu ka brtsi bar bya ba yin/ /phyag rgya drug pa man chad do/ /las kyi slob dpon lgesum pa yin/ /rtsa ba man ngag gnyis po yang / /rtsa ba man ngag bstan pa ni/ /man ngag pas ni rtsa ba che/ /man ngag gis ni man ngag che / /rtsa ba chung na go mnyam mo/ /man ngag gis ni man ngag shin tu che/ /gong ma de las bzlog ste bstan / /lung ston pa yi slob dpon ni/ /phyag rgya nyid dang go mnyam mo/ /sko/ba dpon gyi rtsa ba'i dam tshig go/ /

rab kyi yang rab nyams pa ni/ /bsam ngan mtshon dbyug bsnun nas su/ /thi nas lo ru mi bshags pa/ /yang rab yin te rab kyi 'bring / /lo phyed du ni shes par bya/ /rab kyi tha ma zla ba gsum/ /'bring gi rab kyi rmyedam tshig ni/ /zla ba gcig tu shes par bya/ /'bring gi 'bring ni zla ba phyed/ /'bring gi tha ma/ zhag gcig go/ /tha ma'i dam tshig nyams pa ni/ /tshig rtsub smras nas zla gcig tu/ /mthol bshags mi byed tha ma'i rab/ /'an+d+rang ni zla phyed shes par bya / /tha ma zhag gcig yan chad do/ /gsum du phye ste bstan pa ni/ /mtshon dbyug la sogs brgyab nas su/ /shi nas cung zhig mi bshags pa/ /de ni rab yin 'bring gi ni/ /mtshon phyung brgyab nas ma shi bar/ /tha ma tshig rtsub smras nas ni/ /zhag 'das 3mthol bshags mi byed pa/ /rdo rje srun gye dam tshig nyams pa'i tshad do / /1bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa yi/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i tshad bstan pa / /dam tshig sa ya 'bum sde yang / /bde gshegs bka' ru 'dus pa yin/ /'di ni khyab che khyad par ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon byed pas su/ /slob dang 'gro ba'i don du yang / /cho ga tshul bzhin ma gyur pa/ /lo ru byed na rab kyi rab/ /zla dgur byed na 'adz+reng yin no/ /zla drug tha mar shes par bya/ /'bring gi rab ni zla ba gsum/ /'bring gi 'bring ni zla gcig go/ /'bring gi tha mazla phyed do/ /tha ma'i rab ni zhag gcig go/ /khengs grags 'dod pa'i dbang 27—718

—gyur nas/ /cho ga thams cad 'khrul pa'am/ /'bring ni cho ga phyed 'khrul pa/ /tha ma cho ga gcig 'khrul pa/ /de rnams rgyu yi rim pa yang / /'khrul pa'i cho ga rgyun byed la/ /shin tu che bar gyur pa yin/ /bshags pa yun ring mi byed nga/ / /bshags la brtson na de la smad/ /'khrul pa'i cho ga rgyun du ni/ /mi byed gcig gnyis de la smad/ /che chung yod na de la ri1snabastod/ /de ltar rab 'bring dgu gsum ni/ /mkhas pas brtags nas shes par bya yang na/sgrub dang slob dpon gnyis ka yang / /bde gshegs bka' ni 3khyab che bas /dod mo dbang bskur byas nas su/ /dbang dang dam tshig mi shes dang / /snod min bstan par mi bya la/ /dbang la sogs pa ston pa dang / /yi dam lha ni bajed nas su/ /slar yang len par mi byed dang / /thun mtshams sgom — par mi byed dang / /zas dang gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang / /phyi nang spyin sreg 4rnal 'byor dang / /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /mchod pa'i dus kyi 5'khor lo sogs/ /yi dam lha dang slob dpon gyikhu/ /mdun du dam bca' byas nas ni/ /spangs dang ma bshags brjed 7pa rnams/ /rdo rje dril bu phreng ba gsum/ /mi gyebacang rab gnas ma byas dang / /rgyu dang tshad sogs 'khrul pa dang / /'tshong dang bgo (dang gte 'jug dang / /rab gnas byas la shes par bya/ /ma byas pa la chung ngu 'ong / /po ti glegs bam la sogs dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ la sogs phyag mtshan rnams/ /gong bzhin rab gnas byas pa dang / /ma byas pa ni che chung ngo / /khyad par sgrub pa po yis 7ni/ /rdor dril la sogs thams cad kun/ /gtso bo la sogs mchod byas la/ /chos mthun yid 'ong gzung bar bya/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 27—7/9

'dzin nang gi sdom pa gsum/ /gnyis ni rig 'dzin rten yang yin/ /yang na rig 'dzin nang du 'dus/ /mi dge la sogs bcu po yang / /gsum du 'dus te khyad par ni/ /spang ba dang ni mi spang dang / /dngos dang bsam/ nga/ dus dang ni/ /gnas skabs dang ni rnal 'byor kyi/ /blo yi khyad par rim/ nga/ yis / /shes par de ni ma byas na/ /byas na yang ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /ma/ byas na yang ltung bar 'gyur/ /de bas slob dpon la gus pas/ /man ngas gis ni shes par bya/ /chos spyod la sogs bcu po yang / /man ngag bsgom/ nga/ ma shes na/ /mdor na bka' yi chos rnams kun/ /thams cad chos tshul bzhin shes bya/ /de ltar mi shes dam tshig nyams/ /sku dang me tog dman nga/ dang / /slob dpon la sogs grib ma la/ /'gom dang brdzi rmi1bar byed pa dang / /dbang dang brdzi 2bar mi byed kyi/ /bar gyi dam tshig de dag kun/ /lo dunu/ lon la chen por 'gyur/ /lo phyed lon na 'bring du 'gyur/ /tha ma zla gcis shes par bya/ /bde gshegs bka' yi dam tshig go/ /sems can rnams la byams pa yi/ /sems spangs pas ni dam tshig nyams///de yi rab 'adz+reng bstan pa ni/ /zhing dag pa yi gang zag la/ /khros dang byams sems spangs nas ni/ /mtshon dbyug la sogs bsnun nas ni/ /loru bshags pa mi byed pa/ /rab kyi rab yin 'bring gi ni/ /de phyed du ni shes par bya/ /tha ma yi ni zla gcig go/ /zhing ma dag pa'i gang zag la/ /gong bzhin byas nas lo ru ni/ /mi bshags pa ni 'bring gi rab/ /'bring gi lo phyed tha ma ni/ /zla ba gcig tu shes par bya/ /sems can la sogs gzhan ngo/ 27—720

la / /gong bzhin byas nas rtelo ru ni/ /mi bshags pa ni tha ma'i rab/ /'bring ni lo phyed tha ma gcig /zhing dag pa yi gang zag la/ /nyin gcig mang por rdung byed la/ /rab kyi yin te 'bring gi ni/ /ma dag pa yi gang zag 'a/ / /tha ma sems can phal pa la/ /mang po rnams ni rdung byed la2/ /de las mang nyung 'khrul pa dang / /sems dang dngos dang sogs pa rnams/ /slo/ba dpon zhal nas shes par bya/ /dag dang ma dag gang zag dang / /sems can gzhan la sogs pa la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gdungs nas ni/ /'chi la thug pa'i sems can la/ /nyin dang mtshan ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhis mi skyong na/ /dam tshig nyams te gong ma bzhin/ /slob dpon zhal nas shes par bya/ /byams sems spangs pa'i dam tshig go/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong dam tshig nyams pa ni/ /dam tshig rab 'bring tshad bstan pa/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor sems bskyed nas/ /slar log nyan thos sems bskyed la/ /zhugs nas lo ru gnas pa yin/ /bshags pa mi byed rab yin no/ /'bring gi lo phyed tha ma ni/ /zla ba gcig tu shes par bya/ /zla phyed zhag bdun zhag gcig ni/ /tha ma yi ni rab 'bring gsum / /gong ma de ni 'bring gi yin/ /rab ni mu stegs sems su ni/ /zhugs nas lo gcig lo phyed dang / /zla gcig tha ma'i rab yin no/ /sems spangs pa yi dam tshig go/ /rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod 4pa'i dam tshig gi/ /27—72/

rab 'bring gi ni tshad bstan pa/ /chos la smod 7nas lo ru ni/ /mi bshags pa ni rab yin no/ /'bring ni lo phyed tha ma ni/ /zla ba gcig tu shes par bya/ /rgyun du smod cing mi bshags pa/ /lo dang lo phyed zla ba dang / /rab kyi rab 'bring gsum yin no/ /gong ma 'bring yin tha ma ni/ /zla phyed zhag gcig zhag bdun ni/ /tha ma yi ni rab 'bring gsum/ /chos la smod pa'i dam tshig go/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa'i byedam tshig ni/ /rab 'bring gi ni tshad bstan pa/ /ma smin pa la gnyis yod de/ /dbang bskur de ni ma byas dang / /glen pa lkugs par /1gyur pa gnyis/ /de lta bu yi gang zag la/ /man ngag gsang ba bstan nas kyang / /lo yi dus su mi bshags pa/ /'bring gi rab yin 'bring gi lo/ /phyed 'bring yin te tha ma ni/ /zla ba gcig tu shes par bya/ /de 'dra'i gang zag mang po la/ /yang nas yang du sgogs shepa ni/ /lo gcig lo phyed zla phyed ni/ /rab kyi rab 'bring gsum yin no/ /mi zab chos su gyur pa yi thu / /lo gabyug tu ni gnas pa dang / /tha ma'i rab yin tha ma yi/ /lo phyed 6zla gcig gnyis po yin/ /yang na zab pa'i don rnams la/ /zla phyed zhag bdun zhag gcig ni/ /tha ma yi ni rab 'bring gsum/ /yang na de gsum 'khrul ka yi/ /slob dpon mkhas pas shes par bya/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa'i dam tshig go/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga — bdag la/ /brnyas par byed pa'i dam tshig ni/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i tshad bstan pa/ /phung po lha sheyi nga rgyal du/ /ma shesashes 27—722

nas spangs pa ni/ /bshags pa mi byed lor lon pa/ /'bring gi rab yin 'adz+reng gi ni/ /lo phyed tha ma zla ba gcig /zla phyed zhag bdun zhag gcig ni/ /tha 1ma'i rab 'bring gsum yin no/ /ma shes steng du yang nas yang / /smod nga/ra byed cing gdung ba ni/ /lo gcig lo phyed zla gcig ni/ /rab kyi 'bring yin gsum yin no/ /phung po brnyas byed dam tshig go/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba'i dam tshig ni/ /rtsa ba rlung gi man ngag la/ /lan cig dka' ba la sogs kyi/ /zab mo'i don la lo dus su/ /the tshom za zhing mi bshags pa/ /rab kyi rab yin 'bring gi ni/ /tha ma zla ba lo gcig go/ /lhan cig bka' bca' ma gtogs pa'i/ /lhag ma rnams la je tshom ni/ /lo dus zla ba 'bring gi rab/ /lhag ma gnyis po gong bzhin bya/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin las/ /lha yi 2rnal 'byor gnyis dang ni//mi shes phyi nang thun mong gsum/ /yang na gong ma gnyis po yi/ /zla phyed zhag bdun zhag gcig ni/ /tha yi rab 'bring gsum yin no/ /som nyi za ba'i dam tshig go/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan par/ /byed pa'i dam tshig nyams pa ni/ /gdug —ces bya ba'i slob dpon ni/ /rdo rje srun dang rnal 'byor gyi/ /dgrar gyur bstan pa 'jig pa dang / /de la sogs pa byed pa rnams/ /gdug pa 'es ni bya ba yin/ /de lta bu yi gdug pa ni/ /mthol bshags mi byed lo ru ni//gnas pas rab kyi rab yin no/ /lhag ma gnyis po gong bzhin no/ /slob 27—723

dpon ma gtogs rdo rje spun/ /'bring gi rab 'bring gsum yin no/ /gnyis po ma gtogs lhag ma ni/ /tha ma'i rab 'bring gsum yin no/ /yang na de rnams gsum ka la/ /zhag grangs brtsi na —1gong bzhin no/ /gdug la byams/ pa'i dam tshig go/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la/ /rtog 2par byed pa'i dam tshig ni/ /chos rnams spros dang bral ba la/ /lo gcig rtog par 'dzin pa dang / /gzhan yang de la sbyor byed pa'i/ /bshags par mi byed pa yi mi/ /lhag ma gnyis ni gong bzhin no/ /gzhan la mi spyor rang tsam ni/ /lo nas zla bar 'bring gi ni/ /rab 'bring du ni shes par bya/ /dngos por ma bzung tshol 'dod pa/ /de bzhin lo nas zla ba'i bar/ /tha ma'i rab 'bring gsum yin no//rtog 'dzin byed pa'i dam tshig go/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa yi/ /sems sun 'byin pa'i dam tshig ni/ /dad dang ldan pa'i gang zag rnams/ /zab mo'i chos las bzlog nas ni/ /nu/ stegs chos la spyor byas pa/ /lo nas zla ba'i bar du ni/ /rab kyi rab 'bring gsum yin no/ /zab mo'i don las bzlog nas ni/ /nyan thos jeg par spyor byed pa/ /'adz+reng rab gsum yin no bzhin tshad/ /zab mo'i don las bzlob nas ni/ /pha rol phyin par sbyor byed pa/ /tha ma'i rab 'bring gsum yin no/ /yang na/ pha rol theg pa bzlog nas ni/ /mu stegs jeg par sbyor byed pa/ /'bring yin nyan thos zlog byed pa/ /tha ma yin te gsang sngags ni/ /rab 27—724

yin yang na mang po rnams/ /zlog 1byed pa ni rab yin te/ /nyung ngu 'bring yin tha ma ni/ /sems sun 'byin pa'i dam tshig go/ /dam tshig rnams la ji bzhin rnyed/ /mi bsten dam tshig nyams pa'i tshad/ /rtsa ba dang ni yan lag gi/ /dam tshig nyin mtshan mi sdo 2dang / /spyod pa la sogs lnga po lnga/ /dang du blangs nas mi bsten pa/ /lo nas zla ba'i bar du ni/ /mi/ bshags rab kyi gsum yin no/ /rtsa ba dang du mi len par/ /'jog pa /'bring gi gsum yin no/ /yan lag mi len tha ma gsum/ /yang na zla phyed '-ig bdun du/ /zhag gcig pa ni 'bring gi gsum/ /nyin mtshan gcig la tha rnga/'i gsum/ /mi bsten pa yi 4dam tshig go/ /bud med shes rab rang bzhin can/ /smod par byed pa'i 5dam tshig ni/ /dper na ba lang ko ba nas/ /sgras mtshon bar du slob pa bzhin/ /bud med shes rab sgyu ma can/ /las kyi phyag rgya mtshan ldan la/ /brten nas de la 6 lobs gyur na/ /yid kyi lha mo la brten nas7/ /de nas gtum mo nyid la brten / /da nas shes rab dga' ma la/ /lhan cig dga' ba'i bar du ni/ /brten nas shes rab rim par bskyed / /de nas phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'thob/ /de ltar bud med shes rab la/ /smod cing spong bar byed pa ni/ /lo dus lon na rab kyi rab/ /phyed dang zla gcig gnyis su bstan/ /de lta'i shes rab rang bzhin la/ /rnal 'byor lam pa smod na ni/ /'adz+reng gi gsum dang bstan nga/ yin/ /mtshan dang mi ldan thams cad la/ /rgyun du smod cing mi bshags pa//27—725

lo dus lon na tha ma'i rab/ /phyed dang zla gcig gnyis su bstan/ /shes rab smod pa'i dam tshig go/ /rtsa ba'i dam tshig rab 'bring nyu nyams pa'i tshad bstan pa'o/ /yan lag dam tshig bstan pa 2ni/ /rnal 'byor sngags pas sngags pa ni/ /nan gyis len pa gsum du bsten༄// /gzhan gyi bud med len pa dang / /rang gi rnal 'byor ma gnyis la/ /chags pa'i don du 'jug pa dang / /byin gyes brlab par mi byed par/ /tha mal spyod pas 'jug pa dang / /rtags dang mi/ ldan 'jug pa ni/ /rnal 'byor chags pa'i lam pas ni/ /dang po chags nga/ 'dul ba dang / /zab mo'i don la 'jug bya'i phyir/ /shin tu chags pa cher ldan pa4/ /bde gshegs rgyal bas bstan pa yin/ /rnal 'byor grol ba'i lam pa la/ /gong ma de bzhin ma bstan te/ /las dang rnal 'byor dus su ni//yid kyi lha mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am spyod dus su/ /mo/sa pas de bsam dam tshig yin/ /rtags ldan brtan 5pa thob nas ni/ /mchos gi dngos grub myur 'dod pas/ /rnal 'byor ma yis lung bstan nas/ /mi de lha la sogs pa yis/ /zhag gcig zla gcig zhag drug tu/ /bsnyen pas mchos ni thob par 'gyur/ /chags rnged rnal 'byor mos pa yi/ /skad cig shes rab la brten nas/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de don bya ba'i rim pa ni/ /sa la gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /kho na nyid la brten pa yin/ /de ltar mi shes 'khrul par spyod/ /rgyun du spyod cing lo dus su/ /mi bshagasade ni rab 6yin no/ /de bas nyung bar gyur pa ni/ /'bring nyid du ni shesang/ra 27—726

— —— — —— ———dodabya / /thabs cig spyod pa tha ma yin/ /nan 1 gyis len pa'i dam tshig go/ /ma gsungs pa yi rig ma la/ /sngags pas bdud rtsi thob 2byed ni/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /man ngag rna bar ma brgyud par/ /nan gyis brtags nas tshul 'chos pa/ /rgyun du byed cing lo dus su/ /mi bshags pa ni rab yin no/ /de bas nyung ba 'bring yin te/ /gcig tsam byed pa tha ma yin / /ma thob pa yi dam tshig go/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dam tshig go/ /bstan la 'thab mo rtsod byed pa/ /dbang bskur man ngag zab mo dang / /slob dpon gcig par ma gyur la/ /mi zab tshogs la bshad pa yi 5/ /dus su rtsod nas mtshon dbyug 7ni/ /'dres nas cung zhig mi bshags pa/ /rab kyi yin te 'bring gi ni/ /mtshon dbyug 'dres nas yun thung ba/ /tha ma tshig rtsub shin tu thub/ /shi bar gyur na slob dpon gyi8/ /'bring po man chad brtsi bar bya/ /tshogs kyi dam tshig nyams pa'o/ /gsang chos yan lag shes gyur kyang / /gzhan la mi ston shes 9 ngan ni/ /sgod du gyur pa'i gang zag la/ /man ngag shes bzhin mi ston na/ /sgod gyur mang la mi ston rab/ /nyung la mi ston tha ma gcig /yang na dus kyi gsum po ni / /gong ma bzhin du shes par bya/ /lung mi ston pa'i dam tshig go/ /

dad pa'i sems can chos kyi tshorgyu/ /gzhan gyi gtam 3byed byang chub sems—/ /theg chen snod du gyur pa la/ /gus pas chos ni dri byed pa/ /lan mi 'debs te yi ge'i gtam 1/ /byed pa rab yin 'bring gi ni/ /lung ma bstan pa'i gtam byed cing / /tha ma nyan thos kyi ni gtam/ /dus gsum gong bzhin shes par bya/ /log par ston pa'i dam tshig go/ /nyan thos nang du zhag bdun 'dug /theg pa chen po'i chos la ni/ /thos par gyur nas skur pa yi/ /nang du zhag bdun 'dug nas ni/ /spangs/ nas spong byed lo dus su/ /mi bshags pa ni rab yin no/ /zhag gsum du d+mā gcig ni tha/ /de gnyis su ni gong bzhin no/ /yang na rigs 'drar gyur nga/ la / /gnyis po man chad brtsi bar bya/ /zhag bdun nyal ba'i dam tshig go/ /rnal 'byor ye shes mi shes par/ /nga ni sngags pa yin zhes zer/ /rnal 'byor med pa'i ting 'dzin kyis/ /tshig tsam 'ga' yi nga rgyal gyis/ /sngags par 4khas 'ches yang nas 5yang / /lo dus mi bshags rab yin no/ /de bas nyung ltar shin tu nyung / /gnyis po yin par shes par bya/ /mi shesang/ yi dam tshig go/ /snod min pa yi sems can la/ /phyi yi chos bshad yin pa la/ /gsang ba'i chos rnams 'chad pa ni/ /phyi tsam bstan pa'i gang zag la/ /gsang ba'i man ngag ston pa ni/ /yang yang ston dang mang la ston/ /lo dus mi bshags 27—728

rab yin no/ /gnyis po gong bzhin shes par bya/ /dam tshig de rnams kun layang / /dus dang bsam pa dngos po kun/ /che chung byung bar gyur pa dang / /mnyam par gyur dang ma tshang rnams/ /mkhas pas brtags nas cho ga ni/ /che chung bstod dang smad 37par bya/ /de ltar ma shes gsum dang dgu/ /mu de bzung nas lhag kyang bzang / /de rnams ni dam tshig nyams pa'i tshad bstan pam/ ༄2 ma nyams pa'i tshad bstan pa ni/ gong ma de rnams ma byung dang / /yang na slob dpon dkon mchog dang / /rdo rje spun dang sdug pa yi/ /sems can rnams kyi don du ni/ /rab tu ma gyur 'bring gi ni/ /de dag man chod byung na yang / /nyams par mi 'gyur bde gshegs gsungs4/ /lus la phan nga/ra gyur nas kyang / /ting 'dzin grogs su gyur pa ni/ /nges 5par mi 'gyur bde gshegs gsungs6/ /sems can 'dul bar gyur pa dang / /sems can drang ba'i don du yang / /nyams par mi 'gyur bde gshegs gsungs7/ /de rnams shes rab zab mo dang / /slob dpon zhal gyi man ngag la/ /brten nas gnang bkag rim pa ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis shes par bya/ /dam tshig ma nyams pa'i tshad bstan pa'o / /8da ni dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba'i cho ga bstan te cho ga yang ni dgu ru shes par bya/ rab kyis lo gcig la bsgoms la/ /tshogs 'khor bcu gnyis phrag bzhi dang / /sbyin sreg bdun brgya nyi shu dang / /gtor ma bdun brgya nyi 27—729

shu dang / /de dus rdo rje slob dpon dang / /rdo rje mched kyang spyan drangs la/ /rdo rje slob dpon grangs 1gyur na/ /gzugs bya yang na mchil lham gos/ /nge/ rten yang na ming gi yi ges bskyed/ /'od zer 'phros nas slob dpon gyis/ /rnam shes bkug 2nas de la gzung / /yi dam lha'am mi bskyod pa'i/ /gzugs su bltas la de la ni/ /bskyed —rim thun re byed pa dang / /bzlas/ brjod 'bum phrag gsum gyis ni/ /yi ge 'khor lo'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdas dang slob dpon gnyis ka yi/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang / /sbyin sreg gis kyang de bzhin sbyang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa yis/ /'khor lo 'du 'phros sbyang bar bya/ /'khor lo 'du 'phros mchod pa'o/ /gtor ma dang pos sbyang mchod dang / /bar mas bsrung zhing spel /3ba dang / /tha mas gnod pa mi byed cing / /bshags pa rgyun bya 'dus byas kyi4 / /dge rtsa la sogs gzhan yang bya/ /de ltar byas nas 3slob dpon la/ /slar yang sdom pa gsum blangs la/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug cing dbang bskur blang / /slob dpon sked gyur rdo rje spun/ /mkhas pa nyid las 9 blang bar bya/ /de med yi dam lha la blang / /de ltar byas na dag 'gyur te/ /dngos grub kyang ni thob par 'gyur/ /'bring dang tha ma gnyis po yang / /phyed phyed 'dres phyed shes par bya/ /'bring gi rab ni zla ba gcig /lha bsgom sbyin sreg sum cu dang / /gtor ma sum cu phrag gnyis dang / /tshogs 'khor gsum dang bzlas brjod ni/ /sum khri bshags pa thun mtshams su/ /'bring gi 'bring ni nyi shu ru/ / sbyin sreg gtor ma nyi shu dang / /1 tshogs gnyis bzlas brjod nyi khri bya/ /'bring gi tha 27—730

dod dodadodam bcu ru sbyin sreg bya/ /gtor ma bcu dang bzlas brjod khri/ /de dag cho ga byed pa yang / /slob dpon la sogs ma tshogs kyang / /rnal 'byor gnyis kyis bor len bya/ /tha ma'i rab 'bring zhag bdun du/ /sbyin sreg gtor ma bdun dang bzlas brjod stong / /tshogs 'khor gcig dang bshags pa mthun/ /tha ma'i 'bring ni zhag gsum du/ /sbyin sreg gtor ma gsum dang mchod pa brtsam/ /bzlas brjod lnga brgya bshags pa bya/ /tha ma'i tha ma zhag gcig tu/ /gtor ma sbyin sreg re re dang / /bzlas brjod brgya dang bshags pa bya/ /de ltar byas pas dag par 'gyur/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo ma 'byor pas/ /sbyin sreg gcig pus 1bskang ba yin//rab kyi gsum gyi sbyin sreg ni/ /sum khri nyi khri khri ru bya/ /'bring gi gsum gyi spyin sreg ni/ /lnga stong stong dang lnga brgya bya/ /tha ma gsum gyi sbyin sreg ni/ /brgya dang lnga bcu nyi shu lnga/ /de ltar byas pas dag par 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg ma byas rnal 'byor pas/ /bzlas brjod kyis ni bya bar gsungs//gsum gyi rab 'bring gsum gsum ste/ /bye ba bdun 'bum sum 'bum dang / /'bum dang bdun khri sum khri dang / /khri dang bdun stong sum stong dang / /stong dang bdun brgya sum brgya dang / /de ltar byas pas dag par 'gyur/ /de ltar mi 'grub rnal 'byor pas/ /gtor ma chen po'i cho gas kyang / /rdzo7—73/

— ——— —dod dod————spyin sreg bzhin du bsten 1nas su/ /nyams pa dag ste bskong bar 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg bzlas brjod gtor ma las/ /byung ba'i dngos grub gsum gyes ni / /dam tshig nyams pa bskong bar 'gyur/ /thun mong 4dngos grub grub nas kyang / /brgyud pas mchog kyang 'grub par gsungs/ /bsgom pa las byung dngos grub kyis5/ /dam tshig nyams pa bskongs gyur nas 6/ /dngos grub gnyis ka thob par 'gyur/ /lhag ma rnams kyi cho ga ni/ /slob dpon rab gsum phar bor nas/ /'bring gi gsum gyi rab tu bstan/ /tha ma gsum gyi 'bring du bstan/ /tha ma rab kyi sbyin sreg gcig /'bring gi gtor ma'am bzlas brjod bya/ /tha mas/ bla ma'i mchod pa bya/ /bla ma dz+wamachod pa'i man ngag kyang / /maṇ+ḍal gsum mam/ gcig byas la/ /maṇ+ḍal mthar phyin mdzes pa la/ /me tog mdzes ldan mchod pa bsags8/ /lus tshags bgos pas pus btsugs nas/ /bdun dang bcu dang bcu gnyis dang / /bya ba cho ga gzhan dang mthun/ /khyad par bdag bi sdig pa ni/ /'od zer dra bas bsdus nas ni/ /phyung nas gdan gyi pad stengs su/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang / /bdag gi 'od zer 'khrul 'khor gyis9/ /sdig pa spyong zhing bshags par 7bya/ /yang na sgyu ma lta bu'i sems / /de bzhin byas pas dag par 'gyur/ /yan lag cho ga bstan pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i tha ma gsum po dang / /go rims bzhin du shes par bya/ /27—732

sbyang 1lha ru bskyed pa la/ /mchod pa la sogs gong bzhin no/ /de bzhin 'gyur na'ang gong bzhin no/ /bde gshegs bka' 'das dus su ni/ /gang 2bhedu nyams pa de la ni/ /sbyang ba la sogs bya ba dang / /rigs kyi lha'am phyag mtshan nam / /ā li kā li'i 4phreng ba ni/ /bsnyims nas gong bzhin shes par bya/ /sems can byams sems dam tshig la/ /gang du spangs pa de 5bkug nas/ /dngos dang bsam pa gnyis kas su/ /sbyang ba la sogs gong bzhin bya/ /byang sems spong ba de la yang / /phyi nang yang ni gnyis su bstan//phyi be+e gong bzhin nang gi ni/ /'bab ra ka tar ma zin pa'o/ /de yi sbyang ba la sogs kun/ /snying ga gong 'og la bsnyims nas/ /rang gi po ti kho na la/ /gzhan gyi 6bhepo ti 'am dngos de nyid/ /bsam 7dang dngos la sogs pa ni/ /gong ma bzhin du shes par bya/ /de 'og slar yang smin par bya/ /yang na yi dam lha sogs la/ /gong bzhin khyad par ngag gis sbyang / /phung po lha ru bsams 2nas ni/ /nang mchod nang gi sbyin sreg ni/ /bsam ste sbyang ba'i cho ga bya/ /rang bzhin chos kyi gnas de ru/ /the tshom za ba'i de nyid la/ /rang bzhin de nyid bsams nas su/ /de nyid lha 'am thig le 'am/ /yig 'bru gtum mo la sogs la/ /gtsang 9mchod la sogs gong bzhin bya/ /sems can gdug pa sbyang ba dang / /bla ma srun la mchod pa bya/ /stong pa'i don la mos pa dang / /bla ma yi dam dbu steng du/ /chos sgu'i rtags dang gtsug toral/ /khyad par mchod par bya ba'o/ /sems can dad ldan bkug nas ni/ /27—733

sbyang ba la sogs byas nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor bsgrub 1byung dbang bskur dang / /man ngag zab mo'i don bstan pa/ /lhar dmigs mchod pa la sogs bya / /dam tshig thams cad dran nas kyang / /thams cad lhar dmigs khyad par ni/ /spyad par bya ba la sogs la/ /rigs lnga yab yum bsams nas ni/ /mchod cing sbyang bar bya ba yin/ /shes rab thams cad bkug nas ni/ /sbya/nga bar byas la lha mor dmigs/ /mchod pa sna tshogs khyad par bsam/ /bdas po dang bcas bkug pa la/ /sbyang ba la sogs gong bzhin bya/ /yang na tha mal zhen pa bzlog /mkha' la sogs pa byen brlabs ༄ la/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bltas nas ni/ /phan tshun mchod pas tshim par bya/ /tha mal lce ni sbyangs nas su/ /rdo rje lce ru byin brlabs la/ /gang bshad legs bab gnas capa ni/ /sbyang dang lhag 5bsam la sogs bya/ /khyad par rdo rje 'od zer las/ /bzlas shing mchod pas tshim par bya/ /bstan bya nyid kyang bkug nas ni/ /gso zhing sbyang ba'i cho ga bya/ /rnal 'byor spun rnams bkug nas ni/ /sbyang ba la sogs gong bzhin no/ /snod ldan sems can bkug nas ni/ /sbyang ba la sogs bya ba dang / /gsang ba dngos dang bsam pa yis/ /bstan la sogs pa bya ba'o/ /dad ldan kun la gong bzhin no/ /sbyang ba la sogs dngos dang bsam/ /gnyis ka'i thabs kyis bstan pa yin/ /nyan thos la sogs sbyang ba dang / /bdag nyid sbyang bar bya ba'o/ /rnal 'byor lha la nan tan bya'o/ /nga rgyal la sogs sbyang ba'o/ /de ltar cho ga byas nas ni/ /dam tshig nyams pa bskongs nas kyang / /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par gsungs/ /27—734

las dang po yi gang zag la/ /rtog pa sna tshogs dgur gyur pas/ /rig 'dzin sa ni ma thob par/ /dam tshig nyams pa 'byung 'gyur bas/ /bskang ba'i cho ga ma byas na/ /ngan song gsum dang rdo rje yi/ /dmyal ba dag tu ltung bar 'gyur/ /bskal pa grangs med gnas nas ni/ /de nas bskal par tsha grang myong / /de nas byol song yi dwags su/ /yun ring gnas nas brgya lam na/ /sems can glen lkugs la sogs su/ /yun ring gnas nas tha mar ni/ /sngon gyi dge ba'i sa bon gyis/ /bde gshegs thugs rjes phrad pa dang / /de ru dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /slar yang thur la ltung bar 'gyur/ /ma nyams gyen du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan cher bskyed cing / /dam tshig sa ya 'bum sde ni/ /lung rgyud kun la'ang gsal bas na/ /shes rab can gyis blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni blo dman don du gsungs/ /theg pa chen po smod pa dang / /khyad par gsang sngags smod pa ni/ /bskal pa mtha' yi bar du yang / /lce la phur bus 'debs shing khro chu ldud/ /de bas gsang sngags 'di la smad par mi bya'o/ /rgyud rnams kun dang mi 'gal tsam du ni/ /dper na sa gzhi lta bu'i dam tshig ni1/ /sgrub dang slob dpon rnams la bsten 2nga/sa su/ /myu gu lta bu'i sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /rin chen phug gi yang steng 4du/ /snying pos dam tshig nyams pa la/ /bskang ba'i cho ga mi shes pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi nad kyis btab/ /de la slob dpon chen pos su/ /rdo rje bstod glus 5bshags pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma la bshags nas kyang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyud kun du/ /cho ga zab mo sbas pa la/ /yang nas yang du gsol btab pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma yis chos bstan te/ /de ni slob dpon 27—735

chen po yis/ /bdag gi rna bar brgyud pa 'di/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor don ched 1 du/ /bdag gis rim par bkod pa yang / /bde gshegs mkha' 'gos bzod par bzhes/ /slob dpon chen po snying po zhabs kyis mdzad pa slob dpon bha bi pa'i gdams ngag mngon par bkod pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/716 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉༄ rdo je theg nga/'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher 'grel bzhugs/ slob dpon chen po snying po zhal kyis mdzad/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa ti ṭī ka 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgrub/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rgyab/717 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasung / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dgongs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈n+d+ra ra 〉〉ba / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlab/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da ba dang /718 rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dus/ 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ska/ //719 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngadi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sgom/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉pa bsresas /〈〈snar 〉snga sreg 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rjod/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zabang / 9〈〈snar 〉〉ngago/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/72spyo 1 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉stanas/721 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rdung byed pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smos /722 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smon/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgog 'di/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skug pa/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgro sa5〈〈co 〉(yin/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉phye/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ 8〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉rnamanga' 〈〈pe〉ro /723 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamatha'/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadugs/724 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtsis ni/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/725 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazlog 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasdo/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉'as /5〈〈co〉〉pa/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ sna〈〈pe〉〉skyed/726 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gi/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉gipa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga stan/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 〈〈pe〉〉bstan / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/27dod736

727 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnaman/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thog 〈〈pe 〉〉tha mo brtsod/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thab mo brtsod/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamar/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanan/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtsod/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dodabyugs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shis/728 sna 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ 3—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadams/ 1〈〈pe 〉sngagadams/ 〈〈snar 〉sngagadam/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ lta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasu/729 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stod dang smod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉donas/ 4〈〈snar 〉sngagasung /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyes/ — 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasung / 〈〈snar 〉〉// //73༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 krongs/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga kugs/ na 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'phro sbyang ba/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga krung zhing sbol/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skal/ rka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgoms/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gisbyin sreg gtor ma nyi shu dang // 331 77〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pal/732 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga stan/ hūṃ/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpongs par/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mongs/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi—/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpongs gyur na/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnama'i/ re 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsag 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadang / tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rem/72/3 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byeng / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbong / — 〈〈co 〉〉'tshal nas/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉li—/ 5〈〈pe 〉rnamang ba bde/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 7〈〈snar 〉snga sams/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sam/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadugs pa sbyangs pa// 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/734 ) 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlab/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngadi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉donas/hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lha/735 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'di/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yib/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gter—/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i stod glu'i/736 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chen/27dod737

sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ mū la pan+ti ṭī kā—/ bod skad du/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ltung ba bcu bzhi po ni dkyus su bsdebs pa bdun te/ bdun po de dag la ltung ba'i ngo bo bdun dang / rgyu bdun dang / dngos po bcu bzhi zung phral na bcu bzhi po tshan tshan gsum mo/ /de la ltung ba dang po dang gnyis pa'i ngo bo dang rgyu gcig ste/ bla ma la brnyas pa nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' las 'das pa ste/ de yang / bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /tha dad par ni mi brtag go/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro / /des na rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i phyir ltung ba gnyis ngo bo dang rgyu gcigabye /brnyas pa'i yul bla ma de yang thun mong gi lam 'khor ba yid la byas pa 'di las blo log par pyebyas pa shes shing byas pa gzo ba la brten nas 27—739

byams pa dang snying rje brtan par byas pa de gnyis kyi stobs las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems brtan par byas 'jug pa'i sdom pa dang ldan pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs / snying rje med cing khro la gdung / /khengs shing chags la ma bsdams/ dang / /spyoms dang bcas par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas thun mong gi lam/ gyi mi mthun pa de rnams las log nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid dbang bzhi'i sgo nas lta ba dang / spyod pa dang / sgom pa gsum gyi man ngab dang ldan pa de yang dang yang du/ goms par byas pas yon tan dang / /brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi spyor ba shes/ /snying rje ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i las la mkhas/ /sngags bshad pa yi spyod pa shes/ /rab tu zhi dang dbang po dul/ /zhes bya bas de ltar yon 1bcu bzhi dang ldan pa lta ba rnam gnyis grub par gnas pa'i don dang /nges par grub pa'i thabs lnga dang / spyod pa rnam pa gnyis dang / dbang rnam pa bzhi'i man ngag dang ldan pa'i khyegrub pa'i tshig gi nyams dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhes bya ba ste/ de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa nye bar bsten pa'i sgo nas/ slob ma de rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan par bya ba dang / 'jug sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan par bya ste/ 'og nas/ mnyam par bzhag pas bla ma la/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod byas la/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni/ /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /sngags pas 'bad de gzung jebar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas bla ma des dang po 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs yid la bya ba dang / skyabs su 'gro ba dang byams pa dang snying rje'i 27—740

sgo nas byang chub tu sems brtan par byas nas nye'ajug sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan pa la dbang bzhi snod du bsgrubs nas lta spyod sgom pa gsum gyi man ngag dang ldan par bsgrub pa de'i phyir ro/ /de nas sngags sogs sbyin pa yis/ /dam chos snod du byas nas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bla ma la rag las pas / dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs snyezhes/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsungs par/ /shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /zhes bya ba de lta bu'i bla ma de zhe dus rtag tu phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas 'byin byed dngos grub thams cad kyi rag las pa d+nghayin pas de'i phyir/ gdan bstabs 5pa dang ldang ba dang /don gyi bya ba sogs bsnyen bkur byed 6pa dang / bla ma las ni dngos grub dang / /mtho ris dang ni thar pa thob/ /ces pa nas/ mdun du dul bas 'dug par bya / /zhes bya ba'i bar du bya ba mtha' dag dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis ma yengs par bya ba'i tshul gyis bla ma bsten par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bla ma la brnyas na sangs rgyas thams cad la brnyas pa ste/ de 'dra'i mgon la bsam bcas pas/ /slob mar gyur pas ④brnyas na ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa ste 3 / /des ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob/ /ces pa nas/ der ni gnas pa yang dag bshad / /ces bya ba'i bar dang / de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /dge ba yongs su mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /zhes pa de ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid do/ /sbyong ba la sogs pa ni phal cher bla ma gser gling pa la sogs pa'i bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /rtsang ba de gnyis kyi rgyu ni bla ma grub pa thob pa'i tshig gi nyams dang 27—741

bral ba rnams dang phrad pa'i dbang gis lam gyi snod du ma bsgrubs par dbang la sogs pa byas kyang / rtsa ba ma brtan pa'i dbang gis nges par 'dren mi rmyenus shing / nges pa med pa'i phyir bla ma gtso bor mi byed de/ de'i phyir slob dpon brnyas pa la sogs pa thams cad 'byung ste de ni log par bstan cing bsgrub sa7pa zhes bya ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i sbyang ba gang yang med par dbang dang bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag bstan bye/du zin kyang rtsa ba med pa'i dbang gis myur du 'jig la nges par chung ngo / /de bas na de gnyis ni bka' 'das dang gnyis kyi rgyu yin pas na/ dzñā na sidhi las/ rang nyid kyis lam ma mthong bas/ /ji lta bzhin du gzhan dag 'dren/ /long ba gnyis ni 'grogs gyur na/ /gnyis ka lhang cebar the tshom med/ /ces pa dang / yang / sdig pa can kyi lam de yis/ /bgrod pa nyams pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bla ma dam pa la brten par bya'o/ /spun la nyes pa brjod pa dang byams pa spong ba gnyis rtsang ba'i ngo bo gcig la de 'byung ba'i rgyu yang gcig ste/ de'i rgyu ni sngon du thun mong gi lam byams 5snying rje ma sbyangs pas sems can la phan 'dod khyepa dang / gces par 'dzin pa'i blo 37med la de'i dbang gis gnod cing smod pa la sogs pa'i rkyen phra mo mi bzod de/ de'i phyir srun la nyes pa brjod cing sems can la byams pa spong ba des de gnyis ngo bo gcig ste gzhan la gnod par 'dra bas so/ /byang chub sems spong dang grub pa'i mtha' smod pa gnyis rgyu dang ngo bo 27—742

gcig ste/ rgyu ni byams pa dang snying rje'i stobs kyis tshobyang chub kyi sems brtan par ma byas par blangs su zin yang mi brtan te/ de yang / thams cad la ni lhag pa'i gnas/ /gang du thams cad 'jig pa ste/ /bskal pa bye ba stong du yang / /yang dag bskyed khrupa'i dge ba che/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa yi/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsags gepas so/ /bskal pa bye bas 'byung ba ni/ /skad cig nyid la rnam par 'jig /de bas don de bsrungs pas ④ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu gsungs/ /zhes 'byung bas byang chub sems de spangs pa dang / spangs pa'i tshad dang / de'i nyes pa'o/ /spangs pa ni gsum ste/ bla ma la brten nas dang / spun la brten nas dang /sems can la brten nas spong ba'o/ /tshad ni rten gsum po de la brten nas nyon mongs pa'i bsam pas g.yo sgyu la sogs pas nyin mtshan echa ci rigs par 'das pa'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba rtsad nas 'byin pa ni nyes pa'o/ /gzhan gyi byang chub kyi sems kyi bar chad byas na yang nyes pa che bar shes par bya'o/ /de la rang gi theg pa ni theg pa chen po gnyis so/ /gzhan ni nyan thos kyi'o/ /sgod pa ni gong ma ltar mi sbyong zhing smod pa ste/ rang mi gnas shing gzhan mi 'dzud pa'o/ /gsang ba sgrogs pa dang / phung po smod pa gnyis rgyu dang ngo bo gcig ste/rim gyis ma sbyangs pa'i phyir snod du ma gyur pa la gsang ba'i don grub par gnas pa'i don lta ba rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa bstan pas phung po lha'i bdag nyid la sogs pa bskyed ༅pa'i go rims ⑦spong bas rgyu dang ngo bo gcig go/ /de yang /27—743

lha yi gzugs ni bsgoms pa la/ /sems kyi bsgon pa dag la ni/ /glegs bam tsam yang bstan pa ni/ /sbyin par mi bya shes bya ste/ /rdo rje ye shes rab spong bas/ /rmongs pa dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de yi dmyal ba'i rgyur gyur pas/ /mi de'ang dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de dang bdag gzhan phung tub ni/ /'byung bas 3nges par bsrung bar gyebya/ /zhes so/ /chos la yid gnyis za ba dang / /sdug la byams sems gnyis rgyu dang ngo bo gcig ste/ de yang sems can thams cad rang bzhin dag pa 'od gsal dang zung 'jug gi rang bzhin du gcig pa la de gnyis la the tshom za ste/ 'khor ba dang zhi ba'i phyag rgya chen po zung du ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis gdug gyepa can de gnod cing dmod pa la sogs pa byang chub kyi rkyen du byung ba la rdeg pa la sogs pa drag shul gyi sbyor phyabs phan pa ma yin par bsgrubs pas rgyu dang ngo bo gcig go/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos la der rtog pa dang / dad ldan sems sun 'byin pa rgyu dang ngo bo gcig ste/ ming la sogs pa bral ba ni grub pa'i gnas pa'i don nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba la dngos po dang mtshan mar brtags pa'i rgyus de la dad pa'i sems can dbang po rab dang ldan pa rnams sun 'byin te/ ma zhugs pa la mi 'jug la/ zhugs pa bzlog cing brtan par mi byed pas so/ /dam tshig mi bsten pa dang shes rab smod pa gnyis kyang / bdud rtsi lngal 27—744

sogs pa'i dam tshig mi bsten ṭ+wā pa ni shes rab smod pa'i rgyu yin te/ de la smod pa nyid de spong ba'i rgyu'o/ /des na dang por bla ma grub pa thob pa'i tshig gi nyams dang ldan pa brtags la legs par blang gi gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /des na/ bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams gyur pas/ /dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang / /slob ma'i 'byel pa brtag khyepar bya/ /zhes pas so/ /de ltar ltung ba de rnams las 'das pa na nyes pa bstan pa ni slob dpon la smod pa de zhes pa ni mtshon pa'i don te/ ltung ba gzhan la nyes pa 'dra bar shes par bya ba'i lci yang ni yod de/ de'i nyes pa ni yams dang zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig go/ /rgyal po me dang zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig go/ /de zuphyir nam yang tshigs su bcad pa gsum mo/ /gal te bsam pa'i sgo nas nyams na bla ma'i spyan sngar maṇ+ḍal la sogs pas mchod la nyes pa ming gis bshags te phyis bsdam zhing bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi blo nyis 'gyur du bslab ste/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'i phyir bla ma la ni zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig go/ /de bzhin du lhang ba lhag ma rnams kyang bsam pa'i bye brag gis bskang bar bya'o/ /des na dang por bla ma legs par brtag cing legs par bsten la/ de nas snod du bsgrub par gsol ba gdab/ des kyang rjes su brtse ba'i sgo nas snod du bsgrubs te/ dang po 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / lha dang bla ma la brten du gzhug gophyo / /de nas thun mong pa'i skyabs 'gro la brten la/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa brten ༄6du gzhug /de nas khyad par gyi skyabs 'gro la brten nas byang chub kyi sems brtan du gzhug /de nas 'jug pa'i sdom pa 27—74pya

legs par byin la dbang bzhi'i sgo nas lta spyod sgom gsum kyi rtogs pa bsgrub 1po//de nas rtog sdepa dang mthun pa'i lam la sbyar te/ /sprede yang bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dus su bla ma dang lha tha mi dad pa la tshogs bsags④/ rtsang ba dang po'i rgyu spangs/go rims zhede rnams dbang po rab kyis 2chos thams cad zung 'jug tu rtogs pa sgrub pa'i thabs su shes par bya'o/ /'bring dang tha mas tha mal pa'i rtog pa zlog pa'i thabs su shes par bya ba'i phyir phyin ci ma log pas ltung ba gnyis pa dang bdun pa dang brgyad pa dang drug pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i rgyu spangs/ thun mong be+e lam byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i lam rnal 'byor dang bdag dang gnas bsrung bas lhang ba gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang lnga pa dang dgu pa dang bcu pa'i rgyu spangs/ de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa la brten nas chos thams cad 'od gsal du rtogs pa bsgrubs nas/bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig brten pas bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi pa dang bcu gcig pa'i rgyu spangs/ yang na lha la gsang ba dang shes rab dang bzhi pa blangs she7pas bcu bzhi pa dang bcu gsum pa'i rgyu spangs/ de ltar na bcu bzhi po rnams mnyam gzhag gi rtselas kyi rim pa las 1 'dus pas rjes kyis kyang de'i bdag nyid du bya dgos pa'i nges pa bskyed cing brtan par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi'i 4 1/dbang du byas nas ltung ba re re la ltung ba'i ngos 'dzin dang rkyen gang gis byung ba dang / nyes pa dang / tshul ji ltar mi 'byin pa'i thabs so/ /bde gshegs bka' ni 'khor ba'i nyes pa nas byas zhes dang / byas gzo dang / byams lho2snying rje dang 'jug pa'i sdom pa'i bar du ⑫brtan parabya 27—746

ba dang / khyad par can dbang rnam ltapa bzhis snod du bsgrubs nas lta ba la sogs pa'i man ngag ni bde gshegs kyi bka'o/ /'das pa ni ma gus pa dang /bag med pa dang / mi shes pa dang / nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis so/ /des na bla ma'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa brtan par mi byed par nyin mtshan gyi cha 'das pa ni ldung ba'o/ /rkyen ni ma dad pa la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /nyes pa ni sngar yams dang zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhi ste/ bla ma'i skabs su bka' las 'das pa dang shes rab smod pa zhes re re la sbyar ro/ /mi 'byung ba'i thabs ni bla mas bstan pa'i lam dran pa dang shes bzhin gyis 3mar me dang chu'i rgyun ltar yid la bya'o/ /spun ni sbyor ba gcig pa dang / de las gzhan pa dang sems can mtha' dag go/ /nyes pa brjod pa'i yul la brda phrad cing nyin mtshan gyi sum cha 'das na ltung ba'o/ /rkyen ni yul gsum po gang yang rung bas sems dang mthun par ma byas pa dang / mi byed pa'i dbang gis zhe sdang dang phrag dog gam nyon mongs pa gang yang rung ba dang mtshungs par khro ba'o/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni khro ba'i rkyen nye bar gnas pa'i tshe byas pa shes pa la sogs pa byams pa yid la bya ba dang /yang na chos thams cad skye med du yid la bya ba'o/ /byams pa ni byas pa shes pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod pa'o/ /spong ba ni phan pa ma yin par bsgrubs pas nyin mtshan gyi cha 'das na lhang ba'o/ /rkyen ni gong ma ltar yul gsum la brten nas bdag gi 27—747

bsam pa dang mthun par mi byed pa dang / ma byas pa'i dbang gis phan pa ma yin pa bsgrub —1cing spong ba'o/ /mi 'byung ba'i thabs ni rkyen nye bar gnas pa'i dus su de la ched du gtad pa'i tshul gyis byams pa yid la bya ba'am zung 'jug tu zushes par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi sems ni sems can gyi don du rdo rje 'chang 'dod pa'o/ /de spong ba ni yul gyi dbang gis gsum ste/ bla ma dang rdo rje spun dang sems can la g.yo sgyu spyod pas yon tan thob par bya snyam pa dang / don dom bar nyin mtshan gyi cha 'das pa'o/ /rkyen ni snga ma ltar ro/ /mi 'byen pa'i thabs ni mi mthun pa'i rkyen nye bar gnas pa'i dus su phan yon dang nyes dmigs shes pas byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya'o/ /yang na skye ba med pa yid la bya'o/ /rang gi grub pa'i mtha' ni theg pa chen po rnam pa gnyis so/ /gzhan gyi ni nyan thos dang bse ru'o/ /te badz+ra 'dus pa'i le'u ltar rim gyis mi sbyong bar smod pas nyin mtshan 'das pa'o/ /rkyen ni bla ma dam tshig nyams pa 5dang bral ba rnams dang phrad pas lam rim gyis sbyang 5ba rnams la smod cing khro ba'o/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni blo rim gyis bslabs 6pas theg pa gcig tu shes par bya'o/ /yongs su ma smin pa ni lam rim dz+wagyis ma sbyangs pa'o/ /gsang ba ni grub pa gnas pa'i don nam mkha' dang 'dra bar lta ba gnyis so / /sgrogs pa ni lus 8snangag gi spyor bas nyin mtshan 'das na'o/ /rkyenani 27—748

ma sbyangs pa dang phrad pa'i dbang gis so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni yul de lta bu dang phrad pa na blo'i bye brag dris nas de dang mthun par bya'o/ /phung po smod pa ni bskyed pa'i go rims snamatha' dag gzung ngo / /smod pa ni de ma bsgoms 33par nyin mtshan 'das na'o/ /rkyen ni zab mo ston pa'i lung dang yongs su 'dzin pa ngan pa lags 1so/ /mi 'byen pa'i thabs ni lha sgom pa'o / /rang bzhin dag pa ni lta ba gnyis so/ /som nyi za ba ni de gnyis kyi rtog pa ma skyes pa'o/ /de'i bdag nyid du rtog 5pa med par nyin mtshan 'das na'o//rkyen bla ma dam pa dang bral bas dngos por lta ba'i dbang gis so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni bla ma dam pa'i ngag la brten nas lta ba goms par bya'o/ /gdug pa can ni mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams so/ /bdag la gnod pa'i dbang gis zhe sdang gis bslang nas phan pa ma yin pa drag po byed pa 6nyin mtshan 'das na'o/ /rkyen ni nyes par byas pa'i dbang gis so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni bzod pa bsgom pa ste bdud phyir bzlog pa'i lung las shes par bya'o/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos ni 'od gsal ba dang zung du 'jug pa'o/ /de rtogs 7pa ni de gnyis kyi rang bzhin dang mi mthun par gzhan du rtogs pas nyin mtshan 'das pa'o/ /rkyen ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ma phrad pa'o/ /27—7/9

— —mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni de'i gdams pa las so/ /dad ldan ni lam rim gyis ma sbyangs kyang grub par gnas pa'i don la 'dod pa'o/ /sun 'byin pa ni ma bstan pa dang log par bstan pas so/ /rkyen ni mos pa'i gang zag dang phrad pas so/ /mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni rtog pa dang sbyar te chos bstan pa'o/ /dam tshig ni bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'o/ /mi ston nga/ ni mi gtsang ba'i blos dor te dus 'das pa'o/ /rkyen ni rdzas nye bar gnas nga/'o//mi 'byin pa'i thabs ni mi rtog pa'i sems kyis so/ /nyes pa 'di rnams lci yang yod kyang gnod pa ni 'dra'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na rtsa ba'i lhang ba yin pas so/ / sngags pas 'di dag spangs nas ni/ /dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur—/ /zhes bya ba ni spang bya spangs pa'i yon tan no/ /gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pas bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur—/ /de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /thur du bltas ①te dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes bya ba ni nyams pa'i nyes pa mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni/ /bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par bya/ /zhes pa ni bag bya ba la bslab pa'o/ /dbang bskur nas ltung ba bcu bzhi pa dang bla ma lnga bcu gang 'dod pa'i sgrub thabs dag ni don rgyas par ston pa yin pas nges par nan tan gyis 27—750

bslabs te gzhan du na bla ma'i nyes pa'o/ /de ltar bcu bzhi po bsdu na gsum ste/ thun mong gi byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa dang / khyad par gyi byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa dang / de gnyis ka mi nyams par byed pa'o/ /ltung ba dang po dang gnyis pa ni gnyis ka mi kye7nyams par byed pa'o/ /spun la dang / byams spong dang /byang chub sems 'dor dang / grub pa'i mtha' smod pa dang / gdug la ༄ —byams pa spong ba ste/ lnga po de dag ni thun mong gi sems mi nyams par byed pa ste / de bas na 'bad pas bsrung ngo / /gsang ba sgrogs pa dang / phung po smid pa dang / dag pa'i chos la yid gnyis dang / ming sogs bral la der rtog dang / sems sun 'byin pa dang / dam tshig mi bsten pa dang / shes rab smod pa de rnams spangs pas khyad par gyi byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa'o/ /yang de ni lta spyod sgom /byegasum kyi rang bzhin yang yin te/ chos la yid gnyis dang / ming sogs bral la der rtog spangs pas lta ba rnam gnyis thurtogs pa'o/ /dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang lnga pa dang drug pa dang bdun pa dang brgyad pa dang 5bcu pa'i dgu spangs pas sgom 6pa'i man ngag dang / sems sun 'byin pa dang / dam tshig mi bsten 7pa dang /shes rab smod pa gsum kyis sredagu spangs shing sbyangs pas spyod pa'o/ /de gsum ma spangs par bsgoms pas bka' 'da' shedang / bla ma brnyas pa ma 27—751

—spangs pa yin no/ /de bas na bcu dang lnga bcu la nan tan yang dang yang du bya ste dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nyams na nyes pa thams cad kyang 'byung ngo / /de ltar 7ma yin par sngags tshig tsam gyis man ngag bstan nas/ bla mar khas 'che ba ltung ba'i snod du bsgrubs na mi dge ba'i rgyu byas pasasnye/ mi dge ba'i bdag po'i rkyen zhes bya/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang / bdud sdig can dang / slu bar byed pa zhes bya ste skyon mang du mi brjod do/ /de lta bu'i bla ma dang slob ma de yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi phung po rnams rnyed pa dang bkur ste'i rgyus 4bsgrubs pas ngan song sgrub pa'i thabs dang rkyen des dug dang bdud rtsi 'dres pa dang 'dra'o/ /de bas na bla ma dam pa bsten pa gces par rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /dam pa'i gogs dang bla ma dang / /ma phrad srid par 'khyams pa las/ /phan phyir bla ma'i lung bzhin du/ /bris pas de dag la phan shog /'di mthong tsam kyis skye bo rnams/ /chos la nan tan bya ba'i rgyur/ /gyur nas bla ma gtsor byed cing / /sgrub chol nan tan byed pa'i rgyur/ /skal ngan skye bo rnams dang phrad pa na/ /rang skyon dbang gis smod par byed mod kyi/ /drang srong chen po'i lung ni su zhig spong / /de phyir de dag la yang gnod khum gyur/ /gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa/ rnams bslab 7pa'i phyir/ /gsal byed man ngag bkod pa'o/ /gsang sngags rdo rje jeg pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bslab pa gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag ces bya ba slob dpon rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i 'grel pa mkhas 27—752

〉tharlabs/ 7 〈〈co 〉〉girim/ 8 〈〈pe 〉〉thung /749 bla〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rim/ khya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra sgom/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 4 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/27—753

1391༄ / /rdo rje sdeg pa'i rtsa ba'i sbung ba'i rgya cher bshad pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yā na mū la patrī 2ṭī kā/ bod skad du/rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i lhang ba'i rgya cher bshad pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag gnas 1dus gsum bde gshegs mnyam nyid sgu//kha sbyar bde chen longs spyod yongs rdzogs dpal/ /bdud bzhi las rgyal 'go kun re 'dod skong / /thugs rje bdag nyid 'jam mgon phyag 'tshal te/ /'dir ni mi mkhas gsang sngags don la mngon rmongs pa'i/ /dbang bskur dam tshig sed de zhal gyi bdud rtsi bral/ /bdud kyis 4mngon bslus rang nyid phung ba kho nar zad/ /snying rje 5gso thabs bdud rtsi 'di ni bshad par bya/ /lam mchog rnams kyi gzhir 'gyur dam tshig 'di/ /theg mchog rgyud kun las ni rab bstan pa/ /slob dpon gzhan dag gzhan du 'chad de 'di yi don/ /bdag gis bla ma las 6/rnyed theg mchog spyod pa nyon/ /de la gsang sngags kyi 27—755
