1394ra༅/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/tshosngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa tsakra bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo / /yang dag bde bas ma lus gang / /dngos grub ster mdzad brtse ba can/ /rnam grol chos sku'i bdag nyid de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i rgyud las ni/ /gsung sogs shin tu sbas pa nyid/ /gsal bar mdor bsdus mjes par ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bshad/ /sngags pas khyad par mtshan mo'i dus/ /zhag re 'ang ni ji snyed par/ /zla re dang ni lo re la/ /'khor lo las 'das nyams par 'gyur/ /nye bar 'tshe pred dur khrod dgona'u / /rdzing bu'i 'gram dang skyed mos tshal/ /mtsho ngogs ju klung ri sul dang / /rang gi khyim sogs 'bras bur bcas/ /yang dag brgyad pa ḍa thob gyur pa/ /dpal ldan chog shes snying rje ldan/ /'jig rten 27—88/

chos la mi chags shing / /sred 1dang sgyu sogs rnam par spangs/ /snyan par smra / zhing 'dzum pa'i bzhin/ /bzod can brtan la brtson 'grus ldan/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' gsungs/ /'khor lo pa yang de nyid kyi/ /slob ma sred sogs rnam par spangs/ /dbang bskur thob cing blo ldan bzod/ /brtson dang dran pa la sogs ldan/ /dam/ tshig spyad bya spyod pa rnams/ /rgan pa'i rim pa bzhin du 'dod/ /dbang ma/ thob pas mi rig 2par/ /sgrub pos 'khor lo de bya'o/ /me tog gdugs sogs mar me ldan/ /sna tshogs ston mo btung bas brgyan/ /mal stan yon tan bcas pa yis/ /'phags pa'i skye bo ci sogs pa'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi dbang phyug gdan/ /ro 'am 4stag lpags 5dur khrod ras/ /rgyan ni rang gi rigs las so/ /phyi rol dam pa'i phyag rgyas 'khyud/ /rang gi slob mas yongs/ su bskor/ /des kyang rang rigs zhwadag la 'khyud/ /ci nus bsam gtan dag gis bya/ /bla ma'i cho ga shes shing dran/ /brtson 'grus bzod dang ldan pa dang / /bla ma la gus blo mthun pa/ /las kyi rdo rjer de 3 rab bsngags / /dbang bskur yang ni gdung can dang / /thob dang sgyu can dag dang ni/ /dbang ma thob par 'khor lo gang / /ring po nas kyang bsten 9mi bya/ /bla mas bde chen bsgom byas nas/ /'byung po kun la gtor ma sbyin/ /stobasal sogs pas sbyang byas la/ /me tog gis ni rang lus mchod/ /snod ni re re kun la sbyin/ /bla ma la ni snod gnyis dbul/ /de bzhin bza' btung nyis 'gyur ro/ /de nas rang zhal hom khung du/ /rnam rig pa la'i mchod yon bya/ /lag pa dgang gzar blugs gzar gyis/ /yid kyis me la ngo/stobs sogs 27—882

bsregs / /nang gi bdag nyid sbyin sreg gis/ /rang 'dod lha ni tshim par bya / /glu sogs kyis ni mnyes bya zhing / /yang dang yang du brda tshig smra/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga/ /rig ma mig bzang skyobargyad la ni/ /cho ga bzhin du brten — 7zhes bya/ /ko la la sogs ci shes bya/ /he ru ka yi gzugs kyi gar/ /dran pa rjed med rnal 'byor bya/ /sgom la chags pa'i sems kyis ni / /rtag tu sems kyis goms par bya/ /rdo rje chos dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnal 'byor pha dang ma tshogs kun/ /glu dang gar la goms bya zhing / /mchog tu glu dang gar bya'o/ /'di nyid tshogs kyi bsrung ba ste/ /bdag nyid kyis kyang de bzhin bsrung / /'di yis ༄'jig rten dbang du byed/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa 'di nyid yin/ /rgyun du glu ni len pa dang / /gang du rtag tu gar byed pa/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug mdun bya'o/ /de nas dri ni mtshon par bya/ /sgog 5pa'i dri ni dang po ste/ /bya rgod spos ni gnyis pa yin/ /de nas ga bur tsan+dan dri/ /glu dbyangs su ni mtshon bya ba/ /sgra ni ngang pa bung ba'i sgra/ /dri yi mthar ni thos pa dang / /ce spyang dag gi sgra yang ni/ /phyi rol skyed mos tshal du mtshon/ /gang gi bdag gis mi rnyed pa 'am/ /sgod ma yin pas 'jigs pa gang / /bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga sogs/ /bsam gtan gyis ni yongs su brtag /'khor lo'i dbang phyug byin brlabs pa/ /snod skyon rjes su gzung bar bya/ /'dud rtsedang bcas pas snod de ni/ /ha cang myur min bul ba min/ /bgegs sogs brnyas pa spang ba'i phyir/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgyas smra bar bya/ /hub sgra rnged cing ma yengs pas/ /cung zad 'thungs nas legs bkang ste/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi 7khyad par gyis/ /gong gi phyag rgyas dbul bar 27—883

—bya / /sgrub pa po yis yang dang yang / /de dag kun la phyag bya'o/ /snod ni sa la bzhag pa 'am/ /gzhan la byin par gyur pa na/ /lag nas bo na chad pas bcad/ /rang gis thams cad mi btung ngo / /bza' dang btung ba rang gis ni/ /shin tu ltogs kyang blang mi bya/ /rtsod pa la sogs gang 1snabyed pa/ /de nas de ni gdon par bya/ /gal te gdon par mi nus na/ /de tshe sdig nga/ la brtags nasan/ /rang nyid gzhan du 'gro ba 'am/ /mi smra ba la brten par bya/ /las kyi rdo rjes btung sogs la/ /rang gis blangs kyang nyes pa sed//spyod lam shugs kyis phyir 'gro na/ /de ni dgag par mi bya'o/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhe sdang gis/ /gzhan snod dam pa ma yin pa'i/ /tshig gis smad dang rtsod pa'i gtam/ /mi dga' ba yang spang bar bya/ /bkag pa rnams ni spyod gyur na/ /rtsa ba'i lhang dang sgom po ni/ /myur du gso ba'i cho ga bya/ /de ni sdang ba'i cho gar grags/ /rdo rje slob dpon tshim gyur pas/ /bar du gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /glu gar la sogs rgyun du ni/ /de yi zibaka' yis gnang bar bya/ /tshogs kyi 'dus pas byas pa ni/ /lag pa rkang sogs bag ldan bya/ /shin tu bag med rgyu yi phyir/ /btung ba mang po spyad mi bya/ /ma dag gis ni g.yeng bar 5'gyur/ /g.yengs pas rnal 'byor 'khrugs 'gyur zhing / /rnal 'byor nyams pas dngos grub med/ /bdud kyi las ni bzlog par dka'/ /gang yang sems ni bsrung nus pas/ /rang ngam gzhan yang mchod par bya/ /gzugs sogs sna tshogs dag pa yis/ /de yis 'dir ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /skad cig tsam yang gzhan gzugs kyis/ /ma rig gdug can gyi ni sems/ /'grub 'dod dngos grub don gnyer bas/ /'bad pas mkhas pa gnas minabya//27—884

ji snyed lus kyi g.yo 'gul dang / /ngag gi brjod pa ji snyed pa/ /de snyed sngags dang phyag rgya ste/ /he ru ka dpal go 'phang 1gnas/ /gang gi dug gi dum bu yis/ /skye bo rnams ni 'chi 'gyur ba/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa yis/ /dug gis dug ni 'joms par byed/ /kha cig byel 2bar gzhan yod pas/ /yu/na ring 'dug par mi nus na/ /de yis phyag 'tshal mkhyen gsol na/ /bzod gsol nas ni 'gro bar bya/ /'di dang gzhan gyi rgyud gsungs pa'i/ /bya ba rnams ni brda la bya/ /gang phyir myur du byas pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dga' nyams byed/ /de ltar cho gas 'khor lo cher/ /rang gi slob ma dbang bskur phyir/ /bsgom pa la sogs stobs nyid kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub ster/ /sgom pa la sogs de bzhin 'dir/ /yang ni bka' gsal byed pa/sa kyang / /gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag la 'grub/ /bla mas tha ma'i gtor ma sbyin/ /de bzhin phyi rol lhag gtor nang / /sgrub pa ngo/ yis phyag 'tshal zhing / /smon lam dag ni gdab par bya/ /ma lus rtog 4pa las 'das pa/ /srid zhi mnyam spyor rtag mi 'gyur/ /dpe med pa yi 5 ros dgyes pa'i/ /rnal 'byor tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje yan lag ma sbyar bas/ /gting rtog 6phung po yongs bcom 'gyur/ /bdag gi dge ba ge'adi yis ni/ /thabs 'di myur ba nyid ston shog /dngos po kun gyis phyag byas nas/ /dpal ldan tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi8/ /rim pa 'di ni bsdus nas kyang / /ci bde bar 9ni gnas par bya/ /'di ni bla ma'i rim thob pa'i /bdag nyid dran par bya ba'i phyir/ /cho ga cung zad 7brjod pa la/ /mkhas pa rnams ni bzod par mdzod/ /dngos grub kun gyi 1gter gyur yon tan sngon 27—885

'gro tshogs 'khor kyi/ /cho ga gsal por bris pa'i bsod nams dri med gang thob des/ /myur du dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang yul skal bzang la chags shing / /srid pa las grol zhi ba'i phyag rgya chen bo thob par shog /ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta a bh+ya ka ra gup+tas mdzad pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga rdzogs so// //ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shrī rat+na rak+ṣi ta'i zhal snga nas so lku// //bsdur mchan/881 ༄1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉go tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa bzhugs/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pagon/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge /882 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sted/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉regs/ 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thadug ho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lko ma// 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thags/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉reg 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8ra/ khye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mistan/ /—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pags/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis ma lha/ 〈〈co 〉dkyi me la/883 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazangs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lken/ /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kus/ je〈〈co〉yo 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgog 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra dud/ )〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanas/884 tsho 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7nga / rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa/ 〈〈pe 〉snyen/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas/ thu〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayengs par/885 sna 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngaphangs/ — ——〈〈co 〉〉bye/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga〈co 〉ra sgom/ ji〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rkogs /3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thade ba'i/ zhwa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatog 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas/ 8bhe〈〈pe 〉ste sa rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/886 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉riso/27—886

sngag /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga—1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa 2tsakra bi byeḥ/ bod skad du/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs rnams bsag par bya ba dang / /bgegs rnams zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bsod nams mthar thug tshogs 'khor lo/ /lung dang man ngag ji bzhin bri/ /de la re zhig dang po gzhung rdomathun pa'i tshogs kyi khang pa tsan+dan la sogs pa dri zhim pos 4bskor ba yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su las thams cad pa'i skyes bu lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas chag chag gdab 5pa dang / maṇ+ḍal bya ba dang / me tos dgram pa dang / mchod pa bsham pa dang / phyogs skyong gi gtor ma rgya chen po la sogs pa bsham mo/ /de nas slob dpon spyan drangs la gnas ji ltar rigs pa dang bcas par bzhugs su gsol nas/ las thams cad pa'i bumang rgyan chas dang ldan pa byin gyis brlab bo6/ /mchod pa'i bum pa yang ci rigs 27—888

par bsham mo/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa 'du bar 'os pa kun bkug la de dag gis gsol ba gdab dzopo/ /khro bo sngon po mdzes pa ste/ /khyod ni bzang po yid du 'ong / /nor bu charin chen ces bcings pa'i/ /dbyug pa phyag na bsnams pa ste/ /bdag ni 'khor ba las bsgral phyir/ /dpa' bos gnang gis gtong —du gsol/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs dbus su/ /bzang po 4sgo ni phye ste thong / /zhes gsol ba btab nas nang du bkug ste/ las kyi bum pa'i chus gtor zhing skyor chu drud do/ /de nas gral rim pa bzhin du bkod la rdo rje slob dpon la me tog phul/ gsol ba gdab/ rnal 'byor pa kun la yang me tog gtor la bskul bar bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms la mos pa tsam gyis lce lag byen gyis brlab po/ /rdo rje dang dril bu yang hūṃ gis byin kyis brlabs la mngon par rtogs sgosnapa brjod/ hūṃ thog ma med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ñtsapa bdag po'i gtso/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/ dril bu yang / āḥsrid pa rang bzhin gyis dag phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis gdod nas dag /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /srid pa dam pa mchog tu byed/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi 7a/ de nas mchod pa'i khyad par thams cad 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon gyi 9'od zer gyis —bla ma dang bcas pa'i lha rnams nam mkha' la bltas la/ yon chab dang / zhal bsil dang /zhabs bkru dbul zhing / me tog nas sgra snyan gyi bar du rim pas mchod do/ /de nas de kho na lnga'am/ gzhung gang yin pas bstod pa bya/ yan lag bdun pa mdo rgyas bsnyus /1gang yang rung ba 1 bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol 27—889

byas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas shu lkun+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong pa nyid du bsgoms la/ yi ge hūṃ gi snang ba las ra ba dang dra ba dang sa gzhir bsgoms la / de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyeri rab rin po che'i rang bzhin bsgoms/ la / de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje bsams te/ de'i lte ba la rgyu 5las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par bskyed nas/ der gang yin pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor bskyed la ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs te mchod nas dbyer med par bstem mo/ /de nas chang la srung ba dang byen gyis brlab pa gzhung bzhin byas te/ yi ge ha dmar pos kha dog sbyangs la/ ho dkar pos dri ngan bsal te dīḥmathing gas phya/nus pa bcom nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ de nyid kyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste bstem mo/ /de nas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha la so so'i ming nas brjod cing mchod de/ de nas bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'i srin lag gis maṇ+ḍal gru gsum bris la der bdud rtsi gtor bas zla ba'i gdan phyogs mtshams su gyur par bsam mo/ /der ye shes 'khor lo mos pa tsam gyis bsams la bdud rtsis mchod / de nas bdag nyid la mchod de 'di ltar mtheb srin kyis lce rtse dang smin 9ma'i dbus dang spyi bor gtor ro/ /de nas de dag mi dmigs par bsams la gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor la yon chab la sogs pa'i khyad par gyis mchod de bstod pa byas te 7gshegs su mi gsol lo/ /de nas zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma rgya chen po btang ste yi ge 'bru gsum gyis sbyang ba dang spar ba dang /rtogs par byas la maṇ+ḍal thig btab pa'i le'u tse 9dgu par byas te dbusam la ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsam/ phyogs mtshams sbyil zhing skyong brgyad/ mamo 27—890

sum cu gnyis dang bcas pa sbyan drangs la mchod do/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang bzhi mdo nyid dang ni//khyad par du ni khang stong dang / /rigs ngan khyim dang thang dang ni/ /khyad par du ni chu la gnas/ /nag po drag po drag chen po/ /lha sbyin mnyam du bsten pa dang / /nag po gcigs dang mi sdug pa/ /dga' las 'das pa'i log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed mo dang drag mo dang / /mi sdug ma dang dbu ༄1 ma dang / /rgyal ma rnam par rgyal ma dang 37/ /mi thub gzhan kyis ༄ —mi thub ma//nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo/ /nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo/ /rab tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo/ /'phrog byed ma dang dmar ser ma/ /'jigs byed grong nas rnal 'byor ma/ /drag mo gzugs dang gzugs chen mo/ /mche ba gabyugs dang thod chen ma/ /thod phreng phreng /jecan kha ṭ+wāṃ ma/ /sbrul chen ral gri dgra sta can/ /rdo rje de bzhin gzhu can ma/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkha' chen po/ /las kun rjes su sgrub byed ma/ /de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen de/ /rdul med rnal 'byor 'byin pa'o/ /rdo rje dbang mo bka' 'di yis/ /thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /oṃ kak+ka ṭ+wā na ba ban+dha 5na/ khakhru dha na/ sarba dubye 9ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a mu ka hūṃ dza ཿzhes pas bkug la pad+ma'i gdan la gnas par bsams la/ mchod pa lngar byin gyis brlabs la de nyid dbul te/ so so'i lce hūṃ las rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje'i sbu gu'i 'od kyis bdud rtsi mchod par bsams la chos bshad de/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod do/ /de nas smon lam gdab 27—891

——ste—/ sems can thams cad sdig med cing / /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /gang gis lam nas 'gro ba yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad par shog /ma rgal kyeb rnams bsgral bar bya/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /de ltar nyid du rjes brtse bas/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas la dgod/ / ces pas bsngo ba byas la gshegs su mi gsol lo/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa pho mo kun lha'i dkyil 'khor du bltas la dang por dris mchod/ de nas me tog dang bdug pa dang / mar mes tshul bzhin du mchod/ de nas bdud rtsi hūṃdang bcas pa'i chang gis mchod de/ de nas lag pa g.yas par chang bzung la g.yon pa rtse gsum par byas te tshig 'dis chang sbyin te/ ltos shig mdzes pa dam tshig chos/ /de la the tshom yod ma yin/ /bram ze khye dang gdol pa gsum//rang bzhin gcig tu rtogs pas bza'/ /zhes brjod la drang ngo / /len pa pos brjod pa/ 'dod chags dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /rin thang med las legs 'ong chos/ /gzung dang 'dzin med rnam par spangs/ /de kho na nyid 4bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes brjod la pad kor 5dang bcas pas blang ngo / /de nas 'og ma rnams drang ba la 'di skad brjod de/ spyor ba'i dngos grub don du ni / /sbyor kun de nyid de bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor pa yis kun du spyad/ /ji ltar bde ba spyad par bya/ /zhes brjod la drang ngo / /de'i 'og tu sha dang mar la sogs pas mchod do/ /de nas bshos so sor drangs la de dag kun gyi phud bsdus la slob dpon la dbul/ slob dpon gyis 6phud de cha gnyis su bgos 7la/ cha gcig byin gyis brlabs/ g.yon phyogs su bzhag ste dkyi' 'khor gyi lha la dbul/ cha gcig g.yas su bzhag la byen gyis brlabs te 27—892

—phyogs skyong gi gtor mar dbul te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis mchod la/ de nas ci bder rol zhing spyad do/ /skabs der bkra shis kyi glu blang ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang phyogs skyong la gnang ba nod pa dang bzod gsol byas la gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas ye shes kyi 1lha la yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol byas la badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /dam tshig gi lha la oṃ āt+ma tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ zhes brjod la bdag gi snying gar bsdu'o/ /oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa kṛt+ta gats+tsha hūṃ zhes pas phyi rol 2gyi lha gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas lhag ma basbus te khyem gyi lhag ma ni khyem de nyid kyi mi ma yin pa la bsngo'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi lhag ma ni phyi rol kyi sha za la sogs pa'i mi ma yin pa rnams la sbyin te phyi'i sgor bskyal lo/ /lhag ma de lta bu bza' ba'i skal ba med pa la yang slob dpon gyi kha nas bdud rtsi byin no/ /de nas yon bdag la bkra shis dang sgon lam gdab po/ /de nas gtor skyel log pa dang tshogs kyi khang pa'i sgor mre long dang bud dgrol dang / chu chan gyi zho dang zan gyis mchod do/ /de nas nang du phyin la rnal 'byor pa pho mo rnams la yang 4mchod par bya'o/ /ma khrongs skye bo gang dag tshogs rnams bsag 5par 'dod pa dang / /bslab pa'i lam la nges par zhugs pa'i sgrub pa po dag gi/ /dri med lung dang bla ma'i gdams ngag ltar/ /ma nor bzung ste bdag dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir du dris pa yin/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i cho ga slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa sgogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṇ+ḍa pa de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //27—893

sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa tsakra bi byeḥ2/ bod skad du/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu dad pa chen po yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal nas/ /mdor bsdus tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ /yang dad 1par ni brtsam 4par bya/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub byed pa'o/ /rtag tu bya 'am zla bar ni/ /yang na lo re na ni bya/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pas ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo mchod par bya/ /rang gi slob ma dag dang ldan/ /de yang dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /yon tan rnams kyis brgyan pa dang / /sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du ni/ /bde ba chen po dang ldan nas/ /de ltar dam tshig dbus gnas la/ /rang gi ting 'dzin sdogs byas nas/ /dang po 'byung po'i gtor ma btang 5/ /de nas rim bzhin bzhugs su gsol/ /de yang shes rab dang ldan par/ /med na ting nge 27—895

—'dzin gyis bsam/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri chab phreng dang na bza' dang / /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du ni/ /bza' 1ba btung ba lha bcos/ rnams / /de dag gis ni mchod par bya/ /de ltar phyi yi mchod byas nas/ /nang gi mchod pa dag ni bya/ /pad+ma lta bur rang gi kha/ /hom khung nyid du bsam byas la/ /dgang gzar 2bkang ba drugs par bya/ /lag pa drugs/ gzar dag gis kyang / /mchod rdzas yang dag dbul bar bya/ /de ltar hom/ gyis mchod byas nas/ /rang gi dga' ba'i rtsed 4mo yis/ /yi dam lha ni mnyes par bya/ /tshogs kyis mchod la dam tshig spyad/ /sems ni brtan nga/ra shes rab spyod/ /btung ba'i snod ni mang gyur na/ /kun la re re sbyin par bya//bla ma la ni nges par gnyis/ /yang dag par ni dbul bar bya bza' ba gang zhim bla ma la'o/ /bla ma la dad brtson 'grus ldan/ /sems bzang bzod dang ldan pa yis/ /las rnams kun ni bya ba yin/ /sngags pa rang gis byen brlabs nas/ /gzhan dag la ni sbyin par bya/ /de yis pad+ma'i phyag rgya yis/ /gus par byas te blang bar bya/ /ma dad pas ni blang mi bya/ /skom yang kun ni btung mi bya/ /bkres skom yod kyang rang gis 5ni/ /blang ba ru ni mi bya'o/ /bdud rtsi bzhin du btung bar bya/ /sa la bor bar mi bya zhing / /slar ni skyogs ni sbyin par bya/ /gnang ba byin nas sa la gzhag /gtor 6ba gzhan la sbyin mi bya/ /sa la 'jog pa 7chad pas bcad/ /rtsod byed slob dpon la smod dang / /nga rgyal dang ni ldan pa ni/ /tshogs kyi nang du gzhag 8mi bya/ /bla ma dag gis 9bza' btung la/ /gnang med len par byed gyur pa/ /chad pas bcad dam yang na dbyung / /de nyid mi nyan par 'gyur na/ /rang gi 27—896

gnas nas gzhan du 'gro/ /yang na nyal la 'dug par bya/ /gang zhig dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /'thab mo la sogs sems kyis kyang / /nges pa ru ni bsam mi bya/ /byas gyur phyis ni mi bya ba'i/ /sdom pa yang dag par ni blang / /ra kau ro bar gyur na ni/ /nan tan gyis ni lus ngag bsdam/ /las kyi rdo rje dag gis ni/ /rang gis blangs te bza' bar bya/ /de ni skyon ni rnged par bstan / /gar la sogs pa'i rol mo rnams/ /gnang ba med par mi bya'o/ /kang la gnang ba byin pa yis/ /tshogs kyi 1dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /de yi skad cig nyid la bya/ /de ltar gang gis ma byas pa2/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' bcag go/ /phyi rol du ni 'byung ba'i tshe/ /lus ngag yid gsum bsdam byas te/ /bla ma la ni phyag byas la/ /phyi rol du ni 'byung bar bya/ /spyod yul du ni bab gyur na/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni gzung 4mi bya/ /bya ba thams cad bsngal la ni/ /dga' ba dang ni bcas par bya/ /sems kyi dran pa mred gyur na/ /lha yi ting 'dzin dang mi ldan/ /ting nge 'dzin dang mi ldan na / /lha yi dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /ting nge 'dzin la g.yengs 5gyur na/ /skyon de gong ma nyid dang mtshungs/ /rtse gcig sems kyis dngos grub 'thob/ /de ru 'dug par mi nus na/ /phyag byas la ni 'gro bar bya/ /lhag ma thams cad bsdus nas ni/ /phyi rol du ni gtor ma gtang / /rdzogs nas mgu ba la sogs sbyin/ /phyag byas nas 6ni bzod par gsol/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga byas pa yi/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gis gang thob pa/ /khams gsum sems can rnams ni yang dag par/ /dngos grub chen po yang dag thob gyur cig /paṇ+ḍi ta bzang po spyin pas tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa rdzogs so// //27—897

rgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya shrī bha dra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur lhaba'o// //bsdur mchan/895 nyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄༅/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉waḥ/ (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉brtsams / ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatang /896 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gza'/ (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzang / rju〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉nyan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rtse/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyan/ sgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatar/ she〈〈co 〉〉par/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 897 377〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ rgya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ 13〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉cag ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung /5〈〈pe 〉〉mongs/ 〈〈snar 〉sngonangs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/898 nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1323)27wa 898

bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa tsakra bi bye tsin+ta ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog dang thun mong kun gyi gzhi/ /lam dang dngos grub mthar phyin pa/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /de 2 'dir bsdus te brjod par bya/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i skyon sel cing mi mthun phyogs rnams 'joms byed pa/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa nyid/ /lhag pa'i lha yang tshim par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub ni/ /myur du lung bstan thob par byed/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga yi/ /rim 'dis 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byin/ /ji ltar yang dag spyor ba las/ /rab tu bshad kyis lha mo nyon/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub byed cing / /dge ba'i tshogs la 'dud pa gang / /zos pas dngos grub 'gyur ba nyid/ /de bzhin rdo rje phreng 27—899

—ba las/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad kyis nyon/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rim nga/ 'di1 / /gang zhig mchod pa bzhin du spyad/ /rang gzhan rtedangos grub nye ba nyid / /'dir ni mgron dang dus dang ni/ /gnas dang rdzas dang bya ba'o/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i cho ga 'dis/ /gang zhig dngos grub mngon du 'gyur/ /sde la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i sgra/ /don ni dgos pa'i sgo nas te/ /mgron gyi rang bzhin bshad par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phreng ba las/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin/ /mnyam zhing gcig tu gyur byas nas/ /brda dang phyag rgya'i spyor ba shes/ /dam tshig ldan pa 'jug pa'o/ /de la mang du 'dus pa'i ritshogs / /'khor lo lha yi rim pa nyid/ /thun mong dus su bshad pa nyid/ /khyad par 'di yis shes par bya/ /thams cad du ni dam tshig gcig /rtos pa thams cad yongs su spangs/ /bla ma la gus nying 'dzin gnas/ /sbyin sogs yon tan rgyan spras pa'i/ /thabs 'dis 3tshogs kyi 'khor lo la/ /bgegs med par ni rab tu 'jug /gzhan du skyon dang bcas par 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab phan tshun du/ /yid 'phrog bya dang bya min mkhas/ /lo ni nyi shu lnga lon las6/ /lhag pa yongs su spang bar bya/ /yongs shes thabs ni thams cad la/ /shes rab gcig gis bya ba min/ /'dir ni sgrub pa gcig pa yi/ /bla mas slob ma rjes su gzung / /ji skad sdom pa 'byung ba las/ /gang zhig dkyil 'khor dge bar 'gyur/ /slob dpon sngon du phyogs byas nas/ /slob dpon yon tan ma bsdams na/ /'jig rten pa yis dpyas par 'gyur/ /slob dpon med par gyur pa na/ /gzhan yang bla ma mtshan nyid ldan/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug byas pa nyid/ /gus pa gcig pa'i tshul gyis spyad/ /de yang 27—900

—rdo rje phreng ba las/ /zhi la 1sogs pa'i phrin las dang / /sngags kyi spyor ba'i cho ga shes/ /bya ba nyi shu'i dbye bas ni/ /bla ma'i cho ga bya ba nyid/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan pha rol 'gro/ /nyin mtshan rtag par dge la spro/ /shes rab rno zhing bzo gnas mkhas/ /gnyis med yon tan gyis lci ba/ /'di ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /nang du gsang ba 'dus la sogs/ /phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa can/ /man ngag rim nga/'i khyad par gyis/ /ji ltar rigs pa'i spyod pa la/ /slob ma rjes 2'dzin ston pa dngos/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor la sogs dang / /mdo dang las kyi tshogs rnams dang / /don dam pa yi bya ba mkhas/ /snang ba gsum la sogs pa la/ /rang gis goms 'gyur gzhan la ston/ /rnal 'byor rim pa'i slob dpon te/ /yid 'phrog sdud pa 5slob dpon no/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes / /dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i las la mkhas/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin nus pa dang / /gsang ba'i dbang gi mthar son pa/ /shes rab snying rje mtshungs par ldan / /rgyud kyi rim pa'i spyor ba mkhas/ /zab mo'i spyod pa rab ldan pa/ /'di ni rdo rje sems dpa' dngos/ /ji skad phyag na rdo rje yis/ /'khor lo sdom la 'brel pa las/ /thun mong bsod nams bsag pa'i rgyu/ /ye shes dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dge bsnyen pha ma la sogs pa/ /slob dbon dag la rab tu phyogs/ /gsang sngags theg pa'i cho ga 'dir/ /slob dpon rnam pa gsum yin la/ /khyem pa dge tshul dge slong ste/ /tha ma 'bring dang mchog yin no/ /sbyin bdag blo gros mi 'phel phyir/ /thun mong spang bya'i slob dpon ni/ /snying rje med cing khro ba dang / /khengs shing chags la mi brtan pa//27—901

— bslab pas ma bsdams 'dod pa che/ /rang la bstod pa mi bya'o/ /khyad par khyim pa'i slob dpon ni/ /bud med bcas shing dkor zas dang / /zhing las g.yog dang tshong pa dang / /rmongs pa rnyed phyir chos smra ba/ /'di ni tshogs kyi slob dpon min/ /'dir ni tshul khrims yon tan ldan/ /rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i/ /yon bdag zil gnon bkur ba'i gnas/ /'di nyid 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'gyur/ /'dis ni dkyil 'khor gtso bo dag /ma byas yon bdag bsod nams nyams/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'di nyid du/ /dam tshig sdom pa ma gcig na/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug de yis ni/ /rnal 'byor bsdu bar mi bya'o/ /gzhan gyi rgyud kyi bslab 4byar mngon/ /gnas khang gzhan du mchod par bya'o/ /'di nyid khulung dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /bya ba don dang bcas par 'gyur/ /kha cig rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma/ /sgom rim gzhan du gyur pa na/ /rnal 'byor lhag pa'i lha la mchod/ /de yi rjes su rim pa 'dis/ /skad cig byed pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsgrub bya de yi lha mchod pa/ /'di nyid yang dag mtshan nyid yin/ /tha dad so so'i rgyud dag gis / /bslab pas grol bar 'dod pa la/ /brda yi rim pa so so yi/ /phan tshun dam tshig sbyor mi shes/ /'khor lo'i cho ga nyams pa nyid/ /de rnams mgron kyi rnam gzhag phyago/ /de nas lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /gong du gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /sngags kyis mchod la /kyegasol ba gdab/ /rnal 'byor kun spyod la sogs pa'i/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyis ni/ /nag po'i phyogs dang dkar phyogs kyi/ /bcupa la ni de rab mchod/ /yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /de bzhin du ni 27—902

brgyad pa la/ /dpal ldan dgyes mdzad rdo rje mchod/ /dus kyi 'khor lo nya gnyis la/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zla re bzhin/ /lnga brgyad bcu dang bcu bzhi dang / /de bzhin bco lnga nag phyogs la'ang / /lnga ste dus ni bcu ru 'gyur/ /de dag dus kyi khyad par ro/ /'dir ni rtag tu phun tshogs sam/ /ji ltar 'dod cing ji ltar nus/ /grub par nus na nyin re 'am/ /lo zla kun du bya ba'o / /gnas ni dben par gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor bar bya//phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ /thams cad 'jigs pa spangs pa yi/ /skye bos dben zhing yid 'phrog pa/ /grong ngam ldum ra nags tshal dang / /dur khrod ri yi phug tu'o/ /dang po yid 'jug byi dor bya/ /dkyil 'khor rnam par me tog dgram/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las ni/ /me tog sna tshogs bkram pa yi/ /gzhal yas khang gis nyurnam par spras ③/ /de dag gnas kyi rnam bzhag go/ /gang zhig dam tshig med par ni/ /bu la sogs pa'ang mi gzhug go/ /ji skad sdom pa 'byung ba las/ /yongs su grub pa'i gnas dag dang / /gdan la 'jug par bya ba ni/ /rgan dang gzhon pa'i dbye bas der/ /slob dpon rjes su 'jug par bya/ /snod dang mi ldan nga rgyal che/ /bla ma'i skyon rtog shes rgyud rtsub / /gong ma'i dbang gis ma smin pa/ /rang gi bu dang chung ma dang / /de bzhin bran dang bran mor bcas/ /dngos grub 'dod phyir sgrub pa pos/ /dam tshig 'di dag gzhug mi bya/ /de ltar 'di dag gzhug pa na/ /rmongs dang dngos grub ring bar 'gyur/ /dam tshig bral gyur snyug bsngal zhing / /de bzhin lus ngag yid kyis myong / /gnas nas 'thon dang phun tshogs nyams/ /snatshogs snyug bsngal myong ba nyid/ /sgrub pos 'di bzhin mchod pa'i yul/ /27—903

——pha rol rnal 'byor dngos grub nyams/ /dam tshig med pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /nam yang bskor bar mi bya'o/ /mched yul rnam par bzhag pa ni/ /tshul dang mthun pa'i gnas dag tu/ /snyan gsan phab pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /slob dpon rjes su 'jug par bya'o/ /phyi ru rnal 'byor khrus byas nas/ /sgo dag skyong ba'i slob dpon la/ /tshigs hūṃbacad 'di yis 'jug par bya/ /khro bo sngon po mdzes pa ste/ /khyod ni dam tshig yid du 'ong / /nor bu rin chen spras pa yi/ /dbyug pa phyag na bsnams pa nyid/ /bdag ni 'khor ba las bsgral phyir/ /rnal 'byor tshogs kyi dbus dag tu/ /bzang po'i sgo ni phye nas su/ /dpa' bos gnang gis gtong 2 du gsol/ /nang du stan la rgan rim gyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rim pa 'am/ /yang na gral gyi rim pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon yon bdag gis/ /ri rab steng du skad cig la/ /gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang dkyil du/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gzugs su blta/ /dam tshig sems dpa'i rang bzhin la/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug par bya/ /ar+gha dang ni zhal bsil dang / /bsang chu sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /me tog phreng ba spos la sogs / /thun mong gi ni mchod pa dbul/ /yon gyi bdag pos bstod pa bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /mkha' 'go ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun du rtog pa'i 4'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yod med rtog pa las grol zhing / /'khor 'das rnam pa gnyis med pa/ /dpe med bde bas gang gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo'i dpa' bo la sogs bstod/ /'dis ni mngon par 27—904

brkyang phyag 'tshal/ /slob dpon rgyud kyi dbye bas der/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi 1rim pas ni/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs su 'gyur/ /ji lha'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom2ske/ /yon bdag yi dam gzhan yin na/ /sngon la rang gi yi dam ste/ /rjes la skad cig nyid la ni/ /yon bdag 'dod lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /las kyi rdo rje'i bya ba ni/ /ji skad bde mchog 'byung ba las/ /gtsang zhing zhi la blo gros ldan/ /rmongs dang ser sna rnam par spang (kye/ /thams cad dang ni mthun par blta/ /las kyi rdo rjer der rtog go/ /de bzhin rdo rje phreng ba las/ /khyod ni rang byung rdo rje sems/ /mtshungs med las kyi rdo rje nyid/ /de nas sna tshogs ston mo dang / /sha dang chang ni mnyam por sbyor/ /longs spyod yid 'phrog bde ba can/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes/ /a mra ④dang ni pa na 5sa/ /mi dim 6na rī 7 ke la sogs/ /'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /tshogs kyi dkyil du dbul ba ni/ /yang dag spyor ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ /'phags pa phyag na rdo rjes gsungs/ /ji ltar tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /bdud rtsi ri lu'i 8chu yis bsang /sngon du gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /phyag rgya chen po'i thig le las/ /thog mar gtor ma chen po ni/ /sna tshogs pa yi bza' ba dang / /btung ba dang ni ldan pa nyid/ /thog ma bar dang tha ma ni/ /lhag pa lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /gtor ma dbul bar bya ba ni/ /mdun du dri bzang sogs pas byug /dri yis 9thig les dkyil 'khor la/ /rang gi lha yi 'khor lo ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bskyed la mchod/ /dam tshig sems dpa' mkha' nyid las/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug par bya/ /de yi rtsibs bcur khro bo bcu/ /srung ⑩ba'i 'khor 27—905

—lo'i lte ba la/ /sgrub pa po yi lha nyid de/ /srung skyeba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol du/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i phyogs skyong dang / /zhing skyong dur khrod la sogs pa/ /ji ltar mngon rtogs sngags kyis ni③/ /skad cig gis ni rang gi lha/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gzugs su blta/ /yum dang bcas pa nyid du bsgom/ /dam tshig la ni gzhug par bya/ /ji ltar cho ga la sogs pa/ /gtor ma bdud rtsir byin brlabs te/ /rang rang sngags kyis dbul bar bya/ /khyad par so so'i mngon rtogs ni/ /gzhung mangs kye'ajigs pas ma bris shing / /yongs su grags pa cung zad bkod/ /de nas g.yon pa'i ming med dang / /rgan po'i sor mo gnyis sbyar nas/ /shes rab khu ba byin gyis brlab/ /de yi mdun du chos 'byung bri/ /shes rab thabs kyi khu bas gtor/ /lhag pa lha yi dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal bar blta/ /srung ④bas byin kyis brlabs /thupa'i gnas/ /ting 'dzin byed pa rgyun mi bcad/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje yis/ /slob dpon la ni snod gnyis dbul/ /gzhan pa rnams la re re'o//mchod rdzas bla ma nyis 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan rnams mnyam por shes/ /'ga' zhig tshim par ma gyur na'ang / /rang gis blang bar mi bya ste/ /las kyi rdo rje las blangs na/ /lhang ba nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig lag nas lhung ba dag /dngos po gzhan gyis ༅dgab par bya/ /'dren pas ha cang gang ba min / /len pas 7ha cang stong pa min/ /phan tshun gcig la gcig min bzhin / /'dod ces ngag gis smra ba min/ /9'dren pas pad kor saphyagargya ste / /g.yon pas steng du bskyod par bya/ /len pas kyang ni de bzhin no/ phyag 'tshal nas ni dbul bya zhing / /'dren pas de bzhin shes par bya/ /27—906

—g.yas pa'i lha nga sar btsugs te/ /thog mar thabs dang shes rab la /gzigs shig dhimadzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di la the tshom bya mi rung / /bram ze khye dang gdol pa yang / /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni sbyin par bya'o/ /yang ni len pa po yis ni/ /bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ /gzung 'dzin rnam par spangs pa yis/ /de kho na nyid la skyabs ③mchi'o/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni len par bya'o/ /bla ma'i bka' drin gnang ba yi/ /snod ni sa la gzhag a+yomi bya/ /gnang ba thob gyur gzhag ④par bya'o/ /de las gzhan du chad par 'gyur/ /slob dpon rjes gnang ma byen par/ /rnal 'byor bza' btung phyedon gzhan min/ /slob dpon thog mar rang gi ni/ /phyag rgya mchod la de nas rol/ /btung ba dga' ba bskyed skyepa tsam/ /de bas lhag dang chad pa min/ /bde ba bskyed 3phyir btung ba ste/ /myos pa'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /rnal 'byor lha yi nga rgyal dang kye/ /dus rnams kun du bya ba nyid/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'dus pas spun/ /gtam gyi rnyed pa la sogs pa/ /de bzhin g.yeng ba spang bar bya/ /mchil ma 'dor la sogs pa dang / /smad ra 'thog dang dgod pa dang / /rkang lag brkyang bar mi bya'o/ /yang yang ldang dang 'dug pa dang / /mgrin pa bsgyur sogs rtag tu spang / /gang zhig dgos pa'i dbye ba la/ /brda skad phyag rgya bgo bar bya/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dbang phyug gis/ /gnang ba byin par ma gyur par/ /gzhan du glu dang gar dang ni/ /de bzhin rol mo 'khrol la sogs/ /zab mo'i skyeskad sogs 'dri ba min/ /gnang ba thob nas ci bder 'gyur/ /gang zhig bza' 27—907

—dang btung ba la/ /thams cad bdud rtsir sbyar byas la/ /de nas rang gi lte bar ni/ /gang zhig dgos pa'i dbye ba yis/ /lha yi 'khor lo gnas par bsam—/ /rang gi lag pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /blugs gzar dgang gzar rang gzugs nyid/ /lte ba'i lha la mchod pa'i tshul/ /longs spyod tshogs kyis mchod par bya/ /de bzhin gzugs la sogs pa'i yul/ /mig la sogs pa'i dbang po nyid/ /ji ltar lha yi gzugs kyis ni/ /rnam par dag pa'i ro gcig pa'i/ /phan tshun ༄teshes pa nyid kyis so/ /de yang rdo rje phreng ba las /lte ba pad+ma'i dbus su ni/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug dran pa nyid/ /gang zhig phan tshun gcig la gcig /rnam par dag par mi shes na/ /de la 'khor lo'i 'bras bu med/ /thams cad dngos grub 'bras nyams 'gyur/ /gang du rim pa 'di yis ni/ /phyi dang nang gi 3bdag nyid kun/ /ro gcig par ni spyad byas nas/ /de ni 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid/ /yang dag tshogs 'khor 'bras bu 'byin/ /myos byed bde ba bskyed kyipa'i tshe/ /glu dang gar ni byed 'dod na/ /gnang ba thob nas rdo rje yi/ /glu gar rnal 'byor pa yis bya//de yang brtag gnyis rgyal po las/ /glu ni rnam dag sngags su gnas/ /gar ni sdom 4pa byed pa nyid/ /de yi phyir ni glu dang gar/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rgyun du bya/ /dga' ba rdo rje bsdams pa yis/ /rkang pa rdo rje rtse gcig chodang / /rnal 'byor mnyam par gzhag 6pa yis/ /bde ba bskyed phyir gar nyid de/ /thar pa'i rgyur ni brjod par bya'o/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i rim pa ste/ /gzhan du gnang ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin rdo rje phreng ba las/ /dga' ba bskyed nas gnang ba yis/ /glu dang gar ni bya ba nyid/ /gang zhig rdo rje 27—908

bsdams la sogs/ /de bzhin lha ni mnyes pa nyid/ /rgyud las gsungs pa rdo rje'i glu/ / kobe+e i resbyi ā bo hūṃlā/ muṣ+ṭha ṇi 2re kasko lāsde/ gha ṇi jekṛ pi zheṭa ho bādz+dza yi.i/ ka ru ṇi 3ki a i ṇa lkuro lā/ ta ho ba la khādz+dza 9i/ gā tshedzhai ma a shā ⑪pidz+dza a 6i/ ha le kwa ye kā liñdza tenar pa ṇi a i/ dun+d+ra ra bādzhai — a i/ tsa u sa ma kasgo rī (skyesi h+la/ kapru ra 'di i a te.i/ mā la ad+dhā ṇa 〉/ liñdzamu/ ta ho bha ru khā i 15a i/ phre kha ṇa kha shākheṭa ka redhe / shudhe a shud+dhā ṇa mu ⑥ṇi a i/ ni re su saṃ gets+tsha rtse1ḍā wi/ ta ho dza sa rā wa pa ṇi byeshā.a i/ma la a dze kun+d+ra ru pā ṭa i ḍiṇ+ḍi ma ta ho ṇa bārji ༄ — a i/ grub thob bla mas gsungs pa'i dbyangs/ /stong pa snying rje dbyer med par/ /don ston rdo rje'i glu nyid do/ /gzhan du rtogs stsopas phan tshun du/ /sbrel ba rdo rje'i glu ma yin/ /rdo sde rkang pa'i gar la sogs/ /gzhan du grags phyir 'dir ma spros/ /'dir ni cho ga ji bzhin du/ /glu gar la sogs rim pa ni/ /byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ba nyid/ /de la thun mong byin rlabs hūṃ rtags/ /de yang brtag gnyis rgyal po las/ /gsungs pa rim bzhin shes byas te/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug mdun du ni/ /gang zhig gus pas glu dang gar/ /byas pas dri yi mtshan nyid ni / /thog mar sgog pa'i dri nyid de/ /de nas yang ni bya rgod dri/ /ga pur ma la ya yi dri/ /byin rlabs she glu yi mtshan nyid do/ /ngang pa 2/dang ni bung ba'i sgra/ /thos pas glu yi khyad par nyid/ /ba lang tshe yi sgra nyid ni/ /phyi rol nye ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /khyad par byin kyis brlabs pa'i rtags/ /de yang rdo rje phreng ba las/ /gal te thun mong rnal 'byor ma/ /'dus pa'i tshogs su 'ongs pa na/ /g.yon pa'i stso ma'i 9brda yis ni/ /bde ba'i phyag 27—909

rgya bya ba nyid/ /de la sgrub pa po yis ni/ /gtam 'dri rnam rtog byar mi rung / /cung zad dri ①bar 'dod na ④yang / /gang zhig rdo rje slob dpon nam/ /yang na las kyi rdo rje yis/ /brda dang phyag rgya 'dri bar 'gyur/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi rnal 'byor ma/ /yang dang yang du 'gro zhing 'ong / /de la the tshom za ba dang / /ya mtshan 'jigs par byed don sogs/ /sgrub pa po yis mi bya ste—/ /byas na dngos grub nyams pa nyid/ /de nas dkyil 'khor sbud pa na/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /de yang rdo rje phreng ba las/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma'i spyor ba yis/ /dngos grub rnal 'byor chen por 'gyur/ /oṃ k+ṣi uspyoṇ+ḍi k+ṣe tra pā khā ya swā hā/ sngags 'di zhubarjod sbung kha phrus ④gdab/ /yang na phya slob dpon sngon 'gro bas/ /gang zhig ma mthong gyur pa na/ /rtags kyi spyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni shes par bya/ /gang zhig byad zlum kha dog dmar/ /bzhin bzang smin ma ring ba ni/ /'od dpag med kyi rigs shes bya/ /de la rus sbal phyag rgya bstan/ /cung zad sbom zhing mig dkyus ring / /dkar ser mdog can yid 'phrog ma/ /sna tshogs gos ni 'dzin pa ste/ /ri mo gsum 'greng dpral bar mtshan/ /gang du gnas pa'i sa dag tu/ /grong ba'i shi sogs gtam smra ba/ /'di nyid rin 'byung rnal 'byor ma / /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro zhes byar blta/ /rtse gsum pa yi phyag rgya bstan/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi gar stabs kyis/ /de yi mdun du blta bar bya'o/ /lagatu g.yon pas byin nas ni/ /phyag rgya rab tu ston par byed/ /kha dog gnag cing gos nag 'dzin/ /skra li dpral ba gzhu yi dbyibs/ /mtshan ma'irnam par rtog par ston/ /sems 'gro ba yi mar rab grags/ /g.yon bsgumadace 27—910

ba'i gar gyis ni/ /phyag rgya rab tu bstan par bya/ /mi bskyod pa yi rigs su shes / /g.yon pa'i stangs kyi kyelan yang 'debs/ /lus sgom gsus pa cung zad 'phyang / /mig yangs rdzi ma mang ba la/ /byen pa sbom zhing mdzes pa ni/ /sa 'og grub pa shes pa ste/ /rnam snang rigs su shes pas na/ /de la dung gi phyag rgya ke /bstan/ /mig skam ba spu thams cad langs/ /lus skem lag pa ring ba la/ /mkha' 'gro zhes sgra rab tu sgrogs/ /'di nyid don grub rigs su shes//de la rab blta mtha' ma bskor/ /lag pa g.yon gyi dbye ba yi4/ /ba dan phyag rgya bstan par bya/ /ji ltar 'di dag la mkhas pas/ /rab tu 'bad pa/sa shes par bya/ /dri ba'am phyag rgya byed pa na/ /de yi don gyis mchod par brjod / /gang zhig 'di rnams thams cad la/ /dpa' bo rkyang 3pa'i bya ba ni/ /dpa' bo'i ston mo zhes su brjod/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug de lta min/ /de bzhin dpa' mo rkyang gyepa la/ /dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ston mo nyid/ /de ltar 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la/ /shes rab thabs dang bcas pa nyid/ /gzhan yang gang zhig stobs dang ni/ /myos byed khu ba rkyang pas ni/ /'phags pa phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs/ /stobs dang myos byed khu bar ni/ /mi ldan yon tan bsod nams nyams/ /gtso bo tshogs kyi dbang phyug gis7/ /khyad par shes rab g.yon du bzhag /'dir ni ji ltar 'byor pa dang / /ji ltar nus pa'i rim pa yis/ /lnga snyeyi bdag nyid dkyil 'khor sogs/ /rnam par dag pa'i cho gas mchod/ /thams cad rang gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'dir ni dge bar 'dod pas na/ /rnam dag lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /slob mas tshogs kyi rnal 'byor goms/ /nang gi dbang phyug gyur pa ste/ /rgyun par shin tu goms pas 27—911

—na / /gang tshe cho ga 'di yis ni/ /rim pa 'di ni rnam par sbyad/ /de tshe rtag tu goms pas na/ /spros bcas spros med rnam par gzhag—7 /de nas sgrub pa po yis ni/ /zhal bsil 2phyag phyis go la dbul/ /yon tan sogs pas mnyes par bya/ /rang gi lha yi 'khor lo nyid/ /dang po thar par 'gyur ba ste/ /de nas bsod nams bsngo bar bya/ /bzod par gsol la tshogs kyi ni//'khor lo gshegs par bya ba nyid/ /bdag nyid dbang phyug gyur pas na/ /gzhan la phyag ni bya mi dgos/ /cho ga'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /ji ltar rigs/ par 'bad gyur na/ /de yi bsod nams mtha' ma be+e/ /tshad gzung rngunus nga/ ma yin no/ /de ltar phyag na rdo rje yis/ /gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang bar ri'agyur / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta rañtsha rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na 5rak+ṣi ta pa'i zhal snga nas khubod kyi lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa grub pa dpal bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //27—912

— —par 25 ba shanas dra/ ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa tsakra bi bye pā ka sa nā ma/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga rim par phye ba zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bde chen rgyal po yi2/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal nas/ /dngos grub dgos pa kun sgrub rdopa'i/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rim bshad bya/ /de la tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya rtsa'am 'bum la sogs pa byed par 'dod pas 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i rim pa ni gsum ste/ rgyal po lta bu'i dang / 'bangs 4lta bu'i dang / rnal 'byor pa'i rim pa lta bus bya ba'o / /dang po ni 'byor pa dang ldan pas rgyud gang dang rtog bsre mthun pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo lha grangs dang mnyam pa rang gi slob dpon sngon du 'gro ba'i blo can rnams kyis de'i cho ga dang / brda dang phyag rgya la sogs pa tha ma stoms 'jug gi bar du bya ba ni gcig ste/ rim par phye ba dang po'o/ /27—915

gnyis pa ni ji ltar tshogs pa'i 'byor pa dang / ji ltar rigs pa'i rna'/ 'byor pho mo rnams rdo rje slob dpon sngon du 'gro bar bya ste/ cho ga ni rgyud kyi dbye ba las shes te/ de lta bu'i bya ba gcig tu 'dod de rim par phye ba gnyis pa'o / /gsum pa ni 'byor pa dang ldan pas rgyud du ma'i rnal 'byor pa rang gi ris byed la mkhas pa'i tshogs la spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rim pas bya ste/ de ltar rnal 'byor pa'i grangs ji snyed pa de snyed tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dbye ba shes par bya ste/'di ni 1rim par phye ba gsum pa'o/ /de thams cad la gnas dang rdzas dang / rnal 'byor pa dang / cho ba dang / yon bdag la bar chad med par bya'o/ /grangs du ma bya bar 3'dod pas tshul 'dis ni yongs su shes par bya'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga rim par phye ba zhes bya ba ā tsār+ya 5he ru ka badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na rak+ṣi ta'i zhal snga nas lo tsā ba grub pa dpal bzang pos bsgyur —ba'o / / //27—916

bsdur mchan/915 zhu/mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ⑧ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gepes 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ bya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanamangs/916 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wani/ sri〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snams par/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉tsar+ya/ /④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1325)27wa 917

༄/ /d+ku dang gsung dang thugs rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta su pra tiṣ+ṭha nā ma/ bod skad du/sku dang gsung dang thugs rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsung thugs rten bla ma la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal rten gsum la/ /rgyud dang bla ma'i gsung 3brten nas/ /sgrib sbyong rab gnas bri bar bya/ /slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing / /mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya sngags dang cho ga shes/ /las rnams kun la mkhas pa ste/ /dam sdom byang chub sems 'byongs pas/ /bsnyen pa rnam gsum rdzogs byas la/ /de dang 'dra ba'i grogs bcas kyis/ /dus zla gza' skar tshes grangs ni/ /nyi ma'i khyem ni bcu gnyis te/ /dgun dpyid ra 'bring ro hi ta'i/ /dus su nyi ma log nas ni/ /byang 'gro zla drug nyin mo 'phel/ /27—9/8

de drug zhi ba rab gnas shis/ /dbyar ston ra 'bring zla drug lhor/ /nag 'phel drag nyi der mi brtsamahu / /phur bu lag dang pa ba sangs/ /zla ba bzang ldan gza' de ⑤shis/ /nyi spen dmag dpon nor 'joms ngan/ /chu smad snar ma gro bzhin dang / /lag dang sgon snrubs rgyal chu stod/ /khrums smad skye dgu 'phel ba dang / /rab tu gnas pa'i mchog tu byed/ /yid 'dod dngos grub me bzhi ste/ /snrubs dang go bzhin de bzhin te/ /lag gis skal bzang grusnar mas rgyal/ /mgo yis nye bar zhi bar byed/ /chu stod kyis 4ni bu dag gson—/ /khrums smad rtag par dngos grub ster/ /rgyal gyis tshe ring brtan sapar 'gyur/ /spyon gyis mchog tu bde bar byed/ /lha mtshams kyis ni mchog ster 'gyur/ /gza' dang skar ma de dag kyang / /dar gud 6mi rigs las dang sbyar/ /tshes gcig gsum lnga drug bdun bcu/ /drug po nor 'joms spang gzhan shis/ /gza' skar tshes grangs mthun 'dzom na/ /mar gyi ngo la'ang bya bar shis/ /gnam stong bcu bzhi kun du spang / /zla ba gza' dang skar ma dang / /nyi ma dus 'dzom skad cig la/ /ji skad gsungs pa bzhin byas na/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /rab tu gnas pa mchog 'gyur te/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal dbang phyug ni/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /slob dpon mtshan ma thob pa na/ /gza' dang rgyu skar brtsi 7mi dgos / /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'ang med/ /gza' rnams thams cad rjes mthun zhing / /bgegs dang rgyu skar lha rnams nyid/ /de drug bka' sgrub kun gnas shing / /gzugs brnyan mchod rten la sogs kyi8/ /dngos grub dag ni ster bar mdzad/ /yid kyis cung zad gang bsams pa/ /skye dang 27—919

skye bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang thog mchod rten la sogs gnas/ /khyem dang lha yi gnas rnams su/ /sangs rgyas la sogs rab gnas bya/ /brdungs lugs 'bur tshobris sogs rten ni/ /rang rang mtshan nyid ldan pa ste/ /zhi khro la sogs rang tshul mthun/ /tshad kyis gyetshad la phab cing bzang / /de 'dra rab tu gnas par 'gyur/ /bzlog pa skyon 'gyur de phyir gzab/ /rab gnas dgos dang mi dgos gnyis/ /dam pa'i don du dpyad pa na/ /gang zhig gang gis gang du brlab/ /gdod ma nas zhi skye med la/ /ji 'dra ji ltar rab tu gnas/ /chos rnams thams cad 'od gsal du/ /rtog zudang ldan pa'i mchod gnas la/ /rab tu gnas pa mi dgos te/ /yang na stong nyid ma rtogs kyang / /mchod rten glegs bam sgu gzugs sogs/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul byin rlabs las/ /byung ba min na mi 'byung bar/ /rtogs te shin tu dad ldan na/ /rab tu gnas pa mi dgos so/ /dang po'i las can ma 'byongs la/ /'jig rten tha snyad kun rdzob tu/ /'gro bas de nyid mi shes la/ /ston pas rab tu gnas pa bshad/ /dbye ba sgra don skyon yon las/ /bya ba'i thabs dang rnam pa drug /don dam spros med rab gnas dang / /kun rdzob sku gsung thugs gsum ste/ /yon tan phrin cholas zhor la 'byung / /dam tshig sems dpa' sbyangs bskyed 6la/ /ye shes sems dpa' yun ring du/ /gnas pa'i phyir ni 7rab tu gnas/ /gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa la/ /byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na/ /de la bkra mi shis 'gyur zhing / /de srid mchod par de mi 'os/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /rig (pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa na/ /'jig rten kun gyis mchod mi byed/ /de bzhin byinam 27—920

brlabs sku la/ /gang zhig phyag 'tshal mchod byed pa/ /dam tshig bral zhing snga gas dman te/ /sbyin sreg thal ba 'bras med mtshungs/ /'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud chen las/ /skye bo tshul khrims 'chal 'di la/ /bde 'gro mtho ris yod min la/ /bde ba mchog tu'ang mi 'gyur na/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sngags rnams ni/ /'grub par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /ta la'i mgo bcad sngo min ltar/ /de bzhin sngags sgrub rmongs pa dang / /tshul khrims nyams shing sdig las byed/ /rtag tu bud med chags pa la༄1/ /'di ni rab tu bsten rngum yin / /mi dge bshes gnyen bsten pas ni/ /sngags kyi rgyal po ga la 'grub//yon tan yang ni rtsa rgyud las/ /'jig rten sngags rnams ji snyed dang / /de slob bse ru byang chub sems/ /bdag nyid chen pos gsungs pa yin/ /cho ga gzhung dang mthun par ni/ /rab tu gnas pa byas nas kyang / /ri mo 'di ni mdun bzhag /5na/ /sngags rnams ma lus 'grub par 'gyur/ /de bzhin mchod dang phyag 'tshal dang / /mthong dang reg pa tsam gyis kyang / /sdig pa'i rnyog pa kun las grol/ /ras ris la sogs ma thu chen la/ /don du gnyer dang bskul bas ni/ /myur du skye ba don yod thob/ /rjes su yi rang de bzhin no/ /rten 'di mthong ba'i skye bo yis/ /4bsod nams thob pa don yod pa/ /bskal pa bye ba rnams su yang / /brjod par yang ni mi nus so/ /las ni yon bdag bsod nams spel/ /sngags pas dge ba rnyed par byed/ /de bzhin slob dpon sngags gnas pas/ /chos ldan mchod pa byed pa gang / /de yis skye bar mchod par 'gyur/ /bya thabs cho ga dag las 5bya/ /cho ga dman gnas bkra mi shis/ /'dir sdug pha rol 'jigs pa che/ /dngos grub 27—921

'dod pas cho gar 'bad/ /cho ga'i tshul legs bsod nams ni/ /mthong dang mi mthong rnams su skye/ /sku gzugs sngags kyi mtshan nyid kyis/ /rten 'a/ byin rlabs thu'ajug par 'gyur/ /gang zag blo rigs tha dad pas/ /yon mchod 'byor chog tshogs pa yis/ /rab gnas rgyas pa spros bcas bya /'bring pos cho ga tshad 3 tsam dang / /bsdus pa ting 'dzin thun gcig la/ /rdul tshon la sogs mi dgos bya/ /rgyas pa mtshan ldan bla ma la/ /slob mas lan gsum gsol btab nas/ /bka' bsgo slob mas rdzas bsogs te/ /yid 'ong gnas su bsnyen gsum bskyal/ /sa yi cho ga gzhung bzhin bya/ /lha bum sbyin sreg sa yi lha/ /sta gon spyi dang mthun par bya/ /'di skabs slob ma sta gon ni/ /gang byed gzhung dang mthun gnas yin/ /de yang sngags grogs slob dpon 'dra/ /yon bdag sta gon gnas pa ni/ /rgyas pa bkra shis cho ka 'di / /brtsams nas yongs su rdzogs kyi bar/ /yon mchod la sogs mi rnams kun/ /lus ngag yid spyod bzang ltas bya/ / ngan pa'i jephyogs kun thag ring spang / /bzang ngan gang byung mi rabs bdun/ /'byung bas ngan na 'bar sogs bzlog /nang par dkyil 'khor rdzas tshang 'ubasham/ /shar lhor rab gnas dbang stegs ni/ /dpangs khru rgya ni rten 6dang sbyar/ /ba yi lngas byugs pad 'khor ser/ /nyi nub dpon slob khrus byas brgyan/ /bgegs bskrad chad lhag bskang byas te/ /bum pa'i bsnyen sgrub gzhung ltar bya/ /de yang srung ba'i 9'khor lo nas/ /mchod bstod bsgom bzlas bar du ni/ /mtshan ma byung gi bar du bya/ /de rjes rang 'jug dbang yang blang / /derjes snyan gsan gsol ba gdab/ /phyir phyin gtor ma rgya chen gtang / /27—922

bgegs la bka' bsgo bden bdar bya/ /nang zhugs nye reg 1'thor 'thung byas / /sngon du yon bdag dbang rgyas bskur/ /de nas rab gnas sta gon te / /rten gsar rnams ni der drangs la/ /dkyil 'khor mkhar 'degs bdag khror bsgyur/ /bgegs la bka' bsgo stang stabs bya/ /khro bo'i bstod bzlas ra dra sogs/ /srung ge'akhor rgyas par bsgom par bya/ /gong nas rten gsar bzhugs pa na/ /na bza' car g.yogs ༄ —zhal phyir bstan/ /dkyil 'khor bris nas sta ④gon te/ /ma bris rab gnas dbang nus med/ /slob dpon brtan ma thob nus med/ /dkyil 'khor bris chog dgos med 'gyur/ /des na rgyud dang bla ma ni/ /dam pa'i snyan brgyud gdams ngag dgos/ /sta gon bgegs ni bskrad pa'i gnad3)/ /dngos gzhi byin rlabs 9sbar ba'i gnadaspu//rjes ni bstan pa dar rgyas gsum/ /sta gon nub mo phyag rgya dgrol/ /dkyil 'khor shar sogs ku sha'i steng / /seng ge'i nyal stabs chos nyid nyal/ /skya rengs ༄trīshar dus chos nyid las/ /langs te khrus byas brgyan lhar bskyed/ /rten gsar tha mal dril 9sbyang phyir/ /shing bu gru gsum me sbar la/ /kham phor steng du bag zan gyi/ /kong bu gsum la mar me sbar/ /'bras kyi chang bu sasum la ni/ /rdo rje gtsug tor gnod spyin gyis/ /sgu la phyi bkru lan gsum bya / /'bras med bag phyes bya bar 'os/ /sngags gnyis zlos shing yungs kar brab/ /mi gtsang dor bsam sla ngar blugs/ /de rjes chu mes —de lta/ra bya/ /yang na g.yam /1steng chu me dang / /zho zan bsres dang yungs kar la/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ zhes bzlas mer bsregs bzhi mdor dor/ /'dag chal sug pa nye shing pa/ /shu ti sran phye ba yi lnga/ /til mar gyis ni 27—923

—sngags bcas bkru/ /bag chags sbyang phyir chu brgyad khrus/ /rdul g.yab me long bstan byas te/ /chab gtsang chu gtsang sman chab dang / /spu sdechab 'o ma 'bru sna lnga/ /rin chen mchod yon khrus byas la/ /shing bal ras kyis sku phyis la—/ /dbang stegs steng du bzhugs ①gsol la/ /mar dang dri lnga ga pur dang / /tsan+dan dzā gyeti gur gum dang / /gla rtsi byugs te stong par sbyang / /stong pa'i sngags gsum rim bzhin brjod/ /de nas lhar bskyed dngos de 'am/ /dkyil 'khor gang bris yi dam lha/ /gtso 'khor bcas pa'am gtso rkyang ni/ /mngon par byang chub lngas bskyed la/ /rab gnas dbang bskur mnga' gsol gsum / /rab gnas ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /spyan drang chos brgyad snyan gsan dbab/ /spyan drangs bzhugs gsol khrus mchod yon/ /phyag 'tshal sum bsres sku gsung thugs/ /byin gyes brlab kyepa'i bar du bya/ /de la mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal thun mong lnga/ /rgyan dang gzhal yas gdugs rgyal mtshan/ /ba dan 'phan dang bla re dang / /me tog phreng ba ro'/ mos bskor/ /na bza' nam mkha' mdzod zhal zas/ /gling bzhi dzimaṇ+ḍal dbul bar bya/ /rang rang sngags dang rten 'byel gyi3/ /snying po brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas pas brtan par byed pa yin/ /de dag spyi yi rab gnas te/ /khyad par sgu gsung thugs rnams la/ /rang rang cho ga gzhung bsrangs rkyel/ /mchod rten la sogs thugs rten la/ /khyad par chos bzhi byin gyis brlab9 / /rdo ring jem skas chu srin gyi/ /rgyal mtshan la sogs dbul ba'o/ /byen brlabs sa gzhi chos kyi dbyings/ /seng khri mi 'jigs bzhir byen brlab / /27—924

rmang ni dge bcu khri 'phang ni/ /dang po dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ /gnyis pa yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /gsum pa rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ /bzhi pa snang ba'i dbang po lnga/ /bum rten stobs lngar byin gyis brlab༄1/ /bum pa byang chub yan lag bdun/ /kha khyer 3'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ /de dag rgyu chos byen brlab ste/ /'bras bu'i chos su 'di ltar brlab / /srog shing mkhyen bcu bre legs ni/ /ye shes bzhi dang rnam thar bzhi/ /'khor lo bcu gsum sa bcu dang / /dran pa nyer gzhag gsum du brlab/ /char khabs gdugs ni thugs rje'i skyabs/ /tog ni chos dbyengs ngo bo nyid/ /phyi ni sgu gsum nang gzhal yas/ /rdo ring rin chen them skas 5dang / /chu srin rgyal mtshan dar dbe+engs dang / /rin chen phreng ba nyi zla dbul/ /bya ru thabs dang shes rab yin/ /6mchod rten sku bsdus rab gnas bya/ /rang rang rab gnas legs par bya/ /sku gzugs khyad par chos brgyad de/ /spyan dbye dbu skra sprul sku'i gzhar3/ /longs sku'i dung gi so mangs 8bshad/ /shangs dbyes sru 'thog 9tshems rtsa bru/ /ljags bzhar snyan spabs 1 bru zhing bsal/ /na bza' sprul pa'i sku la ni/ /smad gsum chu tshags par 'khar gsil / /longs sku zhi 'a/ dar gyi ste/ /khro bo'i stag lpags dar sngon gyi/ /stod g.yogs rgyan ni sbrulathod sogs/ /sprul sku rgyan med longs zhi la/ /bris bkod dbul bsam ཿcho gas dbul/ /dngos su dbul du yod na rab/ /gsung rab zhal bsro'i khyad par dgu/ /don gsung skye 'gag med par brlab/ /tshig gsung yig 'bru 'igasung rab ni/ /yan lag tshad med bzhi bcur brlab/ /khye dbul glegs shing glegs sathag dbul/ /na bza' zhal khebs rgya rim bdun/ /pha 27—925

—rol phyin pa yum chen mo/ /mdo sde 'dul ba byang chub che/ /rgyud sde rdo rje chos sogs te/ /cho ga yi ①dam la sogs pa/ /ngo shes bye brag mi shes spyi/ /yang na bden gnyis yi ger bsam/ /dri lnga yis ni de nas byug /sa bon lnga yi gtor bya'i don/ /skye rnged rtog 5 pa gsal ba yis/ /chos sku la ni chos sku thim/ /gnyis su med bsams me tog dbul/ /thugs kyi (7mchod pa dri yis byug /de nas spyir ni dbang bcu gcig /bum pa dbu rgyan cod pan dang / /phyag rgya ming dbang las bzhi'i dbang / /chos kyi thurgyal po gsang ba'i dbang / /thabs shes gdugs dang phreng dbang bskur/ /rjes la mnga' gsol rten kun la//rdzas brgyad sna bdun dbul ba dang / /bkra shis byin cher gsol ba ni/ /'brang rgyas la sogs bkra shis rdzas/ /mang la 'jig rten dge ba dang / /mdzad pa bcu gnyis dkon mchog gsum/ /rigs lnga la sogs mang po ni/ /bklag 6dang gyer bas zhal bsro bya/ /gong du cod pan dbang bskur ram/ /yang na sngags 'dis bcing 7byas te/ /oṃ hūṃ i j-i rdu/khaṃ/ sku yi sum 'gyur khri la ni/ /mdun du ma nub mi yor bzhugs/ /de ltar ma byas skyon mang 9sna/'byung / /de nas slob dpon yon bdag gnyis/ /me tog gtor te gdan khri nas/ /bzung la bzhugs par lan gsum gsol/ /de nas mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad sogs / /bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ /de yi yon tan la dad pas / /me tog spos dang de bzhin dri/ /mar me lha bshos na bza' sogs/ /sngags ldan rgyas basbus skabs dang sbyar/ /de nas yon bdag mdun 11bzhaga'// /me tog dri yi mnga' gsol ba/ /rten 'byel snying po zlos bzhin du/ /lha la dbul ba bzhin byas la/ /gzengs 7bstod mchod pa'i rjes gnang spyin/ /27—926

—kasang ba'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /phyag na rdo rje 'khor bcas la/ /gtor ma phul la gsol ba gdab/ /spyi yi chos skyong phyogs skyong bcu/ /rnam 3 sras mgon po gzhi 5bdag la/ /gtor sbyin phrin las bka' bsgo bya/ /phyi rjes bzo 1bo grogs byed sogs/ /'di skad brjod de mchod par bya/ /kye sason dga' bas 'di nyid du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ /bdag la mthun pa'i nus pa med/ /de phyir khyed ni bzod par gsol/ /de dag gang dag brtul zhugs can/ /dge slong dge bsnyen dge bsnyen ma/ /mchog tu gus pas mchod byas la/ /ji ltar 'os pa'i yon yang dbul / /rab tu byung ba'i gnas brtan dang / /khyim pa'i gtso bo la sogs la/ /gnyer gtad 5bka' bsgo 'di skad brjod/ /snyigs ma lnga yi dus 'di yi/ /mchog gi sku dang mnyam pa yi/ /sprul pa'i sku ni 'di yin gyis/ /khyod kyis ma nyams srung mchod kyis/ /sngags kyi bza' bca' yon bdag la/ /skabs 'dir sbyin te 'di skad brjod/ /sngags kyi 6gtsang sbra'i bza' bca' dag /gzugs brnyan bdag po khyod la sbyin/ /bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ /zos na sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ /gal te lhag nyid dge 'dod na/ /bla ma gus pas dge bya zhing / /de ltar rnam pa thams cad du/ /bla ma yang dag mnyes byas te/ /yon gyi dam pa dbul ba ni/ /rta dang glang po shing rta nor/ /longs spyod yo byad dbul 'di brjod/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes pa yis las dang dngos grub thams cad 'thob/ /de bas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /de nas mtshan mo gtang rag ste/ /gnyen dang rigs rgyud 'khor rnams kyi7/ /bzang ba'i glu gar rol mo ste/ /dung la 27—927

—sogs pa'i rol mo dbul/ /lho phyogs rgyas pa'i thab byas la/ /'o ma can gyi bud shing brtsig /'bru dang mngar gsum mar 'o mas/ /dang po mjug tu re/ lha mchod/ /bar du dkyil 'khor rab gnas lha/ /stong ngam lnga brgya sogs/ sngags 'dis/ /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ sdog zhi tshe dpal rgyas nga/ra 'phel / /gtang rag lhag chad bskang ba yi/ /mchod bstod bzod gso'/ skabs sbyar bya/ /rten gsar ye shes mi gshegs te/ /tsā ru'i ston mo rgyas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor lha gshegs dam tshig bsdu⑫/ /rdul tshon a kār sngags bsnyus te/ /chu sogs dor la ba'i lngas byug /de nas 'gro rnams dad bya'i phyir/ /shing rta khri sogs mtho bar bteg /mchod pa rol mo dang bcas/ pas / /grong khyer rnams su bskor bar bya/ /spros mi dga' la bsdus pa ni/ /bsnyen pas cho ga sta gon dang / /dkyil 'khor bri sgrub rten gsar la/ /bgegs bskrad yi ge brgyas brtan par/ /gong bzhin byin dbye la sogs pa/ /nub gcig la ni kun rdzogs bya/ /mnga' gsol rgyas par ma grub kyang / /'di la nyes par mi 'gyur ro/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i rab gnas ni/ /brtan pa thob pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /gza' skar tshes grangs mi brtsi ste/ /rdul tshon mi brten 2 thun gcig la/ /dkyil 'khor bsgoms te brgya rtsa bsnyen/ /bgegs bskrad bkru sogs gong ltar bya/ /bskyed de spyan drangs —sgu gsung thugs / /byin gyis brlab 4dang dbang bskur ba/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od kyis ni/ /'og min rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas/ /bkra shis lha mo bum 5rol bcas / /dbang bsgur rigs bdag 6rgyas btab bsam/ /rten 'byel snying po brgya rtsa res/ /dri dang me tog gtor byugs te/ /rang rang lha la chos skrar 27—928

——thim / /bsams la rdo rjes hūṃmachod bstod bya/ /rjes sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ /lha khang rab gnas 'dir ma bshad/ /da ni phyag mtshan byin dbab ste / /swa bhā'i sngags kyis stong ngang las/ /dkar rigs lha khang mchod rten gnas / /khang khyim hūṃ ñtshalas 'khor rnam snang / /gsung rigs dmar dang po ti codace/ /gaṇ+ḍi 17cha lang dril bu sogs/ /j-i 6las pad+ma snang mtha' yas/ /nag sngo rdo rje 7phur phreng 8thugs/ /hūṃ las rdo rje 9mi bskyod bskyedarka/ /ser po bang mdzod yon tan rigs/ /e las rin chen rin 'byung bskyed/ /las rigs ljang gu rgya gram gri/ /khaṃ las ral gris don yod grub/ /chos skyong rnams la'ang hūṃrang rang gis/ /'jig rten 'bag la rigs gsum gyis/ /rigs kyi 'bag la rang rang lhas/ /ngo mi shes kun de 'drar re'am/ /rigs bstun gong gis shes par bya/ /srog nyurnyachags gtso bo'i sprul sgus bya/ /sang 1/'khor kun dga' ra bkad sa/ /gzhal yas khang ngam a mo li chu mig khron sogs mā ma tī/ /bza' shing ra dang ldum ra sogs/ /shing gi lha mo khrod 'chang mas/ /phyugs lhas par+ṇa sha ba ri/ /'bru dang bang mdzod dzam+bha la/ /yon bdag dkyil 'khor mthong na lha/ /ma mthong ni sani sprul skus bya/ /bla ma'i sku 'bag thugs dam ste/ /mi shes rang gi yi dam las/ /sngags la ma zhugs sprul pa'i sku/ /kun la dgug gzhug gong bzhin bya/ /phrin las rgyas pa'i cho ga ste/ /rab gnas rim gsum 'khor bcas 'di/ /bdag gis rang bzor ma byas te7/ /gtso cher klu sgrub lugs gtsor bzhag /rdo rje 'chang nas gnyis brgyud pa'i/ /lung dang 'dra sneba'i nā 7ro dang / /byang chub sems las thob pa yi/ /sgeg pa rdo rje skal ldan mchog /de gsum snyan nas 27—929

snyan brgyud pa'i/ /man ngag bla ma mnyes pas thob/ /rgyud dang bstan bcos/ legs brten nas/ /rang nyid dran pa gso ba dang / /gzhan yang bdag 'dra gti mug la/ /phan phyir gzhan gyis bskul nas bris ༄1/ /ma rtogs nongs pa bzod 5par gsol/ /brtsams pa'i dge ba cung 5zad des/ /sems can bde chen sku thob shog /sku dang gsung dang thugs rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra dang / lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng ges bi kra ma shī lar bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //brdzur mchan/918 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉bo dang gsung dang thubanu rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasungs/919 ༄1 〈〈snar 〉thatsam/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazangs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/ 5〈〈nge 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thastan/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgud/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/92༷ 3〈〈snar 〉marakhur/ rte〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ 7 — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ (pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaraphrin/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ sa〈〈co 〉7/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉'am 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/921 1〈〈pe 〉〉la/ 〈〈co 〉〉pa dang / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra stan/ 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagazhag 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar〉'a/3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/922 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ca/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdzangs 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉noba'i—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cang / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sten/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉)bsgrub / she 〈〈pe 〉thasrungs pa'i/ 〈〈snar 〉ra sung ba'i/923 1〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉regs/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srung / da〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagayog 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈smar 〉〉ta—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snganang / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snganang / 8〈〈pe 〉〉27—930

༄༅/ /gdugs la sogs pa rab tu gnas pa dang rnying pa 'byin pa'i cho ga1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ts+tsha tā di pra tijo dzīzlodhā ra bi byeḥ/ bod skad du / gdugs la sogs pa rab tu gnas pa dang rnying pa 'byin pa'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gser las grub pa la sogs nga/'i gdugs a yig las skyes pa'i yu ba a ba dhū tī'i rang bzhin can/ haṃ yig las skyes pa rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis nges par bcings pa'i rtsibs sum cu rtsa sanyis pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi chos kyi dbyengs mtshon par byed cing / nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung thams cad 'phrog par byed nga/'i dam tshig sems dpa' rnam par bsams nas/ de dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug ste der gzhug par bya zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te yang dag par mchod nas/ oṃ na maḥsarba budha bo bye satā ṭ+wāṃ āḥts+tsha tā ba li swā hā/ 'dis lan brgya rtsa brgyad bsngags 27—933

——par bya ste gdugs rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du oṃ yig las skyes pa ches bzang po'i gser gyis spras pa'i yu/ ba can bkra shis pa'i rang bzhin ston ka'i thuzla ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba'i rnga yab rnam par bsams nas/ de dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rang gi snyi nga ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug ste dam tshig sems dpa' la gzhug par bya zhing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te mchod pa byas nas/ oṃ tsu ru tsā ma ri swa hā / zhes pa'i sngags kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad du lhag par gnas par bya ste rnga yab rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du sau yig las skyes pa'i seng ge dang / a yig las skyes nga/'i gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / shaṃ yig las skyes pa'i rin po che'i bum pa dang / e/ yig las skyes pa'i nya dang rma bya dang ri dwags dang chu srin la sogs pa dang / yam̐ yig las skyes pa'i mkha' lding dang / paṃ yig las skyes pa'i pad+ma dang / a yig las skyes pa'i me long dang / saṃ yig las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje dang /khyu mchog dang / hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje dang / tram̐ yig las skyes pa'i rin po che dang / haṃ yig las skyes pa'i ngang pa la sogs pas mtshan par gyur pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' rnam par bsams nas de dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes/ sems dpa' rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug ste dam tshig sems dpa' la gzhug par bya zhing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te yang dag par mchod nas/ oṃ s+dzabadz+ra dh+wa dza ba ti dza yot+ta ri swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis lan brgya rtsa brgyad du lhag par gnas par bya ste rgyal mtshan rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du paṃ yig las skyes pa 'od gsal zhing rab tu gdung ba skyed par 27—934

byed pa'i dam tshig sems dpa'i gzugs rnam par bsams nas/ de dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug ste dam tshig sems dpa' la gzhug par bya zhing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te yang dag par mchod nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ke tu badz+ra pa tā ke bye tiṣ+ṭha paṃ swā hā/ zhes pa 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas par bya ste ba dan rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor pa'i lha dang gnas kyi bdag po dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang sa'i bdag po dang glags lta ba'i skye bo dang bzo bo dang slob dpon dang chos smra ba la sogs pa rnams la bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin mchod pa byas nas snga ra bshad pa'i cho gas gtor ma chen bo sbyin par bya'o/ /grong dang grong khyer dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gang du mchod rten dang / sgu gzugs dang /rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rnying pa dang gas pa dang tshig pa dang zhig pa la sogs nga ra lha rnams gnas par gyur na gnas der sems can rnams la nor nyams pa dang 'thab rtsod dang mu ge dang skye bo rnams zad par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i skyon rnams 'byung bas rnying pa 'byin pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de la slob dpon ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas chu dang me tog dang bdug pa dang mar mre dang zhal zas la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/ 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan che ge rdo rje mchog /rig sngags rgyal po khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sems can rnams la phan phyir dang / /khyed rnams la yang ma/chod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po rnying pa 'byin pa yi/ /cho ga bzang po bya bar 27—935

'dod / /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi/ /bum pa 'dir ni gzhug par gsol / /zhes so/ /de nas yud tsam de la nges par brtags te de'i thugs/ kar de'i sa bon bltas te lag pa g.yon pas bgrang phreng bzung nas/ de la bcings pa'i srad bu lnga dang rdo rje dang bcas pa lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/rang rang gi sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad du yongs su bzla zhing hoḥyig gnyis dang spel ba'i sa bon rnam par gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas sngar bshad pa'i cho gas/ sbyin sreg byas nas thag pa rnams kyis bcings te khyu mchog gi 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa rnams kyis bskyod par bya'o/ /de nas bum pa des phyogs dben par bzhag ste me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /mchod rten la sogs pa rdo'i rang bzhin gang yin pa dang / grum pa dang zhig nga/ de ni chu mang po yod pa'i chu klung du gzhug par bya'o/ /sa'i rang bzhin kyi mchod rten la sogs pa gang dang gang 'du bya bar mi bzod pa rnams ni de nyid du gzhug par bya'o/ /gang dang gang shing las byas pa'i rnying pa dang zhig pa de dang de 1ni mar gyis bsgos te ras kyis dkris nas sbyin sreg gi mes bsreg par bya'o/ /gang zhig zangs la sogs pa las byas pa de ni bzhu nas sngar gye tshad las mi dman par bya'o/ /mchod rten la sogs pa de dag /2grub nas mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas sngar bum par bzhag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi ye shes sems dpa' phyung nas mchod rten la sogs pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' la gzhug par bya zhing de la bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rang rang gi sngags kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad du byen gyis brlabs te/ sngar bshad pa'i rim pas me'i mchod pa dang rab tu gnas 27—936

༄/ /sa dang shing dang rdo'i cho ga bzhugs/sna༄go/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ /sa gzhi mchod pa mchog bsgrubs te/ /lha las ldang bar byas/ nas ni/ /de nas sa gzhi sbyar bar bya/ /de la slob dpon gyis rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor byas te mtshan mo'i dus su gzhon nu ma gcig gdong shar du phyogs pa la mchod pa byas te bstod nas/ kye bcom ldan 'das ma dge ba dang mi dge ba sgos shig ces brjod de/ a/ ka /pa/ ta/ tsa/ sa/ ha/ba / dza rnams tshig gi thog mar byung ba'i de'i brjod pa ma 'khrul par rjes su dpag par bya'o/ /de mig dgu pa'i sa rnams la der gal te byang du a yig thog mar gyur pa de'i tshe nges par shar gyi phyogs su rkang pas lhag pa'i khru gang 6 'og na srog chags gnyis kyi zug rngu'o/ /de ma phyung na rigs rgyud dang rang gi chung ma 'chi ba dang me'i 'jigs pa'i skyon 'byung ngo / /ka dang por brjod na 27—938

byang du me'i zug rngu ste rgyal rigs kyi rus pa rkang pa gnyis kyis lhag pa'i khru gang gi 'og na yod do/ /de gal te ma phyung na de'i tshe nad sna tshogs dang / ske'i 'jigs pa dang don nyams pa rgyal pos gzir ba rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /pa dang por brjod na byang dang lho'i phyogs su rkang pas dman pa'i khru gnyis kyi 'og na rje'u rigs kyi rus pa'i dum bu'o/ /de ma phyung na phyi dang nang du tsha sadung dang don nyams par 'gyur ro/ /ta dang po dang phyi mar brjod na srin po'i phyogs na dmangs rigs kyi rus pa'i dum bu mtho gnyis kyi 'og na'o/ /de gal te ma phyung na de'i tshe nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba dang me'i 'jigs pa dang byem gyi bdag po 'chi'o/ /tsa dang por brjod na chu'i phyogs su bram ze'i rus pa'i zug rngu rkang pas lhag pa'i khru gnyis kyi 'og na'o/ /de ma phyung na khyem mes 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /sa dang po dang phyi mar yod na rlung gi phyogs su sa'i bdag po'i rgyud kyi rus pa'i zug rngu 'byung ste phyed dang bcas pa'i mtho gnyis kyi khrog nas so/ /de ma phyung na mdza' ba yun thung ba nyid dang mya ngan du 'gyur ro//ha dang por brjod na byang gi phyogs su rkang pa gsum gyis lhag pa'i khru gnyis kyi 'og na rje'u rigs kyi skye bo'i rus pa'i zug rngu ste 'dis ni skyes pa dang bud med rnams tshe thung ba nyid du 'gyur ro/ /ba yig dang po dang phyi mar yod na dbang ldan du mtho gsum na dmangs rigs kyi rus pa'o/ /yang na byi la'i rus pa dang ñtsa gas dang sol ba yod do/ /de ma phyung bar bzhag na rgyud kyi nor nyams par 'gyur ro/ /dza dang po dang phyi mar brjod na de'i dbus na bram ze'i rus pa'i zug rngu ste de ma phyung na rgyal po'i chad pas gzir ba dang nor zad pa'i skyon 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir thams cad du nyes pa du ma 'byung ba'i phyir 27—939

zug rngu rnams dbyung bar bya'o/ /de nas gzhon nu ma mchod de mdun du yungs/ kar dkar po dang nim pa'i lo ma la sogs pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis g.yas su/ bskor zhing g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis g.yon du bskor nas me la lan gsum du dor bar bya'o/ /sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ sarba pā pa da ha na badz+ra sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā/ de nas arka'i ras bal gyis mar me'i sdong bu byas te/ til nas po'i snum gyis mar me sbar te zug rngu brtag par bya'o/ /de la phyogs gang du mar me'i rtse mo rgyug pa der nges par zug rngu yod do zhes rtogs par bya'o/ /gang du mar me rdul gyis bskor ba der zug rngur 'gyur ro/ /de nas gtor ma dang mchod pa la sogs pa byas nas me tog dang bcas pa'i 'bras yos sa la gtor bar bya'o// //shing gi las zhes gsungs pa de brjod par bya'o/ /nags kyi 'khrul 'khor de 'dren pa/ /mkhas pas yang dag blangs nas ni/ /shing gi mgo bor legs bzhag ste/ /bdud rtsi'i me la sbyin sreg bya/ /de la tshes dang gza' dang rgyu skar bzang po la mchod rten bzhengs pa dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i mchod sdong dang / sgo dang / ka ba la sogs pa shing gi rtse mo'i mthar thug pa rnams kyi chu dang zheng dag phya mkhan dang thig skud 'dzin pa la sogs nga/ rnams kyis yang dag par brtags te/ shing bzo ba'i 'khor rnams tshogs nga/ dang mchod spyin byed pa'i slob dpon dag dang lhan cig nags su 'khrul 'khor gyis 'gro bar bya'o/ /nags tshal dang nye bar slebs pa'i dus su bdag nyid las thams cad pa'i gzugs su brtags shing bsams te/ rkang pa g.yas 27—940

mdun du byas nas shar dang byang gi phyogs su gdong phyogs pa'i slob dpon nags tshal gyi phyogs su rab tu zhugs te/ lo nyis brgya ma lon pa'i shing rnams ni nye bar mi blang ngo / /de la shing rnams ni dri ke sha ra dang / mā lū ra dang /tit+ta sā ra dang / lha'i shing dang / sing lding dang / gas+thā ri dang / sbrang rtsi can dang / mya ngan med dang / ba ku la dang / rnam par rgyal byed dang /sa/'i tsan+dan dang / tsadza ka dang / tsan+dan dang / kibyu ka dang / pa lā sha dang / pistso la dang / tsa la da la dang / sha ra sā la dang / tā la dang /gradh+ri la dang / ardzu na dang / dzam+bu dang / bhaṇ+ḍi la dang / ro hi be+e la sogs pa shing bzang po du ma gang dang gang du skyes pa'i shing de dag legs par brtags te mtshan mo'i dus su las thams cad pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i slob dpon spro ba dang ldan pas shing bzo ba grogs dang bcas pa legs par bsrung ba byas te/ nyer spyod lngas bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang phyogs kyi bdag po dang / nags kyi shing gi lha la sogs pa rnams yang dag par mchod de/ phyogs kyi gtor ma yang byin nas shing bzo ba grogs dang bcas pa bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / zas dang / skom dang /tāsbru la la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par mgu bar byas nas/ 'dod pa'i lhal bcom ldan che ge zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas thugs mnyes te/ shing bzo ba grogs dang bcas pa dang lhan cig 'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang zhi ba'i yid kyis nyal bar bya'o/ /de la rmi lam bzang po nges par mthong na legs par grub par 'gyur ro/ /rmi lam nganapa thams cad zhi ba'i sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas snga bar mchod pa thams 27—911

cad dang yang dag par ldan pa'i slob dpon rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas der gnas pa'i shing gi lha mo'i gzugs kyi shing gi rgyal ngo/ yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /de la shing gi lha mo de rnams dang zhing skyong nge rnams kyang 'di yin te/ lha'i shing dang / dī ke sha ra dang / tsadza ka dang /mya ngan med pa'i shing rnams la shing gi lha mo gsang ba ma'o/ /zhing skyong stobs/ po che'o/ /ne+e m+bi dang / shā la dang / sha snar la'i shing rnams kyi ni 'jig rten gyi ma'o/ /zhing skyong ri bo chen po'o/ /a ru ra'i shing dang / ba ṭa dang /ra shing rnams kyi ni rna ba nyed ma'o/ /zhing skyong shin tu stobs so/ /tsu ta'i shing la ni am+bi kā'o/ /zhing skyong stobs can no/ /ta la'i shing la bde byed ma'o / /zhing skyong skra gyen brdzes so/ /kan+da pa'i shing la bzhin bzang ma'o/ /zhing skyong dril bu chen po'o/ /ka rañdza la ni ka rañdzar gnas ma'o/ /zhing skyong gtum pa'i dril bu'o/ /sbrang rtsi'i shing la dbang bskur ma'o/ /zhing skyong skyes/ pa'i dbang phyug go/ /gser shing la gtum mo'o/ /zhing skyong su dza ne+e tā'o/ /shri go ra'i shing la dpal chen mo'o/ /zhing skyong me'i kha'o/ /de nas las dang rjes su mthun par shing gi lha mo rnams dang zhing skyong rnams kyi yang rnam pa bsgoms nas rang rang gi sngags kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de la/ oṃ na maḥswā hā/zhing skyong gi'o/ /oṃ e gu khya kā yi na maḥswā hā/ de bzhin du oṃ me ma hā me ra we na maḥswā hā/ oṃ māṃ lo ka mā tri kā yi na maḥswā hā/ oṃ aḥ.a ti ba lā ya na ma/ཿswā hā/ oṃ k+shi kaṇ+ḍi mo ṭi kā yi na maḥswā hā/ oṃ baḥb lā ya na maḥswā hā/ oṃsaṃ/ saṃ bi kā yi na maḥswā hā/ oṃ khru sprusgo ke shā ya na maḥswā hā/ oṃ shaṃ shaṃ ka ri kā ye na maḥswā hā/ oṃ hūṃ ma hā ghaṇ+ḍa ya na maḥswā hā/ oṃ sum̐ su mu khā yi na maḥ2swāhā/27—912

oṃ/ rtsa tsaṇ+ḍa ghaṇ+ḍa ya na maḥswā hā/ oṃ shaṃ ka re dza bā si bye na maḥswā hā/ oṃ sum̐ 1sum̐ se shwa rā ya na maḥswā hā/ oṃ shaṃ she kā yi na maḥswā hā/ oṃ sum̐ su dza de te na maḥswā hā / oṃ rtsa tsaṇ+ḍa bye na maḥswā hā/ oṃ baṃ bsgo mu khā ya na maḥswā hā/ oṃ dze+e ma hā la khye na maḥswā hā/ gtsug lag khang gi rgyu yi phyir/ /bdag ni ljon shing gcad nga/ra 'dod/ /da ni khyed rnams shing gzhan la/ /gnas te bdag la bzod nga/ra mdzod/ /ces bya ba'i tshigs bcad lan gsum du brjod de/ shing la gnas pa'i lha la gsol te/ de nas me tog la sogs pas legs par mchod de/shing gzhan la gnas par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas bsrung ba'i ched du rma bya chen mo bklag par bya'o/ /de nas las thams cad pa'i gzugs can gyi shing bzo ba gser dang ras dang tāsbya la la sogs pa rnams kyis yongs su mgu bar byas te/ dgra sta sbrang rtsis byugs te dge ba'i sems kyis shing bzo ba lag pa g.yas pa gyen du phyogs pa dang / kha byang shar du bltas te nyi ma la bltas nas shing gcad 2par bya'o/ /der yang dge ba dang mi dge ba'i mtshan ma blta bar bya ste mi dge ba'i mtshan ma byung na spang bar bya zhing / dge ba'i mtshan ma byung na gzung bar bya'o/ /gal te shing byang phyogs su lhang bar gyur na de'i tshe mchod spyin byed pa la nor dang las kyi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su lhung na rig pa dang ye shes kun du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te dbang po'i phyogs su shing lhang na de'i tshe dpal dang 'byor pa dang rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /gal te shing gzhan rnam par nyed pa'i bar du lhung bar gyur pa de'i tshe dge ba dang bde ba nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te shing gzhan ma bcom par lhung na mchod sbyin byed pa la 'jigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /me dang bden bral dang gshin 27—97/3
