rje dang chu dang rlung gi phyogs rnams su lhang na grangs bzhin du me'i 'jigs nga/ dang nad dang 'chi ba dang chu dang rlung gi 'jigs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bskyod pa na sgra mi gsal ba ring du grag cing lhang na mchod sbyin byed pa po la sdus bsngal gyi mtshan mar 'gyur ro/ /gcod pa'i dus su gal te rnga mo dang rta dang ce spyang dang bong bu dang sbrul dang phag dang bya rog la sogs pa gdug pa'i 'dab chags mthong bar gyur na de'i tshe nges par gsad pa dang bcing ba dang bgegs/ du ma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te shing las khrag 'dzag na de'i tshe mchod sbyin byed pa 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsi dang 'o ma 'dzag na gsad pa dang bcing ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang shing rnams la rang bzhin pa'i mngar ba dang tsha ba dang kha ba dang bska ba'i bcud 'byung ba de la ni nyes pa med do/ /sbal pa le brgan gyi mdog can byung na des ni nad 'byung ba rjes su dpag par bya'o/ /de bzhin du shing gi khong nas byi ba mdog ser skya byung na des chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang swā sha'i nad 'byung bar rjes su dpag par bya'o/ /shing gi bar nas rtsangs pa mdog ser ngo/ byung na des ni nor nyams par rjes su dpag par bya'o/ /de'i khong nas khyem gyi rtsangs pa phug ron 1kyi mdog can byung na des mchod sbyin byed pa dbul por 'gyur bar rjes su dpag par bya'o/ /kha dog dmar po'i na kū sdeka lā sha byung na des ni nad 'byung bar rjes su dpag par bya'o/ /khong nas sbrul sngo bsangs/ byung na des kyang nor zad pa nyid do/ /kha tū'i mdog can gye chu byung na des ni chu'i 'jigs pa nyid rjes su dpag par bya'o/ /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / g.yung drung dang / dpal be'u dang / bum pa dang / rnga 27—941

——yab dang / 'khor lo dang / pad+ma dang / dga' ba 'khyel pa dang / sdong ris dang ku sha rnams rgo mtshan ma bzang po ste de lta bu la sogs pa dge ba dang mi dge ba'i mtshan ma rnams yongs su shes par byas nas shing gcad par bya'o/ /nge nas shing de dag yang dag par rnam par phye nas rtsa ba dang sked pa dang rtse mo'i mtshams rnams phye ste cha gcig gis lhag pa'i cha bcu'i tshad du bya ste/ shing rnams ji lta bar nags kyi 'khrul 'khor yang de bzhin te mchod rten dang bilba la so/gas pa'i phyir du nags kyi 'khrul 'khor de rnams kyis drang bar bya'o// //rdo ba yang shis pa rnams gzung bar bya zhing mi shis pa rnams spang bar bya'o//de la ri'i ljongs dang ngam grog dang chu 'gram la sogs par gnas pa'i rdo ba mkhregs 1pa dang sra ba dang dri zhim pa dang shin tu reg na mnyen pa dang dri nga ba mred cing 'jam pa dang snum pas ni tshe dang ldan no/ /'di la shis pa gnyis te dkar po dang ser po dang dmar bo dang ljang gu dag dang / rdo ba nag po la gal te ri mo dkar po phra mo dang thig le dang ldan pa de'i tshe blon dang ldan pa dang /bza' mi'i rgyud dang rigs dang rgyal srid dang nor dang 'bangs rnams la shis so/ /steng dang byang dang dbang ldan dang shar gyi phyogs su gdong phyogs pas ni grangs bzhin du mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub dang skye bo dang nor dang rigs rgyud 'phel lo//thar pa dang mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub sbyin pa'i rdo ba rnams gzung bar bya'o/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i gzong gis bsnun pa na bye ma dang bcas pa dang /rtsub pa dang bral ba dang gog sgra can gyi rdo ba rgan po 'di dag yongs su spang ngo / /deltar shis pa dang mi shis pa'i rdo ba rnams shes par byas nas shis pa'i rdo ba 27—9/3

rnams ba yi rnam lngas byugs te dri bzang po'i chus khrus byas nas dri la sogs nga/ rnams kyis rgyas pa'i sems kyis mngon par mchod de shing gi skabs su bshad pa'i las rnams thams cad 'dir yang bya'o/ /de nas grong khyer du 'jug pa'i dus su shing rnams dang / rdo ba rnams rgyal po'i skyes bu rnams kyis rgyas pa'i sems kyis drang bar bya zhing snga ma bzhin du mar me dang sil snyan sna tshogs kyi sgra dang ca co dang bcas te shin tu gus pa dang bcas pas zhugs te/ rgya che zhing mnyam pa'i sar bkod de pad+ma'i dbus su gzhag par bya'o/ /gtsug lag khang sogs bzhengs pa la nye bar mkho ba'i sa brtag pa dang shing dang rdo ba'i cho ga 'di sngags kyi gzhung lugs che ba zhig gis dum bur mngon no/ /'di'i rgya dpe gnyal gyi phyogs nas rnyed de lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bus zhabs rten gyi pad+ma la phyag byas pa'i 'dren nga/ dam pa chos kyi rje rin po che zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa'i zhal snga nas bsgyur cig ces gsung ba bzhin du zha lu lo tsā bas dpal sne'u gdong rtser bsgyur ba'o / / //27—9/6

༄/ /dbyig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba cho ga'i bya ba ba༅ pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ hi ra bye mā lā 2nā ma da sha kṛ yā bi byeḥ/ bod skad du/ dbyig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba cho ga'i bya ba bcu pa/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dpal ldan sa bcu'i pha rol dri med ye shes don gyi bya ba dbang byed cing / /de kho na nyid rnam pa'i gzungs mchog yon tan tshogs kyi rim pas byang chub yang dag thob/ /rnam pa kun gye mchog ni rab spyin dam pa'i mtshan nyid bzhi yis brgyan par gyur pa yi/ /ma lus chos dang nor dang thar dang dpal gyi ched du rdo rje 'dzin pas khyed la srungs//rtsod pa'i dus kyi skye bo 'di dag phal cher tshe thung sred pa'i sems ldan rnam dpyod dang / /'byor bral dad dang bzod pa shes rab bsod nams stobs dang bral phyir brtse ba bya bar 'os/ /de dag dus kun rgyu dang 'bras bu mang po nyid kyis bya ba gzhan la rab 'jug pas/ /thams cad mkhyen pas ras ris la sogs 27—9 /8

—kazugs brnyan bya ba'i thabs ni rnam bcu rab gsungs nyid/ /bya ba'i cho ga bcu yis dman pa'i rab gnas ni/ /ku sha'i 'bras bu bzhin du grub pa'i bdag mi 'gyur/ /de phyir kun las drangs te mdo ru bsnyus pa ni/ /bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu ru rnam par bri bar bya/ /de la dang por skye gnas sbyang / /de nas mtshams mtha' nye bar sbyar/ /skye dang ming dang nye bar dri/ /gtsug phud bya ba nyid dang yang / /brtul zhugs brtan dang kun tu spyod/ /lag pa 'dzin dang me yi las/ /de ltar mdor bstan cho ga bcu/ /rgyas par bshad pa'ang 'di lta ste/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dmangs rigs skye dgu yi/ /bu mo dkar dang ser dang dmar nag mdangs ldan ma/ /de dag rnams kyis tshul bzhin bkal ba'i srad bu bzang / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon par spyod rnams la'o/ /yus+thā sibye hasta srurlot+tha nu/lto saṃ grwaṅgā dhī ra mu l+ya kra yā ṅgā/ ā ralto bā put+pa ba t+yā ra dzo bye ran+taḥ/ sha yā 'a/bye sat+padru ṭā di/ 'jug ngogs chu dang 'o ma dri chab sogs ldan pa'i/ /chag chag gis ni bsam gtan khang pa legs sbyang zhing / /lha yi brtul zhugs bya bar 'dod pas de tshe brgyad pa la/ /bas mtha'i gnas mal thal ba chang dang chu yis kyang / /slob dpon dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpar bsgom byas te/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dang ni rgan rabs mchod par bya/ /bya ba kun la 'jig rten stong sogs lha rnams ni/ /dang por gtor ma la sogs sbyin pas kun tshim bya/ /bza' dang btung ba mchog dang gar dang gru rnams dang / /thog mar yon la sogs pa byin pas mgu ba yi/ /bzo bo las kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin nyid bsams 27—9/9

te / /lag par rdo rje chu skyes nyi zlas mtshan pa dag /byin nas myur du lanu/ 'grub bya phyir rab tu 'bad/ /lus ni dag cing skam la rung zhing brtan pa yi/ /gos la sogs pa'ang stong dang snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ /de ltar rang bzhin rnged pa'i ngo bor yang dag bsam/ /sna tshogs rin chen dri dang me tog chur bsres pa'i/ /mchod yon byen nas bkra shis bstod pa'i sgra dang bcas/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga yi srad bus ji lta bzhin/ /'khor lo'i tshul bzhin thig gdab nga/ ni bsgrub par bya/ /ras ris kyi'o/ /glegs bam chos kyi mdzod ni gro ga sogs la'ang rung / /shes rab ye shes rnam pa dhīḥskyes bdud rtsi dang / /smyu gu hūṃ las rdo rje'i rtse mo rnam dag pas/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i bdag nyid yi ge'i phreng spro byed/ /glegs bam gyi'o/ /sa shing lcags kyi khams dang rdo ba si 1tho la/ /shes rab dag pa'i zla ba nya 'dra snying gar te/ /gang gang lha yi snying po'i sngags de sngags pa yis/ /khams la de ni lan brgyad dag tu bzlas par bya/ /mchod rten dang sku gzugs la sogs pa'i'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gang / /'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rang bzhin med/ /'gro ba 'di yi rang bzhin med/ /dngos po dag par byed pa'o/ /mkha' khyab sdogs sangs rgyas kun dang / /byang chub sems dpa' kun 'gro rnams / /'dir ni sangs rgyas gnas mdzad la/ /yang dag nye bar mdzad par 'os/ /nye bar byed pa'o zhes pa dang po skye gnas sbyang ba'i bya ba'o// //de nas bar snang zla ba nya ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /shin tu dmar ba'isnyo yig rnam par spel zhing 'bar/ /sku gsum sa bon dang mnyam sa bon bzangapo 27—950

can—/ /dkyil 'khor pa ni bdag por bcas pas rnam par gzigs/ /ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /dga' ldan du ni bzhugs pa las/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje slob dpon che/ /lhar ni bdag gis brtag par bgyi/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /sa bon gyur pa'i ye shes che/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad par 'os/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas be+er yang mchod de lha'i thugs ka'i chu skyes kyi nang gi zla ba gang ba la gnas pa'i rang gi sa bon kyi 'od zer rab tu 'phros pa'i lcags kyus dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ baṭ+wāṃ ku sha bī dza maṇ+ḍa la mā kaste ya dzaḥ/o badz+ra pā 1 sha bī dza maṇ+ḍa lo pra be+e sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa bī dza 2maṇ+ḍa lo ban+dha ya baṃ / oṃ badzā be sha bī dza maṇ+ḍa lo to ṣa ya hoḥ/ zhes pa ni dgug pa la sogs pa'i sngags so/ /bya ba kun la ting 'dzin gsum bsgoms nas/ /snying po mngon par bzla zhing 'di bsgrub bya/ /yi ge brgya pas bskangs shing brtan byas te / /phye dang gsang bar bcas pa'i mchod gtor sbyin/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra puste hūṃ/mre tog go/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ bdug pa'o/ /i āḥbadz+ra dī pe hūṃ/ mar me'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra gasgo hūṃ/ dri chab bo/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai bi bye hūṃ/ zhal zas so/ /o badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa tī no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ rnyo me bha ba / su tostso me bha wa/ su postso rnge bha ba/ a nu ralto me bha ba/ sadze+e sid+dhim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sat+tha karma su tsa me tsiṭ+wāṃ she yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga bān saza ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badzī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ/ zhes pa 27—9pya/

—yi ge brgya pa'i sngags so/ /dpung bzangs kyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad kyi gtor ma dang / rang gi brtag pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba la sbyin te/ 'dir ni mangs kyis dogs pas bdag gis ma bris so zhes pa gnyis pa mtshams kyi mtha' nye bar spyor ba'i bya ba'o// //mchod yon kyi snod mchog shel dang in+d+ra bhā la dang rdo rje ljang gu dang puṣ+perna ga rnams kyis gang ba'i gser dang nor bu dang zangs dang rdo ba 3la sogs pa dang dung chos 'bras yos dang me tog ku sum+bha'i 'bras bu dang til dang dri dang rnge tog dang 'o ma dang chu rnams kyis yongs su bkang ba'o/ /oṃ bispyon+ta ༄ kṛta hūṃ/bsang gtor gyi dung chos byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā dār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon gyi snod byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhabs bsil dang zhal gyi dung chos byin gyis brlab pa'o zhes pa mchod yon dang nye ba'i byed pa'o/ /dī raṣ+ṭa mā tram̐ ka ru kho pa mo da re dī mā tra lasboṣ+ṭha mu khaṃ sa mā ya tai/ta dbye mā nā ya ta muñtsa kan+dha re tri bhā ga bistu ra su rū pa kaṣ+ṭha ke/ kha gdugs dkar po ltar mdzes pa'i bum pa bsgrub par bya ste las thams cad pa la'o/ /ma tshos pa dang nag nog dang gas pa la sogs pa spangs pa/ legs par sbyangs shing dag pa'i lus can bdug pas legs par bdugs pas/ tri ne t+ya tsā m+bi ka ra tsi tra tsit+na tai/ 'jug ngogs bzang po'i chu gtsang mas bkang ba rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang gos dang gre tog gis brgyan te/ ku sha sar pa 'khyel par bcas pa'i gdan la gzhag go/ /a shwat+tha dang tsū ta dang ba ṭa dang brka ṭi 27—9shi2

—dang mchod sbyin shing ste de rnams kyi lcug ma lnga dang shing shun rnams so/ /ba byung rnams ni ba lang gi lci ba dang chu dang 'o ma dang zho dang mar rnams so/ /sau tī dang sā ha dang dṛ ha ti kā dang gi ri karje kā rnams dang / gro dang til dang sran ma dang nas rnams dang / mu tig dang byi ru dang mu men dang gser dang dngul te lnga dang / ga bur dang gur gum dang tsan+dan dang gla rtsi dang sih+la rnams dang / srad bu ser po dang ljang gu dang dmar po dang nag po rnams so/ /dbang ldan dang zla ba dang chu lha dang dbang po'i bu rnams kyi dkar po'o/ /tshangs pa dang dbang po dang sa dang nor sbyin rnams kyi mdog ser po'o/ /nyi ma dang sbyin sreg mkhan gyi dmar po'o/ /rlung lha dang lha min dag gi ljang gu dang nag po'o/ /lha min dgra dang gshin rje dag gi sna tshogs pa'o zhes pa bum pa la sogs pa'i yo byad do/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg las bshad pa'i cho gas bdud rnams sbyangs te/ bum pa dang rdul tshon gyis bris pa dang sku gzugs la sogs pa rnams la dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang mnyes pa rnams byas te lhag par gnas pa'i cho gas slar yang sngags pas mchod de ba byung dang dri bzangs zangs kyi snod du sbyar ba drur ba'i myu gu las byas pa'i pir gyis byugs te/ sgu gzugs gser las byas pa la sogs pa ni legs par bzhag nas dri bzangs dang til mar gyis sbyang ngo / /raṅgārka 1sbyar ba las byas pa'i sgod du legs par bzhag pa sat+paṇ+ḍi babe+e la bi le pa na maṅga yaṣ+ṭiḥ/ dri dang / sgyu ru ra dang /dri bzang po'i khyad par gyi phye ma bum pa'i cha'i nang du bcug pas dri ma bsal te/rin po che'i 'od can 'od kyis rnam par bkra ba'i me long gi ngos la glegs bam rnams kyi gzugs brnyan gyi gzugs la ste/ bkra shis brjod pa'i snyan pa'i glu 27—933

—'don zhing rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs pa rnams kyis rim gyis khrus byas te khrus kyi cho ga'o/ /lus rdzogs pa'i sku gzugs la sogs pa rnams ni byis pa skyes pa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin khrus la sogs pas lus yang dag par sbyangs te/ yan lag dgu sa bon rnams kyis yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ /dpal sku rdo rje la sogs pa'i ngo bo smin mtshams dang mgrin pa dang snying gar nyi ma'i gzugs dang / mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang skra mtshams dang lte ba'i bar du zla ba nya ba la yan lag dgu'i sa bon rnams ni 'di lta ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ k+ṣiṃ/ dz+re/ khaṃ/ gi/k+ṣe / saṃ/ mig g.yas su ma yig las byung ba'i nyi ma dang / mig g.yon du ṭa yig las byung ba'i zla ba legs par bsams te/ gser gyi thur ma dang mar me dang mig sman dang me long gi ngos dang rdo rje'i rtse mo rnams kyis so/ /mngar gsum gyis byugs pa'i thur mas/ /thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib bzhin/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling tog bdag gis bsal bar bkyi/ /oṃ tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥ sa man+ta tsagru bya rbi sho dha ne+e swā hā/mig sman gyis byugs pa'i thur mas/ oṃ di bya tsakyu ṣe hūṃ swā hā/ me long gi ngos kyis/ oṃ dharma tsak+ṣu ṣe hūṃ swā hā/ sgron mes/ oṃ pradzñā tsak+ṣu ṣe aḥswā hā/ rdo rje'i rtse mos/ oṃ bud+dhā tsak+ṣu ṣe hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa mig sbyin pa'i cho ga'o / /a shwat+tha'i 'dab mar bcug pa'i sbrang rtsi mar dang ka ra dang ldan pa 'di la myang du gzhug cing 'o ma'i rgyun sbyin zhing gos ser po'i stod g.yogs la sogs pa'o/ /oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma dhu pā sa ne+e 1hūṃ phaṭa niḥswā hā/ mngar gsum myang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sasba de ba tā byurja mṛ ta dhā re swā hā/ 'o ma myang ba'o/ /oṃ tshis mā dh+yaṅga dṛ shwe ka ba tsā bar ṇi hūṃ swā hā/ stod g.yogs kyi'o//27—9bye//

—oṃ āḥbadz+ra bā sa se hūṃ swā hā/ ras yug gur gum la sogs pas bkra bar brgyan pa'i 'o zhes pa gsum pa skye ba'i bya ba'o// //rang gi snying ga'i zla ba gang ba las ming gi phreng ba'i 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams phyung ste spros pa bdag nyid kyi lag pas bzung ba'i rdo rje'i rtse la bkod nas sku gzugs kyi spyi bor bzhag ste snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya'o zhes pa bzhi pa ming gi bya ba'o// //lha'i thugs kar sngags bkod cing bzhag nas sngags pas snying gar thal mo sbyar te rgyal ba'i tshogs la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /oṃ bde ba chen po chags pa che/ /'gro ba kun la sgrub mdzad pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun kyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de/ /dam tshig gi ni 'dod pa mchog /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs shog /chos kyi dbyings kyi byen rlabs dang / /dam tshig rjes su dran pas kyang / /thugs brtses sems can kun gyi don/ /thams cad grub par ma/dzad du gsol/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya hoḥ'es pa gsol ba'i sngags so/ /rnam bkra sku mnga' thub pa'i skyes mchog sras dang bcas rnams la/ /a mra chu shing 'bras mngar parka ṭi dang tin+ta lī/ /dā li tin+d+ra ka dang ha ru ṣa dang so dag byed/ /nā raṅga dang tā la mngar 'dzam bī dza snyu ra bzang / /a mra ta ka 'bras gsum tsher ldan rgun 'bru la sogs pa/ /chu dang skar ma nyi ma sa dang lo 'dab tshogs pa las/ /dus dang rjes mthun 'bras 27—9pyapya

—bu cho ga bzhin du nam bskyed pa'i/ /'bras bu mchog gi bza' bca' rnams kyang kun nas dbul bar bgyi/ /sngags kyang / oṃ āḥs mā bye pha le sarba mu ni pu tra dī ṇa ne+e saṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes pa 'bras bu gsol ba'i cho ga'o/ /don chen ba'ed pa de rnams mtha' dag ni sku khrus dang / /bsang gtor mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil la sogs mchod pa dang / /rgya nag gos la sogs pas yongs/ brgyan na bza' dbul bgyi zhing / /rdo ba dngul dang nor bu gser las byas pa'i snod sogs su/ /'bras chan bza' ba zho dang ka ra 'o ma'i thug pa dang / /tshod ma dam pa rab mchog rnam pa mang po dag dang bcas/ /gro yi phye mas tshu'/ bzhin sprul pa'i la du la sogs pa/ /cho ga bzhin du yongs su sbyangs pa'i zhal zas yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ o jo ba ladhe dzo ba lan+da de swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis 'di dag lan bdun mngon par bsngags te/ oṃ di byan+de sa mā bye dh+yā 1na py-i ṇa ne+e —swā hā zhes pa 'dis dbul bar bya'o zhes pa zha'/ zas gsol ba'i cho ga'o zhes pa lnga pa nye bar 'dren pa'i bya ba'o// //hūṃ zhes rdo rje can kyi gzugs su sprul par byas te sru gri'i so ni ches rno bas//skye ba la sogs sgrib pa gegs gyur 'khyog cing nag pa de rnams yang dag bzhar byas te/ /ye shes rnam pa'i rang bzhin dag tu bsgoms te spyi bor gtsug phud dbyibs ni bya ba yin/ /rna bar chos kyi gegs gyur sdig pa'i sgrib g.yogs yang dag zhugs la khab rtse sbyin par bya/ /sna tshogs rin chen rnam bkra gser gyi cod pan dang ni rna ba'i gong rgyan mchog tu 'bar/ /zha nye sogs byas rna rgyan dam pa rdo rjes brten pa dang ni tā la can dag dang / /mu tig do shal rnam 'phyang 27—936

mgul rgyan dang ni gdu bu dpung rgyan seng ge gdong dag dang / /'og pag dam pa bcings las spros pa'i dril chung g.yo ba'i sgra ldan dang ni zhabs gdub dbul/ /oṃ sar+pā ba ra ṇa ba man ts+tsha da ya dzñā na tsū lo kalpa ya hūṃ swā hā/ gtsug phud byed pa'o / /oṃ sarba dhan+d+ra bya dhi ka ra r+ṇa saṃ be+e dha ya hūṃ swā hā/ rna ba 'bugs pa'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /rigs lnga las byung cod pan te/ /khyed cag mchod pa'i don du'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mu ku ṭā bhe ṣe ka shri ye hūṃ swā hā/ cod pan no/ /oṃ bo dh+yaṅgā bha ra ṇa bi bhu kha ṇi hūṃ swā hā/ rgyan no/ /zhes pa drug pa gtsug phud byed pa'i bya ba'o// //rang gi snying ga'i zla ba'i gzugs la lha'i mtshan ma dam pa rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang ral gri la sogs pa'i gzugs 'phro bar bsams te 'jig rten gyi khams su spros pa slar nye bar son pa de'i lag tu tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis sbyin no/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes dam pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /dngos po med pa'i chos rnams la/ /mtshan ma bsgom par rab tu bsgrags/ /ye shes gang dang gang gis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nyer 'gro ba/ /sems can don sogs bya ba kun/ /khyod kyis sa steng rtag tu bya/ /zhes pa bdun pa brtul zhugs brtan pa'i bya ba'o// //slob dpon bya ba mtha' dag la ni shin tu mkhas pas dri yi dkyil 'khor dam pa dag /byas nas steng du spe tog rab tu bkram ste cho ga bzhin du mchod pa mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /rig pa la sogs kyang ni rgyu ste gzhan gyi sems ni 27—937

— gcig tsam gsal ba ma yin nyid/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba'i 'gro ba 'di kun rang gi sems las byung bar bsam par bya/ /slob dpon gyis smra'o/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /byang chub sems las byung bar mnyam/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /bse ru nyan thos skye bo rnams/ /rang bzhin rnged cing dmigs pa med/ /mnyam nyid ye shes de bzhin nyid/ /byang chub sems zhes bya bar brjod/ /de ltar lhag par mos par bya'o/ /zhes pa brgyad pa mnyam par 'jug pa'i bya ba'o// //rang gi snying gar chu skyes zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rang gi mtshan ma sa bon yi ge'i 'od kyis sprul/ /brtse ldan sgrub po blo ni rab tu 'phel ched du/ /sgu gzugs lus la rigs dang rjes mthun bu mo dag /lugs ma sogs la sku gzugs kyi ni g.yon ngos su/ /legs sbyangs nor bu bzhin du rnam par bsams te spro/ /bag ma'i tshul ni rnam pa brgyad dang ldan zhing mdzes/ /gsang sngags rig pas lag pa 'dzin pa bsgrub par bya/ /rigs lnga'i cha shas kyi lus mdzes pa la spyi bo dang snying ga dang lte ba dang gsang ba dang byen pa'i mthar thug par oṃ hūṃ swā āḥhā zhes pa'i sngags kyis de'i lus la spyi bor zla ba la/ hūṃ dzā ta shar da lam+bu dza māḥkā ra pi kā ra karje ka pha lan+tañtsa/ las dang chos dang dam tshig dang phyag rgya chen po rnams kyis lus mngon par sbyangs te/ yang dka par mchod cing brtan par byas nas gos dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang rgyan chen po dang bcas pa dpal chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi lha mo sku gzugs dang gcig nyid du bya'o/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes snang gsa'/ 27—9pya8

'od byed ma/ /lag pas lag pa bzung nas su/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rab tu sgyur/ /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /oṃ hūṃ s+thā badzā bha ba dṛ zwa tiṣ+ṭha rgyu khaṃ hūṃ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ye dhas+thā he tu pra bha bā te tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga to khya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ/ de ltar rab tu gnas pa byas nas/ nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa nyid du rjes song rab gnas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs dang chos kyi glegs bam rdo rje dril bu rnams/ /de ltar dam pa'i don du min mod 'on kyang 'jig rten du/ /'jig rten phan pa bzhed pa'i mgon pos rab tu gnas pa'ang mdzad/ /gang 'di sku gzugs rab gnas pa/ /sa dang chu dang rnge rlung las/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya ru yang / /lha rnams kun gyis srung du gsol//zhes pa brtan par byed pa'o zhes pa dgu pa lag pa 'dzin pa'i bya ba'o// //rab gnas byas pa'i lha rnams ni/ /ske yi las kyis bskang ba nyid/ /brtag pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /cho gas bdag nyid chen pos bsgrub/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ /me ni lha yi zhal nyid de/ /spyin sreg de nyid rnam par gnas/ /sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim/ /tshim pas dngos grub sbyin par byed/ /las rnams kun gyi dngos grub ni/ /sbyin sreg med par 'byung mi 'gyur/ /gsang sngags thams cad rab sgrub phyir/ /sbyin sreg las ni brtsam par bya/ /me yi gnas ni rnam shes nas/ /sbyin sreg rab tu brtag par bya/ /de yi 'du byed ma bskyed 1na/ /las ni 'bras bu med par 27—9pya9

'gyur / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /dbye dang bskrad pa la sogs/ la / /sbyin sreg las kyi rjes 'brangs pas/ /ji skad bshad pa thams cad bya//zhes so/ /chos kyi dbyings ni yongs gyur pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin las byung / /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes te/ /'bar ba'i phung po lta bu'i me/ /sa yi dbyibs kyis 'dzin par byed/ /thab kyis skye ba 'phel bar byed/ /shing gis lhag par dpa' bar byed/ /ku shas thams cad srung bar byed/ /don grub dkar pos zhi bar byed/ /'bras kyis rgyas par byed par 'dod/ /mar gyis phun sum tshogs kun byed/ /yam shing gzi brjid rnam 'phel byed/ /ti'/ gyis sdig pa 'phrog cing dge/ /so bas dpal dang nor 'gugs byed/ /sran mas stobs ni chen por byed/ /nas kyis rdzu 'phrul shugs rab sbyin/ /drur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed/ /gro yis nad ni nyams par byed/ /sbrang rtsi 'o mas shes rab sbyin/ /zho zan bde ba kun sbyin byed/ /me yis 'dod don dngos grub sbyin/ /rang 'dod lha yis grol ba ster/ /lhag ma las dang rjes mthun par/ /zhi sogs las byed shes par bya/ /dgang gzar shes rab blugs gzar thabs/ /de dag gnyis med bsgom pa'o/ /de las nges par 'thon pa'i mar/ /ye shes chen po'i bdud rtsir 'dod/ /de yis rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas/ /bdag nyid lha rnams tshim par byed/ /gang zhig de ltar sbyin sreg byed/ /skal bzang dngos grub phun sum tshogs/ /gsum dang bdun dang nyer gcig sogs/ /ji srid 'bum dang bye ba brgya/ /rang 'dod dngos grub rjes 'brangs pas/ /rgyud kyi dngos sogs yang dag 'dod/ /sreg blugs thams cad zhal la bsam/ /zas dang zhal bsil sogs phyag tu/ /rdzo7—960

— dod—dod —yam shing ku sha sogs 'od la/ /bdug spos thams cad 'bar ba la rnge tog la sogs kun dbu la/ /thugs kar dri la sogs pa kun/ /bsang gtor sku ni thams cad la/ /de bzhin zhabs bsil zhabs dag la/ /gos dang mchod phyir thogs la sogs/ /rgyan la sogs pa sku la'o/ /mar me mchod yon zhal zas kyi/ /mchod pa rim bzhin mdun du dbul/ /zhes pa sbyin sreg gi man ngag go/ /chos kyi yi ge las byung shin tu zlum pa'i thab dbus su/ /re 1pha las byung gtsug phud gsum pa oṃ yig chu skyes gnas/ /'bar ba'i nang du chu yi dkyil 'khor la gnas shin tu dkar/ /dag byed me ni bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i 'od zer phreng ba can/ /zhi ba spyan gsum ral pa'i tshogs ni yongs su bcings gyur cing / /mchod phyir thogs dang dkar po'i gos kyis lus ni rnam par brgyan / /g.yas kyi phyag gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang phreng bas yongs su brgyan/ /g.yon par dbyu gu yal ga gsum pa dang ni spyi blugs 'dzin/ /oṃ pā pa k+ṣasna ye swā hā/ bram ze dag las bslangs dang nor bu'i 'od las byung ba'i me/ /n+ya gro dha dang pispa la dang pā la sha dang chu skyes shing / /'bras chan 'bras yos nas dang 'o ma til dang khur ba dang / /yungs kar tsan+dan me tog dang ni ku sha'i rtse dang drurba'o/ /kha shar du lta ba dang nye bar spyod pa thams cad dkar po dang thab zlum po'o zhes pa zhi ba'i las kyi me'i las so// //'bar ba'i nang du sa yi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /dbang chen zhes bya'i ske ni shin tu ser ba nyid/ /gos dang rgyan ni kha dog ser po yang dag 'dzin / /dbyu gu bgrang phreng spyi drugs mchog spyin spyan gsum pa/ /phun 27—96/

tshogs mchog dang nad med shin tu rgyas byed pa/ /dpal ldan lus chen ral nga bzang po rab tu bcings/ /lus ni dag byed mchod phyir thogs dang ldan gyur cing / /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems ldan bzhin rgyas pa'o/ /oṃ ma/ ted+dhāgha ye swā hā/ rgyal po rgyal rigs shing gtsubs pa dang rin po che/ /tshong pa'i me dang dge 'dun tshong bang chen po'i rnge/ /ba ṭa tsadza ka sogs ya 1 dzñā sa sa m+bi/ /parka ṭi dang ko la a mra bi la 'bras tā la byes/ /gser 'od dzā ti che/ tog brgya pa kaṇi ka /zho zan bu ram dbu ba nas zan til 'khur khaṇ+ḍa rnams/ /thab khung gru bzhi dang kha byang du bya ba dang / nye bar spyod pa rnams kyang ser po'o zhes pa rgyas pa'i me'i las so// //'bar ba'i shing rta'i dbus su 'dod pa zhes bya'i me rnon po/ /nyin byed gzhon nu dang mtshungs lha yi lus ni rgyan dmar ldan/ /dang po'i phyag zung rtse mos dbyu gu shing dang lcags kyu ste/ /de las sbug shos phyag zung zhags pa dang ni spyi blugs 'dzin/ /dmar zhing mnyen la phra ba'i spyan gsum mdzes shing rjes/ su chags/ /spyi bor ral pa'i tshogs kyi cod pan bsgyings pa 'dzin byed cing / /brtan zhing rol pa'i 'jug pas bde ba kun du myong byed la/ /srid gsum skye bo rnams ni cho ga bzhin du dbang byed pa'o/ /oṃ kā māgha ye swā hā/ tshos byed gar mkhan rje'u rigs smad 'tshong ri mo mkhan gyi me/ /de bzhin dbang byed las kyi rgyun la legs bsngags yam shing ni/ /tsaspra si gru sidha la gu 2tsa dang ba ku la dang pri yad+ku/ /sha ra la dang dha ba dri zhim swā du kā dang ṣā ya rak+ta dang / sa mi seng ldeng pā la sha dang a mra bai kaṅka ta mya ngan med4/ /'dab ma g.yo dang 27—962

ba ṭa snang byed kāshra rī dang tsher ma sgur po dang / /rgya shug sbrang shing ka rā la dang kin+d+ra nā raṅga dang rgun 'brum shing / /pad+ma ut+pa la dang arka a sho ka dang klu thing ge sar dang / /me tog dmar po dang ni dzā ti mā la tī dang mā dha bī nyid ngang / /dmar po'i til dang 'bras kyi sa bon gu gul dang pa shu ba la dzā ta dang / /dbang gi rgyud dang brtag pa las ni gsungs pa yi/ /mngar gsum gyis ni byugs pa'i rdzas rnams thams cad do/ /thab ni zur gsum pa lcags kyu'i rnam nga/ dang nub dang rlung du kha phyogs pa dang nyer spyod rnams dmar po'o zhes pa dbang gi me'i las so// //'bar ba'i phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /hūṃ khros rnge yi 'od zer tshogs//dud ka khros shing 'jigs rung gzugs/ /mche ba drag gabyugs sgra ngan can/ /ma/dog nag rgyan gyis sgu brgyan zhing / /'jigs rung 'od zer tshogs rab gsal/ /skra tshogs dmar ser gyen du badze+es/ /spyan gsum sdang mig khro gnyer can/ /g.yas pa ral gri dbyug pa g.yo/ /g.yon ni zhags pa spyi blugs 'dzin/ /mi sngu ga gnyis rnged dpa' zhing gtum/ /lhag ma thams cad sngon bzhin no/ /bar ba lcags rus rdo ba tha ma'i mal/ /las byung srad bu mdog ngan khyem gyi me/ /phag gi khyem dang bha dadhi dang ta re ga /gaṇ+ḍa ka dang ring po mgrin rus ga laṇ+ḍa/ /go ṭa ra dang tsher ma can dang tik+ta shing / /bya rog 'ug pa bi ci sgo ka'i gshog pa dang / /tik+ta lung tang dang ni 'dab mchog ga se kai/ /rtog las yang dag sasungs pa'i bsreg bya mtha' yas rnams/ /thab ni zur gsum pa'am zla ba phyed pa lta bu'o/ /oṃ kro dhāgha ye dza hi tro ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye bar spyod pa 37 — 963

thams cad nag po'o zhes pa mngon spyod kyi me'i las so// //thun mtshams sprin dmar dang ni skya rengs dmar 'dra'i ske/ /dga' 'ing rjes su chags pa rab rgyas rang bzhin can/ /sgeg pa'i rgyan dang na bza' dang ni lhab lhab mdzes/ /yan lag mchog ni ral pa'i dpal ldan rgya chen lus/ /mchod phyir thogs 1kyis lus kyi phyed ni mdzes pa ste/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis lcags kyu dang ni sngags phreng dang / /g.yon pas kṛ t+yā sa ka dang ni spyi drugs/ 'dzin / /ri dwags e ne+e ya yi pags pa lus la yang dag gnas/ /a sho la dang kang ke li dang nas dang arka'i me tog rnams so/ /thabs ni lcags kyu'i rnam pa'o/ /oṃ lo hi tāgha ye swā hā/ nyer spyod thams cad dang phyag rgya tham/sa/ cad dmar po'o zhes pa dgug pa'i me'i las so// //bdud rtsi'i mig can me chen po/ /skra dang ba spu dmar ser can/ /mgrin pa mtho zhing gzi brjed che/ /sems can rjes su 'dzin byed pa/ /skra grol phyag bzhi lcags kyu dang / /dbyu gu zhags pa spyi blugs ldan/ /tshangs pa'i srad bu rus phreng can/ /rab gtum spyan gsum 'bar ba'o/ /arka si ṅge'i me tog sogs/ /rtog pa las gsungs sreg rdzas rnams/ /las kyi rab tu dbye ba las/ /thab ni ral gri'am rta babs dbyebs/ /oṃ a mṛ tāsna ye swā hā/ 'chi ba dang sdig pa dang nad rab tu zhi ba'i me'i las so// // dza ṭha 2ra dang gnyis med me ni shin tu rno/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mdog can 27—96 /

lus ni mdzes shing 'bar/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis yan lag brgyan//mdung dang mda' dang be+egs kyu dang ni spyi blugs 'dzin/ /'bras dang yungs kar la sogs pa rnams so/ /thab ni rin po che'i rnam pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā dza ṭha rāgha ye swā hā/ nor thams cad dang dpal 'gugs pa'i me'i las so/ //zad byed ces bya drag po'i me lha ni/ /lus la rab tu gsal ba'i gzi brjid bcings shing 'bar/ /phyag na mda' dang ral gri dbyug pa spyi blugs ldan//mi rus phreng can dbu skra ser skya gyen badze+es pa'o/ /'bras bu yod me+ed shing dang si dzu'i me tog sogs/ /thab ni gru gsum mo/ /oṃ k+ṣa yi ka ro grwagha ye swā hā/rengs pa dang mi snang ba dang bka' bzhin byed pa'i rnge'i las so// //rgyal ba'i sku mchog dag pas yan lag lnga/ /rnam par bkra zhing dka' thub ldan pa'i me chen po/ /ri dwags nag po'i pags pa'i na bza' nyid dag dang / /ral pa rnam bsgyings zhi ba'i rgyan ni nges par 'dzin/ /mchog sbyin bgrang phreng dbyu gu ril ba rnam par 'dzin/ /sna tshogs gos can mtha' yas gzi brjid yang dag ldan/ /tshangs skud dang bcas srad bu brel bas pad+mar gnas / /thab ni nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā tā pa sāgha ye swā hā/ rig pa 'dzin pa nyid dang mkha' la spyod pa'i mngon par shes pa'i ye shes kyi me'i las so// //ro zan me ni 'jig rten 'dzin pa rab tu gtum/ /cung zad dmar zhing 27—965

—sngo ba lus kun shing lta bu/ /ral gri spyi blugs sngags phreng dang ni dbyug gsum/ can / /ral pa dmar ser 'phyang zhing mig ni gyen bcings pa'o/ /thab rni mdung gi rnam pa'o/ /oṃ kra byā dāsna ye swā hā/ gsod pa dang gnod pa dang nad byed pa'i me'i las so// //shin tu rtsub cing dmar nag thal ba dhū sa ra/ /snying po'i lus can rlung zhes bya ba'i me ru 'dod/ /mig gsum ral can lus dang mgo bo rus pa'i bdag /ri dwags pags pa'i gos can rlung 'dra'i ri dwags zhon/ /ma rak+ta thal 'bar bas btsos pa'i gos 'dzin zhing / /mchod sbyin gsum gyi srad bu rgyan ldan mgrin pa mtho/ /lag par yal ga gsum dbyug bgrang phreng ga ṇi tī kā dang / /g.yo bas ba dan 'phyar zhing ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin/ /ba dan kyi rnam pa'i thab bo/ /oṃ ma ru tāgha ye swā hā/ 'ded pa dang sgod par byed pa'i rnge'i las so /rab tu rmongs byed ces bya shin tu zhi ba'i las/ /shin tu khebs pa'i lus can skye bo rmongs byed pa/ /rnam dag zhing yang sa shing mdzes pa'i mig ldan zhing //ral pa rab bcings rin chen 'bar ba'i cod pan can/ /rnam par bkra ba'i gos dang rgyan ni nye bar thogs/ /sgeg cing rol pa dpal ldan pad+ma'i go 'phang son / /shin tu dmar zhing rab bzhad ga be+e tri kā dang / /mchog kun rab sbyin dbyu gu gsum dang spyi blugs 'dzin/ /thab ni zur gsum pad+ma'i dbyibs can no/ /oṃ pra mo dāsna ye swā hā/ dpal gyi rig sngags chags par byed pa 37 966

— —dodargyal srid 'dod pa'i mo'i las so// //gang zhig thab ni rnam bcu rab byed rtogs pa yis/ /sems can bsam pa rab 'byams dngos grub legs sgrub phyir/ /dpal ldan khro rgyal dpa' bo sanyis med rnam rgyal ba'i/ /rgyud las rgyal ba stobs bcu mnga' bas yang dag gsungs / /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i yul sogs rnams las phyag rgya sngags/ /las kyi rab spyor dang ni cho ga nges pa ste/ /dpal ldan sdom pa 'byung ba che mchog sngags rgyal las/ /rdzas dang me dang sbyin sreg yul gyi de nyid gsungs/ /dpal ldan pad+ma 'byung ba'i rgyud rgyal rgyas chen las/ /pad+ma 'dra sogs thab kyi dag pa'i mtshan ma'i cha/ /rgyas pa la sogs las la nor rgyal gzugs dngos grub / /khyab bdag 'jig rten dbang pos rnam mang dngos grub phyir/ /dpal ldan pad+ma gar dang rta mgrin kha n+ya bā da dang / /sgrol ma 'byung dang mi g.yo tshogs bdag rtog pa'i rgyal po las/ /sna tshogs cho ga dge dang mi dge'i sgrub pa mtha' dag gi/ /dngos grub rgyu ru sbyin sreg las ni yang dag bsngags mdzad cing / /zhi ba la sogs las rnams kun la 'bras bu nyer spyod dang / /sdas la sogs pa'i bye brag cho ga rgya cher rab tu bstan/ /de yi lam tsam 'dir ni rmongs pa'i skye bos rtogs bya'i phyir/ /me yi bya ba'i cho ga'i khyad par rab tu bstan pa yin/ /gsad las thab ni sor brgyad de/ /rgyas pa la ni tshad bcu'o/ /dbang la bcu gnyis grangs yin te/ /zhi bar bcu bzhi'i bdag nyid do/ /bu sogs rigs 'phel ba la ni/ /sor mo bcu drug tshad yin no/ /glang po rta phyugs ma he sogs/ /'phel la sor ni bco brgyad do/ /yul du 'chi dang nad rdzo7— 967

la sogs/ /zhi phyir sor ni nyi shu'o/ /nor 'bru rgyal srid phun tshogs dag /'phel la sor mo nyi shu gnyis/ /dngos grub blo dang lus ldan ma/ /dgug 'a/ sor mo nyi shu bzhi/ /bsdus pa'i thab ni mdor bstan yin/ /rgyas par khru yi grangs kyis so/ /thab kyi phyed dam sum cha ni/ /zabs su rgyal ba mchog gis bzhed / /mchu dang kha khyer mu khyud rnams/ /thams cad kyi ni brgyad cha'o/ /zabs kyi phyed tshad de'i pad+ma/ /de yi sum chas lte ba'o/ /de dbus lte ba'i tshad dang ni/ /sbyar ba'i mtshan ma kun gyis mtshan/ /gru bzhi rin chen pad+ma'i dbyibs / /thab tu ku sha'i gdan la me/ /las thams cad pa'i ye shes me/ /yi ge gsum zhu'i chu la ni/ /pad+mar ram̐ gi sa bon skyes/ /sgu mdog dmar ser mdzes shing 'jam/ /g.yon na dbyu gu gsum spyi drugs/ /g.yas na bgrang phreng mchog sbyin 'dzin/ /spyan gsum ral pa'i len bu can/ /mgo bo thub pas gsal gyur cing / /nyi mar bzang po'i stegs kyis 'dug /cod pan rdo rje sems dpas mtshan/ /mchod phyir thogs ni dam pas brgyan/ /lha rdzas gos ni kun du gsal/ /bye bo dga' byed zhi ba'i gzugs/ /'dod don dngos grub kun stsol ba/ /de yi lto bar lha rnams kun/ /dkyil 'khor mchos tu rmad byung ba/ /ro ma re pha rdo rje mchog /gru gsum dra ba legs par dbul//rdo rje lcags kyu sogs spyor bas/ /sngags dang phyag rgya yang dag ldan/ /de nyid gsum ni rna ba ru/ /bkab ste ye shes me dgug bya/ /n+ya gro dha dang a shwat+tha//kaṅge li dang tsu ta dang / /mchod sbyin lus las byung ba yi/ /lcug ma sar pa dang ku sha /thab kyi dbus su legs 'du sha /'o ma sbrang rtsi bska ba yi/ shing dang mā dhā ya ldan pa/ /dge 'dun rgyal rigs rgyal po sogs/ /mchod 27—968

sbyin thab las skyes pa'i me'o/ /zhes pa sbyin sreg gi me'o/ /oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge/ /tshangs pa lha yi dag byed yin/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun mnyes/ /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /bgegs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol swā hā/ /ku sha'i 'dab ma dgram pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ tshur byen tshur byon 'byung bo che/ /lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod swā hā/ /ye shes kyi me nye bar byed pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥbibyān+ta kṛta sarba pā pa bisgo mā rā na bhasmin ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ yungs kar lnga 'dor ba'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ bibyān+ta kṛta sarba kle sho pa kle shāsgo shārnyi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ chu 'dor ba'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbispyon+ta kṛta sar+pā ba ra ṇi ma mā pa na ya hūṃ/ kham phor dkar po 'dor ba'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbispyon+ta kṛta sarba puju dzñā na sam+bha rā na phyo ka ya hūṃ swā hā/ zan 1'dor ba'i'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā 2ya bi sho dha ne+e hūṃ swā hā/ dri lnga la sogs pa'i khrus kyi'o/ /oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ/ gsar du me sbar ba'i'o/ /oṃ agha ye swā hā/ mar gyi'o//oṃ kā māgha ye a dī pyu dī bya ā bi shā bi shā ya hā sh-i ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya swā hā/mre'i dgang blugs kyi'o/ /oṃ bo bye bṛk+ṣu ya swā hā/ a shwat+tha'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yadzñā ya swā hā/ u dus+thā ra'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra la tā ya swā hā/ blak+ṣa'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ku be rā ya swā hā/ ba ṭa'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ha kā rā ya swā hā/ a mra'i'o/ /oṃ badzā rku ya swā hā/ arka'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra so mā ya swā hā/ pa lā sha'i'o/ /oṃ badzāṅgā rā ya swā hā/ seng ldeng gi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bu dhā ya swā hā/ a pa mārga'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sha naibya rā ya swā hā/ yam shing gi'o/ /oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā ya swā hā/ ku sha'i'o/ /oṃ badzā yu ṣe swā hā/ drurba dang kun+da'i'o/ /oṃ 27—969

—badz+ra bī dzā ya swā hā/ so ba'i'o/ /oṃ badz+ra be gā ya swā hā/ nas kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ gro'i'o/ /oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma'i'o/ /oṃ/ sarba pā pa da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ til gyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ ma grugs pa'i'o/ /oṃ sar+pārja sid+dhi ye swā hā/ yungs kar gyi'o/ /oṃ sarba sadza de swā hā/ zho dang bu ram gyi'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā dar+sha na pha khā ya saṃ swā hā/ ko la'i 'bru la sogs pa'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra bā se se hūṃ swā hā/ gos kyi'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra tadze+e lā ya swā hā/ so rtsi'i'o/ /me la sreg blugs sngags dang ni/ /spel ba rab tu sbyar bar bya/ /rang gi 'dod lha'i sngags kyis ni/ /dgang drugs legs par spyad par bya/ /zhes pa bsreg bya'i sngags so/ /de nas sngags pa mnyam gzhag pas/ /kha dog dri dang sgra'i rnam pas/ /de bzhin bzang ngan me yi ni/ /mtshan ma nye bar brtag par bya/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu 'dra / /ba mo spyi blugs lta bu dang / /put+pa rā ga dang 'dra bas/ /sems can sdig pa nyams par byed/ /kun+da zla ba ltar snum dang / /gzugs mdzes be+e ḍūr+ya lta bu/ /du ba med cing dri med pa'i/ /me yis nad med rigs 'phel byed / /ban+t+ra kibyu a sho ka /ya ba'i me tog 'dra ba dang / /'dam bu chu gsher gser lta bus/ /rgyal srid dbang phyug sogs dbang byed/ /tsadza utru/ la au shīr/ /mā la tī dang pad+ma mtshungs/ /ga pur kha che a ka ru/ /tsan+dan gla rtsi'i dri ldan pas/ /dri'o/ /pi wang gling bu rdza rnga sogs/ /dung dang cha lang sgra bzang dang / /sil snyan zab mo nges sgrogs pa'i/ /me yis kun la bde ba ster/ /sgra'o/ /dpal be+e'u gdugs dang dung 'dra dang / /rtse gsum bum pa lta bu dang / /rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdo rje mchog /bkra shis dang ni glang rdzo7—970

ngo/'i dbyibs/ /dga' ba la sogs g.yas su 'khyil/ /gcig tu bsdus pas don chen sbyin/ /rtse mo gcig tu 'bar ba'i me/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad byed/ /g.yo med rtse mo gnyis pa 'bring / /rtse mo bzhi pas legs rgyas spyin / /'di ni dge bar rig bya ste/ /de bzhin de las bzlog mi dge/ /sreg drugs sbyin sreg cho ga nyid kyis tsā ru rab bsgrub ste/ /'o thug khaṇ+ḍa bu ram 1dbu ba 'bras dang ldan/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang so sor ldan las legs grub zas/ /gser sogs snod du bzhag pa so sor dbul bar bya/ /oṃ slo j-i khaṃ hūṃ oṃ āḥhūṃ/oṃ di byādz+re sa mā bye dh+yā na spru ṇa ne+e swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis sbyangs te dbul bar bya'o//de bzhin gshegs pa'i lhag ma 'di/ /zos pas sdig pa nyams par byed/ /ces brjod nas mchod sbyin byed pa rnams la tsā ru'i lhag ma sbyin du gzhug par bya'o / /dgang blugs dang rnam pa mang po'i gos dang 'bras bu la sogs pas rnge/ dang bde bar gshegs pa dang mdo dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang bcas pa rnams yang dag par mnyes par byas nas/ gtor ma'i cho ga dang nye bar spyod nga/sa rdul tshon gye dkyil 'khor la sogs pa la gnas pa thams cad kyang yang dag par mchod de/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /gang gzhan nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma tshang bgyis pa de kun la/ /bdag la brtse bas bzod mdzad 'os / /shes rab ye shes dri med pas/ /slob dpon dang ni rgyal po dang / /spyin pa byed pa'i skye bo la'ang / /dus kun zhi dang bde legs mdzod/ /rang 'dod rjes 'brangs smon lam gyi/ /khyad par dag kyang gdab bya zhing / /dge 'dun tshogs kun mchod ston gyis/ /spro bar byas te gshegs su gsol/ /bya ba bcu ni yang dag bsdus pa rab bsgrubs pa'i/ /dge ba rnam dag ye shes bcu 27—97/

—yis sbyangs pa las/ /skye dgu'i yid kyi ma rig mun pa mthar byas te/ /myur du pha rol phyin mchog sa ni rab bgrod shog /me'i bya ba bcu pa'o zhes pa dbyig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba cho ga'i bya ba bcu pa rdzogs so// //gzhung 'di lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu'i 'dren pa dam pa chos kyi rje sprul sku rin po che'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' lung bzhin/ lo tsā ba dge slong chos skyong bzang pos sa skyong ba mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan dpon chen kun dga' bsod nams rin chen dbang gi rgyal po'i bdag rkyen las dpal e waṃ chos 'khor du bsgyur ba'o / / //bsdur mchan/948 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉stanang dpe bsdur byas yod/ 3〈〈co 〉〉pa la/95༷ 1〈〈co〉〉ma'i/951 1〈〈co 〉〉dra / 2〈〈co 〉dre/ 〈〈co 〉dze+e/952 1〈〈co 〉7ba/ 2〈〈co 〉laghān+ta/ 〈〈co 〉tsā/95t+ta 1〈〈co 〉d+kuṅgārga/ 2〈〈co 〉thatriṇ+ḍi/ — 〈〈co 〉༄'i/954 1〈〈co 〉〉'a sa na/956 1〈〈co 〉〉sgyu/ 2〈〈co 〉〉ṇi/959 1〈〈co 〉snga skyes/961 1〈〈co 〉lke/962 1〈〈co 〉7/ 2〈〈co 〉〉thu/ 〈〈co 〉〉pa 4〈〈co〉〉ba/964 1〈〈co 〉〉dze+egs/ 2〈〈co 〉〉dzan/969 1〈〈co 〉phron/ 〈〈co 〉〉ka 〈〈co 〉〉du/971 1〈〈co 〉〉dus/27—972
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1329)

༄ / /'dod pa'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ma shās+thā nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'dod pa'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsal dang yan lag bde stangs dang / /rigs dang rdzas dang sngags rnams ni/ /sngags pas shes nas 'jig rten 'dir/ /bde ba'i mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /bde ba'i khyad par bskyed pa'i phyir/ /drang srong swa ra ya nas gsungs/ /'dod pa'i bstan bcos 'bum sde las/ /klu sgrub kyis ni stong phrag gcig /basbus/ snye de las bdag gis kyang / /bde ba bsgrub phyir 'di gsung ngo / /'bad pas rol byed ma rnams kyi/ /mkhas pas bde ba bskyed par bya/ /yang na shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /rol byad 2ma yi rigs shes 'gyur/ /'dod pa bsten pa'i dus su ni/ /bud rnged rnams ni mgu bar 'gyur/ /bud med rigs ni rnam bathi ste/ /byes pa rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /pad+ma can dang dung can ma/ /rdzo7——97 /

——glang chen ma dang sna tshogs ma/ /ri bong dang ni khyu mchog dang / /rta dang de bzhin dgo ba dang / /pad+ma'i gdong can skal bzang 1ma/ /'dod pa'i kazugs can bud med mchog /khams gsum kun du grags pa yi/ /pad+ma can gyi mtshan nyid do/ /gdong pa ring zhing gzug 2bzang ma/ /skal ldan kun gyi yid du 'ong / /ngang pa'i 'gros can blo bzang ma/ /'di ni dung can ma zhes bya/ /tsho zhing cung zad mche ba can/ /yan lag ma nyams mdzes ldan mchog /mdog ldan skal bzang gsang ba thub/ /de ni glang chen ma ru grags/ /skyung ka'i dbyangs can yan lag gnag /sna tshogs gzugs can snyan par smra/ /byams ldan sems ni ma dkrugs mchog /de ni sna tshogs ma zhes bya/ /pags pa stong zhing 'jam pa dang / /gser gyi me tog dang mtshungs rtags/ /yan lag bkra zhing kha dog gnag /gang gi rtags ni de ri bong / /gdong pa ring 'ing skad bzang mchog /rol byed ma rnams mgu bar byed/ /pags pa dmar ldan rtsed mo mdzes/ /de yi 4rtags ldan khyu mchog yin/ /shin tu ring zhing sbom pa 5ni/ /dpag med yon tan ster ba'o/ /mgrin sngon dang ni mtshungs pa ste/ /'bras can ltar ni bshad pa yin/ /thung zhing sgom pa glang nya yin/ /brtan zhing rol byed ma yid 'ong / /rtags kyi tha snyad de yis ni/ /ri dwags dgo 6ba zhes su brjod/ /'dod pa'i bstan bcos mtha' dag las/ /rtags kyi mtshan nyid 'di bzhi bstan/ /lhan cig skres nga/ bad kan can/ /ring ba rlung can mkhris pa can/ /rked pa zlum zhing bzang mo ste/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang mtshungs mig /yongs su rdzogs shing 'dod pa rdzogs/ /skye gnas mdzes pa lhan cig skyes/ /bud med mdog dkar pad+ma can/ /yid 27— 975

'byung las byung 1ring bar bshad/ /tsho zhing gsang ba rgyas pa ni/ /grang ba'i reg ldan bad kan can/ /mgo yi sha rgyas bzang mo ste/ /kha yi 'gram gnyis/ shin tu dog2 /skra li mgo bo lhag par che/ /gang gi mtshan ma de rlung can/ /sbal pa'i rgyab 'dra mgrin pa sra/ /dro ba'i reg pa yang dag ldan/ /mdos ser zla mtshan myur ba ni/ /mtshan ma de yod mkhris pa can/ /dus kyi sor d+mā ri bong ste/ /de bzhin rgu ba khyu mchog bcad/ /rta ni lo yi zla ba'i tshad/ /bzang po'i tshad ni dgo 4ba'o/ /rigs kyi 5sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /mkhas nga/ rnams kyis 6shes par bya/ /bud med ngag 7gi rigs dag dang / /mtshon pas je tshom rnged par shes/ /pad+ma can ni nor sbyin mo/ /dung ma dri za mo ru bshad / /glang chen sha za ma yin te/ /sna / tshogs ma ni sring 1 mor bshad/ /ri bong pad+ma can gyi bdag /khyu mchog dung ma de bzhin te/ /rta ni glang chen ma yi bdag /sna tshogs ma ni dgo 11ba'o/ /nor sbyin mo ni nor gyis mgu/ /dri zhim spos sogs dri za mo/ /bza' dang bcas pa 1 sha za mgu/ /dpa' ba gnyis kyis shā srin mo mgu/ /rigs mi 7mthun pa mthun bya'i phyir/ /rdzas kyi spyor ba bshad par bya/ /lan brgya bkrus pa'i mar gyis ni/ /rtags ni 'bad pas bsku bar bya/ /gre la cung zad bsros gyur na/ /'dod pa'i dus su sbom par 'gyur/ /rtsa ba bcu pa'i bcud kyis len/ /bzhos thog 'o ma bsres te btung / /'dod pa'i nus pa med pa rnams/ /bzlog dka'i 'dod pa skye bar 'byung 15/ /sbal pa'i yan lag lnga blangs nas/ /chu skyes dmar po'i ze'u rte 'bru bsres/ /phye ma bha ga'i nang du ni/ /zhag gsum bcug pas chung bar 'gyur / /gang du zla ba gnas par ni/ /der ni 'dod pa rtag tu gnas/ /27 —976

sacig tu gyur pas mnyam pa'i bde/ /longs spyod grol bar mkhas pas bskyed/ /yul dang rigs kyi bye brag ni/ /shes nas las kyi tshogs rnams 1sbyar/ /so dang sen mo gnas rnams ni/ /chos kyi spyor bas shes par bya/ /tshes gcig la ni spyi bo ste/ /gnyis pa la ni rna bar bshad/ /gsum pa la ni sna ru ste/ /de/ bzhin bzhi pa gdong yin te/ /lnga pa la ni mgrin par gnas/ /drug pa la ṭi dpung par ro/ /bdun pa la ni snying gar gnas/ /brgyad pa de bzhin snyeng gar phyabastan/ /dgu pa lte bar blta bar bya/ /bcu pa skye rags 'khor bar gnas/ /bcu gcig pa ni gsang bar brtag /bcu gnyis pa ni brla dag gnas/ /bcu gsum pa ni pus mo ste/ /bcu bzhi pa ni byin pa gnyis/ /gnam stong la ni rkang bol du'o/ /yar ngo'i zla ba gnas la ni/ /rim bzhin du ni bzlog 4par bya/ /'phel dang 'grib pa'i tshul du ni/ /mkhas pas shes nas spel bar bya/ /smin drug dang ni smal po mgo/ /kha 5dang rta chung de bzhin te/ /bye dang phul dag tshes la ni/ /mkhas pas rtag tu spang bar bya/ /dus min la ni mi brtsam ste/ /rol byed ma dang phrad mi bya/ /gal te chags pas 'jug gyur na/ /the tshom med par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mnyam pa'i bde ba dus su ni/ /rol mo sna tshogs bsten par bya/ /bud rnged mchog rnams mgu bya'i phyir/ /dang po 6thun gnyis bsten par bya/ /so dang sen mos 8gdab pa ni/ /bde ba'i dus su bsten par bya/ /bde bas myos pa'i dus su ni/ /sen mo la sogs khyad par gdab/ /nyi ma zla ba 'pho dus dang / /zla ba zhag gi mtshams de bzhir/ /'chi bas 'dod pa spyad mi bya/ /bud med zla mtshan dus su ni/ /sa bon len pas spang bar bsngags9/ /skal ldan ma yi bha 27—977

ga las/ /mkhas pas me tog blang byas nas/ /bzhos thog 'o mar bsres byas/ nas / /bud med mo gsham rnams la ni/ /byen pas bu bzang skye bar 'gyur//gzhan gyis mi thub dkar po'i rtsi/ /sgud pa dkar pos dkri bar bya/ /bud med rked par bcing byas na/ /bde bar bu ni btsa' bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i bstan bcos 1rgyas pa las/ /bcing thabs bzhi po bshad par bya/ /pad+ma'i bcing thabs nyis log dang / /brla 2bsdams dang ni reg pa'o/ /bha ga la ni 'o byas nas/ /skye gnas lag pas ste bar bya/ /'bad pas liṅga bcug byas nas/ /dal bas brgyab pa brtsam par bya/ /rkang pa byin pas gnas byas nas/ /mgul nas rtag tu 'khyud par bya/ /sen mo yan lag 'dri byas nas/ /myur ba'i brgyab pa brtsam par bya/ /'di ni pad+ma'i bcing thabs te / /pad+ma can dang lhan cig brtsam4/ /'di ni pad+ma can dgyes pas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i yon tan te5/ /rkang pa gcig gis dzimanan byas nas/ /rkang pa gcig bcings khyad par du/ /'bad pas rtag tu chud byas na/ /'jam pa'i brgyab pa brtsam 9par bya/ /byin pa yis ni phye bas na/ /rang si byen pa'i nang du 'jug /de nas phrag par dgal bar bya/ /slar yang mgul nas gzung bar bya/ /rtags ni 'bad pas 'jug byas nas/ /yang dang yang du brgyab par bya/ /rang gi yon tan 'byung 'gyur na/ /'o mas lan gsum bkru byas nas/ /de bzhin bha ga bkru bar bya 1/ /dung can ma yi nu ma bzung / /snga ma'i 'dug stangs slar bcings nas/ /bsrub cing 1 sngags 'di brjod par bya/ /oṃ tsa la tsa la swā hā/ stong bzlas pas ni dngos grub ste/ /yon tan bslab rnams skye bar 'gyur/ /de 2ni gnyid log 'dug stangs te/ /27—978

——dung can ma dang lhan cig bshad/ /brla gnyis kyis 1ni brla bsdams te/ /nu ma lag pas gzung 2bar bya/ /byin khung gru mos phye byas nas/ /'bad nga/sa rtags ni 'jug par bya/ /de ni glang mo dag gis 4ni/ /rol byed ma yi byen pa phye/ /ma mchu tsum pa byas nas su/ /de yi 'og tu brgyab par bya/ /'di ni bsdams pa'i 'dug stangs te/ /glang chen ma la sbyar byas nas/ /yon tan rgyun rnams ster bar 'gyur/ /yan lag phan tshun 'khyud byas nas/ /rol byed ma yi nu drag 'jib/ /rang gi brla steng gzhag 5byas nas/ /rtags ni 'bad pas 'jug par bya/ /sa la bsdad par byas nas ni/ /de 'og ma/grin pa g.yas pas 'khyud/ /lag pa g.yon pa gtso bos gzung 6/ /yang dang yang du brgyab par bya/ /sna tshogs ma dang lhan cig tu/ /reg pa'i 'dug stangs tsog pur bshad/ /sna tshogs ma ni tsum pa nas/ /mgrin par 'khyud pas yon tan ster/ /de dang chang ni btung bar bya/ /bcud kyis len kyang khyad par du/ /yang dang yang du ngal so zhing / /so rtsi dag kyang bza' bar bya/ /tshig ni snyan par smra bar bya/ /'bad pas rigs kyi sgra ni brjod/ /dus shes pa yi mkhas pas ni/ /sna tshogs gos ni bgo bar bya/ /pad+ma'i dri can pad+ma can/ /dung ma mar gyi dri yis brtag /glang chen ma ni rdul dris so/ /khro ma'i dri yis sna tshogs brtag /nu ma babyung bar bya ba dang / /mkhas pas mang du tsum 7pa na/ /mgrin par 'khyud cing ma mchu myang / /de ltar las rnams byas nas ni/ /de nas glu dang gar rnams kyis/ /rol byed ma rnams mgu bar bya/ /'dod chags khyad par sbyar ba yis/ /'khor ba'i sbug bsngal skye mi 'gyur/ /'dod ldan gang zag rnams kyis ni/ /ser sna zhe sdang 27—979

—spang bar bya/ /dul zhing ngo tsha shes pa dang / /rol byed ma yi rtse zla rnams/ /'bad de kun du gsang bar bya/ /'jam pas 'dul te drag pos min/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i/ /'dod pa'i bstan bcos ①rgyas pa las/ /bsdus te gzugs bzang bdag gis ni/ /'gro la phan phyir snying por bsdus/ /'dod pa'i bstan bcos mdor bsdus pa slob dpon gzugs bzang gis mdzad pa bye gabs (〈// // 2bsdur mchan/974 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbyed/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sten/975 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zangs/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazugs/ kye〈〈snar 〉dod/ cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da sa/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpo/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgo/976 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'byung / 2〈〈pe 〉rnamadog — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi rgo/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ 6〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sum̐/ dza〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skadag sgyushe〈〈snar 〉rnamatshan/ ḍa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rismi /7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srin/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgo/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ 1/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ kho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur/ tsha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ze/977 1〈〈snar 〉〉rnam/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto bar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ka 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ni zlog 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lta/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpo'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdon/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mo/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉:mibakas / 978 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chos/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlab/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rtse/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉7ma /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadar/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 1〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibacings 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉chad / 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar rtsam/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / te3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha byas/ e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7bas/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dod/979 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / sgyu — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ga ngas bzhag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zung / /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra tsum/27dod980
98༷ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉torachos/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 bkra shis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1330)27wa 981

thug /rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa/༄1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tan+d+ra rja a 2ba tā ra/ bod skad du/ rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam snang mdzad chen ye shes ni/ /bde bar gshegs nga 'i thugs la gnas/ /rdo rje dbyengs la sogs pa'i gzugs/ /sangs rgyas la sogs 'khor lo bskor/ /de ltar chos kyi sku dang ni/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku/ /rnam snang mdzad dang thub pa yang / /rgyud 'di ston pa dag bstod nas/ /de nyid bsnyus pa'i rgyud las ni/ /de nyid rnam sgrub rim pa zhig /mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /legs par basbus te bshad par bya'o/ /rgyud 'di shin tu zab ces la/ /mtshan ma tha dad rab tu bstan/ /de bas de la 'jug pa tsam/ /bdag gis su ni 'di bgyis so/ /mi gnyis ye shes spyod yul ba/ /tshig gi spros pa ma lus grol/ /dus kun du ni de bzhin pas/ /de nyid ces ni bcom 27—985

ldan gsungs1/ /de phyir ye shes gang 'jug pa/ /de la'ang de nyid ces su bsgrags / /gang phyir de nyid spyod yul bar/ /nam yang slu 2bar mi 'gyur phyir / /de nyid basbus pa'i rgyud las ni/ /kun rdzob bden pa la gnas nas/ /de nyid mtshan nyid gzhan bstan pa/ /de dag mnyan pa nyid du gyis/ /rang gi ye shes mthu yi mtshan/ /rdo rje dbyings la sogs mtshan nyid/ /'gro ba'i don la mi slu bas/ /de nyid ces ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /ji ltar zhe na/bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis sngags kyi spyod pa la mos pa'i sems can gye tshogs rnams kyi don rnam pa mang po gzigs nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing stug po na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 4chen po don thams cad grub pa sprul pa byang chub kyi snying po na bzhugs pa la mngon par byang chub pa la rnam pa 5lnga bstan te/ rdo rje dbyings 6de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs su byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi ye shes rtogs /pa/pa'i gnas skabs kyi khyad par byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ma lus pa dpag bsam gyi shing dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 8bhelta bu 'bras bu'i ngo bo bla na med pa/kun du bzang po'i sems zhes bya ba rdo rje ltar mi shigs shebhe pa de'i rgyu'i gnas skabs na gnas pa de'i rigs kyi 1 bdag nyid dang bcas par 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyal po lta bur rang gi sems kyi bdag nyid bstan to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po de nyid rang gi ngo bo'i bye brag gis mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen dbang dang / 'od dpag tu med pa dang / don yod par grub pa'i bde bar gshegs pa zhes bya ba rnams su kha dog dang dbyebs ji ltar grags pa bzhin brtags nas/ de rnams 27—986

—las kyang ji ltar gnas pa'i rim pa bzhin du rang gis 1rtogs pa'i mthu'i khyad par gyi ngo bo de bzhin nyid dang / me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang /so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba rnams su rang gi ngo bo tha dad par bstan to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi bdag nyid kun du bzang po'i sems bskyed pa de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying ga na gnas par brtag pa sngon du byas te/ji ltar 'dod pa'i sems dpa' chen bo rnams bskyed pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gis de las byung nas rim pa bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje rgyal po dang / rdo rje chags pa dang /rdo rje dga' ba la sogs pa phal cher rang gi ming dang sngags kyi tshig dang / de dag rjes su mthun pa'i phyag rgyas phyag gnyis mtshan pa/ dpe med pa'i sku'i cha lugs 'dzin pa rang gi ngo bo'i bye brag tu byin gyis brlabs te gnas so/ /de rnams las kyang bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems chen po dus gsum du 'jug pa de nyid bde bar gshegs pa 'gugs pa dang / rjes su chags pa dang / mnyes pa la sogs pa mthu'i bye brag ngo mtshar rnams su bstan to/ /de nas yang de dag dang po nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa nyid las byung ba'i phyir rgyal ba'i rigs zhes grags so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' skye dgu'i bdag po de nyid 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten dbang po dang / nam mkha'i snying po rnams rang gis brtags pa'i sku la snying po 2gnas par bstan nas/ de'i rjes su mthun par 27—987

sgu'i tshogs du mar gyur te/ de dag nyid kyi phyag na gnas pa'i phyag rgya'i mtshan ma rdo rje dang pad+ma la sogs pa las byung nas rnam pa mang por gnas par brtags so / /de rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi dbang phyug de nyid rang gis byas pa'i sku'i tshogs kyi bye brag gdug pa mang po 'dul ba dang /rnam par dag pa'i chos la gzigs pa dang / skye bo phongs pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa mtha' das gi yon tan gyi 1khyad par mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin rnams khyad par med par yang dag par bskyed do/ /rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / rin po che'i rigs la sogs pa yang rdo rje la sogs pa las byung ba'i phyir de dag rnam par bkod do //de dag kyang rgyas par rgyud 'di nyid du rigs so so'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha sems dpa' 'byung ba las bstan te/ de bzhin du rgyud 'dir gtogs pa'i rigs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan nyid de rnams phyag rgya chen po dang / dam tshig dang / chos dang /las kyi phyag rgya sgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan pa las bshad pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i nam mkha'i dbyengs thams cad na rtag tu khyab par gnas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam par 'jug pas rdo rje dbyings rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi sems dpa' zhes bya ba la sogs pa bshad pa nas kun du bzang po byang chub sems dpa' chen po ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje la gnas so zhes bya ba'i bar du 4de ltar gsal bar bstan mod kyi/ 'dir yang mdor bstan te/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan sems dpa' de nyid ni/ /rdorje 27—988

sems dpa' bdag nyid gtso/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ /sems dpa' brtan pa rang byung ba/ /sems dpa' rnams kyi sems dpa' mchog /thugs kar rdo rje bsgoms pas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba/ /rdo rje de 'a/ rab tu gnas/ /de nyid ye shes tshul gyis su/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od mnyam med/ /thugs las sna tshogs byung nas ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs su gyur nga/ yang / /sems can kun gyi rdul snyed kyi/ /rgyal ba dag tu de nyid gyur/ /rdo rje sku ni de rnams las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag byung / /de las dang po'i sems dpa' yi/ /mtshan ma thams cad rab tu byung / /mtshan ma las kyang sems dpa' che/ /de rnams las kyang tshul 'di kun/ /zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /de nyid bsdus pa chen po las kyang / bcom ldan rnal 'byor de nyid ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' don chen stsol 1/ /rigs lnga yi 2ni khyad par gyis / /spyod dang mi spyod bcas par rol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dpal mchog dang po las kyang don 'di nyid gzhung 'dis bstan te/ sngon mtha' med pa/'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po thams cad bdag /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /sems can kun gyi sems gang yin/ /brtan pa'i phyir ni dpa' zhes bya/ /mnyam par gzhag pas ting 'dzin gnas/ /nges pa las ni rdo rjer gyur/ /sems dpa'i byin rlabs tshul gyis ni/ /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /byang chub spyod pa'i rjes mthun pa/ /bdud dang bdud las rgyal ba nyid/ /byang chub sangs rgyas de nyid de/ /rdo rje drag po mthar byed pa/ /phyag na rdo rje nyid kyang de/ /de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /27—989

nges par rdo rje rigs chen po/ /de nyid pad+ma'i rigs dag pa/ /de nyid nor bu'i rigs bzang bshad/ /de nyid chags pa'i sgo ru bstan/ /'dod dang grol ba de nyid de/ /dus gsum srid gsum mchog gsum ste/ /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum pa/ /de nyid gnas pa kun gyi mchog /brtan la sra ba che zhing stug /'gro ba'i 27sems ni 'dus byas pas/ /thams cad byed pa thams cad nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs so zhes kyang rnal 'byor gyi tshul las bstan to / /de nyid las rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtso bo yin par yang bsgrags te/ 'di skad du theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa chung ngu las kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid che ba bstan pa las bshad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas phyag bya zhing / /mchod cing bstod de bkur bar 'os/ /gang phyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems/ /byang chub sems ni khyod la bya/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub khyod la brten/ /khyod ni thams cad gzigs pa'i yab/ /byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yi/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams khyod la brten/ /sems dpa' rnam pa thams cad mkhyen/ /brtan pas de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bshad pa ste/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i snying po yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun de nyid/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /dad pas gang zhig dad de yang / /de bzhin gshegs pas phyag byar 'os/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa nyid rnam pa du mar de kho na nyid ces bya bar 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i phyir bzhugs par blo gros rab tu dri mamed 27—990

pa rnal 'byor gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud len 'dod pa'i sems can dam pa rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ /gang gi phyir dngos grub khyad par can ji ltar 'dod pa'i bde ba 'byung ba rnams kyang de dag dang mnyam par ldan na bde ba 1nyid kyis de'i go 'phang myur du thob ste/ bdag nyid chen po sras dang bcas pa de dag mnyes par byas nas sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs nus pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad do/ /de bas na gang bdag nyid che ba rang bzhin gyis rlabs che bas/ de ༄ —sems can gyi tshogs chen po la rnam pa thams cad kyis phan 'dogs ༄ par bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir yon tan rin po che mtha' yas pa'i tshogs la gnas pa 'jig rten gsum po thams cad kyi dbang phyug chen ngo/ rgyun mi 'chad par 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don mdzad pa'i bde ba ring por 4mi thogs par thob ltapar 'dod pa de la de'i phyir sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas de dag /thob par byar rung ba nyid du dgongs pa chen po mdzad do/ /de rnams kyis kyang de'i phyir 7sgrub pa'i thabs su rang gis brtags pa'i lha'i ngo bo nyid kyi bye brag tu gyur pa phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa bzhi 'dir bstan te/ ji skad du/ji ltar 'jig rten 'dul gyur pa/ /de ltar dngos grub myur du bstan/ /de la thabs ni phyag rgya che/ /dngos grub thams cad rab sgrub pa/ /ji ltar phyag rgyas 'grub 'gyur ba/ /de ltar byang chub spyod la sogs/ /thabs kun cho ga'i rim pas kyang / /sangs rgyas sems can don mi 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa mnyes par bya ba de rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du gtogs par gsungs pa nyi tshe skabs 'dir gleng bar rig par bya ste/ gang gi phyir zhe na/ de dag nyid mnyes par 27—991

bya ba'i phyir cho ga bsnyus pa yin te/ de bas na phyag rgya chen po dang / dam tshig dang / chos dang / las kyi phyag rgya'i sgra rnams spyi'i rgyud 7nas bshad par bya'o/ /de la lha nyid kyis de'i bdag nyid dam/ de'i cha shas kyis gang khyad par med pa 2bstan pa de dag ni phyag rgya zhes bya 1ste mtshan ma zhes bya ba'i don to/ /phyag rgya dang mtshan ma dang / rtags dang / nye ba'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba rnams ni don tha dad par ma yin te/ ji lta zhe na/ lha'i ngo bo nyid dam / de'i cha shas kyis bye brag med par brtags te sgrub pa pos lha gang rjes/ su dran par 'dod pa de la dmigs nas dran pa skye bar 4'gyur te/ de'i phyir 'di de'i nye ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /de bas na don de rgyud 'di nyid dang /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba nyid phyalas kyang gsal ba nyid du bstan te/ji skad du re zhig 'di nyid las/ 'da' dka' de bzhin mi shigs pa/ /rgyal po'i 6phyag rgya mchog gi rtags/ /bdag nyid chen po mtshan ma'i gzugs/ /de bas phyag rgya zhes bsgrags so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'jig rten gsum las/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa las kyang / sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi 8 / /gzugs brnyan gyi ni spyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya thams cad khyad par 'di/ /bskyed par rab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes bshad nas don dam pa de kho na nyid phyag rgya yin no zhes kyang bshad do/ /'dir gzugs brnyan zhes smos pa ni lha'i mtshan ma'i mtshan nyid du bstan pa ste/ de'i phyir mi 'dra ba'i mtshan ma la yang gzugs su bshad pas na mtshan nyid ma rdzogs pa la sogs pa'i nyes par yangami 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa 9zhes bya ba yang 'dir gang zag dang chos la bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid yin par blta'o7/ /gzhung gzhan dag las kyang don dam 27—992

pa'i lha'i mtshan ma'i mtshan nyid phyag rgya yin par bstan te1/ ji skad du/ chos kyi dbyengs ni mdo ru na/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya 4che zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs so//de la chos kyi dbyings zhes bya ba'i sgra ni don dam pa dang / de dang 'byel pa'i lha'i khyad par rnams la bya ste/ dper na skabs kha cig tu rgyal po zhes bya ba'i sgra sa rgyal po dang / de dang 'byel ba'i 'khor la'ang bya ba bzhin no/ /chos kyi dbyengs bye dang 'brel par brjod pa de yang gang yin zhe na/ gang dag gis de rtogs nas rnam par dag ste/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa ji ltar rigs par 'byung ba ste de bas na/ 'dus ma byas las byung ba ni 'phags pa'i gang zag go zhes bya ba yang de nyid la bya'o/ /yongs su ma dag pa'i lhar snang ba rnams kyang yang na ni de lta bus 'dul ba'i skye bo rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa nyid dam/ yang na ni cho chos kyi dbyings kyi phyogs la goms par byas pa las bsod nams bskyed pa'i skye bo thob pa dag de lta bur snang ngo / /yang 5ye de rnams kyang chos kyi dbyings dang 'brel pa nyid du shes par bya ste/ de bas na thams cad du phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid mthun 4 pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya de yang 'dir sku la sogs pa'i bye brag gis phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba dang / las kyi dam tshig dang / chos dang / las kyi phyag rgya dang rnam pa bzhir bstan te/ de la lha'i sgu'i gzugs brnyan ni phyag rgya chen bo ste/ ji ltar zhe na 'dra ba'i phyir lha de dran pa'i rgyur che bas na phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /de'i mtshan nyid kyang rgyud 'di dang gzhan las kyang phyag rgya chen po'i cho ga las kyang bstan te ji skad du rgyud 'di las/ sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje yi/ /27—993

gzugs brnyan gyi ni spyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid chen po phyag rgya che/ /de ltar shes na 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du rgyud gzhan das las kyang / sku gsung thugs ni rdo rje dag /ji ltar bris pa'i tshul bzhin du/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya dang ldan na/ /sems dpa' chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /'es/ gsungs so/ /de la bris pa'i tshul bzhin du zhes bya ba ni lha'i 3sku'i gzugs brnyan ji ltar bris pa mtshan mar brtag 2pa sngon du byas te/ de'i rjes su mthun par yid kyis lha'i sku'i gzugs brnyan nyid ji ltar rigs par bdag dang /lha de bye brag med par bsam mo zhes bya ba'i don to/ /lha'i sgu'i gzugs kyang 'dir rnam pa gnyis te gcig ni phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa'i lha'i sku'o/ /de las gzhan pa ni rdo rje dbyengs kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa ste phyag rgya lha'i sku'o/ /de gnyis las gzugs 4kyi lha mo rnams ni de lta bus 'dul ba'i 'gro ba'i dbang gis phyag rgya la sogs pa yan lag mang po'i mtshan nyid du bud med kyi gzugs sbas nas/ de'i brdar gyur pa mchod rten khri la bzhugs pa la sogs pa phyag rgya'i gzugs su 'dir bstan to/ /de bas na rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba bris pa'am/ byas pa'am/ ngo bo gzugs sam de bsgoms pa las byung ba ni gzungs kyi lha mo'i phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /yang na rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa de dag nyid kyi phyag rgya lag par bkod cing bcings pa dag kyang gzungs 5kyi lha mo de dag nyid kyi phyag rgya chen po'i rang gi ngo bo ston par byed pa yin te/ de'i rjes su mthun par lhamo de rnams kyi sgu dran par bskyed pa'i phyir bstan par rig par bya'o/ /phyag rgya chen po de dag thams cad kyang phyi nang gi bye brag gis rnam pa gnyis su rig par 27—991

——bya ste/ de la bris pa la sogs pa'i gzugs ni phyi rol gyi'o/ /de las gzhan nga/ lha'i sku'i gzugs brnyan yid kyis bsams pa ni nang gi yin te/ 'di ni phyag rgya chen po'i don bstan pa'o/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i don bshad par bya ste/ de la dam tshig gi phyag rgya mtshan ma sor mo bkod pa'i bdag nyid ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi thugs gsang ba ni dam tshig ces bya ba'i sgrar brjod de/ rgyud nas bshad pa ni yang dag par 'thob pa'am/ rtogs par bya ba'i phyir ram/mi 'da' ba'i don du dam tshig ces bya'o/ /gang gi phyir zhe na/ de rang gi yu/la gyi 7de kho na nyid ni 2 dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis nami 'da' ba'i ngo bo zhes sngar bshad pa yin no/ /de lta bas na lha'i thugs gsang 4ba'i mtshan ma ni dam tshig ces bshad pa'i don te/ de bas na rgyud 'di nyid dang gzhan las kyang dam tshig gi phyag rgya sgrub pa na bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te snying ga'i phyogs su bzhag la rang gi snying gar sems rdo rjer bsam mo zhes bshad do/ /de'i mtshan nyid kyang gzhung chen po las bshad pa/ rang gi sems ni rab rtogs pas/ /zla ba las ni rdo rje bsgom//rnam gsum gcig tu bsgom pa ni/ /thugs kyi gsang ba 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thugs kyi mtshan ma gang yin pa de ni de'i don du na de'i gnas kyi mtshan ma yang yin par rig par bya ste/ shes pa dang shes pa bo tha mi dad pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du gzhan dag las 5kyang / sgu gsung thugs ni rdo rje rnams—/ /sor mo dz+rel bas 6brtan pa ste/ /dam tshig sems las shes par bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya gnyis su bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sgu dang gsung dang thugs 27—995

—gsang ba rnam par dbye ba ni de'i mtshan ma dang brdas gzhung 'di nyid du de rnam par bkod pas 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la gzigs nas bstan to/ /rgyud gzhan dag las ni sku la sogs pa bsdus pa nyid la phal cher dam tshig gi phyag rgyar btags pa dag snang ngo / /yang na sems dpa' chen po rnams de las mi 'da' bas na lha mi 'da' ba'i mtshan nyid kyi dam tshig dang ldan pa'i phyir dam tshig dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya la dam tshig gi phyag rgya zhes bya'o/ /yang na de dag nyid mi 'da' ba yin pas na de nyid la dam tshig gi phyag rgya zhes 3bya ba'i sgrar brjod de/ ji skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis kyang / /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pas/ /phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bshad/ /sku gsung thugs ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /zhes bya ba 'di gsungs so/ /phyogs 'di la ni dam tshig nyid phyag rgya yin pas na dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o zhes rgyud nas bshad par bya'o/ /grags pa'i sgra ni yul so sor nges par shes par bya ste/ de bas na phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa la dam tshig gi phyag rgya zhes gdags 3snapa'i rgyu srid du zin kyang de ltar mi brjod do/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya de dag kyang rdo rje dang / lcags kyu dang / mda' dang / mnyes pa la sogs par 'du shes pa ste/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i sgra de rnams kyi dgongs pa bshad pa rgyud 'di las bshad de/ 'di skad du/ bcom ldan sems dpa' de nyid ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting 'dzin ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sgrub pa'o/ /shin tu 'bigs pas rdo rje'o/ /mchog tu spyor bas lcags kyu'o/ /phra mor 'bigs pas mda' yin no/ /mgu bas dge ba byed pa ste/ /spras pas 4rin po che ru bshad/ /nyi ma gzi brjid ces su brjod/ /bsgreng bas 27—996

rgyal mtshan zhes bstan te/ /bzhad pas gad mo zhes su grags/ /'dod chags dag pas pad+ma ste/ /nyon mongs dgra gcod /ral gri'o/ /dkyil 'khor tshul bas 'khor lo ste/ /tshig tu brjod pas smra zhes bya/ /sna tshogs thams cad rdo rje'i phyir/ /mi tshugs spyor bas go cha'o/ /'jigs pas spyor ba mche ba ste/ /bcings pa'i tshul gyis khu tshur ro/ /ji ltar bcom ldan sems dpa' d+mā / /rdo rje sems dpa' thams cad du/ /de bzhin rdo rje la sogs mtshan/ /bsgoms na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos kyi tshig gi 27rang bzhin gyi mtshan ma ni chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ badz+ra dzñā na dang / sa ma ya ste/ zhes bya ba 3la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /chos zhes bya ba'i sgras ni 'dir gsung gi bdag nyid kyi lha ni bshad pa'i chos nyid la bya'o / /gang gi phyir de bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi gsung thams cad ni don dam pa'i chos ston pa dang / gzhan la phan pa ston pa'i ngo bo yin pas ni 4 bshad pa'i chos kyi bdag nyid yin te/ de'i phyir phyag rgyar gyur pa badz+ra dzñā na zhes bya ba la sogs pa chos kyi phyag rgya'i tshig rnams la ni chos kyi phyag rgya zhes bshad do/ /de bas na chos kyi phyag rgya sgrub pa'i tshe lce la rdo rje sgom 5mo zhes gsungs so/ /'di ltar gzhan dag las kyang gsung gi 6gsang ba bshad pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya nyid du ston te/ ji skad du/ rdo rje tshig gi spyor ba yis chos kyi rang bzhin phyag rgyar brjod/ /'di ni gsal ba gsung 'chang ba/ /rdo rje'i 7tshig be+e sgra med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang na lha'i gsung gi mtshan ma'i rang bzhin ni chos kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid de/ de'i tshe chos nyid phyag rgya bas na chos kyi phyag rgya zhes rgyud nas bshad par bya'o/ /lha'i gsung gi brdar bstan 27—997

— — —pa'i yi ge de yang pha rol la phan pa ston pa'i ngo bo yin pas na chos nyid yin te/de'i rang bzhin gyi phyag rgya la chos kyi phyag rgya zhes gsungs so/ /'dir yang smra ba po dang tshig tha mi dad pas na de'i rang bzhin gyi mtshan ma yang 1don du na yan lag dang bcas pa'i lha'i ngo bo nyid byin gyis rlob par bstan pa yin no/ /de bzhin du phyag rgya gzhan rnams la yang phal cher bstan te/ 'di ni chos kyi phyag rgya'i rgyud nas bshad pa'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i sgra'i don yang bshad par bya ste/ de la lha'i las kyi mtshan ma ni las kyi phyag rgya ste/ byang chub mchog la sogs pa'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid do/ /de bzhin du de sgrub pa'i tshe las sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje rtse mo thams cad pa las thams cad sgrub pa lus kyi snying ga'i phyogs su de sgrub pa pos bsam par bshad de/ 'dir yang las nye bar bstan pa'i sgo nas yan lag dang bcas pa'i lha'i ngo bo nyid nye bar ston par don gyis shes par bya ste/ las dang byed pa po tha mi dad pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i ngo bo nyid kyi bye brag bshad zin to/ /de dag thams cad kyang rnam pa gnyis te/ lhar brtag pa'i rang bzhin dang / dam tshig can gyi skye bos brtags pa'o/ /de la lha rnams kyis sprul pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa gang yin pa'am gang lha'i ngo bo nyid dam/ de'i cha shas su bye brag rnged par byas te brtag 6pa de ni lhar brtags pa'o/ /gang yang lha'i lus las/ de dang rjes su mthun par dam tshig can gyis bskyed pa'i lha'i ngo bo nyid dam/ de'i cha shas su bye brag med par mos pa de ni dam tshig can gyi skye bos brtags par grags so/ /des lhar brtags pa'i phyag rgya lha'i bdag nyid du sngags pas bsgom pa'i don du byin gyis rlob par mdzad do zhes tsho7— 998

phal cher bshad de/ gang gi phyir zhe na/ dam tshig can gyi skye bos brtags pa'i phyag rgya la sngon dam tshig mdzad pa'i rjes su dgongs nas lha rnams kyis byen gyis rlob par mdzad de/ ji skad du/ gang dag bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs tshogs/ /dam tshig nyams kyis 'jigs pas na/ /byen gyis rlob pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du dam tshig can gyi 1skye bos brtags pa'i yi ge'i rang bzhin gyi lha'i ngo bo nyid kyang dngos su lhar brtags pa'i lha'i ngo bo nyid du byen gyis rlob par mdzad par blta'o/ /de bzhin du rgyud gzhan las kyang / bdag lhar byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir yi ge'am phyag rgyar rnam par brtag go zhes bshad do/ /ji skad du/ de nas phyag rgya'am yi ge yis/ /rdo rje'i lus su bsgyur bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du yang 3yi ge lnga'am/ yi ge gsum mam/ yi ge'i phyi mo'am/ yi ge mang po bkod pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis rlob par 'gyur bas na bde bar gshegs pa nyid du bshad do/ /phyag rgya ya nga mo dā dan da mu dā 4ste/ mgu bas na phyag rgya'am/ mu dā ltan mu dā 6ste/ phyag rgyas 'debs pas na phyag rgya bas de skad ces bshad do/ /gang gi phyir zhe na/ des srog chags rnams bsrung ba'i phyir phan gdags pa dang / 'dod pa'i dngos grub myur du 'grub nga/'i phyir rgyas 'debs te/ ji skad du/ ji ltar rgyal po rang gi rgyas/ /rgyal po'i gabyugs ni btab pa ltar/ /bdag chen nyid kyi phyag rgyas kyang / /skye bo rnams la de bzhin btab/ /ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin du gzhan dag las kyang gsang ba'i bdag po de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rgyan du gyur pa chos kyi dbyengs rtogs pa'i mtshan ma phyag rgya'i rim par dbye ba'i le'u rgyas pa zhes bya ba 27—999

yod do/ /des brgyan 1na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'khor bar 'khor ba na 2'gro ba thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan mas — btab pas lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kun du 'byol bar 'gyur zhing de rnams kyang de dag gi bka' nyan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /phyag rgyas de ltar byin gyis rlob pa de yang skyes bu'i skal ba dang / mos pa dang / mnyam par gzhag 5pa rnam pa gsum las chung ngu dang / 'bring po dang chen po'i bye brag rnam pa gsum du 'gyur ro/ /de bas na dam tshig can gyi skye bos brtags pa'i phyag rgya'i sgo nas lhar bsgom pa goms pa dang ldan pa chen po dang / 'bring po dang / chung ngu'i bye brag gis dgos pa yang rnam pa gsum du 'grub par bshad do/ /yang na srid pa dang /mya ngan las 'das par so sor bcings pa'am grol ba'am/ don chen po la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs rnams 'jigs par byed pas na phyag rgya zhes bya'o/ /gzhung gzhan dag las kyang rgyud nas bshad pa 'di rnams gzhan du bstan pa/'di ni dam tshig rtsa ba ste/ /dbu rgyan bcings pa rgyu yi mchog /gang gis lus kun brtan pas na/ /de bas phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs so / /de kho na nyid rab tu dbye ba basbus pa'o/ /de bas na bdag nyid chen po des de rig par byas nas nges par sems can gyi tshogs chen po la phan gdags pa'i phyir go 'phang dam pa thob par 'dod pas bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad la bdag nyid phul nas bdag gis lhag pa'i lha sems dpa' gang yang rung ba cig 6ji ltar yongs su 27—/000

—bzung ba mnyes par byed pas gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub bsgrub par bya'o/ /1mnyes par bya ba'i yan lag rnams kyi bye brag kyang 'dir phal cher lung gi tshig gis blta bar bya'o/ /de'i phyir de'i thabs kyi cho ga shes pa'i bla ma rin po che mnyes pa nyid du bya'o/ /de nas bla ma mnyes par byas pa 2des bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dang / dam tshig dang / chos dang las kyi dkyil 'khor du cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du dbang bsgur bas jeg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i cho gas sdom pa gzung ba dang / yongs su bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig dang /'dul ba dang / spyod pa dang / spyod yul rnams la cho ga bzhin du mkhas par byas pas de phyin chad dam tshig la sogs pa ji ltar blangs pa bsrung ba'i phyir rtag tu spro ba mi glod par bya ste/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don ma lus par sgrub 4pa la de thog mar 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /dam tshig kyang skabs 'dir ni 'bras bu 'dod pa rnams kyis mi 'da' bar bya ba yin pas rang gi lhag pa'i lha mnyes par 'gyur ba dang / rjes su mthun pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi spyod pa dge ba dang mi dge ba la sogs pa la 'jug pa dang ldog pa'i mtshan nyid de ston pas gsungs pa'i tshul gyis 5khyad par ro/ /kun 'thob cing 'gro ba'am/'dir kun rtogs shing chud par 'gyur bas na rgyud nas bshad pa la dgongs nas dam tshig ces bshad do/ /de yang lha thams cad thun mong ba dang khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ rgyud 'di dang de las gzhan pa'i dpal mchog dang po la sogs pa cha mthun pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams dang / rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor gyi tshul thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa rnams las bshad par rig par bya'o/ /de gnyis las rgyud gzhan las gsungs pa lha tsho7—— /00/
